provenance.rawSnippet: Prajñāpāramitā-hṛdaya-sūtra Oṃ Namo Bhagavatyai Ārya-prajāpāramitāyai! Ārya Āvalokiteśvaro bodhisattvo gambhīraṃ prajñāpāramitā-cāryāṃ caramāṇo vyavalokayati sma, pañca-skandhās tāṃś ca svabhāva-śūnyān paśyati sma. Iha Śāriputra rūpaṃ śūnyatā, śūnyat'aiva rūpaṃ, rūpān na pṛthak śūnyatā, śūnyatāyā na pṛthag rūpaṃ, yad rūpaṃ sā śūnyatā, yā śūnyatā tad rūpaṃ. Evam eva vedanā-saṃjñā-saṃskārā-vijñānam. Iha Śāriputra sarva-dharmāḥ śūnyatā-lakṣaṇā anutpannā aniruddhā amalā avimalā anūnā aparipūrṇāḥ. Tasmāc Chāriputra śūnyatāyāṃ na rūpaṃ na vedanā na saṃjñā na saṃskārāḥ na vijñānaṃ, na cakṣuḥ-śrotra-ghrāṇa-jihvā-kāya-manāṃsi, na rūpa-śabda-gandha-rasa-spraṣṭavya-dharmāḥ, na cakṣur-dhātur yāvan na mano-vijñāna-dhātuḥ, n'āvidyā n'āvidyā-kṣayo yāvan na jarā-maraṇaṃ na jarā-maraṇa-kṣayo na duḥkha-samudaya-nirodha-mārgā na jñānaṃ na prāptir n'āprāptiḥ. Tasmāc Chāriputra aprāptitvād bodhisattvo prajñā-pāramitām āśritya viharaty acitt'āvaraṇaḥ. Citt'āvaraṇa-nāstitvād atrasto viparyās'ātikrānto niṣṭhā-nirvāṇaḥ. Tradhva-vyavasthitāḥ sarva-buddhāḥ prajñāpāramitām āśritya anuttarāṃ samyak-sambodhim abhisambuddhāḥ. Tasmāj jñātavyaṃ prajñāpāramitā mahā-mantro mahā-vidyā-mantro'nuttara-mantro samasama-mantraḥ sarva-duḥkha-praśamanaḥ satyam amithyatvāt. Prajñāpāramitāyām ukto mantraḥ, tadyathā - Oṃ gate gate pāragate pārasaṃgate bodhi svāhā. Ity ārya-prajñāpāramitā-hṛdayaṃ samāptam.

verses.meaningZh: 彼、彼圣母（阴性主格）以及具足湖或，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·六度满行清净，彼·天人·人道·阿修罗·音乐及世间、世界，以世尊此，宣说演畅·归命敬礼·破有相福德光，如是（结句印定）
verses.meaningEn: She, that and a lake + endowed with or, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & perfection of the six pāramitās, he + god + Human Realm + Asura and world, realm, Bhagavān + hence, speaking, bowing, thus, so it is stated

titleZh: 【梵本原典】大白傘蓋佛母無能勝大迴遮母陀羅尼經 (DSBC No.4 / GRETIL 梵本)
titleEnglish: Uṣṇīṣa-Sitātapatrā Invincible Sovereign Protection Dhāraṇī (GRETIL bsu004_u.htm)
translatorZh: 哥廷根大学 GRETIL / 尼泊尔 DSBC 梵文贝叶经校勘本 (Sitatapatra)
sutraSourceZh: GRETIL 梵文佛典库 (bsu004_u.htm) · 汉译对勘：T19n0976
deityZh: 大白傘蓋佛母 (Sitātapatrā)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 本条目直接构建自德国哥廷根大学 GRETIL 梵语原典档案「bsu004_u.htm」（共 159 行，完整提取核心真言与经句共 38 句）。系统已自动将其原始 IAST 梵文实时转写为天城文、唐代悉昙梵字、唐宋古汉语音译、现代梵音拼读参考、国际音标 (IPA) 及摩多轻重音律。
recitationTipsZh: 此为学术校勘梵文写本原貌，每一句均配备「梵音拼读参考」与「唐宋古汉语音译」平行对照，且每个音节胶囊内均同时展示梵文、古汉语与现代拼读。

provenance.rawSnippet: Sitātapatrā ( Sitā 147 ) om namaḥ śrīsarvabuddhabodhisattvebhyaḥ / evaṃ mayā śrutam ekasmin samaye bhagavān deveṣu trāyastriṃśeṣu viharati sma / sudharmāyāṃ devasabhāyāṃ mahatā bhikṣusaṃghena mahatā ca bodhisattvasaṃghena bhikṣuśataiḥ śakreṇa ca devatānāmindreṇa sārdham / tatra khalu bhagavān prajñapta evāsane niṣadya uṣṇīṣamavalokitaṃ nāma samādhiṃ samāpadyate sma / samanantarasamāpannasya bhagavata uṣṇīṣamadhyādimāni mantrapadāni niścaranti sma / namo bhagavate uṣṇīṣāya śuddhe viraje vimale svāhā / namo bhagavate apraṇihato uṣṇīṣāya / namo buddhāya / namo dharmāya / namo saṃghāya / namaḥ saptānāṃ samyaksaṃbuddhakoṭīnāṃ namo maitreyapramukhānāṃ sarvabuddhabodhisattvānāṃ saśrāvakasaṃghānām / namo loke arhatānām / namaḥ strotaāpannānām / namaḥ sakṛdāgāmināma / namo anāgāminām / namo loke samyaggatānām / namaḥ samyakpratipannānām / namo devarṣīṇām / namo devabrahmaṇe / namo buddhāya / namo bhagavate rudrāya umāpatisahitāya / namo varuṇāya / namo bhagavate nārāyaṇāya / mahāpañcamudrā namaḥ namaskṛtāya / namo bhagavate nandikeśvaramahākālāya / tripuranagaravidrāvaṇakarāya / adhimuktikakaśmīramahāśmaśānanivāsitāya / namo mātṛgaṇasahitāya / namo bhagavate tathāgatakulasya / namo bhagavate padmakulasya / namo bhagavate vajrakulasya / namo bhagavate maṇikulasya / namo bhagavate gajakulasya / namo bhagavate karmakulasya / namo bhagavate ratnakulasya / namo bhagavate kumārakulasya / namo bhagavate nāgakulasya / namo bhagavate rāgakulasya / namo bhagavate dṛḍhaśūraraṇasenapraharaṇarājāya tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya / namo bhagavate amitābhāya tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya / namo bhagavate akṣobhyāya tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya / namo bhagavate vajradharasāgaragarjine tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya / namo bhagavate bhaiṣajyaguruvaidūryaprabharājāya tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya / namo bhagavate amoghasiddhaye tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya / namo bhagavate supuṣpitasālendrarājāya tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya / namo bhagavate padmottararājāya tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddāya / namo bhagavate vipaśyine tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya / ( Sitā 148 ) namo bhagavate śikhine tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya / namo bhagavate viśvabhuve tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya / namo bhagavate krakucchandāya tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya / namo bhagavate kanakamunaye tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya / namo bhagavate kāśyapāya tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya / namo bhagavate śākyamunaye tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya / namo bhagavate ratnacandrāya tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya / namo bhagavate ratnaketurājāya tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya / namo bhagavate samantabhadrāya tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya / namo bhagavate vairocanāya tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya / namo bhagavate vikasitakamalottaragandhaketurājāya tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya / ebhyo namaskṛtvā imāṃ bhagavatīṃ sarvatathāgatoṣṇīṣasitātapatrānāmāparājitāṃ pratyaṅgirāṃ pravakṣyāmi / sarvakalikalahavigrahavivādapraśamanīm / sarvabhūtagrahanivāraṇīm / sarvaparavidyācchedanīm / akālamṛtyuparitrāyaṇīm / sarvasattvabandhanamokṣaṇīm / sarvaduḥsvapnanāśanīm / yakṣarākṣasagrahāṇāṃ vidhvaṃsanakarīm / caturaśītināṃ grahasahasrāṇāṃ vidhvaṃsanakarīm / aṣṭāviṃśatīnāṃ nakṣatrāṇāṃ prasādanakarīm / sarvaśatrunivāraṇīmaṣṭānāṃ mahāgrahāṇāṃ vidhvaṃsanakarīm / ghoraduṣṭaduḥsvapnānāṃ ca vināśanakarīm / viṣaśastrāgnyudakottāraṇīm / sarvadurgatibhayottaraṇīm / yāvadaṣṭāvakālamaraṇaparitrāṇakarīm / aparājitāṃ mahāghorāṃ mahābalāṃ mahātejāṃ mahācaṇḍāṃ mahāśvetāṃ mahadīptāṃ mahāmālāṃ mahājvālāṃ mahāpāṇḍaravāsinīm / āryatārā bhṛkuṭī caiva jayā ca vijayā tathā / sarvamāravihantrī ca vajramāleti viśrutā | padmā bhāvajacinhā ca mālā caivāparājitā / vajratuṇḍī viśālī ca śāntā vaidehapūjitā | saumyarūpā mahāśvetā jvālā pāṇḍaravāsinī / āryatārā mahābalā aparā vajraśṛṅkhalā | tathā cavajrakaumārī kulaṃdarītathaiva ca / vajrahastā vajravidyā tathā kāñcanamālikā | ( Sitā 149 ) kusuṃbharatnā (radanā) caiva vairocanakulaprabhā / tathāgatakuloṣṇīṣaviśrutā vijṛmbhamānikā | vajrā kanakaprabhā locanā vajratuṇḍikā / tathā śvetā ca kamalākṣiṇī buddhalocanā | tathā vajraprabhā candrā tathā vajradharāpi ca / vajramālā mahāmāyā devī ca kanakaprabhā | sulocanātathā caivaśvetā ca kamalekṣaṇā / vinītā śāntacittā ca ātmaguṇajñā śaśiprabhā

verses.iast: namaḥ sarvabuddhabodhisattvebhyaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切佛陀菩提萨埵！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all, Buddha, Bodhisattva!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu004_u.htm（原典总行数：159 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0976）

verses.iast: namo bhagavate uṣṇīṣāya
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼世尊（薄伽梵）致敬·佛顶肉髻相、无见顶相！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, Uṣṇīṣa, Buddha's crown protuberance!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu004_u.htm（原典总行数：159 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0976）

verses.iast: namo 'mitābhāya tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼阿弥陀佛（无量光如来）·如来·出·堪敬尊·正等正觉、正遍知！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Amitābha, Buddha of Infinite Light, Tathāgata, income, Perfectly and Completely Awakened Buddha!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu004_u.htm（原典总行数：159 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0976）

verses.iast: namo bhagavate vīra-vajradharāya sāgara-nirghoṣāya tathāgatāya
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼世尊（薄伽梵）致敬·勇猛丈夫、无畏英雄尊·金刚总持、执金刚尊·大海、功德海·责任、责难·如来（乘如实道来成正觉）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, heroic, valiant, fearless hero, Vajradhara, Holder of the Vajra, ocean, sea, blame, censure, Tathāgata, Thus-Come One!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu004_u.htm（原典总行数：159 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0976）

verses.iast: namaḥ samantabuddhānām
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼普遍没驮南！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to universal, buddhānām!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu004_u.htm（原典总行数：159 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0976）

verses.iast: oṃ sitātapatroṣṇīṣa aparājite pratyaṅgirāya
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！大白伞盖佛顶肉髻相，无能胜、不可摧伏尊，向般罗底扬吉罗（大回遮母、总破邪咒母）
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! White Parasol + Uṣṇīṣa, O invincible, unconquered / in invincible, unconquered, to/for Pratyaṅgirā, Counter-Sorcery Protective Goddess
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu004_u.htm（原典总行数：159 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0976）

verses.iast: sarva-bhūta-graha-nigraha-karaṇī
verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，部多鬼神、一切生类、真实，曜执、星曜鬼神执障，内制、刑狱，工具、因缘
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, spirit, living being, true/existent, planet, seizing spirit/graha, seizing, holding, restraining, subduing, means, cause
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu004_u.htm（原典总行数：159 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0976）

verses.iast: para-vidyā-chedanī
verses.meaningZh: 他人，明咒、真言明妃、圣智明，除断佛母
verses.meaningEn: Someone else, Vidyā, sacred wisdom-spell, illumination, removing
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu004_u.htm（原典总行数：159 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0976）

verses.iast: akāla-mṛtyu-paritrāṇa-karī
verses.meaningZh: 非时、不合时宜，死、死魔厄难，救护、普皆庇佑，掌佛母
verses.meaningEn: Untimely, out of season, death, mortality, complete protection, deliverance, shelter, palm
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu004_u.htm（原典总行数：159 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0976）

verses.iast: sarva-bandhana-mokṣaṇī
verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，系缚、枷锁缠缚，自由化佛母
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, bondage, fetter, imprisonment, freeing, delivering
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu004_u.htm（原典总行数：159 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0976）

verses.iast: sarva-duṣṭa-duḥsvapna-nivāraṇī
verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，暴恶者、恶心障难，恶梦、不祥梦境，断
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, wicked, corrupted, malevolent, hostile, bad dream, nightmare, evil omen, keeping back, warding off (feminine)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu004_u.htm（原典总行数：159 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0976）

verses.iast: caturaśītīnāṃ graha-sahasrāṇāṃ vidhvaṃsana-karī
verses.meaningZh: 诸八十四之，曜执、星曜鬼神执障，诸千、千手千眼之，摧灭，掌佛母
verses.meaningEn: Caturaśītīnāṃ, planet, seizing spirit/graha, of thousand, ruining, spoiling, destroying, violating, palm
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu004_u.htm（原典总行数：159 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0976）

verses.iast: aṣṭāviṃśatīnāṃ nakṣatrāṇāṃ prasādana-karī
verses.meaningZh: 诸二十八之，诸星宿（二十八宿）之，一样，掌佛母
verses.meaningEn: Of twenty-eight, of constellation, lunar mansion, the same, palm
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu004_u.htm（原典总行数：159 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0976）

verses.iast: aṣṭānāṃ mahā-grahāṇāṃ vidhvaṃsana-karī
verses.meaningZh: 诸八（八正道，大、摩诃（广大无边），诸曜执、星曜鬼神执障之，摧灭，掌佛母
verses.meaningEn: Of all eight, great, vast, supreme, of planet, seizing spirit/graha, ruining, spoiling, destroying, violating, palm
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu004_u.htm（原典总行数：159 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0976）

verses.iast: sarva-śatru-nivāraṇī
verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，怨敌、仇害违缘，断
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, enemy, adversary, hostile force, keeping back, warding off (feminine)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu004_u.htm（原典总行数：159 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0976）

verses.iast: ghora-duḥsvapnānāṃ ca nāśanī
verses.meaningZh: 威怖、猛厉降魔，诸恶梦、不祥梦境之以及摧灭、除断佛母
verses.meaningEn: Formidable, terrific, awe-inspiring, of all bad dream, nightmare, evil omen and destroying, removing
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu004_u.htm（原典总行数：159 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0976）

verses.iast: viṣa-śastra-agni-uttaraṇī
verses.meaningZh: 毒害、蛇毒与三毒，刀杖兵戈，圣火、智火（火大），令度佛母
verses.meaningEn: Poison, venom, toxin, weapon, sword, blade, fire, sacred flame (Agni), rescue, salvation (feminine)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu004_u.htm（原典总行数：159 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0976）

verses.iast: aparājitā mahā-ghorā mahā-balā mahā-caṇḍā mahā-dīptā mahā-tejā mahā-śvetā mahā-jvalā mahā-pāṇḍaravāsinī
verses.meaningZh: 无能胜佛母，大、摩诃（广大无边），威怖、猛厉降魔，大、摩诃（广大无边），力、十力神通威神力，大、摩诃（广大无边），威猛、暴烈除障，大、摩诃（广大无边），炽耀、光明赫奕，大、摩诃（广大无边），威光，大、摩诃（广大无边），洁白、清净白色，大、摩诃（广大无边），炽燃光明、放光普照（入嚩攞），大、摩诃（广大无边），白衣观自在母（莲华部母）
verses.meaningEn: Aparājitā, the Unconquerable Goddess, great, vast, supreme, formidable, terrific, awe-inspiring, great, vast, supreme, power, strength, spiritual force, great, vast, supreme, fierce, ardent, wrathful, great, vast, supreme, blazing, shining, luminous, great, vast, supreme, sharpness, great, vast, supreme, white, bright, pure-colored, great, vast, supreme, blaze forth with wisdom radiance! great, vast, supreme, Pāṇḍaravāsinī, White-Robed Lotus Mother
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu004_u.htm（原典总行数：159 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0976）

verses.iast: ārya-tārā bhṛkuṭī ceva vijaya-vajramāleti viśrutā
verses.meaningZh: 圣、尊贵圣者，圣救度佛母（度母），颦眉观音母（忿怒除障度母），妙行迁变空·最上真言离言说，最胜尊胜、普胜一切！金刚食天瘟疫，美名称
verses.meaningEn: Noble, holy, exalted (Ārya), Tārā, Savioress Goddess, Bhṛkuṭī, Frown-Browed Protective Tārā, awakened conduct beyond flux & supreme ineffable speech, supreme victory! triumph! Vajramala + plague, heard, learnt, understood, known as
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu004_u.htm（原典总行数：159 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0976）

verses.iast: padmakā vajra-jihvā ca mālā-ceva-aparājitā
verses.meaningZh: 莲花，金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），广长舌相以及鬘、宝鬘、念珠鬘，妙行迁变空·最上真言离言说，无能胜佛母
verses.meaningEn: = , of a tree a man, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, tongue and garland, rosary, necklace, awakened conduct beyond flux & supreme ineffable speech, Aparājitā, the Unconquerable Goddess
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu004_u.htm（原典总行数：159 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0976）

verses.iast: vajradaṇḍī viśālā ca śānta-vaideha-pūjitā
verses.meaningZh: 金刚金刚杖，广博、广大清净以及寂静、调柔安稳，大王舍谛洲，所恭敬
verses.meaningEn: Vajra + staff, broad, spacious, extensive and peaceful, calm, tranquil, living in or coming from Videha, honored
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu004_u.htm（原典总行数：159 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0976）

verses.iast: saumya-rūpā mahā-śvetā ārya-tārā mahā-balā
verses.meaningZh: 寂静温和、慈柔如月，色、妙色身，大、摩诃（广大无边），洁白、清净白色，圣、尊贵圣者，圣救度佛母（度母），大、摩诃（广大无边），力、十力神通威神力
verses.meaningEn: Gentle, serene, lunar-calm, benign, form, matter, sacred body, great, vast, supreme, white, bright, pure-colored, noble, holy, exalted (Ārya), Tārā, Savioress Goddess, great, vast, supreme, power, strength, spiritual force
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu004_u.htm（原典总行数：159 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0976）

verses.iast: aparā vajra-śṛṅkhalā ceva vajra-kumārī kulandharī
verses.meaningZh: 必然，金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），金刚锁链，妙行迁变空·最上真言离言说，金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），孺童，持守摄受·造作离相
verses.meaningEn: A certain, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, chain, fetter, awakened conduct beyond flux & supreme ineffable speech, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, kumārī, bearing
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu004_u.htm（原典总行数：159 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0976）

verses.iast: vajra-hastā ca mahā-vidyā kāñcana-mālikā
verses.meaningZh: 金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），轸以及大、摩诃（广大无边），明咒、真言明妃、圣智明，真金、金耀庄严，妙花鬘、持鬘尊
verses.meaningEn: Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, Hasta and great, vast, supreme, Vidyā, sacred wisdom-spell, illumination, pure gold, golden, garland, wreathed in blossoms
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu004_u.htm（原典总行数：159 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0976）

verses.iast: kusumbha-ratnā ceva vairocana-kulārthadā uṣṇīṣa-vijṛmbhamāṇā ca savajra-kanaka-prabha-locanā
verses.meaningZh: 赭色，珍宝、摩尼宝，妙行迁变空·最上真言离言说，毗卢遮那佛（大日遍照如来），造作离相·离一切相无相·清净离诸尘垢，佛顶肉髻相、无见顶相，闢·张口·本刹·命令以及彼金刚，黄金、纯金光明，光明、星星，眼、佛眼遍照
verses.meaningEn: Safflower, jewel, precious gem, treasure, awakened conduct beyond flux & supreme ineffable speech, Vairocana, Illuminator Buddha, freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks & stainless purity free from dust, Uṣṇīṣa, Buddha's crown protuberance, settle + gape + this + command and he + Vajra, gold, golden, light, eye, illuminating vision
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu004_u.htm（原典总行数：159 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0976）

verses.iast: vajra-tuṇḍī ca śvetā ca kamalākṣā śaśi-prabhā
verses.meaningZh: 金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），觜佛母以及洁白、清净白色以及妙莲华眼目，月轮（怀兔清凉月），光明、清净毫光
verses.meaningEn: Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, beak (feminine) and white, bright, pure-colored and lotus blossom + eye, moon, light, radiance, splendor, aura
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu004_u.htm（原典总行数：159 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0976）

verses.iast: ity ete mudrā-gaṇāḥ sarve rakṣāṃ kurvantu mama sarvasattvānāṃ ca
verses.meaningZh: 耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·诸根清净自在），此等诸尊，手印、法印、契印，诸海会众、圣众眷属，一切、普皆遍满尊，守护、结界护念，愿一切诸尊普皆施作护持！我之（行者所有），诸一切众生、普皆有情之以及
verses.meaningEn: Supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — purified faculties, these, Mudrā, sacred seal, gesture, assembly, host,retinue (plural), O all, every, complete / in all, every, complete, protection, safeguarding, may they all perform/grant! my, of me (the practitioner), of all all sentient beings and
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu004_u.htm（原典总行数：159 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0976）

verses.iast: oṃ ṛṣi-gaṇa-praśastāya sarvatathāgatoṣṇīṣa-sitātapatre hūṃ ṭrūṃ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！仙人、大仙圣者，海会众、圣众眷属，向善祥，一切如来佛顶肉髻相，大白伞盖（清净护庇）尊，吽（金刚心印）！金刚顶护身结界心印
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Ṛṣi, seer, sage, assembly, host,retinue, to/for cut, all Tathagatas + Uṣṇīṣa, O White Parasol (pure protective canopy) / in White Parasol (pure protective canopy), Hūṃ! vajra-armor protection seed syllable
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu004_u.htm（原典总行数：159 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0976）

verses.iast: jambhana-karī hūṃ ṭrūṃ
verses.meaningZh: 令愚，掌佛母，吽（金刚心印）！金刚顶护身结界心印
verses.meaningEn: Crushing, destroying, palm, Hūṃ! vajra-armor protection seed syllable
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu004_u.htm（原典总行数：159 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0976）

verses.iast: stambhana-karī hūṃ ṭrūṃ
verses.meaningZh: 僵仆，掌佛母，吽（金刚心印）！金刚顶护身结界心印
verses.meaningEn: Laming, paralyzing, fixing, stopping, restraining, palm, Hūṃ! vajra-armor protection seed syllable
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu004_u.htm（原典总行数：159 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0976）

verses.iast: mohana-karī hūṃ ṭrūṃ
verses.meaningZh: 作昏，掌佛母，吽（金刚心印）！金刚顶护身结界心印
verses.meaningEn: Stupefying, perplexing, deceiving, palm, Hūṃ! vajra-armor protection seed syllable
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu004_u.htm（原典总行数：159 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0976）

verses.iast: mahā-vidyā-saṃbhakṣaṇa-karī hūṃ ṭrūṃ
verses.meaningZh: 大、摩诃（广大无边），明咒、真言明妃、圣智明，桑·星宿·一刹那，掌佛母，吽（金刚心印）！金刚顶护身结界心印
verses.meaningEn: Great, vast, supreme, Vidyā, sacred wisdom-spell, illumination, saṃ + star + birth under favorable conditions, palm, Hūṃ! vajra-armor protection seed syllable
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu004_u.htm（原典总行数：159 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0976）

verses.iast: rakṣa rakṣa māṃ
verses.meaningZh: 祈请再三拥护、守护于我
verses.meaningEn: Evermore protect, guard and shelter me
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu004_u.htm（原典总行数：159 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0976）

verses.iast: bhagavan-tathāgatoṣṇīṣa-sitātapatra-mahā-vajroṣṇīṣa mahā-pratyangirā mahā-sahasra-bhuje sahasra-śīrṣe koṭi-śata-sahasra-netre
verses.meaningZh: 出有坏，如来佛顶肉髻相，大白伞盖（清净护庇），大、摩诃（广大无边），金刚佛顶肉髻相，大、摩诃（广大无边），第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，大、摩诃（广大无边），千、千手千眼，臂、千臂庄严尊，千、千手千眼，顶首、头顶佛冠尊，俱胝（千万，百，千、千手千眼，眼目、清净慧眼尊
verses.meaningEn: Bhagavan, Tathāgata + Uṣṇīṣa, White Parasol (pure protective canopy), great, vast, supreme, Vajra + Uṣṇīṣa, great, vast, supreme, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, great, vast, supreme, thousand, O arm, hand / in arm, hand, thousand, O head, crown / in head, crown, ten million, myriad (koṭi), hundred, thousand, O eye, guiding vision / in eye, guiding vision
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu004_u.htm（原典总行数：159 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0976）

verses.iast: abhedya-jvalita-naṭanaka mahā-vajrodāra-tribhuvana-maṇḍala
verses.meaningZh: 无开除，炽盛燃耀、大放光明，离名相假立·断除憍慢执障·造作离相，大、摩诃（广大无边），金刚出租，三界、三有世间，曼荼罗、坛城轮圆具足
verses.meaningEn: Non-to be cleft or pierced, blazing, illuminated, flaming, beyond nominal designation & cutting rigid pride & freedom from karmic agency, great, vast, supreme, Vajra + rent, the Three Realms of Existence, Maṇḍala, sacred cosmogram/circle
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu004_u.htm（原典总行数：159 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0976）

verses.iast: oṃ svastir bhavatu mama
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！吉祥安隐、善妙无恙，愿成就、愿悉吉祥，我之（行者所有）
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! well-being, fortune, auspicious safety, may it be, let there be! my, of me (the practitioner)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu004_u.htm（原典总行数：159 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0976）

verses.iast: tadyathā — oṃ anale anale viśade viśade vīra vajradhare bandha bandhani vajrapāṇi phaṭ hūṃ ṭrūṃ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！再三智慧猛火（净除业障火）尊，再三充分、粗放尊，勇猛丈夫、无畏英雄尊，金刚总持、执金刚尊尊，结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮），系缚、枷锁缠缚尊，金刚手菩萨（执金刚秘密主），泮吒（摧破魔障）！吽（金刚心印）！金刚顶护身结界心印，泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! O sacred fire, purifying flame / in sacred fire, purifying flame again and again, O abundant, extensive again and again, heroic, valiant, fearless hero, O Vajradhara, Holder of the Vajra / in Vajradhara, Holder of the Vajra, bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! O bondage, fetter, imprisonment, Vajrapāṇi, Vajra-in-Hand Bodhisattva, Phaṭ! Hūṃ! vajra-armor protection seed syllable, Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu004_u.htm（原典总行数：159 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0976）

verses.iast: oṃ sarvatathāgatoṣṇīṣa-sitātapatre hūṃ phaṭ hūṃ mama hūṃ ni svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！一切如来佛顶肉髻相，大白伞盖（清净护庇）尊，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！吽（金刚心印）！我之（行者所有），吽（金刚心印）！曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·诸根清净自在），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! all Tathagatas + Uṣṇīṣa, O White Parasol (pure protective canopy) / in White Parasol (pure protective canopy), Hūṃ! Phaṭ! Hūṃ! my, of me (the practitioner), Hūṃ! beyond nominal designation (nāma) — purified faculties, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu004_u.htm（原典总行数：159 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0976）

verses.iast: viśvamukhāya svāhā / om nigrigrini sarvakāryasādhani sini sini āvāhayāmi devi śrīvaiśravaṇāya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 向闢如狗面，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！嗡！离名相假立·妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢，一切·圣·成就法，再三提供尊，嫁夜摩天尊，天女、佛母明妃尊，向吉祥毗沙门天王，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Settle, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Oṃ! beyond nominal designation & awakened spiritual movement & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), all + noble + O accomplishing, O supply, provision again and again, taking in marriage + O Yama Heaven, O goddess, sacred female deity, auspiciousness + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu007_u.htm（原典总行数：128 行 · 对勘大正藏 T16n0665 / T21n1252）

verses.iast: / suvarṇadhanadhānyākarṣaṇyai svāhā / sarvapuṇyākarṣaṇyai svāhā / śrīdevatākarṣaṇyai svāhā / sarvapāpanāśanyai svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 向真金·财·驮·他·阿羯沙尼，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！向一切福德阿羯沙尼，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！向吉祥何为阿羯沙尼，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！摧灭除遣·一切诸谛圆满，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Gold + treasure + dha + other + to Akarsani, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! all + merit + to Akarsani, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! auspiciousness + divinity + to Akarsani, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! destroying obstacles (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu007_u.htm（原典总行数：128 行 · 对勘大正藏 T16n0665 / T21n1252）

verses.iast: / sarvālakṣmīpraśamanyai svāhā / sarvatathāgatābhiṣiktāyai svāhā / sarvadevatābhimukhaśriye svāhā / āyurbalavarṇakarāyai svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 息灾寂静·一切诸谛圆满，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！一切·何为·现前·广大光华尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！能作成办·一乘如实之道，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Pacifying (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! all + divinity + having the face towards + O with great magnificence, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! making (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu007_u.htm（原典总行数：128 行 · 对勘大正藏 T16n0665 / T21n1252）

verses.iast: / sarvapavitramaṅgalahastāyai svāhā / siṃhavāhinyai svāhā / padmasaṃbhūtāyai svāhā / sarvakṛtyakākhordavināśanyai svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！一切诸谛圆满·因缘空寂大乐·最上真言离言说，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！第一义谛·施度调伏·无我大慈三昧，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！向一切·业行·压镇·远离·行星土曜，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! ultimate truth & generosity & self-mastery & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! all + actions + an evil demon + without + to the planet Saturn, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu007_u.htm（原典总行数：128 行 · 对勘大正藏 T16n0665 / T21n1252）

verses.iast: / imāni tānyabhayāvalokiteśvaraśriyā mahādevyā nāmāni sarvakilviṣanāśanāni sarvapāpavidhvaṃsanakarāṇi sarvapuṇyākarṣaṇakarāṇi sarvālakṣmīpraśamanakarāṇi sarvaśrīsaubhāgyākarṣaṇakarāṇi / yaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 一切本刹，真如实际·离名相假立·一乘如实之道，以摩诃室利，一切名为、号曰，一切·污秽·一切摧灭，一切·罪业·摧灭·一切掌，一切·福德·召请·一切掌，息灾寂静·能作成办·一切诸谛圆满，吉祥庄严·钩召摄受·能作成办·一切诸谛圆满，凡彼…者
verses.meaningEn: This (plural), immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation & supreme vehicle of awakening, with/by Mahādevī, by name, called (plural), all + filth + destroying, all + evil + ruining + palm, all + merit + the same as + palm, pacifying, making (vocative invocation), glorious, drawing in, making (vocative invocation), whoever, he who
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu007_u.htm（原典总行数：128 行 · 对勘大正藏 T16n0665 / T21n1252）

verses.iast: kaścidvārayiṣyati imāni tathāgatanāmāni kalyamutthāya śucinā sarvabuddhānāṃ puṣpadhūpaṃ dattvā śriyai mahādevyai candanadhūpaṃ dattvā
verses.meaningZh: 造作离相·本性寂静止息·妙行迁变空，一切本刹，如来一切名为，精神·摄伏·立起，以清净，一切没驮南，花烧香，齿已，本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道，向摩诃室利，檀香烧香，齿已
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency & primordial tranquil peace & awakened conduct beyond flux (vocative invocation), this (plural), Tathāgata + by name, drive + hold, by flaming, beaming, all + buddhānām, flower + to burn incense, dattvā, primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation), to Mahādevī, best of its kind + to burn incense, dattvā
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu007_u.htm（原典总行数：128 行 · 对勘大正藏 T16n0665 / T21n1252）

verses.iast: vācayitavyāni sarvaśriyamadhigamiṣyati sarvasukhasaumanasyalābhī bhaviṣyati sarvadevatāśca rakṣāvaraṇaguptiṃ kariṣyanti sarvakāryasiddhistasya bhaviṣyati / idamavocadbhagavānāttamanā abhayāvalokiteśvaro
verses.meaningZh: 语言·极微·一切勇健，趣入通行·一切诸谛圆满，安乐妙善·一切诸谛圆满，当，一切诸何为及守护，能作成办·造作离相，悉地成就·一切诸谛圆满，当，施度调伏·无我大慈三昧·最上真言离言说，无畏观自在
verses.meaningEn: Words + or interrog + strong, going toward (vocative invocation), blissful, will be, all + divinity and guard, protection, and defense, making (vocative invocation), perfected, will be, generosity & self-mastery & selfless great loving-kindness & supreme ineffable speech, non-fear
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu007_u.htm（原典总行数：128 行 · 对勘大正藏 T16n0665 / T21n1252）

verses.iast: bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ / sā ca sarvāvatī parṣat sadevamānuṣāsuragandharvaśca loko bhagavato bhāṣitamabhyanandan
verses.meaningZh: 菩提萨埵，大菩萨，彼、彼圣母（阴性主格）以及具足湖或，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·六度满行清净，彼·天人·人道·阿修罗·音乐及世间、世界，以世尊此，宣说演畅·破有相福德光
verses.meaningEn: Bodhisattvo, mahāsattvaḥ, she, that and a lake + endowed with or, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & perfection of the six pāramitās, he + god + Human Realm + Asura and world, realm, Bhagavān + hence, speaking
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu007_u.htm（原典总行数：128 行 · 对勘大正藏 T16n0665 / T21n1252）

titleZh: 【梵本原典】藥師琉璃光如來本願功德經暨灌頂真言 (P.L. Vaidya BST 17 / GRETIL 梵本)
titleEnglish: Medicine Buddha Lapis Lazuli Radiance Sūtra & Dhāraṇī (GRETIL bsu012_u.htm)
translatorZh: 哥廷根大学 GRETIL / 尼泊尔 DSBC 梵文贝叶经校勘本 (Bhaisajyaguruvaiduryaprabharajasutra)
sutraSourceZh: GRETIL 梵文佛典库 (bsu012_u.htm) · 汉译对勘：T14n0450
deityZh: 藥師琉璃光如來 (Bhaiṣajyaguru)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 本条目直接构建自德国哥廷根大学 GRETIL 梵语原典档案「bsu012_u.htm」（共 162 行，完整提取核心真言与经句共 25 句）。系统已自动将其原始 IAST 梵文实时转写为天城文、唐代悉昙梵字、唐宋古汉语音译、现代梵音拼读参考、国际音标 (IPA) 及摩多轻重音律。
recitationTipsZh: 此为学术校勘梵文写本原貌，每一句均配备「梵音拼读参考」与「唐宋古汉语音译」平行对照，且每个音节胶囊内均同时展示梵文、古汉语与现代拼读。

verses.iast: oṃ namaḥ sarvajñāya
verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！归命，向一切智
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to/for omniscient
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu012_u.htm（原典总行数：162 行 · 对勘大正藏 T14n0450）

verses.iast: namo bhagavate bhaiṣajyaguruvaidūryaprabharājāya tathāgatāya
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼世尊（薄伽梵）致敬·破有相福德光·六度满行清净·生起不可得·尊胜·如来（乘如实道来成正觉）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, blessedness transcending existence & perfection of the six pāramitās & transcending birth & victorious (reverent offering), Tathāgata, Thus-Come One!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu012_u.htm（原典总行数：162 行 · 对勘大正藏 T14n0450）

verses.iast: asti mañjuśrīḥ pūrvasmin digbhāge ito buddhakṣetrād daśagaṅgānadīvālukāsamāni buddhakṣetrāṇy atikramya vaidūryanirbhāsā nāma lokadhātuḥ
verses.meaningZh: 有、真实安住，玅吉祥，圆满充盈·第一义谛，方位尊，从此，觉悟正觉·解脱系缚大力，十·恒河沙·一切无等，觉悟正觉·解脱系缚大力，真如实际·造作离相·清净离诸尘垢，净琉璃世界，名为、号曰，界境
verses.meaningEn: Is, truly exists, beautiful, fulfilling, O direction / in direction, from this, awakened, ten + the sand of the River Ganges + unequalled, awakened, immutable Suchness & freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust, The Land of Pure Crystal, by name, called, lokadhātuḥ
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu012_u.htm（原典总行数：162 行 · 对勘大正藏 T14n0450）

verses.iast: tatra bhaiṣajyaguruvaidūryaprabho nāma tathāgato 'rhan samyaksaṃbuddho viharati vidyācaraṇasaṃpannaḥ sugato lokavid anuttaraḥ puruṣadamyasārathiś
verses.meaningZh: 于彼处、其中，破有相福德光·六度满行清净·生起不可得·尊胜，名为、号曰，如来，应供、阿罗汉，正等觉，一切，明行足，善逝，世间解，无上，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·六度满行清净
verses.meaningEn: There, therein, blessedness transcending existence & perfection of the six pāramitās & transcending birth & victorious, by name, called, tathāgato, Arhat, Worthy One, samyaksaṃbuddho, lives, dwells, spends oneʼs time, vidyācaraṇasaṃpannaḥ, sugato, Knower of the World, anuttaraḥ, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & perfection of the six pāramitās
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu012_u.htm（原典总行数：162 行 · 对勘大正藏 T14n0450）

verses.iast: ca śāstā devānāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ ca buddho bhagavān
verses.meaningZh: 左字门（妙行迁变空（caryā）·本不生体性），天人师，诸天人、诸天护法之，诸人之以及觉者，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵
verses.meaningEn: Awakened conduct beyond flux (caryā) — primordial non-arising, śāstā, of all god, celestial deity (Deva), of person and buddho, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu012_u.htm（原典总行数：162 行 · 对勘大正藏 T14n0450）

verses.iast: tasya khalu punar mañjuśrīḥ bhagavato bhaiṣajyaguruvaidūryaprabhasya tathāgatasya pūrvaṃ bodhisattvacārikāṃ carata imāni dvādaśa mahāpraṇidhānāny abhūvan
verses.meaningZh: 彼之、其（属格），诚然、确实，复次、再三，玅吉祥，以世尊此，破有相福德光·六度满行清净·生起不可得·尊胜，如来（乘如实道来成正觉）之，元，菩提萨埵经过作法，妙行流布·清净离诸尘垢，一切本刹，十二，广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，破有相福德光·最上真言离言说·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: His, of that, indeed, verily, certainly, again, furthermore, beautiful, Bhagavān + hence, blessedness transcending existence & perfection of the six pāramitās & transcending birth & victorious, of Tathāgata, Thus-Come One, first, Bodhisattva + course of conduct, practicing, this (plural), the twelfth, consisting of twelve, great, blessedness transcending existence & supreme ineffable speech & beyond nominal designation
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu012_u.htm（原典总行数：162 行 · 对勘大正藏 T14n0450）

verses.iast: katamāni dvādaśa mahāpraṇidhānāni? prathamaṃ tasya mahāpraṇidhānam abhūt yadāham anāgate 'dhvani anuttarāṃ samyaksaṃbodhim
verses.meaningZh: 一切哪些哪些，十二，大一切发愿，初，彼之、其（属格），大发愿，曾有，凡所…者如是宣说，末尊，无妙音、音声，无上、无与伦比，三耶三佛
verses.meaningEn: Who or which ? (plural), the twelfth, consisting of twelve, great + to make a vow, prathamaṃ, his, of that, great + to make a vow, abhūt, which + spoke, O future / in future, non-sound, noise, roar, thunder, unsurpassed, supreme, peerless, unsurpassed complete perfect enlightenment
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu012_u.htm（原典总行数：162 行 · 对勘大正藏 T14n0450）

verses.iast: abhisaṃbudhyeyam, tadā mama śarīraprabhayā aprameyāsaṃkhyeyāparimāṇā lokadhātavo bhrājeraṃs tapyeran viroceran
verses.meaningZh: 融通·桑·请觉知·此圣女，彼时，我之（行者所有），以身躯光明，无可量·阿僧祇·无量，世界，破有相福德光·清净离诸尘垢·生起不可得·尊胜，真如实际·第一义谛·一乘如实之道，最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢·妙行迁变空
verses.meaningEn: To + saṃ + awake! perceive! behend! + this, at that time, in that case, then, my, of me (the practitioner), body + with, unmeasurable thing + innumerable + immeasurable, lokadhātavo, blessedness transcending existence & stainless purity free from dust & transcending birth & victorious, immutable Suchness & ultimate truth & supreme vehicle of awakening, supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust & awakened conduct beyond flux
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu012_u.htm（原典总行数：162 行 · 对勘大正藏 T14n0450）

verses.iast: yathā cāhaṃ dvātriṃśadbhir mahāpuruṣalakṣaṇaiḥ samanvāgataḥ, aśītibhiś cānuvyañjanair alaṃkṛtadehaḥ, tathaiva sarvasattvā bhaveyuḥ
verses.meaningZh: 犹如、如…所说，妙行迁变空·因缘空寂大乐，施度调伏·最上真言离言说·真如实际，以诸大丈夫相，成就，本性寂静止息·真如实际·破有相福德光，妙行迁变空·离名相假立·最上真言离言说，严身，真如实际·无住安立·最上真言离言说，一切众生、普皆有情，破有相福德光·最上真言离言说·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Just as, according to, awakened conduct beyond flux & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, generosity & self-mastery & supreme ineffable speech & immutable Suchness, a great man or the great spirit + by, samanvāgataḥ, primordial tranquil peace & immutable Suchness & blessedness transcending existence, awakened conduct beyond flux & beyond nominal designation & supreme ineffable speech, adornment, immutable Suchness & non-abiding equipoise & supreme ineffable speech, all sentient beings, blessedness transcending existence & supreme ineffable speech & supreme vehicle of awakening
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu012_u.htm（原典总行数：162 行 · 对勘大正藏 T14n0450）

verses.iast: dvitīyaṃ tasya mahāpraṇidhānam abhūt - yadāham anāgate 'dhvani anuttarāṃ samyaksaṃbodhim abhisaṃbudhyeyam, tadā
verses.meaningZh: 第二，彼之、其（属格），大发愿，曾有，凡所…者如是宣说，末尊，无妙音、音声，无上、无与伦比，三耶三佛，融通·桑·请觉知·此圣女，彼时
verses.meaningEn: Dvitīyaṃ, his, of that, great + to make a vow, abhūt, which + spoke, O future / in future, non-sound, noise, roar, thunder, unsurpassed, supreme, peerless, unsurpassed complete perfect enlightenment, to + saṃ + awake! perceive! behend! + this, at that time, in that case, then
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu012_u.htm（原典总行数：162 行 · 对勘大正藏 T14n0450）

verses.iast: bodhiprāptasya ca me kāyaḥ anarghavaidūryamaṇir iva antarbahiratyantapariśuddho vimalaprabhāsaṃpannaḥ syāt
verses.meaningZh: 菩提得之以及于我、为我，身，离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢·破暗合集，犹如、如同，裏·外方·毕竟·圆满清净，维玛拉普拉巴三婆吠，愿得成就、当如是
verses.meaningEn: Bodhi + of filled with astonishment and wonder and to me, my, kāyaḥ, beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust & dissolving dense ignorance, like, just as, interior + outside + reaching to the end + thoroughly pure, Vimalaprabhā + born, may it be so
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu012_u.htm（原典总行数：162 行 · 对勘大正藏 T14n0450）

verses.iast: vipulakāyas tadupamena śriyā tejasā ca pratyupasthitaḥ syāt
verses.meaningZh: 最上真言离言说·第一义谛·离一切相无相，以彼郁多摩，广大光华，真如实际·生起不可得·尊胜·一切诸谛圆满以及我身，愿得成就、当如是
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & ultimate truth & freedom from conditioned marks, that + by, with great magnificence, immutable Suchness & transcending birth & victorious & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness and I shall wait on  S, may it be so
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu012_u.htm（原典总行数：162 行 · 对勘大正藏 T14n0450）

verses.iast: tasyāṃśujālāni raviśaśikarānatikrameyuḥ te ca ye kecit sattvā lokadhātau jātāś ca, ye cāpi puruṣāḥ, te tamisrāyāṃ ratrāvandhakāre nānādiśaṃ gaccheyuḥ
verses.meaningZh: 彼之·亮·一切网，能作成办·清净离诸尘垢，向汝、彼等以及凡彼等诸有情，任何众生、凡有诸类，器物盘子已，离一切相无相·造作离相·法界总持任持，生起不可得·尊胜·真如实际·本性寂静止息以及凡彼等诸有情，持械宝弓尊，诸士夫，向汝、彼等，于答摩晚上、答摩地狱道中，礼敬赞叹·清净离诸尘垢，分别方，妙行趣入·妙行迁变空·离覆障清凉
verses.meaningEn: His + cloth + net, making, to Thee / they and those who, whoever (pl.), any, some (plural), having a vessel or dish, freedom from conditioned marks & freedom from karmic agency & Dharma-realm retention (imperative seal), transcending birth & victorious & immutable Suchness & primordial tranquil peace and those who, whoever (pl.), O armed with a bow, man, human being, male, person, individual of a generation, to Thee / they, in darkness , a dark night, venerating (vocative invocation), differently + direction, awakened spiritual movement & awakened conduct beyond flux & coolness free of obscuration
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu012_u.htm（原典总行数：162 行 · 对勘大正藏 T14n0450）

verses.iast: sarvadikṣu mama ābhayāṃ spṛṣṭāḥ kuśalāni ca) karmāṇi kurvīran
verses.meaningZh: 湖·宣说·豆菜，我之（行者所有），破有相福德光·一乘如实之道，诸毳衣，一切善、善根功德以及一切事，成办作持·造作离相
verses.meaningEn: A lake + speak + sugar-cane, my, of me (the practitioner), blessedness transcending existence & supreme vehicle of awakening, touched, felt, visited by or afflicted with (plural), wholesome, virtuous, skillful (plural) and actions (plural), enacting
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu012_u.htm（原典总行数：162 行 · 对勘大正藏 T14n0450）

verses.iast: tṛtīyaṃ tasya mahāpraṇidhānam abhūt - ( BhgSū, Vaidya 166 ) yadāham anāgate
verses.meaningZh: 第三，彼之、其（属格），大发愿，曾有，娑字门（一切诸谛圆满（sarvasatya）·威神增益圆满），医者，凡所…者如是宣说，末尊
verses.meaningEn: Tṛtīyaṃ, his, of that, great + to make a vow, abhūt, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (satya) — perfected spiritual vigor, learned, which + spoke, O future / in future
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu012_u.htm（原典总行数：162 行 · 对勘大正藏 T14n0450）

verses.iast: - - - - - - tadā bodhiprāptasya ca me ye sattvā
verses.meaningZh: 彼时，菩提得之以及于我、为我，凡彼等诸有情，器物盘子已
verses.meaningEn: At that time, in that case, then, Bodhi + of filled with astonishment and wonder and to me, my, those who, whoever (pl.), having a vessel or dish
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu012_u.htm（原典总行数：162 行 · 对勘大正藏 T14n0450）

verses.iast: aprameyaprajñopāyabalādhānena aparimāṇasya sattvadhātor akṣayāyopabhogāya paribhogāya syuḥ
verses.meaningZh: 以无可量·聪明·演出饮用·力持，无量之，有情界之，向无尽出皆用，向悉皆用，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·损减除灭忧苦·涅槃除障点证入）
verses.meaningEn: Unmeasurable thing + intelligent + act of drinking + by, of immeasurable, of the universe of beings, imperishable + income + to, to/for enjoyment, usufruct, use, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — dispelling sorrow with nirvāṇic visarga release
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu012_u.htm（原典总行数：162 行 · 对勘大正藏 T14n0450）

verses.iast: kasyaci sattvasya kenacid vaikalyaṃ na syāt
verses.meaningZh: 造作离相·一切诸谛圆满·一乘如实之道，有情、众生、勇猛心之，造作离相·离名相假立·妙行迁变空，差，不、非、无，愿得成就、当如是
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation), of sentient being, living creature, courage, freedom from karmic agency & beyond nominal designation & awakened conduct beyond flux, defect, not, non-, may it be so
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu012_u.htm（原典总行数：162 行 · 对勘大正藏 T14n0450）

verses.iast: caturthaṃ tasya mahāpraṇidhānam abhūt - yadāham anāgate - - - tadā bodhiprāpto
verses.meaningZh: 第四，彼之、其（属格），大发愿，曾有，凡所…者如是宣说，末尊，彼时，菩提得
verses.meaningEn: Caturthaṃ, his, of that, great + to make a vow, abhūt, which + spoke, O future / in future, at that time, in that case, then, Bodhi
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu012_u.htm（原典总行数：162 行 · 对勘大正藏 T14n0450）

verses.iast: 'haṃ ye kumārgapratipannāḥ sattvāḥ śrāvakamārgapratipannāḥ pratyekabuddhamārgapratipannāś ca, te sattvā anuttare bodhimārge mahāyāne
verses.meaningZh: 我、真我自性，凡彼等诸有情，大地·圣道·诸入，诸有情、众生、勇猛心，舍罗婆迦·圣道·诸入，觉悟正觉·摧灭除遣·第一义谛以及向汝、彼等，器物盘子已，无上、无与伦比尊，菩提圣道，大乘尊
verses.meaningEn: I, the awakened self, those who, whoever (pl.), earth + path + practised, sentient being, living creature, courage (plural), sravaka + path + practised, awakened, destroying obstacles and to Thee / they, having a vessel or dish, O unsurpassed, supreme, peerless / in unsurpassed, supreme, peerless, Bodhi + O path, O the ‘Great Vehicle’ / in the ‘Great Vehicle’
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu012_u.htm（原典总行数：162 行 · 对勘大正藏 T14n0450）

verses.iast: niyojayeran
verses.meaningZh: 尊胜降伏·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Conquering
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu012_u.htm（原典总行数：162 行 · 对勘大正藏 T14n0450）

verses.iast: pañcamaṃ tasya mahāpraṇidhānam abhūt - yadāham anāgate - - - tadā bodhiprāptasya
verses.meaningZh: 第五，彼之、其（属格），大发愿，曾有，凡所…者如是宣说，末尊，彼时，菩提得之
verses.meaningEn: Pañcamaṃ, his, of that, great + to make a vow, abhūt, which + spoke, O future / in future, at that time, in that case, then, Bodhi + of filled with astonishment and wonder
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu012_u.htm（原典总行数：162 行 · 对勘大正藏 T14n0450）

verses.iast: ca me ye sattvā mama śāsane brahmacaryaṃ careyuḥ, te sarve akhaṇḍaśīlāḥ syuḥ
verses.meaningZh: 左字门（妙行迁变空（caryā）·本不生体性），于我、为我，凡彼等诸有情，器物盘子已，我之（行者所有），传，梵行，妙行流布·清净离诸尘垢，向汝、彼等，一切、普皆遍满尊，不衰诸尸罗，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·损减除灭忧苦·涅槃除障点证入）
verses.meaningEn: Awakened conduct beyond flux (caryā) — primordial non-arising, to me, my, those who, whoever (pl.), having a vessel or dish, my, of me (the practitioner), O chastising, punishing, instructing, teaching, pure practices, practicing, to Thee / they, O all, every, complete / in all, every, complete, undivided + moral discipline, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — dispelling sorrow with nirvāṇic visarga release
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu012_u.htm（原典总行数：162 行 · 对勘大正藏 T14n0450）

verses.iast: susaṃvṛtāḥ
verses.meaningZh: 诸最要谨慎
verses.meaningEn: Well covered or dressed
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu012_u.htm（原典总行数：162 行 · 对勘大正藏 T14n0450）

verses.iast: mā ca kasyaci śīlavipannasya
verses.meaningZh: 勿、莫令以及造作离相·一切诸谛圆满·一乘如实之道，坏戒之
verses.meaningEn: Do not, let not and freedom from karmic agency & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation), śīlavipannasya
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu012_u.htm（原典总行数：162 行 · 对勘大正藏 T14n0450）

verses.iast: namo ratnatrayāya / nama āryāvalokiteśvarāya bodhisattvāya mahāsattvāya mahākāruṇikāya / namaḥ sarvasattvavyasanaghātine /
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛法僧三宝·圣观自在菩萨·菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情）·摩诃萨埵（大心有情、大菩萨）·大悲圣尊、具足大悲心者·一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha), Noble Avalokiteśvara, Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, Mahāsattva, Great Spiritual Hero, Greatly Compassionate One, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu017_u.htm（原典总行数：120 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1072A）

verses.iast: namaḥ sarvasattvabhayapraśamanakarāya / namaḥ sarvasattvabhayottāraṇakarāya / namaḥ sarvavidyādhigatāya / namaḥ sarvavidyāvidhigatamūrtaye mahākāruṇikāya
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切众生·怖畏·疗·掌·救度超脱·能作成办·一切诸谛圆满·一切圣智容器去·一切圣智·不是规定·去·尊身·大悲圣尊、具足大悲心者！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all sentient beings, fear, heal, to, ferrying across, making (reverent offering), all knowledge, receptacle, to, all knowledge, no rule, understood, to embodiment, Greatly Compassionate One!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu017_u.htm（原典总行数：120 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1072A）

verses.iast: / namo mahāvidyārājaprāptaye mahāyogine
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼大明咒在位非得·广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Mahāvidyā, reign, great (vocative invocation)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu017_u.htm（原典总行数：120 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1072A）

verses.iast: oṃ namo ratnatrayāya
verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！归命，向佛法僧三宝
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to/for the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu019_u.htm（原典总行数：725 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1050）

verses.iast: atha sarvanīvaraṇaviṣkambhī āha - kena prakāreṇa bhagavan? bhagavānāha - bhūtapūrvaṃ kulaputra vipaśyī
verses.meaningZh: 尔时、次复吉祥启白，除诸障，如是宣说、佛言，造作离相·离名相假立，以部，出有坏，世尊如是宣说，古昔，善男子，胜观
verses.meaningEn: Now, thereupon, auspiciously, sarvanīvaraṇaviṣkambhī, spoke, declared thus, freedom from karmic agency & beyond nominal designation (by spiritual power), by/through adorned with many flowers, bhagavan, the World-Honored One + spoke, bhūtapūrvaṃ, a good man, Vipaśyī Buddha
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu019_u.htm（原典总行数：725 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1050）

verses.iast: nāma tathāgato 'rhan samyaksaṃbuddho loka udapādi vidyācaraṇasaṃpannaḥ sugato lokavidanuttaraḥ puruṣadamyasārathiḥ śāstā devānāṃ
verses.meaningZh: 名为、号曰，如来，应供、阿罗汉，正等觉，世间、世界，净水尊足，明行足，善逝，世间解无上，调御丈夫，天人师，诸天人、诸天护法之
verses.meaningEn: By name, called, tathāgato, Arhat, Worthy One, samyaksaṃbuddho, world, realm, water + O foot, vidyācaraṇasaṃpannaḥ, sugato, Knower of the World, puruṣadamyasārathiḥ, śāstā, of all god, celestial deity (Deva)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu019_u.htm（原典总行数：725 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1050）

verses.iast: ca manuṣyāṇāṃ ca buddho bhagavān / tena kālena tena samayenāhaṃ sarvanīvaraṇaniṣkambhin sugandhamukho
verses.meaningZh: 左字门（妙行迁变空（caryā）·本不生体性），诸人之以及觉者，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，借由彼力、以是因缘，以时，借由彼力、以是因缘，三昧耶·勇健·如是宣说，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，好香面门
verses.meaningEn: Awakened conduct beyond flux (caryā) — primordial non-arising, of person and buddho, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, by that truth, thereby, through that power, by/through black, by that truth, thereby, through that power, Samaya + strong + spoke, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, odour + face
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu019_u.htm（原典总行数：725 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1050）

verses.iast: nāma vaṇikputro 'bhūvam / tadā me śrutā vipaśyinastathāgatasya sakāśādāryāvalokiteśvarasya guṇodbhāvanā
verses.meaningZh: 名为、号曰，商人子，破有相福德光·最上真言离言说·无我大慈三昧，彼时，于我、为我，闻，毗卢尸佛·故乡·他·来之，一切诸谛圆满·造作离相·本性寂静止息，功德应作
verses.meaningEn: By name, called, vaṇikputro, blessedness transcending existence & supreme ineffable speech & selfless great loving-kindness, at that time, in that case, then, to me, my, heard, Vipasyin Buddha + home + tha + of to come, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & freedom from karmic agency & primordial tranquil peace, virtue + manifestation
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu019_u.htm（原典总行数：725 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1050）

verses.iast: tadapyatikramya śikhī nāma tathāgato 'rhan samyaksaṃbuddho babhūva vidyācaraṇasaṃpannaḥ sugato lokavidanuttaraḥ puruṣadamyasārathiḥ śāstā
verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·施度调伏·第一义谛，孔雀，名为、号曰，如来，应供、阿罗汉，正等觉，解脱系缚大力·破有相福德光·最上真言离言说，明行足，善逝，世间解无上，调御丈夫，天人师
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & generosity & self-mastery & ultimate truth, Sikhin, by name, called, tathāgato, Arhat, Worthy One, samyaksaṃbuddho, spiritual strength freeing bonds & blessedness transcending existence & supreme ineffable speech, vidyācaraṇasaṃpannaḥ, sugato, Knower of the World, puruṣadamyasārathiḥ, śāstā
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu019_u.htm（原典总行数：725 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1050）

verses.iast: devānāṃ ca manuṣyāṇāṃ ca buddho bhagavān / tena kālena tena samayenāhaṃ sarvanīvaraṇaviṣkambhin
verses.meaningZh: 诸天人、诸天护法之以及诸人之以及觉者，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，借由彼力、以是因缘，以时，借由彼力、以是因缘，三昧耶·勇健·如是宣说，除一切盖障菩萨
verses.meaningEn: Of all god, celestial deity (Deva) and of person and buddho, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, by that truth, thereby, through that power, by/through black, by that truth, thereby, through that power, Samaya + strong + spoke, Sarvanivaranaviskambhin bodhisattva
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu019_u.htm（原典总行数：725 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1050）

verses.iast: dānaśūro nāma bodhisattvo mahāsattvo 'bhūvam / tasya śikhinastathāgatasya sakāśādavalokiteśvarasya bodhisattvasya mahāsatvasya guṇodbhāvanā
verses.meaningZh: 布施勇猛，名为、号曰，菩提萨埵，大菩萨，破有相福德光·最上真言离言说·无我大慈三昧，彼之、其（属格），尸弃佛·故乡·他·来之，融通·望·智火·随一·趣往·自在主，菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情）之，摩诃萨埵（大心有情、大菩萨）之，功德应作
verses.meaningEn: Generosity, by name, called, bodhisattvo, mahāsattvo, blessedness transcending existence & supreme ineffable speech & selfless great loving-kindness, his, of that, Sikhin Buddha + home + tha + of to come, to + hope + fire + mostly ) look + going + of Īśvara, of Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, of Mahāsattva, Great Spiritual Hero, virtue + manifestation
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu019_u.htm（原典总行数：725 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1050）

verses.iast: śrutā
verses.meaningZh: 闻
verses.meaningEn: Heard
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu019_u.htm（原典总行数：725 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1050）

verses.iast: atha sa balirasurendro yajñabhūmerniṣkrāntaḥ śarīracintāmāpede - dātā balirudārayajñamupāsya / kāladānasya dattasya bandhanameva
verses.meaningZh: 尔时、次复吉祥启白，彼、此尊（阳性主格），施食·阿修罗·印达罗，一乘如实之道·生起不可得·尊胜·圣智通达，身躯·思·是的·净水·此处尊，作施，施食·广大崇高·祭祠·常勤，时布施，施度调伏·真如实际·一切诸谛圆满，缚唯
verses.meaningEn: Now, thereupon, auspiciously, he, that one, Asura, supreme vehicle of awakening & transcending birth & victorious & non-dual wisdom awareness, body + thought + yes + water, dātā, noble + to be served, black + of generosity, generosity & self-mastery & immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, indeed
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu019_u.htm（原典总行数：725 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1050）

verses.iast: labdham / namo 'stu devāya / yathaiva kartā sartā sa nītvā pātālamupasthāpitaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 离一切相无相·解脱系缚大力·法界总持任持，归命，愿得成就、当如是，向天人、诸天护法，一乘如实之道·无住安立·最上真言离言说，部门、定异，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，彼、此尊（阳性主格），领导、指导已，陨·严·愈加·置
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from conditioned marks & spiritual strength freeing bonds & Dharma-realm retention, homage to may it be so, let it be! to/for god, celestial deity (Deva), supreme vehicle of awakening & non-abiding equipoise & supreme ineffable speech, division, distinction, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, he, that one, having lead, guide, conduct, direct, fall + enough + thereto
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu019_u.htm（原典总行数：725 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1050）

verses.iast: sāntaḥpuraparivāraḥ / ākhyātaṃ hi mayā bhagavan - bhūtapūrvaṃ kurukṣetre mayā dānaṃ dattaṃ
verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·离名相假立·真如实际，宣，诚然、因为、实乃，由我（具格：如是我闻），出有坏，古昔，刹土尊，由我（具格：如是我闻），布施，施度调伏·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness, declare, for, indeed, surely, by me, bhagavan, bhūtapūrvaṃ, O of a country and celebrated battle-field, by me, dānaṃ, generosity & self-mastery & immutable Suchness
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu019_u.htm（原典总行数：725 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1050）

verses.iast: tasyaitatkarmaphalamanubhavāmi / tathā trātā bhavāhi me bhagavannātha, na bhūyo duḥkhamāpnuyām
verses.meaningZh: 能作成办·真如实际，如是、亦复如是，守护，星宿运尊，于我、为我，出有坏依，不、非、无，又么，施度调伏·等虚空无碍·无我大慈三昧
verses.meaningEn: Making (vocative invocation), thus, in that same way, protected, star + O transport, to me, my, refuge, not, non-, bhūyo, generosity & self-mastery & space-like boundlessness & selfless great loving-kindness
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu019_u.htm（原典总行数：725 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1050）

verses.iast: atha āryāvalokiteśvaro balerindrasya vyākaraṇamanuprayacchati sma - bhaviṣyasi tvamasurendra śrīrnāma tathāgato 'rhan samyaksaṃbuddho
verses.meaningZh: 尔时、次复吉祥启白，圣观自在菩萨，解脱系缚大力·离一切相无相·清净离诸尘垢，记别·日复一日·与摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），当有汝即是，汝·阿修罗·因陀逻，吉祥名为，如来，应供、阿罗汉，正等觉
verses.meaningEn: Now, thereupon, auspiciously, Noble Avalokiteśvara, spiritual strength freeing bonds & freedom from conditioned marks & stainless purity free from dust, day after day, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, Thou art, Thou + Asura + Śakra king of the gods, by name, tathāgato, Arhat, Worthy One, samyaksaṃbuddho
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu019_u.htm（原典总行数：725 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1050）

verses.iast: vidyācaraṇasaṃpannaḥ sugato lokavidanuttaraḥ puruṣadamyasārathiḥ śāstā devānāṃ ca manuṣyāṇāṃ ca buddho bhagavān /
verses.meaningZh: 明行足，善逝，世间解无上，调御丈夫，天人师，诸天人、诸天护法之以及诸人之以及觉者，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵
verses.meaningEn: Vidyācaraṇasaṃpannaḥ, sugato, Knower of the World, puruṣadamyasārathiḥ, śāstā, of all god, celestial deity (Deva) and of person and buddho, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu019_u.htm（原典总行数：725 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1050）

verses.iast: sarve te 'surā vaineyā bhaviṣyanti / tatra tava buddhakṣetre na rāgaśabdo na
verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满尊，向汝、彼等，阿修罗（非天），老成，诸尊未来世、当头，于彼处、其中，汝之、圣尊之，佛土，不、非、无，贪染音，不、非、无
verses.meaningEn: O all, every, complete / in all, every, complete, to Thee / they, Asura, titan/demigod, one that is to be, they future, imminent, there, therein, your, thine, O Buddha-field, region or, not, non-, passion + sound, not, non-
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu019_u.htm（原典总行数：725 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1050）

verses.iast: dveṣaśabdo na mohaśabdo bhaviṣyati / ṣaḍakṣarī mahāvidyā labdhalābhā bhaviṣyati / tena tasya
verses.meaningZh: 瞋恚音，不、非、无，愚痴音，当，六字大明咒，大明咒、大明王母，离一切相无相·解脱系缚大力·法界总持任持，当，借由彼力、以是因缘，彼之、其（属格）
verses.meaningEn: Hatred + sound, not, non-, delusion + sound, will be, Mantra of Six Syllables, Mahāvidyā, Great Wisdom-Spell, freedom from conditioned marks & spiritual strength freeing bonds & Dharma-realm retention, will be, by that truth, thereby, through that power, his, of that
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu019_u.htm（原典总行数：725 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1050）

verses.iast: dharmadakṣiṇā upanāmitā / śatasahasramūlyaṃ muktāhāramupanāmitaṃ maulīkuṇḍalaṃ ca nānāratnasamuccitamupanāmitaṃ ca
verses.meaningZh: 自性左面，愈加哩溜歪斜，百千値，已解脱·如是宣说·此边·愈加·哩溜歪斜，无我大慈三昧·离一切相无相·造作离相以及高显超胜·离名相假立以及
verses.meaningEn: Nature + left, thereto + bent, sgl + value, liberated + spoke + thereto + bent, selfless great loving-kindness & freedom from conditioned marks & freedom from karmic agency and exalting and
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu019_u.htm（原典总行数：725 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1050）

verses.iast: ṣaḍakṣarīmahāvidyāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃ tṛtīyaṃ prakaraṇam
verses.meaningZh: 六字大明咒·大明咒·自在·显色·管保，第三，极所作
verses.meaningEn: Mantra of Six Syllables + Mahāvidyā + magnanimity + color + assuredly, tṛtīyaṃ, prakaraṇam
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu019_u.htm（原典总行数：725 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1050）

verses.iast: athāmitābhasya tathāgatārhataḥ samyaksaṃbuddhasya avalokiteśvarasya bodhisattvasya mahāsattvasya lambikarutena svareṇa nirghoṣeṇārocayati - pasya kulaputra
verses.meaningZh: 尔时阿弥陀佛之，如来堪敬，正等正觉、正遍知之，观自在菩萨（观世音）之，菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情）之，摩诃萨埵（大心有情、大菩萨）之，以俱枳罗以及以音词，离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢·破暗合集，第一义谛·一切诸谛圆满·一乘如实之道，善男子
verses.meaningEn: Now + of Amitābha, Tathāgata, of Perfectly and Completely Awakened Buddha, of Avalokiteśvara, Lord Who Looks Down in Compassion, of Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, of Mahāsattva, Great Spiritual Hero, the Indian cuckoo + by, by/through vowel, beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust & dissolving dense ignorance (vocative invocation), ultimate truth & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme vehicle of awakening, a good man
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu019_u.htm（原典总行数：725 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1050）

verses.iast: ayaṃ padmottamastathāgato 'rhan samyaksaṃbuddhaḥ ṣaḍakṣarīmahāvidyāyāḥ kāraṇenānekalokadhātukoṭīniyutaśatasahasrāṇi paribhramitaḥ / dadasva kulaputra ṣaḍakṣarīṃ mahāvidyāṃ
verses.meaningZh: 此尊、此法，第一义谛·施度调伏·无我大慈三昧，应供、阿罗汉，正等觉，六字大明咒大明咒，因·勇健·多·界境·魔爪·那由他·一切百千，般·漂·趣往，施予自，善男子，六度满行清净·息灭诤怨·造作离相，大明咒、大明王母
verses.meaningEn: This one, ultimate truth & generosity & self-mastery & selfless great loving-kindness, Arhat, Worthy One, samyaksaṃbuddhaḥ, Mantra of Six Syllables + of Mahāvidyā, cause + strong + not one + world-region + the curved end of the bow + tied on + sgl, wisdom + to wander + going, giving + own, a good man, perfection of the six pāramitās & pacifying conflict & turmoil & freedom from karmic agency, Mahāvidyā, Great Wisdom-Spell
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu019_u.htm（原典总行数：725 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1050）

verses.iast: rājñīm / tathāgata evaṃ paribhramati
verses.meaningZh: 清净离诸尘垢·生起不可得·尊胜·圣智通达，如来（乘如实道来成正觉），如是、如此，普遊行
verses.meaningEn: Stainless purity free from dust & transcending birth & victorious & non-dual wisdom awareness, Tathāgata, Thus-Come One, thus, in this way, paribhramati
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu019_u.htm（原典总行数：725 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1050）

verses.iast: iti ṣaḍakṣarimahāvidyāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃ tṛtīyaṃ prakaraṇam
verses.meaningZh: 如是（结句印定），广大殊胜·六度满行清净，第三，极所作
verses.meaningEn: Thus, so it is stated, great, tṛtīyaṃ, prakaraṇam
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu019_u.htm（原典总行数：725 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1050）

verses.iast: ṣaḍakṣarimahāvidyāmaṇḍalavarṇanaṃ caturthaṃ prakaraṇam
verses.meaningZh: 广大殊胜·六度满行清净，第四，极所作
verses.meaningEn: Great, caturthaṃ, prakaraṇam
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu019_u.htm（原典总行数：725 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1050）

verses.iast: iti ṣaḍakṣarimahāvidyāmaṇḍalavarṇanaṃ caturthaṃ prakaraṇam
verses.meaningZh: 如是（结句印定），广大殊胜·六度满行清净，第四，极所作
verses.meaningEn: Thus, so it is stated, great, caturthaṃ, prakaraṇam
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu019_u.htm（原典总行数：725 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1050）

verses.iast: atha avalokiteśvaro bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ padmottamasya tathāgatasyārhataḥ samyaksaṃbuddhasyemāṃ ṣaḍakṣarīṃ mahāvidyāmanuprayacchati
verses.meaningZh: 尔时、次复吉祥启白，观自在，菩提萨埵，大菩萨，莲华最上，如是·宝树宝山·彼佛母·打，觉悟正觉·一切诸谛圆满，六度满行清净·息灭诤怨·造作离相，大明咒·那罗·与
verses.meaningEn: Now, thereupon, auspiciously, avalokiteśvaro, bodhisattvo, mahāsattvaḥ, lotus flower + of highest, thus + tree or mountain + her, awakened, perfection of the six pāramitās & pacifying conflict & turmoil & freedom from karmic agency, Mahāvidyā + man
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu019_u.htm（原典总行数：725 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1050）

verses.iast: om maṇipadme hūṃ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！摩尼宝珠莲华尊，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Maṇi jewel + O lotus flower, Hūṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu019_u.htm（原典总行数：725 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1050）

verses.iast: mahāvidyāmaṇḍalavarṇanaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ prakaraṇam
verses.meaningZh: 大明咒·曼荼罗·显色·管保，第六，极所作
verses.meaningEn: Mahāvidyā + Maṇḍala + color + assuredly, sixth, prakaraṇam
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu019_u.htm（原典总行数：725 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1050）

verses.iast: athe sa dharmabhāṇakastasyaitadavocat - mā tvaṃ kulaputra kaukṛtyamutpādayasi / kati māṣāḥ kleṣā

verses.iast: namo 'stvalokiteśvarāya meheśvarāya prāṇaṃdadāya pṛthivīvaralocanakarāya śubhapadmaśriye parivṛtāya nirvāṇabhūmisaṃprasthitāya sucetanakarāya dharmadharāya
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·最上真言离言说·溲便自在主·施予饶益·第一义谛·大地殊胜慧眼·滑行一同·不是莲华·广大光华尊·围绕·涅槃地发趣·报刊往外价格·持法！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech (reverent offering), urine, to, granting (reverent offering), earth, choicest, to, glide along, having no lotus, O with great magnificence, covered, veiled, or hung with, surrounded or accompanied by, Nirvāṇa, ground, to, press out, to, Protector of the Dharma!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu019_u.htm（原典总行数：725 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1050）

verses.iast: parimocaya me strībhāvājjugupsanīyāt / kalimalaparipūrṇagarbhāvāsaduḥkhāt satataparigrahasaṃgṛhītāt parimokṣaya mām / athāvalokiteśvarastāmetadavocat - bhaviṣyasi
verses.meaningZh: 请普皆救脱、令离诸苦！于我、为我，一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢，罪垢·垢染·圆满·藏·住房·从苦，不已·摄受·桑·在家人·即是，祈请解脱，我（宾格：守护，无住安立·最上真言离言说·离一切相无相，当有汝即是
verses.meaningEn: Deliver completely from all suffering! to me, my, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust, sin + stain + filled or covered with + womb + dwelling + from suffering, continual + to protect + saṃ + become a house or habitation + thus, may You liberation, deliverance! me, non-abiding equipoise & supreme ineffable speech & freedom from conditioned marks, Thou art
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu019_u.htm（原典总行数：725 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1050）

verses.iast: tvaṃ bhagini umeśvaro nāma tathāgato 'rhan samyaksaṃbuddho vidyācaraṇasaṃpannaḥ sugato lokavidanuttaraḥ puruṣadamyasārathiḥ śāstā
verses.meaningZh: 汝、圣尊您，姊妹尊，难迥遮自在，名为、号曰，如来，应供、阿罗汉，正等觉，明行足，善逝，世间解无上，调御丈夫，天人师
verses.meaningEn: Thou, You, O sister, flax, by name, called, tathāgato, Arhat, Worthy One, samyaksaṃbuddho, vidyācaraṇasaṃpannaḥ, sugato, Knower of the World, puruṣadamyasārathiḥ, śāstā
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu019_u.htm（原典总行数：725 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1050）

verses.iast: devānāṃ ca manuṣyāṇāṃ ca buddho bhagavān / himavataḥ parvatarājasya dakṣiṇe pārśve tava
verses.meaningZh: 诸天人、诸天护法之以及诸人之以及觉者，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，雪山，山来诣之，右尊，脇肩尊，汝之、圣尊之
verses.meaningEn: Of all god, celestial deity (Deva) and of person and buddho, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, himavataḥ, of coming from or belonging to goats, O right / in right, O lying, your, thine
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu019_u.htm（原典总行数：725 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1050）

verses.iast: lokadhāturbhaviṣyati / atha sā umādevī vyākaraṇamanuprāptā
verses.meaningZh: 界境当，尔时、次复吉祥启白，彼、彼圣母（阴性主格），难迥遮天女，记别·日复一日·得
verses.meaningEn: Will be, now, thereupon, auspiciously, she, that, flax + goddess, day after day + filled with astonishment and wonder
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu019_u.htm（原典总行数：725 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1050）

titleZh: 【梵本原典】佛說聖佛母小字般若波羅蜜多經暨心真言 (P.L. Vaidya BST 17 / GRETIL 梵本)

verses.iast: namaḥ sarvabuddhabodhisattvebhyaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切佛陀菩提萨埵！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all, Buddha, Bodhisattva!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu050_u.htm（原典总行数：146 行 · 对勘大正藏 T08n0258）

verses.iast: evaṃ mayā śrutam
verses.meaningZh: 如是、如此，由我（具格：如是我闻），闻
verses.meaningEn: Thus, in this way, by me, heard
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu050_u.htm（原典总行数：146 行 · 对勘大正藏 T08n0258）

verses.iast: ekasmin samaye bhagavān rājagṛhe viharati sma gṛdhrakūṭe parvate mahatā bhikṣusaṃghena sārdham
verses.meaningZh: 一时，向平，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，王舍城尊，一切，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），灵鸟顶山尊，时节，广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，以比丘圣僧伽，俱
verses.meaningEn: At one time, to equal, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, O a king's house, palace, lives, dwells, spends oneʼs time, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, O Vulture Peak / in Vulture Peak, parvate, great, beggar + by, together
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu050_u.htm（原典总行数：146 行 · 对勘大正藏 T08n0258）

verses.iast: deśayatu bhagavān prajñāpāramitāṃ svalpākṣarāṃ mahāpuṇyām, yasyāḥ śravaṇamātreṇa sarvasattvāḥ sarvakarmāvaraṇāni kṣapayiṣyanti, niyataṃ ca bodhiparāyaṇā bhaviṣyanti
verses.meaningZh: 施度调伏·本性寂静止息·一乘如实之道，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，般若波罗蜜多（智慧度彼岸），渺小妙语，大福，诸凡彼…之，以听闻惟，诸一切众生、普皆有情，一切一切业障，造作离相·六度满行清净·第一义谛，刊以及菩提依护，诸尊未来世、当头
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery & primordial tranquil peace & supreme vehicle of awakening (imperative seal), the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, Perfection of Wisdom (Prajñāpāramitā), very small or minute + speech, very auspicious or fortunate, whose, of whom (plural), monk + by, all sentient beings (plural), all + karmic obscuration, freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās & ultimate truth (vocative invocation), restrained and Bodhi + going away, they future, imminent
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu050_u.htm（原典总行数：146 行 · 对勘大正藏 T08n0258）

verses.iast: namo ratnatrayāya
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛法僧三宝！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu050_u.htm（原典总行数：146 行 · 对勘大正藏 T08n0258）

verses.iast: namaḥ śākyamunaye tathāgatāya arhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼释迦牟尼佛（能仁寂默）·如来（乘如实道来成正觉）·应供（阿罗汉）致敬·正等正觉、正遍知！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Śākyamuni Buddha, Sage of the Śākyas, Tathāgata, Thus-Come One, the Arhat, Worthy One, Perfectly and Completely Awakened Buddha!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu050_u.htm（原典总行数：146 行 · 对勘大正藏 T08n0258）

verses.iast: tadyathā — oṃ mune mune mahāmunaye svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！再三无我大慈三昧·离名相假立，向大牟尼尊（释迦世尊），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation) again and again, to Great Sage (Mahāmuni), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu050_u.htm（原典总行数：146 行 · 对勘大正藏 T08n0258）

verses.iast: tadyathā — oṃ jeya jeya padmābhe avame avame sarasaraṇi dhiridhiri devatā anupālani yuddhottāriṇi paracakranivāriṇi
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！再三生起不可得·尊胜·一乘如实之道，莲华光明庄严，再三最少、其次尊，流注周遍途径，禅定坚固总持不失禅定坚固总持不失，天神，日复一日守护尊，战斗具弯曲，他兵·在于·具人群
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! transcending birth & victorious & supreme vehicle of awakening again and again, lotus flower + O splendour, O lowest, vilest again and again, flow forth and pervade with blessing! + way, steadfast meditative retention + steadfast meditative retention, a god, day after day + O keeping, fought + O bearer of crossing, enemy + in + O bearer of crowd
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu050_u.htm（原典总行数：146 行 · 对勘大正藏 T08n0258）

verses.iast: pūraya pūraya bhagavati sarva āśā mama ca sarvasattvānāṃ ca
verses.meaningZh: 再三充分、充分称计，世尊佛母！（呼格），一切、普皆遍满，望，我之（行者所有）以及诸一切众生、普皆有情之以及
verses.meaningEn: May You full again and again, O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī! all, every, complete, hope, my, of me (the practitioner) and of all all sentient beings and
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu050_u.htm（原典总行数：146 行 · 对勘大正藏 T08n0258）

verses.iast: sarvakarmāvaraṇāni viśodhaya, buddhādhiṣṭhite svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 一切一切业障，请最极净除、彻底涤净一切业障！佛陀所加持，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: All + karmic obscuration, thoroughly purify! cleanse completely! Buddha + O blessed, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu050_u.htm（原典总行数：146 行 · 对勘大正藏 T08n0258）

verses.iast: iyaṃ sā kulaputra paramārthaprajñāpāramitā sarvabuddhānāṃ jananī bodhisattvamātā bodhidātrī pāpahārakā
verses.meaningZh: 此圣女、此陀罗尼，彼、彼圣母（阴性主格），善男子，第一义谛般若波罗蜜多，一切没驮南，佛母，菩提萨埵母，菩提鎌佛母，罪业挑夫
verses.meaningEn: This (feminine), she, that, a good man, ultimate truth + Perfection of Wisdom, all + buddhānām, mother, Bodhisattva, Bodhi + sickle, evil + porter
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu050_u.htm（原典总行数：146 行 · 对勘大正藏 T08n0258）

verses.iast: svalpākṣarā prajñāpāramitā samāptā
verses.meaningZh: 渺小妙语，般若波罗蜜多（智慧度彼岸），三磨钵耽
verses.meaningEn: Very small or minute + speech, Perfection of Wisdom (Prajñāpāramitā), finished, complete, perfect
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu050_u.htm（原典总行数：146 行 · 对勘大正藏 T08n0258）

verses.iast: namo sarvabuddhabodhisattvebhyaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切佛陀菩提萨埵！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all, Buddha, Bodhisattva!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu055_u.htm（原典总行数：171 行 · 对勘大正藏 T08n0249）

verses.iast: namo daśasu dikṣu sarveṣāmatītānāgatapratyutpannānāṃ trayāṇāṃ ratnānām
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼十报刊往外·施度调伏·造作离相·六度满行清净·一切·轴·慧·趣往·末·诸现在时·诸三重、三合会·诸珍宝、摩尼宝！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to ten, press out, generosity & self-mastery & freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās (imperative seal), all, the pole of a carriage, intelligence, going, future, of all present, triple, threefold, jewel, precious gem, treasure!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu055_u.htm（原典总行数：171 行 · 对勘大正藏 T08n0249）

verses.iast: namo bhagavatyai prajñāpāramitāyai sarvatathāgatasunibhāyai sarvatathāgatānujñātavijñātāyai
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼世尊佛母顶礼·圣智了知·第一义谛·一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说·圣智了知·明了觉识·一切诸谛圆满！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Blessed Mother / Lady Bhagavatī, knowing (vocative invocation), all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation), knowing, discerning (vocative invocation)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu055_u.htm（原典总行数：171 行 · 对勘大正藏 T08n0249）

verses.iast: oṃ) prajñe mahāprajñe prajñāvabhāse prajñālokakāri ajñānavidhamane siddhe susiddhe siddhyamane gavate sarvāṅgasundari ktivatsale
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！聪明、英明尊，大慧，聪明普光明照，聪明·衍伸·妙音尊，黑闇扇子尊，成就者、已成就尊，善妙成就、最胜悉地尊，请成就妙悉地！自尊尊，特，全身孙陀利尊，造作离相·真如实际·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O intelligent, wise, knowing, mahāprajñe, intelligent + O splendor, intelligent + spawn + O the sound, ignorant + O fan, O accomplished, perfected adept (Siddha) / in accomplished, perfected adept (Siddha), O well-accomplished, supremely perfected / in well-accomplished, supremely perfected, be accomplished! manifest siddhi! + O pride, bull, the whole body + O Sundarī, freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu055_u.htm（原典总行数：171 行 · 对勘大正藏 T08n0249）

verses.iast: prasārahaste samāśvāsakare sidhya sidhya, budhya budhya, kampa kampa, cala cala, rāva rāva,
verses.meaningZh: 展手，援手掌尊，再三请成就、速赐悉地！再三请觉知、垂鉴觉照！再三疟疾，再三震动警觉、破除昏沉（左攞），再三叫声、妙音
verses.meaningEn: Stretching + O hand, breathing up + O palm, be accomplished! succeed! again and again, awake! perceive! behend! again and again, trembling, shaking, earthquake again and again, stir awake and shake off delusion! again and again, roaring, crying, sound, noise again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu055_u.htm（原典总行数：171 行 · 对勘大正藏 T08n0249）

verses.iast: āgaccha bhagavate mā vilamba svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 唯愿降临赴会！向世尊（薄伽梵）致敬，勿、莫令，搭拉、垫料，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Come hither! approach! to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, do not, let not, hanging down, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu055_u.htm（原典总行数：171 行 · 对勘大正藏 T08n0249）

verses.iast: namo dharmodgatasya bodhisattvasya mahāsattvasya mahākāruṇakasya
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼法起菩萨·菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情）·摩诃萨埵（大心有情、大菩萨）·大·善顺·谁！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Dharmodgata, Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, Mahāsattva, Great Spiritual Hero, great, compassionate!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu055_u.htm（原典总行数：171 行 · 对勘大正藏 T08n0249）

verses.iast: namo prajñāpāramitāyai
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼圣智了知·第一义谛！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to knowing (vocative invocation)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu055_u.htm（原典总行数：171 行 · 对勘大正藏 T08n0249）

verses.iast: tadyathā - munidharme saṃgrahadharme anugrahadharme vimokṣadharme sattvānugrahadharme vaiśramaṇadharme samantanuparivartanadharme guṇigrahasaṃgrahadharme sarvatrānugatadharme sarvakālaparipūrṇadharme svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：牟尼正法，摄正法，摄益正法，解脱正法，有情·摄益·正法，极微·沙弥·正法，一致·薄·转·正法，持守摄受·妙行趣入，一切处·相随·正法，从来·圆满·正法，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Muni + O Dharma, samgraha + O Dharma, to benefit + O Dharma, liberation + O Dharma, sentient being + to benefit + O Dharma, particle emphasizing the preceding word or merely expletive + ascetic + O Dharma, unanimous + thin + turning-place + O Dharma, bearing (vocative invocation), everywhere + gone after + O Dharma, at all times + filled or covered with + O Dharma, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu055_u.htm（原典总行数：171 行 · 对勘大正藏 T08n0249）

verses.iast: tadyathā - akhane nikhane mukhana nekhane paṭane paṭane paṭare svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：无空心、坑洞，在于空心，面门不，离名相假立·等虚空无碍，再三分裂自然，分裂唯，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: non-O digging, in + O digging, face + not, beyond nominal designation & space-like boundlessness (vocative invocation), split + O certainly again and again, split + particle, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu055_u.htm（原典总行数：171 行 · 对勘大正藏 T08n0249）

verses.iast: tadyathā - gaṅgā gaṅgā na tīrāvabhāsa gaṅgā svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：再三恒迦河，不、非、无，堤岸普光明照，恒迦河，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Ganges River again and again, not, non-, side + splendor, Ganges River, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu055_u.htm（原典总行数：171 行 · 对勘大正藏 T08n0249）

verses.iast: tadyathā śrīye śrīye muni śrīye śrīyase svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：再三清癯此处尊，牟尼、寂默圣者，清癯此处尊，吉祥庄严·本性寂静止息，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: lean again and again, Muni, silent sage, lean, glorious (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu055_u.htm（原典总行数：171 行 · 对勘大正藏 T08n0249）

verses.iast: tadyathā - oṃ vajrabale svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！金刚力，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! Vajra + O power, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu055_u.htm（原典总行数：171 行 · 对勘大正藏 T08n0249）

verses.iast: tadyathā - oṃ hrī śrī dhī śruti smṛti mati gati vijaye svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·禅定三昧总持），吉祥、圣德威光，驮字门（法界总持任持（dhātu，闻，正念、忆持不忘，慧、正念妙慧，趣向、六趣、妙行，最胜尊胜、普胜一切！尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — deep samādhi retention, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, Dharma-realm retention (dhātu) — deep samādhi retention, hearing, ear, sound, noise, report, hearsay, news, tidings, utterance or prescription, mindfulness, recollection, intelligence, wisdom, mindfulness, course, path, realm of rebirth, O supreme victory! triumph! / in supreme victory! triumph! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu055_u.htm（原典总行数：171 行 · 对勘大正藏 T08n0249）

verses.iast: tadyathā - bambari bambari mahābambari būru būru mahābūru svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：再三解脱系缚大力·无我大慈三昧·清净离诸尘垢，广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，再三解脱系缚大力·清净离诸尘垢，广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: spiritual strength freeing bonds & selfless great loving-kindness & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation) again and again, great (vocative invocation), spiritual strength freeing bonds & stainless purity free from dust (imperative seal) again and again, great (imperative seal), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu055_u.htm（原典总行数：171 行 · 对勘大正藏 T08n0249）

verses.iast: tadyathā - oṃ sarvavit svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：bsu055_u.htm（原典总行数：171 行 · 对勘大正藏 T08n0249）

titleZh: 【梵本原典】聖十一面觀自在菩薩根本心咒經 (Gilgit 樺樹皮寫本 / N. Dutt & Somadeva Vasudeva 校勘本)
titleEnglish: Heart Dhāraṇī of Eleven-Faced Avalokiteśvara (Gilgit Manuscript) (GRETIL ekmuhr_u.htm)
translatorZh: 哥廷根大学 GRETIL / 尼泊尔 DSBC 梵文贝叶经校勘本 (Ekadasamukhahrdayam)
sutraSourceZh: GRETIL 梵文佛典库 (ekmuhr_u.htm) · 汉译对勘：T20n1070 / T20n1071
deityZh: 十一面觀自在菩薩 (Ekādaśamukha Avalokiteśvara)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 本条目直接构建自德国哥廷根大学 GRETIL 梵语原典档案「ekmuhr_u.htm」（共 211 行，完整提取核心真言与经句共 69 句）。系统已自动将其原始 IAST 梵文实时转写为天城文、唐代悉昙梵字、唐宋古汉语音译、现代梵音拼读参考、国际音标 (IPA) 及摩多轻重音律。
recitationTipsZh: 此为学术校勘梵文写本原貌，每一句均配备「梵音拼读参考」与「唐宋古汉语音译」平行对照，且每个音节胶囊内均同时展示梵文、古汉语与现代拼读。

verses.iast: oṃ namaḥ sarvabuddhabodhisattvebhyaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！归命，向诸一切佛陀菩提萨埵
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to all + Buddha + to all Bodhisattva
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：ekmuhr_u.htm（原典总行数：211 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1070 / T20n1071）

verses.iast: ñ1.1 evaṃ mayā śru samaye bhagavāṃ cchrāvastyāṃ viharati sma, karī ṇḍalavāṭe var
verses.meaningZh: 如是、如此，由我（具格：如是我闻），啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·损减除灭忧苦），向平，世尊、薄伽梵（具六德尊），妙行迁变空·离覆障清凉·清净离诸尘垢，一切，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），掌佛母，离诸诤论无诤·息灭诤怨·离一切相无相，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Thus, in this way, by me, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — dispelling sorrow, to equal, the Blessed One, Bhagavān, awakened conduct beyond flux & coolness free of obscuration & stainless purity free from dust, lives, dwells, spends oneʼs time, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, palm, conflict-free peace & pacifying conflict & turmoil & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：ekmuhr_u.htm（原典总行数：211 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1070 / T20n1071）

verses.iast: ñ1.2 atha khalv āryāvalokiteśvaro bodhisa mahāsattvo 'nekavidyādharakoṭīniyutaśatasaha parivṛto yena bhagavāṃs tenopasamakrāmad ñ1.3
verses.meaningZh: 尔时、次复吉祥启白，嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk，圣观自在菩萨，菩提彼，大菩萨，多·持明仙·魔爪·那由他·因缘·无法方位，围绕，借由彼因缘，星宿诸特，真如实际·离名相假立·第一义谛

verses.meaningZh: 大、摩诃（广大无边），能作成办·造作离相，彼、真如彼岸，犹如、如…所说，再三篮子、积集尊，再三真如实际·断除憍慢执障，再三诡谲尊，去吧、趣向菩提！
verses.meaningEn: Great, vast, supreme, making (reverent offering), That (ultimate reality), just as, according to, O basket again and again, immutable Suchness & cutting rigid pride (vocative invocation) again and again, O boon-companion again and again, go! proceed!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：ekmuhr_u.htm（原典总行数：211 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1070 / T20n1071）

verses.iast: gaccha bhagavan- āryāvalokiteśvara sva-bhavanam- sva-bhavanam- svāhā / udake sapta-vārā parijapya caturdiśam- kṣipe
verses.meaningZh: 去吧、趣向菩提！出有坏，圣观自在菩萨，嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk，住埸，嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk，住埸，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！净水尊，七（七佛，人群、海众，般一样，全方位，央具梨尊
verses.meaningEn: Go! proceed! bhagavan, Noble Avalokiteśvara, supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — primordial non-arising, bhavanam, supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — primordial non-arising, bhavanam, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! O water, seven, crowd, multitude, wisdom + the same, towards the four quarters of the sky, all around, O finger / in finger
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：ekmuhr_u.htm（原典总行数：211 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1070 / T20n1071）

verses.iast: com āryāvalokiteśvara gaccha sva-bhavanaṃḥ
verses.meaningZh: 摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·摄受法流灌顶），圣观自在菩萨，去吧、趣向菩提！嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk，破有相福德光·最上真言离言说·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness — consecrating Dharma-stream, Noble Avalokiteśvara, go! proceed! supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — primordial non-arising, blessedness transcending existence & supreme ineffable speech & beyond nominal designation
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：ekmuhr_u.htm（原典总行数：211 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1070 / T20n1071）

verses.iast: end of hayagrīvāvidyā folio a different hand adds: oṃ namo ratnatrāyāyaḥ namaś
verses.meaningZh: 陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，悉昙「of」韵字门：摄受法流灌顶，马头明王无明，离一切相无相，悉昙「a」韵字门：本不生体性，施度调伏·清净离诸尘垢·离名相假立，陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，娑字门（一切诸谛圆满（sarvasatya）·本不生体性），嗡！归命，珍宝·守护掩蔽·即是·凡彼…者，归命敬礼·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — samādhi invocation, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'of': consecrating Dharma-stream, Hayagrīva + ignorance, freedom from conditioned marks, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising, generosity & self-mastery & stainless purity free from dust & beyond nominal designation, generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — primordial non-arising, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (satya) — primordial non-arising, Oṃ! homage to jewel + protect shelter + thus + whoever, bowing
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：ekmuhr_u.htm（原典总行数：211 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1070 / T20n1071）

verses.iast: caṇḍavajrapāṇa ye mahāśaktasenāpa ye . tad yathā ugrāya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 妙行迁变空·离诸诤论无诤·息灭诤怨，凡彼等诸有情，大·可·部·净水，凡彼等诸有情，彼、如是真实，犹如、如…所说，向威猛、大势力，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Awakened conduct beyond flux & conflict-free peace & pacifying conflict & turmoil, those who, whoever (pl.), great + can + missile + water, those who, whoever (pl.), that, thus, just as, according to, to/for mighty, fierce, formidable, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：ekmuhr_u.htm（原典总行数：211 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1070 / T20n1071）

verses.iast: ati ugrāya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 太，向威猛、大势力，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Very, to/for mighty, fierce, formidable, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.iast: ugrapriyāya svāhā ugrapriyāya svāhā . % derived from "rudrapriya" etc. ?
verses.meaningZh: 向威猛惜者，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！向威猛惜者，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！施度调伏·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·摄受法流灌顶），啼刻薄，左字门（妙行迁变空（caryā）·钩召发起三昧）
verses.meaningEn: Mighty + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! mighty + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! generosity & self-mastery & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, selfless great loving-kindness — consecrating Dharma-stream, to weep + unkind, awakened conduct beyond flux (caryā) — samādhi invocation
