provenance.rawSnippet: Āryāmoghapāśanāmahṛdayasūtram oṃ namaḥ śrīlokanāthāya / amoghapāśāya bhagavate namaḥ / evaṃ mayā śrutam ekasmin samaye bhagavān potalake parvate viharati sma / āryāvalokiteśvarasya bhuvane anekaśālatālatamālacampakāśokātimuktakanānāratnavṛkṣasamalaṅkṛte mahatā bhikṣusaṅghena sārdham aṣṭādaśabhir bhikṣusahasraiḥ navanavatibhiś ca bodhisattvakoṭiniyutaśatasahasraiḥ anekaiś ca śuddhāvāsikāyikair devaputrakoṭiniyutaśatasahasraiḥ parivṛtaḥ puraskṛta īśvaro maheśvarabrahmakāyikadevaputrān adhikṛtya dharmaṃ deśayati sma / atha khalu āryāvalokiteśvaro bodhisattvo mahāsattva utthāyāsanād ekāṃsam uttarāsaṃgaṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇajānumaṇḍalaṃ pṛthivyāṃ pratiṣṭhāpya yena bhagavāṃs tenāñjaliṃ kṛtvā praṇamya prahasitavadano bhūtvā bhagavantam etad avocat / asti mama bhagavan amoghapāśarājaṃ nāma hṛdayaṃ yan mayā pūrvam ekanavatikalpavilokitāyāṃ lokadhātau lokendrarājatathāgatasya arhatsamyaksaṃbuddhasya sakāśād udgrahītaṃ yena bhagavān ( AphSū 160 ) īśvaro maheśvaradevaputrapramukhāni bahūni śuddhāvāsikāyikadevaputrapramukhāny anekadevaputraśatasahasrāṇi samādāpitāny anuttarāyāṃ samyaksambodhau / asaṃmohajñānavyūhapramukhāni ca mayā daśasamādhiśatasahasrāṇi pratilabdhāni / yasmiṃś ca punar bhagavan pṛthivīpradeśe idam amoghapāśahṛdayaṃ pracaret / veditavyaṃ bhagavan tasmin pṛthivīpradeśe īśvaramaheśvarabrahmakāyikapramukhāni dvādaśadevaputraśatasahasrāṇi rakṣāvaraṇaguptaye sthāsyanti / caityasaṃmato bhagavan pṛthivīpradeśo bhaviṣyati yatredam amoghapāśahṛdayaṃ pracariṣyati / anekabuddhakoṭiniyutaśatasahasrāvaropitakuśalamūlās te bhagavan sattvā bhaviṣyanti / ya idaṃ amoghapāśahṛdayaṃ śroṣyanti / yaḥ kaścid bhagavan kilviṣakārī syāt sarvapāpāspadaḥ pāpadharmasamācārī āryāpavādakaḥ saddharmapratikṣepakaḥ avīciparāyaṇaḥ sarvabuddhabodhisattvāryaśrāvakapratyekabuddhapratikṣepakaḥ saced vipratisāraṃ gacched āyatyaṃ saṃvaram āpadyate / tasyaiva tāvad bhagavan upavāsajāpena ihaiva janmani tat karma viśudhyati parikṣayaṃ gacchati nivartitaṃ bhavati / ekāhikena jvareṇa dvyāhikena tryāhikena vā cāturthikena vā jvareṇa evaṃ saptāhikena vā jvareṇa / akṣiśūlena vā dantaśūlena vā karṇaśūlena vā nāsāśūlena vā dantoṣṭhaśūlena vā jivhāśūlena vā tāluśūlena vā hṛdayaśūlena vā udaraśūlena vā pārśvaśūlena vā kaṭiśūlena vā aṅgaśūlena vā pratyaṅgaśūlena vā arśagrahaṇīśūlena vā atisāreṇa vā hastapādavedanayā vā śirorujā vā balāhakacitrakuṣṭhavicarcikākiṭibhabhagandaralohaliṅgagalagrahavisphoṭakāpasmārakākhordākhyair vā kṛtāpakṛtyair māraṇabandhanatāḍanatarjanabhūtākhyānair ( AphSū 161 ) vā / saṃkṣepato bhagavan kāyapīḍayā vā cittapīḍayā vā dusvapnadarśanena vā tat karma parikṣayaṃ gacchati / paryavadānaṃ gacchati / prāg eva śuddhasattvānāṃ śraddhādhimuktikānāṃ yadi bhagavan catasraḥ parṣadaś catvāro varṇaḥ māyā imadhyanāpi ya idaṃ madīyam amoghapāśahṛdayaṃ śroṣyati udgrahīṣyati dhārayiṣyati vācayiṣyati likhiṣyati likhāpayiṣyati paryavāpsyati anyeṣāṃ ca sattvānāṃ śrāvayiṣyati antas tiryagyonigatānāṃ vā sattvānāṃ karṇapūṭe sthitvā karṇajāpaṃ dāsyati / imāni ca mantrapadāni cintayiṣyati / apratikṣepataḥ arūpataḥ avikalpataḥ asaṃprabhavataḥ aciram agamataḥ akaraṇataḥ niḥkleśataḥ samacittanikṣepataḥ virahitapañcaskandhaḥ / anena yogena buddhānusmṛtir bhāvayitavyā / tad eṣāṃ daśabhyo digbhyo buddhasahasraṃ saṃmukhaṃ darśanaṃ kariṣyanti / atyayadeśanāṃ ca kariṣyati / peyālam / yāvat pustakalikhitaṃ kṛtvā gṛhe sthāpayiṣyati / kiṃ bahunā bhagavann anyonyaspardhayā vā śroṣyati / svāmibhayena vā parānuvṛttyā vā uccagghanahetunā vā śroṣyanti / jñātavyaṃ bhagavan paṇḍitenāryāvalokiteśvarasyānubhāvena teṣāṃ karṇapuṭe sthitvā sa śabdo nipatiṣyati / tadyathāpi nāma bhagavan kaścid eva puruṣaś candanaṃ vā karpūraṃ vā kesaraṃ vā kastūrikāṃ vā ākṛṣya paribhāṣya śilāyāṃ vā bhūmau vā piṣṭvā ātmānaṃ lepayet / na ca tasya candanasya karpūrasya kesarasya kastūrikāyāś caivaṃ bhavati anenāham ākṛṣṭaḥ paribhāṣito vā gandhenātikramiṣyāmīti / api ca sugandha eva saḥ / evam eva bhagavann idaṃ madīyam amoghapāśahṛdayaṃ yaḥ kaścid uccaghana vā ullāpya / peyālam / ( AphSū 162 ) yāvat māyāśabdenāpātheyenāpi pūjayet / teṣāṃ bhagavan khaṭukāṃ sattvānāṃ sa eva kuśalahetur bhaviṣyati / yatra yatropapatsyante tatra tatra avirahitāś ca bhaviṣyanti śīlasamādhiprajñāpuṇyasaṃbhāragandhena / śīlasaugandhikam eva karoti / yaḥ kaścid bhagavan kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā bhikṣur vā bhikṣuṇī vā upāśako vā upāśikā vā tadanyo vā kaścit sattvaḥ amoghapāśahṛdayam uddiṣya śuklāṣṭamyām upavāsaṃ kuryāt / saptavārān amoghapāśahṛdayam anālāpataḥ āvartayet tasya bhagavan dṛṣṭa eva dharmā viṃśatir anuśaṃsāḥ pratikāṃkṣitavyāḥ / katame viṃśati? yaduta rogāś cāsya kāye notpatsyante / utpannāś cāsya rogāḥ karmavaśena śīghraṃ prasamaṃ yāsyanti / snigdhamanojñaślakṣṇagātraś ca bhaviṣyati / bahujanapriyaś ca bhaviṣyati / guhyārthapratilambhaś cāsya bhaviṣyanti / utpannāś cāsyārthaṃ na caurā pratimocayanti / agninā dahyate / nodakena hrīyate / na rājā śaknoti manasāpahartum / karmāntāś cāsya sphītā bhaviṣyanti / nāśaninodakabhayaṃ bhaviṣyati / na vātavṛṣṭibhayaṃ bhaviṣyati / saptavārān amoghapāśahṛdayena bhasmodakaṃ vā parijapya digvidig adha ūrdhvaś ca kṣetrasya bandho dātavyaḥ / sarvopadravopaśamiṣyati / na caujohārā ojo 'pahartuṃ śaknuvanti / sarvasattvānāṃ ca priyo bhaviṣyati mana-āpaś ca bhaviṣyati / na cāsya śatrubhayaṃ bhaviṣyati / utpannaś cāsya śatrubhayaṃ śīghraṃ praśamaṃ yāsyati / na cāsya manuṣyabhayaṃ bhaviṣyati / na ca kākhordabhayaṃ na ca ḍākinībhayaṃ na ca tīvrāḥ kleśopakleśā bhaviṣyanti / nāgninā na viṣeṇa na śastreṇa kālaṃ kariṣyanti / yatra yatropapatsyante tatra tatrāvirahitāś ca bhaviṣyanti maitrīkaruṇāmuditopekṣayā / ime viṃśatir anuśaṃsāḥ pratikāṃkṣitavyāḥ / aparān aṣṭau dharmān pratilapsyante / katamān aṣṭau? maraṇakāle āryāvalokiteśvaro bhikṣurūpeṇa saṃmukhaṃ darśanaṃ dāsyati / sukhena kālaṃ kariṣyati / na bhrāntadṛṣṭir ( AphSū 163 ) bhaviṣyati / na hastavikṣepaṃ kariṣyati / na pādavikṣepaṃ noccāraṃ na prasrāvaṃ na cārūḍhaḥ kālaṃ kariṣyati / supratiṣṭhitasmṛtir bhaviṣyati / nādhomukhaḥ kālaṃ kariṣyati / maraṇakāle 'kṣayapratibhānaṃ cāsya bhaviṣyati / yatra yatra cāsya buddhakṣetre praṇidhis tatra tatropapattir bhaviṣyati / avirahitaś ca bhaviṣyati kalyāṇamitraiḥ / dine dine trikālaṃ trīṇi vārān āvartayitavyam / madyamāṃsapalāṇḍuguñjanakalaśunaśaṃkārakṛtocchiṣṭaviśeṣārthino hy etad varjyaḥ / ayaṃ cāmoghapāśahṛdayaṃ nāma dharmaparyāyaḥ sarvasattvānāṃ balābalaṃ jñātvā śroṣayitavyaḥ / ācāryamuṣṭir na kartavyā / yasmād dhi gate malamātsaryerṣyāpagato bodhisattvā bhavanti / sattvānām arthakaraṇena bodhiḥ prāpyate bodhisattvānāṃ gaṇanāṃś ca gacchanti / bodhir ity ucyate prajñāsattva upāyaḥ / etau dvau dharmau sattvānām arthakaraṇenaiva prāpyete / sacen me bhagavann anujānīyād yan nv aham imaṃ hṛdayaṃ tathāgatasya purataḥ kīrtaye catasṛṇāṃ parṣadām arthāya hitāya sukhāyānyeṣāṃ ca pāpakāriṇām / atha khalu bhagavān āryāvalokiteśvaro bodhisattvaṃ mahāsattvam etad avocat / bhāṣasva śuddhasattvāya yasyedānīṃ kālaṃ manyase / anumoditaṃ tathāgatena paścimakāle paścimasamaye bodhisattvayānikānāṃ pitṛkāryaṃ kariṣyati / atha khalu āryāvalokiteśvaro bodhisattvo mahāsattvo 'nimiṣanayano bhūtvā bhagavantam etad avocat / śṛṇu me bhagavan sarvabuddhabodhisattvanamaskṛtam idaṃ vimokṣamukhamaṇḍalaṃ bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya mahato janakāyasyārthāya hitāya sukhāya vimokṣārthāya / nāmas tryadhvānugatapratiṣṭhitebhyaḥ sarvabuddhabodhisattvebhyaḥ / namaḥ pratyekabuddhāryaśrāvakasaṃghebhyo 'tītānāgatapratyutpannebhyaḥ / namaḥ samyaggatānām / ( AphSū 164 ) namaḥ samyakpratipannānām / namaḥ śāradvatīputrāya mahāmataye / namaḥ āryamaitreyapramukhebhyo provenance.rawSnippet: Mahāmāyūrīvidyārājñī oṃ namo bhagavatyai āryamahāmāyūryai mṛtasaṃjīvanīṃ devīṃ duṣṭasatvanivāraṇīṃ vidyā rājñīṃ mahātmānīṃ māyūrīṃ praṇamāmy ahaṃ namaḥ sarvabuddhabodhisatvebhyo 'rhadbhyaḥ samyaksaṃbuddhebhyo 'tītānāgatapratyutpannebhyaḥ sarvadharmamahāsaṃghebhyaḥ. namo buddhāya namo dharmāya namaḥ saṃghāya, namaḥ saptānāṃ samyaksaṃbuddhānāṃ saśrāvakasaṃghānāṃ, namo loke 'rhatāṃ, namo maitreyapramukhānāṃ bodhisatvānāṃ mahāsatvānāṃ, namo 'nāgāmināṃ, namaḥ sakṛdāgāmināṃ, namaḥ śrotāpannānāṃ, namo loke samyaggatānāṃ, namaḥ samyakpratipannānāṃ. eṣāṃ namaskṛtvā imāṃ mahāmāyūrīṃ vidyārājñīṃ prayojayiṣyāmi. iyaṃ me vidyā samṛdhyatu, śṛṇvantu me bhūtagaṇāḥ. ye kecit pṛthivīcarāḥ khacarā jalacarā devā nāgā asurā marutā garuḍā gandharvāḥ kinnarā mahoragā yakṣā rākṣasāḥ pretāḥ piśācā bhūtāḥ kumbhāṇḍāḥ pūtanāḥ kaṭapūtanāḥ skandā unmādāś cchāyā apasmārā ostārakāḥ śṛṇvantu me ojāhārā bhūtagaṇā garbhāhārā rudhirāharā vasāhārā māṃsāhārā medāhārā majjāhārā jātāhārā jīvitāhārā balyāhārā mālyāhārā gandhāhārā dhūpāhārāḥ puṣpāhārāḥ phalāhārāḥ sasyāhārā āhutyāhārāḥ pūjāhārārā viṣṭyāhārā mūtrāhārāḥ kheṭāhārāḥ śleṣmāhārāḥ śiṃghāṇakāhārā ucchiṣṭāhārā vāntāhārā aśucyāhārāḥ syandanikāhārāḥ, pāpacittāḥ duṣṭacittā raudracittāḥ paraprāṇaharāḥ. imāṃ mahāmāyūrīvidyārājñīṃ pravakṣyāmi, gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ baliṃ ca dāsyāmi, apakrāmantu me pāpacittāḥ duṣṭacittā raudracittāḥ paraprāṇaharāḥ sarvagrahā ojohārāḥ śṛṇvantu me, saumyacittā maitracittāḥ kalyāṇacittāḥ śṛṇvantu me buddhadharmasaṃghābhiprasannāḥ. tadyathā kāli karāli kumbhāṇḍi śaṃkhini kamalākṣi harīti harikeśi śrīmati hari haripiṅgale, laṃbe pralaṃbe kālapāśe kālaśodari yamadūti yamarākṣasi bhūtagrasani, pratīcchatha māṃ, gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpaṃ baliṃ ca dāsyāmi, rakṣatha mama sagaṇaparivārāṇāṃ sarvasatvānāṃś ca sarvabhayopadravebhyaḥ, jīvatu varṣaśataṃ paśyatu śaradāśataṃ, sidhyantu me mantrapadāḥ svāhā. evaṃ mayā śrutam ekasmiṃ samaye bhagavāṃ śrāvastyāṃ viharati sma, jetavane 'nāthapiṇḍasyārāme mahatā bhikṣusaṃghena mahatā bodhisatvasaṃghena sārdhaṃ, tena khalu punaḥ samayena śrāvastyāṃ jetavane 'nāthapiṇḍasyārāme svātir nāma bhikṣuḥ prativasati sma. navo dahrataruṇo 'cirapravrajito 'ciropasaṃpanno 'cirāgata imaṃ dharmavinayaṃ, saṃghasyārthe jentākadārūṇi pāṭayamānaḥ, anyatamasmāt pūtidāruśuṣirān niṣkramya mahatā kṛṣṇasarpeṇa dakṣiṇe pādāṃguṣṭho daṣṭaḥ sa klāntakāyo bhūmau nipatitaḥ, phenaṃ vāhayamāno 'kṣiṇī ca parivartayamānaḥ svapiti. adrākṣīd āyuṣmān ānandaḥ svātir nāma bhikṣum ābādhikaṃ duḥkhitaṃ gāḍhaglānaṃ bhūmau patitaṃ phenaṃ vāhayamānam akṣiṇī parivartayamānaṃ svapantaṃ, dṛṣṭvā ca punas tvaritaṃ tvaritaṃ yena bhagavāṃs tenopasaṃkrāntaḥ, upasaṃkramya bhagavataḥ pādau śirasā vanditvaikānte 'sthāt. ekāntasthitaś cāyuṣmān ānando bhagavantam etad avocat. iha bhagavan chrāvastyāṃ jetavane 'nāthapiṇḍasyārāme svātir nāma bhikṣuḥ prativasati, navo dahras taruṇo 'cirapravrajito 'ciropasaṃpanno 'cirāgata imaṃ dharmavinayaṃ. saṃghasyārthe jentākadārūṇi pāṭayamāno 'nyatamasmāt pūtidārusuṣirān niṣkramya mahatā kṛṣṇasarpeṇa dakṣiṇe pādāṃguṣṭho daṣṭaḥ. sa klāntakāyo bhūmau patitaḥ phenaṃ vāhayamāno 'kṣiṇī ca parivartayamānaḥ svapiti, tasyāhaṃ bhagavaṃ kathaṃ pratipadyāmi. evam ukte bhagavān āyuṣmantam ānandam etad avocat. gaccha tvam ānanda tathāgatasya vacanenānayā mahāmāyūryā vidyārājñyā svāter bhikṣo rakṣāṃ kuru, guptiṃ paritrāṇaṃ parigrahaṃ paripālanaṃ śāntiṃ svastyayanaṃ daṇḍaparihāraṃ śastraparihāraṃ viṣadūṣaṇaṃ viṣanāśanaṃ sīmābandhaṃ dharaṇībandhaṃ ca kuru. devagrahāto nāgagrahāto 'suragrahāto marutagrahāto garuḍagrahāto gandharvagrahātaḥ kinnaragrahāto mahoragagrahāto yakṣagrahāto rākṣasagrahātaḥ pretagrahātaḥ piśācagrahāto bhūtagrahātaḥ kumbhāṇḍagrahātaḥ pūtanagrahātaḥ kaṭapūtanagrahātaḥ verses.meaningEn: Swiftly protect and sweep away calamity! again and again, meditative absorption & steadfast mindfulness again and again, intimate union with the deity samādhi again and again, ultimate truth & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation) again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: kili kili, śīrṣeṇa varṣaṃ, culu culu, cala cala, cili cili, ciḍi ciḍi
verses.meaningZh: 再三金刚橛威神警觉、摧伏魔军（吉栗），以顶首、头顶佛冠，年，再三鼓动法水涤除罪垢（主嚧），再三震动警觉、破除昏沉（左攞），再三积集一切白净善法功德（唧哩），再三妙行迁变空·息灭诤怨
verses.meaningEn: Vajra-kīla transfixing obstacles & awakening again and again, by/through head, crown, varṣaṃ, stir the purifying waters of compassion! again and again, stir awake and shake off delusion! again and again, gathering pure Dharmic merits & radiance again and again, awakened conduct beyond flux & pacifying conflict & turmoil (vocative invocation) again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: ciḍi ciḍi, śikhi śikhi śikhi śikhi, juhu juhu juhu juhu juhu juhu
verses.meaningZh: 再三妙行迁变空·息灭诤怨，再三孔雀尊，再三生起不可得·尊胜·因缘空寂大乐
verses.meaningEn: Awakened conduct beyond flux & pacifying conflict & turmoil (vocative invocation) again and again, O Sikhin again and again, transcending birth & victorious & causal emptiness & spiritual joy (imperative seal) again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: juhu juhu juhu juhu, hara hara haraṇe, jaṃbhe prajaṃbhe, sarvaduṣṭapraduṣṭānāṃ ca jaṃbhe
verses.meaningZh: 再三生起不可得·尊胜·因缘空寂大乐，再三请摄取、遣除苦厄！夺尊，生起不可得·尊胜·破有相福德光，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·生起不可得·尊胜，一切·暴恶者·诸败坏以及生起不可得·尊胜·破有相福德光
verses.meaningEn: Transcending birth & victorious & causal emptiness & spiritual joy (imperative seal) again and again, carry away (suffering)! remove! again and again, O carrying, conveying, taking, receiving, seizing, holding, robbing, removing, destroyi / in carrying, conveying, taking, receiving, seizing, holding, robbing, removing, destroyi, transcending birth & victorious & blessedness transcending existence (vocative invocation), ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & transcending birth & victorious (vocative invocation), all + wicked + of all corrupt and transcending birth & victorious & blessedness transcending existence (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: prajaṃbhe, svāter bhikṣor mama sarvasatvānāṃ ca rakṣāṃ karomi, guptiṃ paritrāṇaṃ parigrahaṃ paripālanaṃ
verses.meaningZh: 第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·生起不可得·尊胜，昴宿，比丘，我之（行者所有），诸一切众生、普皆有情之以及守护、结界护念，能作成办·造作离相，色相、兵团，皆护，摄受，守护、养育
verses.meaningEn: Ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & transcending birth & victorious (vocative invocation), of the auspicious Svātī constellation, of beggar, religious mendicant, a Brahman in the last stage of his life, also a Buddhist, my, of me (the practitioner), of all all sentient beings and protection, safeguarding, making (vocative invocation), form, formation, fashion, paritrāṇaṃ, to protect, protection, guard, nurture, maintenance, care
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: śāntiṃ svastyayanaṃ daṇḍaparihāraṃ śastraparihāraṃ viṣadūṣaṇaṃ viṣanāśanaṃ sīmābandhaṃ dharaṇībandhaṃ ca karomi. jīvatu varṣaśataṃ
verses.meaningZh: 息灾、寂静、安隐，成妙善乐，金刚杖回答，刀杖兵戈回答，摧灭毒素，毒害摧灭，结界，簷结界系缚邪魔外障以及能作成办·造作离相，愿命者，年百
verses.meaningEn: Peace, pacification, tranquility, svastyayanaṃ, staff + watchful care, weapon + watchful care, destroying poison, poison + destroying, drawing a strict line of, support + bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! and making (vocative invocation), may it living, alive, raining
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: paśyatu śaradāśataṃ. tadyathā. citramūle citre citramāle, hale halamāle, phale phalamāle, hale hale,
verses.meaningZh: 愿了知、聪明，箭·作持圣供·走道那么，即说咒曰：感觉不是根本尊，彩画尊，彩画花鬘，耕，耕花鬘，果尊，果花鬘，再三耕
verses.meaningEn: May it looking, knowing, intelligent! reed + make offering + walk about, Thus goes the mantra: perceive + O having no root, O a color painting / in a color painting, a color painting + O garland, O plough / in plough, plough + O garland, O direct effect, direct effect + O garland, O plough / in plough again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: māle māle, khulu khulu vuru varuṇo, dhīre dharya, suru suru, hataṃ viṣaṃ,
verses.meaningZh: 再三花鬘、殿堂尊，再三等虚空无碍·离一切相无相，最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢，水神，勇猛，持守摄受·法界总持任持，再三甘露妙流普润群生（素噜），打，箭毒
verses.meaningEn: O garland again and again, space-like boundlessness & freedom from conditioned marks (imperative seal) again and again, supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust (imperative seal), varuṇo, O intelligent, skilful, clever, wise, bearing, stream forth auspicious ambrosia! again and again, smitten, beaten, struck, raised, viṣaṃ
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: nihataṃ viṣaṃ, sarvaduṣṭapraduṣṭānāṃ draṃṣṭrāviṣaṃ mūlaviṣaṃ annaviṣaṃ sarvabuddhānāṃ tejasā, suru suru ke, cara
verses.meaningZh: 坏，箭毒，一切·暴恶者·诸败坏，施度调伏·清净离诸尘垢·六度满行清净，尾箭毒，喫食箭毒，一切没驮南，真如实际·生起不可得·尊胜·一切诸谛圆满，再三甘露妙流普润群生（素噜），迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·钩召发起三昧），行持妙道、周游救护（左啰）
verses.meaningEn: Nihataṃ, viṣaṃ, all + wicked + of all corrupt, generosity & self-mastery & stainless purity free from dust & perfection of the six pāramitās, root, food, all + buddhānām, immutable Suchness & transcending birth & victorious & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, stream forth auspicious ambrosia! again and again, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — samādhi invocation, move forth in compassionate activity!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: cara ke, biri biri, hataṃ viṣaṃ, nāsti viṣaṃ, saptānāṃ samyaksaṃbuddhānāṃ, saśrāvakasaṃghānāṃ tejasā,
verses.meaningZh: 行持妙道、周游救护（左啰），迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·钩召发起三昧），再三解脱系缚大力·清净离诸尘垢，打，箭毒，离名相假立·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际，箭毒，诸七（七佛，诸正等正觉、正遍知之，彼·舍罗婆迦·诸圣僧伽，真如实际·生起不可得·尊胜·一切诸谛圆满
verses.meaningEn: Move forth in compassionate activity! freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — samādhi invocation, spiritual strength freeing bonds & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation) again and again, smitten, beaten, struck, raised, viṣaṃ, beyond nominal designation & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), viṣaṃ, of all seven, of all Perfectly and Completely Awakened Buddha, he + sravaka + of all Saṃgha, immutable Suchness & transcending birth & victorious & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: ela melā, ili melā, tili melā, tiha duha tilimā timā dumā, vimadhu
verses.meaningZh: 翳罗，谜罗，法界平等摄持心印（伊利），谜罗，芝麻尊，谜罗，真如实际·因缘空寂大乐，施度调伏·因缘空寂大乐，真如实际·离一切相无相·无我大慈三昧，真如实际·无我大慈三昧，施度调伏·无我大慈三昧，闢蜜
verses.meaningEn: Ela, meeting, assembly, primordial Dharma-realm equipoise, meeting, assembly, O the sesamum plant or seed, meeting, assembly, immutable Suchness & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, generosity & self-mastery & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, immutable Suchness & freedom from conditioned marks & selfless great loving-kindness, immutable Suchness & selfless great loving-kindness, generosity & self-mastery & selfless great loving-kindness, settle + sweet
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: sukumbhā sumbhā tumbā samatumbā, āḍe nāḍe, tila kuñjanāḍe, varṣatu devaḥ, tilikisi samantena
verses.meaningZh: 报刊往外瓮，孙婆，真如实际·无我大慈三昧·解脱系缚大力，一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·真如实际，息灭诤怨，茎干尊，芝麻，灌木茎干尊，愿年，天，真如实际·离一切相无相·造作离相，以普遍、周遍十方
verses.meaningEn: Press out + an urn, of a people, immutable Suchness & selfless great loving-kindness & spiritual strength freeing bonds, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & immutable Suchness, pacifying conflict & turmoil (vocative invocation), O stalk / in stalk, the sesamum plant or seed, bush + O stalk, may it raining, devaḥ, immutable Suchness & freedom from conditioned marks & freedom from karmic agency (vocative invocation), by/through universal, all-encompassing
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: navamāsāṃ, maitrī me sarvasatveṣu vuśaḍe śavariṇi vudāriṇi vudāriṇi, kevaṭṭe kevaṭṭakamūle itiśabare, tuṃbe
verses.meaningZh: 第九床坐，慈心（与乐大慈），于我、为我，于诸一切众生、普皆有情中，最上真言离言说·本性寂静止息·息灭诤怨，具优势、威神力尊，再三最上真言离言说·施度调伏·清净离诸尘垢，渔者尊，渔者·之后·鳞茎尊，如是山行，真如实际·解脱系缚大力
verses.meaningEn: The ninth + seat, loving-kindness, benevolence (Maitrī), to me, my, among/in all sentient beings, supreme ineffable speech & primordial tranquil peace & pacifying conflict & turmoil (vocative invocation), O bearer of superiority, power, strength, heroism, supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation) again and again, O fisherman / in fisherman, fisherman + or emphasizing particle + O bulb, thus + O of a people, immutable Suchness & spiritual strength freeing bonds (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: tuṃbe priyaṃ kare, āvaṭṭa parivaṭṭa, navodakena varṣatu devaḥ samantena, namo bhagavate indragomisikāya
verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·解脱系缚大力，惜者，掌尊，最上真言离言说·断除憍慢执障，般回合，以九浮肿，愿年，天，以普遍、周遍十方，归命，向世尊（薄伽梵）致敬，因陀逻·牯牛·花木·身
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & spiritual strength freeing bonds (vocative invocation), dear, valued, pleasing to, beloved of, one's own, O palm, supreme ineffable speech & cutting rigid pride, wisdom + round, nine + by, may it raining, devaḥ, by/through universal, all-encompassing, homage to to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, Śakra king of the gods + bull + of plants + body
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: iṭṭitāya godohikāya bhṛṅgārikāya, ale tale kuntale, aṭṭe naṭṭe kunaṭṭe āśane pāśane, pāpanikūle
verses.meaningZh: 断除憍慢执障·真如实际·一乘如实之道，妙行趣入·施度调伏·因缘空寂大乐，破有相福德光·支分寂静·妙行趣入，严，表面地面尊，毫发尊，楼房尊，离名相假立·断除憍慢执障，造作离相·离名相假立·断除憍慢执障，本性寂静止息·离名相假立，第一义谛·本性寂静止息·离名相假立，罪业不平
verses.meaningEn: Cutting rigid pride & immutable Suchness & supreme vehicle of awakening (reverent offering), awakened spiritual movement & generosity & self-mastery & causal emptiness & spiritual joy (reverent offering), blessedness transcending existence & quiescence of perceptual limbs & awakened spiritual movement (reverent offering), ale, O surface of the ground, O hair / in hair, O tower, buttress, also / in tower, buttress, also, beyond nominal designation & cutting rigid pride (vocative invocation), freedom from karmic agency & beyond nominal designation & cutting rigid pride (vocative invocation), primordial tranquil peace & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), ultimate truth & primordial tranquil peace & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), evil + O low
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: pratikūle, namo bhagavatāṃ buddhānāṃ. sidhyantu mantrapadāḥ svāhā. aśokam āśritya jino vipaśyī śikhī
verses.meaningZh: 不顺尊，归命，才鸣呼，没驮南，愿诸真言章句悉皆成就，诸真言章句、密咒句义，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！无忧花，本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，胜者，胜观，孔雀
verses.meaningEn: O counter-pinnacle? / in counter-pinnacle?, homage to excellence, buddhānām, may all mantra-padas succeed! sacred mantra phrase (plural), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! aśokam, primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, jino, Vipaśyī Buddha, Sikhin
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: jinaḥ puṇḍarīkasya mūle, śālasya mūle upagamya viśvabhūt śirīṣamūle krakucchandabrāhmaṇaḥ. buddhaś ca kanakamuni
verses.meaningZh: 胜者，白莲华（芬陀利花）之，以下，娑罗之，以下，趣入通行·第一义谛，遍一切也许，以尸利沙树下，拘留孙婆罗门，觉悟正觉·解脱系缚大力以及拘那含牟尼
verses.meaningEn: Jinaḥ, of white lotus (Puṇḍarīka), at the door, of sala tree, at the door, going toward, all-pervading + perhaps, acacia tree + at the door, Krakucchanda Buddha, awakened and gold muni
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: uduṃbare nyagrodhamūle upagamya kāśyapaḥ, aśvatthamūle muni śākyapuṅgavaḥ upetya bodhiṃ samavāpya gotamaḥ. eteṣu
verses.meaningZh: 施度调伏·解脱系缚大力·清净离诸尘垢，以尼拘律树下，趣入通行·第一义谛，护容子，以阿说他树下，牟尼、寂默圣者，释子尊，第一义谛·真如实际·一乘如实之道，菩提、无上正觉，随着由于，男人，于诸长柄、本刹中
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery & spiritual strength freeing bonds & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), the Indian fig-tree + at the door, going toward, kāśyapaḥ, asvattha tree + at the door, Muni, silent sage, śākyapuṅgavaḥ, ultimate truth & immutable Suchness & supreme vehicle of awakening, Bodhi, awakening, enlightenment, along with + to be obtained, the biggest ox, among/in stem, sgl
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: buddheṣu maharddhikeṣu yā devatāḥ santi atiprasannāḥ, tā devatā muditamanā udagrāḥ kurvantu śāntiṃ
verses.meaningZh: 于诸佛陀、觉者中，于诸世间此恶者中，凡彼（阴性关系代词），诸何为，一切诸谛圆满·离名相假立·真如实际，诸以及种类，多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·远离寂静周遍），天神，波牟提陀我身，诸喜，愿一切诸尊普皆施作护持！息灾、寂静、安隐
verses.meaningEn: Among/in Buddha, the Awakened One, of a world + among, who, whichever (f.), divinity, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), too kind of (plural), immutable Suchness (tathatā) — expansive quiescence, a god, joyful + you were almost cursed by me, joyful, delighted, may they all perform/grant! peace, pacification, tranquility
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: ca śivaṃ ca nityaṃ. tadyathā. ili mili, kili mili, cili kili voli,
verses.meaningZh: 左字门（妙行迁变空（caryā）·本不生体性），寂静以及常恒、永不间断，即说咒曰：法界平等摄持心印（伊利），契合本尊三昧、慈悲冥合（弥利），金刚橛威神警觉、摧伏魔军（吉栗），契合本尊三昧、慈悲冥合（弥利），积集一切白净善法功德（唧哩），金刚橛威神警觉、摧伏魔军（吉栗），最上真言离言说·离一切相无相
verses.meaningEn: Awakened conduct beyond flux (caryā) — primordial non-arising, kind, friendly, mild, gracious, lovely, auspicious, fortunate and constantly, eternally, Thus goes the mantra: primordial Dharma-realm equipoise, intimate union with the deity samādhi, vajra-kīla transfixing obstacles & awakening, intimate union with the deity samādhi, gathering pure Dharmic merits & radiance, vajra-kīla transfixing obstacles & awakening, supreme ineffable speech & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: udumbare, sudumoḍe, busara busara, hu hu, karañje karañjamūle, iti sanatā kuntari kuntāri,
verses.meaningZh: 优昙华尊，报刊往外·难近母摧伏魔怨护法种子·那罗尊，再三解脱系缚大力·一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢，再三贺字门（因缘空寂大乐（hetu，宝树尊，以宝树下，如是（结句印定），从中古老、曾经，造作离相·离名相假立·真如实际，折脚蚁踊跃

verses.meaningZh: 摄受，守护、养育，息灾、寂静、安隐，成妙善乐，金刚杖回答，刀杖兵戈回答，摧灭毒素，毒害摧灭，结界，簷结界系缚邪魔外障以及愿成办、愿施作加持！
verses.meaningEn: To protect, protection, guard, nurture, maintenance, care, peace, pacification, tranquility, svastyayanaṃ, staff + watchful care, weapon + watchful care, destroying poison, poison + destroying, drawing a strict line of, support + bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! and may he/she perform and accomplish!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: jīvatu varṣaśataṃ paśyatu śaradāśataṃ. tadyathā. sori sori, siri siri, mati mati, hiri
verses.meaningZh: 愿命者，年百，愿了知、聪明，箭·作持圣供·走道那么，即说咒曰：再三梵音、妙音尊，再三吉祥福德流注庄严（悉哩，再三慧、正念妙慧，乐队、斑纹尊
verses.meaningEn: May it living, alive, raining, may it looking, knowing, intelligent! reed + make offering + walk about, Thus goes the mantra: O voice, sound again and again, auspicious Śrī fortune & sacred grace again and again, intelligence, wisdom, mindfulness again and again, O band, stripe
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: hiri, mati pele mati pele, piṃgale curu curu, hataṃ viṣaṃ, bandhumati, nihataṃ
verses.meaningZh: 乐队、斑纹尊，慧、正念妙慧，胯卵尊，慧、正念妙慧，胯卵尊，第一义谛·妙行趣入·离一切相无相，再三速疾运转妙法加持（祖噜），打，箭毒，亲枝慧，坏
verses.meaningEn: O band, stripe, intelligence, wisdom, mindfulness, O testicle / in testicle, intelligence, wisdom, mindfulness, O testicle / in testicle, ultimate truth & awakened spiritual movement & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), swiftly set sacred blessings in motion! again and again, smitten, beaten, struck, raised, viṣaṃ, connection + intelligence, nihataṃ

verses.iast: viṣaṃ bandhumati svāhā. pūrveṇa dhṛtarāṣṭras tu dakṣiṇena virūḍhakaḥ, paścimena virūpākṣaḥ kuberaś cottarādiśaṃ.
verses.meaningZh: 箭毒，亲枝慧，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！阵地、之前，法界总持任持·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢，然而、而、实则，以右，胜生，以西，广目，造作离相·解脱系缚大力·清净离诸尘垢，妙行迁变空·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Viṣaṃ, connection + intelligence, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! in front, Dharma-realm retention & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust, but, indeed, moreover, by/through right, virūḍhakaḥ, by/through (last =) lowest, mean, vulgar, virūpākṣaḥ, freedom from karmic agency & spiritual strength freeing bonds & stainless purity free from dust, awakened conduct beyond flux & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: catvāra ete mahārājā lokapālā yaśasvinaḥ, diśaś catasraḥ paripālayanti mahāsainyā mahābalāḥ. paracakrapramathanāḥ durdharṣā
verses.meaningZh: 交叉点、平方，此等诸尊，大王，持护世界，一样，施度调伏·本性寂静止息，妙行迁变空·真如实际·一切诸谛圆满，诸尊请周遍护持、恒常守护！大多，诸大力威神、大势力尊，他兵诸极摧坏，难敌
verses.meaningEn: Crossroads, square, these, great king, world-protector, the same, generosity & self-mastery & primordial tranquil peace, awakened conduct beyond flux & immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, they completely protect and sustain! great + relating to an army, of great power and might (plural), enemy + tormenting, difficult to be assaulted or approached, invincible, dangerous, terrible
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: cāparājitāḥ, ṛddhimanto dyutimanto varṇavanto yaśasvinaḥ, devāsuram api saṃgrāmam anubhavanti maharddhikāḥ. te 'py
verses.meaningZh: 宝弓·在位·诸趣往，施度调伏·法界总持任持·无我大慈三昧，虚空·部多寂静·末，最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤，一样，天人阿修罗，亦、虽、乃至，圣众、怀敌意遭遇，诸尊顾忌、想蕴，世间诸此恶者，向汝、彼等，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Bow + reign + going, generosity & self-mastery & Dharma-realm retention & selfless great loving-kindness, sky + become quiet + end, supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace, the same, god + Asura, even, also, popular assembly, host, troop, they apprehension, perception, of a world + alas! shame! fie! to Thee / they, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: anayā mahāmāyūryā vidyārājñyā svāter bhikṣor mama sarvasatvānāṃ ca rakṣāṃ kurvantu, guptiṃ paritrāṇaṃ
verses.meaningZh: 此，以孔雀明王，以明妃，昴宿，比丘，我之（行者所有），诸一切众生、普皆有情之以及守护、结界护念，愿一切诸尊普皆施作护持！色相、兵团，皆护
verses.meaningEn: Anayā, with/by Peahen Queen, with/by wise consort, of the auspicious Svātī constellation, of beggar, religious mendicant, a Brahman in the last stage of his life, also a Buddhist, my, of me (the practitioner), of all all sentient beings and protection, safeguarding, may they all perform/grant! form, formation, fashion, paritrāṇaṃ
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: parigrahaṃ paripālanaṃ śāntiṃ svastyayanaṃ daṇḍaparihāraṃ śastraparihāraṃ viṣadūṣaṇaṃ viṣanāśanaṃ sīmābandhaṃ dharaṇībandhaṃ ca kurvantu,

verses.meaningEn: To protect, protection, guard, nurture, maintenance, care, peace, pacification, tranquility, svastyayanaṃ, staff + watchful care, weapon + watchful care, destroying poison, poison + destroying, drawing a strict line of, support + bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! and may they all perform/grant!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: jīvatu varṣaśataṃ paśyatu śaradāśataṃ. tadyathā. ele mele, kile tile, mile śile, vāse,
verses.meaningZh: 愿命者，年百，愿了知、聪明，箭·作持圣供·走道那么，即说咒曰：翳罗尊，谜罗尊，根由尊，芝麻尊，冥合融摄·无我大慈三昧，耳根尊，居尊
verses.meaningEn: May it living, alive, raining, may it looking, knowing, intelligent! reed + make offering + walk about, Thus goes the mantra: ele, O meeting, assembly / in meeting, assembly, O indeed, of course / in indeed, of course, O the sesamum plant or seed, uniting (vocative invocation), O an ear of corn left on the field the gleaning of it / in an ear of corn left on the field the gleaning of it, O dwell / in dwell
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: duṃbe duṃbe, varṣatu devaḥ samantena hili mili tuṃbe tuṃbe, aṭṭa vaṭṭa paradu
verses.meaningZh: 再三施度调伏·解脱系缚大力，愿年，天，以普遍、周遍十方，定慧摄持、心无散乱（希利），契合本尊三昧、慈悲冥合（弥利），再三真如实际·解脱系缚大力，楼房，回合，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·施度调伏
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery & spiritual strength freeing bonds (vocative invocation) again and again, may it raining, devaḥ, by/through universal, all-encompassing, meditative absorption & steadfast mindfulness, intimate union with the deity samādhi, immutable Suchness & spiritual strength freeing bonds (vocative invocation) again and again, tower, buttress, also, round, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & generosity & self-mastery (imperative seal)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: vattā varṣatu devo guḍa guḍantu samantenāḍakovatyāṃ, aṇḍe maṇḍe tunde tutunde curke vukke,
verses.meaningZh: 最上真言离言说·真如实际，愿年，天，黑糖，愿悉黑糖，一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·离名相假立，卵尊，妙，肚子、肚脐尊，真如实际·离名相假立·施度调伏，妙行迁变空·清净离诸尘垢·造作离相，肾脏尊
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & immutable Suchness, may it raining, devo, ball, may they ball! all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation, O egg / in egg, O cream, O belly, navel / in belly, navel, immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation & generosity & self-mastery (vocative invocation), awakened conduct beyond flux & stainless purity free from dust & freedom from karmic agency (vocative invocation), O kidney / in kidney
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: iriḍi miriḍi niriḍi ciriḍi, hili hili, hulu hulu, mili mili, tule tatale
verses.meaningZh: 清净离诸尘垢·息灭诤怨，无我大慈三昧·清净离诸尘垢·息灭诤怨，离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢·息灭诤怨，妙行迁变空·清净离诸尘垢·息灭诤怨，再三定慧摄持、心无散乱（希利），再三威猛速疾摄护除灾（呼嚧），再三契合本尊三昧、慈悲冥合（弥利），秤尊，彼严

verses.iast: svāhā. udgṛhṇa tvam ānanda mahāyakṣasenāpatīnāṃ nāmāni ye dharaṇyāṃ prativasanti. jeṣṭhaputraḥ kuberasya saṃjayo
verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！施度调伏·妙行趣入·因缘空寂大乐，汝、尊者您，阿难，诸大药叉军主之，一切名为、号曰，凡彼等诸有情，驮愉快，对婆珊婆演底，孟夏子，俱吠滥、上首之，若衍底、尊胜
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! generosity & self-mastery & awakened spiritual movement & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, Thou, You, servant, mahāyakṣasenāpatīnāṃ, by name, called (plural), those who, whoever (pl.), dha + delightful, toward + Vasanti, jeṣṭhaputraḥ, of Kubera, the chief of the spirits of darkness, afterwards the god of riches, the regen, victorious
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: naravāhanaḥ. mithilāyāṃ prativasati devasatyopayācakaḥ. so 'py anayā mahāmāyūryā vidyārājñyā svāter bhikṣor mama
verses.meaningZh: 俱吠滥，于弥萨罗中，对髁骨，天人·谛·愈加·乞丐，彼、彼尊（连音式），耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），此，以孔雀明王，以明妃，昴宿，比丘，我之（行者所有）
verses.meaningEn: Carried or drawn by men, in Mithila, toward + donʼt stop ! god + truth + thereto + petitioner, he, that one, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, anayā, with/by Peahen Queen, with/by wise consort, of the auspicious Svātī constellation, of beggar, religious mendicant, a Brahman in the last stage of his life, also a Buddhist, my, of me (the practitioner)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: sarvasatvānāṃ ca rakṣāṃ karotu, guptiṃ paritrāṇaṃ parigrahaṃ paripālanaṃ śāntiṃ svastyayanaṃ daṇḍaparihāraṃ śastraparihāraṃ
verses.meaningZh: 诸一切众生、普皆有情之以及守护、结界护念，愿成办、愿施作加持！色相、兵团，皆护，摄受，守护、养育，息灾、寂静、安隐，成妙善乐，金刚杖回答，刀杖兵戈回答
verses.meaningEn: Of all all sentient beings and protection, safeguarding, may he/she perform and accomplish! form, formation, fashion, paritrāṇaṃ, to protect, protection, guard, nurture, maintenance, care, peace, pacification, tranquility, svastyayanaṃ, staff + watchful care, weapon + watchful care
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: viṣadūṣaṇaṃ viṣanāśanaṃ sīmābandhaṃ dharaṇībandhaṃ ca karotu, jīvatu varṣaśataṃ paśyatu śaradāśataṃ. tadyathā. bale
verses.meaningZh: 摧灭毒素，毒害摧灭，结界，簷结界系缚邪魔外障以及愿成办、愿施作加持！愿命者，年百，愿了知、聪明，箭·作持圣供·走道那么，即说咒曰：力、十力神通威神力尊
verses.meaningEn: Destroying poison, poison + destroying, drawing a strict line of, support + bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! and may he/she perform and accomplish! may it living, alive, raining, may it looking, knowing, intelligent! reed + make offering + walk about, Thus goes the mantra: O power, strength, spiritual force / in power, strength, spiritual force
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: balkale, mātaṃgi caṇḍali puruṣa, nici nici nigauri gandhāre, caṇḍāli mātaṃgi, mālini hili
verses.meaningZh: 解脱系缚大力·离一切相无相·造作离相，无我大慈三昧·真如实际·妙行趣入，妙行迁变空·离诸诤论无诤·息灭诤怨，士夫，再三离名相假立·妙行迁变空，在于娇吠哩尊，第三音，下贱种，无我大慈三昧·真如实际·妙行趣入，无我大慈三昧·离一切相无相·离名相假立，定慧摄持、心无散乱（希利）
verses.meaningEn: Spiritual strength freeing bonds & freedom from conditioned marks & freedom from karmic agency (vocative invocation), selfless great loving-kindness & immutable Suchness & awakened spiritual movement (vocative invocation), awakened conduct beyond flux & conflict-free peace & pacifying conflict & turmoil (vocative invocation), man, human being, male, person, individual of a generation, beyond nominal designation & awakened conduct beyond flux (vocative invocation) again and again, in + O Gauri, O of a people / in of a people, O a Candala or outcast, selfless great loving-kindness & immutable Suchness & awakened spiritual movement (vocative invocation), selfless great loving-kindness & freedom from conditioned marks & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), meditative absorption & steadfast mindfulness
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: hili, āgati gati, gauri gandhāri kauṣṭhikā vacari vihāri, hili hili, kuṃje svāhā.
verses.meaningZh: 定慧摄持、心无散乱（希利），来诣、退还，趣向、六趣、妙行，娇吠哩尊，诸人，造作离相·六度满行清净·远离虚妄安立，告诉踊跃，住房、活生生尊，再三定慧摄持、心无散乱（希利），造作离相·生起不可得·尊胜，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Meditative absorption & steadfast mindfulness, coming, arrival, return, course, path, realm of rebirth, O Gauri, of a people, freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās & beyond conceptual fabrication, say + eager, O dwelling, living, meditative absorption & steadfast mindfulness again and again, freedom from karmic agency & transcending birth & victorious (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: krakucchandaḥ pāṭaliputre ṣṭhalāyāṃ cāparājitaḥ, śailo bhadrapure yakṣa uttarāyāṃ ca mānavaḥ. vajrapāṇi rājagṛhe
verses.meaningZh: 拘留孙，华氏城尊，六度满行清净·远离虚妄安立·离一切相无相，宝弓由线条，峰，贤原来，药叉（夜叉护法捷疾神），于向北中以及儒童，金刚手菩萨（执金刚秘密主），王舍城尊
verses.meaningEn: Krakucchanda Buddha, O Pāṭaliputra, perfection of the six pāramitās & beyond conceptual fabrication & freedom from conditioned marks, bow + from streak, śailo, blessed + formerly, Yakṣa, nature/wealth guardian spirit, in northward and mānavaḥ, Vajrapāṇi, Vajra-in-Hand Bodhisattva, O a king's house, palace
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: gṛdhrakūṭe kṛtālaye, trikṛtvo anuparyanti sāgarān tāṃ vasuṃdharāṃ, mahābalo mahātejā daśayojanavikramaḥ. garuḍo vipule
verses.meaningZh: 灵鸟顶山尊，向断除小溪，三次，日复一日期尊，大海、功德海，救度佛母（绿度母）根本种子字，大地、刹土，大力，大威光，十·踰缮那·超，金翅鸟，广大、宽博无量尊
verses.meaningEn: O Vulture Peak / in Vulture Peak, cut + to small ditch, thrice, three times, day after day + O limit, ocean, sea, Tārā root seed syllable Tāṃ / her, containing wealth, mahābalo, great + sharpness, ten + harnessing + surpass, garuḍo, O vast, extensive, abundant, profound / in vast, extensive, abundant, profound
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: yakṣaḥ citraguptaś citīmukhe, rājagṛhe vakkulo yakṣo mahāsainyo mahābalaḥ. kālopakālakau yakṣau vasathaḥ kapilavastuni,

verses.meaningZh: 黄白色，增长福慧·第一义谛，富楼那面门，能作成办·造作离相，妙行迁变空·息灭诤怨·一乘如实之道，造作离相·破有相福德光·施度调伏，于诸福利、健康中，于诸绝边广川中，爱神，妙行迁变空·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢以及最上真言离言说·造作离相·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Piṅgalaḥ, increasing (vocative invocation), Purna + face, making, awakened conduct beyond flux & pacifying conflict & turmoil & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation), freedom from karmic agency & blessedness transcending existence & generosity & self-mastery, among/in welfare, health, in god, the god of love, awakened conduct beyond flux & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust and supreme ineffable speech & freedom from karmic agency & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: ramatheṣu ca rāvaṇaḥ, piṃgalaś caiva rāśine patnīye priyadarśanaḥ. kumbhīrayakṣo rājagṛhe vipule 'smiṃ
verses.meaningZh: 于诸蓝尔时以及哮吼子，第一义谛·妙行趣入·离一切相无相，以及、亦复如是（ca + eva），清净离诸尘垢·本性寂静止息·离名相假立，妻此处尊，惜者观照，蛟龙药叉，王舍城尊，广大、宽博无量尊，一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧
verses.meaningEn: Blue + among and rāvaṇaḥ, ultimate truth & awakened spiritual movement & freedom from conditioned marks, and indeed, likewise, stainless purity free from dust & primordial tranquil peace & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), mistress, dear + false, crocodile, O a king's house, palace, O vast, extensive, abundant, profound / in vast, extensive, abundant, profound, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: nivāsikaḥ, bhūyaḥ śatasahasrāṇāṃ yakṣeṇa paryupāsyate. ahicchatrāyāṃ gopāla alako alakāpure, nandī va nandinagare
verses.meaningZh: 离名相假立·最上真言离言说·一切诸谛圆满，又么，诸百千之，以药叉（夜叉护法捷疾神），承事供养拘牵尊，因缘空寂大乐·妙行迁变空·离覆障清凉，放牛人，离一切相无相·造作离相，离一切相无相·造作离相·第一义谛，欢喜、贪欲，嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk，波牟提陀小邑
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation & supreme ineffable speech & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, bhūyaḥ, of sgl, by/through Yakṣa, nature/wealth guardian spirit, to present + O held, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & awakened conduct beyond flux & coolness free of obscuration, cowherd, freedom from conditioned marks & freedom from karmic agency, freedom from conditioned marks & freedom from karmic agency & ultimate truth (vocative invocation), joy, supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — primordial non-arising, the Joyful + O town
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: grāmaghoṣe baliḥ sthitaḥ. devāvatāre vaiśramaṇaḥ svasainyaparipālakaḥ, yakṣakoṭiparivṛto 'ḍakavatyāṃ nivāsikaḥ. ete maharddhikā yakṣāḥ
verses.meaningZh: 邑音尊，施食，立，从天降临，极微沙门，自·多·守护，药叉·俱胝·围绕，息灭诤怨·造作离相·最上真言离言说，离名相假立·最上真言离言说·一切诸谛圆满，此等诸尊，广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，药叉
verses.meaningEn: Dwelling-place + O sound, baliḥ, standing, abiding, remaining, devāvatāre, particle emphasizing the preceding word or merely expletive, own + relating to an army + guarding, Yakṣa + ten million, pacifying conflict & turmoil & freedom from karmic agency & supreme ineffable speech, beyond nominal designation & supreme ineffable speech & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, these, great, yakṣāḥ
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: mahāsainyā mahābalāḥ, paracakrapramathanā durdharṣā aparājitāh. ṛddhimanto dyutimanto varṇavanto yaśasvinaḥ, devāsuram api saṃgrāmam
verses.meaningZh: 大多，诸大力威神、大势力尊，他兵极摧坏，难敌，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·生起不可得·尊胜，施度调伏·法界总持任持·无我大慈三昧，虚空·部多寂静·末，最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤，一样，天人阿修罗，亦、虽、乃至，圣众、怀敌意遭遇
verses.meaningEn: Great + relating to an army, of great power and might (plural), enemy + tormenting, difficult to be assaulted or approached, invincible, dangerous, terrible, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & transcending birth & victorious, generosity & self-mastery & Dharma-realm retention & selfless great loving-kindness, sky + become quiet + end, supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace, the same, god + Asura, even, also, popular assembly, host, troop
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: anubhavanti maharddhikāḥ. te 'py anayā mahāmāyūryā vidyārājñyā svāter bhikṣor mama sarvasatvānāṃ ca
verses.meaningZh: 诸尊顾忌、想蕴，世间诸此恶者，向汝、彼等，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），此，以孔雀明王，以明妃，昴宿，比丘，我之（行者所有），诸一切众生、普皆有情之以及
verses.meaningEn: They apprehension, perception, of a world + alas! shame! fie! to Thee / they, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, anayā, with/by Peahen Queen, with/by wise consort, of the auspicious Svātī constellation, of beggar, religious mendicant, a Brahman in the last stage of his life, also a Buddhist, my, of me (the practitioner), of all all sentient beings and
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: rakṣāṃ kurvantu, guptiṃ paritrāṇaṃ parigrahaṃ paripālanaṃ śāntiṃ svastyayanaṃ daṇḍaparihāraṃ śastraparihāraṃ viṣadūṣaṇaṃ viṣanāśanaṃ
verses.meaningZh: 守护、结界护念，愿一切诸尊普皆施作护持！色相、兵团，皆护，摄受，守护、养育，息灾、寂静、安隐，成妙善乐，金刚杖回答，刀杖兵戈回答，摧灭毒素，毒害摧灭
verses.meaningEn: Protection, safeguarding, may they all perform/grant! form, formation, fashion, paritrāṇaṃ, to protect, protection, guard, nurture, maintenance, care, peace, pacification, tranquility, svastyayanaṃ, staff + watchful care, weapon + watchful care, destroying poison, poison + destroying
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: sīmābandhaṃ dharaṇībandhaṃ ca kurvantu, jīvatu varṣaśataṃ paśyatu śaradāśataṃ. tadyathā. akaṭe vikaṭe hariṇi
verses.meaningZh: 结界，簷结界系缚邪魔外障以及愿一切诸尊普皆施作护持！愿命者，年百，愿了知、聪明，箭·作持圣供·走道那么，即说咒曰：造作离相·断除憍慢执障，巨大、怪异尊，具请摄取、遣除苦厄！尊
verses.meaningEn: Drawing a strict line of, support + bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! and may they all perform/grant! may it living, alive, raining, may it looking, knowing, intelligent! reed + make offering + walk about, Thus goes the mantra: freedom from karmic agency & cutting rigid pride (vocative invocation), O exceeding the usual measure, huge, monstrous, hideous, wicked, bad, O bearer of carry away (suffering)! remove!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: hāriṇi dharaṇi dhāraṇi, hukke hukke, vukke vukke, hana hana hana hana hana
verses.meaningZh: 具胸严尊，大地，陀罗尼、总持（总一切法、持无量义）尊，再三因缘空寂大乐·造作离相，再三肾脏尊，再三击破怨魔与无明惑（贺曩）
verses.meaningEn: O bearer of clump, mass, thicket, the earth, O Dhāraṇī, total retention, protective spell, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & freedom from karmic agency (vocative invocation) again and again, O kidney / in kidney again and again, strike down afflictions and mara-forces! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: hana hana hana hana hana, amitrān mama sarvasatvānāṃ ca, daha daha daha
verses.meaningZh: 再三击破怨魔与无明惑（贺曩），不相友，我之（行者所有），诸一切众生、普皆有情之以及再三智火焚净一切罪垢（娜贺）
verses.meaningEn: Strike down afflictions and mara-forces! again and again, enemy, my, of me (the practitioner), of all all sentient beings and incinerate all defilements with wisdom-fire! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: daha daha daha daha daha daha daha, ahitaiṣiṇo mama sarvasatvānāṃ ca, paca
verses.meaningZh: 再三智火焚净一切罪垢（娜贺），因缘空寂大乐·真如实际·六度满行清净，我之（行者所有），诸一切众生、普皆有情之以及成熟善根、烧尽业障（跛左）
verses.meaningEn: Incinerate all defilements with wisdom-fire! again and again, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & immutable Suchness & perfection of the six pāramitās, my, of me (the practitioner), of all all sentient beings and ripen merit and burn away karmic obstructions!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: paca paca paca paca paca paca paca paca paca, pratyarthikāṃ mama sarvasatvānāṃ
verses.meaningZh: 再三成熟善根、烧尽业障（跛左），回犯，我之（行者所有），诸一切众生、普皆有情之
verses.meaningEn: Ripen merit and burn away karmic obstructions! again and again, enemy, my, of me (the practitioner), of all all sentient beings
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: ca, dhu dhu dhu dhu dhu dhu dhu dhu dhu dhu, nāśaya
verses.meaningZh: 左字门（妙行迁变空（caryā）·本不生体性），再三驮字门（法界总持任持（dhātu，请除灭、遣散灾厄！
verses.meaningEn: Awakened conduct beyond flux (caryā) — primordial non-arising, Dharma-realm retention (dhātu) — dispelling sorrow again and again, dispel! destroy!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: ahitaiṣiṇo mama, hu hu hu hu hu hu hu hu hu hu,
verses.meaningZh: 因缘空寂大乐·真如实际·六度满行清净，我之（行者所有），再三贺字门（因缘空寂大乐（hetu
verses.meaningEn: Causal emptiness & spiritual joy & immutable Suchness & perfection of the six pāramitās, my, of me (the practitioner), causal emptiness & spiritual joy (hetu) — dispelling sorrow again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: jiṭi jiṭi jiṭi jiṭi jiṭi jiṭi jiṭi jiṭi jiṭi jiṭi, nāśaya śatrūn
verses.meaningZh: 再三生起不可得·尊胜·断除憍慢执障，请除灭、遣散灾厄！本性寂静止息·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Transcending birth & victorious & cutting rigid pride (vocative invocation) again and again, dispel! destroy! primordial tranquil peace & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: mama sarvasatvānāṃ ca, culu culu culu culu culu culu culu culu culu
verses.meaningZh: 我之（行者所有），诸一切众生、普皆有情之以及再三鼓动法水涤除罪垢（主嚧）
verses.meaningEn: My, of me (the practitioner), of all all sentient beings and stir the purifying waters of compassion! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: culu, hili hili hili hili hili hili hili hili hili hili, mili
verses.meaningZh: 鼓动法水涤除罪垢（主嚧），再三定慧摄持、心无散乱（希利），契合本尊三昧、慈悲冥合（弥利）
verses.meaningEn: Stir the purifying waters of compassion! meditative absorption & steadfast mindfulness again and again, intimate union with the deity samādhi
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: mili mili mili mili mili mili mili mili mili, phuru phuru phuru
verses.meaningZh: 再三契合本尊三昧、慈悲冥合（弥利），再三妙果圆成·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Intimate union with the deity samādhi again and again, fruition of enlightenment & stainless purity free from dust (imperative seal) again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: phuru phuru phuru phuru phuru phuru phuru, ciṭi ciṭi ciṭi ciṭi ciṭi
verses.meaningZh: 再三妙果圆成·清净离诸尘垢，再三觉知警策妙音（唧置）
verses.meaningEn: Fruition of enlightenment & stainless purity free from dust (imperative seal) again and again, awakening mindfulness mantra-pada again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: ciṭi ciṭi ciṭi ciṭi ciṭi, nāśaya sarvaśatrūn mama sarvasatvānāṃ ca, hikke mikke
verses.meaningZh: 再三觉知警策妙音（唧置），请除灭、遣散灾厄！一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，我之（行者所有），诸一切众生、普皆有情之以及饑寒嗝尊，无我大慈三昧·造作离相
verses.meaningEn: Awakening mindfulness mantra-pada again and again, dispel! destroy! all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, my, of me (the practitioner), of all all sentient beings and O sobbing / in sobbing, selfless great loving-kindness & freedom from karmic agency (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: cikke cukke śrībhadre maṅgale samantabhadre hiraṇyagarbhe, sarvārthasādhani, amale vimale, candre candraprabhe, sūrye
verses.meaningZh: 黏腻实物尊，妙行迁变空·造作离相，妙祥，吉祥、胜妙瑞相尊，普贤菩萨（遍吉）尊，金胎神尊，一切义利成就法，无垢、离染清净尊，毘磨利，月轮、清凉满月尊，月光尊，日轮、太阳光明尊
verses.meaningEn: O sticky matter / in sticky matter, awakened conduct beyond flux & freedom from karmic agency (vocative invocation), śrībhadre, O auspiciousness, blessing, good fortune / in auspiciousness, blessing, good fortune, O Samantabhadra, Universally Worthy Bodhisattva / in Samantabhadra, Universally Worthy Bodhisattva, O Spirit Born from a Golden Egg / in Spirit Born from a Golden Egg, all aims and benefits + O accomplishing, O stainless, spotless, pure / in stainless, spotless, pure, pure, O moon, lunar disc / in moon, lunar disc, O moon-like, O sun, solar orb / in sun, solar orb
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: sūryaprabhe sūryakānte, durvijñeye duṃbe duṃbe doduṃbe, priyaṃkare rakṣa māṃ sarvasatvāṃś ca, jīvatu
verses.meaningZh: 日光尊，水晶尊，一样尊，再三施度调伏·解脱系缚大力，施度调伏·解脱系缚大力，一样尊，拥护、守护于我，诸一切众生、普皆有情以及愿命者
verses.meaningEn: O bright as the sun / in bright as the sun, O the sun-stone / in the sun-stone, O the same / in the same, generosity & self-mastery & spiritual strength freeing bonds (vocative invocation) again and again, generosity & self-mastery & spiritual strength freeing bonds (vocative invocation), O the same / in the same, protect, guard and shelter me, all sentient beings and may it living, alive
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: varṣaśataṃ paśyatu śaradāśataṃ. udgṛhṇa tvam ānanda mahāyakṣasenāpatīnāṃ nāmāni, ye daśadiśo rakṣanti paripālayanti.
verses.meaningZh: 年百，愿了知、聪明，箭·作持圣供·走道那么，施度调伏·妙行趣入·因缘空寂大乐，汝、尊者您，阿难，诸大药叉军主之，一切名为、号曰，凡彼等诸有情，施度调伏·本性寂静止息，诸尊拥护、守护，诸尊请周遍护持、恒常守护！
verses.meaningEn: Raining, may it looking, knowing, intelligent! reed + make offering + walk about, generosity & self-mastery & awakened spiritual movement & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, Thou, You, servant, mahāyakṣasenāpatīnāṃ, by name, called (plural), those who, whoever (pl.), generosity & self-mastery & primordial tranquil peace, they protect, guard and shelter! they completely protect and sustain!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: pūrvāyām ānanda diśāyāṃ catvāro mahāyakṣasenāpatayaḥ prativasanti, ye pūrvāṃ diśaṃ rakṣanti paripālayanti. tadyathā.
verses.meaningZh: 于东中，阿难，于方位、境界中，交叉点、平方，大·药叉·部·飞行，对婆珊婆演底，凡彼等诸有情，东，方，诸尊拥护、守护，诸尊请周遍护持、恒常守护！即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: In east, servant, in direction, region, crossroads, square, great + Yakṣa + missile + fly, toward + Vasanti, those who, whoever (pl.), east, direction, they protect, guard and shelter! they completely protect and sustain! Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: dīrghaḥ sunetraḥ pūrṇakaḥ kapilaś ceti. te 'py anayā mahāmāyūryā vidyārājñyā svāter bhikṣor

verses.iast: anayā mahāmāyūryā vidyārājñyā svāter bhikṣor mama sarvasatvānāṃ ca rakṣāṃ kurvantu, guptiṃ paritrāṇaṃ
verses.meaningZh: 此，以孔雀明王，以明妃，昴宿，比丘，我之（行者所有），诸一切众生、普皆有情之以及守护、结界护念，愿一切诸尊普皆施作护持！色相、兵团，皆护
verses.meaningEn: Anayā, with/by Peahen Queen, with/by wise consort, of the auspicious Svātī constellation, of beggar, religious mendicant, a Brahman in the last stage of his life, also a Buddhist, my, of me (the practitioner), of all all sentient beings and protection, safeguarding, may they all perform/grant! form, formation, fashion, paritrāṇaṃ
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: parigrahaṃ paripālanaṃ śāntiṃ svastyayanaṃ daṇḍaparihāraṃ śastraparihāraṃ viṣadūṣaṇaṃ viṣanāśanaṃ sīmābandhaṃ dharaṇībandhaṃ ca kurvantu,
verses.meaningZh: 摄受，守护、养育，息灾、寂静、安隐，成妙善乐，金刚杖回答，刀杖兵戈回答，摧灭毒素，毒害摧灭，结界，簷结界系缚邪魔外障以及愿一切诸尊普皆施作护持！
verses.meaningEn: To protect, protection, guard, nurture, maintenance, care, peace, pacification, tranquility, svastyayanaṃ, staff + watchful care, weapon + watchful care, destroying poison, poison + destroying, drawing a strict line of, support + bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! and may they all perform/grant!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: jīvatu varṣaśataṃ paśyatu śaradāśataṃ. tadyathā. hili hili hili hili hili hili hili
verses.meaningZh: 愿命者，年百，愿了知、聪明，箭·作持圣供·走道那么，即说咒曰：再三定慧摄持、心无散乱（希利）
verses.meaningEn: May it living, alive, raining, may it looking, knowing, intelligent! reed + make offering + walk about, Thus goes the mantra: meditative absorption & steadfast mindfulness again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: hili hili hili, mili mili mili mili mili mili mili mili mili
verses.meaningZh: 再三定慧摄持、心无散乱（希利），再三契合本尊三昧、慈悲冥合（弥利）
verses.meaningEn: Meditative absorption & steadfast mindfulness again and again, intimate union with the deity samādhi again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: mili, huru huru huru huru huru huru huru huru huru huru, ciṭi
verses.meaningZh: 契合本尊三昧、慈悲冥合（弥利），再三疾速拔济除障（虎噜），觉知警策妙音（唧置）
verses.meaningEn: Intimate union with the deity samādhi, swiftly rescue and dispel all afflictions! again and again, awakening mindfulness mantra-pada
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: ciṭi ciṭi ciṭi ciṭi ciṭi ciṭi ciṭi ciṭi ciṭi, hikke hikke hikke
verses.meaningZh: 再三觉知警策妙音（唧置），再三饑寒嗝尊
verses.meaningEn: Awakening mindfulness mantra-pada again and again, O sobbing / in sobbing again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: hikke, hora hora, dhara dhara, hara hara, hala hala, cala cala, curu
verses.meaningZh: 饑寒嗝尊，再三因缘空寂大乐·清净离诸尘垢，再三请执持、总持护念！再三请摄取、遣除苦厄！再三耕，再三震动警觉、破除昏沉（左攞），速疾运转妙法加持（祖噜）
verses.meaningEn: O sobbing / in sobbing, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & stainless purity free from dust again and again, hold! bear! sustain! again and again, carry away (suffering)! remove! again and again, plough again and again, stir awake and shake off delusion! again and again, swiftly set sacred blessings in motion!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: curu svāhā. namaḥ sarvabuddhānāṃ svāhā. pratyekabudhānāṃ svāhā. namo 'rhatāṃ svāhā. maitreyasya bodhisatvasya
verses.meaningZh: 速疾运转妙法加持（祖噜），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！归命，一切没驮南，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！别主诸水星之，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！归命，配称救度佛母根本种子字，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！弥勒菩萨（慈氏尊）之，菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情）之
verses.meaningEn: Swiftly set sacred blessings in motion! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! homage to all + buddhānām, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! for a single person + of all intelligent, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! homage to deserving + Tārā root seed syllable Tāṃ, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! of Maitreya, Loving-Kindness Bodhisattva, of Bodhisattva, Awakening Being
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: mahāsatvasya svāhā. sarvabodhisatvānāṃ svāhā. anāgāmināṃ svāhā. sakṛdāgāmināṃ svāhā. śrotāpannānāṃ svāhā. samyaggatānāṃ svāhā.
verses.meaningZh: 摩诃萨埵（大心有情、大菩萨）之，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！一切诸菩提萨埵之，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！自然·宝树宝山·急躁，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！一切诸谛圆满·造作离相·施度调伏，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！耳根诸入之，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·一乘如实之道，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Of Mahāsattva, Great Spiritual Hero, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! all + of all Bodhisattva, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! certainly + tree or mountain + impetuous, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & freedom from karmic agency & generosity & self-mastery, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! ear + of all entered, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & supreme vehicle of awakening, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: samyakpratipannānāṃ svāhā. brāhmaṇe svāhā. prajāpataye svāhā. indrāya svāhā. īśānāsya svāhā. agnaye svāhā.
verses.meaningZh: 权利诸入之，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！婆罗门，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！向九类主，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！向因陀逻，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！自在主口，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！向圣火、智火（火大），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Right + of all practised, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! O brahmanhood, brahmanic condition / in brahmanhood, brahmanic condition, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! to lord of creatures or of procreation, the Creator, of gods Ṛṣis, also of a separate go, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! to/for Śakra king of the gods, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! owning + mouth, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! to fire, sacred flame (Agni), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: vāyave svāhā. varuṇāya svāhā. kuverāya svāhā. yamāya svāhā. upendrāya svāhā. vaiśramaṇāya svāhā.
verses.meaningZh: 向风、风大命息，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！向水神，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！向恶体，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！向狱王，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！向愈加因陀逻，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！向极微沙弥，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: To wind, vital air, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! to/for the All-encompasser, of a god, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! kuverāya, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! to/for holder, bridle or driver, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! thereto + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! particle emphasizing the preceding word or merely expletive + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: yakṣādhipataye svāhā. dhṛtarāṣṭrāya gandharvādhipataye svāhā. virūḍhakāya kumbhāṇḍādhipataye svāhā. virūpākṣāya nāgādhipataye svāhā. devānāṃ
verses.meaningZh: 向一样，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！向守境土，向乾闼婆控制器，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！向增长，向甕形控制器，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！向广目，向龙主，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！诸天人、诸天护法之
verses.meaningEn: To the same, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! to/for of an ancient king, the elder brother of Pāṇḍu, Gandharva + to controller, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! to/for Virudhaka, evil spirit + to controller, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! to/for having deformed eyes, nāgādhipataye, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! of all god, celestial deity (Deva)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: svāhā. nāgānāṃ svāhā. asurāṇāṃ svāhā. marutānāṃ svāhā. garuḍānāṃ svāhā. gandharvāṇāṃ svāhā. kinnarāṇāṃ
verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！诸龙族、大龙王之，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！诸阿修罗（非天）之，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！诸天神之，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！诸迦楼罗（金翅鸟王）之，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！诸乾闼婆（香音神）之，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！诸紧那罗（歌神）之
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! of all Nāga, dragon/serpent deity, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! of Asura, titan/demigod, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! of all god, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! of all Garuḍa, golden-winged bird king, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! of Gandharva, celestial musician, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! of Kinnara, celestial song-spirit
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: svāhā. mahoragāṇāṃ svāhā. yakṣāṇāṃ svāhā. rākṣasānāṃ svāhā. pretānāṃ svāhā. piśācānāṃ svāhā. bhūtānāṃ
verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！诸摩睺罗伽（大蟒神）之，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！诸药叉（夜叉护法捷疾神）之，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！诸罗刹（暴恶鬼神）之，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！诸饿鬼、薜荔多之，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！诸毗舍遮（啖精气鬼）之，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！诸部多鬼神、一切生类、真实之
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! of Mahoraga, great serpent spirit, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! of Yakṣa, nature/wealth guardian spirit, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! of all Rākṣasa, fierce spirit/demon, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! of all Preta, hungry ghost/departed spirit, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! of all Piśāca, flesh/energy-eating spirit, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! of all spirit, living being, true/existent
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: svāhā. kumbhāṇḍānāṃ svāhā. pūtanānāṃ svāhā. kaṭapūtanānāṃ svāhā. skandānāṃ svāhā. unmādānāṃ svāhā. chāyānāṃ
verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！诸甕形，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！诸臭者之，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！诸极臭鬼之，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！诸偏脣鬼，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！诸颠之，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！诸恶鬼之
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! of all evil spirit, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! of all a kind of demon, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! of all a kind of demon, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! of all a demon that causes drought, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! of all mad, insane, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! of all harpy, a demon that defiles and poisons food
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: svāhā. apasmārāṇāṃ svāhā. ostārakāṇāṃ svāhā. candrasūryayoḥ svāhā. rudrāṇāṃ svāhā. nakṣatrāṇāṃ svāhā. grahāṇāṃ
verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！诸作忘者之，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！救度超脱·一切诸谛圆满，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！妙行迁变空·离名相假立·施度调伏，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！诸紧恶之，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！诸星宿（二十八宿）之，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！诸曜执、星曜鬼神执障之
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! of epilepsy, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! ferrying across, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! awakened conduct beyond flux & beyond nominal designation & generosity & self-mastery, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! of of gods, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! of constellation, lunar mansion, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! of planet, seizing spirit/graha
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: svāhā. jyotiṣāṇāṃ svāhā. ṛṣīṇāṃ svāhā. siddhavratānāṃ svāhā. siddhavidyānāṃ svāhā. gaurīye svāhā. gandhārīye
verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！诸星者，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！六度满行清净·离诸诤论无诤，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！成就者诸禁之，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！成就者诸发现物之，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！娇吠哩此处尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！诸人此处尊
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! of astronomy, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! perfection of the six pāramitās & conflict-free peace, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! accomplished + of all prohibit, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! accomplished + of all finding, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Gauri, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! of a people
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: svāhā. jāṃgulīye svāhā. amṛtāye svāhā. jambhanīye svāhā. stambhanīye svāhā. cāpeṭīye svāhā. drāmiḍīye
verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！生起不可得·尊胜·妙行趣入·离一切相无相，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！甘露出，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！生起不可得·尊胜·无我大慈三昧·破有相福德光，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！镇伏止息·一切诸谛圆满，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！妙行迁变空·第一义谛·断除憍慢执障，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！施度调伏·清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! transcending birth & victorious & awakened spiritual movement & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! ambrosia + O income, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! transcending birth & victorious & selfless great loving-kindness & blessedness transcending existence (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! immobilizing harm (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! awakened conduct beyond flux & ultimate truth & cutting rigid pride (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! generosity & self-mastery & stainless purity free from dust & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.iast: svāhā. śabarīye svāhā. atharvaśabarīye svāhā. caṇḍālīye svāhā. mātaṅgīye svāhā. nāgahṛdayāya svāhā. garuḍahṛdayāya
verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！本性寂静止息·解脱系缚大力·清净离诸尘垢，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！无住安立·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！威猛·小溪·此处尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！无我大慈三昧·真如实际·支分寂静，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！向龙族心，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！向迦楼罗心
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! primordial tranquil peace & spiritual strength freeing bonds & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! non-abiding equipoise & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! fierce + small ditch, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! selfless great loving-kindness & immutable Suchness & quiescence of perceptual limbs (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Nāga + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Garuḍa + to
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mmayuvru.htm（原典总行数：720 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n0982 / T19n0985）

verses.meaningZh: 不衰，总持任持·法界总持任持，最上真言离言说·妙行迁变空·一乘如实之道，成妙善乐，或、抑或，成办作持·造作离相，施度调伏·妙行趣入·因缘空寂大乐，汝、尊者您，阿难，此（陀罗尼明妃，阴性宾格），广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道

verses.meaningZh: 祈请方位，祈请语言，广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，息灾寂静·一切诸谛圆满，妙行迁变空·真如实际·一切诸谛圆满，法会大众，向守护，于我、为我，破有相福德光·造作离相·六度满行清净，破有相福德光·造作离相·六度满行清净，诸近事男，诸近事女

verses.iast: ca. tadyathā. yāvati dhāvati balaki kuru tulu me svāhā. rakṣa māṃ sarvasatvāṃś
verses.meaningZh: 左字门（妙行迁变空（caryā）·本不生体性），即说咒曰：具足凡彼（阴性关系代词）尊，行走，威神力尊，祈请成办羯磨事业（俱噜），真如实际·离一切相无相，于我、为我，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！拥护、守护于我，诸一切众生、普皆有情
verses.meaningEn: Awakened conduct beyond flux (caryā) — primordial non-arising, Thus goes the mantra: O one endowed with who, whichever (f.), dhāvati, O power, accomplish & enact this sacred work! immutable Suchness & freedom from conditioned marks (imperative seal), to me, my, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! protect, guard and shelter me, all sentient beings

titleZh: 【梵本原典】佛說大寒林聖難拏陀羅尼經 (五護陀羅尼之四 · 岩本裕校勘 GRETIL 梵本)
translatorZh: 哥廷根大学 GRETIL / 尼泊尔 DSBC 梵文贝叶经校勘本 (Mahasitavati vidyarajni)
sutraSourceZh: GRETIL 梵文佛典库 (msitvatu.htm) · 汉译对勘：T20n1156A
deityZh: 大寒林佛母 (Mahāśītavatī)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 本条目直接构建自德国哥廷根大学 GRETIL 梵语原典档案「msitvatu.htm」（共 130 行，完整提取核心真言与经句共 67 句）。系统已自动将其原始 IAST 梵文实时转写为天城文、唐代悉昙梵字、唐宋古汉语音译、现代梵音拼读参考、国际音标 (IPA) 及摩多轻重音律。
recitationTipsZh: 此为学术校勘梵文写本原貌，每一句均配备「梵音拼读参考」与「唐宋古汉语音译」平行对照，且每个音节胶囊内均同时展示梵文、古汉语与现代拼读。

verses.iast: Mahāśītavatī namo bhagavatyai āryamahāśītavatyai / evaṃ mayā śrutam ekasmin samaye bhagavān rājagṛhe
verses.meaningZh: 具足大冷尊，归命，向世尊佛母顶礼，广大殊胜·清净离诸尘垢，如是、如此，由我（具格：如是我闻），闻，一时，向平，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，王舍城尊
verses.meaningEn: Great + endowed with sail, homage to to the Blessed Mother / Lady Bhagavatī, great (vocative invocation), thus, in this way, by me, heard, at one time, to equal, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, O a king's house, palace
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：msitvatu.htm（原典总行数：130 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1156A）

verses.iast: viharati sma / śītavane mahāśmaśāne iṅghikāyatanapratyuddeśe tatrāyuṣmān rāhulo 'tīva viheṭhyate / devagrahair
verses.meaningZh: 一切，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），尸陀林尊，大恐毘林尊，支分寂静·破暗合集·造作离相，彼具寿，罗怙罗，很，最上真言离言说·因缘空寂大乐·远离虚妄安立，施度调伏·最上真言离言说·妙行趣入
verses.meaningEn: Lives, dwells, spends oneʼs time, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, O sitavana, great + O smasana, quiescence of perceptual limbs & dissolving dense ignorance & freedom from karmic agency (vocative invocation), That, rāhulo, very, supreme ineffable speech & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & beyond conceptual fabrication (vocative invocation), generosity & self-mastery & supreme ineffable speech & awakened spiritual movement
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：msitvatu.htm（原典总行数：130 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1156A）

verses.iast: nāgagrahair yakṣagrahai rākṣagrahair marutagrahair asuragrahair kinnaragrahair garuḍagrahair gandharvagrahair mahoragagrahair manuṣyagrahair amanuṣyagrahair pretagrahair
verses.meaningZh: 离名相假立·妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢，坚持下去·尊·呼格极微，清净离诸尘垢·造作离相·六度满行清净，天神·尊·呼格极微，气息·尊·呼格极微，造作离相·离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢，妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢·息灭诤怨，持守摄受·妙行趣入，广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，无我大慈三昧·离名相假立·六度满行清净，无我大慈三昧·离名相假立·六度满行清净，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation & awakened spiritual movement & stainless purity free from dust, press on + first + vocative particle, stainless purity free from dust & freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās, god + first + vocative particle, vital spirit + first + vocative particle, freedom from karmic agency & beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust, awakened spiritual movement & stainless purity free from dust & pacifying conflict & turmoil, bearing, great, selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation & perfection of the six pāramitās, selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation & perfection of the six pāramitās, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：msitvatu.htm（原典总行数：130 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1156A）

verses.iast: bhūtagrahair piśācagrahair kumbhāṇḍagrahair dvīpibhiḥ kākair ulūkaiḥ kīṭaiḥ sarīsṛpair anyaiś ca manuṣyāmanuṣyaiḥ satvaiḥ
verses.meaningZh: 也许·尊·呼格极微，第一义谛·本性寂静止息·妙行迁变空，造作离相·无我大慈三昧·破有相福德光，施度调伏·最上真言离言说·第一义谛，造作离相·清净离诸尘垢，以诸鸱枭，以诸蚓，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·第一义谛，离名相假立·一乘如实之道·本性寂静止息以及以诸人非人，以诸有情、众生、勇猛心
verses.meaningEn: Perhaps + first + vocative particle, ultimate truth & primordial tranquil peace & awakened conduct beyond flux, freedom from karmic agency & selfless great loving-kindness & blessedness transcending existence, generosity & self-mastery & supreme ineffable speech & ultimate truth, freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust, by/with owl, by/with a worm, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & ultimate truth, beyond nominal designation & supreme vehicle of awakening & primordial tranquil peace and person + by, by/with sentient being, living creature, courage
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：msitvatu.htm（原典总行数：130 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1156A）

verses.iast: / athāyuṣmān rāhulo yena bhagavāṃs tenopasaṃkrānta upasaṃkramya bhagavataḥ pādau śirasā vanditvā bhagavantaṃ
verses.meaningZh: 即时汝等，罗怙罗，借由彼因缘，星宿诸特，借由彼力·愈加·汇聚，第一义谛·一切诸谛圆满·造作离相，世尊、薄伽梵（具六德圣尊），第一义谛·施度调伏，本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢·一切诸谛圆满，礼敬赞叹·最上真言离言说，若衍底
verses.meaningEn: Then + you [plural], rāhulo, by which, whereby, star + bull, by that truth + thereto + come together, ultimate truth & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & freedom from karmic agency, Bhagavān, the Blessed/World-Honored One, ultimate truth & generosity & self-mastery (imperative seal), primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, venerating, victorious(-ly) passed beyond
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：msitvatu.htm（原典总行数：130 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1156A）

verses.iast: tripradakṣiṇīkṛtya bhagavataḥ purato rudann aśrūṇi pravartayati sma / atha bhagavān jānann eva
verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·第一义谛，世尊、薄伽梵（具六德圣尊），阵地、之前，清净离诸尘垢·施度调伏·离名相假立，本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤，转起妙法·第一义谛，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），尔时、次复吉祥启白，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，生起不可得·尊胜·离名相假立，唯、正是、决定
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & ultimate truth, Bhagavān, the Blessed/World-Honored One, in front, before , in presence of, stainless purity free from dust & generosity & self-mastery & beyond nominal designation, primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace (vocative invocation), turning forth (vocative invocation), selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, now, thereupon, auspiciously, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, transcending birth & victorious & beyond nominal designation, indeed, verily, alone
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：msitvatu.htm（原典总行数：130 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1156A）

verses.iast: rāhulam āmantrayate sma / kiṃ tvaṃ rāhula mama prataḥ sthitvā aśrūṇi pravartayasi
verses.meaningZh: 罗喉罗，妙意三重，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·诸根清净自在·大空菩提点摄持），汝、圣尊您，罗喉罗，我之（行者所有），由转载、向前，一切诸谛圆满·无住安立·真如实际，本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤，转起妙法·第一义谛
verses.meaningEn: Rahula, benevolent + triple, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — purified faculties sealed with bodhicitta bindu, Thou, You, Rahula, my, of me (the practitioner), from forward, onward, forth, away, fore, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & non-abiding equipoise & immutable Suchness, primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace (vocative invocation), turning forth (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：msitvatu.htm（原典总行数：130 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1156A）

verses.iast: / evam ukte āyuṣmān rāhulo bhagavantam etad avocat / ihāhaṃ bhagavan rājagṛhe
verses.meaningZh: 如是（如《如是我闻》evam mayā śrutam），曰尊，具寿，罗怙罗，若衍底，此、此事，宣说、开示教敕，于此如是宣说，出有坏，王舍城尊
verses.meaningEn: Thus, in this manner, O said / in said, āyuṣmān, rāhulo, victorious(-ly) passed beyond, this, spoke, proclaimed, here + spoke, bhagavan, O a king's house, palace
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：msitvatu.htm（原典总行数：130 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1156A）

verses.iast: viharāmi śītavane mahāśmaśāne iṅghikāyatanapratyuddeśe ( Mś Mś ) so 'haṃ bhagavaṃs tatra
verses.meaningZh: 我变易，尸陀林尊，大恐毘林尊，支分寂静·破暗合集·造作离相，再三奢字门（本性寂静止息（śānti）·本不生体性），彼、彼尊（连音式），我、真我自性，破有相福德光·妙行趣入·最上真言离言说，于彼处、其中
verses.meaningEn: I transposition, change, O sitavana, great + O smasana, quiescence of perceptual limbs & dissolving dense ignorance & freedom from karmic agency (vocative invocation), primordial tranquil peace (śānti) — primordial non-arising again and again, he, that one, I, the awakened self, blessedness transcending existence & awakened spiritual movement & supreme ineffable speech, there, therein
