verses.meaningZh: 簷结界系缚邪魔外障以及愿一切诸尊普皆施作护持！愿悉命者，年百，愿悉了知、聪明，本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢·施度调伏，百
verses.meaningEn: Support + bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! and may they all perform/grant! may they living, alive, raining, may they looking, knowing, intelligent! primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust & generosity & self-mastery, śataṃ
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：msitvatu.htm（原典总行数：130 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1156A）

verses.iast: tadyathā / ilā milā utpalā / iramati viramati / halamati / talamati
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：大地、牸牛，冥合融摄·无我大慈三昧，青莲华（优钵罗花），清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧·真如实际，还灭、除断从中，耕慧，表面地面慧
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: = + speech, earth, cow, uniting, blue lotus (Utpala), stainless purity free from dust & selfless great loving-kindness & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), ceasing, desisting, abstaining from, plough + intelligence, surface of the ground + intelligence
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：msitvatu.htm（原典总行数：130 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1156A）

verses.iast: kṣalamati / lakṣamati / rakṣamati / kuru kuru mati / huru huru
verses.meaningZh: 洗涤相貌，十万，守护相貌，再三成办羯磨事业（俱噜），慧、正念妙慧，再三疾速拔济除障（虎噜）
verses.meaningEn: Wash + appearance, lakṣamati, protect + appearance, accomplish & enact this sacred work! again and again, intelligence, wisdom, mindfulness, swiftly rescue and dispel all afflictions! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：msitvatu.htm（原典总行数：130 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1156A）

verses.iast: phuru phuru cara ( Mś Mś Mś Mś ) cara khara khara
verses.meaningZh: 再三妙果圆成·清净离诸尘垢，行持妙道、周游救护（左啰），再三奢字门（本性寂静止息（śānti）·本不生体性），行持妙道、周游救护（左啰），再三凶
verses.meaningEn: Fruition of enlightenment & stainless purity free from dust (imperative seal) again and again, move forth in compassionate activity! primordial tranquil peace (śānti) — primordial non-arising again and again, move forth in compassionate activity! harsh, rough, sharp, piercing again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：msitvatu.htm（原典总行数：130 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1156A）

verses.iast: khuru khuru mati mati bhūmicaṇḍe / kālike / abhisaṃlāpite / sāmalate /
verses.meaningZh: 再三等虚空无碍·清净离诸尘垢，再三慧、正念妙慧，地威猛，时分可尊，破有相福德光·一切诸谛圆满·离一切相无相，答摩笞尊
verses.meaningEn: Space-like boundlessness & stainless purity free from dust (imperative seal) again and again, intelligence, wisdom, mindfulness again and again, ground + O fierce, O relating to time, blessedness transcending existence & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), dark + O a vine
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：msitvatu.htm（原典总行数：130 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1156A）

verses.iast: hūle sthūle / sthūlaśikhare / jaya sthūle / jayavate / vala naṭṭe
verses.meaningZh: 因缘空寂大乐·离一切相无相，粗尊，粗山尖，胜伏、最胜吉祥！粗尊，胜伏鸣呼尊，发，离名相假立·断除憍慢执障
verses.meaningEn: Causal emptiness & spiritual joy & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), O gross, material, gross + O peaked, conquer! victory! O gross, material, conquer! victory! giving clothes to the naked, beyond nominal designation & cutting rigid pride (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：msitvatu.htm（原典总行数：130 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1156A）

verses.iast: / cara nāḍi culu nāḍi culu nāḍi vāgbandhani / virohaṇi / sālohite
verses.meaningZh: 行持妙道、周游救护（左啰），血管，鼓动法水涤除罪垢（主嚧），血管，鼓动法水涤除罪垢（主嚧），血管，沉寂尊，暖气尊，亲戚
verses.meaningEn: Move forth in compassionate activity! vein, artery, any tubular organ of the body, stir the purifying waters of compassion! vein, artery, any tubular organ of the body, stir the purifying waters of compassion! vein, artery, any tubular organ of the body, O stopping of speech, silence, O causing to grow together, heating, O kinsman / in kinsman
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：msitvatu.htm（原典总行数：130 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1156A）

verses.iast: / aṇḍare paṇḍare / karāle / kinnare / keyūre ketumati / bhūtaṃgame
verses.meaningZh: 离诸诤论无诤·息灭诤怨·清净离诸尘垢，第一义谛·离诸诤论无诤·息灭诤怨，揭幕广阔、大口尊，紧那罗（歌神）尊，璎珞尊，幢相太，昂·彼·趣往
verses.meaningEn: Conflict-free peace & pacifying conflict & turmoil & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), ultimate truth & conflict-free peace & pacifying conflict & turmoil (vocative invocation), O projecting , opening wide, gaping, ugly, terrible, O Kinnara, celestial song-spirit / in Kinnara, celestial song-spirit, O a bracelet worn on the upper arm / in a bracelet worn on the upper arm, endowed with brightness + very, arise + him + O going to or in
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：msitvatu.htm（原典总行数：130 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1156A）

verses.iast: bhūtamati / dhanye maṅgalye / hiraṇyagarbhe / mahābale / avalokitamūle / acalacaṇḍe
verses.meaningZh: 昂暗，有钱人、华靡尊，最极吉祥、致福清净尊，金胎神尊，大力威神、大势力尊尊，以观照下，不动明王威猛
verses.meaningEn: Arise + dark, O having or bringing wealth, wealthy, opulent, O auspicious, bringing felicity / in auspicious, bringing felicity, O Spirit Born from a Golden Egg / in Spirit Born from a Golden Egg, O of great power and might / in of great power and might, beheld + at the door, Acala + O fierce
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：msitvatu.htm（原典总行数：130 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1156A）

verses.iast: / dhurandhare jayālike jayāgorohiṇi / curu curu phuru phuru rundha rundha dhare
verses.meaningZh: 持守摄受·法界总持任持，胜伏虚伪尊，誓耶·牯牛·具初升，再三速疾运转妙法加持（祖噜），再三妙果圆成·清净离诸尘垢，再三清净离诸尘垢·离名相假立·法界总持任持，请执持、总持护念！尊
verses.meaningEn: Bearing (vocative invocation), conquer! victory! + O false, Jayā + bull + O bearer of rising, swiftly set sacred blessings in motion! again and again, fruition of enlightenment & stainless purity free from dust (imperative seal) again and again, stainless purity free from dust & beyond nominal designation & Dharma-realm retention again and again, O hold! bear! sustain! / in hold! bear! sustain!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：msitvatu.htm（原典总行数：130 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1156A）

verses.iast: dhare vidhare vidhare viṣkambhani / nāśani vināśani / bandhani / mokṣaṇi vimokṣani
verses.meaningZh: 请执持、总持护念！尊，再三闢请执持，依持在于，摧灭、除断尊，闢摧灭，系缚、枷锁缠缚尊，自由化尊，解脱在于
verses.meaningEn: O hold! bear! sustain! / in hold! bear! sustain! settle + O hold! bear! sustain! again and again, support + in, O destroying, removing, settle + O destroying, O bondage, fetter, imprisonment, O freeing, delivering, liberation + in
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：msitvatu.htm（原典总行数：130 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1156A）

verses.iast: / mocani vimocani / mohani vimohani / bhāvani vibhāvani / śodhani śodhani
verses.meaningZh: 解放尊，自由化从中、弃捨尊，作昏尊，闢作昏尊，物在于，发展中尊，再三理由、询盘尊
verses.meaningEn: O delivering from, hurling, O unharnessing, loosening, freeing from, O stupefying, perplexing, deceiving, settle + O stupefying, becoming + in, O developing, manifesting, O also means of purification again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：msitvatu.htm（原典总行数：130 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1156A）

verses.iast: saṃśodhani viśodhani / saṃkhiraṇi / saṃkiraṇi / saṃcchindani / sādhu turamāṇe /
verses.meaningZh: 桑理由，闢理由，一切诸谛圆满·等虚空无碍·清净离诸尘垢，桑作紊尊，桑·断除烦恼结使缠缚·在于，萨，赶快命令尊
verses.meaningEn: Saṃ + O also means of purification, settle + O also means of purification, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & space-like boundlessness & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), saṃ + O a pig, saṃ + sever every fetter and hostile spell! + in, sadhu, quickly + O command
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：msitvatu.htm（原典总行数：130 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1156A）

verses.iast: hara hara bandhumati / hiri hiri khiri khiri kharali / huru huru
verses.meaningZh: 再三请摄取、遣除苦厄！亲枝慧，再三乐队、斑纹尊，再三等虚空无碍·清净离诸尘垢，虚空蜜蜂，再三疾速拔济除障（虎噜）
verses.meaningEn: Carry away (suffering)! remove! again and again, connection + intelligence, O band, stripe again and again, space-like boundlessness & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation) again and again, hole + bee, swiftly rescue and dispel all afflictions! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：msitvatu.htm（原典总行数：130 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1156A）

verses.iast: khuru khuru piṅgale namo 'stu buddhānāṃ bhagavatāṃ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 再三等虚空无碍·清净离诸尘垢，黄白色尊，归命，愿得成就、当如是，没驮南，才鸣呼，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Space-like boundlessness & stainless purity free from dust (imperative seal) again and again, O a man's name, of an author on Chandas or metrics, of gods demons, homage to may it be so, let it be! buddhānām, excellence, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：msitvatu.htm（原典总行数：130 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1156A）

verses.iast: asyāṃ khalu punā rāhula mahāśītavatīvidyāyāṃ daśottarapadaśatāyāṃ sūtre granthiṃ baddhvā hastena dhāryamānāyāṃ kaṇṭhena
verses.meaningZh: 住，诚然、确实，还复、然而，罗喉罗，广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，第十一·句·于百中，契经，疙瘩、束缚，解脱系缚大力·施度调伏·法界总持任持，以手、尊手执持，决定于慢中，以颈喉、妙音喉轮
verses.meaningEn: Asyāṃ, indeed, verily, certainly, again, Rahula, great, the eleventh + word + in hundred, O discourse, knot, tie, joint, spiritual strength freeing bonds & generosity & self-mastery & Dharma-realm retention, by/through hand, to be held + in opinion, by/through throat, neck
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：msitvatu.htm（原典总行数：130 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1156A）

verses.iast: dhāryamānāyāṃ samantād yojanaśatasya rakṣākṛtā bhaviṣyati ( Mś Mś Mś Mś Mś )
verses.meaningZh: 决定于慢中，一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·离名相假立，踰缮那百之，守护九渊，当，再三奢字门（本性寂静止息（śānti）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: To be held + in opinion, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation, harnessing + of hundred, protection + cleft, will be, primordial tranquil peace (śānti) — primordial non-arising again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：msitvatu.htm（原典总行数：130 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1156A）

verses.iast: / gandhair vā puṣpair vā mudrābhir vā naiva manuṣyo vāmanuṣyo vābhibhaviṣyati /
verses.meaningZh: 妙行趣入·离名相假立·法界总持任持，或、抑或，滋养增益·第一义谛，或、抑或，阶位双手融通，或、抑或，不犹如，人，最上真言离言说·无我大慈三昧·离名相假立，最上真言离言说·破有相福德光·六度满行清净
verses.meaningEn: Awakened spiritual movement & beyond nominal designation & Dharma-realm retention, or, nourishing, or, position of the hands + to, or, not + like, person, supreme ineffable speech & selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation, supreme ineffable speech & blessedness transcending existence & perfection of the six pāramitās (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：msitvatu.htm（原典总行数：130 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1156A）

verses.iast: na śastraṃ na viṣaṃ na rogo na jvaro na prajvaro na vidyāmantro
verses.meaningZh: 不、非、无，器械，不、非、无，箭毒，不、非、无，病，不、非、无，瘟疫，不、非、无，疫病，不、非、无，明咒真言
verses.meaningEn: Not, non-, śastraṃ, not, non-, viṣaṃ, not, non-, rogo, not, non-, jvaro, not, non-, prajvaro, not, non-, Vidyā + Mantra
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：msitvatu.htm（原典总行数：130 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1156A）

verses.iast: na vetāḍaḥ / na vyādhinā nāgninā na viṣodakena kālaṃ kariṣyati / vidyāmantraprayogānāṃ
verses.meaningZh: 不、非、无，毘陀罗鬼，不、非、无，以病患、身心疾疫，离名相假立·妙行趣入，不、非、无，以搅拌净水，时，能作成办·造作离相，明咒·真言·诸加行
verses.meaningEn: Not, non-, zombie, not, non-, by illness, ailment, plague, beyond nominal designation & awakened spiritual movement, not, non-, stir + by, black, making (vocative invocation), Vidyā + Mantra + of all presentation
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：msitvatu.htm（原典总行数：130 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1156A）

verses.iast: ca sarveṣāṃ sādhuprayuktānāṃ cāsiddhānāṃ siddhakarī / siddhānāṃ ca saṃkṣobhaṇī / paraprayuktānāṃ ca
verses.meaningZh: 左字门（妙行迁变空（caryā）·本不生体性），湖相，萨诸相应，悉地成就·妙行迁变空，能作成就者、已成就尊，诸成就者、已成就之以及一切诸谛圆满·造作离相·六度满行清净，愈加诸特殊之以及
verses.meaningEn: Awakened conduct beyond flux (caryā) — primordial non-arising, a lake + work, sadhu + of all yoked, perfected, maker of accomplished, perfected adept (Siddha), of all accomplished, perfected adept (Siddha) and all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās, beyond + of all not employed and
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：msitvatu.htm（原典总行数：130 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1156A）

verses.iast: bandhanī / parabandhanānāṃ ca pramocanī / sarvarogaśokavighnavināyakānāṃ vināśanakarī / kalikalahakaluṣapraśamanakarī / yo
verses.meaningZh: 系缚、枷锁缠缚佛母，他人诸系缚以及能解脱转载、向前尊，一切·疾病·热力·无碍·诸毗那夜迦之，能作闢摧灭，能作罪垢·鬪·不干不净疗尊，凡彼圣尊、能…者
verses.meaningEn: Bondage, fetter, imprisonment (feminine), someone else + of all bondage and liberator from forward, onward, forth, away, fore, all + disease + heat + unhindered + of all Vināyaka, settle + maker of destroying, sin + fight + unclean + maker of heal, who, whichever
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：msitvatu.htm（原典总行数：130 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1156A）

verses.iast: graho na muñcet saptadhāsya sphuṭen mūrdhā arjakasyeva mañjarī / vajrapāṇiś cāsya mahāyakṣasenāpatir
verses.meaningZh: 曜执、星曜鬼神执障，不、非、无，无我大慈三昧·圣智通达·妙行迁变空，萨钵多部件口，一切诸谛圆满·妙果圆成·断除憍慢执障，无我大慈三昧·清净离诸尘垢·法界总持任持，清净离诸尘垢·生起不可得·尊胜·造作离相，穗，最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜·清净离诸尘垢，妙行迁变空·一切诸谛圆满·一乘如实之道，大药叉军主
verses.meaningEn: Planet, seizing spirit/graha, not, non-, selfless great loving-kindness & non-dual wisdom awareness & awakened conduct beyond flux, in seven parts + mouth, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & fruition of enlightenment & cutting rigid pride, selfless great loving-kindness & stainless purity free from dust & Dharma-realm retention, stainless purity free from dust & transcending birth & victorious & freedom from karmic agency, = , blossom or bud often in titles of books, supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious & stainless purity free from dust, awakened conduct beyond flux & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme vehicle of awakening, mahāyakṣasenāpatir
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：msitvatu.htm（原典总行数：130 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1156A）

verses.iast: vajreṇādīptena prajvālitena ekajvālībhūtena tāvad vyāyacched yāvan mūrdhānaṃ sphoṭayet / catvāraś ca mahārājāno
verses.meaningZh: 最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜·清净离诸尘垢，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·生起不可得·尊胜，造作离相·生起不可得·尊胜·最上真言离言说，真如实际·最上真言离言说·施度调伏，最上真言离言说·一乘如实之道·妙行迁变空，一乘如实之道·最上真言离言说·离名相假立，顶，一切诸谛圆满·妙果圆成·断除憍慢执障，妙行迁变空·真如实际·最上真言离言说以及大王气息
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious & stainless purity free from dust (by spiritual power), ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & transcending birth & victorious (by spiritual power), freedom from karmic agency & transcending birth & victorious & supreme ineffable speech (by spiritual power), immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery, supreme ineffable speech & supreme vehicle of awakening & awakened conduct beyond flux, supreme vehicle of awakening & supreme ineffable speech & beyond nominal designation, mūrdhānaṃ, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & fruition of enlightenment & cutting rigid pride, awakened conduct beyond flux & immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech and great king + breath
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：msitvatu.htm（原典总行数：130 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1156A）

verses.iast: 'yomayena cakreṇa mūrdhānaṃ sphoṭayeyuḥ / kṣuradhārāprahāreṇa vināśayeyus tasmāc ca yakṣalokācyavanaṃ bhaveyuḥ /
verses.meaningZh: 以铁杆，以法轮、金轮、脉轮，顶，一切诸谛圆满·妙果圆成·断除憍慢执障，以喷嚏非流转打，摧灭除遣·最上真言离言说，真如实际·一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧以及一乘如实之道·造作离相·六度满行清净，破有相福德光·最上真言离言说·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: By/through iron, by/through wheel, Dharma-wheel, discus, mūrdhānaṃ, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & fruition of enlightenment & cutting rigid pride, sneeze + non-streams + by, destroying obstacles, immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness and supreme vehicle of awakening & freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās, blessedness transcending existence & supreme ineffable speech & supreme vehicle of awakening
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：msitvatu.htm（原典总行数：130 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1156A）

verses.iast: aḍakavatyāṃ rājadhānyāṃ na labhate vāsam
verses.meaningZh: 息灭诤怨·造作离相·最上真言离言说，王·驮·他，不、非、无，获，居
verses.meaningEn: Pacifying conflict & turmoil & freedom from karmic agency & supreme ineffable speech, king + dha + other, not, non-, to take, dwell
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：msitvatu.htm（原典总行数：130 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1156A）

verses.iast: atha khalu punā rāhula mahāśītavatīmahāvidyāyāṃ sakṛtparivartitāyāṃ rājacaurodakāgniviṣaśastrāṭavīkāntāramadhyagataḥ sarvabhayebhyaḥ parimucyate / iyaṃ khalu
verses.meaningZh: 尔时、次复吉祥启白，诚然、确实，还复、然而，罗喉罗，广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，一切诸谛圆满·造作离相·真如实际，在位·不是强盗·浮肿·圣火·搅拌·徒手·旷野·广野·由中间，向诸一切怖畏，除愈拘牵尊，此圣女、此陀罗尼，诚然、确实
verses.meaningEn: Now, thereupon, auspiciously, indeed, verily, certainly, again, Rahula, great, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness, reign + no thief + dropsy + fire + stir + unarmed + forest + hardship + from being in the middle of, all + to all fear, to heal and recover completely + O held, this (feminine), indeed, verily, certainly
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：msitvatu.htm（原典总行数：130 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1156A）

verses.iast: punar mahāśītavatī vidyā ( Mś 6 ) ekanavatyāṃ gaṅgānadīvālukāsamair buddhair bhagavadbhir bhāṣitā
verses.meaningZh: 复次、再三，具足大冷尊，明咒、真言明妃、圣智明，奢字门（本性寂静止息（śānti）·本不生体性），一·九·那个，妙行趣入·支分寂静·离名相假立，觉悟正觉·解脱系缚大力，破有相福德光·妙行趣入·最上真言离言说，妙语、语言
verses.meaningEn: Again, furthermore, great + endowed with sail, Vidyā, sacred wisdom-spell, illumination, primordial tranquil peace (śānti) — primordial non-arising, one + nine + that, awakened spiritual movement & quiescence of perceptual limbs & beyond nominal designation, awakened, blessedness transcending existence & awakened spiritual movement & supreme ineffable speech, spoken, told, uttered
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：msitvatu.htm（原典总行数：130 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1156A）

verses.iast: bhāṣiṣyate bhāṣyate ca siddhā paramasiddhā siddhaparākramā / sarvadevanāgayakṣagandharvāsuragaruḍakinnaramahoragādibhir vanditvā sarvajinagaṇaparivṛtā / sarvabhayopadraveṣu
verses.meaningZh: 宣说演畅·破有相福德光，讲说以及成就者、已成就，管保不成，成就者勇调伏镇被处，持守摄受·广大殊胜·一切诸谛圆满，礼敬赞叹·最上真言离言说，一切·胜者·海会众·围绕，于诸一切怖畏灾横
verses.meaningEn: Speaking (vocative invocation), speech, talk and accomplished, perfected adept (Siddha), assuredly, accomplished + sgl, bearing, great, venerating, all + Victor + assembly + covered, all + fear + among
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：msitvatu.htm（原典总行数：130 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1156A）

verses.iast: mama sarvasatvānāṃ ca rakṣāṃ kuru / śivam ārogyam abhayaṃ ca sarvadā sarvathā
verses.meaningZh: 我之（行者所有），诸一切众生、普皆有情之以及守护、结界护念，祈请成办羯磨事业（俱噜），寂静，健康，无畏以及一切施，诸相本
verses.meaningEn: My, of me (the practitioner), of all all sentient beings and protection, safeguarding, accomplish & enact this sacred work! kind, friendly, mild, gracious, lovely, auspicious, fortunate, healthy, non-fear and one who gives everything, in all ways, by all means, at all
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：msitvatu.htm（原典总行数：130 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1156A）

verses.iast: sarvataḥ sarvāvasthāsu bhavantu
verses.meaningZh: 由一切、普皆遍满，于诸一切分位，愿一切皆得安乐成就
verses.meaningEn: From all, every, complete, all + in to remain standing, may all be blessed & accomplished!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：msitvatu.htm（原典总行数：130 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1156A）

verses.iast: idam avocat bhagavān āttamanā āyuṣmān rāhulaḥ sā ca sarvāvatī parṣat sadevamānuṣāsuragandharvaś ca loko bhagavataḥ samyaksaṃbuddhabhāṣitam abhyanandann iti
verses.meaningZh: 此、此妙法，宣说、开示教敕，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，愉悦、伊人，具寿，罗怙罗，彼、彼圣母（阴性主格）以及具足湖或，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·六度满行清净，彼·天人·人道·气息·不加香尘·踊跃以及世间、世界，世尊、薄伽梵（具六德圣尊），正等正觉妙语，破有相福德光·一乘如实之道·离名相假立，如是（结句印定）
verses.meaningEn: This, this sacred Dharma, spoke, proclaimed, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, glad at heart, delighted, āyuṣmān, rāhulaḥ, she, that and a lake + endowed with or, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & perfection of the six pāramitās, he + god + Human Realm + vital spirit + without smell + be eager and world, realm, Bhagavān, the Blessed/World-Honored One, Perfectly and Completely Awakened Buddha + spoken, blessedness transcending existence & supreme vehicle of awakening & beyond nominal designation, thus, so it is stated
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：msitvatu.htm（原典总行数：130 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1156A）

verses.iast: āryamahāśītavatī nāma vidyārājñī samāptā
verses.meaningZh: 具足圣大冷尊，名为、号曰，明妃，三磨钵耽
verses.meaningEn: Noble + great + endowed with sail, by name, called, wise consort, finished, complete, perfect
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：msitvatu.htm（原典总行数：130 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1156A）

titleZh: 【梵本原典】佛說大護明大陀羅尼經 (五護陀羅尼之五 · 岩本裕校勘 GRETIL 梵本)
translatorZh: 哥廷根大学 GRETIL / 尼泊尔 DSBC 梵文贝叶经校勘本 (Mahamantranusarini)
sutraSourceZh: GRETIL 梵文佛典库 (mahama_u.htm) · 汉译对勘：T20n1155
deityZh: 大護明佛母 (Mahāmantrānusāriṇī)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 本条目直接构建自德国哥廷根大学 GRETIL 梵语原典档案「mahama_u.htm」（共 215 行，完整提取核心真言与经句共 101 句）。系统已自动将其原始 IAST 梵文实时转写为天城文、唐代悉昙梵字、唐宋古汉语音译、现代梵音拼读参考、国际音标 (IPA) 及摩多轻重音律。
recitationTipsZh: 此为学术校勘梵文写本原貌，每一句均配备「梵音拼读参考」与「唐宋古汉语音译」平行对照，且每个音节胶囊内均同时展示梵文、古汉语与现代拼读。

verses.iast: Mahāmantrānusāriṇī C.0.1. oṃ namo bhagavatyai āryamahāmantrānusāriṇyai / namo vidyārājāya / namaḥ samantabuddhānāṃ
verses.meaningZh: 贡高大方·守护掩蔽·具一样，左字门（妙行迁变空（caryā）·本不生体性），嗡！归命，向世尊佛母顶礼，广大殊胜·清净离诸尘垢，归命，向明王，归命，普遍没驮南
verses.meaningEn: High-minded + protect shelter + goddess possessing the same, awakened conduct beyond flux (caryā) — primordial non-arising, Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed Mother / Lady Bhagavatī, great (vocative invocation), homage to to/for lord of spells, homage to universal + buddhānām
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mahama_u.htm（原典总行数：215 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1155）

verses.iast: C.1.1.a. evaṃ mayā śrutam ekasmin samaye bhagavān rājagṛhe viharati sma / veṇuvane
verses.meaningZh: 左字门（妙行迁变空（caryā）·本不生体性），悉昙「a」韵字门：本不生体性，如是、如此，由我（具格：如是我闻），闻，一时，向平，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，王舍城尊，一切，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），竹林尊
verses.meaningEn: Awakened conduct beyond flux (caryā) — primordial non-arising, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising, thus, in this way, by me, heard, at one time, to equal, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, O a king's house, palace, lives, dwells, spends oneʼs time, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, veṇuvane
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mahama_u.htm（原典总行数：215 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1155）

verses.iast: karandakanivāpe / C.1.1.b. evaṃ mayā śrutam ekasmin samaye bhagavān vaiśālyṃ viharati sma
verses.meaningZh: 能作成办·造作离相，左字门（妙行迁变空（caryā）·本不生体性），跋字门（解脱系缚大力（bala，如是、如此，由我（具格：如是我闻），闻，一时，向平，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，最上真言离言说·本性寂静止息·离一切相无相，一切，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Making (vocative invocation), awakened conduct beyond flux (caryā) — primordial non-arising, spiritual strength freeing bonds (bala) — primordial non-arising, thus, in this way, by me, heard, at one time, to equal, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, supreme ineffable speech & primordial tranquil peace & freedom from conditioned marks, lives, dwells, spends oneʼs time, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mahama_u.htm（原典总行数：215 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1155）

verses.iast: / markaṭahradatīrekū ṭāgāraśālāyaṃ C.1.2. tatra bhagavān āyuṣmantam ānandam āmantrayate sma / āgamayānanda
verses.meaningZh: 无我大慈三昧·清净离诸尘垢·造作离相，断除憍慢执障·妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢，左字门（妙行迁变空（caryā）·本不生体性），于彼处、其中，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，寿命活力、健康，阿难，妙意三重，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），趣入通行·妙行趣入
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness & stainless purity free from dust & freedom from karmic agency, cutting rigid pride & awakened spiritual movement & stainless purity free from dust, awakened conduct beyond flux (caryā) — primordial non-arising, there, therein, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, having life or vitality, healthy, long-lived, old, lasting, servant, benevolent + triple, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, going toward
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mahama_u.htm（原典总行数：215 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1155）

verses.iast: yena vaiśālīti / evaṃ bhadante ty āyuṣmān ānando bhagavataḥ pratyaśrauṣīt / atha
verses.meaningZh: 借由彼因缘，吠舍厘如是，如是、如此，大德，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），具寿，普喜，世尊、薄伽梵（具六德圣尊），第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，尔时、次复吉祥启白
verses.meaningEn: By which, whereby, Vaisali + thus, thus, in this way, O venerable, reverend person, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, āyuṣmān, ānando, Bhagavān, the Blessed/World-Honored One, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, now, thereupon, auspiciously
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mahama_u.htm（原典总行数：215 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1155）

verses.iast: bhagavān vṛjiṣu janapadeṣu janapadacārikāñ caran vaiśālīm anuprāpto vaiśālyāṃ viharaty āmrapālīvane / C.1.3.
verses.meaningZh: 世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，于诸跋只中，于诸寨，生起不可得·尊胜·离名相假立·第一义谛，妙行流布·清净离诸尘垢，最上真言离言说·本性寂静止息·离一切相无相，日复一日得，最上真言离言说·本性寂静止息·离一切相无相，最上真言离言说·因缘空寂大乐·清净离诸尘垢，菴罗园园，左字门（妙行迁变空（caryā）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: The World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, in Vajji, among/in district, country, transcending birth & victorious & beyond nominal designation & ultimate truth, practicing, supreme ineffable speech & primordial tranquil peace & freedom from conditioned marks, day after day, supreme ineffable speech & primordial tranquil peace & freedom from conditioned marks, supreme ineffable speech & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & stainless purity free from dust, Amrapali + O free from lust, awakened conduct beyond flux (caryā) — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mahama_u.htm（原典总行数：215 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1155）

verses.iast: tatra bhagavān āyuṣmantam ānandam āmantrayate sma / gacchānanda vaiśālīṃ gatvā indrakīle pādaṃ
verses.meaningZh: 于彼处、其中，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，寿命活力、健康，阿难，妙意三重，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），去吧阿难，最上真言离言说·本性寂静止息·离一切相无相，趣往已，台座门限尊，尊足、四句法足
verses.meaningEn: There, therein, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, having life or vitality, healthy, long-lived, old, lasting, servant, benevolent + triple, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, go! proceed! + servant, supreme ineffable speech & primordial tranquil peace & freedom from conditioned marks, having going in or to, situate or being in, referring to, O bar, bolt, foot, sacred feet, verse-quarter
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mahama_u.htm（原典总行数：215 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1155）

verses.iast: sthāpayitvā imāni mahāmantrānusāriṇī mantrapadāni bhāṣasva / imāś ca gāthāḥ / C.2.1. visarata
verses.meaningZh: 虽是那么，一切本刹，贡高大方·守护掩蔽·具一样，一切真言秘密章句，宣说演畅·破有相福德光，无我大慈三昧·本性寂静止息以及诸孤起，左字门（妙行迁变空（caryā）·本不生体性），闢·彼·忻
verses.meaningEn: Putting aside, this (plural), high-minded + protect shelter + goddess possessing the same, sacred mantra words and phrases, speaking, selfless great loving-kindness & primordial tranquil peace and gatha, awakened conduct beyond flux (caryā) — primordial non-arising, settle + he + joyful
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：mahama_u.htm（原典总行数：215 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1155）

verses.iast: visarata visarata visarata visarata / C.2.2. buddho lokānukampaka ājñāpayati / sarvabuddhānumatena /
verses.meaningZh: 再三闢·彼·忻，左字门（妙行迁变空（caryā）·本不生体性），觉者，世间慈愍，命令·净水·戒精进，以一切佛陀便利

verses.iast: na virudhyate na muṣyate na muhyate na daṇḍyate na muṇḍyate na dahyate
verses.meaningZh: 不、非、无，闢·增长·拘牵尊，不、非、无，掠夺拘牵尊，不、非、无，无我大慈三昧·因缘空寂大乐·一乘如实之道，不、非、无，施度调伏·离诸诤论无诤·息灭诤怨，不、非、无，无我大慈三昧·离诸诤论无诤·息灭诤怨，不、非、无，烧着
verses.meaningEn: Not, non-, settle + grow + O held, not, non-, rob + O held, not, non-, selfless great loving-kindness & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation), not, non-, generosity & self-mastery & conflict-free peace & pacifying conflict & turmoil (vocative invocation), not, non-, selfless great loving-kindness & conflict-free peace & pacifying conflict & turmoil (vocative invocation), not, non-, dahyate
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：maricdhu.htm（原典总行数：117 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1257）

verses.iast: na śatror anūpagacchati / so 'haṃ bhikṣavo mārīcīnāmadevatāyā nāma jānāmi / aham
verses.meaningZh: 不、非、无，怨敌、仇害违缘之，粪田行，彼、彼尊（连音式），我、真我自性，希望人情，摩利支天菩萨·名为·何为·即是，名为、号曰，我了知、英明，我、吾身
verses.meaningEn: Not, non-, of enemy, adversary, hostile force, a moist country + exists, he, that one, I, the awakened self, wish for + favour, Mārīcī + by name + divinity + thus, by name, called, I knowing, wise, I, myself
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：maricdhu.htm（原典总行数：117 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1257）

verses.iast: api na dṛśyate na badhyate na nirudhyate na virudhyate na muhyate na
verses.meaningZh: 亦、虽、乃至，不、非、无，可看、善见，不、非、无，解脱系缚大力·法界总持任持·一乘如实之道，不、非、无，在于·增长·拘牵尊，不、非、无，闢·增长·拘牵尊，不、非、无，无我大慈三昧·因缘空寂大乐·一乘如实之道，不、非、无
verses.meaningEn: Even, also, not, non-, to be seen, visible to, not, non-, spiritual strength freeing bonds & Dharma-realm retention & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation), not, non-, in + grow + O held, not, non-, settle + grow + O held, not, non-, selfless great loving-kindness & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation), not, non-
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：maricdhu.htm（原典总行数：117 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1257）

verses.iast: daṇḍyate na muṇḍyate na dahyate na śatror anūpagacchati / imāni mantrapadāni bhavanti
verses.meaningZh: 施度调伏·离诸诤论无诤·息灭诤怨，不、非、无，无我大慈三昧·离诸诤论无诤·息灭诤怨，不、非、无，烧着，不、非、无，怨敌、仇害违缘之，粪田行，一切本刹，一切真言秘密章句，诸尊愿成、善住
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery & conflict-free peace & pacifying conflict & turmoil (vocative invocation), not, non-, selfless great loving-kindness & conflict-free peace & pacifying conflict & turmoil (vocative invocation), not, non-, dahyate, not, non-, of enemy, adversary, hostile force, a moist country + exists, this (plural), sacred mantra words and phrases, they be! become!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：maricdhu.htm（原典总行数：117 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1257）

verses.iast: / tadyathā ḥ oṃ padākramasi parākramasi udayamasi nairamasi arkamasi markamasi urmasi vanamasi
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：悉昙「ḥ」韵字门：本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入，嗡！秋天·案·汝即是，愈加·案·汝即是，净水·摄伏·汝即是，离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧，清净离诸尘垢·造作离相·无我大慈三昧，无我大慈三昧·清净离诸尘垢·造作离相，清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧·一切诸谛圆满，园汝即是
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'ḥ': primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release, Oṃ! fall + hold fast + Thou art, beyond + hold fast + Thou art, water + hold + Thou art, beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), stainless purity free from dust & freedom from karmic agency & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), selfless great loving-kindness & stainless purity free from dust & freedom from karmic agency (vocative invocation), stainless purity free from dust & selfless great loving-kindness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (vocative invocation), Thou art
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：maricdhu.htm（原典总行数：117 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1257）

verses.iast: gulmamasi cīvaramasi mahācīvaramasi antardhānamasi svāhā / oṃ mārīcīdevatā pathe māṃ gopaya /
verses.meaningZh: 妙行趣入·离一切相无相·无我大慈三昧，妙行迁变空·最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢，广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，灭汝即是，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！嗡！摩利支天菩萨天神，路尊，我，护念、摄护周全
verses.meaningEn: Awakened spiritual movement & freedom from conditioned marks & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), awakened conduct beyond flux & supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), great (vocative invocation), Thou art, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Oṃ! Mārīcī + a god, O road / in road, me (the practitioner), guard, cherish and watch over!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：maricdhu.htm（原典总行数：117 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1257）

verses.iast: utpathe māṃ gopaya / puruṣabhayato māṃ gopaya / rājabhayato māṃ gopaya /
verses.meaningZh: 弯路尊，我，护念、摄护周全，士夫·星宿·如何哪些，我，护念、摄护周全，王·星宿·如何哪些，我，护念、摄护周全
verses.meaningEn: O wrong way / in wrong way, me (the practitioner), guard, cherish and watch over! man + star + from whom, me (the practitioner), guard, cherish and watch over! king + star + from whom, me (the practitioner), guard, cherish and watch over!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：maricdhu.htm（原典总行数：117 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1257）

verses.iast: hastibhayato māṃ gopaya / caurabhayato māṃ gopaya / nāgabhayato māṃ gopaya /
verses.meaningZh: 因缘空寂大乐·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际，我，护念、摄护周全，贼盗·星宿·如何哪些，我，护念、摄护周全，龙族·星宿·如何哪些，我，护念、摄护周全
verses.meaningEn: Causal emptiness & spiritual joy & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness, me (the practitioner), guard, cherish and watch over! thief + star + from whom, me (the practitioner), guard, cherish and watch over! Nāga + star + from whom, me (the practitioner), guard, cherish and watch over!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：maricdhu.htm（原典总行数：117 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1257）

verses.iast: siṃhabhayato māṃ gopaya / vyāghrabhayato māṃ gopaya / aśvabhayato māṃ gopaya /
verses.meaningZh: 狮子·星宿·如何哪些，我，护念、摄护周全，豹·星宿·如何哪些，我，护念、摄护周全，马·星宿·如何哪些，我，护念、摄护周全
verses.meaningEn: Lion + star + from whom, me (the practitioner), guard, cherish and watch over! tiger + star + from whom, me (the practitioner), guard, cherish and watch over! horse + star + from whom, me (the practitioner), guard, cherish and watch over!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：maricdhu.htm（原典总行数：117 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1257）

verses.iast: agnibhayato māṃ gopaya / udakabhayato māṃ gopaya / sarpabhayato māṃ gopaya /
verses.meaningZh: 圣火·星宿·如何哪些，我，护念、摄护周全，净水·星宿·如何哪些，我，护念、摄护周全，蛇·星宿·如何哪些，我，护念、摄护周全
verses.meaningEn: Fire + star + from whom, me (the practitioner), guard, cherish and watch over! water + star + from whom, me (the practitioner), guard, cherish and watch over! crawling + star + from whom, me (the practitioner), guard, cherish and watch over!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：maricdhu.htm（原典总行数：117 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1257）

verses.iast: viṣabhayato māṃ gopaya / sarvapratyarthikapratyamitrabhayato māṃ gopaya / ākuleṣu māṃ gopaya /
verses.meaningZh: 毒害·星宿·如何哪些，我，护念、摄护周全，一切·回犯·冤家·星宿·如何哪些，我，护念、摄护周全，于诸糊涂、烦乱中，我，护念、摄护周全
verses.meaningEn: Poison + star + from whom, me (the practitioner), guard, cherish and watch over! all + enemy + star + from whom, me (the practitioner), guard, cherish and watch over! among/in confounded, confused, agitated, anxious, me (the practitioner), guard, cherish and watch over!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：maricdhu.htm（原典总行数：117 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1257）

verses.iast: anākuleṣu māṃ gopaya / mūrcchiteṣu māṃ gopaya / amūrcchiteṣu māṃ gopaya /
verses.meaningZh: 无于诸糊涂、烦乱中，我，护念、摄护周全，于诸沈昏中，我，护念、摄护周全，无于诸沈昏中，我，护念、摄护周全
verses.meaningEn: Un-among/in confounded, confused, agitated, anxious, me (the practitioner), guard, cherish and watch over! mūrcchiteṣu, me (the practitioner), guard, cherish and watch over! free from, me (the practitioner), guard, cherish and watch over!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：maricdhu.htm（原典总行数：117 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1257）

verses.iast: nāgato me rakṣa / caṇḍamṛgato me rakṣa / rakṣa rakṣa mama sarvasatvānāṃ
verses.meaningZh: 离名相假立·妙行趣入·真如实际，于我、为我，拥护、守护，观照寻伺·妙行迁变空，于我、为我，再三拥护、守护，我之（行者所有），诸一切众生、普皆有情之
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation & awakened spiritual movement & immutable Suchness, to me, my, protect, guard and shelter! contemplating, to me, my, protect, guard and shelter! again and again, my, of me (the practitioner), of all all sentient beings
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：maricdhu.htm（原典总行数：117 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1257）

verses.iast: ca sarvaduṣṭapraduṣṭebhyaḥ / tadyathā ḥ namo ratnatrayāya oṃ ālo tālo kālo sacchalo
verses.meaningZh: 左字门（妙行迁变空（caryā）·本不生体性），向诸一切暴恶者败坏，即说咒曰：悉昙「ḥ」韵字门：本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入，归命，向佛法僧三宝，嗡！衍伸、刻毒实物，七多罗树，时，奸滑
verses.meaningEn: Awakened conduct beyond flux (caryā) — primordial non-arising, all + wicked + to all corrupt, Thus goes the mantra: Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'ḥ': primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release, homage to to/for the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha), Oṃ! spawn, venomous matter, tālo, kālo, deceitful
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：maricdhu.htm（原典总行数：117 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1257）

verses.iast: satvamudrati rakṣa rakṣa māṃ saparivārasya sarvasatvānāṃ ca sarvabhayopadravebhyaḥ svāhā / namo ratnatrayāya
verses.meaningZh: 有情阶位双手，祈请再三拥护、守护于我，彼眷属之，诸一切众生、普皆有情之以及向诸一切怖畏灾横，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！归命，向佛法僧三宝
verses.meaningEn: Sentient being + position of the hands, evermore protect, guard and shelter me, he + of accessory, of all all sentient beings and all + fear + to all calamity, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! homage to to/for the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：maricdhu.htm（原典总行数：117 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1257）

verses.iast: / namo bhagavatyai āryamārīcīdevatāyai / tasyā hṛdayam āvartayiṣyāmi / tadyathā ḥ oṃ
verses.meaningZh: 归命向世尊佛母顶礼，清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道·无我大慈三昧，彼之、其（属格），心，最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，即说咒曰：悉昙「ḥ」韵字门：本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入，嗡！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to to the Blessed Mother / Lady Bhagavatī, stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), his, of that, hṛdayam, supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), Thus goes the mantra: Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'ḥ': primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release, Oṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：maricdhu.htm（原典总行数：117 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1257）

verses.iast: vattālī vadālī varālī varāhamukhī / sarvaduṣṭapraduṣṭānāṃ cakṣurmukhaṃ bandha bandha / bandha mukhaṃ
verses.meaningZh: 不过逮捕七多罗树，演说女性善友，殊胜女性善友，野猪面门，一切·暴恶者·诸败坏，眼面，再三结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮），面
verses.meaningEn: Only apprehend + palm-tree, speaking + female friend, choicest + female friend, boar + face, all + wicked + of all corrupt, eye, bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! again and again, mukhaṃ
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：maricdhu.htm（原典总行数：117 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1257）

verses.iast: jambhaya stambhaya mohaya svāhā / oṃ mārīcyai svāhā / oṃ varālī vadālī
verses.meaningZh: 请调伏、摧折憍慢魔障！请制止、令暴恶魔障止息不动！请令怨魔迷闷失其毒力！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！嗡！向摩利支天菩萨（阳焰威光佛母），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！嗡！殊胜女性善友，演说女性善友
verses.meaningEn: Crush! quell jaws of hostility! immobilize! halt hostile forces! bewilder hostile forces! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Oṃ! to Mārīcī, Goddess of Dawn Rays, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Oṃ! choicest + female friend, speaking + female friend
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：maricdhu.htm（原典总行数：117 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1257）

verses.iast: vattālī varāhamukhī sarvaduṣṭapraduṣṭānāṃ cakṣurmukhaṃ bandha bandha jambhaya jambhaya stambhaya stambhaya mohaya mohaya
verses.meaningZh: 不过逮捕七多罗树，野猪面门，一切·暴恶者·诸败坏，眼面，再三结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮），再三请调伏、摧折憍慢魔障！再三请制止、令暴恶魔障止息不动！再三请令怨魔迷闷失其毒力！
verses.meaningEn: Only apprehend + palm-tree, boar + face, all + wicked + of all corrupt, eye, bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! again and again, crush! quell jaws of hostility! again and again, immobilize! halt hostile forces! again and again, bewilder hostile forces! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：maricdhu.htm（原典总行数：117 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1257）

verses.iast: bhañjaya bhañjaya tarjaya tarjaya hrīṃ hrīṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ svāhā / oṃ
verses.meaningZh: 再三摧碎破除一切魔障，再三威胁、滥用，再三莲华妙幻自在种子字（清净摄受），吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！嗡！
verses.meaningEn: May You shatter and break all obstacles!! again and again, may You threaten, menace, abuse, revile again and again, lotus-māyā seed syllable Hrīṃ again and again, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Oṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：maricdhu.htm（原典总行数：117 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1257）

verses.iast: mārīcyai sara sara muhya muhya vimuhya vimuhya apakrāmya apakrāmya sarvaduṣṭasatvān pathe utpathe
verses.meaningZh: 向摩利支天菩萨（阳焰威光佛母），再三流注周遍、速行护念（萨啰），再三无我大慈三昧·因缘空寂大乐·一乘如实之道，再三最上真言离言说·无我大慈三昧·因缘空寂大乐，再三第一义谛·造作离相·清净离诸尘垢，一切·暴恶者·有情，路尊，弯路尊
verses.meaningEn: To Mārīcī, Goddess of Dawn Rays, flow forth and pervade with blessing! again and again, selfless great loving-kindness & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & supreme vehicle of awakening again and again, supreme ineffable speech & selfless great loving-kindness & causal emptiness & spiritual joy again and again, ultimate truth & freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust again and again, all + wicked + sentient being, O road / in road, O wrong way / in wrong way
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：maricdhu.htm（原典总行数：117 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1257）

verses.iast: sarvavidhnavināyakā apasarantu mā tiṣṭhantu triratnasatyena svāhā / oṃ caṇḍa paramacaṇḍa svāhā /
verses.meaningZh: 一切·服务天神·不·毗那夜迦，事业愿悉辐条，勿、莫令，愿悉祈请安住加持，以三珍宝谛，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！嗡！威猛、暴烈除障，最胜威猛，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: All + serve a god + not + Vināyaka, work + may they spoke of a wheel! do not, let not, may they abide steadfastly & bestow grace!! three + jewel + by, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Oṃ! fierce, ardent, wrathful, supreme + fierce, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：maricdhu.htm（原典总行数：117 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1257）

verses.iast: oṃ agali pagali pañcagali sarvaduṣṭapraduṣṭānāṃ kāyavākcittaṃ mukhaṃ cakṣuṣi bandha bandha hūṃ hūṃ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！妙行趣入·离一切相无相，第一义谛·妙行趣入·离一切相无相，五喉轮，一切·暴恶者·诸败坏，身·语·心，面，妙行迁变空·造作离相·六度满行清净，再三结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮），吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! awakened spiritual movement & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), ultimate truth & awakened spiritual movement & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), five + O throat, all + wicked + of all corrupt, body + mind, mukhaṃ, awakened conduct beyond flux & freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās (vocative invocation), bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! again and again, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：maricdhu.htm（原典总行数：117 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1257）

verses.iast: hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā / idam avocad bhagavān āttamanās te ca
verses.meaningZh: 吽（金刚心印）！泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！此、此妙法，最上真言离言说·妙行迁变空·施度调伏，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，真如实际·无我大慈三昧·离名相假立，向汝、彼等以及

Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! this, this sacred Dharma, supreme ineffable speech & awakened conduct beyond flux & generosity & self-mastery, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, immutable Suchness & selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation, to Thee / they and

verses.meaningZh: 四，大·心·一切阶位双手，乃是中古，再三以诸一切如来，部族同，尊胜降伏·第一义谛
verses.meaningEn: Catvāri, great + heart + position of the hands, to be shot off, to be used, employed, recited, performed, by/with all Tathagatas again and again, buddha-family, conquering
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：manivdhu.htm（原典总行数：182 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n1005A / T19n1006）

verses.iast: catvāry āryavajrahṛdayamudrāṇi upayojyā sarvamaṇḍa lai ḥ
verses.meaningZh: 妙行迁变空·真如实际·最上真言离言说，圣·金刚·心·一切阶位双手，愈加相合，一切妙，攞字门（离一切相无相（lakṣaṇa）·大自在威德统摄），悉昙「ḥ」韵字门：本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入
verses.meaningEn: Awakened conduct beyond flux & immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech, noble + Vajra + heart + position of the hands, thereto + turned to, all + cream, freedom from conditioned marks (lakṣaṇa) — sovereign spiritual mastery, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'ḥ': primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：manivdhu.htm（原典总行数：182 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n1005A / T19n1006）

verses.iast: āśvāsanamudrā samābāhyapaśyadanyamudraṃ samārabhe eṣaiva tathāga ta kule kule kule kule mudrā upayojyā yathāvidhi
verses.meaningZh: 令人鼓舞手印，时候·外·不过·凡所…者·他·阶位双手，时候猕猴尊，急促事关犹如，如是宝树宝山，多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·本不生体性），再三部族（佛，手印、法印、契印，愈加相合，好生
verses.meaningEn: Consoling + Mudrā, half-year + outside + only + which + other + position of the hands, half-year + O of a monkey, rushing on + like, thus + tree or mountain, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — primordial non-arising, O buddha-family, lineage / in buddha-family, lineage again and again, Mudrā, sacred seal, gesture, thereto + turned to, properly, duly
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：manivdhu.htm（原典总行数：182 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n1005A / T19n1006）

verses.iast: bāhyamudrā na grahetavyā : anyamudrā yathā yathā yathā yathā yathā sukhaṃ sarvatra upayoktavyaḥ yathā upayujyate tathāgatakule
verses.meaningZh: 外手印，不、非、无，曜执·趣往·包扎，他手印，再三犹如、如…所说，安乐，一切处、普皆周遍，受雇，犹如、如…所说，利益，如来部族尊
verses.meaningEn: Outside + Mudrā, not, non-, planet + going + wrap, other + Mudrā, just as, according to again and again, sukhaṃ, everywhere, at all times & places, to be employed, just as, according to, upayujyate, Tathāgata + O buddha-family
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：manivdhu.htm（原典总行数：182 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n1005A / T19n1006）

verses.iast: oṃ sarvatathāga ta hṛdaya GBM 1728 1 maṇijvālani āreṣṭaya hūṃ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！一切处·尔时·宝树宝山，多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·本不生体性），心、心髓、根本心咒，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），摩尼宝珠引柴尊，此边祈请可爱，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! from or on all sides + now + tree or mountain, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — primordial non-arising, heart, core essence, heart-mantra, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, Maṇi jewel + O kindling, the hither + may You sought, Hūṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：manivdhu.htm（原典总行数：182 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n1005A / T19n1006）

verses.iast: tathāgatahṛdayamudrā
verses.meaningZh: 如来·心·水獭
verses.meaningEn: Tathāgata + a kind of aquatic animal
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：manivdhu.htm（原典总行数：182 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n1005A / T19n1006）

verses.iast: oṃ sarva ta thāgata thāgata pravarāgramaṇi hūṃ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！一切、普皆遍满，多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·本不生体性），再三他来，最妙·尊·摩尼宝珠，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! all, every, complete, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — primordial non-arising, tha + to come again and again, cover + first + Maṇi jewel, Hūṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：manivdhu.htm（原典总行数：182 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n1005A / T19n1006）

verses.iast: tathāgatasamayamudrā
verses.meaningZh: 如来·三昧耶·手印
verses.meaningEn: Tathāgata + Samaya + Mudrā
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：manivdhu.htm（原典总行数：182 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n1005A / T19n1006）

verses.iast: oṃ sarvatathāgatābhi saṃ bodhanavajre bodhanavajre bodhanavajre hūṃ hūṃ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！一切如来融通，娑字门（一切诸谛圆满（sarvasatya）·本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持），再三带劲金刚尊，吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! all Tathagatas + to, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (satya) — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, causing to expand or blossom + O Vajra again and again, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：manivdhu.htm（原典总行数：182 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n1005A / T19n1006）

verses.iast: tathāgataāśvāsanamudrā
verses.meaningZh: 如来·令人鼓舞·手印
verses.meaningEn: Tathāgata + consoling + Mudrā
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：manivdhu.htm（原典总行数：182 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n1005A / T19n1006）

verses.iast: oṃ sarvatathāgatādhiṣṭhā na na na na maṇi maṇi hūṃ hūṃ phat
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！一切如来加，再三不、非、无，再三摩尼宝珠（如意离垢宝），吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! all Tathagatas + to step over, not, non- again and again, Maṇi jewel, luminous gem again and again, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：manivdhu.htm（原典总行数：182 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n1005A / T19n1006）

verses.iast: tathāgatādhiṣṭhānamudrā
verses.meaningZh: 如来·栏杆台座·水獭
verses.meaningEn: Tathāgata + a kind of aquatic animal
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：manivdhu.htm（原典总行数：182 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n1005A / T19n1006）

verses.iast: oṃ sarvatathāgata pravara maṇi maṇi maṇi maṇi maṇi rucire hūṃ hūṃ phat
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！一切如来，最妙，再三摩尼宝珠（如意离垢宝），妙光尊，吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! all Tathagatas, cover, upper garment, Maṇi jewel, luminous gem again and again, O bright, splendid, beautiful, pleasant, agreeable to / in bright, splendid, beautiful, pleasant, agreeable to, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：manivdhu.htm（原典总行数：182 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n1005A / T19n1006）

verses.iast: tathāgatavajrasiṃhāsanamudrā
verses.meaningZh: 如来·金刚·师子座·手印
verses.meaningEn: Tathāgata + Vajra + lion's throne + Mudrā
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：manivdhu.htm（原典总行数：182 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n1005A / T19n1006）

verses.iast: oṃ sarvatathāgata vipula saṃbha ve GBM 1729 1 hūṃ hūṃ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！一切如来，广大、宽博无量，桑星宿，嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! all Tathagatas, vast, extensive, abundant, profound, saṃ + star, supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — samādhi invocation, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：manivdhu.htm（原典总行数：182 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n1005A / T19n1006）

verses.iast: tathāgatābhiṣekamudrā
verses.meaningZh: 如来·灌顶·手印
verses.meaningEn: Tathāgata + consecration + Mudrā
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：manivdhu.htm（原典总行数：182 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n1005A / T19n1006）

verses.iast: oṃ sarvatathāgata samaya maṇi vajre hūṃ hūṃ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！一切如来，三昧耶（本誓、平等契合、时际），摩尼宝珠（如意离垢宝），金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）尊，吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! all Tathagatas, Samaya, sacred vow, pledge, union, Maṇi jewel, luminous gem, O Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt / in Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：manivdhu.htm（原典总行数：182 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n1005A / T19n1006）

verses.iast: dharmacakramudrā
verses.meaningZh: 转法轮印
verses.meaningEn: Dharmacakra mudra
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：manivdhu.htm（原典总行数：182 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n1005A / T19n1006）

verses.iast: oṃ sarvatathāgata jaya ajitavajre hūṃ hūṃ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！一切如来，胜伏、最胜吉祥！无胜金刚尊，吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! all Tathagatas, conquer! victory! unsurpassed + O Vajra, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：manivdhu.htm（原典总行数：182 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n1005A / T19n1006）

verses.iast: aparājitamudrā
verses.meaningZh: 无能胜手印
verses.meaningEn: Invincible + Mudrā
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：manivdhu.htm（原典总行数：182 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n1005A / T19n1006）

verses.iast: oṃ sa rva tathāgatadharmadhātu tathāgatadharmadhātu tathāgatadharmadhātu mahāmaṇi śikhare hara hara hūṃ hūṃ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！彼、此尊（阳性主格），嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk，再三如来法界，广大，山尖，再三请摄取、遣除苦厄！吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! he, that one, supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — primordial non-arising, Tathāgata + Dharmadhātu again and again, great or precious jewel, O peaked, carry away (suffering)! remove! again and again, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：manivdhu.htm（原典总行数：182 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n1005A / T19n1006）

verses.iast: tathāgatacakravartimu drā
verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·无住安立·妙行趣入，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·远离寂静周遍）
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & non-abiding equipoise & awakened spiritual movement (imperative seal), stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — expansive quiescence
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：manivdhu.htm（原典总行数：182 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n1005A / T19n1006）

verses.iast: oṃ sarvatathāgata vajrā hvaya ddhara dhara hūṃ hūṃ phat
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！一切如来，金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），因缘空寂大乐·最上真言离言说·一乘如实之道，持守摄受·施度调伏，请执持、总持护念！吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! all Tathagatas, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & supreme ineffable speech & supreme vehicle of awakening, bearing, hold! bear! sustain! Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：manivdhu.htm（原典总行数：182 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n1005A / T19n1006）

verses.iast: āryavajramaṇigrahaṇamudrā
verses.meaningZh: 圣·金刚·摩尼宝珠·摄伏·手印
verses.meaningEn: Noble + Vajra + Maṇi jewel + to seize + Mudrā
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：manivdhu.htm（原典总行数：182 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n1005A / T19n1006）

verses.iast: oṃ dhuru dhuru maṇi mahāvidyuta maṇi svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三坚固任持总持法印（度噜），摩尼宝珠（如意离垢宝），大·解·额外，摩尼宝珠（如意离垢宝），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! firmly uphold the dhāraṇī seal! again and again, Maṇi jewel, luminous gem, great + understanding + fastened to, Maṇi jewel, luminous gem, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：manivdhu.htm（原典总行数：182 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n1005A / T19n1006）

verses.iast: cintāmaṇimudrā āryavajrasya mudrā
verses.meaningZh: 如意摩尼宝珠手印，圣金刚之，手印、法印、契印
verses.meaningEn: Cintāmaṇi + Mudrā, noble + of Vajra, Mudrā, sacred seal, gesture
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：manivdhu.htm（原典总行数：182 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n1005A / T19n1006）

verses.iast: oṃ loka pā lite GBM 1730 1 jaya jaya hūṃ hūṃ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！世间、世界，跛字门（第一义谛（paramārtha）·远离寂静周遍），离一切相无相·真如实际，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），再三胜伏、最胜吉祥！吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! world, realm, ultimate truth (paramārtha) — expansive quiescence, freedom from conditioned marks & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, conquer! victory! again and again, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：manivdhu.htm（原典总行数：182 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n1005A / T19n1006）

verses.iast: caturmahārājānāṃ mudrā grahetavyā
verses.meaningZh: 诸四大天王之，手印、法印、契印，曜执·趣往·包扎
verses.meaningEn: Of all Four Deva Kings, Mudrā, sacred seal, gesture, planet + going + wrap
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：manivdhu.htm（原典总行数：182 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n1005A / T19n1006）

verses.iast: oṃ vipulā gravati gravati saṃbhara hūṃ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！广大、宽博无量，再三妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，桑方位，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! vast, extensive, abundant, profound, awakened spiritual movement & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation) again and again, saṃ + bearing, Hūṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：manivdhu.htm（原典总行数：182 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n1005A / T19n1006）

verses.iast: śriyā mahādevyā mudrā grahetavyā
verses.meaningZh: 广大光华，以摩诃室利，手印、法印、契印，曜执·趣往·包扎
verses.meaningEn: With great magnificence, with/by Mahādevī, Mudrā, sacred seal, gesture, planet + going + wrap
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：manivdhu.htm（原典总行数：182 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n1005A / T19n1006）

verses.iast: oṃ daṃṣṭriṇi visara hūṃ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！具牙尊，毘萨罗，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O bearer of large tooth, tusk, fang, plenty, abundance, Hūṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：manivdhu.htm（原典总行数：182 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n1005A / T19n1006）

verses.iast: tarjanīmu drā drā drā śaṃkhinī
verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·生起不可得·尊胜，再三啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·远离寂静周遍），事业具虚空佛母
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & transcending birth & victorious (imperative seal), stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — expansive quiescence again and again, labour + possessing hole
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：manivdhu.htm（原典总行数：182 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n1005A / T19n1006）

verses.iast: oṃ āgamaya dhīra mucāṭṭa hāsinī hūṃ dūtīmudrā baddhitavyā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！祈请传，勇猛，无我大慈三昧·妙行迁变空·断除憍慢执障，具笑声、欢喜佛母，吽（金刚心印）！施度调伏·真如实际·无我大慈三昧，解脱系缚大力·施度调伏·法界总持任持
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! may You traditional, intelligent, skilful, clever, wise, selfless great loving-kindness & awakened conduct beyond flux & cutting rigid pride, possessing laughing, laughter, mirth, joy, derision, Hūṃ! generosity & self-mastery & immutable Suchness & selfless great loving-kindness, spiritual strength freeing bonds & generosity & self-mastery & Dharma-realm retention
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：manivdhu.htm（原典总行数：182 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n1005A / T19n1006）

verses.iast: oṃ sa ma ntākāra ntākāra ntākāra ntākāra paripūraṇe dhaka dhaka hūṃ hūṃ phat maṇḍalanivāsinīnāṃ mudrā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！彼、此尊（阳性主格），摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），再三离名相假立·真如实际·造作离相，般遂尊，再三法界总持任持·造作离相，吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！诸住轮天之，手印、法印、契印
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! he, that one, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness & freedom from karmic agency again and again, wisdom + O satisfy, Dharma-realm retention & freedom from karmic agency again and again, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ! of Maṇḍalanivāsinī, Mudrā, sacred seal, gesture
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：manivdhu.htm（原典总行数：182 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n1005A / T19n1006）

verses.iast: ābāhana mu drā drā drā drā drā grahetavyā
verses.meaningZh: 解脱系缚大力·因缘空寂大乐·离名相假立，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·损减除灭忧苦），再三啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·远离寂静周遍），曜执·趣往·包扎
verses.meaningEn: Spiritual strength freeing bonds & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & beyond nominal designation, selfless great loving-kindness — dispelling sorrow, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — expansive quiescence again and again, planet + going + wrap
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：manivdhu.htm（原典总行数：182 行 · 对勘大正藏 T19n1005A / T19n1006）

verses.iast: oṃ sara sara visara hūṃ hūṃ padmamudrā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三流注周遍、速行护念（萨啰），毘萨罗，吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！壤水獭

verses.meaningZh: 次，金刚手，以佛陀体面，一切·佛陀·栏杆台座，离名相假立·圣智通达·妙行迁变空，大忿怒出生，宣说演畅·最上真言离言说，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Secondary, vajrapāṇiḥ, Buddha + by, all + Buddha, beyond nominal designation & non-dual wisdom awareness & awakened conduct beyond flux, Great Wrathful One, speaking (vocative invocation), selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising

verses.meaningEn: Awakened conduct beyond flux & coolness free of obscuration & generosity & self-mastery, truth, reality, veracity, firm, hard, solid, firm, strong, lasting, durable, steadfast, constant, resolute, faithful,, everywhere + unobstructed, everywhere + invincible, all sentient beings + driving asunder + palm, all sentient beings + putting off + palm, all knowledge + close by + not + palm, all + Vidyā + laming + palm, all + actions + ruining + palm, all + actions + driving asunder + palm
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vjviddhu.htm（原典总行数：170 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1416）

verses.iast: sarvagrahotsādanakaraṃ sarvagrahavimokṣaṇakaraṃ sarvabhūtākarṣaṇakaraṃ sarvavidyāmantrakarmaparāyaṇakaraṃ asiddhānāṃ siddhakaraṃ siddhānāñcāvināśanakaraṃ sarvasattvānāṃ rakṣaṇakaraṃ śāntikaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ sarvasattvānāñca
verses.meaningZh: 一切·曜执·净身·掌，一切·曜执·自由化从中·掌，一切处·召请·掌，一切圣智·阿满多罗·事·依护·掌，诸不成之，齐备，悉地成就·摧灭除遣·能作成办·一切诸谛圆满，诸一切众生、普皆有情之，卫掌，息灾，圆满，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: All + planet + putting off + palm, all + planet + freeing from + palm, being everywhere + the same as + palm, all knowledge + not having or knowing mantras + actions + going away + palm, asiddhānāṃ, cooked, perfected, destroying obstacles, making, of all all sentient beings, guard + palm, śāntikaṃ, pauṣṭikaṃ, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vjviddhu.htm（原典总行数：170 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1416）

verses.meaningZh: 僵仆掌，诸一切众生、普皆有情之以及作昏掌，此（真言，真言，大发，以佛陀体面，药叉印达罗，金刚手，宣说演畅·第一义谛
verses.meaningEn: Laming + palm, of all all sentient beings and stupefying + palm, this (accusative), mantraṃ, great + giving clothes to the naked, Buddha + by, Yakṣa, vajrapāṇiḥ, speaking

verses.iast: om namo ratnatrayāya
verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！归命，向佛法僧三宝
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to/for the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha)

verses.meaningZh: 归命敬礼·离名相假立

verses.iast: mahāyakṣasenāpataye
verses.meaningZh: 向大药叉军主

verses.iast: tadyathā - om truṭa truṭa troṭaya troṭaya sphuṭa sphuṭa sphoṭaya sphoṭaya ghurṇa
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！再三真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·断除憍慢执障，再三真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·断除憍慢执障，再三开，再三请击碎、破除一切结缚！破暗合集·清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & cutting rigid pride again and again, immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & cutting rigid pride again and again, suffused again and again, shatter! split open! again and again, dissolving dense ignorance & stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vjviddhu.htm（原典总行数：170 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1416）

verses.iast: ghurṇa ghurṇāpaya ghurṇāpaya sarvasattvānāṃ vibodhaya vibodhaya sambodhaya sambodhaya bhrama bhrama saṃbhrāmaya saṃbhrāmaya
verses.meaningZh: 破暗合集·清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤，再三破暗合集·清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤，诸一切众生、普皆有情之，再三请令圆满开悟、朗然大觉！再三随着请开晓觉悟，再三头旋，再三桑祈请遊
verses.meaningEn: Dissolving dense ignorance & stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace, dissolving dense ignorance & stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace again and again, of all all sentient beings, fully awaken and enlighten! again and again, along with + awaken! enlighten! illuminate! again and again, spring again and again, saṃ + may You to tour! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vjviddhu.htm（原典总行数：170 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1416）

verses.iast: sarvabhūtāni kuṭa kuṭa saṃkuṭaya saṃkuṭaya sarvaśatrūn ghaṭa ghaṭa saṃdhāṭaya saṃghāṭaya sarvavidyā vajra
verses.meaningZh: 一切一切处、到处可见，再三造作离相·断除憍慢执障，再三桑祈请庵，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，再三瓶，一切诸谛圆满·法界总持任持·断除憍慢执障，祈请僧伽吒，一切圣智，金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）
verses.meaningEn: Being everywhere, ubiquitous, freedom from karmic agency & cutting rigid pride again and again, saṃ + may You cottage! again and again, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, jar, ewer again and again, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & Dharma-realm retention & cutting rigid pride, may You assembly! all knowledge, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vjviddhu.htm（原典总行数：170 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1416）

verses.iast: vajrasphoṭaya vajra vajra kaṭa vajra vajra maṭa vajra vajra matha vajra vajra
verses.meaningZh: 金刚请击碎，再三金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），席，再三金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），无我大慈三昧·断除憍慢执障，再三金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），摧碎魔军与我慢烦恼（末他），再三金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）
verses.meaningEn: Vajra + shatter! split open! Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt again and again, straw mat, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt again and again, selfless great loving-kindness & cutting rigid pride, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt again and again, churn and crush demonic hindrances! Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vjviddhu.htm（原典总行数：170 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1416）

verses.iast: aṭṭahāsanīlavajrasuvajrāya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 向大声笑声·绀青·金刚·勇健金刚杵，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Loud laughter + sapphire-blue + Vajra + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vjviddhu.htm（原典总行数：170 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1416）

verses.iast: om he fullu nirufullu nigṛhṇa kullu mili cullu kuru kullu vajravijayāya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！呼唤圣尊叹词（咄！圣者！），离一切相无相，离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢·离一切相无相，离名相假立·妙行趣入·因缘空寂大乐，造作离相·离一切相无相，契合本尊三昧、慈悲冥合（弥利），妙行迁变空·离一切相无相，祈请成办羯磨事业（俱噜），造作离相·离一切相无相，向金刚最胜尊胜，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O! Hail! Vocative invocation particle, freedom from conditioned marks (imperative seal), beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust & freedom from conditioned marks (imperative seal), beyond nominal designation & awakened spiritual movement & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks (imperative seal), intimate union with the deity samādhi, awakened conduct beyond flux & freedom from conditioned marks (imperative seal), accomplish & enact this sacred work! freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks (imperative seal), Vajra + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vjviddhu.htm（原典总行数：170 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1416）

verses.iast: om kilikīlāya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！向金刚橛威神警觉杵，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! vajra-kīla transfixing obstacles & awakening + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vjviddhu.htm（原典总行数：170 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1416）

verses.iast: om kaṭa kaṭa maṭa maṭa raṭa raṭa moṭana pramoṭanāya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三席，再三无我大慈三昧·断除憍慢执障，再三清净离诸尘垢·断除憍慢执障，摧碎，向转载摧碎，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! straw mat again and again, selfless great loving-kindness & cutting rigid pride again and again, stainless purity free from dust & cutting rigid pride again and again, crushing, breaking, strangling, forward + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vjviddhu.htm（原典总行数：170 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1416）

verses.iast: om cara nicara hara hara sara sara māraya vajravidāraṇāya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！行持妙道、周游救护（左啰），在于行持妙道，再三请摄取、遣除苦厄！再三流注周遍、速行护念（萨啰），祈请魔、天魔烦恼障，向金刚裂解，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! move forth in compassionate activity! in + move forth in compassionate activity! carry away (suffering)! remove! again and again, flow forth and pervade with blessing! again and again, may You Māra, demon, obstacle to awakening! Vajra + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vjviddhu.htm（原典总行数：170 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1416）

verses.iast: om chinda chinda bhinda bhinda mahākilikīlāya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三断除烦恼结使缠缚（嗔陀），再三劈破无明坚固执障（牝陀），向大金刚橛威神警觉杵，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! sever every fetter and hostile spell! again and again, cleave asunder stubborn ignorance! again and again, great + vajra-kīla transfixing obstacles & awakening + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vjviddhu.htm（原典总行数：170 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1416）

verses.iast: om bandha bandha krodha krodha vajrakilikīlāya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮），再三忿，向金刚金刚橛威神警觉杵，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! again and again, wrath again and again, Vajra + vajra-kīla transfixing obstacles & awakening + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vjviddhu.htm（原典总行数：170 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1416）

verses.iast: om curu curu caṇḍakilikīlāya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三速疾运转妙法加持（祖噜），向威猛金刚橛威神警觉杵，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! swiftly set sacred blessings in motion! again and again, fierce + vajra-kīla transfixing obstacles & awakening + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vjviddhu.htm（原典总行数：170 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1416）

verses.iast: om trāsaya trāsaya vajrakilikīlāya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·一切诸谛圆满，向金刚金刚橛威神警觉杵，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness again and again, Vajra + vajra-kīla transfixing obstacles & awakening + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vjviddhu.htm（原典总行数：170 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1416）

verses.iast: om hara hara vajradharāya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三请摄取、遣除苦厄！向金刚总持、执金刚尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! carry away (suffering)! remove! again and again, to/for Vajradhara, Holder of the Vajra, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vjviddhu.htm（原典总行数：170 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1416）

verses.iast: om prahara prahara vajraprabhañjanāya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三巡，向金刚风息，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! a watch a period of about hours again and again, Vajra + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vjviddhu.htm（原典总行数：170 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1416）

verses.iast: om matisthiravajra śrutisthiravajra pratisthiravajra mahāvajra apratihatavajra amoghavajra aihivajra śīghraṃ vajrāya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！慧·坚硬·金刚，闻·坚硬·金刚，对·坚硬·金刚，大金刚，无碍金刚，不空，因缘空寂大乐·最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜，快，向金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! intelligence + hard + Vajra, hearing + hard + Vajra, toward + hard + Vajra, great + Vajra, unobstructed + Vajra, Amoghavajra, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious, śīghraṃ, to/for Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vjviddhu.htm（原典总行数：170 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1416）

verses.iast: om dhara dhara dhiri dhiri dhuru dhuru sarvavajrakulamāvartāya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三请执持、总持护念！再三禅定坚固总持不失（地利），再三坚固任持总持法印（度噜），向一切·金刚·大地·不过·绕，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! hold! bear! sustain! again and again, steadfast meditative retention (dhṛti) again and again, firmly uphold the dhāraṇī seal! again and again, all + Vajra + earth + only + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vjviddhu.htm（原典总行数：170 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1416）

verses.iast: amukaṃ māraya phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 某甲，祈请魔、天魔烦恼障，泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: A certain person, may You Māra, demon, obstacle to awakening! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vjviddhu.htm（原典总行数：170 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1416）

verses.iast: om namaḥ samantavajrāṇām
verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！归命，普遍诸金刚之
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to universal + of Vajra
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vjviddhu.htm（原典总行数：170 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1416）

verses.iast: sarvabalamāvartaya mahābale kaṭabale tatale acale maṇḍalamaye ativajra mahābale vegaraṇa ajite jvala jvala
verses.meaningZh: 一切·跋蓝·祈请绕，大力威神、大势力尊尊，席力，彼严，不动明王、不动摇尊，曼荼罗极微，太金刚，大力威神、大势力尊尊，余力烦恼，无胜尊，再三炽燃光明、放光普照（入嚩攞）
verses.meaningEn: All + may You circumambulate! O of great power and might / in of great power and might, straw mat + O power, That, O Acala, Immovable Wisdom King / steadfast / in Acala, Immovable Wisdom King / steadfast, particle, very + Vajra, O of great power and might / in of great power and might, jerk + passion, O unsurpassed, blaze forth with wisdom radiance! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vjviddhu.htm（原典总行数：170 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1416）

verses.iast: tiṭi tiṭi ti ṅgale daha daha tejovati tili tili bandha bandha mahābale
verses.meaningZh: 再三真如实际·断除憍慢执障，多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·诸根清净自在），支分寂静·妙行趣入·离一切相无相，再三智火焚净一切罪垢（娜贺），具足威光尊，再三芝麻尊，再三结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮），大力威神、大势力尊尊
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & cutting rigid pride (vocative invocation) again and again, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — purified faculties, quiescence of perceptual limbs & awakened spiritual movement & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), incinerate all defilements with wisdom-fire! again and again, tejovati, O the sesamum plant or seed again and again, bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! again and again, O of great power and might / in of great power and might
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vjviddhu.htm（原典总行数：170 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1416）

verses.iast: vajrāṅkuśajvālāya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 向金刚面天焰光，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Vajrāṅkuśa + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vjviddhu.htm（原典总行数：170 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1416）

verses.iast: om namo ratnatrayāya
verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！归命，向佛法僧三宝
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to/for the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vjviddhu.htm（原典总行数：170 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1416）

verses.iast: namaścaṇḍavajrapāṇaye mahāyakṣasenāpataye
verses.meaningZh: 归命敬礼·离名相假立，向大药叉军主
verses.meaningEn: Bowing (reverent offering), mahāyakṣasenāpataye
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vjviddhu.htm（原典总行数：170 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1416）

verses.iast: tadyathā - om hara hara vajra matha matha vajra dhuna dhuna vajra
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！再三请摄取、遣除苦厄！金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），再三摧碎魔军与我慢烦恼（末他），金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），再三护摩献供·法界总持任持，金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! carry away (suffering)! remove! again and again, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, churn and crush demonic hindrances! again and again, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, offering oblation again and again, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vjviddhu.htm（原典总行数：170 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1416）

verses.iast: daha daha vajra paca paca vajra dhara dhara vajra dhāraya dhāraya vajra
verses.meaningZh: 再三智火焚净一切罪垢（娜贺），金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），再三成熟善根、烧尽业障（跛左），金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），再三请执持、总持护念！金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），再三方位，金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）
verses.meaningEn: Incinerate all defilements with wisdom-fire! again and again, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, ripen merit and burn away karmic obstructions! again and again, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, hold! bear! sustain! again and again, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, may You holding, bearing! again and again, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vjviddhu.htm（原典总行数：170 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1416）

verses.iast: dāruṇa dāruṇa vajra chinda chinda vajra bhinda bhinda vajra hūṃ phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 再三惨酷，金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），再三断除烦恼结使缠缚（嗔陀），金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），再三劈破无明坚固执障（牝陀），金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Hard, rough, harsh, cruel, severe again and again, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, sever every fetter and hostile spell! again and again, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, cleave asunder stubborn ignorance! again and again, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vjviddhu.htm（原典总行数：170 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1416）

verses.iast: om namaścaṇḍavajrakrodhāya
verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！归命敬礼·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! bowing (reverent offering)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vjviddhu.htm（原典总行数：170 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1416）

verses.iast: om hulu hulu tiṣṭha tiṣṭha bandha bandha hana hana amṛte hūṃ phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三威猛速疾摄护除灾（呼嚧），再三安住加持，再三结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮），再三击破怨魔与无明惑（贺曩），甘露、不死妙法尊，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! swiftly protect and sweep away calamity! again and again, abide steadfastly & bestow grace! again and again, bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! again and again, strike down afflictions and mara-forces! again and again, O ambrosia, nectar of immortality / in ambrosia, nectar of immortality, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vjviddhu.htm（原典总行数：170 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1416）

verses.iast: hṛdayopahṛdayamūlamantraḥ
verses.meaningZh: 心·下属·尾·真言
verses.meaningEn: Heart + subordinate + root + Mantra
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vjviddhu.htm（原典总行数：170 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1416）

verses.iast: sarvapāpakṣayaṃ kṛtvā sarvaduḥkhavināśanam
verses.meaningZh: 一切·罪业·尽，既作已、行持已，一切·苦·闢·摧灭
verses.meaningEn: All + evil + exhaustion, having done, having performed, all + suffering + settle + destroying
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vjviddhu.htm（原典总行数：170 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1416）

verses.iast: mūlaṃ tatsarvamantrāṇāṃ sarvaśrīsamalaṅkṛtam
verses.meaningZh: 尾，彼·一切·诸真言，吉祥庄严·一切诸谛圆满
verses.meaningEn: To (the neighborhood of), That + all + of Mantra, glorious
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vjviddhu.htm（原典总行数：170 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1416）

verses.iast: upaśāntendriyo bhūtvā naṣṭāśrayahatāyuṣaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 优波羶大根，昂已，离名相假立·六度满行清净·断除憍慢执障
verses.meaningEn: Upasanta + an organ, having arise, beyond nominal designation & perfection of the six pāramitās & cutting rigid pride
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vjviddhu.htm（原典总行数：170 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1416）

verses.iast: alakṣmyā pariviṣṭāśca devatāśca parāṅmukhāḥ
verses.meaningZh: 无以吉祥相，般诸蕴和及诸何为及诸尊颜、习习从中
verses.meaningEn: Non-with/by mark, sign, wisdom + entered and divinity, having the face turned backwards, averted, turned away
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vjviddhu.htm（原典总行数：170 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1416）

verses.iast: kāntā priyaviyoge ca duṣṭagraha upadrutaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 相亲，惜者离尊以及暴恶者曜执，愈加由经营
verses.meaningEn: Desired, loved, lovely, beautiful, dear + O separation and wicked + planet, thereto + from run
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vjviddhu.htm（原典总行数：170 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1416）

verses.iast: anyonyā vyasanameva ca
verses.meaningZh: 各个、不同，入唯以及
verses.meaningEn: Various, different, indeed and
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vjviddhu.htm（原典总行数：170 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1416）

verses.iast: grahanakṣatrapīḍā vā kākhordā dāruṇā grahāḥ
verses.meaningZh: 曜执·星宿·逼迫，或、抑或，压镇，坚硬、粗暴，诸曜执、星曜鬼神执障
verses.meaningEn: Planet + constellation + violation, or, an evil demon, hard, rough, harsh, cruel, severe, planet, seizing spirit/graha (plural)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vjviddhu.htm（原典总行数：170 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1416）

verses.iast: pāpakaṃ paśyate svapne śokāyāsasamucchritam
verses.meaningZh: 糟糕、恶障，了知、聪明，梦尊，热力·正勤·立
verses.meaningEn: Bad, evil, looking, knowing, intelligent, O sleep, dream / in sleep, dream, heat + effort
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vjviddhu.htm（原典总行数：170 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1416）

verses.iast: tacca susnātaśucinā śrotavyaṃ sūtramuttamam
verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·妙行迁变空，一切诸谛圆满·离名相假立·真如实际，本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，界线最上
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & awakened conduct beyond flux, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness, primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, highest
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vjviddhu.htm（原典总行数：170 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1416）

verses.iast: śṛṇvantu ye idaṃ sūtraṃ gambhīraṃ buddhagocaram
verses.meaningZh: 本性寂静止息·离诸诤论无诤·最上真言离言说，凡彼等诸有情，此、此法门，界线，甚深、深妙难测，佛陀行境
verses.meaningEn: Primordial tranquil peace & conflict-free peace & supreme ineffable speech (imperative seal), those who, whoever (pl.), this, here, sūtraṃ, profound, deep, unfathomable, Buddha + scope
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vjviddhu.htm（原典总行数：170 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1416）

verses.iast: prasannacittasumanāḥ śucivastrairalaṅkṛtāḥ
verses.meaningZh: 喜·心·善称音，本性寂静止息·妙行迁变空·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: Believing in + mind, primordial tranquil peace & awakened conduct beyond flux & supreme ineffable speech
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vjviddhu.htm（原典总行数：170 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1416）

verses.iast: te ca sarve ca duṣṭātmā upasargā sudāruṇāḥ
verses.meaningZh: 向汝、彼等以及一切、普皆遍满尊以及暴恶者我者，前置词，诸楚毒
verses.meaningEn: To Thee / they and O all, every, complete / in all, every, complete and wicked, addition , accident, ill luck, calamity, something terrible (plural)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vjviddhu.htm（原典总行数：170 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1416）

verses.iast: tejo 'sya ca praśāmyeta samastā sarvamāpnutā
verses.meaningZh: 威光，此尊之、此咒之以及转载·抗母·趣往，广收，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: Tejo, of this, his/its and forward + {{aiming at peae->aiming at peace|||AnnaRybakovaT + going, joined, composed, whole, entire, all, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vjviddhu.htm（原典总行数：170 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1416）

verses.iast: āyuśca barddhate puṇyaṃ sarvapāpairvimokṣitā
verses.meaningZh: 寿命、无量寿及解脱系缚大力·清净离诸尘垢·法界总持任持，福德、胜妙功德，究竟解脱·一切诸谛圆满
verses.meaningEn: Life-force, longevity and spiritual strength freeing bonds & stainless purity free from dust & Dharma-realm retention (vocative invocation), merit, auspicious virtue, emancipating
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vjviddhu.htm（原典总行数：170 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1416）

verses.iast: maṇisarṣapadūrvābhirratnākṣatasacandanaiḥ
verses.meaningZh: 以诸摩尼宝珠·白芥子·大王·融通·珍宝·不伤·彼·檀香
verses.meaningEn: Maṇi jewel + mustard or mustard-seed + of a king + to + jewel + unhurt + he + by
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vjviddhu.htm（原典总行数：170 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1416）

verses.iast: vajragranthitapuṣpaiśca jalāmāpūryakāñcanam
verses.meaningZh: 以诸金刚先结花及圆满充盈·归命敬礼·生起不可得·尊胜
verses.meaningEn: Vajra + enslaved + by and fulfilling, bowing
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vjviddhu.htm（原典总行数：170 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1416）

verses.iast: ghaṭaṃ tu rajataṃ cāpi śucivastreṇa vāsitam
verses.meaningZh: 瓶，然而、而、实则，呆子，持械宝弓尊，以清净布，喷香
verses.meaningEn: Jar, ewer, but, indeed, moreover, rajataṃ, O armed with a bow, flaming + by, perfumed, fragrant
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vjviddhu.htm（原典总行数：170 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1416）

verses.iast: ekaviṃśativāraṃ vā tathā cāṣṭottaraṃśatam
verses.meaningZh: 二十一人群，或、抑或，如是、亦复如是，妙行迁变空·六度满行清净·断除憍慢执障
verses.meaningEn: Twenty-one + crowd, or, thus, in that same way, awakened conduct beyond flux & perfection of the six pāramitās & cutting rigid pride
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vjviddhu.htm（原典总行数：170 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1416）

verses.iast: japedvidāraṇaṃ mantraṃ yaḥ snāyāt pārthivaḥ sadā
verses.meaningZh: 生起不可得·尊胜·第一义谛·施度调伏，真言，凡彼…者，以沐来，国王，恒常、一切时
verses.meaningEn: Transcending birth & victorious & ultimate truth & generosity & self-mastery, mantraṃ, whoever, he who, to wash + since, pārthivaḥ, always, evermore
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vjviddhu.htm（原典总行数：170 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1416）

verses.iast: evaṃ yaḥ kurute nityaṃ tasya sampadyate śubham
verses.meaningZh: 如是、如此，凡彼…者，大地梵音，常恒、永不间断，彼之、其（属格），随着造偈句，清净吉祥、善妙庄严
verses.meaningEn: Thus, in this way, whoever, he who, earth + O voice, constantly, eternally, his, of that, along with + way, auspicious, pure, bright, virtuous
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vjviddhu.htm（原典总行数：170 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1416）

verses.iast: idamavocad bhagavānāttamanāste ca bhikṣavaḥ sā ca sarvāvatī parṣat sadevamānuṣāsuragaruḍagandharvaśca loko bhagavato bhāṣitamabhyanandanniti
verses.meaningZh: 施度调伏·无我大慈三昧·最上真言离言说，世尊·愉悦·故乡以及希望鸿毛，彼、彼圣母（阴性主格）以及具足湖或，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·六度满行清净，彼·天人·人道·阿修罗·迦楼罗·音乐及世间、世界，以世尊此，宣说演畅·破有相福德光
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery & selfless great loving-kindness & supreme ineffable speech, the World-Honored One + glad at heart + O home and wish for + down, she, that and a lake + endowed with or, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & perfection of the six pāramitās, he + god + Human Realm + Asura + Garuḍa and world, realm, Bhagavān + hence, speaking (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vjviddhu.htm（原典总行数：170 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1416）

verses.iast: āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī samāptā
verses.meaningZh: 圣·金刚·裂解，名为、号曰，陀罗尼、总持（总一切法、持无量义），三磨钵耽
verses.meaningEn: Noble + Vajra + tearing or breaking asunder, by name, called, Dhāraṇī, total retention, protective spell, finished, complete, perfect
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vjviddhu.htm（原典总行数：170 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1416）

titleZh: 【梵本原典】佛說持世陀羅尼經 / 財源天母陀羅尼 (岩本裕校勘 GRETIL 梵本)
titleEnglish: Dhāraṇī of Bountiful Earth Goddess Vasudhārā (GRETIL vadhdhdu.htm)
translatorZh: 哥廷根大学 GRETIL / 尼泊尔 DSBC 梵文贝叶经校勘本 (Vasudharadharani)
sutraSourceZh: GRETIL 梵文佛典库 (vadhdhdu.htm) · 汉译对勘：T20n1162 / T20n1163
deityZh: 持世菩薩 / 財源天母 (Vasudhārā)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 本条目直接构建自德国哥廷根大学 GRETIL 梵语原典档案「vadhdhdu.htm」（共 149 行，完整提取核心真言与经句共 565 句）。系统已自动将其原始 IAST 梵文实时转写为天城文、唐代悉昙梵字、唐宋古汉语音译、现代梵音拼读参考、国际音标 (IPA) 及摩多轻重音律。
recitationTipsZh: 此为学术校勘梵文写本原貌，每一句均配备「梵音拼读参考」与「唐宋古汉语音译」平行对照，且每个音节胶囊内均同时展示梵文、古汉语与现代拼读。

verses.iast: Vasudhārādhāraṇīsūtra āryavasudhārādhāraṇīsūtra oṃ namo bhagavatyai āryaśrīvasudhārāyai
verses.meaningZh: 持世陀罗尼经，圣持世陀罗尼经，嗡！归命，向世尊佛母顶礼，吉祥庄严·总持任持·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Chi Shi Tuoluoni Jing, noble + Chi Shi Tuoluoni Jing, Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed Mother / Lady Bhagavatī, glorious, upholding (vocative invocation)
