verses.meaningEn: To be recited or praised + tower, womb + tower, O all, every, complete / in all, every, complete, not, non-, supreme ineffable speech & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & beyond conceptual fabrication (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: sarve ḍākinyo na viheṭhayanti
verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满尊，息灭诤怨·造作离相·离名相假立，不、非、无，最上真言离言说·因缘空寂大乐·远离虚妄安立
verses.meaningEn: O all, every, complete / in all, every, complete, pacifying conflict & turmoil & freedom from karmic agency & beyond nominal designation, not, non-, supreme ineffable speech & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & beyond conceptual fabrication (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: chāyā na viheṭhayanti
verses.meaningZh: 影，不、非、无，最上真言离言说·因缘空寂大乐·远离虚妄安立
verses.meaningEn: Shadow, not, non-, supreme ineffable speech & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & beyond conceptual fabrication (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: jātā na viheṭhayanti
verses.meaningZh: 部多、充满，不、非、无，最上真言离言说·因缘空寂大乐·远离虚妄安立
verses.meaningEn: Become characterized by, full of, not, non-, supreme ineffable speech & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & beyond conceptual fabrication (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: bhāvanāhārāḥ na viheṭhayanti
verses.meaningZh: 观想诸胸严，不、非、无，最上真言离言说·因缘空寂大乐·远离虚妄安立
verses.meaningEn: This is his + clump, not, non-, supreme ineffable speech & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & beyond conceptual fabrication (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: rūpāhārāḥ śabdāhārāḥ gandhāhārāḥ rasāhārāḥ sparśāhārāḥ āhutyāhārāḥ nānārūpāhārāḥ virūpāhārāḥ anantarūpāhārāḥ kāmarūpāhārāḥ vicitrarūpāhārāḥ balāhārāḥ
verses.meaningZh: 色诸楼阁，声诸楼阁，香诸楼阁，噜噜诸楼阁，诸触食，火供净施·因缘空寂大乐，分别·色·诸楼阁，微质怛囒诸楼阁，无边·色·诸楼阁，体相诸楼阁，斑驳陆离·色·诸楼阁，力诸楼阁
verses.meaningEn: Form + tower, sound + tower, smell + tower, roar + tower, touch-food (plural), sacred offering, differently + form + tower, many-coloured + tower, boundless + form + tower, a shape changing at will + tower, variegated + form + tower, power + tower
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: balyāhārāḥ aśucyāhārāḥ vicitrāhārāḥ yāvad ucchiṣṭāhārāḥ na viheṭhayanti
verses.meaningZh: 解脱系缚大力·离一切相无相·一乘如实之道，本性寂静止息·妙行迁变空·一乘如实之道，微质怛囒诸胸严，一乘如实之道·最上真言离言说·施度调伏，余剩诸楼阁，不、非、无，最上真言离言说·因缘空寂大乐·远离虚妄安立
verses.meaningEn: Spiritual strength freeing bonds & freedom from conditioned marks & supreme vehicle of awakening, primordial tranquil peace & awakened conduct beyond flux & supreme vehicle of awakening, many-coloured + clump, supreme vehicle of awakening & supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery, left + tower, not, non-, supreme ineffable speech & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & beyond conceptual fabrication (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: yāvat khecarāḥ bhūcarāḥ antarīkṣacarāḥ jalacarāḥ sthalacarāḥ sarve na viheṭhayanti
verses.meaningZh: 乃至，妙行流布·等虚空无碍，诸趣往、居住者大地，裏·模样·诸坚固，诸水上动物、捕捞，陆路诸行持妙道，一切、普皆遍满尊，不、非、无，最上真言离言说·因缘空寂大乐·远离虚妄安立
verses.meaningEn: How, practicing, going or living on the earth, interior + look + immovable, aquatic animal, fish (plural), raised or dry ground + move forth in compassionate activity! O all, every, complete / in all, every, complete, not, non-, supreme ineffable speech & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & beyond conceptual fabrication (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: eteṣāṃ mama sarvasattvānāṃ mahāvajreṇa mūrdhnisphālanāya sphoṭanāya praharaṇāya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ vajreṇa sarvaduṣṭān
verses.meaningZh: 长柄轴，我之（行者所有），诸一切众生、普皆有情之，以大金刚，顶首·犁铁·导师，向裂解，向器械，吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！以金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），一切暴恶者
verses.meaningEn: Stem + the pole of a carriage, my, of me (the practitioner), of all all sentient beings, great + by, head + plowshare + leader, to/for splitting, breaking, to/for striking, beating, fighting, war, battle, weapon, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ! by/through Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, all + wicked
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: sarvaśatrūn māraya māraya śoṣaya oṣaya stambhaya stambhaya bandhaya bandhaya hana hana daha
verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，再三魔、天魔烦恼障，祈请消渴，六度满行清净·一乘如实之道，再三请制止、令暴恶魔障止息不动！再三结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮），再三击破怨魔与无明惑（贺曩），智火焚净一切罪垢（娜贺）
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, may You Māra, demon, obstacle to awakening! again and again, may You drying up, parching, removing, destroying, perfection of the six pāramitās & supreme vehicle of awakening, immobilize! halt hostile forces! again and again, may You bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary!! again and again, strike down afflictions and mara-forces! again and again, incinerate all defilements with wisdom-fire!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: daha paca paca mara mara māraya māraya sarvaśatrūn nāśaya nāśaya hūṃ phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 智火焚净一切罪垢（娜贺），再三成熟善根、烧尽业障（跛左），再三临危、死厄，再三魔、天魔烦恼障，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，再三请除灭、遣散灾厄！吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Incinerate all defilements with wisdom-fire! ripen merit and burn away karmic obstructions! again and again, dying, death again and again, may You Māra, demon, obstacle to awakening! again and again, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, dispel! destroy! again and again, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: yasya ca kulaputra iyaṃ sā gṛhapate vasudhārā nāma dhāraṇī śrāddhasya kulaputrasya vā
verses.meaningZh: 凡彼…之以及善男子，此圣女、此陀罗尼，彼、彼圣母（阴性主格），婆罗房子，财源佛母（持世丰饶母），名为、号曰，陀罗尼、总持（总一切法、持无量义），真正信根、耳根软之，善男子之，或、抑或
verses.meaningEn: Whose, of whom and a good man, this (feminine), she, that, guardian of a house, Vasudhārā, Stream of Gems Goddess, by name, called, Dhāraṇī, total retention, protective spell, of believing, having true faith, of a good man, or
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: kuladuhitur vā hṛdayagatā gṛhagatā hastagatā pustakagatā śrutimātragatā paryavāptā manasā suparicintitā dhāritā vācitā
verses.meaningZh: 造作离相·离一切相无相·施度调伏，或、抑或，住房，执着不是揭帝，尊手双手，书去，闻·惟·去，愈加·麦·亲近，那罗、天女，报刊往外·般·分别，承，最上真言离言说·妙行迁变空·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks & generosity & self-mastery, or, dwelling in one's heart, grasping + not gone, being in the hand or in the hands of, book + understood, hearing + merely + understood, beyond + any grain or corn + got, of man, of a goddess, =, press out + wisdom + thought, supported, supreme ineffable speech & awakened conduct beyond flux & immutable Suchness
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: likhitā anumoditā parebhyaś ca vistareṇa saṃprakāśitā ca tad bhaviṣyati
verses.meaningZh: 写，离名相假立·无我大慈三昧·施度调伏，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·破有相福德光以及以广说，一切诸谛圆满·第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢以及彼、如是真实，当
verses.meaningEn: Write, beyond nominal designation & selfless great loving-kindness & generosity & self-mastery, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & blessedness transcending existence and by/through to explain, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust and that, thus, will be
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: tasya kulaputrasya vā kuladuhitur vā dīrgharātram arthāya hitāya sukhāya kṣemāya subhikṣāya yogasaṃbhārāya bhaviṣyati
verses.meaningZh: 彼之、其（属格），善男子之，或、抑或，造作离相·离一切相无相·施度调伏，或、抑或，长夜，向义利、所求善愿、胜义，向利，向乐，向安，向丰安，向修习资粮，当
verses.meaningEn: His, of that, of a good man, or, freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks & generosity & self-mastery, or, long dark night, to/for meaning, benefit, aim, welfare, to/for put, placed, laid, to/for easy, pleasant, comfortable, happy, to/for causing peace and comfort, to/for having or offering food enough, bond + to, will be
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: yaś cemāṃ vasudhārā nāma dhāraṇīṃ tathāgatebhyo 'rhadbhyaḥ samyaksaṃbuddhebhya udārāṃ pūjāṃ kṛtvā namaskṛtvā āvartayet
verses.meaningZh: 奢字门（本性寂静止息（śānti）·本不生体性），妙行迁变空·无我大慈三昧，财源佛母（持世丰饶母），名为、号曰，总持任持·法界总持任持，向诸如是度越吧，向诸活该服用，正等正觉富人，广大崇高、宏伟尊胜，供，既作已、行持已，顶礼敬拜已，最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Primordial tranquil peace (śānti) — primordial non-arising, awakened conduct beyond flux & selfless great loving-kindness, Vasudhārā, Stream of Gems Goddess, by name, called, upholding, thus + to, deserve + to, Perfectly and Completely Awakened Buddha + belonging to one's household, noble, exalted, vast, generous, to make an offering, having done, having performed, having paid homage/salutation, supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: sarvatathāgatānāṃ sarvaśrāvakapratyekabuddhānāṃ sarvabodhisattvānāṃ sarvatathāgatasarvamudrāmantravidyādevatānāṃ tebhyaḥ sarvapūjābhipūjayet
verses.meaningZh: 诸一切如来之，一切·舍罗婆迦·诸佛驮之，一切诸菩提萨埵之，一切如来·一切·手印·魔法功夫·诸何为之，向诸向汝、彼等，供养礼赞·一切诸谛圆满
verses.meaningEn: Of all all Tathagatas, all + sravaka + of all Buddha for himself alone, all + of all Bodhisattva, all Tathagatas + all + Mudrā + magic art + of all divinity, to/from to Thee / they, worshipping
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: ardharātre tricaturvārāṇi tasya devatā āttamanasthā pramuditaḥ prītisaumanasyajāto vācayet
verses.meaningZh: 半晚上，三·四·一切人群，彼之、其（属格），天神，愉悦架子，欢喜，最喜心中乐生，最上真言离言说·妙行迁变空·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Half + O night, three + four + crowd, his, of that, a god, glad at heart + stand, pramuditaḥ, prītisaumanasyajāto, supreme ineffable speech & awakened conduct beyond flux & supreme vehicle of awakening
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: tadā bhagavatyā vasudhārayā svayam evāgatya dhanadhānyahiraṇyavṛṣṭiṃ pātayiṣyanti
verses.meaningZh: 彼时，以世尊佛母！（呼格），以财源佛母（持世丰饶母），亲自、自性显现，唯·宝树宝山·那个，财·驮·他·金·一雨，第一义谛·真如实际·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: At that time, in that case, then, with/by O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī! with/by Vasudhārā, Stream of Gems Goddess, oneself, spontaneously, in person, indeed + tree or mountain + that, treasure + dha + other + gold + rain, ultimate truth & immutable Suchness & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: prītyā tathāgataśāsane prītyā buddhaprajñaptyā prītyā dharmaprajñaptyā prītyā saṃghaprajñaptyā prītyā sarvaśrāvakapratyekabuddhaprajñaptyā prītyā pañcakulāvasthitamudrāmantravidyādevatā prajñaptyā prītyā dharmabhāṇakasyāśayena
verses.meaningZh: 以欢喜，如来传，以欢喜，以佛陀假，以欢喜，以正法假，以欢喜，以圣僧伽假，以欢喜，以一切·舍罗婆迦·佛驮·假，以欢喜，五·部族·依止处·手印·魔法功夫·天神，以假，以欢喜，以正法·种类戏剧·谁·意乐
verses.meaningEn: With/by joy, Tathāgata + O chastising, with/by joy, Buddha + with, with/by joy, Dharma + with, with/by joy, Saṃgha + with, with/by joy, all + sravaka + Buddha for himself alone + with, with/by joy, five + buddha-family + standing + Mudrā + magic art + a god, with/by provisional, with/by joy, Dharma + a kind of drama + by
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: namo ratnatrayāya
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛法僧三宝！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: oṃ namo bhagavatyai āryavasudhārāyai
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，向世尊佛母顶礼，总持任持·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed Mother / Lady Bhagavatī, upholding (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: oṃ bhagavate śrīvajradharasāgaranirghoṣāya tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！向世尊（薄伽梵）致敬，向吉祥·金刚总持·大海·责任，如来·出·堪敬尊，向正等正觉、正遍知
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, auspiciousness + Vajradhara + ocean + to, Tathāgata + income, to/for Perfectly and Completely Awakened Buddha
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: oṃ namo bhagavate 'kṣobhyāya tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，向世尊（薄伽梵）致敬，向阿閦如来（不动如来），如来·出·堪敬尊，向正等正觉、正遍知
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, to/for Akṣobhya, Imperturbable Buddha, Tathāgata + income, to/for Perfectly and Completely Awakened Buddha
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: oṃ namaḥ sarvatathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，一切如来·出·堪敬尊，向正等正觉、正遍知
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to all Tathagatas + income, to/for Perfectly and Completely Awakened Buddha
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: namaḥ sarvatathāgatebhyo 'tītānāgatapratyutpannebhyaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切如来富人·一切过去末现在时！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all Tathagatas, belonging to one's household, gone away, future, present!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: namaḥ kṣemaṅkarasya tathāgatasya namo vajradharasāgaragambhīrasya tathāgatasya
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼能作成办·造作离相·如来（乘如实道来成正觉）·金刚总持·大海·甚深·如来（乘如实道来成正觉）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to making, Tathāgata, Thus-Come One, Vajradhara, ocean, of profound, Tathāgata, Thus-Come One!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: agrayugaprāptebhyo bhadrayugaprāptebhyo vipaśyādibhyaḥ śākyamunibhyo dānapāramitāparipūrṇebhyo bhagavadbhyaḥ vipaśyinas tejasā

verses.meaningZh: 施财，最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤，以及、亦复如是（ca + eva），印达罗，最上真言离言说·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际，再三如是、亦复如是，琴瑟，无我大慈三昧·离名相假立·妙行趣入，悉地、妙成就，认为愿悉此处，不已、从来，现生，一切、普皆遍满，乐趣喜，犹如如意，悉地成就·一切诸谛圆满，一切真言秘密章句于此
verses.meaningEn: Dhanado, supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace, and indeed, likewise, indro, supreme ineffable speech & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness, thus, in that same way again and again, lute, selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation & awakened spiritual movement, Siddhi, spiritual accomplishment/perfection, think + may they walk, continual, sadyaḥ, all, every, complete, pleasure + close by, just as + at will, perfected, sacred mantra words and phrases + here

verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'ḥ': primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release, Oṃ! O phlegm again and again, space-like boundlessness & cutting rigid pride (vocative invocation) again and again, space-like boundlessness & cutting rigid pride (imperative seal) again and again, coolness free of obscuration & awakened conduct beyond flux (imperative seal) again and again, swiftly dissolve karmic knots & obstacles!

verses.iast: kiṃ punaḥ śraddhyādhimuktikasya puruṣasya puruṣapramāṇaṃ mahābhogaṃ dadāti
verses.meaningZh: 迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·诸根清净自在·大空菩提点摄持），复次、再三，保管·怀念·铁杆利益之，补卢杀沙，士夫量，广大规模，施物
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — purified faculties sealed with bodhicitta bindu, again, furthermore, assure + think of + of having a zealous interest, puruṣasya, man, of great extent, gift
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: īpsitaṃ manorathaṃ paripūrayati
verses.meaningZh: 所愿，希望、贪欲，塡
verses.meaningEn: Wished, desired, wish, desire, fancy, fulfils
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: oṃ vajre vajre mahāvajre vajropame ṭake ṭhake hūṃ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）尊，大金刚尊，金刚郁多摩，断除憍慢执障·造作离相，远离虚妄安立·造作离相，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt / in Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt again and again, great + O Vajra, Vajra + O uppermost, cutting rigid pride & freedom from karmic agency (vocative invocation), beyond conceptual fabrication & freedom from karmic agency (vocative invocation), Hūṃ! Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: oṃ śriye śrīkari dhanakari dhānyakari ehi āgacchāgaccha brīṃ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！广大光华尊，吉祥大象尊，财大象尊，驮·他·大象尊，善来降临坛场（翳呬），唯愿降临赴会！唯愿降临赴会！啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·禅定三昧总持·大空菩提点摄持），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O with great magnificence / in with great magnificence, auspiciousness + O an elephant, treasure + O an elephant, dha + other + O an elephant, come forth, O Blessed One! come hither! approach! + come hither! approach! stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — deep samādhi retention sealed with bodhicitta bindu, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: oṃ śaṅkhanidhānāya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！向法螺藏，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! conch shell + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: oṃ padmanidhānāya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！向莲华藏，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! lotus flower + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: oṃ aṣṭau yakṣiṇī sarvapūjā hūṃ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！八，具药叉（夜叉护法捷疾神）佛母，一切供，吽（金刚心印）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! aṣṭau, goddess possessing Yakṣa, nature/wealth guardian spirit, all + to make an offering, Hūṃ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: oṃ yān yān sarvakāmaṃ iha kāmayati
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·远离寂静周遍），一切是的，于此、今于此处，希戒精进
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! beyond nominal designation (nāma) — expansive quiescence again and again, all + yes, here, in this world/place, wish + as many
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: tān tān sarvān īpsitān paripūrayati
verses.meaningZh: 再三彼等（宾格复数），一切、普皆遍满，所愿，塡
verses.meaningEn: Them, those again and again, all, every, complete, wished, desired, fulfils
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: siddhyantu mantrapadāni
verses.meaningZh: 愿诸真言章句悉皆成就，一切真言秘密章句

verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: tadyathā ḥ namo ratnatrayāya
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：悉昙「ḥ」韵字门：本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入，归命，向佛法僧三宝
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'ḥ': primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release, homage to to/for the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: oṃ namo devi dhanaduhite vasudhārāṃ pātaya pātaya dhaneśvari ratnadehe huru huru dhaneśvari

verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: ratnaṃ me dehi dadāpaya ratnasāgaramahānidhāne nidhānakoṭiśatasahasraparivāre ehy ehi bhagavati vasudhāre praviśya mama

verses.meaningEn: Ratnaṃ, to me, my, give! grant! bestow! cause to giving! jewel + ocean + great + O laying down, laying down + ten million + sgl + O accessory, come! approach! come forth, O Blessed One! O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī! O Vasudhārā, Stream of Gems Goddess / in Vasudhārā, Stream of Gems Goddess, forward + forming or belonging to a community, my, of me (the practitioner)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: puraṃ mama bhavanaṃ mahānidhānaṃ pātaya pātaya turu turu kuru kuru hūṃ phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 城邑，我之（行者所有），住埸，大藏，再三陨，再三迅疾度脱一切危厄（都噜），再三成办羯磨事业（俱噜），吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Before, my, of me (the practitioner), bhavanaṃ, great, may You fall! again and again, swiftly ferry across all perils! again and again, accomplish & enact this sacred work! again and again, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: kailāśanivāsini svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 造作离相·离一切相无相·本性寂静止息，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks & primordial tranquil peace (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: iyaṃ sā gṛhapati vasudhārānāma dhāraṇīmantrapadā

verses.meaningEn: This (feminine), she, that, householder, Vasudhārā + by name, Dhāraṇī + sacred mantra phrase
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.meaningEn: Of her, of this deity, of Dhāraṇī, total retention, protective spell, by/through might, majesty, superhuman strength, power over, disease + scarcity + epidemic + merciless, not, non-, they excelling
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: yas tu kulaputra imāni vasudhārānāma dhāraṇīmantrapadāni tathāgatānām arhatānāṃ samyaksaṃbuddhānāṃ pūjāṃ kṛtvā ṣaṇmāsān āvartayet
verses.meaningZh: 娑字门（一切诸谛圆满（sarvasatya）·本不生体性），然而、而、实则，善男子，一切本刹，财源佛母名为，陀罗尼一切真言秘密章句，诸如来（乘如实道来成正觉）之，诸应供、阿罗汉（破烦恼贼）之，诸正等正觉、正遍知之，供，既作已、行持已，六度满行清净·离诸诤论无诤·无我大慈三昧，最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness (satya) — primordial non-arising, but, indeed, moreover, a good man, this (plural), Vasudhārā + by name, Dhāraṇī + sacred mantra words and phrases, of all Tathāgata, Thus-Come One, of all Arhat, Worthy One, of all Perfectly and Completely Awakened Buddha, to make an offering, having done, having performed, perfection of the six pāramitās & conflict-free peace & selfless great loving-kindness, supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: tataḥ siddho bhavati
verses.meaningZh: 由伊人、本刹，成就者、已成就，成办、生起、安住
verses.meaningEn: From stem of he, she, it, accomplished, perfected adept (Siddha), becomes, arises, is

verses.iast: yasyāṃ diśi iyaṃ vidyā dhāryate sā dik pūjyamānā bhavati
verses.meaningZh: 凡彼…之，方位，此圣女、此陀罗尼，明咒、真言明妃、圣智明，决定、嚩卢枳谛，彼、彼圣母（阴性主格），迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·诸根清净自在），供养·狱王·自然，成办、生起、安住
verses.meaningEn: Whose, of whom, direction, this (feminine), Vidyā, sacred wisdom-spell, illumination, to be held, borne, worn, kept, turned, fixed, retained, upheld, supported, observed, she, that, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — purified faculties, reverence + holder + certainly, becomes, arises, is
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: yasmin sthāne pūjyate pauṣṭikārthaṃ svagṛhe vā paragṛhe vā śraddhayā paramaśraddhayā vasudhārā pratimāṃ
verses.meaningZh: 一乘如实之道·一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧，止尊，供养拘牵尊，布瑟置迦义利，自家尊，或、抑或，他人家尊，或、抑或，以信，以管保不是耳根软，财源佛母（持世丰饶母），创始人、称计
verses.meaningEn: Supreme vehicle of awakening & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness, O point, matter, subject, reverence + O held, prosperity-increasing rite + meaning, own + O a servant, or, someone else + O a servant, or, with/by trusting, faithful, assuredly + with, Vasudhārā, Stream of Gems Goddess, framer, creator

verses.iast: bhaṭṭārikāṃ vā paṭaṃ vā agrato 'nuprasārya candanena caturasraṃ maṇḍalakaṃ kṛtvā puṣpadhūpadīpagandhamālyavilepanacūrṇacīvaracchatradhavajaghaṇṭāpatākopaśobhite balinaivedyavividhopacārair
verses.meaningZh: 破有相福德光·断除憍慢执障·清净离诸尘垢，或、抑或，褐子，或、抑或，土地阵地、递送之前，离名相假立·第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢，以檀香，四方，规格，既作已、行持已，滋养增益·第一义谛，解脱系缚大力·离一切相无相·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Blessedness transcending existence & cutting rigid pride & stainless purity free from dust, or, cloth, or, place in front, send before, beyond nominal designation & ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust, by/through best of its kind, caturasraṃ, disease which destroys a family, having done, having performed, nourishing (vocative invocation), spiritual strength freeing bonds & freedom from conditioned marks & beyond nominal designation
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: yathāvibhavaṃ pūjāṃ kṛtvā dharmabhāṇakaś cāpi sugandhajalasnātaḥ sugandhāṅgaśucivastraṃ prāvṛtyamayūrāsenopari samupaviśya pratimāpaṭṭādikaṃ vā sthāpayitvā
verses.meaningZh: 犹如坏，供，既作已、行持已，持守摄受·法界总持任持，持械宝弓尊，好香·净水·由沐，好香·动着·龌浊·布，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，随着·愈加·那罗，创始人·绢疋·第一，或、抑或，虽是那么
verses.meaningEn: Just as + free from existence, to make an offering, having done, having performed, bearing, O armed with a bow, odour + water + from to wash, odour + move + impure, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation), along with + thereto + forming or belonging to a community, framer + city + first, or, putting aside
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: tam evānusmṛtya sūryodayavelāyāṃ paripūjayitvā pratyaham akhaṇḍasamādānato yāvad eva sakalāṃ rātriṃ dhāraṇīm avicchinnam
verses.meaningZh: 彼（宾格），唯·日复一日·忆持·那个，昇于时，般·供养·极微已，日常，等虚空无碍·离诸诤论无诤·息灭诤怨，一乘如实之道·最上真言离言说·施度调伏，唯、正是、决定，全部、圆满一切，宵，总持任持·法界总持任持，无间断
verses.meaningEn: Him, that, indeed + day after day + remember + that, sunrise + in time, wisdom + reverence + having or interrog, daily, space-like boundlessness & conflict-free peace & pacifying conflict & turmoil, supreme vehicle of awakening & supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery, indeed, verily, alone, entire, complete, all, night, upholding, non-torn asunder, severed, interrupted, destroyed, perished
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: āvartayet
verses.meaningZh: 最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: tasya krameṇa sarvasaṃpattir bhavati
verses.meaningZh: 彼之、其（属格），以次第，一切协定，成办、生起、安住
verses.meaningEn: His, of that, by/through step, course, method, way, all + agreement, becomes, arises, is
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: tataḥ prāktena pi divase niyamena rātrim atināmayitvā punaḥ pratyuṣe sugandhajalasnātaḥ śuciramalavastrāvṛto brahmacārī
verses.meaningZh: 由伊人、本刹，转载·晚上·勇健，跛字门（第一义谛（paramārtha）·诸根清净自在），日尊，以决定，宵，太·名·极微已，复次、再三，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，好香·净水·由沐，净·无垢·布·纒，融通、梵行学生佛母
verses.meaningEn: From stem of he, she, it, forward + night + strong, ultimate truth (paramārtha) — purified faculties, O heaven or day / in heaven or day, by/through = + limitation, restriction to, night, very + name + having or interrog, again, furthermore, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), odour + water + from to wash, stainless + cloth + covered, to
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: bhūtvā śubhe sthāne sanidānadhāraṇīm avicchinnam āvartayet trīṇi vārāṇi
verses.meaningZh: 昂已，融通，止尊，总持任持·一切诸谛圆满，无间断，最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，三，一切人群、海众
verses.meaningEn: Having arise, to, O point, matter, subject, upholding, non-torn asunder, severed, interrupted, destroyed, perished, supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, trīṇi, crowd, multitude
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: tataḥ kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā mahāpuruṣamātrayā vasudhārayā gṛhaṃ paripūrayanti

verses.meaningEn: To/for put, placed, laid, to/for easy, pleasant, comfortable, happy, to/for possession, enjoyment, carnal enjoyment, sexual union, to/for enjoyment, usufruct, use, to/for causing peace and comfort, awakened conduct beyond flux & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: ānanda āha ḥ udgṛhītā me bhagavann iyaṃ vasudhārānāmadhāraṇī dhāritā vācitā paryavāptā anumoditā manasā suparicintitā ca sādhu bhagavann iti
verses.meaningZh: 阿难，如是宣说、佛言，悉昙「ḥ」韵字门：本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入，施度调伏·妙行趣入·因缘空寂大乐，于我、为我，破有相福德光·妙行趣入·最上真言离言说，此圣女、此陀罗尼，财源佛母·名为·陀罗尼，承，最上真言离言说·妙行迁变空·真如实际，愈加·麦·亲近，离名相假立·无我大慈三昧·施度调伏，那罗、天女，报刊往外·般·分别以及萨，破有相福德光·妙行趣入·最上真言离言说，如是（结句印定）
verses.meaningEn: Servant, spoke, declared thus, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'ḥ': primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release, generosity & self-mastery & awakened spiritual movement & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, to me, my, blessedness transcending existence & awakened spiritual movement & supreme ineffable speech, this (feminine), Vasudhārā + by name + Dhāraṇī, supported, supreme ineffable speech & awakened conduct beyond flux & immutable Suchness, beyond + any grain or corn + got, beyond nominal designation & selfless great loving-kindness & generosity & self-mastery, of man, of a goddess, =, press out + wisdom + thought and sadhu, blessedness transcending existence & awakened spiritual movement & supreme ineffable speech, thus, so it is stated
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: atha khalv āyuṣmān ānanda utthāyāsanād ekāṃsam uttarāsaṃgaṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇajānumaṇḍalaṃ pṛthivyāṃ pratiṣṭhāpya yena
verses.meaningZh: 尔时、次复吉祥启白，嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk，具寿，阿难，真如实际·无住安立·一乘如实之道，一肩，郁多罗僧，既作已、行持已，右膝盖，那罗包扎，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，借由彼因缘
verses.meaningEn: Now, thereupon, auspiciously, supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — primordial non-arising, āyuṣmān, servant, immutable Suchness & non-abiding equipoise & supreme vehicle of awakening, one shoulder, monastic upper robe, having done, having performed, right + knee, of a man + wrap, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, by which, whereby
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: bhagavāṃs tenāñjaliṃ praṇamya kṛtakarapuṭo bhūtvā bhagavataḥ mukham avalokya yadīdānīṃ tasyāṃ velāyām imāṃ
verses.meaningZh: 星宿诸特，借由彼力合掌，恭敬稽首顶礼已，所作·掌·囊，昂已，世尊、薄伽梵（具六德圣尊），下额，鸿毛通常，设使如今，彼之、其（属格），于时，此（陀罗尼明妃，阴性宾格）
verses.meaningEn: Star + bull, by that truth + to join palms, having bowed down in reverence, done + palm + bag, having arise, Bhagavān, the Blessed/World-Honored One, mukham, down + granting free space or sphere of action, if + immediately, his, of that, in time, this (feminine accusative)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: gāthā abhāṣat
verses.meaningZh: 讽颂，宣说演畅·破有相福德光
verses.meaningEn: Gatha, speaking
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: acintayo dravyasamṛddhaye sadā anekaratnaṃ susamṛddhakāñcanam
verses.meaningZh: 妙行迁变空·离名相假立·真如实际，向实兴盛，恒常、一切时，多宝，好好儿圆满真金
verses.meaningEn: Awakened conduct beyond flux & beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness, property + to thriving, always, evermore, not one, thoroughly perfect + pure gold
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: āpūrṇam asmin gṛheṣu maṇḍalaṃ namo 'stu te śrīvasudhāraṇī sadā
verses.meaningZh: 内装、充分，于此之中，于诸家中，曼荼罗，归命，愿得成就、当如是，向汝、彼等，吉祥·财物·陀罗尼，恒常、一切时
verses.meaningEn: Filled with , full, in this, among/in a servant, maṇḍalaṃ, homage to may it be so, let it be! to Thee / they, auspiciousness + good + Dhāraṇī, always, evermore
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: acintayo bhagavān buddho buddhadharmo 'py acintayā
verses.meaningZh: 妙行迁变空·离名相假立·真如实际，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，觉者，佛法，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），以无愧
verses.meaningEn: Awakened conduct beyond flux & beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, buddho, Dharma, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, with/by thoughtlessness, disregard
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: acintayeti prasannānāṃ vipākaś cāpy acintayā
verses.meaningZh: 妙行迁变空·离名相假立·真如实际，诸喜，最上真言离言说·第一义谛·造作离相，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·远离寂静周遍），以无愧
verses.meaningEn: Awakened conduct beyond flux & beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), of all believing in, supreme ineffable speech & ultimate truth & freedom from karmic agency, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — expansive quiescence, with/by thoughtlessness, disregard
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: śāstā jānaya sarvajña dharmarājaparaṃparā
verses.meaningZh: 天人师，祈请了知、英明，一切智，法王历次
verses.meaningEn: Śāstā, may You knowing, wise, omniscient, Dharmaraja + following one another
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: pāragāmiphalaṃ prāpto buddhavīraṃ namo 'stu te
verses.meaningZh: 第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·妙行趣入，得，佛陀勇猛丈夫，归命，愿得成就、当如是，向汝、彼等
verses.meaningEn: Ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & awakened spiritual movement, prāpto, Buddha + heroic, homage to may it be so, let it be! to Thee / they
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: atha khalv āyuṣmān ānando imaṃ dharmaparyāyaṃ bhagavato 'ntikāt śrutvā hṛṣṭatuṣṭa udagra āttamanāḥ pramuditā prītisaumanasyajāto bhagavantam etad avocat
verses.meaningZh: 尔时、次复吉祥启白，嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk，具寿，普喜，此（真言，法门，以世尊此，从侧，听已，依止处满足喜，喜，如意，极喜地，最喜心中乐生，若衍底，此、此事，宣说、开示教敕
verses.meaningEn: Now, thereupon, auspiciously, supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — primordial non-arising, āyuṣmān, ānando, this (accusative), device, means of, Bhagavān + hence, from near, having to listen, standing on end + pleased, joyful, delighted, āttamanāḥ, pramuditā, prītisaumanasyajāto, victorious(-ly) passed beyond, this, spoke, proclaimed
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: ko nāmāyaṃ bhagavanta dharmaparyāyaḥ kathaṃ bhagavan dhārayāmy enaṃ dharmaparyāyam
verses.meaningZh: 迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·摄受法流灌顶），名出，世尊末，法门，如何，出有坏，总持任持·法界总持任持，离名相假立，法门
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — consecrating Dharma-stream, name + income, Bhagavān + end, dharmaparyāyaḥ, how? in what way? whence?, bhagavan, upholding, beyond nominal designation, device, means of
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: bhagavān āha ḥ sucandragṛhapatiparipṛcchety api ānanda dhāraya sarvadhanadhānyahiraṇyasuvarṇaratnanidhānam ity api dhāraya sarvatathāgatapraśastety
verses.meaningZh: 世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，如是宣说、佛言，悉昙「ḥ」韵字门：本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入，一切诸谛圆满·妙行迁变空·离名相假立，亦、虽、乃至，阿难，祈请方位，一切·财·驮·他·金·真金·珍宝·藏，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·诸根清净自在），亦、虽、乃至，祈请方位，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: The World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, spoke, declared thus, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'ḥ': primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & awakened conduct beyond flux & beyond nominal designation, even, also, servant, may You holding, bearing! all + treasure + dha + other + gold + gold + jewel, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — purified faculties, even, also, may You holding, bearing! all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: api dhāraya sarvatathāgatādhiṣṭhitā vasudhārādhāraṇīkalpam ity api dhāraya
verses.meaningZh: 亦、虽、乃至，祈请方位，一切如来所加持，雨宝陀罗尼经劫波，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·诸根清净自在），亦、虽、乃至，祈请方位
verses.meaningEn: Even, also, may You holding, bearing! all Tathagatas + blessed, Yu Bao Tuoluoni Jing + for a kalpa, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — purified faculties, even, also, may You holding, bearing!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: idam avocad bhagavān āttamanā āyuṣmān ānandas te ca bhikṣavas te ca bodhisattvā
verses.meaningZh: 此、此妙法，最上真言离言说·妙行迁变空·施度调伏，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，愉悦、伊人，具寿，离名相假立·施度调伏·一切诸谛圆满，向汝、彼等以及希望人情，向汝、彼等以及菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情）
verses.meaningEn: This, this sacred Dharma, supreme ineffable speech & awakened conduct beyond flux & generosity & self-mastery, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, glad at heart, delighted, āyuṣmān, beyond nominal designation & generosity & self-mastery & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, to Thee / they and wish for + favour, to Thee / they and Bodhisattva, Awakening Being
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: mahāsattvāḥ sā ca sarvāvatī parṣat sadevamānuṣāsuragaruḍagandharvaś ca loko bhagavato bhāṣitam abhyanandann iti
verses.meaningZh: 诸摩诃萨埵（大心有情、大菩萨），彼、彼圣母（阴性主格）以及具足湖或，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·六度满行清净，彼·天人·人道·阿修罗·迦楼罗·香·踊跃以及世间、世界，以世尊此，妙语、语言，破有相福德光·一乘如实之道·离名相假立，如是（结句印定）
verses.meaningEn: Mahāsattva, Great Spiritual Hero (plural), she, that and a lake + endowed with or, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & perfection of the six pāramitās, he + god + Human Realm + Asura + Garuḍa + be eager and world, realm, Bhagavān + hence, spoken, told, uttered, blessedness transcending existence & supreme vehicle of awakening & beyond nominal designation, thus, so it is stated
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: ārya śrīvasudhārānāmadhāraṇīparisūtra samāptā
verses.meaningZh: 圣、尊贵圣者，吉祥·财源佛母·名为·陀罗尼·般·契经，三磨钵耽
verses.meaningEn: Noble, holy, exalted (Ārya), auspiciousness + Vasudhārā + by name + Dhāraṇī + wisdom + discourse, finished, complete, perfect
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: ye dharmā hetuprabhavā hetuṃ teṣāṃ tathāgato hy avadat
verses.meaningZh: 凡彼等诸有情，正法、诸法实相，因生，因，彼等一切之，如来，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），最上真言离言说·施度调伏·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Those who, whoever (pl.), Dharma, cosmic truth/teaching/phenomena, cause + excelling, cause, of them, their, tathāgato, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery & immutable Suchness
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: teṣāṃ ca yo nirodha evaṃvādī mahāśramaṇaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 彼等一切之以及凡彼圣尊、能…者，灭谛，如是论者，大沙门
verses.meaningEn: Of them, their and who, whichever, suppression, thus + vādī, great
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：vadhdhdu.htm（原典总行数：149 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1162 / T20n1163）

verses.iast: namo bhagavate dhvajāgra rājāya tathāgatāya arhate samyak sambuddhāya tadyathā
verses.meaningZh: 归命向世尊（薄伽梵）致敬，顶部计都、规格，向王，向如来（乘如实道来成正觉），向应供（阿罗汉）致敬，权利、正确，向随着佛陀，即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Homage to to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, top of a banner, to/for king, to/for Tathāgata, Thus-Come One, to the Arhat, Worthy One, right, proper, along with + to, Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：dhvajkeu.htm（原典总行数：138 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1399）

verses.iast: jaya jaya vijaya vijaya jayavāhini-sam gari prabhañjani prabhañjani sarva śatruṇām jambhaya jambhaya
verses.meaningZh: 再三胜伏、最胜吉祥！再三最胜尊胜、普胜一切！尊胜降伏·生起不可得·尊胜，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），饮料、毒素尊，再三风息、暴雨尊，一切、普皆遍满，本性寂静止息·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢，再三请调伏、摧折憍慢魔障！
verses.meaningEn: Conquer! victory! again and again, supreme victory! triumph! again and again, conquering (vocative invocation), selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, O devouring, O wind, storm again and again, all, every, complete, primordial tranquil peace & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust, crush! quell jaws of hostility! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：dhvajkeu.htm（原典总行数：138 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1399）

verses.iast: stambhaya stambhaya mohaya mohaya bhagavati jayavāhini mātha mātha pra-mātha pra-mātha grasa grasa
verses.meaningZh: 再三请制止、令暴恶魔障止息不动！再三请令怨魔迷闷失其毒力！世尊佛母！（呼格），尊胜降伏·生起不可得·尊胜，再三消灭，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·本不生体性），消灭，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·本不生体性），消灭，再三妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢·一切诸谛圆满
verses.meaningEn: Immobilize! halt hostile forces! again and again, bewilder hostile forces! again and again, O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī! conquering (vocative invocation), destruction, annihilation again and again, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — primordial non-arising, destruction, annihilation, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — primordial non-arising, destruction, annihilation, awakened spiritual movement & stainless purity free from dust & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：dhvajkeu.htm（原典总行数：138 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1399）

verses.iast: hasa hasa huṃ huṃ lambodari trinetre caturmukhe caturvaktre catur daṃṣṭre catur bhuje
verses.meaningZh: 再三笑声，再三金刚怒王种子字（摧伏魔障），腹垂尊，三眼目，神明尊，四面目，四，牙尊，四，臂、千臂庄严尊
verses.meaningEn: Laughter, mirth again and again, vajra seed syllable Huṃ again and again, O having a large belly, three + O eye, O four faces, four + O meters, four, O large tooth, tusk, fang / in large tooth, tusk, fang, four, O arm, hand / in arm, hand
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：dhvajkeu.htm（原典总行数：138 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1399）

verses.iast: asi musala khaḍga triśūla vajra dhāraṇīrakṣa rakṣa mām
verses.meaningZh: 汝即是（当体即是），碓，智慧宝剑（断烦恼剑），三戟叉（破三毒戟），金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），陀罗尼眼目，拥护、守护，我（宾格：守护
verses.meaningEn: Thou art, pestle, mace, club, bell-clapper, sword (wisdom-blade), trident, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, Dhāraṇī + eye, protect, guard and shelter! me
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：dhvajkeu.htm（原典总行数：138 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1399）

verses.iast: bhagavati hana hana daha daha paca paca mātha mātha pramātha pramātha huṃ huṃ phaṭphaṭbhañja bhañja sarva śatrūṇām
verses.meaningZh: 世尊佛母！（呼格），再三击破怨魔与无明惑（贺曩），再三智火焚净一切罪垢（娜贺），再三成熟善根、烧尽业障（跛左），再三消灭，再三姦妇女、压倒性，再三金刚怒王种子字（摧伏魔障），顿断魔障·顿断魔障·摧碎破除一切魔障，摧碎破除一切魔障，一切、普皆遍满，本性寂静止息·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī! strike down afflictions and mara-forces! again and again, incinerate all defilements with wisdom-fire! again and again, ripen merit and burn away karmic obstructions! again and again, destruction, annihilation again and again, tearing, rape , overwhelming, destruction again and again, vajra seed syllable Huṃ again and again, shatter obstacles and ignorance! + shatter obstacles and ignorance! + shatter and break all obstacles! shatter and break all obstacles! all, every, complete, primordial tranquil peace & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：dhvajkeu.htm（原典总行数：138 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1399）

verses.iast: dhvajāgra keyure tisṭhat tisṭhat triṭa ulkā dhāraṇi trailokyanātha vidhvaṃśaya para sainya rakṣa
verses.meaningZh: 顶部计都、规格，造作离相·一乘如实之道·清净离诸尘垢，再三真如实际·一切诸谛圆满·远离虚妄安立，真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·断除憍慢执障，炬，陀罗尼、总持（总一切法、持无量义）尊，三界依，服务天神祈请笛，他人，多，拥护、守护
verses.meaningEn: Top of a banner, freedom from karmic agency & supreme vehicle of awakening & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & beyond conceptual fabrication again and again, immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & cutting rigid pride, meteor, firebrand, flame, O Dhāraṇī, total retention, protective spell, the Three Worlds + refuge, serve a god + may You tradition, someone else, relating to an army, protect, guard and shelter!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：dhvajkeu.htm（原典总行数：138 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1399）

verses.iast: rakṣa māṃ cala cala cili cili culu culu kala kala kili kili
verses.meaningZh: 拥护、守护于我，再三震动警觉、破除昏沉（左攞），再三积集一切白净善法功德（唧哩），再三鼓动法水涤除罪垢（主嚧），再三尊手，再三金刚橛威神警觉、摧伏魔军（吉栗）
verses.meaningEn: Protect, guard and shelter me, stir awake and shake off delusion! again and again, gathering pure Dharmic merits & radiance again and again, stir the purifying waters of compassion! again and again, hand again and again, vajra-kīla transfixing obstacles & awakening again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：dhvajkeu.htm（原典总行数：138 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1399）

verses.iast: kulu kulu muncaṭṭa hāsaya vidhvaṃśaya parasainya bhramaya
verses.meaningZh: 再三造作离相·离一切相无相，无我大慈三昧·离名相假立·妙行迁变空，祈请笑声、欢喜，服务天神祈请笛，他人多，祈请头旋
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks (imperative seal) again and again, selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation & awakened conduct beyond flux, may You laughing, laughter, mirth, joy, derision! serve a god + may You tradition, someone else + relating to an army, may You spring
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：dhvajkeu.htm（原典总行数：138 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1399）

verses.iast: buddha satyena dharma satyena saṃgha satyena satya vādināṃ satyena buddha satyāmatikrama dharma
verses.meaningZh: 佛陀、觉者，以谛、真实不虚语，正法、诸法实相，以谛、真实不虚语，圣僧伽、清净海众，以谛、真实不虚语，谛、真实不虚语，最上真言离言说·施度调伏·离名相假立，以谛、真实不虚语，佛陀、觉者，参半·趣往·趣往以上，正法、诸法实相
verses.meaningEn: Buddha, the Awakened One, by/through truth, reality, veracity, Dharma, cosmic truth/teaching/phenomena, by/through truth, reality, veracity, Saṃgha, noble spiritual community, by/through truth, reality, veracity, truth, reality, veracity, supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery & beyond nominal designation, by/through truth, reality, veracity, Buddha, the Awakened One, equally + going + going over, Dharma, cosmic truth/teaching/phenomena
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：dhvajkeu.htm（原典总行数：138 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1399）

verses.iast: satyāṃ atikrama saṃgha satyāṃ atikrama satya vādinaṃ satyamatikrama
verses.meaningZh: 谛、真实不虚语，趣往以上、易逝，圣僧伽、清净海众，谛、真实不虚语，趣往以上、易逝，谛、真实不虚语，最上真言离言说·施度调伏·离名相假立，参半·摄伏·趣往以上
verses.meaningEn: Truth, reality, veracity, going over, passing, Saṃgha, noble spiritual community, truth, reality, veracity, going over, passing, truth, reality, veracity, supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery & beyond nominal designation, equally + hold + going over
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：dhvajkeu.htm（原典总行数：138 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1399）

verses.iast: lambodare kuṭṭa kuṭṭa kuṭṭya kuṭṭya rudra mānaya biṣṇu mānaya candra sūrya mānaya
verses.meaningZh: 腹垂尊，再三摧碎，再三造作离相·断除憍慢执障·一乘如实之道，紧恶，祈请慢，解脱系缚大力·六度满行清净·离诸诤论无诤，祈请慢，月轮、清凉满月，日轮、太阳光明，祈请慢
verses.meaningEn: O having a large belly, sqashing, stamping, crushing, hammering again and again, freedom from karmic agency & cutting rigid pride & supreme vehicle of awakening again and again, of gods, may You opinion, conception, spiritual strength freeing bonds & perfection of the six pāramitās & conflict-free peace (imperative seal), may You opinion, conception, moon, lunar disc, sun, solar orb, may You opinion, conception
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：dhvajkeu.htm（原典总行数：138 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1399）

verses.iast: trailokya adhipatya mānaya sarva devo mānaya sarva yakṣa rākṣasa gandharva kinnara mahoraga
verses.meaningZh: 三界、三千世界，自在主那个，祈请慢，一切、普皆遍满，天，祈请慢，一切、普皆遍满，药叉（夜叉护法捷疾神），罗刹（暴恶鬼神），乾闼婆（香音神），紧那罗（歌神），摩睺罗伽（大蟒神）
verses.meaningEn: The Three Worlds (Trailokya), lord + that, may You opinion, conception, all, every, complete, devo, may You opinion, conception, all, every, complete, Yakṣa, nature/wealth guardian spirit, Rākṣasa, fierce spirit/demon, Gandharva, celestial musician, Kinnara, celestial song-spirit, Mahoraga, great serpent spirit
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：dhvajkeu.htm（原典总行数：138 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1399）

verses.iast: mānaya vidhvamsaya mama sarva śatru vaḥ rangha rangha ranghāpaya ranghāpaya jvala jvala
verses.meaningZh: 祈请慢，最上真言离言说·法界总持任持·无我大慈三昧，我之（行者所有），一切、普皆遍满，怨敌、仇害违缘，嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk，再三喜滋滋想必，再三喜滋滋祈请令想必，再三炽燃光明、放光普照（入嚩攞）
verses.meaningEn: May You opinion, conception, supreme ineffable speech & Dharma-realm retention & selfless great loving-kindness, my, of me (the practitioner), all, every, complete, enemy, adversary, hostile force, supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release, be pleased + surely again and again, be pleased + cause to surely again and again, blaze forth with wisdom radiance! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：dhvajkeu.htm（原典总行数：138 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1399）

verses.iast: puṣpa mālini liḍhi liḍhi triṭa triṭa bhṛkuti mukhaḥ parasainya kurucchedana karaṇha ha
verses.meaningZh: 花，无我大慈三昧·离一切相无相·离名相假立，再三离一切相无相·法鼓觉悟，再三真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·断除憍慢执障，毘倶胝尊，面门、尊颜、法门入口，他人多，祈请成办羯磨事业除断，能作成办·造作离相，贺字门（因缘空寂大乐（hetu
verses.meaningEn: Flower, selfless great loving-kindness & freedom from conditioned marks & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), freedom from conditioned marks & awakening Dharma-drum resonance (vocative invocation) again and again, immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & cutting rigid pride again and again, O Bhrkuti, face, mouth, gateway/door, someone else + relating to an army, accomplish & enact this sacred work! + removing, making, causal emptiness & spiritual joy (hetu) — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：dhvajkeu.htm（原典总行数：138 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1399）

verses.iast: hi hi hu hu he he riṇi riṇi riṇā māte jayantu dhvaje
verses.meaningZh: 再三诚然、因为、实乃，再三贺字门（因缘空寂大乐（hetu，再三呼唤圣尊叹词（咄！圣者！），再三清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤，清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤，母尊，愿悉胜伏、最胜吉祥！宝幢、胜幡尊
verses.meaningEn: For, indeed, surely again and again, causal emptiness & spiritual joy (hetu) — dispelling sorrow again and again, O! Hail! Vocative invocation particle again and again, stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace (vocative invocation) again and again, stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace, māte, may they conquer! victory!! O victory banner, standard / in victory banner, standard
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：dhvajkeu.htm（原典总行数：138 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1399）

verses.iast: buddhāvalokite rakṣa rakṣa mama bhagavatāvalokite svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 佛陀观照，再三拥护、守护，我之（行者所有），才·鸣呼·观照，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Buddha + O beheld, protect, guard and shelter! again and again, my, of me (the practitioner), excellence + O beheld, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：dhvajkeu.htm（原典总行数：138 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1399）

verses.iast: guṇa rāja prabhāse svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 功德、殊胜妙德，王，神明男人尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Virtue, excellence, auspicious quality, king, O of gods men, also of a celebrated place of pilgrimage / in of gods men, also of a celebrated place of pilgrimage, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：dhvajkeu.htm（原典总行数：138 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1399）

verses.iast: suryārka vimale svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 日阿罗歌花，毘磨利，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Arka flowers, pure, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：dhvajkeu.htm（原典总行数：138 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1399）

verses.iast: sarva graha nakṣatra dā me karaṇa svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，曜执、星曜鬼神执障，星宿（二十八宿），陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，于我、为我，时间，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, planet, seizing spirit/graha, constellation, lunar mansion, generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — expansive quiescence, to me, my, active, clever, skilled, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：dhvajkeu.htm（原典总行数：138 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1399）

titleZh: 【梵本原典】大聖歡喜雙身毘那夜迦天心陀羅尼 (岩本裕 & Klaus Wille 校勘 GRETIL 梵本)

verses.iast: evaṃ mayā śrutam ekasmin samaye bhagavān rājagṛhe viharati sma / gṛdhrakūṭaparvate mahatā
verses.meaningZh: 如是、如此，由我（具格：如是我闻），闻，一时，向平，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，王舍城尊，一切，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），灵鹫山尊，广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧
verses.meaningEn: Thus, in this way, by me, heard, at one time, to equal, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, O a king's house, palace, lives, dwells, spends oneʼs time, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, gṛdhrakūṭaparvate, great
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：ganphrdu.htm（原典总行数：140 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1270）

verses.iast: bhikṣusaṃghena sārdham ardhatrayodaśabhir bhikṣuśataiḥ saṃbahulaiś ca bodhisatvair mahāsatvaiḥ / tena khalu punaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 以比丘圣僧伽，俱，半·十三·融通，以诸比丘百，一切诸谛圆满·解脱系缚大力·因缘空寂大乐以及菩提·参半·极微，以诸摩诃萨埵（大心有情、大菩萨），借由彼力、以是因缘，诚然、确实，复次、再三
verses.meaningEn: Beggar + by, together, half + thirteen + to, beggar + by, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & spiritual strength freeing bonds & causal emptiness & spiritual joy and Bodhi + equally + particle emphasizing the preceding word or merely expletive, by/with Mahāsattva, Great Spiritual Hero, by that truth, thereby, through that power, indeed, verily, certainly, again, furthermore
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：ganphrdu.htm（原典总行数：140 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1270）

verses.iast: samayena bhagavān āyuṣmantam ānandam āmantrayate sma
verses.meaningZh: 以三昧耶（本誓、平等契合、时际），世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，寿命活力、健康，阿难，妙意三重，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: By/through Samaya, sacred vow, pledge, union, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, having life or vitality, healthy, long-lived, old, lasting, servant, benevolent + triple, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：ganphrdu.htm（原典总行数：140 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1270）

verses.iast: yaḥ kaścit kulaputra ānanda imāni gaṇapatihṛdayāni dhārayiṣyati vācayiṣyati paryavāpsyati pravartayiṣyati tasya sarvāṇi kāryasiddhāni bhaviṣyanti
verses.meaningZh: 凡彼…者，任何一人、或有众生，善男子，阿难，一切本刹，誐那鉢底一切心，总持任持·法界总持任持，最上真言离言说·妙行迁变空·一乘如实之道，愈加·麦·顶门尊颜·戒精进，转起妙法·第一义谛，彼之、其（属格），一切一切、普皆遍满，果一切成就者，诸尊未来世、当头
verses.meaningEn: Whoever, he who, anyone, someone, a good man, servant, this (plural), Ganapati + heart, upholding (vocative invocation), supreme ineffable speech & awakened conduct beyond flux & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation), beyond + any grain or corn + forehead or face + as many, turning forth (vocative invocation), his, of that, all, every, complete (plural), to be done + accomplished, they future, imminent
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：ganphrdu.htm（原典总行数：140 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1270）

verses.iast: oṃ namo 'stu te mahāgaṇapataye svāhā / oṃ gaḥ gaḥ gaḥ gaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，愿得成就、当如是，向汝、彼等，向大誐那鉢底，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！嗡！再三誐字门（妙行趣入（gati）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to may it be so, let it be! to Thee / they, great + to Ganapati, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Oṃ! awakened spiritual movement (gati) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：ganphrdu.htm（原典总行数：140 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1270）

verses.iast: gaḥ gaḥ gaḥ gaḥ / oṃ namo gaṇapataye svāhā / oṃ gaṇādhipataye
verses.meaningZh: 再三誐字门（妙行趣入（gati）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入），嗡！归命，向誐那鉢底，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！嗡！向海会众控制器
verses.meaningEn: Awakened spiritual movement (gati) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release again and again, Oṃ! homage to to Ganapati, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Oṃ! assembly + to controller
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：ganphrdu.htm（原典总行数：140 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1270）

verses.iast: svāhā / oṃ gaṇeśvarāya svāhā / oṃ gaṇapatipūjitāya svāhā / oṃ kaṭa
verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！嗡！向海会众自在主，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！嗡！向誐那鉢底所恭敬，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！嗡！席
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Oṃ! assembly + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Oṃ! Ganapati + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Oṃ! straw mat
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：ganphrdu.htm（原典总行数：140 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1270）

verses.iast: kaṭa maṭa maṭa dara dara vidara vidara hana hana gṛhṇa gṛhṇa dhāva
verses.meaningZh: 席，再三无我大慈三昧·断除憍慢执障，再三揭幕、一些，再三闢揭幕，再三击破怨魔与无明惑（贺曩），再三妙行趣入·因缘空寂大乐·离诸诤论无诤，濯
verses.meaningEn: Straw mat, selfless great loving-kindness & cutting rigid pride again and again, cleaving, rending, opening again and again, settle + cleaving again and again, strike down afflictions and mara-forces! again and again, awakened spiritual movement & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & conflict-free peace again and again, wash
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：ganphrdu.htm（原典总行数：140 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1270）

verses.iast: dhāva bhañja bhañja jambha jambha tambha tambha stambha stambha moha moha deha
verses.meaningZh: 濯，再三摧碎破除一切魔障，再三齿相、獠牙，再三彼星宿，再三柱，再三愚痴、无明迷妄，身
verses.meaningEn: Wash, shatter and break all obstacles! again and again, tooth, tusk, the jaws, mouth again and again, him + star again and again, post, column, prop, support again and again, delusion, ignorance, bewilderment again and again, body, person,
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：ganphrdu.htm（原典总行数：140 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1270）

verses.iast: deha dadāpaya dadāpaya dhanasiddhi me prayaccha / oṃ rudrāvatārāya svāhā / oṃ
verses.meaningZh: 身，再三令施予，起步不成尊，于我、为我，乐趣喜，嗡！向紧恶入，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！嗡！
verses.meaningEn: Body, person,, cause to giving! again and again, set in motion, to me, my, pleasure + close by, Oṃ! of gods + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Oṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：ganphrdu.htm（原典总行数：140 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1270）

verses.iast: adbhutavindukṣubhitacittamahāhāsam āgacchati / mahābhayamahābalaparākramāya mahāhastidakṣiṇāya dadāpaya svāhā / oṃ namo 'stu te
verses.meaningZh: 希·了知·乱动·心·大·笑声，来，向广大大力威神勇调伏镇被处，向酒席·如是宣说·隶圉·右，祈请令施予，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！嗡！归命，愿得成就、当如是，向汝、彼等
verses.meaningEn: Extraordinary + knowing + shake + mind + great + laughing, is recorded, is handed down by tradition, great danger or dread + of great power and might + to, feast + spoke + servants + to, cause to giving! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Oṃ! homage to may it be so, let it be! to Thee / they
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：ganphrdu.htm（原典总行数：140 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1270）

verses.iast: mahāgaṇapataye svāhā / oṃ gaḥ gaḥ gaḥ gaḥ gaḥ gaḥ gaḥ gaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 向大誐那鉢底，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！嗡！再三誐字门（妙行趣入（gati）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）
verses.meaningEn: Great + to Ganapati, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Oṃ! awakened spiritual movement (gati) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：ganphrdu.htm（原典总行数：140 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1270）

verses.iast: / oṃ namo gaṇapataye svāhā / oṃ gaṇeśvarāya svāhā / oṃ gaṇādhipataye
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，向誐那鉢底，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！嗡！向海会众自在主，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！嗡！向海会众控制器
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to Ganapati, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Oṃ! assembly + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Oṃ! assembly + to controller
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：ganphrdu.htm（原典总行数：140 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1270）

verses.iast: svāhā / oṃ gaṇapatipūjitāya svāha / oṃ suru suru svāhā / oṃ
verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！嗡！向誐那鉢底所恭敬，自如是宣说，嗡！再三甘露妙流普润群生（素噜），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！嗡！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Oṃ! Ganapati + to, own + spoke, Oṃ! stream forth auspicious ambrosia! again and again, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Oṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：ganphrdu.htm（原典总行数：140 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1270）

verses.iast: turu turu svāhā / oṃ muru muru svāhā / idam ānanda gaṇapatihṛdayāni
verses.meaningZh: 再三迅疾度脱一切危厄（都噜），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！嗡！再三速疾摧碎烦恼结缚（亩噜），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！此、此妙法，阿难，誐那鉢底一切心
verses.meaningEn: Swiftly ferry across all perils! again and again, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Oṃ! swiftly dissolve karmic knots & obstacles! again and again, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! this, this sacred Dharma, servant, Ganapati + heart
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：ganphrdu.htm（原典总行数：140 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1270）

verses.iast: yaḥ kaścit kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā bhikṣur vā bhikṣuṇī vā upāsako vā
verses.meaningZh: 凡彼…者，任何一人、或有众生，善男子，或、抑或，善女人，或、抑或，比丘，或、抑或，比丘尼，或、抑或，近事男，或、抑或
verses.meaningEn: Whoever, he who, anyone, someone, a good man, or, a good woman, or, bhikṣur, or, nun, or, upāsako, or
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：ganphrdu.htm（原典总行数：140 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1270）

verses.iast: upāsikā vā / yaḥ kaścit kāryam ālabhate mantrasādhanaṃ vā triratnapūjaṃ vā deśāntaragamanaṃ
verses.meaningZh: 近事女，或、抑或，凡彼…者，任何一人、或有众生，果，向衍伸星宿汝，真言修习，或、抑或，三·珍宝·供养，或、抑或，行脚海外
verses.meaningEn: A female lay Buddhist, or, whoever, he who, anyone, someone, kāryam, spawn + star + to Thee, Mantra, or, three + jewel + reverence, or, a travelling abroad
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：ganphrdu.htm（原典总行数：140 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1270）

verses.iast: vā rājakulagamanaṃ vā antardhānaṃ vā tena buddhabhagavatāṃ pūjāṃ kṛtvā āryagaṇapatihṛdayaṃ saptavārānucārayitavyaṃ sarvakāryāṇi
verses.meaningZh: 或、抑或，王宫行，或、抑或，灭，或、抑或，借由彼力、以是因缘，佛陀·才·鸣呼，供，既作已、行持已，圣·誐那鉢底·心，一切诸谛圆满·第一义谛·真如实际，一切一切果
verses.meaningEn: Or, a king's or a royal family, or, antardhānaṃ, or, by that truth, thereby, through that power, Buddha + excellence, to make an offering, having done, having performed, noble + Ganapati, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & ultimate truth & immutable Suchness, all + to be done
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：ganphrdu.htm（原典总行数：140 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1270）

verses.iast: tasya sidhyante nātra śaṃsayaḥ / sarvakalikalahamardamātsareṣu nityaṃ śamatavyaṃ sarvapraśamaṃ gacchati / dinedine
verses.meaningZh: 彼之、其（属格），向驱除假定今日汝，离名相假立·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢，庄严言辞凡彼…者，于诸一切·罪垢·鬪·调伏摧碾一切恶障·勿·爬行中，常恒、永不间断，息勇健，一切轻安，行，施度调伏·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: His, of that, drive off + suppose now + to Thee, beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust, solemn utterance + whoever, all + sin + fight + subdue and pulverize all evil forces! + do not + among, constantly, eternally, rest + strong, all + calmness, exists, carries on, generosity & self-mastery & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：ganphrdu.htm（原典总行数：140 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1270）

verses.iast: kalpam utthāya sarvasaptavārānucārayitavyaṃ mahāsaubhāge bhaviṣyati / rājakulagamanakāle mahāprāsādo bhaviṣyanti / śrutidharo bhaviṣyati
verses.meaningZh: 劫波，立起，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，酒席·那个·分尊，当，王宫·行·时尊，大房，诸尊未来世、当头，闻请执持，当
verses.meaningEn: For a kalpa, = for a long time, utthāya, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, feast + yonder + O part, will be, a king's or a royal family + going + O black, great, they future, imminent, hearing + hold! bear! sustain! will be
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：ganphrdu.htm（原典总行数：140 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1270）

verses.iast: / na cāsya kāye mahāvyādhayo bhaviṣyanti / na kaścid eva tārapradakṣiṇo 'vatāraṃ
verses.meaningZh: 不、非、无，妙行迁变空·一切诸谛圆满·一乘如实之道，身、佛身法身尊，大·猎人·凡彼圣尊，诸尊未来世、当头，不、非、无，造作离相·本性寂静止息·妙行迁变空，唯、正是、决定，星右遶，入
verses.meaningEn: Not, non-, awakened conduct beyond flux & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme vehicle of awakening, O body, kāya (sacred dimension) / in body, kāya (sacred dimension), great + hunter + who, they future, imminent, not, non-, freedom from karmic agency & primordial tranquil peace & awakened conduct beyond flux, indeed, verily, alone, a star + moving to the right, descent, appearance
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：ganphrdu.htm（原典总行数：140 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1270）

verses.iast: lapsyate bhṛṅgo 'vatāraṃ lapsyati na cāsya bodhicittottarāyā bhaviṣyanti / jātau jātau jātismaro
verses.meaningZh: 离一切相无相·第一义谛·一切诸谛圆满，破有相福德光·支分寂静·妙行趣入，入，离一切相无相·第一义谛·一切诸谛圆满，不、非、无，妙行迁变空·一切诸谛圆满·一乘如实之道，菩提心·无上·即是，诸尊未来世、当头，再三生起不可得·尊胜·真如实际，生祈请忆念本誓
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from conditioned marks & ultimate truth & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (vocative invocation), blessedness transcending existence & quiescence of perceptual limbs & awakened spiritual movement, descent, appearance, freedom from conditioned marks & ultimate truth & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (vocative invocation), not, non-, awakened conduct beyond flux & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme vehicle of awakening, aspiration to enlightenment + upper + thus, they future, imminent, transcending birth & victorious & immutable Suchness (imperative seal) again and again, kind + remember Your primordial vow!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：ganphrdu.htm（原典总行数：140 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1270）

verses.iast: bhaviṣyati
verses.meaningZh: 当
verses.meaningEn: Will be
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：ganphrdu.htm（原典总行数：140 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1270）

verses.iast: idam avocat bhagavān āttamanās te ca bhikṣavas te bodhisatvā mahāsatvāḥ sā ca
verses.meaningZh: 此、此妙法，宣说、开示教敕，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，真如实际·无我大慈三昧·离名相假立，向汝、彼等以及希望人情，向汝、彼等，菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情），诸摩诃萨埵（大心有情、大菩萨），彼、彼圣母（阴性主格）以及
verses.meaningEn: This, this sacred Dharma, spoke, proclaimed, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, immutable Suchness & selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation, to Thee / they and wish for + favour, to Thee / they, Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, Mahāsattva, Great Spiritual Hero (plural), she, that and
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：ganphrdu.htm（原典总行数：140 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1270）

verses.iast: sarvāvatī parṣat sadevamānuṣāsuragaruḍagandharvaś ca loko bhagavato bhāṣitam abhyanandann iti
verses.meaningZh: 具足湖或，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·六度满行清净，彼·天人·人道·阿修罗·迦楼罗·香·踊跃以及世间、世界，以世尊此，妙语、语言，破有相福德光·一乘如实之道·离名相假立，如是（结句印定）
verses.meaningEn: A lake + endowed with or, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & perfection of the six pāramitās, he + god + Human Realm + Asura + Garuḍa + be eager and world, realm, Bhagavān + hence, spoken, told, uttered, blessedness transcending existence & supreme vehicle of awakening & beyond nominal designation, thus, so it is stated
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：ganphrdu.htm（原典总行数：140 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1270）

verses.iast: āryamahāgaṇapatihṛdayaṃ samāptam
verses.meaningZh: 圣·大·誐那鉢底·心，三磨钵耽
verses.meaningEn: Noble + great + Ganapati, finished, complete, perfect
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：ganphrdu.htm（原典总行数：140 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1270）

titleZh: 【梵本原典】佛說聖曜母陀羅尼經 / 諸星母陀羅尼經 (Klaus Wille 校勘 GRETIL 梵本)
titleEnglish: Mother of the Nine Planetary Deities (Grahamātṛkā) Dhāraṇī (GRETIL grahmdhu.htm)
translatorZh: 哥廷根大学 GRETIL / 尼泊尔 DSBC 梵文贝叶经校勘本 (Grahamatrkanamadharani)
sutraSourceZh: GRETIL 梵文佛典库 (grahmdhu.htm) · 汉译对勘：T21n1302 / T21n1303
deityZh: 聖曜母菩薩 (Grahamātṛkā)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 本条目直接构建自德国哥廷根大学 GRETIL 梵语原典档案「grahmdhu.htm」（共 168 行，完整提取核心真言与经句共 102 句）。系统已自动将其原始 IAST 梵文实时转写为天城文、唐代悉昙梵字、唐宋古汉语音译、现代梵音拼读参考、国际音标 (IPA) 及摩多轻重音律。
recitationTipsZh: 此为学术校勘梵文写本原貌，每一句均配备「梵音拼读参考」与「唐宋古汉语音译」平行对照，且每个音节胶囊内均同时展示梵文、古汉语与现代拼读。

provenance.rawSnippet: Grahamātṛkānāmadhāraṇī āryagrahamātṛkā nāma dhāraṇī oṃ namo bhagavatyai āryagrahamātṛkāyai / evaṃ mayā śrutam ekasmin samaye bhagavān aḍakavatyāṃ mahānagaryām anekadevanāgayakṣarākṣasagandharvāsuragaruḍakinnaramahoragāpasmārādityasomāṅgārabudhabṛhaspatiśukraśaniścararāhuketvādibhiś cāṣṭāviṃśatinakṣatrādibhiḥ stūyamāno mahāvajrasamayālaṅkāravyūhādhiṣṭhānādhiṣṭhite siṃhāsane viharati sma / anekair bodhisattvasahasraiḥ sārdham / tadyathā - vajrapāṇinā ca nāma bodhisattvena mahāsattvena / vajracaṇḍena ca nāma bodhisattvena mahāsattvena / vajrasenena ca nāma bodhisattvena mahāsattvena / vajravināyakena ca nāma bodhisattvena mahāsattvena / vajracāpahastena ca nāma bodhisattvena mahāsattvena / vajravikurvitena ca nāma bodhisattvena mahāsattvena / vajrādhipatinā ca nāma bodhisattvena mahāsattvena / vajrālaṅkāreṇa ca nāma bodhisattvena mahāsattvena / vajravikrameṇa ca nāma bodhisattvena mahāsattvena / jyotivajreṇa ca nāma bodhisattvena mahāsattvena / avalokiteśvareṇa ca nāma bodhisattvena mahāsattvena / samantabhadreṇa ca nāma bodhisattvena mahāsattvena / samantāvalokiteśvareṇa ca nāma bodhisattvena mahāsattvena / lokaśriyā ca nāma bodhisattvena mahāsattvena / padmaketunā ca nāma bodhisattvena mahāsattvena / ratnaketunā ca nāma bodhisattvena mahāsattvena / vikasitavaktreṇa ca nāma bodhisattvena mahāsattvena / padmagarbheṇa ca nāma bodhisattvena mahāsattvena / padmanetreṇa ca nāma bodhisattvena mahāsattvena / mañjuśriyā ca nāma bodhisattvena mahāsattvena / maitreyeṇa ca nāma bodhisattvena mahāsattvena / evaṃ pramukhair bodhisattvair mahāsattvaiḥ śatasahasraiḥ sārdhaṃ parivṛtaḥ puraskṛto bhagavān dharmaṃ deśayati sma / ādau kalyāṇaṃ madhye kalyāṇaṃ paryavasāne kalyāṇaṃ svarthaṃ suvyañjanaṃ kevalaṃ paripūrṇaṃ pariśuddhaparyavadātaṃ brahmacaryaṃ saṃprakāśayati sma / cintāmaṇimahāvyūhālaṅkāraṃ nāma dharmaparyāyaṃ deśayati sma / atha khalu vajrapāṇir bodhisattvo mahāsattvas tat parṣanmaṇḍalam avalokyāsanād utthāya svaṛddhyādhiṣṭhānena bhagavantam anekaśatasahasraṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya praṇamya purato niṣadya sagarveṇa paryaṅkam ābhujya līlayā tat parṣanmaṇḍalam avalokya vajrāñjalī svahṛdaye pratiṣṭhāpya bhagavantam etad avocat / grahāś ca bhagavann ugrānugrarūpāś ca raudrāraudrarūpās ca krūrākrūrarūpāś ca sattvān viheṭhayanti / keṣāñcit prāṇam apaharanti keṣāñcid upadravāś ca kurvanti keṣāñcid ojohārāṃś ca kurvanti keṣāñcid dravyam apaharanti keṣāñcid dīrghāyuṣsattvānām alpāyuṣaṃ kurvanti / evaṃ sarvasattvānām upadraveṇa vāhayanti / tad deśayatu bhagavan dharmaparyāyaṃ yena sarvasattvānāṃ sarvopadravebhyo rakṣā bhaviṣyati / bhagavān āha - sādhu sādhu vajrapāṇe yas tvaṃ sarvasattvānām arthāya hitāya sukhāya kṛpācittam utpādya mahāguhyātiguhyataraṃ tathāgataṃ samyaksaṃbuddhaṃ paripṛcchasi / tac chṛṇu sādhu ca suṣṭhu ca manasi kuru bhāṣiṣye 'haṃ te / grahāṇām ugrarūpāṇāṃ krūrātibhīṣaṇamukhānāṃ mahāguhyātiguhyataraṃ divyapūjām arghaṃ ca jāpañ ca dhūpañ ca - yathānuvarṇabhedena yathā tuṣyanti te grahāḥ / pūjitāḥ pratipūjyante nirdahante yam ānitaḥ | devāś cāpy asurāś caiva kinnarāś ca mahoragāḥ / yakṣāś ca rākṣasāś caiva manuṣāś caivāmānuṣāḥ | śamayanti ca kruddhāś ca mahānugrāś ca tejasā / pūjāṃ teṣāṃ pravakṣāmi mantrāṃś cāpi yathākramam | atha khalu bhagavāñ chākyamuniḥ samyaksaṃbuddhaḥ svahṛdayāt karuṇāvikrīḍitaṃ nāma raśmijvālaṃ niścārya grahāṇāṃ mūrdhni praveśayati sma / atha tatkṣaṇād eva te sarve ādityādayo grahā utthāya bhagavantaṃ śākyamuniṃ tathāgatam arhantaṃ samyaksaṃbuddhaṃ sarvābhir divyapūjābhiḥ pūjayitvā praṇamya jānubhir nipatya kṛtāñjalipuṭā bhūtvā bhagavantam etad avocan anugṛhītā vayaṃ bhagavatā tathāgatenārhato samyaksaṃbuddhena tad deśayatu bhagavan tādṛśaṃ dharmaparyāyaṃ yena vayaṃ sāmagrībhūtasya dharmabhāṇakasya rakṣāṃ kuryāmaḥ / guptiṃ paritrāṇaṃ parigrahaṃ paripālanaṃ śāntiṃ svastyayanaṃ daṇḍaparihāraṃ śastraparihāraṃ viṣadūṣaṇaṃ viṣanāśanaṃ sīmābandhanaṃ dharaṇībandhaṃ ca kuryāmaḥ / atha khalu bhagavāñ chākyamunis tathāgato 'rhan samyaksaṃbuddho grahāṇāṃ mantrapūjāñ ca bhāṣate sma / oṃ megholkāya svāhā / oṃ śītāṃśave svāhā / oṃ raktāṅgakumārāya svāhā / oṃ budhāya svāhā / oṃ bṛhaspataye svāhā / oṃ asurottamāya svāhā / oṃ kṛṣṇavarṇāya svāhā / oṃ rāhave svāhā / oṃ jyotiḥ ketave svāhā / yathānukramabhedena diśāś copadiśāś ca gandhamaṇḍalakaṃ padmamadhye dvādaśāṅgulapramāṇaṃ caturasraṃ caturdvāraṃ catustoraṇaśobhitaṃ kūṭāgāraṃ cakrasamanvitaṃ kartavyam / tanmadhye sitakamalopari kuṅkumagandhamaṇḍalake cintayed devaṃ bhāskaraṃ tāpasarūpadharaṃ bhujābhyāṃ sitakamaladharaṃ raktavarṇaṃ sahasrasūryakoṭisamatejomālinaṃ vigraham / asya deyaṃ kṣīrabhojanaṃ kundurudhūpam / oṃ megholkāya svāhā / pūrvasyāṃ diśi raktakamalopari priyaṅgugandhamaṇḍalake somo brāhmaṇa iti jñeyaṃ sitavarṇaṃ jaṭāmukuṭapuṣpāvasaktaṃ bhojanaghṛtodanaṃ śrīvāsadhūpaḥ / oṃ candrāmṛtavikramāya namaḥ / śītāṃśave svāhā / dakṣiṇasyāṃ diśi śuklakamalopari candanagandhamaṇḍalake bhikṣurūpo maṅgalo raktavarṇo ratnamakuṭo vāme śakti dakṣiṇe varadahasto bhojanam asya kṣīrabhojanaṃ bhāṣabhaktaṃ vā gugguladhūpaḥ / oṃ raktāṅgārasojjvalakumārāya namaḥ / aṅgārāya svāhā / paścimāyām diśi raktapadmopari kṛṣṇāgarugandhamaṇḍalake brahmacārī budhaḥ syāt pītavarṇo raktaśmaśruḥ akṣasūtrakamaṇḍaludharaḥ / bhojanaṃ mudrabhāṣakṛṣaraḥ / dhūpo gandharasaḥ / oṃ rājaputrapītavarṇāya namaḥ / budhāya svāhā / uttarasyāṃ diśi sitakamalopari devadārugandhamaṇḍalake parivrājako gurus taptakāñcanavarṇābho raktaśmaśruḥ akṣasūtrakamaṇḍaludharaḥ / asya deyaṃ dadhibhaktodanakṣīraṃ vā madhudhṛtadhūpaḥ / oṃ lohitavarṇanigamāya namaḥ bhogāspadāya svāhā / āgneyāṃ diśi raktapadmopari candanagandhamaṇḍalake śukrapāśupatadhāri gokṣīravarṇadhavalāmbho jaṭāmukutākṣasūtrakamaṇḍaludharaḥ / asya deyaṃ kṣīrabhojanaṃ karpūradhūpaḥ / oṃ namaḥ śukrādhipataye asurottamāya śuddhavigrahe svāhā / nairṛtyāṃ diśi sitapaṅkajopari nīlacandanagandhamaṇḍalake śaniścaro kṛṣṇavarṇaphaṇabhṛtkṣapaṇako jñeyaḥ bījajaṭāmukuṭaśmaśruḥ / akṣasūtrakṣikṣirikādharo bhojanam asya bhāṣabhaktakṛṣaraḥ / dhūpo gandharasaḥ / oṃ nīlavarṇasannibhāya namaḥ / kṛṣṇaśaniścarāya svāhā / vāyavyāṃ diśi raktāmbhojopari tagarādigandhamaṇḍalake kāpāliko rāhu rājāvartanibho 'rdhadeho ravirathabhayānakalocanayugo daṃṣṭrākarālo bhṛkuṭīkṛtalalāṭapañcavarṇaḥ meghamadhyagato bhujābhyāṃ candrasūryakamalābhinayasthitaḥ / asya deyaṃ bhāṣāmiṣabhojanaṃ tilakṛṣaro vā vilvapatradhūpaḥ / oṃ vikṛtavadanarudhirāśin rāho bhṛṅgāñjanasannibhāya namaḥ / amṛtapriyāya svāhā / aiśānyāṃ diśi raktasaroruhopari spṛkkāgandhamaṇḍalake cāṇḍālaketur bhavet / dhūmravarṇaḥ kṛtāñjalir nāgākṛtiḥ svapucchabhṛt / asya deyaṃ bhojanaṃ dhṛtapūrakaṃ sajjaraso dhūpaḥ / oṃ dhūmravarṇasannibhāya jyotiṣketave namaḥ svāhā / maṇḍalasya pūrvadvāre buddho bhagavān dakṣiṇadvāre vajrapāṇiḥ paścimadvāre lokanāthaḥ uttaradvāre mañjuśrīkumāraḥ / pūrvottarakoṇe sarve grahāḥ pūrvadakṣiṇakoṇe sarve rāśinakṣatrāḥ dakṣiṇapaścimakoṇe sarvopadravāḥ paścimottarakoṇe bhaṭṭārikā mahāvidyā / śvetā nīlāruṇatrimukhā hastadvayena vyākhyānamudrā dakṣiṇe ratnachatrā vāme pāśaśaktidharā ratnamukuṭīvajraparyaṅkopaviṣṭā candāsanasamāsīnā ṣoḍaśavarṣākārā sarvālaṅkārabhūṣitā / bāhyapūrvadvāre dhṛtarāṣṭrasya dadhibhaktaṃ dakṣiṇe virūḍhakasya dadhimāṣabhaktaṃ paścime virūpākṣasya kṣīrabhatam uttare kuberasya dadhimāṣabhaktaṃ sindūramastakam / yathānukramabhedena puṣpādipūjā kartavyā / pratyekam dīpo deyaḥ / dhṛtamadhubhyāṃ śaṃkhaṃ pūrayitvā pañcaratnaṃ prakṣipyārgho deyaḥ / sarveṣāṃ mukhapaṭo deyam iti / evaṃ varṇabhujāsanamudrācihnāni bhavanti / oṃ namaḥ sarvatathāgatebhyaḥ sarvāśāparipūrakebhyaḥ sarvathā bhaktine svāhā / ratnatrayasya mantraṃ evaṃ pratyekaṃ japet saptasaptāṣṭaśataṃ mantram ekaikaśaḥ / evaṃ pūjitāḥ sarve grahā vividharūpiṇo dadati vipulān bhogān saubhāgyān janayanty api / imāni vajrapāṇe navagrahāṇāṃ hṛdayāni paṭhitasiddhāni tathānukramabhedena gandhamaṇḍalakaṃ kṛtvā dvādaśāṅgulimadhye pūjayitavyāni tāmramṛṇmayarūpyādibhojanena arghaṃ datvāṣṭottaraśatavārān mantraṃ japet ekaikaśaḥ / paścāt punar vajrapāṇe gṛhamātṛkānāma dhāraṇīmantrapadāni saptavārānuccārayitavyāni / tatas te ādityādayo rakṣāvaraṇaguptiṃ kariṣyanti / dāridryaṃ duḥkhaṃ mocayiṣyanti gatāyuṣaṃ dīrghāyuṣaṃ kariṣyanti / yaś ca khalu punar vajrapāṇe bhikṣubhikṣuṇyupāsakopāsikān ye vā sattvajātīyā yeṣāṃ karṇapuṭe śabdaṃ nipatiṣyanti na teṣām akālamṛtyunā kālaṃ kariṣyanti / yaś ca khalu punar vajrapāṇe grahān maṇḍalamadhye pūjayitvā dine dine saptavārānuccārayiṣyanti / tatra tasya dharmabhāṇakasya sarve grahāḥ sarveṇa sarvāśāṃ paripūrayiṣyanti / tatkulād api dāridryañ ca nāśāyiṣyanti / atha khalu bhagavāñ chākyamuni tathāgataḥ punar api gṛhamātṛkānāma dhāraṇīmantrapadāni bhāṣate sma / oṃ namo ratnatrayāya / oṃ namo buddhāya / oṃ namo dharmāya / oṃ namaḥ saṃghāya / oṃ namo vajradharāya / oṃ namaḥ padmadharāya / oṃ namaḥ kumārāya / oṃ namaḥ sarvagrahāṇāṃ sarvāśāparipūrakāṇām / oṃ namaḥ nakṣatrāṇām / oṃ namo dvādaśarāśīnām / oṃ namaḥ sarvopadravāṇām / tadyathā - oṃ buddhe buddhe śuddhe uddhe vajre vajre padme padme sara sara prasare prasare smara smara krīḍa krīḍa krīḍaya krīḍaya mara mara māraya māraya mardaya mardaya stambha stambha stambhaya stambhaya ghaṭa ghaṭa ghāṭaya ghāṭaya mama sarvasattvānāñ ca vighnān chinda chinda bhinda bhinda sarvavighnān nāśanaṃ kuru kuru mama saparivārasya sarvasattvānāñ ca kāryaṃ kṣepaya kṣepaya mama sarvasattvānāñ ca sarvanakṣatragrahapīḍān nivāraya nivāraya bhagavati śriyaṃ kuru mahāmāyā prasādhaya sarvaduṣṭān nāśaya sarvapāpāni mama saparivārasya sarvasattvānāñ ca rakṣa rakṣa vajre vajre caṇḍe caṇḍe caṇḍini caṇḍini nuru nuru musu musu mumu mumu muñca muñca havā have ugre ugratare pūraya bhagavati manorathaṃ mama sarvaparivārasya sarvasattvānāñ ca sarvatathāgatādiṣṭhānādhiṣṭhite svāhā / oṃ svāhā / hūṃ svāhā / hrīḥ svāhā / dhūḥ svāhā / dhīḥ svāhā / oṃ ādityāya svāhā / oṃ somāya svāhā / oṃ dharaṇīsutāya svāhā / oṃ budhāya svāhā / oṃ bṛhaspataye svāhā / oṃ śukrāya svāhā / oṃ śaniścarāya svāhā / oṃ rāhave svāhā / oṃ ketave svāhā / oṃ buddhāya svāhā / oṃ vajrapāṇaye svāhā / oṃ padmadharāya svāhā / oṃ kumārāya svāhā / oṃ sarvagrahāṇāṃ svāhā / oṃ sarvanakṣatrāṇāṃ svāhā / sarvopadravāṇāṃ svāhā / oṃ dvādaśarāśīnāṃ svāhā / oṃ sarvavidye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ svāhā / imāni vajrapāṇe grahamātṛkānāma dhāraṇīmantrapadāni sarvasiddhikarāṇi ca / yac ca khalu punar vajrapāṇe imāni grahamātṛkānāma dhāraṇīmantrapadāni kārtikamāsaśuklapakṣasya saptamīm ārabhyopoṣadhiko bhūtvā yāvac caturdaśīgrahanakṣatrān madhye pūjayitvā dine dine saptavārānuccārayitavyāni / tataḥ pūrṇamāsyām ahorātraṃ vācayet / tasya navanavativarṣāṇi mṛtyubhayaṃ na bhaviṣyati / ulkāpātagrahanakṣatrapīḍābhayaṃ na bhaviṣyati / jātau jātau jātismaro bhaviṣyati / sarve grahā īpsitaṃ varaṃ dāsyanti / atha te sarve grahāḥ sādhu bhagavann iti kṛtvā praṇamyāntarhitābhūvann iti / idam avocad bhagavān āttamanās te ca bhikṣavas te ca bodhisattvā mahāsattvāḥ sā ca sarvāvatīparṣat sadevamānuṣāsuragaruḍagandharvaś ca loko bhagavato bhāṣitam abhyanandann iti / āryagrahamātṛkānāma dhāraṇī samāptā

verses.iast: Grahamātṛkānāmadhāraṇī āryagrahamātṛkā nāma dhāraṇī oṃ namo bhagavatyai āryagrahamātṛkāyai / evaṃ mayā śrutam
verses.meaningZh: 曜执·摩怛理迦·名为·陀罗尼，圣·曜执·摩怛理迦，名为、号曰，陀罗尼、总持（总一切法、持无量义），嗡！归命，向世尊佛母顶礼，清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道·妙行趣入，如是、如此，由我（具格：如是我闻），闻
verses.meaningEn: Planet + matrix + by name + Dhāraṇī, noble + planet + matrix, by name, called, Dhāraṇī, total retention, protective spell, Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed Mother / Lady Bhagavatī, stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening & awakened spiritual movement (vocative invocation), thus, in this way, by me, heard
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: ekasmin samaye bhagavān aḍakavatyāṃ mahānagaryām anekadevanāgayakṣarākṣasagandharvāsuragaruḍakinnaramahoragāpasmārādityasomāṅgārabudhabṛhaspatiśukraśaniścararāhuketvādibhiś cāṣṭāviṃśatinakṣatrādibhiḥ stūyamāno mahāvajrasamayālaṅkāravyūhādhiṣṭhānādhiṣṭhite siṃhāsane viharati sma
verses.meaningZh: 一时，向平，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，息灭诤怨·造作离相·最上真言离言说，广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，持守摄受·广大殊胜·妙行流布·离名相假立，妙行迁变空·六度满行清净·断除憍慢执障，一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·一乘如实之道，大·金刚·中间·上首·此边·庄严·加持·所加持，师子座尊，一切，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: At one time, to equal, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, pacifying conflict & turmoil & freedom from karmic agency & supreme ineffable speech, great, bearing, great, practicing, awakened conduct beyond flux & perfection of the six pāramitās & cutting rigid pride, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & supreme vehicle of awakening, great + Vajra + in the middle of + of the chief town in Ceylon the island itself + the hither + mass + spiritual blessing + O blessed, O lion's throne / in lion's throne, lives, dwells, spends oneʼs time, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: arthāya hitāya sukhāya kṛpācittam utpādya mahāguhyātiguhyataraṃ tathāgataṃ samyaksaṃbuddhaṃ paripṛcchasi / tac chṛṇu
