verses.meaningEn: To/for meaning, benefit, aim, welfare, to/for put, placed, laid, to/for easy, pleasant, comfortable, happy, compassion + mind, burst forth + eatable, great + hidden or covered + very + hide + from whom, Tathāgata, Thus-Come One, Perfectly and Completely Awakened Buddha, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & awakened conduct beyond flux (vocative invocation), awakened conduct beyond flux (caryā) — primordial non-arising, coolness free of obscuration & conflict-free peace (imperative seal)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: sādhu ca suṣṭhu ca manasi kuru bhāṣiṣye 'haṃ te / grahāṇām ugrarūpāṇāṃ
verses.meaningZh: 萨以及极善以及事关，祈请成办羯磨事业（俱噜），宣说演畅·破有相福德光，我、真我自性，向汝、彼等，诸曜执、星曜鬼神执障之，诸可怕相貌之
verses.meaningEn: Sadhu and good, excellent and concentrates the mind on, reflects, accomplish & enact this sacred work! speaking (vocative invocation), I, the awakened self, to Thee / they, of planet, seizing spirit/graha, of of awful appearance
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: krūrātibhīṣaṇamukhānāṃ mahāguhyātiguhyataraṃ divyapūjām arghaṃ ca jāpañ ca dhūpañ ca - yathānuvarṇabhedena yathā
verses.meaningZh: 凶恶·比较可怕·诸面门，大·密·太·被覆·如何哪些，天妙供，功德以及生起不可得·尊胜·第一义谛·圣智通达以及法界总持任持·第一义谛·圣智通达以及以犹如·日复一日·显色·异生性，犹如、如…所说
verses.meaningEn: Bloody + quite dreadful + of all face, great + hidden or covered + very + hide + from whom, divine + to make an offering, worth, price and transcending birth & victorious & ultimate truth & non-dual wisdom awareness and Dharma-realm retention & ultimate truth & non-dual wisdom awareness and just as + day after day + color + by, just as, according to
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: tuṣyanti te grahāḥ / pūjitāḥ pratipūjyante nirdahante yam ānitaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 欢喜悦泽·真如实际，向汝、彼等，诸曜执、星曜鬼神执障，诸所恭敬，向对·供养·假定今日·汝，离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢·施度调伏，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），离名相假立·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Delighting (vocative invocation), to Thee / they, planet, seizing spirit/graha (plural), honored (plural), toward + reverence + suppose now + to Thee, beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust & generosity & self-mastery (vocative invocation), selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: devāś cāpy asurāś caiva kinnarāś ca mahoragāḥ / yakṣāś ca rākṣasāś caiva manuṣāś caivāmānuṣāḥ
verses.meaningZh: 施度调伏·最上真言离言说·本性寂静止息，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·远离寂静周遍），一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·本性寂静止息，以及、亦复如是（ca + eva），造作离相·离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢以及诸摩睺罗伽（大蟒神），一乘如实之道·造作离相·六度满行清净以及清净离诸尘垢·造作离相·六度满行清净，以及、亦复如是（ca + eva），无我大慈三昧·离名相假立·六度满行清净，以及诸不是人间
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery & supreme ineffable speech & primordial tranquil peace, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — expansive quiescence, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & primordial tranquil peace, and indeed, likewise, freedom from karmic agency & beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust and Mahoraga, great serpent spirit (plural), supreme vehicle of awakening & freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās and stainless purity free from dust & freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās, and indeed, likewise, selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation & perfection of the six pāramitās, and indeed + not human
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: śamayanti ca kruddhāś ca mahānugrāś ca tejasā / pūjāṃ teṣāṃ pravakṣāmi mantrāṃś cāpi yathākramam
verses.meaningZh: 事业诸尊此处以及造作离相·清净离诸尘垢·施度调伏以及广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧以及真如实际·生起不可得·尊胜·一切诸谛圆满，供，彼等一切之，转载我因缘，诸真言、密咒（护心密语），持械宝弓尊，如其所应
verses.meaningEn: Labour + they walk and freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust & generosity & self-mastery and great and immutable Suchness & transcending birth & victorious & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, to make an offering, of them, their, forward + I cause to grow or increase, Mantra, sacred formula, O armed with a bow, in order
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: atha khalu bhagavāñ chākyamuniḥ samyaksaṃbuddhaḥ svahṛdayāt karuṇāvikrīḍitaṃ nāma raśmijvālaṃ niścārya grahāṇāṃ mūrdhni
verses.meaningZh: 尔时、次复吉祥启白，诚然、确实，破有相福德光·妙行趣入·最上真言离言说，离覆障清凉·造作离相·一乘如实之道，正等觉，自从心，大悲遊戏相，名为、号曰，光芒焰光，晚上境界，诸曜执、星曜鬼神执障之，顶首
verses.meaningEn: Now, thereupon, auspiciously, indeed, verily, certainly, blessedness transcending existence & awakened spiritual movement & supreme ineffable speech, coolness free of obscuration & freedom from karmic agency & supreme vehicle of awakening, samyaksaṃbuddhaḥ, own + from heart, compassion, by name, called, ray of light + light, night + a outcast, of planet, seizing spirit/graha, head
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: praveśayati sma / atha tatkṣaṇād eva te sarve ādityādayo grahā utthāya bhagavantaṃ
verses.meaningZh: 请令契入、引入坛城三昧！摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），尔时、次复吉祥启白，真如实际·造作离相·六度满行清净，唯、正是、决定，向汝、彼等，一切、普皆遍满尊，日天残忍，曜执、星曜鬼神执障，立起，若衍底
verses.meaningEn: Cause to enter! infuse! selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, now, thereupon, auspiciously, immutable Suchness & freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās, indeed, verily, alone, to Thee / they, O all, every, complete / in all, every, complete, sun + merciless, planet, seizing spirit/graha, utthāya, victorious(-ly) passed beyond
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: śākyamuniṃ tathāgatam arhantaṃ samyaksaṃbuddhaṃ sarvābhir divyapūjābhiḥ pūjayitvā praṇamya jānubhir nipatya kṛtāñjalipuṭā bhūtvā
verses.meaningZh: 释迦牟尼佛（能仁寂默），如来（乘如实道来成正觉），活该末，正等正觉、正遍知，一切融通，以诸天妙供，供养极微已，恭敬稽首顶礼已，生起不可得·尊胜·离名相假立·破有相福德光，上首那个，谦卑囊，昂已
verses.meaningEn: Śākyamuni Buddha, Sage of the Śākyas, Tathāgata, Thus-Come One, deserve + end, Perfectly and Completely Awakened Buddha, all + to, divine + with to make an offering, reverence + having or interrog, having bowed down in reverence, transcending birth & victorious & beyond nominal designation & blessedness transcending existence, chief + that, humble + bag, having arise
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: bhagavantam etad avocan anugṛhītā vayaṃ bhagavatā tathāgatenārhato samyaksaṃbuddhena tad deśayatu bhagavan tādṛśaṃ
verses.meaningZh: 若衍底，此、此事，人情享受，满足、喜悦，我等，才鸣呼，如来·勇健·堪敬，以正等正觉、正遍知，彼、如是真实，施度调伏·本性寂静止息·一乘如实之道，出有坏，这样一样、这样一块
verses.meaningEn: Victorious(-ly) passed beyond, this, favour + delight in, favoured, satisfied, happy, we, excellence, Tathāgata + strong, by/through Perfectly and Completely Awakened Buddha, that, thus, generosity & self-mastery & primordial tranquil peace & supreme vehicle of awakening (imperative seal), bhagavan, such like, such a one
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: dharmaparyāyaṃ yena vayaṃ sāmagrībhūtasya dharmabhāṇakasya rakṣāṃ kuryāmaḥ / guptiṃ paritrāṇaṃ parigrahaṃ paripālanaṃ
verses.meaningZh: 法门，借由彼因缘，我等，遇会部多鬼神，说法者之，守护、结界护念，成办作持·造作离相，色相、兵团，皆护，摄受，守护、养育
verses.meaningEn: Device, means of, by which, whereby, we, concord + of spirit, of a preacher of the doctrine, religious preacher, protection, safeguarding, enacting, form, formation, fashion, paritrāṇaṃ, to protect, protection, guard, nurture, maintenance, care
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: śāntiṃ svastyayanaṃ daṇḍaparihāraṃ śastraparihāraṃ viṣadūṣaṇaṃ viṣanāśanaṃ sīmābandhanaṃ dharaṇībandhaṃ ca kuryāmaḥ / atha
verses.meaningZh: 息灾、寂静、安隐，成妙善乐，金刚杖回答，刀杖兵戈回答，摧灭毒素，毒害摧灭，结界管保，簷结界系缚邪魔外障以及成办作持·造作离相，尔时、次复吉祥启白
verses.meaningEn: Peace, pacification, tranquility, svastyayanaṃ, staff + watchful care, weapon + watchful care, destroying poison, poison + destroying, drawing a strict line of + assuredly, support + bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! and enacting, now, thereupon, auspiciously
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: khalu bhagavāñ chākyamunis tathāgato 'rhan samyaksaṃbuddho grahāṇāṃ mantrapūjāñ ca bhāṣate sma /
verses.meaningZh: 诚然、确实，破有相福德光·妙行趣入·最上真言离言说，离覆障清凉·造作离相·一乘如实之道，如来，应供、阿罗汉，正等觉，诸曜执、星曜鬼神执障之，供养礼赞·无我大慈三昧以及说，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Indeed, verily, certainly, blessedness transcending existence & awakened spiritual movement & supreme ineffable speech, coolness free of obscuration & freedom from karmic agency & supreme vehicle of awakening, tathāgato, Arhat, Worthy One, samyaksaṃbuddho, of planet, seizing spirit/graha, worshipping and to speak, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: oṃ megholkāya svāhā / oṃ śītāṃśave svāhā / oṃ raktāṅgakumārāya svāhā /
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！向云炬，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！嗡！向月轮，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！嗡！向赤红肢孺童，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! cloud + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Oṃ! to cold-rayed, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Oṃ! red + member + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: oṃ budhāya svāhā / oṃ bṛhaspataye svāhā / oṃ asurottamāya svāhā /
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！向水星，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！嗡！向木星，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！嗡！向阿修罗最上，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! to/for intelligent, clever, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Oṃ! to of a god , the planet Jupiter, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Oṃ! Asura + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: oṃ kṛṣṇavarṇāya svāhā / oṃ rāhave svāhā / oṃ jyotiḥ ketave svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！向深青黑显色，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！嗡！向罗喉，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！嗡！打败正勤，向光明幢、相好胜帜，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! dark-blue + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Oṃ! to the Seizer, of a demon supposed to swallow the sun and moon and thus cause eclipses, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Oṃ! overpower + effort, to banner, ray, emblem, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: / yathānukramabhedena diśāś copadiśāś ca gandhamaṇḍalakaṃ padmamadhye dvādaśāṅgulapramāṇaṃ caturasraṃ caturdvāraṃ catustoraṇaśobhitaṃ kūṭāgāraṃ
verses.meaningZh: 以犹如分次第异生性，施度调伏·本性寂静止息，妙行迁变空·第一义谛·施度调伏以及香规格，莲华中尊，十二·寸·量，四方，四门，四次·牌楼·卓越，楼观
verses.meaningEn: Just as + order + by, generosity & self-mastery & primordial tranquil peace, awakened conduct beyond flux & ultimate truth & generosity & self-mastery and smell + disease which destroys a family, lotus flower + O neutral, the twelfth + inch, caturasraṃ, four, four times + arch + splendid, palace tower
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: cakrasamanvitaṃ kartavyam / tanmadhye sitakamalopari kuṅkumagandhamaṇḍalake cintayed devaṃ bhāskaraṃ tāpasarūpadharaṃ bhujābhyāṃ sitakamaladharaṃ
verses.meaningZh: 法轮辅以，任务，推广中尊，不那利般，郁金香·香·规格尊，妙行迁变空·离名相假立·真如实际，天人、诸天护法，一样、日轮，道者显色，破有相福德光·生起不可得·尊胜·一乘如实之道，不那利请执持
verses.meaningEn: Wheel + accompanied by, to be made or done, extend + O neutral, a white lotus flower + wisdom, saffron + smell + O disease which destroys a family, awakened conduct beyond flux & beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness, god, celestial deity (Deva), the same, performing penance or belonging to it + having the colour, blessedness transcending existence & transcending birth & victorious & supreme vehicle of awakening, a white lotus flower + hold! bear! sustain!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: raktavarṇaṃ sahasrasūryakoṭisamatejomālinaṃ vigraham / asya deyaṃ kṣīrabhojanaṃ kundurudhūpam / oṃ megholkāya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 赤红显色，千·日轮·俱胝·平·威光·园丁，离，此尊之、此咒之，所施，乳喫，薰陆香烧香，嗡！向云炬，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Red colour, thousand + sun + ten million + equal + garland-maker, separation, division, of this, his/its, deyaṃ, milk + to eat, Boswellia + to burn incense, Oṃ! cloud + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: / pūrvasyāṃ diśi raktakamalopari priyaṅgugandhamaṇḍalake somo brāhmaṇa iti jñeyaṃ sitavarṇaṃ jaṭāmukuṭapuṣpāvasaktaṃ bhojanaghṛtodanaṃ
verses.meaningZh: 圆满充盈·第一义谛，方位，赤红·垢染·般，谷·香·规格尊，月，婆罗门，如是（结句印定），乃是已知、创建往外，洁白显色，滋养增益·生起不可得·尊胜，喫·酥油·波浪
verses.meaningEn: Fulfilling, direction, red + stain + wisdom, a medicinal plant and perfume + smell + O disease which destroys a family, somo, brahmanhood, brahmanic condition, thus, so it is stated, to be known, understood, learnt, found out, white + color, nourishing, to eat + clarified butter + wave
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: śrīvāsadhūpaḥ / oṃ candrāmṛtavikramāya namaḥ / śītāṃśave svāhā / dakṣiṇasyāṃ diśi śuklakamalopari
verses.meaningZh: 种类树脂烧香，嗡！向月轮甘露超，归命，向月轮，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！施度调伏·造作离相·六度满行清净，方位，白·妙莲华·般
verses.meaningEn: A kind of resin + to burn incense, Oṃ! moon + ambrosia + to, homage to to cold-rayed, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! generosity & self-mastery & freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās, direction, white + lotus blossom + wisdom
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: candanagandhamaṇḍalake bhikṣurūpo maṅgalo raktavarṇo ratnamakuṭo vāme śakti dakṣiṇe varadahasto bhojanam asya kṣīrabhojanaṃ
verses.meaningZh: 檀香·香·规格尊，比丘色，吉祥、胜妙瑞相，赤红显色，宝冠、摩尼宝天冠，左尊，威，右尊，施愿者肘，喫，此尊之、此咒之，乳喫
verses.meaningEn: Best of its kind + smell + O disease which destroys a family, beggar + form, auspiciousness, blessing, good fortune, red colour, jeweled crown/diadem, O left / in left, ability, power, capacity of, O right / in right, boon-granting, to eat, of this, his/its, milk + to eat
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: bhāṣabhaktaṃ vā gugguladhūpaḥ / oṃ raktāṅgārasojjvalakumārāya namaḥ / aṅgārāya svāhā / paścimāyām
verses.meaningZh: 宣说演畅·破有相福德光，或、抑或，蔓菁烧香，嗡！向赤红·肢·无味·炽盛·孺童，归命，向炭，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！于西中
verses.meaningEn: Speaking, or, to burn incense, Oṃ! red + member + tasteless + flaming + to, homage to to/for charcoal, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! in (last =) lowest, mean, vulgar
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: diśi raktapadmopari kṛṣṇāgarugandhamaṇḍalake brahmacārī budhaḥ syāt pītavarṇo raktaśmaśruḥ akṣasūtrakamaṇḍaludharaḥ / bhojanaṃ mudrabhāṣakṛṣaraḥ
verses.meaningZh: 方位，赤红·钵头摩·般，沉香·香·规格尊，融通、梵行学生佛母，水星，愿得成就、当如是，金黄赞，赤红须，持守摄受·造作离相，喫，宣说演畅·无我大慈三昧
verses.meaningEn: Direction, red + wisdom, smell + O disease which destroys a family, to, budhaḥ, may it be so, yellow, red + beard, bearing, to eat, speaking
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: / dhūpo gandharasaḥ / oṃ rājaputrapītavarṇāya namaḥ / budhāya svāhā / uttarasyāṃ
verses.meaningZh: 烧香，香乃是，嗡！向童子金黄显色，归命，向水星，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·一切诸谛圆满
verses.meaningEn: To burn incense, be, Oṃ! a king's son + yellow + to, homage to to/for intelligent, clever, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: diśi sitakamalopari devadārugandhamaṇḍalake parivrājako gurus taptakāñcanavarṇābho raktaśmaśruḥ akṣasūtrakamaṇḍaludharaḥ / asya deyaṃ dadhibhaktodanakṣīraṃ
verses.meaningZh: 方位，不那利般，松树·香·规格尊，普行，妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢·一切诸谛圆满，真如实际·第一义谛·造作离相，赤红须，持守摄受·造作离相，此尊之、此咒之，所施，酪·饼·波浪·慧眼
verses.meaningEn: Direction, a white lotus flower + wisdom, a species of pine + smell + O disease which destroys a family, parivrājako, awakened spiritual movement & stainless purity free from dust & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, immutable Suchness & ultimate truth & freedom from karmic agency, red + beard, bearing, of this, his/its, deyaṃ, giving + food + wave + eye
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: vā madhudhṛtadhūpaḥ / oṃ lohitavarṇanigamāya namaḥ bhogāspadāya svāhā / āgneyāṃ diśi raktapadmopari
verses.meaningZh: 或、抑或，蜜·育·烧香，嗡！向红显色城，归命，向蛇盘身住靠处，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！火热，方位，赤红·钵头摩·般
verses.meaningEn: Or, sweet + to rear + to burn incense, Oṃ! reddish + color + to, homage to winding + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! fiery, direction, red + wisdom
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: candanagandhamaṇḍalake śukrapāśupatadhāri gokṣīravarṇadhavalāmbho jaṭāmukutākṣasūtrakamaṇḍaludharaḥ / asya deyaṃ kṣīrabhojanaṃ karpūradhūpaḥ / oṃ namaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 檀香·香·规格尊，金星·畜主·持，牯牛·乳·显色·洁白·净水，持守摄受·生起不可得·尊胜，此尊之、此咒之，所施，乳喫，樟脑烧香，嗡！至心归命礼！
verses.meaningEn: Best of its kind + smell + O disease which destroys a family, clear + holding, bull + milk + color + white + water, bearing, of this, his/its, deyaṃ, milk + to eat, camphor + to burn incense, Oṃ! reverent homage!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: śukrādhipataye asurottamāya śuddhavigrahe svāhā / nairṛtyāṃ diśi sitapaṅkajopari nīlacandanagandhamaṇḍalake śaniścaro kṛṣṇavarṇaphaṇabhṛtkṣapaṇako jñeyaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 向金星控制器，向阿修罗最上，清净离，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，方位，洁白·种类莲华·般，绀青·檀香·香·规格尊，行星土曜，造作离相·六度满行清净·离诸诤论无诤，乃是已知、创建往外
verses.meaningEn: Clear + to controller, Asura + to, pure + O separation, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, direction, white + a kind of lotus + wisdom, sapphire-blue + best of its kind + smell + O disease which destroys a family, the planet Saturn, freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās & conflict-free peace, to be known, understood, learnt, found out
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: bījajaṭāmukuṭaśmaśruḥ / akṣasūtrakṣikṣirikādharo bhojanam asya bhāṣabhaktakṛṣaraḥ / dhūpo gandharasaḥ / oṃ nīlavarṇasannibhāya
verses.meaningZh: 谛听妙闻·解脱系缚大力，拥护守护·持守摄受·造作离相，喫，此尊之、此咒之，宣说演畅·破有相福德光，烧香，香乃是，嗡！向绀青·显色·赢得·一样
verses.meaningEn: Hearing, protecting, bearing, to eat, of this, his/its, speaking, to burn incense, be, Oṃ! sapphire-blue + color + win + to
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: namaḥ / kṛṣṇaśaniścarāya svāhā / vāyavyāṃ diśi raktāmbhojopari tagarādigandhamaṇḍalake kāpāliko rāhu rājāvartanibho
verses.meaningZh: 归命向深青黑行星土曜，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！最上真言离言说·一乘如实之道，方位，赤红·莲华·般，格香·元·香·规格尊，守护养育·造作离相，罗喉，人皇·途径·呼请仁者圣众叹词
verses.meaningEn: Homage to dark-blue + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! supreme ineffable speech & supreme vehicle of awakening, direction, red + lotus + wisdom, tagara + beginning + smell + O disease which destroys a family, guarding, the Seizer, of a demon supposed to swallow the sun and moon and thus cause eclipses, the felloe or the track of a wheel + O Venerable Ones!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: 'rdhadeho ravirathabhayānakalocanayugo daṃṣṭrākarālo bhṛkuṭīkṛtalalāṭapañcavarṇaḥ meghamadhyagato bhujābhyāṃ candrasūryakamalābhinayasthitaḥ / asya deyaṃ bhāṣāmiṣabhojanaṃ tilakṛṣaro
verses.meaningZh: 半身，日轮·尔时·暴恶·眼·轭，牙·诸出处·衍伸，颦眉观音母·所作·额·微质怛囒，云中间，破有相福德光·生起不可得·尊胜·一乘如实之道，月轮·日轮·妙莲华·默剧·立，此尊之、此咒之，所施，妙语·开放眼帘·斋戒，芝麻·耕·辐条
verses.meaningEn: Half, the sun + now + dreadful + eye, large tooth + scatterer + spawn, Bhṛkuṭī + done + forehead + five-coloured, cloud + being in the middle of, blessedness transcending existence & transcending birth & victorious & supreme vehicle of awakening, moon + sun + lotus blossom + pantomime + standing, of this, his/its, deyaṃ, speech + open the eyes + not eating, the sesamum plant or seed + to plow
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: vā vilvapatradhūpaḥ / oṃ vikṛtavadanarudhirāśin rāho bhṛṅgāñjanasannibhāya namaḥ / amṛtapriyāya svāhā /
verses.meaningZh: 或、抑或，最上真言离言说·离一切相无相·第一义谛，嗡！最上真言离言说·造作离相·真如实际，清净离诸尘垢·因缘空寂大乐，破有相福德光·支分寂静·妙行趣入，归命，向甘露惜者，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Or, supreme ineffable speech & freedom from conditioned marks & ultimate truth, Oṃ! supreme ineffable speech & freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness, stainless purity free from dust & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, blessedness transcending existence & quiescence of perceptual limbs & awakened spiritual movement (reverent offering), homage to ambrosia + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: aiśānyāṃ diśi raktasaroruhopari spṛkkāgandhamaṇḍalake cāṇḍālaketur bhavet / dhūmravarṇaḥ kṛtāñjalir nāgākṛtiḥ svapucchabhṛt /
verses.meaningZh: 来他，方位，清净离诸尘垢·造作离相·真如实际，苜蓿·香·规格尊，妙行迁变空·离诸诤论无诤·息灭诤怨，当得成就、若成，灰白赞，谦卑，龙族形相，自·跟踪·方位
verses.meaningEn: Śiva's belonging to Śiva + other, direction, stainless purity free from dust & freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), sprkka + smell + O disease which destroys a family, awakened conduct beyond flux & conflict-free peace & pacifying conflict & turmoil, may be, would become, smoke-coloured, humble, suppliant, Nāga, own + tail + bearing
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: asya deyaṃ bhojanaṃ dhṛtapūrakaṃ sajjaraso dhūpaḥ / oṃ dhūmravarṇasannibhāya jyotiṣketave namaḥ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 此尊之、此咒之，所施，喫，育流程，绳子事关味，烧香，嗡！向灰白·显色·赢得·一样，生起不可得·尊胜·一乘如实之道·真如实际，归命，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Of this, his/its, deyaṃ, to eat, to rear + stream, having the string on, to burn incense, Oṃ! smoke-coloured + color + win + to, transcending birth & victorious & supreme vehicle of awakening & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), homage to Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: / maṇḍalasya pūrvadvāre buddho bhagavān dakṣiṇadvāre vajrapāṇiḥ paścimadvāre lokanāthaḥ uttaradvāre mañjuśrīkumāraḥ /
verses.meaningZh: 曼荼罗、坛城轮圆具足之，本门尊，觉者，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，右门尊，金刚手，西门尊，世所宗奉，无上门尊，文殊师利菩萨孺童
verses.meaningEn: Of Maṇḍala, sacred cosmogram/circle, former + O =, buddho, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, right + O =, vajrapāṇiḥ, lowest + O =, Lokanatha, upper + O =, Mañjuśrī
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: pūrvottarakoṇe sarve grahāḥ pūrvadakṣiṇakoṇe sarve rāśinakṣatrāḥ dakṣiṇapaścimakoṇe sarvopadravāḥ paścimottarakoṇe bhaṭṭārikā mahāvidyā /
verses.meaningZh: 本·无上·隅尊，一切、普皆遍满尊，诸曜执、星曜鬼神执障，本·右·隅尊，一切、普皆遍满尊，群体诸星宿，右·西·隅尊，一切诸灾横，西·无上·隅尊，破有相福德光·断除憍慢执障·清净离诸尘垢，大明咒、大明王母
verses.meaningEn: Former + upper + O corner, O all, every, complete / in all, every, complete, planet, seizing spirit/graha (plural), former + right + O corner, O all, every, complete / in all, every, complete, group + constellation, right + lowest + O corner, all + calamity, lowest + upper + O corner, blessedness transcending existence & cutting rigid pride & stainless purity free from dust, Mahāvidyā, Great Wisdom-Spell
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: śvetā nīlāruṇatrimukhā hastadvayena vyākhyānamudrā dakṣiṇe ratnachatrā vāme pāśaśaktidharā ratnamukuṭīvajraparyaṅkopaviṣṭā candāsanasamāsīnā ṣoḍaśavarṣākārā sarvālaṅkārabhūṣitā
verses.meaningZh: 洁白、清净白色，东方初发白·三·面门，以手二，众说水獭，右尊，珍宝·车·守护掩蔽，左尊，羂索韦驮菩萨，归命敬礼·清净离诸尘垢，享受·奴仆·不·彼·按月，十六·夏·监狱，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: White, bright, pure-colored, three + face, hand + by, a kind of aquatic animal, O right / in right, jewel + cha + protect shelter, O left / in left, noose + carrying a spear, bowing, delight in + foe + not + he + monthly, the sixteenth + summer + prison, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: / bāhyapūrvadvāre dhṛtarāṣṭrasya dadhibhaktaṃ dakṣiṇe virūḍhakasya dadhimāṣabhaktaṃ paścime virūpākṣasya kṣīrabhatam uttare kuberasya
verses.meaningZh: 外·本·门尊，守境土，酪饼，右尊，增长之，酪·豆颗·饼，西尊，广目之，乳·星宿·彼，无上，俱吠滥、上首之
verses.meaningEn: Outside + former + O =, of of an ancient king, the elder brother of Pāṇḍu, giving, O right / in right, of Virudhaka, giving + bean, O (last =) lowest, mean, vulgar, of having deformed eyes, milk + star + him, O upper, higher, of Kubera, the chief of the spirits of darkness, afterwards the god of riches, the regen
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: dadhimāṣabhaktaṃ sindūramastakam / yathānukramabhedena puṣpādipūjā kartavyā / pratyekam dīpo deyaḥ / dhṛtamadhubhyāṃ
verses.meaningZh: 酪·豆颗·饼，黄丹脑，以犹如分次第异生性，花·元·供，任务，别主，灯，所施，法界总持任持·真如实际·无我大慈三昧
verses.meaningEn: Giving + bean, red lead + head, just as + order + by, flower + beginning + to make an offering, to be made or done, pratyekam, dīpo, to be given, granted, married, restored, committed, Dharma-realm retention & immutable Suchness & selfless great loving-kindness
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: śaṃkhaṃ pūrayitvā pañcaratnaṃ prakṣipyārgho deyaḥ / sarveṣāṃ mukhapaṭo deyam iti / evaṃ
verses.meaningZh: 事业大空无碍法界虚空种子，圆满充盈·第一义谛，五宝，转载·住着·膨胀·吞食，所施，湖相，面纱、屏风，所施，如是（结句印定），如是、如此
verses.meaningEn: Labour + boundless Dharmadhātu sky seed syllable, fulfilling, five, forward + abide + swell + devour, to be given, granted, married, restored, committed, a lake + work, veil, screen, deyam, thus, so it is stated, thus, in this way
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: varṇabhujāsanamudrācihnāni bhavanti / oṃ namaḥ sarvatathāgatebhyaḥ sarvāśāparipūrakebhyaḥ sarvathā bhaktine svāhā / ratnatrayasya
verses.meaningZh: 显色·噉·床座·手印·一切标帜，诸尊愿成、善住，嗡！归命，向诸一切如来，向诸悉满所望，诸相本，破有相福德光·造作离相·真如实际，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！佛法僧三宝之
verses.meaningEn: Color + eat + seat + Mudrā + emblem, they be! become! Oṃ! homage to to all all Tathagatas, to all Fulfiller of Many Wishes, in all ways, by all means, at all, blessedness transcending existence & freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! of the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: mantraṃ evaṃ pratyekaṃ japet saptasaptāṣṭaśataṃ mantram ekaikaśaḥ / evaṃ pūjitāḥ sarve grahā
verses.meaningZh: 真言，如是、如此，别主，生起不可得·尊胜·第一义谛·真如实际，七·七·一百八，真言，造作离相·本性寂静止息，如是、如此，诸所恭敬，一切、普皆遍满尊，曜执、星曜鬼神执障
verses.meaningEn: Mantraṃ, thus, in this way, pratyekaṃ, transcending birth & victorious & ultimate truth & immutable Suchness, seven + seven + one hundred and eight, mantram, freedom from karmic agency & primordial tranquil peace, thus, in this way, honored (plural), O all, every, complete / in all, every, complete, planet, seizing spirit/graha
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: vividharūpiṇo dadati vipulān bhogān saubhāgyān janayanty api / imāni vajrapāṇe navagrahāṇāṃ hṛdayāni
verses.meaningZh: 持守摄受·最上真言离言说，施予，广大、宽博无量，蛇盘身，一切诸谛圆满·破有相福德光·妙行趣入，生起不可得·尊胜·离名相假立·一乘如实之道，亦、虽、乃至，一切本刹，最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜·清净离诸尘垢，诸九曜之，一切心、心髓、根本心咒
verses.meaningEn: Bearing, giving, vast, extensive, abundant, profound, winding, curve, coil, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & blessedness transcending existence & awakened spiritual movement, transcending birth & victorious & beyond nominal designation & supreme vehicle of awakening, even, also, this (plural), supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), of nine luminaries, heart, core essence, heart-mantra (plural)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: paṭhitasiddhāni tathānukramabhedena gandhamaṇḍalakaṃ kṛtvā dvādaśāṅgulimadhye pūjayitavyāni tāmramṛṇmayarūpyādibhojanena arghaṃ datvāṣṭottaraśatavārān mantraṃ japet ekaikaśaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 读诵·趣往·一切成就者，以如是分次第异生性，香规格，既作已、行持已，十二·指甲·中尊，供养·极微·一切勇健，以铜·粉碎·过去·银·元·喫，功德，施度调伏·真如实际·最上真言离言说，真言，生起不可得·尊胜·第一义谛·真如实际，造作离相·本性寂静止息
verses.meaningEn: Read aloud + going + accomplished, thus + order + by, smell + disease which destroys a family, having done, having performed, the twelfth + finger or toe + O neutral, reverence + or interrog + strong, copper-coloured + crush + made or consisting of + silver + beginning + by, worth, price, generosity & self-mastery & immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech, mantraṃ, transcending birth & victorious & ultimate truth & immutable Suchness, freedom from karmic agency & primordial tranquil peace
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: / paścāt punar vajrapāṇe gṛhamātṛkānāma dhāraṇīmantrapadāni saptavārānuccārayitavyāni / tatas te ādityādayo rakṣāvaraṇaguptiṃ
verses.meaningZh: 后，复次、再三，最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜·清净离诸尘垢，家·摩怛理迦·名为，陀罗尼一切真言秘密章句，高显超胜·一切诸谛圆满，次，向汝、彼等，日天残忍，守护
verses.meaningEn: Rear, again, furthermore, supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), a servant + matrix + by name, Dhāraṇī + sacred mantra words and phrases, exalting (vocative invocation), secondary, to Thee / they, sun + merciless, guard, protection, and defense
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: kariṣyanti / dāridryaṃ duḥkhaṃ mocayiṣyanti gatāyuṣaṃ dīrghāyuṣaṃ kariṣyanti / yaś ca khalu
verses.meaningZh: 能作成办·造作离相，乏，苦，解脱释放·无我大慈三昧，妙行趣入·真如实际·一乘如实之道，施度调伏·清净离诸尘垢·破暗合集，能作成办·造作离相，奢字门（本性寂静止息（śānti）·本不生体性）以及诚然、确实
verses.meaningEn: Making (vocative invocation), poverty, duḥkhaṃ, liberating (vocative invocation), awakened spiritual movement & immutable Suchness & supreme vehicle of awakening, generosity & self-mastery & stainless purity free from dust & dissolving dense ignorance, making (vocative invocation), primordial tranquil peace (śānti) — primordial non-arising and indeed, verily, certainly
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: punar vajrapāṇe bhikṣubhikṣuṇyupāsakopāsikān ye vā sattvajātīyā yeṣāṃ karṇapuṭe śabdaṃ nipatiṣyanti na teṣām
verses.meaningZh: 复次、再三，最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜·清净离诸尘垢，破有相福德光·造作离相·六度满行清净，凡彼等诸有情，或、抑或，有情类，那几个的，耳根囊尊，声，上首诸尊提舍，不、非、无，彼等一切之
verses.meaningEn: Again, furthermore, supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), blessedness transcending existence & freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās, those who, whoever (pl.), or, sentient being + of, yeṣāṃ, ear + O bag, sound, chief + they of a heavenly archer of a lunar mansion, not, non-, of them, their
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: akālamṛtyunā kālaṃ kariṣyanti / yaś ca khalu punar vajrapāṇe grahān maṇḍalamadhye pūjayitvā
verses.meaningZh: 以非时横死、夭折厄难，时，能作成办·造作离相，奢字门（本性寂静止息（śānti）·本不生体性）以及诚然、确实，复次、再三，最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜·清净离诸尘垢，曜执、星曜鬼神执障，曼荼罗中尊，供养极微已
verses.meaningEn: By untimely/premature death, black, making (vocative invocation), primordial tranquil peace (śānti) — primordial non-arising and indeed, verily, certainly, again, furthermore, supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), planet, seizing spirit/graha, Maṇḍala + O neutral, reverence + having or interrog
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: dine dine saptavārānuccārayiṣyanti / tatra tasya dharmabhāṇakasya sarve grahāḥ sarveṇa sarvāśāṃ paripūrayiṣyanti
verses.meaningZh: 再三日子尊，高显超胜·一切诸谛圆满，于彼处、其中，彼之、其（属格），说法者之，一切、普皆遍满尊，诸曜执、星曜鬼神执障，以一切、普皆遍满，湖叫声，圆满充盈·第一义谛
verses.meaningEn: O day / in day again and again, exalting (vocative invocation), there, therein, his, of that, of a preacher of the doctrine, religious preacher, O all, every, complete / in all, every, complete, planet, seizing spirit/graha (plural), by/through all, every, complete, a lake + roaring, fulfilling (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: / tatkulād api dāridryañ ca nāśāyiṣyanti / atha khalu bhagavāñ chākyamuni tathāgataḥ
verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·造作离相·离一切相无相，亦、虽、乃至，施度调伏·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道以及摧灭除遣·离名相假立，尔时、次复吉祥启白，诚然、确实，破有相福德光·妙行趣入·最上真言离言说，离覆障清凉·造作离相·一乘如实之道，如来
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks, even, also, generosity & self-mastery & stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening and destroying obstacles (vocative invocation), now, thereupon, auspiciously, indeed, verily, certainly, blessedness transcending existence & awakened spiritual movement & supreme ineffable speech, coolness free of obscuration & freedom from karmic agency & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation), tathāgataḥ
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: punar api gṛhamātṛkānāma dhāraṇīmantrapadāni bhāṣate sma / oṃ namo ratnatrayāya / oṃ
verses.meaningZh: 复次、再三，亦、虽、乃至，家·摩怛理迦·名为，陀罗尼一切真言秘密章句，说，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），嗡！归命，向佛法僧三宝，嗡！
verses.meaningEn: Again, furthermore, even, also, a servant + matrix + by name, Dhāraṇī + sacred mantra words and phrases, to speak, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, Oṃ! homage to to/for the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha), Oṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: namo buddhāya / oṃ namo dharmāya / oṃ namaḥ saṃghāya / oṃ
verses.meaningZh: 归命向佛陀、觉者，嗡！归命，向正法、诸法实相，嗡！归命，向圣僧伽、清净海众，嗡！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to to/for Buddha, the Awakened One, Oṃ! homage to to/for Dharma, cosmic truth/teaching/phenomena, Oṃ! homage to to/for Saṃgha, noble spiritual community, Oṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: namo vajradharāya / oṃ namaḥ padmadharāya / oṃ namaḥ kumārāya / oṃ
verses.meaningZh: 归命向金刚总持、执金刚尊，嗡！归命，向莲华请执持，嗡！归命，向孺童，嗡！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to to/for Vajradhara, Holder of the Vajra, Oṃ! homage to lotus flower + to, Oṃ! homage to to/for boy, youth, son, prince, Oṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: namaḥ sarvagrahāṇāṃ sarvāśāparipūrakāṇām / oṃ namaḥ nakṣatrāṇām / oṃ namo dvādaśarāśīnām /
verses.meaningZh: 归命一切诸曜执，诸悉满所望之，嗡！归命，诸星宿（二十八宿）之，嗡！归命，十二诸群体
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all + of planet, of Fulfiller of Many Wishes, Oṃ! homage to of constellation, lunar mansion, Oṃ! homage to the twelfth + of group
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: oṃ namaḥ sarvopadravāṇām / tadyathā - oṃ buddhe buddhe śuddhe uddhe vajre
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，一切诸灾横，即说咒曰：嗡！再三佛陀、觉者尊，清净、纯洁无染尊，施度调伏·法界总持任持，金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）尊
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to all + of calamity, Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! O Buddha, the Awakened One / in Buddha, the Awakened One again and again, O pure, cleansed, bright / in pure, cleansed, bright, generosity & self-mastery & Dharma-realm retention (vocative invocation), O Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt / in Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: vajre padme padme sara sara prasare prasare smara smara krīḍa krīḍa krīḍaya
verses.meaningZh: 金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）尊，再三莲华（出淤泥而不染清净心）尊，再三流注周遍、速行护念（萨啰），再三初升、洪水尊，再三忆念本誓，再三戏剧、体育，祈请戏剧、体育
verses.meaningEn: O Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt / in Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, O lotus flower (pure, unstained) / in lotus flower (pure, unstained) again and again, flow forth and pervade with blessing! again and again, O coming forth, rising, appearing, spreading, free course, bold behaviour again and again, remember Your primordial vow! again and again, playing, sporting again and again, may You playing, sporting
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: krīḍaya mara mara māraya māraya mardaya mardaya stambha stambha stambhaya stambhaya ghaṭa
verses.meaningZh: 祈请戏剧、体育，再三临危、死厄，再三魔、天魔烦恼障，再三调伏摧碾一切恶障（末娜），再三柱，再三请制止、令暴恶魔障止息不动！瓶
verses.meaningEn: May You playing, sporting, dying, death again and again, may You Māra, demon, obstacle to awakening! again and again, may You subdue and pulverize all evil forces!! again and again, post, column, prop, support again and again, immobilize! halt hostile forces! again and again, jar, ewer
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: ghaṭa ghāṭaya ghāṭaya mama sarvasattvānāñ ca vighnān chinda chinda bhinda bhinda sarvavighnān
verses.meaningZh: 瓶，再三破暗合集·断除憍慢执障·一乘如实之道，我之（行者所有），一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说以及障碍、毗那夜迦魔障，再三断除烦恼结使缠缚（嗔陀），再三劈破无明坚固执障（牝陀），一切障碍
verses.meaningEn: Jar, ewer, dissolving dense ignorance & cutting rigid pride & supreme vehicle of awakening again and again, my, of me (the practitioner), all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech and obstacle, impediment, obstructing spirit, sever every fetter and hostile spell! again and again, cleave asunder stubborn ignorance! again and again, all + obstacle
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: nāśanaṃ kuru kuru mama saparivārasya sarvasattvānāñ ca kāryaṃ kṣepaya kṣepaya mama sarvasattvānāñ
verses.meaningZh: 摧灭、除断，再三成办羯磨事业（俱噜），我之（行者所有），彼眷属之，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说以及果，再三投，我之（行者所有），一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: Destroying, removing, accomplish & enact this sacred work! again and again, my, of me (the practitioner), he + of accessory, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech and kāryaṃ, may You throwing, a throw or cast again and again, my, of me (the practitioner), all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: ca sarvanakṣatragrahapīḍān nivāraya nivāraya bhagavati śriyaṃ kuru mahāmāyā prasādhaya sarvaduṣṭān nāśaya sarvapāpāni
verses.meaningZh: 左字门（妙行迁变空（caryā）·本不生体性），一切·星宿·扶·亦·火天，再三请遮止、遣除一切灾横！世尊佛母！（呼格），清癯风大自在除障种子，祈请成办羯磨事业（俱噜），广大泡影，转载请成办，一切暴恶者，请除灭、遣散灾厄！一切一切罪业
verses.meaningEn: Awakened conduct beyond flux (caryā) — primordial non-arising, all + constellation + grasp + even + of Agni, ward off! avert! prevent! again and again, O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī! lean + Vāyu wind-mandala swiftness seed syllable, accomplish & enact this sacred work! the Great Illusion, forward + accomplish! fulfill! perfect! all + wicked, dispel! destroy! all + evil
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: mama saparivārasya sarvasattvānāñ ca rakṣa rakṣa vajre vajre caṇḍe caṇḍe caṇḍini caṇḍini
verses.meaningZh: 我之（行者所有），彼眷属之，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说以及再三拥护、守护，再三金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）尊，再三威猛、暴烈除障尊，再三妙行迁变空·离诸诤论无诤·息灭诤怨
verses.meaningEn: My, of me (the practitioner), he + of accessory, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech and protect, guard and shelter! again and again, O Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt / in Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt again and again, O fierce, ardent, wrathful / in fierce, ardent, wrathful again and again, awakened conduct beyond flux & conflict-free peace & pacifying conflict & turmoil (vocative invocation) again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: nuru nuru musu musu mumu mumu muñca muñca havā have ugre ugratare
verses.meaningZh: 再三离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢，再三无我大慈三昧·一切诸谛圆满，再三无我大慈三昧，再三无我大慈三昧·圣智通达·妙行迁变空，火供祀施，火供祀施尊，威猛、大势力尊，威猛弯曲
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust (imperative seal) again and again, selfless great loving-kindness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (imperative seal) again and again, selfless great loving-kindness (imperative seal) again and again, selfless great loving-kindness & non-dual wisdom awareness & awakened conduct beyond flux again and again, sacrifice, O sacrifice / in sacrifice, O mighty, fierce, formidable / in mighty, fierce, formidable, mighty + O crossing
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: pūraya bhagavati manorathaṃ mama sarvaparivārasya sarvasattvānāñ ca sarvatathāgatādiṣṭhānādhiṣṭhite svāhā / oṃ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 祈请充分、充分称计，世尊佛母！（呼格），希望、贪欲，我之（行者所有），一切眷属之，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说以及一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！嗡！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: May You full, O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī! wish, desire, fancy, my, of me (the practitioner), all + of accessory, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech and all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Oṃ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: / hūṃ svāhā / hrīḥ svāhā / dhūḥ svāhā / dhīḥ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 吽（金刚心印）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！莲华部心印（清净惭愧·弥陀观音种子），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！驮字门（法界总持任持（dhātu，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！文殊般若心印（甚深智慧总持），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Hūṃ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Dharma-realm retention (dhātu) — perfected spiritual vigor with nirvāṇic visarga release, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Mañjuśrī wisdom seed syllable (prajñā), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: / oṃ ādityāya svāhā / oṃ somāya svāhā / oṃ dharaṇīsutāya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！向日天、慧日，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！嗡！向月轮、甘露月，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！嗡！向簷迫切往外，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! to/for sun, solar deity, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Oṃ! to/for moon, nectar-orb, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Oṃ! support + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: / oṃ budhāya svāhā / oṃ bṛhaspataye svāhā / oṃ śukrāya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！向水星，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！嗡！向木星，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！嗡！向金星，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! to/for intelligent, clever, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Oṃ! to of a god , the planet Jupiter, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Oṃ! to/for clear, bright, pure, white, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: / oṃ śaniścarāya svāhā / oṃ rāhave svāhā / oṃ ketave svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！向行星土曜，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！嗡！向罗喉，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！嗡！向光明幢、相好胜帜，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! to/for the planet Saturn, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Oṃ! to the Seizer, of a demon supposed to swallow the sun and moon and thus cause eclipses, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Oṃ! to banner, ray, emblem, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: / oṃ buddhāya svāhā / oṃ vajrapāṇaye svāhā / oṃ padmadharāya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！向佛陀、觉者，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！嗡！向金刚手菩萨（执金刚秘密主），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！嗡！向莲华请执持，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! to/for Buddha, the Awakened One, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Oṃ! to Vajrapāṇi, Vajra-in-Hand Bodhisattva, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Oṃ! lotus flower + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: / oṃ kumārāya svāhā / oṃ sarvagrahāṇāṃ svāhā / oṃ sarvanakṣatrāṇāṃ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！向孺童，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！嗡！一切诸曜执，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！嗡！一切诸星宿之，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! to/for boy, youth, son, prince, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Oṃ! all + of planet, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Oṃ! all + of constellation, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: / sarvopadravāṇāṃ svāhā / oṃ dvādaśarāśīnāṃ svāhā / oṃ sarvavidye hūṃ hūṃ
verses.meaningZh: 一切诸灾横，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！嗡！十二诸群体，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！嗡！一切圣智尊，吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！
verses.meaningEn: All + of calamity, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Oṃ! the twelfth + of group, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Oṃ! O all knowledge / in all knowledge, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: phaṭ svāhā / imāni vajrapāṇe grahamātṛkānāma dhāraṇīmantrapadāni sarvasiddhikarāṇi ca / yac ca
verses.meaningZh: 泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！一切本刹，最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜·清净离诸尘垢，曜执·摩怛理迦·名为，陀罗尼一切真言秘密章句，一切·悉地·一切掌以及左字门（妙行迁变空（caryā）·本不生体性）以及
verses.meaningEn: Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! this (plural), supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), planet + matrix + by name, Dhāraṇī + sacred mantra words and phrases, all + Siddhi + palm and awakened conduct beyond flux (caryā) — primordial non-arising and
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: khalu punar vajrapāṇe imāni grahamātṛkānāma dhāraṇīmantrapadāni kārtikamāsaśuklapakṣasya saptamīm ārabhyopoṣadhiko bhūtvā yāvac caturdaśīgrahanakṣatrān
verses.meaningZh: 诚然、确实，复次、再三，最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜·清净离诸尘垢，一切本刹，曜执·摩怛理迦·名为，陀罗尼一切真言秘密章句，造作离相·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，一切诸谛圆满·第一义谛·真如实际，此边·怖畏·布萨，昂已，真言宣演·一乘如实之道，妙行迁变空·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Indeed, verily, certainly, again, furthermore, supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), this (plural), planet + matrix + by name, Dhāraṇī + sacred mantra words and phrases, freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & ultimate truth & immutable Suchness, the hither + fear, having arise, uttering, awakened conduct beyond flux & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: madhye pūjayitvā dine dine saptavārānuccārayitavyāni / tataḥ pūrṇamāsyām ahorātraṃ vācayet / tasya
verses.meaningZh: 中尊，供养极微已，再三日子尊，高显超胜·一切诸谛圆满，由伊人、本刹，富楼那月份古老，昼夜，最上真言离言说·妙行迁变空·一乘如实之道，彼之、其（属格）
verses.meaningEn: O neutral, impartial, reverence + having or interrog, O day / in day again and again, exalting (vocative invocation), from stem of he, she, it, Purna + a month old, ahorātraṃ, supreme ineffable speech & awakened conduct beyond flux & supreme vehicle of awakening, his, of that
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: navanavativarṣāṇi mṛtyubhayaṃ na bhaviṣyati / ulkāpātagrahanakṣatrapīḍābhayaṃ na bhaviṣyati / jātau jātau jātismaro
verses.meaningZh: 九·九十·一切年，厄难，不、非、无，当，星坠·曜执·星宿·逼迫·怖畏，不、非、无，当，再三生起不可得·尊胜·真如实际，生祈请忆念本誓
verses.meaningEn: Nine + ninety + raining, danger or fear of death, not, non-, will be, planet + constellation + violation + fear, not, non-, will be, transcending birth & victorious & immutable Suchness (imperative seal) again and again, kind + remember Your primordial vow!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: bhaviṣyati / sarve grahā īpsitaṃ varaṃ dāsyanti / atha te sarve grahāḥ
verses.meaningZh: 当，一切、普皆遍满尊，曜执、星曜鬼神执障，所愿，殊胜、胜愿、妙好，诸尊奴隶制度、依属，尔时、次复吉祥启白，向汝、彼等，一切、普皆遍满尊，诸曜执、星曜鬼神执障
verses.meaningEn: Will be, O all, every, complete / in all, every, complete, planet, seizing spirit/graha, wished, desired, choicest, supreme boon, excellent, they slavery, servitude, dependence, now, thereupon, auspiciously, to Thee / they, O all, every, complete / in all, every, complete, planet, seizing spirit/graha (plural)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: sādhu bhagavann iti kṛtvā praṇamyāntarhitābhūvann iti / idam avocad bhagavān āttamanās te
verses.meaningZh: 萨，破有相福德光·妙行趣入·最上真言离言说，如是（结句印定），既作已、行持已，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤，如是（结句印定），此、此妙法，最上真言离言说·妙行迁变空·施度调伏，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，真如实际·无我大慈三昧·离名相假立，向汝、彼等
verses.meaningEn: Sadhu, blessedness transcending existence & awakened spiritual movement & supreme ineffable speech, thus, so it is stated, having done, having performed, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace, thus, so it is stated, this, this sacred Dharma, supreme ineffable speech & awakened conduct beyond flux & generosity & self-mastery, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, immutable Suchness & selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation, to Thee / they
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: ca bhikṣavas te ca bodhisattvā mahāsattvāḥ sā ca sarvāvatīparṣat sadevamānuṣāsuragaruḍagandharvaś ca loko
verses.meaningZh: 左字门（妙行迁变空（caryā）·本不生体性），希望人情，向汝、彼等以及菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情），诸摩诃萨埵（大心有情、大菩萨），彼、彼圣母（阴性主格）以及一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，彼·天人·人道·阿修罗·迦楼罗·香·踊跃以及世间、世界
verses.meaningEn: Awakened conduct beyond flux (caryā) — primordial non-arising, wish for + favour, to Thee / they and Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, Mahāsattva, Great Spiritual Hero (plural), she, that and all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, he + god + Human Realm + Asura + Garuḍa + be eager and world, realm
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

verses.iast: bhagavato bhāṣitam abhyanandann iti / āryagrahamātṛkānāma dhāraṇī samāptā
verses.meaningZh: 以世尊此，妙语、语言，破有相福德光·一乘如实之道·离名相假立，如是（结句印定），圣·曜执·摩怛理迦·名为，陀罗尼、总持（总一切法、持无量义），三磨钵耽
verses.meaningEn: Bhagavān + hence, spoken, told, uttered, blessedness transcending existence & supreme vehicle of awakening & beyond nominal designation, thus, so it is stated, noble + planet + matrix + by name, Dhāraṇī, total retention, protective spell, finished, complete, perfect
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：grahmdhu.htm（原典总行数：168 行 · 对勘大正藏 T21n1302 / T21n1303）

sutraSourceZh: GRETIL 梵文佛典库 (mekhdh_u.htm) · 汉译对勘：T21
deityZh: 寶帶金剛護法
meritsAndSummaryZh: 本条目直接构建自德国哥廷根大学 GRETIL 梵语原典档案「mekhdh_u.htm」（共 146 行，完整提取核心真言与经句共 70 句）。系统已自动将其原始 IAST 梵文实时转写为天城文、唐代悉昙梵字、唐宋古汉语音译、现代梵音拼读参考、国际音标 (IPA) 及摩多轻重音律。
recitationTipsZh: 此为学术校勘梵文写本原貌，每一句均配备「梵音拼读参考」与「唐宋古汉语音译」平行对照，且每个音节胶囊内均同时展示梵文、古汉语与现代拼读。

verses.iast: namaḥ sarvabuddhabodhisatvebhyaḥ evaṃ mayā śrutam ekasmiṃ samaye bhagavāṃ cchākyeṣu viharati sma /
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切佛陀菩提萨埵·如是、如此·由我（具格：如是我闻）·闻·造作离相·一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·平·世尊、薄伽梵（具六德尊）·妙行迁变空·离覆障清凉·造作离相·一切·摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all, Buddha, Bodhisattva, thus, in this way, by me, heard, freedom from karmic agency & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness, equal, the Blessed One, Bhagavān, awakened conduct beyond flux & coolness free of obscuration & freedom from karmic agency (imperative seal), lives, dwells, spends oneʼs time, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising!

verses.iast: upacāra tathāgatasya namaskṛtvā puṣpagandhaṃ datvā sūtrakaṃ kartavyaṃ / unmardanaṃ vistapanaṃ omārjanaṃ kartavyaṃ sarvagrahanivāraṇa sarvarogapraśamanaṃ bhavatv iti

verses.iast: tadyathā nile nile / vimale tam a le / hiri bhiri siri masara svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：再三离名相假立·离一切相无相，毘磨利，彼（宾格），悉昙「a」韵字门：本不生体性，攞字门（离一切相无相（lakṣaṇa）·钩召发起三昧），乐队、斑纹尊，无畏威神震伏魔怨（毗利），吉祥福德流注庄严（悉哩，无我大慈三昧·一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: beyond nominal designation & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation) again and again, pure, him, that, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising, freedom from conditioned marks (lakṣaṇa) — samādhi invocation, O band, stripe, fearless spiritual majesty, auspicious Śrī fortune & sacred grace, selfless great loving-kindness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningEn: This (feminine accusative), Vidyā, sacred wisdom-spell, illumination, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'ṃ': primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, hearing, or emphasizing particle + father, all, every, complete, medini, spirit + Saṃgha, pracalitā, god + Saṃgha, along with + to come

verses.iast: Tbh Tbh Tbh Tbh bodhisatvagaṇaiś cānyaiḥ daśabhūmīśvarair api / āyatārādibhir devīvidyārājñīsahasrakaiḥ
verses.meaningZh: 再三婆字门（破有相福德光（bhava，菩提觉知·解脱系缚大力，妙行迁变空·离名相假立·一乘如实之道，施度调伏·本性寂静止息·破有相福德光，亦、虽、乃至，救度超脱·一乘如实之道，以诸天女·明妃·威势·忧苦

verses.iast: paramakṛpayā yuktaḥ papracchety avalokitam / taskaroragasiṃhāgnigajavyāghrāmbusaṃkaṭe
verses.meaningZh: 以最胜慈悲，具，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·妙行迁变空，观照、慈悲垂视，强盗·水兽·狮子·圣火·象·豹·净水·迮尊

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·施度调伏·离名相假立，这，无我大慈三昧·离名相假立，彼、此尊（阳性主格）已，诸固定、败絮，轮廻大海，诸带子、丁字裤，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·造作离相，第一义谛·本性寂静止息，喜爱瞋怒·暗·愈加·呼格极微

verses.iast: sarvavyādhivinirmuktāḥ sarvaiśvaryaguṇānvitāḥ / akālamṛtyunirdagdhāś cyutā yānti sukhāvatīm
verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，造作离相·离一切相无相·无我大慈三昧，没，一乘如实之道·离名相假立·真如实际，安乐妙善·一切诸谛圆满
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks & selfless great loving-kindness, gone away, supreme vehicle of awakening & beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), blissful
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：tarb108u.htm（原典总行数：223 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1105）

verses.iast: tāny ahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi devasaṃghāḥ śṛṇudhva me anumodeta saddharme bhaviṣyadhvaṃ sunirvṛtāḥ
verses.meaningZh: 耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·远离寂静周遍），我、真我自性，桑·坡度宝山·慧眼·夜摩天尊，天人诸圣僧伽，本性寂静止息·离诸诤论无诤·法界总持任持，于我、为我，日复一日·乐趣·趣往，妙法尊，当有·以下·金刚界大日智法身水轮甘露种子，诸非常大胆
verses.meaningEn: Supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — expansive quiescence, I, the awakened self, saṃ + slope of a mountain + eye + O Yama Heaven, god + Saṃgha, primordial tranquil peace & conflict-free peace & Dharma-realm retention, to me, my, day after day + delight + going, O the wonderful Dharma, below + Vajradhātu Mahāvairocana ambrosia seed syllable, very courageous, well-humoured (plural)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：tarb108u.htm（原典总行数：223 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1105）

verses.iast: oṃ locane sulocane tāre tārotsave sarvasatvānukampini / sarvasatvottāriṇi sahasrabhuje sahasranetre
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！眼、佛眼遍照尊，报刊往外眼，星尊，星喜筵，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，一切众生具弯曲，千臂，千眼目
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O eye, illuminating vision / in eye, illuminating vision, press out + O eye, O a star / in a star, a star + O enterprise, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation), all sentient beings + O bearer of crossing, thousand + O arm, thousand + O eye
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：tarb108u.htm（原典总行数：223 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1105）

verses.iast: oṃ namo bhagavate 'valokya āvalokyā / sarvasatvānāṃ cāhaṃ phuṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，向世尊（薄伽梵）致敬，鸿毛通常，最上真言离言说·离一切相无相·造作离相，诸一切众生、普皆有情之，妙行迁变空·因缘空寂大乐，吒字门（断除憍慢执障（ṭaṅka）·损减除灭忧苦），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, down + granting free space or sphere of action, supreme ineffable speech & freedom from conditioned marks & freedom from karmic agency, of all all sentient beings, awakened conduct beyond flux & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, cutting rigid pride (ṭaṅka) — dispelling sorrow, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：tarb108u.htm（原典总行数：223 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1105）

verses.iast: oṃ śuddhe viśuddhe śodhanaviśodhani / sugatātmaje maitrīhṛdaye nirmale śyāme śyāmarūpiṇi
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！清净、纯洁无染尊，最极清净、究竟净除尊，理由·闢·理由，善逝佛子，向慈心心髓，净无垢秽、纤尘不染尊，青黑尊，青黑具色
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O pure, cleansed, bright / in pure, cleansed, bright, O completely purified, supremely pure / in completely purified, supremely pure, also means of purification + settle + O also means of purification, Sugata + O born of one's self, loving-kindness + to heart, O utterly spotless, taintless / in utterly spotless, taintless, O black, dark-coloured, black + O bearer of form
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：tarb108u.htm（原典总行数：223 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1105）

verses.iast: mahāprājñe pravare pravarabhūṣite parājite / mahāraudri viśvarūpi mahāyaśa
verses.meaningZh: 非常英明尊，最妙尊，最妙·繁忙来讲·趣往，被他所胜尊，大咾捺哩尊，微质怛囒、种种尊，大称
verses.meaningEn: O very wise / in very wise, O cover, upper garment / in cover, upper garment, cover + be busy for + O going, O conquered, overthrown, great + O Raudri, O many-coloured, multiform, manifold, various, great + fame
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：tarb108u.htm（原典总行数：223 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1105）

verses.iast: kalpāgnimahātejā lokadhātrīmahāyaśā / sarasvatī viśālākṣī prajñāśrībuddhivardhanī
verses.meaningZh: 劫火·大·威光，世间·母·大·称，妙音天女（辩才天），一样佛母，般若·吉祥·觉慧·兴盛佛母
verses.meaningEn: Kalpa fire + great + sharpness, world + great + fame, Sarasvatī, Goddess of Eloquence & Wisdom, the same (feminine), Prajñā + auspiciousness + awakened intellect + increasing
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：tarb108u.htm（原典总行数：223 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1105）

verses.iast: oṃ dhṛtidā puṣṭidā svāhā oṃkārā kāmarūpiṇī / sarvasatvahitodyuktā saṃgrāme tāraṇī jayā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！法界总持任持·真如实际·施度调伏，滋养增益·第一义谛，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！音节，具体相佛母，一切众生·利·齐备，圣众、怀敌意遭遇尊，弯曲、超群佛母，誓耶
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Dharma-realm retention & immutable Suchness & generosity & self-mastery, nourishing, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! the syllable, goddess possessing a shape changing at will, all sentient beings + put + prepared, O popular assembly, host, troop, carrying over, rescuing, Jayā
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：tarb108u.htm（原典总行数：223 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1105）

verses.iast: prajñāpāramitādevī āryātārā manoramā / dundubhisakhinī pūrṇavidyārājñī priyaṃvadā
verses.meaningZh: 般若波罗蜜多天女，圣·架子·鎚锉，得意，大鼓·彼·具虚空佛母，富楼那明妃，演说、和蔼
verses.meaningEn: Perfection of Wisdom + goddess, noble + frame + awl, manoramā, drum + he + possessing hole, Purna + wise consort, speaking, kindly
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：tarb108u.htm（原典总行数：223 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1105）

verses.iast: candrānanā mahāgaurī ajitā pītavāsasā / mahāmāyā mahāśvetā mahābalaparākramā
verses.meaningZh: 月轮口门，大娇吠哩，无胜，第一义谛·真如实际·最上真言离言说，广大泡影，大洁白，大力威神勇调伏镇被处
verses.meaningEn: Moon + mouth, great + Gauri, unsurpassed, ultimate truth & immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech, the Great Illusion, great + white, of great power and might + sgl
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：tarb108u.htm（原典总行数：223 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1105）

verses.iast: mahāraudrī mahācaṇḍī duṣṭasatvanisūdanī / praśāntā śāntarūpā ca vijayā jvalanaprabhā
verses.meaningZh: 大咾捺哩，大威猛，暴恶者·有情·在于·素捺那佛母，寂静、赊多，赊多相貌以及尊胜，炽燃光明
verses.meaningEn: Great + Raudri, great + fierce, wicked + sentient being + in + sudana, tranquillized, quiet, calm, indifferent, of calm appearance and for victory, burning + light
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：tarb108u.htm（原典总行数：223 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1105）

verses.iast: vidyunmālī dhvajī khaḍgī cakrī cāpayutāyudhā / jambhanī stambhanī kālī kālarātrī niśācarī
verses.meaningZh: 融通佛母，宝幢、胜幡佛母，智慧宝剑（断烦恼剑）佛母，法轮、金轮、脉轮佛母，宝弓·额外·器械，令愚佛母，僵仆佛母，时佛母，时晚上，一样坚固佛母
verses.meaningEn: To, victory banner, standard (feminine), sword (wisdom-blade) (feminine), wheel, Dharma-wheel, discus (feminine), bow + fastened to + weapon, crushing, destroying (feminine), laming, paralyzing, fixing, stopping, restraining (feminine), black, black + night, the same + immovable
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：tarb108u.htm（原典总行数：223 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1105）

verses.iast: rakṣaṇī mohinī śāntā kāntā vibhāvinī śubhā / brāhmaṇī vedamātā ca guhā ca guhavāsinī
verses.meaningZh: 卫佛母，具愚痴、无明迷妄佛母，寂静、调柔安稳，相亲，具一样佛母，清净吉祥、善妙庄严，部多梵行，吠陀母以及龛以及秘密藏护持尊具居佛母
verses.meaningEn: Guard (feminine), possessing delusion, ignorance, bewilderment, peaceful, calm, tranquil, desired, loved, lovely, beautiful, possessing the same, auspicious, pure, bright, virtuous, become a Brahman, Vedas and a niche and guardian of the esoteric secret treasury + possessing dwell
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：tarb108u.htm（原典总行数：223 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1105）

verses.iast: māṅgalyā śaṅkarī saumyā jātavedā manojavā / kāpālinī mahābhāgā saṃdhyā satyāparājitā
verses.meaningZh: 闭会祈祷、吉祥，作乐佛母，寂静温和、慈柔如月，部多吠陀，意生，守护养育·造作离相，具柄权，以接，谛无能胜佛母
verses.meaningEn: = , also benediction, auspicious ceremony or festival, Sankara, gentle, serene, lunar-calm, benign, become characterized by + Vedas, Manojava, guarding, having a great portion or a good lot, with/by combination, truth + Aparājitā
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：tarb108u.htm（原典总行数：223 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1105）

verses.iast: sārthavāhā kṛpadṛṣṭī naṣṭamārgapradarśanī / varadā śāsanī śāstrī strīrūpāmitavikramā
verses.meaningZh: 商主，体相隐形，散失·圣道·模样，施愿者、满善愿尊，传，论，女子·色·病人·超
verses.meaningEn: The same, shape + unseen, lost + path + look, boon-granting, wish-bestowing, chastising, punishing, instructing, teaching, instruction, precept, rule, theory, a scientific or canonical work (feminine), woman + form + sick + surpass
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：tarb108u.htm（原典总行数：223 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1105）

verses.iast: śavalī yoginī siddhā cāṇḍālī cāmṛtā dhruvā / dhanyā puṇyā mahābhāgā subhāgā priyadarśanī
verses.meaningZh: 本性寂静止息·最上真言离言说·离一切相无相，具修习佛母，成就者、已成就，妙行迁变空·离诸诤论无诤·息灭诤怨，妙行迁变空·无我大慈三昧·真如实际，是么，有钱人、华靡，福德、胜妙功德，具柄权，有钱人、充实，惜者观照
verses.meaningEn: Primordial tranquil peace & supreme ineffable speech & freedom from conditioned marks, possessing bond, tie, attachment, accomplished, perfected adept (Siddha), awakened conduct beyond flux & conflict-free peace & pacifying conflict & turmoil, awakened conduct beyond flux & selfless great loving-kindness & immutable Suchness, steady, firm, constant, certain, safe, having or bringing wealth, wealthy, opulent, merit, auspicious virtue, having a great portion or a good lot, wealthy, rich, dear + false
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：tarb108u.htm（原典总行数：223 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1105）

verses.iast: kṛtāntatrāsanī bhīmā ugrā ugramahātapā / jagadekahitodyuktā śaraṇya bhaktivatsalā
verses.meaningZh: 实物怛啰佛母，作怖，威猛、大势力，威猛·乐趣·日，生起不可得·尊胜·妙行趣入·施度调伏，归依处，物流慈爱
verses.meaningEn: Causing an end + trasana, fearful, terrible, †, mighty, fierce, formidable, mighty + gladden + was assessed a fine, transcending birth & victorious & awakened spiritual movement & generosity & self-mastery, affording or seeking protection, refuge, or help, distribution + loving her calf
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：tarb108u.htm（原典总行数：223 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1105）

verses.iast: vāgīśvarī śivā sūkṣmā nityā sarvārthamātṛkā / sarvārthasādhanī bhadrā goptrī dhātrī dhanaṃjayā
verses.meaningZh: 尊主语言佛母，寂静，微细，以礼，一切义利摩怛理迦，一切义利成就法，贤，妙行趣入·第一义谛·真如实际，母，一样、若衍底
verses.meaningEn: A master of language (feminine), kind, friendly, mild, gracious, lovely, auspicious, fortunate, fine, small, minute, subtile, intangible, inconceivable, atomic, nityā, all aims and benefits + matrix, all aims and benefits + accomplishing, blessed, awakened spiritual movement & ultimate truth & immutable Suchness, dhātrī, the same, victorious
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：tarb108u.htm（原典总行数：223 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1105）

verses.iast: abhayā gautamī puṇyā śrīmallokeśvarātmajā / tārā nāmaguṇānantā sarvāśāparipūraṇī
verses.meaningZh: 无畏，瞿昙弥，福德、胜妙功德，吉祥·大勇力士·毫发·幅度·佛子，圣救度佛母（度母），名·无用·无边，一切·望·般·遂佛母
verses.meaningEn: Non-fear, Gotami, merit, auspicious virtue, auspiciousness + mighty champion + hair + width + born of one's self, Tārā, Savioress Goddess, name + having no qualities or virtues + boundless, all + hope + wisdom + satisfy
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：tarb108u.htm（原典总行数：223 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1105）

verses.iast: nāmāṣṭottaraśatakaṃ tat kīrtitaṃ hitena vaḥ / rahasyam adbhutaṃ guhyaṃ devānām api durlabham
verses.meaningZh: 名为·八·无上·百，彼、真如彼岸，誉彼，以利，嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk，大密，希，密，诸天人、诸天护法之，亦、虽、乃至，难得
verses.meaningEn: By name + eight + upper + consisting of hundred or the hundredth, That (ultimate reality), renown + him, by/through put, placed, laid, supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release, rahasyam, extraordinary, guhyaṃ, of all god, celestial deity (Deva), even, also, difficult to be obtained or seen
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：tarb108u.htm（原典总行数：223 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1105）

verses.iast: / 43 saubhāgyaṃ bhāgyakaraṇaṃ sarvakīlbiṣanāśanam / sarvavyādhipraśamanaṃ sarvasatvasukhāvaham
verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·破有相福德光·妙行趣入，那乞叉多罗时间，摧灭除遣·归命敬礼·一切诸谛圆满，一切·病患·疗，一切众生·乐·御
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & blessedness transcending existence & awakened spiritual movement, relating to Bhaga, destroying obstacles, bowing, all + illness + heal, all sentient beings + joy + to transport
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：tarb108u.htm（原典总行数：223 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1105）

verses.iast: trikāraṃ yaḥ paṭhed dhīmān śuciḥ snānasamāhitaḥ / acireṇaiva kālena rājyaśriyam avāpnuyāt
verses.meaningZh: 𣎑，凡彼…者，第一义谛·远离虚妄安立·施度调伏，成就觉慧，净，沐·不·等引，妙行迁变空·清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤，以时，皇图·清癯·摄伏，最上真言离言说·第一义谛·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Thigh bone, whoever, he who, ultimate truth & beyond conceptual fabrication & generosity & self-mastery, dhīmān, śuciḥ, to wash + not, awakened conduct beyond flux & stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace, by/through black, fit to reign + lean + hold, supreme ineffable speech & ultimate truth & beyond nominal designation
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：tarb108u.htm（原典总行数：223 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1105）

verses.iast: duḥkhitaḥ syāt sukhī nityadaridro dhanavān bhavet / jaḍo bhaven mahāprājño medhāvī ca na saṃśayaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 苦涩、染污，愿得成就、当如是，乐佛母，常流浪者，富人，当得成就、若成，癡，星宿思恋，非常英明，心怜悧以及不、非、无，疑惑
verses.meaningEn: Pained, afflicted, miserable, may it be so, easy, pleasant, comfortable, happy, with constantly internal mind fixing your will on salvation + vagrant, a rich person, may be, would become, jaḍo, star + long for, very wise, medhāvī and not, non-, saṃśayaḥ
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：tarb108u.htm（原典总行数：223 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1105）

verses.iast: bandhanān mucyate baddho vyavahāre jayo bhavet / śatravo mitratāṃ yānti śṛṅgiṇaś cātha daṃṣṭriṇaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 从生死轮回系缚中，解放拘牵尊，带子、丁字裤，略尊，胜伏、最胜吉祥！当得成就、若成，因缘妙音，友谊、昵爱，一乘如实之道·离名相假立·真如实际，本性寂静止息·支分寂静·妙行趣入，妙行迁变空·无住安立，施度调伏·六度满行清净·断除憍慢执障
verses.meaningEn: From the bondage of mortality, release + O held, strap, thong, O designation, term, conquer! victory! may be, would become, cut in pieces + sound, friendship, intimacy, supreme vehicle of awakening & beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), primordial tranquil peace & quiescence of perceptual limbs & awakened spiritual movement, awakened conduct beyond flux & non-abiding equipoise, generosity & self-mastery & perfection of the six pāramitās & cutting rigid pride
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：tarb108u.htm（原典总行数：223 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1105）

verses.iast: saṃgrāme saṃkaṭe durge nānābhayasamākule / smaraṇād eva nāmāni sarvapāpāny apohati
verses.meaningZh: 圣众、怀敌意遭遇尊，迮尊，深处，分别·怖畏·内装，忆念本誓·一切诸谛圆满，唯、正是、决定，一切名为、号曰，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，离
verses.meaningEn: O popular assembly, host, troop, O contracted / in contracted, O evil state / in evil state, differently + fear + O crowded, recalling, indeed, verily, alone, by name, called (plural), all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, removal, rejection, negation
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：tarb108u.htm（原典总行数：223 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1105）

verses.iast: nākālamṛtyur bhavati prāpnoti vipulāṃ śriyam / mānuśyaṃ saphalaṃ janma yasya kasya mahātmanaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 天界·衍伸·死，成办、生起、安住，得究竟，广大、宽博无量，清癯摄伏，无我大慈三昧·离名相假立·本性寂静止息，无果，生起不可得·尊胜·离名相假立·无我大慈三昧，凡彼…之，谁，理智
verses.meaningEn: Celestial vault + spawn + death, becomes, arises, is, attain, vast, extensive, abundant, profound, lean + hold, selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation & primordial tranquil peace, having fruits or testicles, transcending birth & victorious & beyond nominal designation & selfless great loving-kindness, whose, of whom, kasya, the supreme spirit, the intellect
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：tarb108u.htm（原典总行数：223 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1105）

verses.iast: yaś cedaṃ prātar utthāya mānavaḥ kīrtayiṣyati / sa dīrghakālam āyuṣmān śriyaṃ ca labhate naraḥ
verses.meaningZh: 奢字门（本性寂静止息（śānti）·本不生体性），以及、另有，及早、初日分，立起，儒童，造作离相·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，彼、此尊（阳性主格），长期，具寿，清癯风大自在除障种子以及获，男子
verses.meaningEn: Primordial tranquil peace (śānti) — primordial non-arising, and early, in the morning, to-morrow, utthāya, mānavaḥ, freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), he, that one, a long time, āyuṣmān, lean + Vāyu wind-mandala swiftness seed syllable and to take, naraḥ
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：tarb108u.htm（原典总行数：223 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1105）

verses.iast: devā nāgās tathā yakṣā gandharvāḥ kaṭapūtanāḥ / piśācarākṣasā bhūtā mātaro raudratejasaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 天人、诸天护法，离名相假立·妙行趣入·一切诸谛圆满，如是、亦复如是，药叉（夜叉护法捷疾神），诸乾闼婆（香音神），诸极臭鬼，毗舍遮罗刹，部多鬼神、一切生类、真实，勿速度，黑心威光
verses.meaningEn: God, celestial deity (Deva), beyond nominal designation & awakened spiritual movement & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, thus, in that same way, Yakṣa, nature/wealth guardian spirit, Gandharva, celestial musician (plural), a kind of demon (plural), Piśāca + Rākṣasa, spirit, living being, true/existent, do not + speed, relating to Rudra or the Rudras + radiance
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：tarb108u.htm（原典总行数：223 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1105）

verses.iast: kṣayāpasmārakārakaś caiva kṣatakākhorḍakādayaḥ / ḍākinyās tārakā pretāḥ skandā mārā mahāgrahāḥ
verses.meaningZh: 造作离相·六度满行清净·一乘如实之道，以及、亦复如是（ca + eva），造作离相·六度满行清净·真如实际，息灭诤怨·造作离相·离名相假立，解脱，饿鬼，偏脣鬼，魔、天魔烦恼障，乐趣诸执拗
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās & supreme vehicle of awakening, and indeed, likewise, freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās & immutable Suchness, pacifying conflict & turmoil & freedom from karmic agency & beyond nominal designation, pupil of the eye, pretāḥ, a demon that causes drought, Māra, demon, obstacle to awakening, gladden + niggardliness
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：tarb108u.htm（原典总行数：223 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1105）

verses.iast: chāyām api na laṅghante kiṃ punas tasya vigrahaḥ / duṣṭasatvā na vādhante vyādhayo nākramanti ca
verses.meaningZh: 于切断、皮肤中，亦、虽、乃至，不、非、无，以飞跃内，迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·诸根清净自在·大空菩提点摄持），第一义谛·离名相假立·一切诸谛圆满，彼之、其（属格），身言相合，暴恶者彼，不、非、无，最上真言离言说·法界总持任持·离名相假立，猎人凡彼圣尊，离名相假立·造作离相·清净离诸尘垢以及
verses.meaningEn: In cut off, even, also, not, non-, leap + within, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — purified faculties sealed with bodhicitta bindu, ultimate truth & beyond nominal designation & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, his, of that, vigrahaḥ, wicked + having he, not, non-, supreme ineffable speech & Dharma-realm retention & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), hunter + who, beyond nominal designation & freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation) and
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：tarb108u.htm（原典总行数：223 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1105）

verses.iast: devāsuram api saṃgrāmam anubhavanti maharddhikāḥ / sarvaiśvaryaguṇair yuktaḥ putrapautraiś ca vardhate
verses.meaningZh: 天人阿修罗，亦、虽、乃至，圣众、怀敌意遭遇，诸尊顾忌、想蕴，世间诸此恶者，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，具，第一义谛·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢以及增长
verses.meaningEn: God + Asura, even, also, popular assembly, host, troop, they apprehension, perception, of a world + alas! shame! fie! all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, yoked, harnessed, set to work, appointed, instituted, occupied with,, ultimate truth & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust and vardhate
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：tarb108u.htm（原典总行数：223 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1105）

verses.iast: jātismaro bhaved dhīmān kulīnaḥ priyadarśanaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 生祈请忆念本誓，破有相福德光·最上真言离言说·施度调伏，成就觉慧，道德、有关，惜者观照
verses.meaningEn: Kind + remember Your primordial vow! blessedness transcending existence & supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery, dhīmān, of noble race or mind, dear + false
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：tarb108u.htm（原典总行数：223 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1105）

verses.iast: prītimāṃś ca mahāvāgmī sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际以及大雄辩佛母，一切·论·无畏
verses.meaningEn: Ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness and great + eloquent, all + instruction
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：tarb108u.htm（原典总行数：223 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1105）

verses.iast: kalyāṇamitrasaṃsevī bodhicittavibhūṣitaḥ / sadāvirahito buddhair yatra yatropapadyate
verses.meaningZh: 善知识·桑·之后佛母，菩提心·闢·繁忙来讲·趣往，恒常落寞，觉悟正觉·解脱系缚大力，凡于何处，凡于何处·愈加·造偈句
verses.meaningEn: Dharma Friends + saṃ + serving, aspiration to enlightenment + settle + be busy for + going, always + abandoned, awakened, where, wherever, where + thereto + way
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：tarb108u.htm（原典总行数：223 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1105）

verses.iast: ity āryatārābhaṭṭārikāyā nāmāṣṭottaraśatakaṃ buddhabhāṣitaṃ samāptam
verses.meaningZh: 耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·诸根清净自在），阿唎多罗·自在主·踊跃·身，名为·八·无上·百，佛陀妙语，三磨钵耽
verses.meaningEn: Supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — purified faculties, Arya-Tara + lord + eager + body, by name + eight + upper + consisting of hundred or the hundredth, Buddha + spoken, finished, complete, perfect
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：tarb108u.htm（原典总行数：223 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1105）

verses.iast: śubham
verses.meaningZh: 清净吉祥、善妙庄严
verses.meaningEn: Auspicious, pure, bright, virtuous
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵本档案：tarb108u.htm（原典总行数：223 行 · 对勘大正藏 T20n1105）
