verses.iast: ṣaḍbhiḥ prabhedair bodhisatvasya prabhāvo vartate
verses.meaningZh: 六度满行清净·息灭诤怨·破有相福德光，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·破有相福德光，菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情）之，威，转
verses.meaningEn: Perfection of the six pāramitās & pacifying conflict & turmoil & blessedness transcending existence, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & blessedness transcending existence, of Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, prabhāvo, vartate
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：asmahsbu.htm（全书共 2523 行）

verses.iast: abhijñāvidyāvimokṣābhibhvāyatanakṛtsnāyatanāpramāṇasamādhiprabhedaiḥ
verses.meaningZh: 以诸六通·明咒·解脱·境界王位·一切处·十二处·无量·三摩地·万
verses.meaningEn: Six supernatural powers + Vidyā + liberation + sphere of sovereignty + kasina + ayatana + infinitude + Samādhi + by
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：asmahsbu.htm（全书共 2523 行）

verses.iast: evaṃ ṣaḍarthena vibhāgalakṣaṇena prabhāvaṃ darśayitvā tanmāhātmyodbhāvanārthaṃ ślokaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 如是、如此，六度满行清净·息灭诤怨·清净离诸尘垢，以离相，威，施度调伏·清净离诸尘垢·本性寂静止息，推广·自在·应作·义利，颂
verses.meaningEn: Thus, in this way, perfection of the six pāramitās & pacifying conflict & turmoil & stainless purity free from dust (by spiritual power), distribution + by, might, majesty, superhuman strength, power over, generosity & self-mastery & stainless purity free from dust & primordial tranquil peace, extend + magnanimity + manifestation + meaning, ślokaḥ
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：asmahsbu.htm（全书共 2523 行）

verses.iast: dhāraṇīnāṃ samādhīnāṃ nidhānopamam eva ca
verses.meaningZh: 诸陀罗尼、总持（总一切法、持无量义）之，诸三摩地、正定等持之，网罗无双，唯、正是、决定以及
verses.meaningEn: Of Dhāraṇī, total retention, protective spell, of Samādhi, meditative absorption, net + matchless, indeed, verily, alone and
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：asmahsbu.htm（全书共 2523 行）

verses.iast: AMsa 9.72
verses.meaningZh: 无我大慈三昧·一切诸谛圆满
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：asmahsbu.htm（全书共 2523 行）

verses.iast: svadhātuto dvayābhāsāḥ sāvidyākleśavṛttayaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·最上真言离言说·法界总持任持，二诸似，一切诸谛圆满·最上真言离言说·施度调伏
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme ineffable speech & Dharma-realm retention, both + pseudo, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：asmahsbu.htm（全书共 2523 行）

verses.iast: svadhātuta iti bhāvāṅgād ālayavijñānataḥ
verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·最上真言离言说·法界总持任持，如是（结句印定），破有相福德光·最上真言离言说·支分寂静，由阿赖耶识
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme ineffable speech & Dharma-realm retention, thus, so it is stated, blessedness transcending existence & supreme ineffable speech & quiescence of perceptual limbs, from connaissance-réceptacle
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：asmahsbu.htm（全书共 2523 行）

verses.iast: dvayābhāsā iti grāhyagrāhakābhāsāḥ
verses.meaningZh: 二似，如是（结句印定），渊博·嚩啰·诸似
verses.meaningEn: Both + pseudo, thus, so it is stated, to be seized + taking + pseudo
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：asmahsbu.htm（全书共 2523 行）

verses.iast: sahāvidyayā kleśaiś ca vṛttir eṣāṃ ta ime sāvidyākleśavṛttayaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 以娑婆明咒，造作离相·离一切相无相·本性寂静止息以及疏，此等，多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·本不生体性），怎么，一切诸谛圆满·最上真言离言说·施度调伏
verses.meaningEn: To bear + with, freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks & primordial tranquil peace and vṛttir, they, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — primordial non-arising, ime, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：asmahsbu.htm（全书共 2523 行）

verses.iast: dvayadravyavivarjitā iti grāhyadravyeṇa grāhakadravyeṇa ca
verses.meaningZh: 二·实·微蘖多，如是（结句印定），以渊博实，以嚩啰实以及
verses.meaningEn: Both + property + abandoned by, thus, so it is stated, to be seized + by, taking + by and
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：asmahsbu.htm（全书共 2523 行）

verses.iast: evaṃ kleśaḥ paryeṣitavyaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 如是、如此，烦恼、惑染尘劳，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Thus, in this way, affliction, mental defilement, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：asmahsbu.htm（全书共 2523 行）

verses.iast: vidyāsthāne pañcavidhe yogamakṛtvā sarvajñatvaṃ naiti kathaṃcit paramāryaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 明咒止尊，五部分，趣入通行·一乘如实之道，一切智汝，不如是，如何感觉，最圣
verses.meaningEn: Vidyā + O point, five + O part, going toward, omniscient + Thou, not + thus, how? in what way? whence? + perceive, paramāryaḥ
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：asmahsbu.htm（全书共 2523 行）

verses.iast: svaṃ duḥkham udvoḍhum ihāsamartho lokaḥ kutaḥ piṇḍitam anyaduḥkhaṃ
verses.meaningZh: 嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk，苦，施度调伏·最上真言离言说·法鼓觉悟，于此·无等·他，世间、世界，为谁的，充分、紧凑，他苦
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, duḥkham, generosity & self-mastery & supreme ineffable speech & awakening Dharma-drum resonance, here + tha, world, realm, kutaḥ, full, compact, other
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：asmahsbu.htm（全书共 2523 行）

verses.iast: duḥkhātmakaṃ lokam avekṣamāṇo duḥkhāyate vetti ca tadyathāvat
verses.meaningZh: 苦佛子，世间、世界，最上真言离言说·造作离相·六度满行清净，感到苦痛、染污，最上真言离言说·真如实际以及彼也他
verses.meaningEn: Suffering + son, world, realm, supreme ineffable speech & freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās, feel pain, be distressed, supreme ineffable speech & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation) and that + according to propriety
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：asmahsbu.htm（全书共 2523 行）

verses.iast: dhāraṇītāṃ samāśritya bodhisatvā punaḥ punaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 陀罗尼救度佛母根本种子字，时候·清癯·那个，菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情），再三复次、再三
verses.meaningEn: Dhāraṇī + Tārā root seed syllable Tāṃ, half-year + lean + that, Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, again, furthermore again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：asmahsbu.htm（全书共 2523 行）

verses.meaningZh: 诸陀罗尼、总持（总一切法、持无量义）之，诸三摩地、正定等持之，藏·泮·本刹·犹如以及
verses.meaningEn: Of Dhāraṇī, total retention, protective spell, of Samādhi, meditative absorption, laying down + paṃ + this + like and
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：asmahsuu.htm（全书共 2904 行）

verses.iast: Msa 9.72
verses.meaningZh: 娑字门（一切诸谛圆满（sarvasatya）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness (satya) — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：asmahsuu.htm（全书共 2904 行）

verses.iast: yathā māyā yantra parigṛhītaṃ bhrāntinimittaṃ kāṣṭhaloṣṭādikam tathābhūtaparikalpaḥ paratantraḥ svabhāvo veditavyaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 犹如、如…所说，幻化、如幻妙力，机，趣入、小气，迷惑相，薪·砖·第一，如此假定，依他起性，自性，乃是已知
verses.meaningEn: Just as, according to, illusion, magical display (Māyā), apparatus, comprehended, confusd, firewood + clod of earth + first, being so + Täuschung, dependence on others, svabhāvo, to be known
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：asmahsuu.htm（全书共 2904 行）

verses.iast: yathā māyākṛtaṃ tasyāṃ māyāyāṃ hastyaśvasuvarṇādyākṛtistadbhāvena pratibhāsitā, tathā tasminnabhūtaparikalpe dvayabhrāntirgrāhyagrāhakatvenapratibhāsitā parikalpitasvabhāvākārā veditavyā
verses.meaningZh: 犹如、如…所说，幻化所作，彼之、其（属格），于幻化、如幻妙力中，因缘空寂大乐·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际，形像洁白，如是、亦复如是，于彼处·不·部多鬼神·假定，二·迷惑·渊博·威神力想蕴·勇健·形像·洁白，分别·自性·相，乃是已知
verses.meaningEn: Just as, according to, illusion + done, his, of that, in illusion, magical display (Māyā), causal emptiness & spiritual joy & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness (by spiritual power), image + white, thus, in that same way, in that + not + spirit + O Täuschung, both + confusd + to be seized + power of perception + strong + image + white, sole imagination + own-being + disposition, to be known
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：asmahsuu.htm（全书共 2904 行）

verses.iast: svadhātuto dvayābhāsāḥ sāvidyākleśavṛttayaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·最上真言离言说·法界总持任持，二诸似，一切诸谛圆满·最上真言离言说·施度调伏
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme ineffable speech & Dharma-realm retention, both + pseudo, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：asmahsuu.htm（全书共 2904 行）

verses.iast: svadhātuta iti bhāvāṅgā dālayavijñānataḥ
verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·最上真言离言说·法界总持任持，如是（结句印定），物肢，明了觉识·施度调伏
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme ineffable speech & Dharma-realm retention, thus, so it is stated, becoming + member, discerning
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：asmahsuu.htm（全书共 2904 行）

verses.iast: dvayābhāsā iti grāhyagrāhakābhāsāḥ
verses.meaningZh: 二似，如是（结句印定），渊博·嚩啰·诸似
verses.meaningEn: Both + pseudo, thus, so it is stated, to be seized + taking + pseudo
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：asmahsuu.htm（全书共 2904 行）

verses.iast: sahāvidyayā kleśaiśca vṛttireṣāṃ ta ime sāvidyākleśavṛttayaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 以娑婆明咒，以诸烦恼、惑染尘劳及疏此等，多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·本不生体性），怎么，一切诸谛圆满·最上真言离言说·施度调伏
verses.meaningEn: To bear + with, by/with affliction, mental defilement and they, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — primordial non-arising, ime, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：asmahsuu.htm（全书共 2904 行）

verses.iast: dvayadravyavivarjitā iti grāhyadravyeṇa grāhakadravyeṇa ca
verses.meaningZh: 二·实·微蘖多，如是（结句印定），以渊博实，以嚩啰实以及
verses.meaningEn: Both + property + abandoned by, thus, so it is stated, to be seized + by, taking + by and
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：asmahsuu.htm（全书共 2904 行）

verses.iast: evaṃ kleśaḥ paryeṣitavyaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 如是、如此，烦恼、惑染尘劳，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Thus, in this way, affliction, mental defilement, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：asmahsuu.htm（全书共 2904 行）

verses.iast: vidyāsthānaparyeṣṭau ślokaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 最上真言离言说·施度调伏·一乘如实之道，颂
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery & supreme vehicle of awakening (imperative seal), ślokaḥ
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：asmahsuu.htm（全书共 2904 行）

verses.iast: vidyāsthāne pañcavidhe yogamakṛtvā sarvajñatvaṃ naiti kathaṃcitparamāryaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 明咒止尊，五部分，趣入通行·一乘如实之道，一切智汝，不如是，如何·感觉·最圣
verses.meaningEn: Vidyā + O point, five + O part, going toward, omniscient + Thou, not + thus, how? in what way? whence? + perceive
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：asmahsuu.htm（全书共 2904 行）

verses.iast: pañcavidhaṃ vidyāsthānam
verses.meaningZh: 五服务天神，明咒立
verses.meaningEn: Five + serve a god, Vidyā
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：asmahsuu.htm（全书共 2904 行）

verses.iast: adhyātmavidyā hetuvidyā śabdavidyā cikitsāvidyā śilpakarmasthānavidyā ca
verses.meaningZh: 内明，因明，声明，医方明，工巧·业处·明咒以及
verses.meaningEn: Adhyātmavidyā, logic, dialectics, grammar, cikitsāvidyā, many-coloured + place of business + Vidyā and
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：asmahsuu.htm（全书共 2904 行）

verses.iast: tadyadarthaṃ bodhisattvena paryeṣitavyaṃ taddarśayati
verses.meaningZh: 彼哪些目的，以菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情），第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道，彼示
verses.meaningEn: That + for which purpose, by/through Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening, that + teach
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：asmahsuu.htm（全书共 2904 行）

verses.iast: sarvajñatvaprāptyarthamabhedena sarvam
verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，一切、普皆遍满
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech (by spiritual power), all, every, complete
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：asmahsuu.htm（全书共 2904 行）

verses.iast: bhedena punarhetuvidyāṃ śabdavidyāṃ ca paryeṣate nigrahārthamanyeṣāṃ tadanadhimuktānām
verses.meaningZh: 以异生性，复次因明，声明以及方圆、附件，内制·义利·认为·那几个的，真如实际·施度调伏·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: By/through breaking, splitting, breach, division, separation, seduction, winning over , interrup, again + logic, grammar and circumference, enclosure, circle, seizing + meaning + think, immutable Suchness & generosity & self-mastery & beyond nominal designation
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：asmahsuu.htm（全书共 2904 行）

verses.iast: cikitsāvidyāṃ śilpakarmasthānavidyāṃ cānyeṣāmanugrahārthaṃ tadarthikānām
verses.meaningZh: 医方明，工巧·业处·明咒，妙行迁变空·离名相假立·一乘如实之道，彼诸企求之
verses.meaningEn: Cikitsāvidyāṃ, many-coloured + place of business + Vidyā, awakened conduct beyond flux & beyond nominal designation & supreme vehicle of awakening, that + of all desirous
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：asmahsuu.htm（全书共 2904 行）

verses.iast: adhyātmavidyāṃ svayamājñārtham
verses.meaningZh: 内明，亲自·命令·他
verses.meaningEn: Adhyātmavidyāṃ, oneself + command + tha
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：asmahsuu.htm（全书共 2904 行）

titleZh: 【梵本】梵文贝叶佛典《Avadanasataka》总持真言选 (avsata_u.htm)
translatorZh: 德国哥廷根大学 GRETIL 梵文电子校勘库（佛教梵文文献库）
deityZh: 十方三世诸尊 · 梵本原典总持

verses.iast: bhūtapūrvaṃ bhikṣavo 'tīte 'dhvani candano nāma samyaksaṃbuddho loka udapādi tathāgato 'rhan samyaksaṃbuddho vidyācaraṇasaṃpannaḥ sugato lokavid anuttaraḥ puruṣadamyasārathiḥ śāstā
verses.meaningZh: 古昔，希望人情，过去尊，无妙音、音声，檀香，名为、号曰，正等觉，世间、世界，净水尊足，如来，应供、阿罗汉，正等觉，明行足，善逝，世间解，无上，调御丈夫，天人师
verses.meaningEn: Bhūtapūrvaṃ, wish for + favour, O gone away, passed, dead, non-sound, noise, roar, thunder, best of its kind, by name, called, samyaksaṃbuddho, world, realm, water + O foot, tathāgato, Arhat, Worthy One, samyaksaṃbuddho, vidyācaraṇasaṃpannaḥ, sugato, Knower of the World, anuttaraḥ, puruṣadamyasārathiḥ, śāstā
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：avsata_u.htm（全书共 2486 行）

verses.iast: parāhatya sarvakleśaprahāṇād arhatvaṃ sākṣākṛtam
verses.meaningZh: 他人·如是宣说·那个，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，阿罗汉果，一切诸谛圆满·造作离相·六度满行清净
verses.meaningEn: Someone else + spoke + that, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, the fruit of arhat cultivation, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：avsata_u.htm（全书共 2486 行）

verses.iast: arhan saṃvṛttaḥ traidhātukavītarāgaḥ samaloṣṭakāñcana ākāśapāṇitalasamacitto vāsīcandanakalpo vidyāvidāritāṇḍakośo vidyābhijñāpratisaṃvitprāpto bhavalābhalobhasatkāraparāṅmukhaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 应供、阿罗汉，由包层，三界离欲，污秽·脣·真金，虚空界·巴掌·住舍，不怎么样，解·乃至·今日·趣往·壳，圣智了知·最上真言离言说，汝·衰·贪欲·恭敬·尊颜
verses.meaningEn: Arhat, Worthy One, from covering, The Three Realms + free of desire, filth + plough-bull + pure gold, space + the palm of the hand + equanimous, indifferent, understanding + how + now + going + egg, knowing, you + non-acquirement + greed + good treatment or service + having the face turned backwards
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：avsata_u.htm（全书共 2486 行）

verses.iast: sendropendrāṇāṃ devānāṃ pūjyo mānyo 'bhivādyaś ca saṃvṛttaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 一同因达罗·愈加·诸因陀逻，诸天人、诸天护法之，供养凡彼圣尊，乃是尊贵、具寿，破有相福德光·最上真言离言说·施度调伏以及由包层
verses.meaningEn: Along with Indra + thereto + of Śakra king of the gods, of all god, celestial deity (Deva), reverence + who, to be respected, venerable, blessedness transcending existence & supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery and from covering
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：avsata_u.htm（全书共 2486 行）

verses.iast: bhūtapūrvaṃ bhikṣavo 'tīte 'dhvani asminn eva bhadrake kalpe viṃśatisahasrāyuṣi prajāyāṃ kāśyapo nāma
verses.meaningZh: 古昔，希望人情，过去尊，无妙音、音声，一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·离名相假立，唯、正是、决定，良好、诸人尊，细轨尊，最上真言离言说·本性寂静止息·真如实际，于裔胄、孩子们中，护容子，名为、号曰
verses.meaningEn: Bhūtapūrvaṃ, wish for + favour, O gone away, passed, dead, non-sound, noise, roar, thunder, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation, indeed, verily, alone, O good, O style, manner, fashion, supreme ineffable speech & primordial tranquil peace & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), in bringing forth, kāśyapo, by name, called
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：avsata_u.htm（全书共 2486 行）

verses.iast: samyaksaṃbuddho loka udapādi vidyācaraṇasaṃpannaḥ sugato lokavid anuttaraḥ puruṣadamyasārathiḥ śāstā devānāṃ ca manuṣyāṇāṃ
verses.meaningZh: 正等觉，世间、世界，净水尊足，明行足，善逝，世间解，无上，调御丈夫，天人师，诸天人、诸天护法之以及诸人之
verses.meaningEn: Samyaksaṃbuddho, world, realm, water + O foot, vidyācaraṇasaṃpannaḥ, sugato, Knower of the World, anuttaraḥ, puruṣadamyasārathiḥ, śāstā, of all god, celestial deity (Deva) and of person
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：avsata_u.htm（全书共 2486 行）

verses.iast: ca buddho bhagavān
verses.meaningZh: 左字门（妙行迁变空（caryā）·本不生体性），觉者，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵
verses.meaningEn: Awakened conduct beyond flux (caryā) — primordial non-arising, buddho, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：avsata_u.htm（全书共 2486 行）

verses.iast: sa vārāṇasīṃ nagarīm upaniśritya viharati ṛṣipatane mṛgadāve
verses.meaningZh: 彼、此尊（阳性主格），最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤，离名相假立·妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢，比邻，一切，仙堕尊，鹿野苑
verses.meaningEn: He, that one, supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace, beyond nominal designation & awakened spiritual movement & stainless purity free from dust, near, lives, dwells, spends oneʼs time, O fall, O Deer Park / in Deer Park
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：avsata_u.htm（全书共 2486 行）

verses.iast: atha bhagavataḥ kāśyapasya samyaksaṃbuddhasya
verses.meaningZh: 尔时、次复吉祥启白，世尊、薄伽梵（具六德圣尊），迦叶，正等正觉、正遍知之
verses.meaningEn: Now, thereupon, auspiciously, Bhagavān, the Blessed/World-Honored One, of light-guard, of Perfectly and Completely Awakened Buddha

verses.meaningEn: Secondary, knowing, connection, Bhagavān, the Blessed/World-Honored One, O body, physical frame, sacred relics / in body, physical frame, sacred relics, body + to make an offering, having done, having performed, universal + harnessing, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & ultimate truth, bowing, steady + from friend, shout, yell, high + by

verses.iast: arhan saṃvṛttaḥ traidhātukavītarāgaḥ samaloṣṭakāñcana ākāśapāṇitalasamacitto vāsīcandanakalpo vidyāvidāritāṇḍakośo vidyābhijñāpratisaṃvitprāpto bhavalābhalobhasatkāraparāṅmukhaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 应供、阿罗汉，由包层，三界离欲，污秽·脣·真金，虚空界·巴掌·住舍，不怎么样，解·乃至·今日·趣往·壳，圣智了知·最上真言离言说，汝·衰·贪欲·恭敬·尊颜

verses.meaningEn: Namely + friend + beginning thus, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — expansive quiescence, again + a certain + from sound, profound, deep, unfathomable, ultimate truth + peak + from stem, bright, supreme + utterly spotless + light + from stem, immutable Suchness & supreme vehicle of awakening & beyond nominal designation, bearing

verses.iast: om namo bhagavate ārya amoghapāśahṛdaya
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，向世尊（薄伽梵）致敬，圣、尊贵圣者，不空羂索心
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, noble, holy, exalted (Ārya), unerring lasso + heart
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bsu002_u.htm（全书共 84 行）

verses.iast: om mune mune mahāmunaye svāhā / om same same mahāsame rakṣa rakṣa māṃ sarvasattvānāṃca sarvapāpaprasamane svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三无我大慈三昧·离名相假立，向大牟尼尊（释迦世尊），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！嗡！再三平尊，大平尊，祈请再三拥护、守护于我，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，一切·罪业·转载·会议，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation) again and again, to Great Sage (Mahāmuni), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Oṃ! O equal again and again, great + O equal, evermore protect, guard and shelter me, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, all + evil + forward + O meeting, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bsu002_u.htm（全书共 84 行）

verses.iast: namaḥ suparikīrttita nāma dheyāya tathāgatāyā / namaḥ samantāvabhāsavijitasaṃgrāmaśriye tathāgatāya / namaḥ indraketudhvajaśriye
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切诸谛圆满·第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·名为、号曰·驮都、摇摆·如来即是·普现·驮都·圣众·广大光华尊·如来（乘如实道来成正觉）·因陀逻·光明幢·宝幢·广大光华尊！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust, by name, called, realm, sway, control, Tathāgata, thus, conquered, popular assembly, O with great magnificence, Tathāgata, Thus-Come One, Śakra king of the gods, banner, victory banner, O with great magnificence!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bsu002_u.htm（全书共 84 行）

verses.iast: tathāgatāya arhate samyaksambuddhāya / namo vikrāntagāmine tathāgatāyārhate samyaksambuddhāya / namo buddhāya namo
verses.meaningZh: 向如来（乘如实道来成正觉），向应供（阿罗汉）致敬，向权利随着佛陀，归命，最上真言离言说·造作离相·清净离诸尘垢，如来·出·堪敬尊，向权利随着佛陀，归命，向佛陀、觉者，至心归命礼！
verses.meaningEn: To/for Tathāgata, Thus-Come One, to the Arhat, Worthy One, right + along with + to, homage to supreme ineffable speech & freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), Tathāgata + income, right + along with + to, homage to to/for Buddha, the Awakened One, reverent homage!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bsu002_u.htm（全书共 84 行）

verses.iast: dharmāya namaḥ saṃghāya / namo atītānāgata pratyutpannebhyo buddhebhyo bhagavadbhyaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 向正法、诸法实相，归命，向圣僧伽、清净海众，归命，过去末，现在时富人，佛陀富人，向诸才宣说
verses.meaningEn: To/for Dharma, cosmic truth/teaching/phenomena, homage to to/for Saṃgha, noble spiritual community, homage to gone away + future, present + belonging to one's household, Buddha + belonging to one's household, excellence + to
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bsu002_u.htm（全书共 84 行）

verses.iast: tadyathā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bsu002_u.htm（全书共 84 行）

verses.iast: smṛtivarddhani gativarddhani dhṛtivarddhani prajñāvarddhani pratibhānavarddhani dhyānavarddhani samaryavarddhani sarvabodhipakṣadharmmavarddhani sakalaburddhadharmaparipūṇīye svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 正念兴盛尊，趣向兴盛尊，想兴盛尊，般若兴盛尊，辩才兴盛尊，禅那兴盛尊，三末耶兴盛尊，一切·菩提·宗法·兴盛尊，持守摄受·一切诸谛圆满，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Mindfulness + O increasing, course + O increasing, holding fast + O increasing, Prajñā + O increasing, eloquence + O increasing, meditative concentration + O increasing, conflux + O increasing, all + Bodhi + property of the position + O increasing, bearing (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bsu002_u.htm（全书共 84 行）

verses.iast: namo ratnatrayāya namo āryāvalokiteśvarāya bodhisattvāya mahāsattvāya mahākārūṇikāya / ebhyo namaskṛtvā idamāryāvalokiteśvaramukhoṅgīrṇamamoghapāśarājannāma hṛdayaṃ
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛法僧三宝·圣观自在菩萨·菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情）·摩诃萨埵（大心有情、大菩萨）·广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧·破有相福德光·一乘如实之道·顶礼敬拜已·施度调伏·无我大慈三昧·清净离诸尘垢·心！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha), Noble Avalokiteśvara, Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, Mahāsattva, Great Spiritual Hero, great (reverent offering), blessedness transcending existence & supreme vehicle of awakening, having paid homage/salutation, generosity & self-mastery & selfless great loving-kindness & stainless purity free from dust, hṛdayaṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bsu002_u.htm（全书共 84 行）

verses.iast: tathāgata saṃmukhabhāṣitaṃ mahatā parṣata madhye ahamidāniṃmāvarttayiṣye sidhyantu me mantrapadā sarvvakāryāṇi
verses.meaningZh: 如来（乘如实道来成正觉），当面妙语，广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·六度满行清净，中尊，因缘空寂大乐·无我大慈三昧·施度调伏，愿诸真言章句悉皆成就，于我、为我，真言章句、密咒句义，一切一切果
verses.meaningEn: Tathāgata, Thus-Come One, face to face + spoken, great, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & perfection of the six pāramitās, O neutral, impartial, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & selfless great loving-kindness & generosity & self-mastery (vocative invocation), may all mantra-padas succeed! to me, my, sacred mantra phrase, all + to be done
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bsu002_u.htm（全书共 84 行）

verses.iast: om cara cara ciri ciri curū curū mara mara miri miri murū
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三行持妙道、周游救护（左啰），再三久远常恒护持不退（唧哩），再三妙行迁变空·清净离诸尘垢，再三临危、死厄，再三慈愍覆护一切有情（弭哩），无我大慈三昧·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! move forth in compassionate activity! again and again, enduring steadfast protection & mindfulness again and again, awakened conduct beyond flux & stainless purity free from dust again and again, dying, death again and again, compassionate shelter & soothing grace again and again, selfless great loving-kindness & stainless purity free from dust
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bsu002_u.htm（全书共 84 行）

verses.iast: murū mahākārūṇika / sara sara siri siri surū surū curū curū ciri
verses.meaningZh: 无我大慈三昧·清净离诸尘垢，广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，再三流注周遍、速行护念（萨啰），再三吉祥福德流注庄严（悉哩，再三一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢，再三妙行迁变空·清净离诸尘垢，久远常恒护持不退（唧哩）
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness & stainless purity free from dust, great, flow forth and pervade with blessing! again and again, auspicious Śrī fortune & sacred grace again and again, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust again and again, awakened conduct beyond flux & stainless purity free from dust again and again, enduring steadfast protection & mindfulness
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bsu002_u.htm（全书共 84 行）

verses.iast: ciri viri viri piri piri miri miri mahāpadāhasta / kala kala kili
verses.meaningZh: 久远常恒护持不退（唧哩），再三最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢，再三第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢，再三慈愍覆护一切有情（弭哩），乐趣·灾异·手，再三尊手，金刚橛威神警觉、摧伏魔军（吉栗）
verses.meaningEn: Enduring steadfast protection & mindfulness, supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation) again and again, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation) again and again, compassionate shelter & soothing grace again and again, gladden + disaster + hand, hand again and again, vajra-kīla transfixing obstacles & awakening
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bsu002_u.htm（全书共 84 行）

verses.iast: kili kulu kulu mahāśuddhasatvā / buddhaya buddhaya bodha bodha bodhi bodhi bodhaya
verses.meaningZh: 金刚橛威神警觉、摧伏魔军（吉栗），再三造作离相·离一切相无相，大清净尊者，再三佛陀、觉者，再三悟，再三菩提、无上正觉，请开晓觉悟、令发菩提觉智！
verses.meaningEn: Vajra-kīla transfixing obstacles & awakening, freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks (imperative seal) again and again, great + Suddhasattva, may You Buddha, the Awakened One! again and again, waking again and again, Bodhi, awakening, enlightenment again and again, awaken! enlighten! illuminate!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bsu002_u.htm（全书共 84 行）

verses.iast: bodhaya kaṇa kaṇa kiṇi kiṇi kuṇu kuṇu paramaśuddhasattva / kara kara kiri
verses.meaningZh: 请开晓觉悟、令发菩提觉智！再三赤红，再三痕迹尊，再三造作离相·离诸诤论无诤，最胜清净尊者，再三掌，舒散光明、散布吉祥！（源自 √kṝ）
verses.meaningEn: Awaken! enlighten! illuminate! kernel again and again, O thick hard skin, callosity, scar again and again, freedom from karmic agency & conflict-free peace (imperative seal) again and again, supreme + Suddhasattva, palm again and again, scatter rays of blessing!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bsu002_u.htm（全书共 84 行）

verses.iast: kiri kurū kurū mahāsthāmaprāpta
verses.meaningZh: 舒散光明、散布吉祥！（源自 √kṝ），再三成办作持·造作离相，大势至
verses.meaningEn: Scatter rays of blessing! enacting again and again, Mahāsthāma
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bsu002_u.htm（全书共 84 行）

verses.iast: cala cala saṃcala saṃcala vicala vicala eṭaṭa eṭaṭa bhara bhara bhiri bhiri bhurū bhurū tara tara
verses.meaningZh: 再三震动警觉、破除昏沉（左攞），再三索索，再三闢震动警觉，再三断除憍慢执障，再三方位、战斗，再三无畏威神震伏魔怨（毗利），再三破有相福德光·清净离诸尘垢，再三弯曲、超群
verses.meaningEn: Stir awake and shake off delusion! again and again, trembling, quaking again and again, settle + stir awake and shake off delusion! again and again, cutting rigid pride again and again, bearing, carrying again and again, fearless spiritual majesty again and again, blessedness transcending existence & stainless purity free from dust again and again, crossing, surpassing, overcoming again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bsu002_u.htm（全书共 84 行）

verses.meaningZh: 轮廻活期，日复一日·报刊·勇健，高显超胜·一切诸谛圆满，苦根，闢增长，离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，无人，非灵魂、没电，离名相假立·六度满行清净·第一义谛，无补特伽罗，自我离，彼（宾格）

verses.meaningZh: 向汝、彼等，陀罗尼面门，三摩地·等引·尊，广大、宽博无量，六通，亦、虽、乃至，田·转载·定居者·无边

verses.iast: namo ratnatrayāya / namo vairocanāya tathāgatāya / nama āryāvalokiteśvarāya bodhisattvāya mahāsattvāya mahākāruṇikāya
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛法僧三宝·毗卢遮那佛（大日遍照如来）·如来（乘如实道来成正觉）·圣观自在菩萨·菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情）·摩诃萨埵（大心有情、大菩萨）·大悲圣尊、具足大悲心者！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha), Vairocana, Illuminator Buddha, Tathāgata, Thus-Come One, Noble Avalokiteśvara, Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, Mahāsattva, Great Spiritual Hero, Greatly Compassionate One!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bsu015_u.htm（全书共 76 行）

verses.iast: / namaḥ atītānāgatapratyutpannebhyaḥ sarvatathāgatebhyo 'rhad bhyaḥ samyaksaṃbuddhebhyaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切过去末现在时·一切如来富人·清净离诸尘垢·因缘空寂大乐·施度调伏·耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）·一切正等正觉、正遍知！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to gone away, future, present, all Tathagatas, belonging to one's household, stainless purity free from dust & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & generosity & self-mastery, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release, Perfectly and Completely Awakened Buddha!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bsu015_u.htm（全书共 76 行）

verses.iast: namo ratnatrayāya / nama āryāvalokiteśvarāya bodhisattvāya mahāsattvāya / tad yathā hāhā hāhā
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛法僧三宝·圣观自在菩萨·菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情）·摩诃萨埵（大心有情、大菩萨）·彼、如是真实·犹如、如…所说·因缘空寂大乐！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha), Noble Avalokiteśvara, Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, Mahāsattva, Great Spiritual Hero, that, thus, just as, according to, causal emptiness & spiritual joy!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bsu015_u.htm（全书共 76 行）

verses.iast: / ime tile cile bhile khile svāhā / snānopasparśanavastrābhyukṣipaṇamantraḥ saptajāpena
verses.meaningZh: 怎么，芝麻尊，妙行迁变空·离一切相无相，破有相福德光·离一切相无相，硬度尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！一切诸谛圆满·离名相假立·第一义谛，以七诵念
verses.meaningEn: Ime, O the sesamum plant or seed, awakened conduct beyond flux & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), blessedness transcending existence & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), O hardness, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & beyond nominal designation & ultimate truth, seven + by
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bsu015_u.htm（全书共 76 行）

verses.iast: namo ratnatrayāya / nama āryāvalokiteśvarāya bodhisattvāyamahāsattvāya
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛法僧三宝·圣观自在菩萨·菩提萨埵出摩诃萨埵！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha), Noble Avalokiteśvara, Bodhisattva, income, to!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bsu015_u.htm（全书共 76 行）

verses.iast: namo ratnatrayāya / nama āryāvalokiteśvarāya bodhisattvāyā mahāsattvāyā / tadyathā thiri thiri dhiri dhiri svāhā / gandhapuṣpopanivedanamantraḥ
verses.meaningZh: 归命向佛法僧三宝，归命，向圣观自在菩萨，菩提萨埵即是，摩诃萨埵即是，即说咒曰：再三无住安立·清净离诸尘垢，再三禅定坚固总持不失（地利），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！香·花·愈加·在于·吠陀·那么怛罗
verses.meaningEn: Homage to to/for the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha), homage to to/for Noble Avalokiteśvara, Bodhisattva + thus, Mahāsattva + thus, Thus goes the mantra: non-abiding equipoise & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation) again and again, steadfast meditative retention (dhṛti) again and again, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! smell + flower + thereto + in + Vedas
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bsu015_u.htm（全书共 76 行）

verses.iast: namo ratnatrayāya / nama āryāvalokiteśvaraya bodhisattvāya mahāsattvāya mahākāruṇikāya / tadyathā sāde sāde
verses.meaningZh: 归命向佛法僧三宝，归命，祈请圣观自在菩萨，向菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情），向摩诃萨埵（大心有情、大菩萨），向大悲圣尊、具足大悲心者，即说咒曰：再三疲倦、疑悔尊
verses.meaningEn: Homage to to/for the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha), homage to may You Noble Avalokiteśvara! to/for Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, to/for Mahāsattva, Great Spiritual Hero, to/for Greatly Compassionate One, Thus goes the mantra: O sitting on horseback, riding again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bsu015_u.htm（全书共 76 行）

verses.iast: sidi sidi sudu sudu svāhā / balinivedanamantra ekaviṃśatijāpena
verses.meaningZh: 再三一切诸谛圆满·施度调伏，再三一切诸谛圆满·施度调伏，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！威势·犹如·此处·那么怛罗，以二十一诵念
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & generosity & self-mastery (vocative invocation) again and again, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & generosity & self-mastery (imperative seal) again and again, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! mighty + like, twenty-one + by
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bsu015_u.htm（全书共 76 行）

verses.iast: namo ratnatrayāya / nama āryāvalokiteśvarāyabodhisattvāya mahāsattvāya / mahākāruṇikāya / tadyathā yasi ddhasi
verses.meaningZh: 归命向佛法僧三宝，归命，向圣观自在菩萨出菩提萨埵，向摩诃萨埵（大心有情、大菩萨），向大悲圣尊、具足大悲心者，即说咒曰：一乘如实之道·一切诸谛圆满，施度调伏·法界总持任持·一切诸谛圆满
verses.meaningEn: Homage to to/for the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha), homage to Noble Avalokiteśvara + income + to, to/for Mahāsattva, Great Spiritual Hero, to/for Greatly Compassionate One, Thus goes the mantra: supreme vehicle of awakening & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (vocative invocation), generosity & self-mastery & Dharma-realm retention & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bsu015_u.htm（全书共 76 行）

verses.iast: cari huru icuruḥ suruḥ muruḥ svāhā / homamantraḥ / anena mantreṇa jñātīnāṣṭai(?)
verses.meaningZh: 经过作法，疾速拔济除障（虎噜），妙行迁变空·清净离诸尘垢，甘露妙流普润群生（素噜），速疾摧碎烦恼结缚（亩噜），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！护摩供阿满多罗，以此（真言功德力），以真言、密咒（护心密语），圣智了知·生起不可得·尊胜
verses.meaningEn: Course of conduct, regular system of action, swiftly rescue and dispel all afflictions! awakened conduct beyond flux & stainless purity free from dust, stream forth auspicious ambrosia! swiftly dissolve karmic knots & obstacles! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! oblation + not having or knowing mantras, by this, by/through Mantra, sacred formula, knowing (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bsu015_u.htm（全书共 76 行）

verses.iast: ragniṃ prajvālya dadhimadhudhṛtābhyaktānāmahorātrauṣikena ekena triṃśatā homaḥ kāryaḥ / tataḥ karma samārabhet
verses.meaningZh: 清净离诸尘垢·妙行趣入·离名相假立，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·生起不可得·尊胜，施予饶益·广大殊胜·施度调伏，以一、唯一不二，真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·本性寂静止息，护摩，果，由伊人、本刹，事，一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Stainless purity free from dust & awakened spiritual movement & beyond nominal designation, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & transcending birth & victorious, granting, great (by spiritual power), by/through one, single, non-dual, immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & primordial tranquil peace, homaḥ, to be done, from stem of he, she, it, actions, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & stainless purity free from dust
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bsu015_u.htm（全书共 76 行）

verses.iast: namo ratnatrayāya nama āryāvalokiteśvarāya bodhisattvāya mahāsattvāya mahākāruṇikāya / tadyathā ili mili tili
verses.meaningZh: 归命向佛法僧三宝，归命，向圣观自在菩萨，向菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情），向摩诃萨埵（大心有情、大菩萨），向大悲圣尊、具足大悲心者，即说咒曰：法界平等摄持心印（伊利），契合本尊三昧、慈悲冥合（弥利），芝麻尊
verses.meaningEn: Homage to to/for the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha), homage to to/for Noble Avalokiteśvara, to/for Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, to/for Mahāsattva, Great Spiritual Hero, to/for Greatly Compassionate One, Thus goes the mantra: primordial Dharma-realm equipoise, intimate union with the deity samādhi, O the sesamum plant or seed
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bsu015_u.htm（全书共 76 行）

verses.iast: tili hili svāhā / dīpābaddha udakena rvā bhasmanā vā saptajāpena
verses.meaningZh: 芝麻尊，定慧摄持、心无散乱（希利），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！烈火限制，以净水，嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk，灰烬自然，或、抑或，以七诵念
verses.meaningEn: O the sesamum plant or seed, meditative absorption & steadfast mindfulness, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! ) + bound, by/through water, supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — expansive quiescence, chewing + certainly, or, seven + by
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bsu015_u.htm（全书共 76 行）

verses.iast: namo ratnatrayāya / nama āryāvalokiteśvarāya bodhisattvāya mahāsattvāya mahākāruṇikāya / tadyathā piṭi piṭi
verses.meaningZh: 归命向佛法僧三宝，归命，向圣观自在菩萨，向菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情），向摩诃萨埵（大心有情、大菩萨），向大悲圣尊、具足大悲心者，即说咒曰：再三篮子、积集尊
verses.meaningEn: Homage to to/for the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha), homage to to/for Noble Avalokiteśvara, to/for Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, to/for Mahāsattva, Great Spiritual Hero, to/for Greatly Compassionate One, Thus goes the mantra: O basket again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bsu015_u.htm（全书共 76 行）

verses.iast: tiṭi tiṭi viṭi viṭi gaccha gaccha bhagavānāryāvalokiteśvara svabhavanaṃ svabhavanaṃ svāhā / udake
verses.meaningZh: 再三真如实际·断除憍慢执障，再三诡谲尊，再三去吧、趣向菩提！世尊圣观自在菩萨，再三自住埸，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！净水尊
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & cutting rigid pride (vocative invocation) again and again, O boon-companion again and again, go! proceed! again and again, the World-Honored One + Noble Avalokiteśvara, own again and again, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! O water
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bsu015_u.htm（全书共 76 行）

verses.iast: saptavārān parijapya caturdiśaṃ kṣipet / āryāvalokiteśvara gaccha svabhavanam
verses.meaningZh: 七人群，般一样，全方位，造作离相·六度满行清净·第一义谛，圣观自在菩萨，去吧、趣向菩提！自住埸
verses.meaningEn: Seven + crowd, wisdom + the same, towards the four quarters of the sky, all around, freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās & ultimate truth, Noble Avalokiteśvara, go! proceed! own
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bsu015_u.htm（全书共 76 行）

verses.meaningEn: Bhagavān, the Blessed/World-Honored One, unanimous + press + right, or, friendly + by, awakened conduct beyond flux & immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, Mantra + be glad or merry + wind + O held, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, homage to all + buddhānām, Mantra, sacred formula
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bsu041_u.htm（全书共 12845 行）

verses.iast: / eṣa mañjuśrīḥ paramahṛdayaḥ sarvakarmakaraḥ
verses.meaningZh: 急促事关，玅吉祥，最胜心，一切管事者
verses.meaningEn: Rushing on, as subst, beautiful, supreme + heart, all
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bsu041_u.htm（全书共 12845 行）

verses.iast: vidyārājñīnāṃ samāgamaṃ vakṣyate / tadyathā - ūrṇā bhrūlocanā padmā śravaṇaḥ grīvā abhayā
verses.meaningZh: 诸明妃之，来诣一起、会议，因缘拘牵尊，即说咒曰：白毫，眉眼，莲华（出淤泥而不染清净心），听闻，项，无畏
verses.meaningEn: Of wise consort, coming together, meeting, union, intercourse with, cause to grow or increase + O held, Thus goes the mantra: urna, brow + eye, lotus flower (pure, unstained), monk, back of the neck, non-fear
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bsu041_u.htm（全书共 12845 行）

verses.iast: karuṇā maitrī kṛpā prajñā raśmi cetanā prabhā nirmalā dhīvarā
verses.meaningZh: 大悲（拔苦悲心），慈心（与乐大慈），慈悲，般若、超越妙慧，光芒、百千光明聚，思，光明、清净毫光，净无垢秽、纤尘不染，分别殊胜
verses.meaningEn: Compassion (Karuṇā), loving-kindness, benevolence (Maitrī), compassion, pity, Prajñā, transcendent wisdom, ray of light, beam, volition, light, radiance, splendor, aura, utterly spotless, taintless, thought + choicest
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bsu041_u.htm（全书共 12845 行）

verses.iast: ye 'pi te mātarā mahāmātarāḥ lokamanucarantiḥ; satvaviheṭhikā balimālyopahāriśca / tadyathā - brahmāṇī
verses.meaningZh: 凡彼等诸有情，亦、虽、乃至，向汝、彼等，勿弯曲，大·勿·诸弯曲，世间·那罗·动着·对治，一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·最上真言离言说，施食·鬘·愈加·拿来净水及即说咒曰：解脱系缚大力·清净离诸尘垢·因缘空寂大乐
verses.meaningEn: Those who, whoever (pl.), even, also, to Thee / they, do not + crossing, great + do not + crossing, world + man + move + opposite, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech, tax + flower + thereto + to fetch water and Thus goes the mantra: spiritual strength freeing bonds & stainless purity free from dust & causal emptiness & spiritual joy
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bsu041_u.htm（全书共 12845 行）

verses.iast: māheśvarī vaiṣṇavī kaumārī cāmuṇḍā vārāhī aindrī yāmyā āgneyā vaivasvatī lokāntakarī vāruṇī aiśānī
verses.meaningZh: 无我大慈三昧·因缘空寂大乐·本性寂静止息，吠瑟拏微，娇么哩，遮文茶，末罗呬弭，东，南，火热，日女，能作随一一极，西，东北
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & primordial tranquil peace, Vaisnavi, Kaumari, Camunda, Varahi, aindrī, yāmyā, fiery, vaivasvatī, mostly ) look + maker of ultimate, vāruṇī, aiśānī
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bsu041_u.htm（全书共 12845 行）

verses.iast: vāyavyā paraprāṇaharā sukhamaṇḍitikā śakunī mahāśakunī pūtanā kaṭapūtanā skandā ceti / ityete mahāmātarā
verses.meaningZh: 以西北，他人有害，安乐妙善·一切诸谛圆满，兆，大兆，臭者，极臭鬼，偏脣鬼，妙行迁变空·真如实际，经过趣往，大·勿·弯曲
verses.meaningEn: Vāyavyā, someone else + robbing life, blissful, bird (feminine), great + bird, a kind of demon, a kind of demon, a demon that causes drought, awakened conduct beyond flux & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), course + O going, great + do not + crossing
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bsu041_u.htm（全书共 12845 行）

verses.iast: anekamātaraśatasahasraparivārāḥ; te 'pi taṃ mahāparṣanmaṇḍalaṃ namo buddhāyeti vācamudīrayantyaḥ sthitā abhūvam
verses.meaningZh: 多·勿·弯曲·百千·诸眷属，向汝、彼等，亦、虽、乃至，彼（宾格），广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，归命，佛陀·出·瘟疫，最上真言离言说·妙行迁变空·无我大慈三昧，立，破有相福德光·最上真言离言说·无我大慈三昧
verses.meaningEn: Not one + do not + crossing + sgl + accessory, to Thee / they, even, also, him, that, great, homage to Buddha + income + plague, supreme ineffable speech & awakened conduct beyond flux & selfless great loving-kindness, standing, abiding, remaining, blessedness transcending existence & supreme ineffable speech & selfless great loving-kindness
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bsu041_u.htm（全书共 12845 行）

verses.iast: om jñaiḥ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！以诸了知、聪明，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! by/with knowing, versed in, conversant or familiar with, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bsu041_u.htm（全书共 12845 行）

verses.iast: tadyathā - om varade svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！施愿者、满善愿尊尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! O boon-granting, wish-bestowing / in boon-granting, wish-bestowing, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bsu041_u.htm（全书共 12845 行）

verses.iast: om bhūri svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！聪慧，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! intelligence, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bsu041_u.htm（全书共 12845 行）

verses.iast: om nu re svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·损减除灭忧苦），啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·钩召发起三昧），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! beyond nominal designation (nāma) — dispelling sorrow, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — samādhi invocation, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bsu041_u.htm（全书共 12845 行）

verses.iast: tadyathā - om vilokini svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！最上真言离言说·离一切相无相·造作离相，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! supreme ineffable speech & freedom from conditioned marks & freedom from karmic agency (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bsu041_u.htm（全书共 12845 行）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼以世尊佛母！（呼格）·圣智了知·清净离诸尘垢！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to with/by O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī!, knowing (vocative invocation)!

verses.meaningEn: Fame + and indeed, verily, certainly, again, furthermore, press out + O spirit, bodhisattvo, mahāsattvo, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & selfless great loving-kindness, seven treasures, having done, having performed, thus + to, stainless purity free from dust & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & generosity & self-mastery, Perfectly and Completely Awakened Buddha + belonging to one's household

verses.meaningZh: 布施，奉施，名闻及善男子，或、抑或，善女人，或、抑或，趣往、途径，般若波罗蜜多即是，持守摄受·欢喜悦泽·法界总持任持，讽颂·高兴快乐·可见，总持任持·法界总持任持
verses.meaningEn: Dānaṃ, give, fame + and a good man, or, a good woman, or, going, way, Perfection of Wisdom + thus, bearing, delighting (vocative invocation), gatha + be glad or merry + to be seized or taken, upholding
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bsu051_u.htm（全书共 138 行）

verses.meaningEn: How? in what way? whence? and all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust, namely + O a kind of grass

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：再三度越吧、已往彼岸尊！度向彼岸吧、已达究竟彼岸！普同度至彼岸吧（圆证菩提）！菩提、无上正觉，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: gone, O One gone beyond! again and again, gone all the way to the other shore! gone completely altogether beyond! Bodhi, awakening, enlightenment, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.iast: Oṃ namo bhagavate śrīguṇasāgarāya
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，向世尊（薄伽梵）致敬，向吉祥功德海
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, auspiciousness + to
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：dvavims_pu.htm（全书共 2158 行）

verses.iast: atha bhagavān āha
verses.meaningZh: 尔时、次复吉祥启白，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，如是宣说、佛言
verses.meaningEn: Now, thereupon, auspiciously, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, spoke, declared thus
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：dvavims_pu.htm（全书共 2158 行）

verses.iast: bhaviṣyasi tvaṃ kulaputra dhātuśikharanāmalokadhātor dhātustejo nāma tathāgato 'rhan samyaksaṃbuddho vidyācaraṇasaṃpannaḥ sugato lokavid
verses.meaningZh: 当有汝即是，汝、圣尊您，善男子，界·山尖·名为·界境，法界总持任持·真如实际·一切诸谛圆满，名为、号曰，如来，应供、阿罗汉，正等觉，明行足，善逝，世间解
verses.meaningEn: Thou art, Thou, You, a good man, realm + peaked + by name + of world-region, Dharma-realm retention & immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, by name, called, tathāgato, Arhat, Worthy One, samyaksaṃbuddho, vidyācaraṇasaṃpannaḥ, sugato, Knower of the World
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：dvavims_pu.htm（全书共 2158 行）

verses.iast: anuttaraḥ puruṣadamyasārathiḥ śāstā devānāṃ ca manuṣyāṇāṃ ca buddho bhagavān iti / vyākaraṇaṃ
verses.meaningZh: 无上，调御丈夫，天人师，诸天人、诸天护法之以及诸人之以及觉者，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，如是（结句印定），记别
verses.meaningEn: Anuttaraḥ, puruṣadamyasārathiḥ, śāstā, of all god, celestial deity (Deva) and of person and buddho, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, thus, so it is stated, vyākaraṇaṃ

verses.iast: śrutvā pravrajyāgrahaṇaṃ cakāra

verses.iast: tatkṣaṇe sākṣād arhattvaṃ prāptam

verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：dvavims_pu.htm（全书共 2158 行）

verses.iast: Oṃ namo bhagavate śrīguṇasāgarāya
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，向世尊（薄伽梵）致敬，向吉祥功德海

verses.iast: atha bhagavān āha
verses.meaningZh: 尔时、次复吉祥启白，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，如是宣说、佛言
verses.meaningEn: Now, thereupon, auspiciously, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, spoke, declared thus
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：dvavims_tu.htm（全书共 2159 行）

verses.iast: bhaviṣyasi tvaṃ kulaputra dhātuśikharanāmalokadhāto r dhātustejo nāma tathāgato 'rhan samyaksaṃbuddho vidyācaraṇasaṃpannaḥ sugato
verses.meaningZh: 当有汝即是，汝、圣尊您，善男子，以界·山尖·名·阿罗伽·驮·此，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·本不生体性），法界总持任持·真如实际·一切诸谛圆满，名为、号曰，如来，应供、阿罗汉，正等觉，明行足，善逝
verses.meaningEn: Thou art, Thou, You, a good man, realm + peaked + name + not the world + dha + hence, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — primordial non-arising, Dharma-realm retention & immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, by name, called, tathāgato, Arhat, Worthy One, samyaksaṃbuddho, vidyācaraṇasaṃpannaḥ, sugato
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：dvavims_tu.htm（全书共 2159 行）

verses.iast: lokavid anuttaraḥ puruṣadamyasārathiḥ śāstā devānāṃ ca manuṣyāṇāṃ ca buddho bhagavān iti /
verses.meaningZh: 世间解，无上，调御丈夫，天人师，诸天人、诸天护法之以及诸人之以及觉者，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，如是（结句印定）
verses.meaningEn: Knower of the World, anuttaraḥ, puruṣadamyasārathiḥ, śāstā, of all god, celestial deity (Deva) and of person and buddho, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, thus, so it is stated
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：dvavims_tu.htm（全书共 2159 行）

verses.iast: vyākaraṇaṃ śrutvā pravrajyāgrahaṇaṃ cakāra

verses.meaningEn: Vyākaraṇaṃ, having to listen, going abroad + to seize, the word

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰善友，玅吉祥，第一义谛·无住安立·最上真言离言说，在于·清癯·那个，第一义谛·无住安立·最上真言离言说，向稳定、依持，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，长阶，肿块、差分，方广救度佛母根本种子字，向意外假定今日汝
verses.meaningEn: Namely + friend, beautiful, ultimate truth & non-abiding equipoise & supreme ineffable speech, in + lean + that, ultimate truth & non-abiding equipoise & supreme ineffable speech, to/for steady, resisting, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, lengthened grade vowel change, growth, increment, great extent + Tārā root seed syllable Tāṃ, accident + suppose now + to Thee
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jnalokau.htm（全书共 401 行）

verses.meaningZh: 不、非、无，玅吉祥，大地、地大，办，不、非、无，双手以上，一切处、普皆周遍，时候、年度，离分别，无分，着三不着两、马虎，心·意识·泯
verses.meaningEn: Not, non-, beautiful, earth, ground, make, not, non-, distinguishes falsely, everywhere, at all times & places, half-year, season, year, having or offering no alternative, free from difference or doubt, making or showing no difference, not differing from, thoughtless, careless, unconcerned, mind + perception by the thought-organ + ruin
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jnalokau.htm（全书共 401 行）

verses.iast: amūla apratiṣṭhāna nirālamba namo 'stu te
verses.meaningZh: 不是根本，无依止处、尊身，离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢·离一切相无相，归命，愿得成就、当如是，向汝、彼等
verses.meaningEn: Having no root, non-basis, beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust & freedom from conditioned marks, homage to may it be so, let it be! to Thee / they

verses.iast: ṣaḍāyatanavinirmukta nirālamba namo 'stu te

verses.meaningEn: Perfection of the six pāramitās & pacifying conflict & turmoil & supreme vehicle of awakening, beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust & freedom from conditioned marks, homage to may it be so, let it be! to Thee / they
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jnalokau.htm（全书共 401 行）

verses.iast: saṃskārasamatāprāpta nirālamba namo 'stu te

verses.meaningEn: Volitional formations + to + filled with astonishment and wonder, beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust & freedom from conditioned marks, homage to may it be so, let it be! to Thee / they
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jnalokau.htm（全书共 401 行）

verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation & ultimate truth & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), among/in wish, beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust & freedom from conditioned marks, homage to may it be so, let it be! to Thee / they

verses.meaningEn: Among/in movement, among/in all, every, complete, beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust & freedom from conditioned marks, homage to may it be so, let it be! to Thee / they

verses.meaningEn: To, not, non-, supreme ineffable speech & freedom from karmic agency & ultimate truth (vocative invocation), beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust & freedom from conditioned marks, homage to may it be so, let it be! to Thee / they

verses.iast: tasmād vidyābalān nāgaḥ sa hartuṃ yadi śakyate
verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧，威神力魔法，龙，彼、此尊（阳性主格），因缘空寂大乐·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，设使，可以、切实
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness, the power of magic, nāgaḥ, he, that one, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, if, when, possible, feasible, practicable
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kbavk64u.htm（全书共 751 行）

verses.iast: sa tair vidyādharo nāma suvarṇārpaṇasaṃvidā
verses.meaningZh: 彼、此尊（阳性主格），啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·大自在威德统摄），持密咒者，名为、号曰，真金·献·旁边·今日
verses.meaningEn: He, that one, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — sovereign spiritual mastery, vidyādharo, by name, called, gold + offering + side + now
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kbavk64u.htm（全书共 751 行）

verses.iast: ātte vidyābalāt tena nāge garudatejasā

verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), from the power of magic, by that truth, thereby, through that power, O Nāga, dragon/serpent deity / in Nāga, dragon/serpent deity, awakened spiritual movement & stainless purity free from dust & generosity & self-mastery
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kbavk64u.htm（全书共 751 行）

verses.iast: sā vidyābandhakī tasya lobhād anyopayoginī

verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kbavk64u.htm（全书共 751 行）

verses.meaningEn: Yoked, harnessed, set to work, appointed, instituted, occupied with,, someone else + to, Vidyā + free from existence + can + whoever
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kbavk64u.htm（全书共 751 行）

verses.meaningZh: 奢字门（本性寂静止息（śānti）·本不生体性），心柔善，唯诸尊宣说，转载不是关系，即说咒曰·日复一日·听·编织，本性寂静止息·造作离相·离一切相无相，根由，第一义谛·妙行迁变空·真如实际，燋拘牵尊，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），希望、劝请，悉昙「u」韵字门：损减除灭忧苦，拏字门（离诸诤论无诤（araṇa）·禅定三昧总持）以及彼（宾格），境，来
verses.meaningEn: Primordial tranquil peace (śānti) — primordial non-arising, mind + or house, indeed + they instruct, forward + having no relations, namely + day after day + to listen + weave, primordial tranquil peace & freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), indeed, of course, ultimate truth & awakened conduct beyond flux & immutable Suchness, to heat + O held, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, wish for, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'u': dispelling sorrow, conflict-free peace (araṇa) — deep samādhi retention and him, that, part, to come
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kukalpmu.htm（全书共 1292 行）

verses.iast: tpa tsyata iti
verses.meaningZh: 跛字门（第一义谛（paramārtha）·本不生体性），真如实际·一切诸谛圆满·一乘如实之道，如是（结句印定）
verses.meaningEn: Ultimate truth (paramārtha) — primordial non-arising, immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme vehicle of awakening, thus, so it is stated
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kukalpmu.htm（全书共 1292 行）

verses.iast: prasādāya vyāyamitavyaṃ tadyathānuśrūyate tamasāvane ki la
verses.meaningZh: 向淳，包扎·出·邮件·来诣，即说咒曰·日复一日·听·编织，阿夷阿波南尊，迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·诸根清净自在），攞字门（离一切相无相（lakṣaṇa）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: To/for pure, wrap + income + post + coming from the sheep, namely + day after day + to listen + weave, dark-coloured + O favour, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — purified faculties, freedom from conditioned marks (lakṣaṇa) — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kukalpmu.htm（全书共 1292 行）

verses.iast: tadyathānuśrū yate rājñ. pratilabdhāyāṃ ś r ad dh āyā m ahany ahan i gṛhe pari
verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·施度调伏·一乘如实之道，拘牵尊，孃字门（圣智通达（jñāna）·远离寂静周遍），于获，奢字门（本性寂静止息（śānti）·本不生体性），啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·本不生体性），陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，驮字门（法界总持任持（dhātu，一乘如实之道，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），因缘空寂大乐·离名相假立·一乘如实之道，日子、天天，悉昙「i」韵字门：诸根清净自在，家尊，般
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & generosity & self-mastery & supreme vehicle of awakening, O held, restrained, checked, controlled / in held, restrained, checked, controlled, non-dual wisdom awareness (jñāna) — expansive quiescence, pratilabdhāyāṃ, primordial tranquil peace (śānti) — primordial non-arising, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — primordial non-arising, generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — primordial non-arising, Dharma-realm retention (dhātu) — primordial non-arising, supreme vehicle of awakening, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & beyond nominal designation & supreme vehicle of awakening, day, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'i': purified faculties, O a servant, wisdom
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kukalpmu.htm（全书共 1292 行）

verses.iast: ma
verses.meaningZh: 摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kukalpmu.htm（全书共 1292 行）

verses.iast: yate / tadyathānuśr ūyate
verses.meaningZh: 拘牵尊，真如实际·施度调伏·一乘如实之道，一乘如实之道·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: O held, restrained, checked, controlled / in held, restrained, checked, controlled, immutable Suchness & generosity & self-mastery & supreme vehicle of awakening, supreme vehicle of awakening & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kukalpmu.htm（全书共 1292 行）

verses.iast: ku latila k . .. ṇi .e
verses.meaningZh: 迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·损减除灭忧苦），离一切相无相·真如实际，迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·本不生体性），拏字门（离诸诤论无诤（araṇa）·诸根清净自在），悉昙「e」韵字门：钩召发起三昧
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — dispelling sorrow, freedom from conditioned marks & immutable Suchness, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — primordial non-arising, conflict-free peace (araṇa) — purified faculties, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'e': samādhi invocation
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kukalpmu.htm（全书共 1292 行）

verses.iast: śrīvibhavaprabhāvaprat
verses.meaningZh: 吉祥庄严·本性寂静止息
verses.meaningEn: Glorious
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kukalpmu.htm（全书共 1292 行）

verses.iast: smāc chīlasahāyena mokṣ
verses.meaningZh: 左字门（妙行迁变空（caryā）·远离寂静周遍），离覆障清凉·离一切相无相·一切诸谛圆满，沙字门（六度满行清净（ṣaṭpāramitā）·摄受法流灌顶）
verses.meaningEn: Awakened conduct beyond flux (caryā) — expansive quiescence, coolness free of obscuration & freedom from conditioned marks & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (by spiritual power), perfection of the six pāramitās — consecrating Dharma-stream
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kukalpmu.htm（全书共 1292 行）

verses.iast: m atikramāya prayatitavyam / tadyathānu śrūya
verses.meaningZh: 摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），向趣往以上、易逝，圣供勇健，即说咒曰日复一日，本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, to/for going over, passing, offering + strong, namely + day after day, primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kukalpmu.htm（全书共 1292 行）

verses.iast: tadyathānu śrūyate sthaviramau dgalyāyan
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰日复一日，听编织，一切诸谛圆满·无住安立·最上真言离言说，施度调伏·妙行趣入·离一切相无相
verses.meaningEn: Namely + day after day, to listen + weave, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & non-abiding equipoise & supreme ineffable speech (imperative seal), generosity & self-mastery & awakened spiritual movement & freedom from conditioned marks
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kukalpmu.htm（全书共 1292 行）

verses.iast: ī .. bhir avetya prasādāya praya titavyam / tadyathānuśrūyate rājñā kila kaś c i
verses.meaningZh: 悉昙「ī」韵字门：禅定三昧总持，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·诸根清净自在），最上真言离言说·真如实际·一乘如实之道，向淳，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道，真如实际·最上真言离言说·一乘如实之道，即说咒曰·日复一日·听·编织，圣智了知·清净离诸尘垢，根由，奢字门（本性寂静止息（śānti）·本不生体性），左字门（妙行迁变空（caryā）·本不生体性），悉昙「i」韵字门：诸根清净自在
verses.meaningEn: Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'ī': deep samādhi retention, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — purified faculties, supreme ineffable speech & immutable Suchness & supreme vehicle of awakening, to/for pure, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening, immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech & supreme vehicle of awakening, namely + day after day + to listen + weave, knowing, indeed, of course, primordial tranquil peace (śānti) — primordial non-arising, awakened conduct beyond flux (caryā) — primordial non-arising, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'i': purified faculties
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kukalpmu.htm（全书共 1292 行）

verses.iast: myena phalan nānveṣṭavyaṃ / tadyathānuśrūyate ka śc id alpaparicchadaḥ puruṣo dārid ry ābhi
verses.meaningZh: 无我大慈三昧·一乘如实之道·离名相假立，妙果圆成·离一切相无相·离名相假立，离名相假立·最上真言离言说·六度满行清净，即说咒曰·日复一日·听·编织，迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·本不生体性），左字门（妙行迁变空（caryā）·本不生体性），陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，小覆盖，男子，施度调伏·清净离诸尘垢，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），破有相福德光
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness & supreme vehicle of awakening & beyond nominal designation (by spiritual power), fruition of enlightenment & freedom from conditioned marks & beyond nominal designation, beyond nominal designation & supreme ineffable speech & perfection of the six pāramitās, namely + day after day + to listen + weave, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — primordial non-arising, awakened conduct beyond flux (caryā) — primordial non-arising, generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — purified faculties, small + cover, puruṣo, generosity & self-mastery & stainless purity free from dust, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, blessedness transcending existence (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kukalpmu.htm（全书共 1292 行）

verses.iast: atha khalu bhagavān āyuṣmantaṃ rāhulam āmantrayate sma
verses.meaningZh: 尔时、次复吉祥启白，诚然、确实，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，寿命活力、健康，罗喉罗，妙意三重，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Now, thereupon, auspiciously, indeed, verily, certainly, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, having life or vitality, healthy, long-lived, old, lasting, Rahula, benevolent + triple, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：madadh_u.htm（全书共 69 行）

verses.iast: udgṛhṇa tvaṃ rāhula imāṃ mahādaṇḍadhāraṇīṃ vidyām
verses.meaningZh: 施度调伏·妙行趣入·因缘空寂大乐，汝、圣尊您，罗喉罗，此（陀罗尼明妃，阴性宾格），广大殊胜·总持任持·无我大慈三昧，明咒、真言明妃、圣智明
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery & awakened spiritual movement & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, Thou, You, Rahula, this (feminine accusative), great, upholding, Vidyā, sacred wisdom-spell, illumination
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：madadh_u.htm（全书共 69 行）

verses.iast: catasṛṇāṃ parṣadāṃ rakṣāvaraṇaguptaye bhikṣūṇāṃ bhikṣuṇīnām upāsakānām upāsikānāṃ ca dīrgharātram arthāya hitāya sukhāya bhaviṣyati
verses.meaningZh: 妙行迁变空·真如实际·一切诸谛圆满，法会大众，向守护，破有相福德光·造作离相·六度满行清净，诸比丘尼，诸近事男，诸近事女以及长夜，向义利、所求善愿、胜义，向利，向乐，当
verses.meaningEn: Awakened conduct beyond flux & immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, assembly, to guard, protection, and defense, blessedness transcending existence & freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās, of nun, of all lay-disciple, of all a female lay Buddhist and long dark night, to/for meaning, benefit, aim, welfare, to/for put, placed, laid, to/for easy, pleasant, comfortable, happy, will be
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：madadh_u.htm（全书共 69 行）

verses.iast: asyāṃ khalu rāhula mahādaṇḍadhāraṇyāṃ vidyāyāṃ sakṛtparivartitāyāṃ rājacaurodakāgniviṣaśastrāṭavīkāntāraparvatadurgamadhyagataḥ sarvabhayebhyaḥ pratimucyate
verses.meaningZh: 住，诚然、确实，罗喉罗，大·金刚杖·放置·愉快，于明咒、真言明妃、圣智明中，一切诸谛圆满·造作离相·真如实际，救度超脱·趣入通行·清净离诸尘垢，向诸一切怖畏，对·解放·拘牵尊
verses.meaningEn: Asyāṃ, indeed, verily, certainly, Rahula, great + staff + put + delightful, in Vidyā, sacred wisdom-spell, illumination, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness, ferrying across, going toward, all + to all fear, toward + release + O held
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：madadh_u.htm（全书共 69 行）

verses.iast: iyaṃ khalu mahādaṇḍadhāraṇīvidyā ekanavatigaṅgānadīvālikāsamair buddhair bhāṣitā bhāṣyate bhāṣiṣyate ca siddhā paramasiddhā sarvadevanāgayakṣagandharvāsuragaruḍakinnaramahoragābhir vanditā sarvajanagaṇaparivṛtā
verses.meaningZh: 此圣女、此陀罗尼，诚然、确实，大·金刚杖·陀罗尼·明咒，造作离相·离名相假立·最上真言离言说，觉悟正觉·解脱系缚大力，妙语、语言，讲说，宣说演畅·破有相福德光以及成就者、已成就，管保不成，一切施·犹如·龙族·药叉·乾闼婆·阿修罗·迦楼罗·紧那罗·摩睺罗伽·融通，礼敬赞叹·最上真言离言说，大家·海会众·围绕
verses.meaningEn: This (feminine), indeed, verily, certainly, great + staff + Dhāraṇī + Vidyā, freedom from karmic agency & beyond nominal designation & supreme ineffable speech, awakened, spoken, told, uttered, speech, talk, speaking (vocative invocation) and accomplished, perfected adept (Siddha), assuredly, one who gives everything + like + Nāga + Yakṣa + Gandharva + Asura + Garuḍa + Kinnara + Mahoraga + to, venerating, everyone + assembly + covered
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：madadh_u.htm（全书共 69 行）

verses.iast: sarvabhayopadraveṣu mama sarvasattvānāṃ ca śivam ārogyaṃ bhavatu
verses.meaningZh: 于诸一切怖畏灾横，我之（行者所有），诸一切众生、普皆有情之以及寂静，健康，愿成就、愿悉吉祥
verses.meaningEn: All + fear + among, my, of me (the practitioner), of all all sentient beings and kind, friendly, mild, gracious, lovely, auspicious, fortunate, healthy, may it be, let there be!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：madadh_u.htm（全书共 69 行）

verses.meaningZh: 从此，目犍连，无限量尊，阿僧祇尊，细轨尊，遭遇公然，名为、号曰，如来，配称，正等觉，世间、世界尊，净水尊足，明行足，善逝，世间解，无上，调御丈夫
verses.meaningEn: From this, Moggallāna, O unmeasured, unlimited / in unmeasured, unlimited, O innumerable, O style, manner, fashion, encounter + openly, by name, called, tathāgato, deserving, worthy, entitled to, samyaksaṃbuddho, O world, realm / in world, realm, water + O foot, vidyācaraṇasaṃpannaḥ, sugato, Knower of the World, anuttaraḥ, puruṣadamyasārathiḥ
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mhvastuu.htm（全书共 13933 行）

verses.iast: evaṃ mayā śrutamekasmiṃ samaye bhagavāṃ rājagṛhe viharati sma gṛdhrakūṭe parvate
verses.meaningZh: 如是、如此，由我（具格：如是我闻），谛听妙闻·本性寂静止息，向平，世尊、薄伽梵（具六德尊），王舍城尊，一切，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），灵鸟顶山尊，时节
verses.meaningEn: Thus, in this way, by me, hearing, to equal, the Blessed One, Bhagavān, O a king's house, palace, lives, dwells, spends oneʼs time, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, O Vulture Peak / in Vulture Peak, parvate
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mhvastuu.htm（全书共 13933 行）

verses.iast: atha khalv āyuṣmān mahāmaudgalyāyano kālyam eva nivāsayitvā pātracīvaram ādāya rājagṛhaṃ nagaraṃ piṇḍāya prakrami
verses.meaningZh: 尔时、次复吉祥启白，嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk，具寿，目犍连，旦，唯、正是、决定，在于·天衣·极微已，衣钵，摄取受用已，王舍城，小邑，向丸，措施、踏步尊
verses.meaningEn: Now, thereupon, auspiciously, supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — primordial non-arising, āyuṣmān, Moggallāna, dawn, indeed, verily, alone, in + garment + having or interrog, robe and bowl, having taken forth, rājagṛhaṃ, nagaraṃ, to/for ball, O step, stride
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mhvastuu.htm（全书共 13933 行）

verses.iast: atha khalv āyuṣmato mahāmaudgalyāyanasya aciraprakrāntasyaitat abhavat
verses.meaningZh: 尔时、次复吉祥启白，嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk，以具寿此，目犍连之，妙行迁变空·清净离诸尘垢·第一义谛，无汝
verses.meaningEn: Now, thereupon, auspiciously, supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — primordial non-arising, hence, of Moggallāna, awakened conduct beyond flux & stainless purity free from dust & ultimate truth, non-you
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mhvastuu.htm（全书共 13933 行）

verses.iast: atiprāgas tāvad etarahiṃ rājagṛhaṃ nagaraṃ piṇḍāya carituṃ / yaṃ nūnāhaṃ yena śuddhāvāsaṃ devanikāyaṃ tenopasaṃkrameyaṃ
verses.meaningZh: 以及及早，真如实际·最上真言离言说·施度调伏，这早晚儿，王舍城，小邑，向丸，妙行流布·清净离诸尘垢，风大自在除障种子，真实无疑如是宣说，借由彼因缘，净居天，圣众神明，借由彼力·战拏攻击·此圣女
verses.meaningEn: Too early, immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery, at this time, rājagṛhaṃ, nagaraṃ, to/for ball, practicing, Vāyu wind-mandala swiftness seed syllable, spoke, by which, whereby, suddhavasa, host of gods, by that truth + violent attack + this
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mhvastuu.htm（全书共 13933 行）

verses.iast: athāyuṣmān mahāmaudgalyāyanaḥ tadyathāpi
verses.meaningZh: 即时汝等，目犍连，即说咒曰善友
verses.meaningEn: Then + you [plural], Moggallāna, namely + friend
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mhvastuu.htm（全书共 13933 行）

verses.iast: ito maudgalyāyana aparimite asaṃkhyeye kalpe ratno nāma samyaksaṃbuddho abhūṣi tathāgato 'rhaṃ samyaksaṃbuddho
verses.meaningZh: 从此，大目犍连，无限量尊，阿僧祇尊，细轨尊，珍宝、摩尼宝，名为、号曰，正等觉，无严饰，如来，配称，正等觉
verses.meaningEn: From this, maudgalyāyana, O unmeasured, unlimited / in unmeasured, unlimited, O innumerable, O style, manner, fashion, jewel, precious gem, treasure, by name, called, samyaksaṃbuddho, non-O adorned with, tathāgato, deserving, worthy, entitled to, samyaksaṃbuddho
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mhvastuu.htm（全书共 13933 行）

verses.iast: vidyācaraṇasampannaḥ sugato lokavid anuttaraḥ puruṣadamyasārathiḥ śāstā devānāṃ ca manuṣyāṇāṃ ca
verses.meaningZh: 明行圆满，善逝，世间解，无上，调御丈夫，天人师，诸天人、诸天护法之以及诸人之以及
verses.meaningEn: Activity of Full Brightness, sugato, Knower of the World, anuttaraḥ, puruṣadamyasārathiḥ, śāstā, of all god, celestial deity (Deva) and of person and
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mhvastuu.htm（全书共 13933 行）

verses.iast: ahaṃ tadā rājā cakravarti abhūṣi
verses.meaningZh: 我、真我自性，彼时，人皇，转轮圣王尊，无严饰
verses.meaningEn: I, the awakened self, at that time, in that case, then, rājā, O Cakravartin, universal wheel-turning monarch, non-O adorned with
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mhvastuu.htm（全书共 13933 行）

verses.iast: tato mayaitasya bhagavato ratanavato caturaśīti kūṭāgārasahasrāṇi kāritāni citrāṇi
verses.meaningZh: 次，过去趣往，以世尊此，摩尼宝鸣呼，八十四，楼观一切千，造作离相·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，一切彩画
verses.meaningEn: Secondary, made or consisting of + of going, Bhagavān + hence, jewel, caturaśīti, palace tower + thousand, freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), a color painting (plural)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mhvastuu.htm（全书共 13933 行）

verses.iast: nāmo 'stu buddhānāṃ namo 'rhatāṃ
verses.meaningZh: 名为、号曰，愿得成就、当如是，没驮南，归命，配称救度佛母根本种子字
verses.meaningEn: By name, called, may it be so, let it be! buddhānām, homage to deserving + Tārā root seed syllable Tāṃ
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mhvastuu.htm（全书共 13933 行）

verses.iast: daśabhūmikasyādi
verses.meaningZh: 十地·谁·元
verses.meaningEn: The Ten Bodhisattva Grounds + beginning
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mhvastuu.htm（全书共 13933 行）

verses.iast: na ca mantraṃ prayojenti parasya dehaghātakaṃ
verses.meaningZh: 不、非、无以及真言，乐趣热门，他人之，身凶手
verses.meaningEn: Not, non- and mantraṃ, pleasure + O a hot, of someone else, body + slayer
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mhvastuu.htm（全书共 13933 行）

verses.iast: namo 'stu te buddha anantadarśana
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼愿得成就、当如是·汝、彼等·佛陀、觉者·无边观照！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to may it be so, let it be!, Thee / they, Buddha, the Awakened One, boundless, false!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mhvastuu.htm（全书共 13933 行）

verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mpratpru.htm（全书共 496 行）

verses.meaningEn: Sravaka (plural), all + buddhānām, supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery & supreme vehicle of awakening, of great power and might (plural)

verses.iast: Mahāpratisarāvidyādhāraṇī
verses.meaningZh: 大随求佛母·明咒·陀罗尼

verses.iast: om namo bhagavatyai āryamahāpratisarāyai
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，向世尊佛母顶礼，广大殊胜·清净离诸尘垢

verses.iast: namo buddhāya namo dharmāya namaḥ saṃghāya
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛陀、觉者·正法、诸法实相·圣僧伽、清净海众！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Buddha, the Awakened One, Dharma, cosmic truth/teaching/phenomena, Saṃgha, noble spiritual community!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mprsvdhu.htm（全书共 166 行）

verses.iast: namaḥ sarvatathāgatebhyo namaḥ sarvabuddhabodhisattvebhyo 'tītānāgatapratyutpannebhyo namaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切如来富人·一切·佛陀·菩提萨埵·富人·过去·末·现在时·富人！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all Tathagatas, belonging to one's household, all, Buddha, Bodhisattva, belonging to one's household, gone away, future, present, belonging to one's household!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mprsvdhu.htm（全书共 166 行）

verses.iast: tadyathā om amṛtavare vara-vara pravara viśuddhe hūṃ-hūṃ phaṭ-phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！甘露殊胜，再三殊胜、胜愿、妙好，最妙，最极清净、究竟净除尊，吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! ambrosia + O choicest, choicest, supreme boon, excellent again and again, cover, upper garment, O completely purified, supremely pure / in completely purified, supremely pure, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ Phaṭ (shatter all obstacles)! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mprsvdhu.htm（全书共 166 行）

verses.iast: om amṛtavilokini garbha saṃrakṣaṇi ākarṣaṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭphaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！无我大慈三昧·真如实际·最上真言离言说，藏、胎藏、心髓宝藏，守护从中尊，阿羯沙尼尊，吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！顿断魔障顿断魔障，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! selfless great loving-kindness & immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation), womb, treasury, essence, matrix, O guarding, protecting from, O Akarsani, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! shatter obstacles and ignorance! + shatter obstacles and ignorance! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mprsvdhu.htm（全书共 166 行）

verses.iast: aparājitāhṛdayam
verses.meaningZh: 无能胜佛母心
verses.meaningEn: Aparājitā
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mprsvdhu.htm（全书共 166 行）

verses.iast: om vimale vipule jayavare jayavāhini amṛtaviraje hūṃ hūṃ phaṭphaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！毘磨利，广大、宽博无量尊，胜伏殊胜，尊胜降伏·生起不可得·尊胜，甘露嚩啰阇尊，吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！顿断魔障顿断魔障，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! pure, O vast, extensive, abundant, profound / in vast, extensive, abundant, profound, conquer! victory! + O choicest, conquering (vocative invocation), ambrosia + O free from dust, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! shatter obstacles and ignorance! + shatter obstacles and ignorance! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mprsvdhu.htm（全书共 166 行）

verses.iast: om bhara-bhara saṃbhara-saṃbhara indriye balaviśodhani hūṃ hūṃ phaṭphaṭru ru cale svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三方位、战斗，再三桑方位，根尊，力·闢·理由，吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！妙果圆成·断除憍慢执障·清净离诸尘垢，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·损减除灭忧苦），震动警觉、破除昏沉（左攞）尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! bearing, carrying again and again, saṃ + bearing again and again, O an organ, power + settle + O also means of purification, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! fruition of enlightenment & cutting rigid pride & stainless purity free from dust (imperative seal), stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — dispelling sorrow, O stir awake and shake off delusion! / in stir awake and shake off delusion! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mprsvdhu.htm（全书共 166 行）

verses.iast: om maṇidhari vajriṇi mahāpratisare hūṃ hūṃ phaṭphaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！持摩尼宝珠（如意离垢宝）尊，具金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）尊，大随求佛母（随愿即得大明王母）尊，吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！顿断魔障顿断魔障，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O bearer of Maṇi jewel, luminous gem, O bearer of Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, O Mahāpratisarā, Great Wish-Fulfilling Amulet Goddess / in Mahāpratisarā, Great Wish-Fulfilling Amulet Goddess, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! shatter obstacles and ignorance! + shatter obstacles and ignorance! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mprsvdhu.htm（全书共 166 行）

verses.iast: upahṛdayavidyā
verses.meaningZh: 下属明咒
verses.meaningEn: Subordinate + Vidyā
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mprsvdhu.htm（全书共 166 行）

verses.iast: yayā yukto vajrakāyo namastasyai namo namaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 一乘如实之道，具，金刚身，向管保故乡，归命，至心归命礼！
verses.meaningEn: Supreme vehicle of awakening, yoked, harnessed, set to work, appointed, instituted, occupied with,, vajrakāya, assuredly + to home, homage to reverent homage!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mprsvdhu.htm（全书共 166 行）

verses.iast: atha bhagavān ye)nopasthānaśālā tenopajagāma
verses.meaningZh: 尔时、次复吉祥启白，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，凡彼等诸有情，离名相假立·第一义谛·一切诸谛圆满，借由彼力近去
verses.meaningEn: Now, thereupon, auspiciously, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, those who, whoever (pl.), beyond nominal designation & ultimate truth & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, by that truth

verses.iast: upetya purastād bhikṣusaṃghasya prajñapta evāsane nyaṣī

verses.meaningEn: Ultimate truth & immutable Suchness & supreme vehicle of awakening, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, beggar + of Saṃgha, arranged, so + O old, beyond nominal designation & supreme vehicle of awakening & perfection of the six pāramitās

verses.meaningZh: 离名相假立·六度满行清净·施度调伏，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，破有相福德光·造作离相·六度满行清净，无我大慈三昧·离名相假立·真如实际，向汝、彼等，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation & perfection of the six pāramitās & generosity & self-mastery, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, blessedness transcending existence & freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās, selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness, to Thee / they, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mpsu_w_u.htm（全书共 1501 行）

verses.meaningEn: Namely + in this, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & generosity & self-mastery, blessedness transcending existence & supreme ineffable speech & immutable Suchness, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme vehicle of awakening & immutable Suchness, this, this sacred Dharma, burst forth + now, namely + ignorance + cause, volitional formations, conditioned phenomena, how, samudayo, suppression, primordial tranquil peace (śānti) — primordial non-arising and becomes, arises, is
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mpsu_w_u.htm（全书共 1501 行）

verses.meaningZh: 天衣，妙花鬘、持鬘尊，那缚忙里迦花，苏曼那，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·威神增益圆满），无住安立·造作离相，法界总持任持·离名相假立·六度满行清净，清净离诸尘垢，一切童子，多年生，解脱自在、不是不可，大家之
verses.meaningEn: Garment for the rainy season, garland, wreathed in blossoms, Arabian jasmine, sumanā, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — perfected spiritual vigor, non-abiding equipoise & freedom from karmic agency, Dharma-realm retention & beyond nominal designation & perfection of the six pāramitās, stainless purity free from dust, all + child, perennial, free from the obstructions, of everyone, anybody

verses.meaningEn: Dha + rubbish, servant, O lofty seat or platform for spectators, tower, upper story, palace, temple / in lofty seat or platform for spectators, tower, upper story, palace, temple, four + settle, dha (plural), turned forward or eastward, selfless great loving-kindness & ultimate truth & immutable Suchness, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'ā': expansive quiescence, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising, blessedness transcending existence (bhaga) — perfected spiritual vigor, beyond nominal designation (nāma) — primordial non-arising, supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace (vocative invocation), silver, also (plural), lapis lazuli, beryl, supreme vehicle of awakening & conflict-free peace (vocative invocation), all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & fruition of enlightenment & cutting rigid pride (vocative invocation), O vehicle
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mpsu_w_u.htm（全书共 1501 行）

verses.meaningZh: 妙行迁变空·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢，娑字门（一切诸谛圆满（sarvasatya）·远离寂静周遍），一切呼吸、生活，无我大慈三昧·第一义谛·真如实际，破有相福德光·最上真言离言说·离名相假立，一切金色，一切白银、另有，最上真言离言说·息灭诤怨，以狱王，拏字门（离诸诤论无诤（araṇa）·诸根清净自在），娑字门（一切诸谛圆满（sarvasatya）·本不生体性）

verses.meaningEn: Extend + O neutral, half + Indian subcontinent + a drop + be busy for + going, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & freedom from karmic agency, extend + O neutral, mantram

verses.meaningZh: 次，外尊，半·寸·折叠覆盖·无二

verses.meaningEn: There, therein, O first, primal, foremost, earliest, principal, best, chief, O bag / in bag, mantram, Oṃ! Maṇi jewel + thus + former, indeed, verily, alone, O second, secondly, for the second time, immutable Suchness & non-abiding equipoise & supreme ineffable speech, in two parts, in twain

verses.meaningZh: 次，外尊，融通囊，一，于彼处、其中，妙行迁变空·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢，妙行迁变空·真如实际·第一义谛，线条双倍，一切诸谛圆满·法界总持任持，以本·元·方·次第，真言
verses.meaningEn: Secondary, O outside, to + bag, ekam, there, therein, awakened conduct beyond flux & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust (imperative seal), awakened conduct beyond flux & immutable Suchness & ultimate truth (vocative invocation), streak + consisting of two, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & Dharma-realm retention (imperative seal), former + beginning + by, mantraṃ
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mpvv_u.htm（全书共 93 行）

verses.iast: likhet
verses.meaningZh: 离一切相无相·等虚空无碍·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from conditioned marks & space-like boundlessness & immutable Suchness

verses.meaningZh: 诸碎块、份额之，中尊，因缘空寂大乐·造作离相·清净离诸尘垢，持守摄受·无我大慈三昧，真言，离一切相无相·等虚空无碍·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Of all a piece split off, fragment, portion, O neutral, impartial, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), bearing (vocative invocation), mantraṃ, freedom from conditioned marks & space-like boundlessness & immutable Suchness

verses.meaningZh: 四·解·豆菜，四次·三·麦芒·金刚·半·藏，以火热·元·隅·次第，真言，离一切相无相·等虚空无碍·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Four + understanding + sugar-cane, four times + three + grief? + Vajra + half + O womb, fiery + beginning + corner + by, mantraṃ, freedom from conditioned marks & space-like boundlessness & immutable Suchness
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mpvv_u.htm（全书共 93 行）

verses.iast: iti mantradvayam ekāntaritaṃ likhet
verses.meaningZh: 如是（结句印定），真言二，一隔，离一切相无相·等虚空无碍·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Thus, so it is stated, Mantra + both, one + separate, freedom from conditioned marks & space-like boundlessness & immutable Suchness
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mpvv_u.htm（全书共 93 行）

verses.meaningZh: 次，外尊，欢喜悦泽·清净离诸尘垢，成办作持·造作离相，由伊人、本刹，初尊，囊尊，莲华部心印·偈子赞叹·鬘，一、唯一不二，离一切相无相·等虚空无碍·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Secondary, O outside, delighting, enacting, from stem of he, she, it, O first, primal, foremost, earliest, principal, best, chief, O bag / in bag, Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara + hymn of praise + a set or row of five, one, single, non-dual, freedom from conditioned marks & space-like boundlessness & immutable Suchness
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mpvv_u.htm（全书共 93 行）
