verses.iast: namo bhagavatyai āryamahāsāhasrapramardanyai
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼世尊佛母顶礼·广大殊胜·调伏碾碎·清净离诸尘垢！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Blessed Mother / Lady Bhagavatī, great, subduing (vocative invocation)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mspram_u.htm（全书共 912 行）

verses.iast: asaṅge / khaṅgavate / balavate / balanirghoṣe / śūre śūravate / vajraṃgame
verses.meaningZh: 无着尊，等虚空无碍·支分寂静·妙行趣入，力鸣呼尊，力责任，勇尊，勇鸣呼尊，金刚趣往
verses.meaningEn: O Asanga / in Asanga, space-like boundlessness & quiescence of perceptual limbs & awakened spiritual movement (vocative invocation), power, power + O blame, O bold, valiant, mighty, bold, O going to or in
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mspram_u.htm（全书共 912 行）

verses.iast: / vajradhare / stambhe jambhe / dṛḍhasāre / viraje / vighase /
verses.meaningZh: 金刚总持、执金刚尊尊，柱尊，齿相、獠牙尊，坚固尊，嚩啰阇尊，饭食尊
verses.meaningEn: O Vajradhara, Holder of the Vajra / in Vajradhara, Holder of the Vajra, O post, column, prop, support, O tooth, tusk, the jaws, mouth, dṛḍhasāre, O free from dust, O food, the remains of an oblation of food / in food, the remains of an oblation of food
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mspram_u.htm（全书共 912 行）

verses.iast: varāgraprāpte / araṇe dharmayukte diśi vighuṣṭe svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 殊胜·尊·得尊，解脱自在、贪欲尊，良性、虔信尊，方位，扬名尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Choicest + first + O filled with astonishment and wonder, O free from depravity, passion, impurity, O virtuous, pious, just / in virtuous, pious, just, direction, vighuṣṭe, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mspram_u.htm（全书共 912 行）

verses.iast: vidyāpāśena daṇḍena sadā saṃsāragāminaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 以明咒羂索，以金刚杖、宝杖，恒常、一切时，轮廻趣往
verses.meaningEn: Vidyā + by, by/through staff, scepter, rod, always, evermore, wandering + going
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mspram_u.htm（全书共 912 行）

verses.iast: vidyātikrāntāḥ pariṣadaḥ samantād daṇḍatarjitāḥ
verses.meaningZh: 发现物诸古昔，衆，一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·离名相假立，金刚杖诸威胁
verses.meaningEn: Finding + surpassing, assembly, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation, staff + threat
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mspram_u.htm（全书共 912 行）

verses.iast: yakṣakoṭīsahasrāṇi vidyāpāśena karṣitāḥ
verses.meaningZh: 药叉·魔爪·一切千，以明咒羂索，钩召摄受·造作离相
verses.meaningEn: Yakṣa + the curved end of the bow + thousand, Vidyā + by, drawing in
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mspram_u.htm（全书共 912 行）

verses.iast: prāñjalīkā namasyāmo dharmarāja namo 'stu te
verses.meaningZh: 成办，具寿是的，法王，归命，愿得成就、当如是，向汝、彼等
verses.meaningEn: Making a gesture of reverence in front, to be worshipped + yes, Dharmaraja, homage to may it be so, let it be! to Thee / they
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mspram_u.htm（全书共 912 行）

verses.iast: sarve samāgatās te 'pi vidyāpāśena karṣitāḥ
verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满尊，一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·妙行趣入，向汝、彼等，亦、虽、乃至，以明咒羂索，钩召摄受·造作离相
verses.meaningEn: O all, every, complete / in all, every, complete, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & awakened spiritual movement, to Thee / they, even, also, Vidyā + by, drawing in
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mspram_u.htm（全书共 912 行）

verses.iast: namas te puruṣavīra namo 'stu puruṣottama
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼汝、彼等·士夫勇猛丈夫·愿得成就、当如是·士夫最上！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Thee / they, man, heroic, may it be so, let it be!, man, highest!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mspram_u.htm（全书共 912 行）

verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：nitkarpu.htm（全书共 219 行）

verses.meaningZh: 跋字门（解脱系缚大力（bala，凡所…者，以及于此之中，一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·施度调伏，破有相福德光·最上真言离言说·真如实际，一切诸谛圆满·一乘如实之道·真如实际，此、此妙法，迸今日

verses.iast: repheṇa sūryaṃ purato vibhāvya tasmin ravau hūṃbhavaviśvavajram
verses.meaningZh: 清净离诸尘垢·妙果圆成·离诸诤论无诤，日轮、太阳光明，阵地、之前，闢未来世，于彼处、于彼时，清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，金刚不坏菩提心印·愿成·遍一切·金刚
verses.meaningEn: Stainless purity free from dust & fruition of enlightenment & conflict-free peace (by spiritual power), sun, solar orb, in front, before , in presence of, settle + what ought to be, in that, therein, stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech (imperative seal), adamantine bodhicitta seed syllable + be! become! + all-pervading
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：rabhramu.htm（全书共 197 行）

verses.iast: hūṃkārasphārivadanaṃ bhasmoddhūlitavigraham
verses.meaningZh: 因缘空寂大乐·造作离相·清净离诸尘垢，破有相福德光·一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧
verses.meaningEn: Causal emptiness & spiritual joy & freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust, blessedness transcending existence & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：rabhramu.htm（全书共 197 行）

verses.iast: madhye maṇḍitaṃ oṃkārahūṃkārākārahaṃkṛtaiḥ
verses.meaningZh: 中尊，甲板趣往，以诸音节·吽字·相·不动明王因业清净虚空种子·所作
verses.meaningEn: O neutral, impartial, deck + going, the syllable + hum syllable + disposition + Acala Vidyārāja & space-element seed syllable + by
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：rabhramu.htm（全书共 197 行）

verses.iast: oṃ vajra mahādveṣa caturānandadāyaka
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），大瞋恚，四·阿难·施者
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, great + hatred, four + servant + giving
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：rabhramu.htm（全书共 197 行）

verses.iast: athāntarīkṣe hūṃkāreṇa vajraṃ vicintya, tasyādhastād āḥkāreṇa padmam, tanmadhye praṇavāṅkitāni dravyāṇi, vajrapadmasamāyogād agnijvālanam,
verses.meaningZh: 尔时天线尊，以吽字，金刚，闢主顾，真如实际·一切诸谛圆满·一乘如实之道，造作离相·清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤，壤，推广中尊，神圣·弯子·一切趣往，一切实，最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜·清净离诸尘垢，圣火引柴
verses.meaningEn: Now + O aerial, by/through hum syllable, vajraṃ, settle + =, immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme vehicle of awakening, freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace (by spiritual power), padmam, extend + O neutral, the sacred syllable Om + bend + going, property, wealth, supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious & stainless purity free from dust, fire + kindling
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：rabhramu.htm（全书共 197 行）

verses.iast: tena teṣāṃ tāpanam, pākād dravīkṛtya jñānasūryīkaraṇād dyotanam, tatkiraṇair daśadiksarvatathāgatānāṃ rūpadarśanam, tajjñānabījebhyas tair
verses.meaningZh: 借由彼力、以是因缘，彼等一切之，炎热，第一义谛·造作离相·施度调伏，消化业行，圣智了知·能作成办·生起不可得·尊胜，光明照耀，真如实际·造作离相·清净离诸尘垢，十·方·诸一切如来之，色观照，圣智了知·真如实际，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·大自在威德统摄）
verses.meaningEn: By that truth, thereby, through that power, of them, their, heating, burning, distressing, illumining, ultimate truth & freedom from karmic agency & generosity & self-mastery, become fluid + actions, knowing, making, shining, illuminating, enlightening, showing, immutable Suchness & freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust, ten + of all all Tathagatas, form, knowing, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — sovereign spiritual mastery
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：rabhramu.htm（全书共 197 行）

verses.iast: eva kiraṇair ākṛṣya jñānāmṛtaṃ teṣu saṃpātya samarasīkuryāt. evaṃ tāny amṛtīkṛtya tryakṣareṇādhiṣṭhāya hūṃkāreṇa
verses.meaningZh: 唯、正是、决定，造作离相·清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤，钩召摄引·造作离相，圣智甘露，真如实际·六度满行清净，桑统治权，成办作持·一切诸谛圆满，如是、如此，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·远离寂静周遍），无我大慈三昧·真如实际·造作离相，真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道，以吽字
verses.meaningEn: Indeed, verily, alone, freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace, magnetizing, primordial wisdom, immutable Suchness & perfection of the six pāramitās (imperative seal), saṃ + dominion, enacting, thus, in this way, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — expansive quiescence, selfless great loving-kindness & immutable Suchness & freedom from karmic agency, immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening (reverent offering), by/through hum syllable
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：rabhramu.htm（全书共 197 行）

verses.iast: jihvāyāṃ śubhravajram, hṛtsūrye ca maṇḍalam adhimucya, tair amṛtair ātmānaṃ maṇḍalaṃ ca saṃtarpayet
verses.meaningZh: 于广长舌相中，善见金刚，除断日轮以及曼荼罗，法界总持任持·无我大慈三昧·妙行迁变空，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·大自在威德统摄），无我大慈三昧·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢，我气息，曼荼罗以及一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: In tongue, beautiful, bringing + O sun and maṇḍalam, Dharma-realm retention & selfless great loving-kindness & awakened conduct beyond flux, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — sovereign spiritual mastery, selfless great loving-kindness & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust, self + breath, maṇḍalaṃ and all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：rabhramu.htm（全书共 197 行）

verses.iast: iti karmarājāgrī nāma tṛtīyaḥ samādhiḥ, nairmāṇikaś ca kāyaḥ. bhāvanākhinno mantraṃ japet. samaṇḍalam ātmānaṃ devatārūpeṇāvirbhūtaṃ vicintya
verses.meaningZh: 如是（结句印定），事·来诣·尊佛母，名为、号曰，第三，精进，离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧以及身，观想沉闷，真言，生起不可得·尊胜·第一义谛·真如实际，彼曼荼罗，我气息，救度超脱·施度调伏，闢主顾
verses.meaningEn: Thus, so it is stated, actions + coming from or belonging to goats + first, by name, called, the third, samādhiḥ, beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust & selfless great loving-kindness and kāyaḥ, this is his + depressed, mantraṃ, transcending birth & victorious & ultimate truth & immutable Suchness, he, self + breath, ferrying across, settle + =
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：rabhramu.htm（全书共 197 行）

verses.meaningZh: 凡彼等诸有情，本性寂静止息·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际，于诸舍离道德中，能察，于诸明咒、真言明妃、圣智明中，诸究

verses.iast: asmin khalu punaḥ sarvajñajñānapratilābhavyākaraṇe bhāṣyamāṇe viṃśatibhir mārakanyāmāraputragaṇapārṣadyasahasrair anutpattikeṣu dharmeṣu kṣānti ḥ pratilābdhā

verses.meaningEn: In this, indeed, verily, certainly, again, furthermore, omniscient + primordial wisdom + receiving + O explanation, O command, supreme ineffable speech & primordial tranquil peace & immutable Suchness, selfless great loving-kindness & stainless purity free from dust & freedom from karmic agency, beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness & ultimate truth (imperative seal), among/in Dharma, cosmic truth/teaching/phenomena, patience, forbearance, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'ḥ': primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness

verses.meaningEn: Audārikaṃ and body, kāya (sacred dimension), Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'ṃ': primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, pride + made or consisting of, body, kāya (sacred dimension), ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), work + they, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising

verses.meaningEn: Bhūtapūrvaṃ, all + bold + O gone away, Dharma-realm retention & supreme ineffable speech & beyond nominal designation, by/with innumerable, freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks & ultimate truth (vocative invocation), jewel, by name, called, tathāgato, Arhat, Worthy One, samyaksaṃbuddho, world, realm, water + O foot

verses.meaningZh: 明行足，善逝，世间解，无上，调御丈夫，天人师，诸天人、诸天护法之以及诸人之以及觉者，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵
verses.meaningEn: Vidyācaraṇasaṃpannaḥ, sugato, Knower of the World, anuttaraḥ, puruṣadamyasārathiḥ, śāstā, of all god, celestial deity (Deva) and of person and buddho, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord

verses.meaningEn: Now, thereupon, auspiciously, to Thee / they, a Jain monk, Bhagavān + hence, near to, freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust & generosity & self-mastery, unbelief + mind, immutable Suchness & ultimate truth & generosity & self-mastery, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, by that truth, thereby, through that power, indeed, verily, certainly

verses.meaningEn: Again, furthermore, by/through black, by that truth, thereby, through that power, by/through Samaya, sacred vow, pledge, union, śakro, of all god, celestial deity (Deva), indro, vajraṃ, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & causal emptiness & spiritual joy

verses.meaningEn: Now, thereupon, auspiciously, bodhisattvaḥ, again + even, all Tathagatas + with, awakening, whatever, that which, immutable Suchness & awakened conduct beyond flux & beyond nominal designation, immutable Suchness & awakened conduct beyond flux & beyond nominal designation, I looking, knowing, intelligent, all Tathagatas, causal emptiness & spiritual joy

verses.iast: om namo buddhāya
verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！归命，向佛陀、觉者
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to/for Buddha, the Awakened One
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：suvrnavu.htm（全书共 1007 行）

verses.iast: namo 'stu te mahāvīra sambuddha dvipadottama
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼愿得成就、当如是·汝、彼等·大勤勇·随着佛陀·二·句·最上！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to may it be so, let it be!, Thee / they, greatly zealous and bold, along with, Buddha, two, word, highest!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：suvrnavu.htm（全书共 1007 行）

verses.iast: bhūtapūrvaṃ mahārāja ita ekanavate kalpe bhagavāṃ vipaśyī nāma tathāgato loka udapādi vidyācaraṇasamampannaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 古昔，大王，趣往、途径，一九，细轨尊，世尊、薄伽梵（具六德尊），胜观，名为、号曰，如来，世间、世界，净水尊足，明咒·杂罗南·彼·瞒·微妙·我等
verses.meaningEn: Bhūtapūrvaṃ, great king, going, way, one + nine, O style, manner, fashion, the Blessed One, Bhagavān, Vipaśyī Buddha, by name, called, tathāgato, world, realm, water + O foot, Vidyā + residence + he + maṃ + be wonderful + us
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：suvrnavu.htm（全书共 1007 行）

verses.iast: sugato lokavid anuttaraḥ puruṣadamyasārathiḥ śāstā devamanuṣyāṇāṃ buddho bhagavān
verses.meaningZh: 善逝，世间解，无上，调御丈夫，天人师，诸神明男人之，觉者，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵
verses.meaningEn: Sugato, Knower of the World, anuttaraḥ, puruṣadamyasārathiḥ, śāstā, of gods men, buddho, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：suvrnavu.htm（全书共 1007 行）

verses.iast: sa bandhumatīṃ rājadhānīm upaniḥsṛtya viharati bandhumatīyake dāve
verses.meaningZh: 彼、此尊（阳性主格），结界系缚·解脱系缚大力，清净离诸尘垢·生起不可得·尊胜·法界总持任持，愈加·之前·流畅，一切，结界系缚·解脱系缚大力，火势、森林尊
verses.meaningEn: He, that one, binding obstacles, stainless purity free from dust & transcending birth & victorious & Dharma-realm retention, thereto + before + running, lives, dwells, spends oneʼs time, binding obstacles (vocative invocation), O conflagration, of a forest
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：suvrnavu.htm（全书共 1007 行）

verses.iast: namo 'stu tasmai nāthāya puṇyakṣetrāya tāyine
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼愿得成就、当如是·彼尊（为格）·依·福田·扩大勇健！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to may it be so, let it be!, him, to that one, refuge, aid, field of blessing, expand, O strong!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：suvrnavu.htm（全书共 1007 行）

verses.iast: namo 'stu lokanāthāya sarvajñāya vipaśyine
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼愿得成就、当如是·世所宗奉·一切智·最上真言离言说·第一义谛·本性寂静止息！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to may it be so, let it be!, Lokanatha, omniscient, supreme ineffable speech & ultimate truth & primordial tranquil peace (vocative invocation)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：suvrnavu.htm（全书共 1007 行）

verses.meaningEn: Like, just as, wisdom + extinguished, along with + to + moving + yes, that, thus, one, single, non-dual, ultimate truth (paramārtha) — dispelling sorrow, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — dispelling sorrow, perfection of the six pāramitās — consecrating Dharma-stream, wish for + down, knotty + vagrant + agriculture + action + a measure of grain + down + toward + turning, excellence

verses.iast: Vajravidarani-Dharani
verses.meaningZh: 金刚·闢·揭幕·在于，请执持在于
verses.meaningEn: Vajra + settle + cleaving + in, hold! bear! sustain! + in
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：vajvidhu.htm（全书共 87 行）

verses.iast: namo bhagavatya āryamahāvajravidāraṇāyai / namo buddhāya
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼世尊疾速·广大殊胜·清净离诸尘垢·佛陀、觉者！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Bhagavān, hastening, great (vocative invocation), Buddha, the Awakened One!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：vajvidhu.htm（全书共 87 行）

verses.iast: namo ratnatrayāya
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛法僧三宝！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：vajvidhu.htm（全书共 87 行）

verses.iast: namo caṇḍavajrapāṇaye mahāyakṣasenāpataye
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼威猛金刚手菩萨·大药叉军主！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to fierce, to Vajrapāṇi, mahāyakṣasenāpataye!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：vajvidhu.htm（全书共 87 行）

verses.iast: tadyathā / taṭa taṭa trotaya trotaya sphuṭa sphuṭa sphoṭaya sphoṭaya ghuṇa ghuṇa
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：再三坡度、海滨，再三真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道，再三开，再三请击碎、破除一切结缚！再三破暗合集·离诸诤论无诤
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: slope, declivity again and again, immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening again and again, suffused again and again, shatter! split open! again and again, dissolving dense ignorance & conflict-free peace again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：vajvidhu.htm（全书共 87 行）

verses.iast: ghuṇāpaya ghuṇāpaya sarvasatvāni bodhaya bodhaya saṃbodhaya saṃbodhaya trasa trasa soṃtrāsaya soṃtrāsaya sarvabuddhābodhinī
verses.meaningZh: 再三破暗合集·离诸诤论无诤·第一义谛，一切一切众生、普皆有情，再三请开晓觉悟、令发菩提觉智！再三理解、聪慧，再三活动、动人，再三一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢，一切·佛陀·具无明
verses.meaningEn: Dissolving dense ignorance & conflict-free peace & ultimate truth again and again, all sentient beings (plural), awaken! enlighten! illuminate! again and again, may You understanding, intelligence! again and again, movable, moving again and again, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust again and again, all + Buddha + possessing ignorance
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：vajvidhu.htm（全书共 87 行）

verses.iast: sarvabuddhābodhinī kūṭa kūṭa kūṭaya kūṭaya saṃkuṭaya saṃkuṭaya sarvaśatrūn ghaṭa ghaṭa saṃghaṭaya saṃghaṭaya
verses.meaningZh: 一切·佛陀·具无明，再三边椽，再三边椽，再三桑祈请庵，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，再三瓶，再三桑祈请瓶
verses.meaningEn: All + Buddha + possessing ignorance, bone of the forehead, horn again and again, may You bone of the forehead, horn again and again, saṃ + may You cottage! again and again, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, jar, ewer again and again, saṃ + may You jar again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：vajvidhu.htm（全书共 87 行）

verses.iast: sarvavidyāvajra sarvavidyāvajra sphoṭaya vajra vajra kaṭa vajra vajra maṭa vajra vajra pratha
verses.meaningZh: 再三一切·明咒·金刚，请击碎、破除一切结缚！再三金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），席，再三金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），无我大慈三昧·断除憍慢执障，再三金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），那罗、名望
verses.meaningEn: All + Vidyā + Vajra again and again, shatter! split open! Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt again and again, straw mat, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt again and again, selfless great loving-kindness & cutting rigid pride, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt again and again, of a man, = + fame, renown
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：vajvidhu.htm（全书共 87 行）

verses.iast: vajra vajra tatha sahanīlavajra suvajrāya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 再三金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），真如实际·无住安立，俱共·绀青·金刚，向勇健金刚杵，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt again and again, immutable Suchness & non-abiding equipoise, together with + sapphire-blue + Vajra, to/for having a strong thunderbolt, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：vajvidhu.htm（全书共 87 行）

verses.iast: ṛddhisthiravajra śrutisthiravajra pratisthiravajra mahāvajra apratihatavajra amoghavajra ehy ehi vajra śīghraṃ vajrāya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 通·坚硬·金刚，闻·坚硬·金刚，对·坚硬·金刚，大金刚，无碍金刚，不空，善来（连音式：迎请圣尊速降）！善来降临坛场（翳呬），金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），快，向金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: A spiritual power + hard + Vajra, hearing + hard + Vajra, toward + hard + Vajra, great + Vajra, unobstructed + Vajra, Amoghavajra, come! approach! come forth, O Blessed One! Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, śīghraṃ, to/for Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：vajvidhu.htm（全书共 87 行）

verses.iast: nara daha daha dhara dhara vajra tejovati tiri tiri bandha bandha mahābala vajra vajrāṅkuśa jvālaya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 男子，再三智火焚净一切罪垢（娜贺），再三请执持、总持护念！金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），具足威光尊，再三真如实际·清净离诸尘垢，再三结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮），大力威神、大势力尊，金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），金刚面天，祈请焰光，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Man, husband, hero, incinerate all defilements with wisdom-fire! again and again, hold! bear! sustain! again and again, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, tejovati, immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation) again and again, bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! again and again, of great power and might, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, Vajrāṅkuśa, may You light, flame, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：vajvidhu.htm（全书共 87 行）

verses.iast: oṃ namo ratnatrayāya / namaś caṇḍavajrapāṇaye mahāyakṣasenāpataye
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，向佛法僧三宝，归命敬礼·离名相假立，向威猛金刚手菩萨，向大药叉军主
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to/for the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha), bowing, fierce + to Vajrapāṇi, mahāyakṣasenāpataye
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：vajvidhu.htm（全书共 87 行）

verses.iast: kiṃ manyadhve bhikṣavaḥ yo 'sau caṇḍālaḥ eṣa evāsau daśabalakāśyapaḥ tena kālena tena
verses.meaningZh: 迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·诸根清净自在·大空菩提点摄持），无我大慈三昧·离名相假立·一乘如实之道，希望鸿毛，凡彼圣尊、能…者，那个，下贱种，急促事关，唯那个，十力护容子，借由彼力、以是因缘，以时，借由彼力、以是因缘
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — purified faculties sealed with bodhicitta bindu, selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation), wish for + down, who, whichever, yonder, that, one so and so, caṇḍālaḥ, rushing on, as subst, indeed + yonder, possessing the ten bala, by that truth, thereby, through that power, by/through black, by that truth, thereby, through that power
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：vinv172u.htm（全书共 1715 行）

verses.iast: samayena; so 'sau māṇavaḥ eṣa eva asau devadattaḥ tena kālena tena samayena;
verses.meaningZh: 以三昧耶（本誓、平等契合、时际），彼、彼尊（连音式），那个，摩纳婆，急促事关，唯、正是、决定，那个，天授，借由彼力、以是因缘，以时，借由彼力、以是因缘，以三昧耶（本誓、平等契合、时际）
verses.meaningEn: By/through Samaya, sacred vow, pledge, union, he, that one, yonder, that, one so and so, a youth, rushing on, as subst, indeed, verily, alone, yonder, that, one so and so, devadattaḥ, by that truth, thereby, through that power, by/through black, by that truth, thereby, through that power, by/through Samaya, sacred vow, pledge, union
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：vinv172u.htm（全书共 1715 行）

verses.iast: tadāpy eṣa vidyāyāḥ parihīṇaḥ; adyāpy eṣa ṛddheḥ parihīṇaḥ; tasmāt tarhi bhikṣavaḥ evaṃ
verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·施度调伏·第一义谛，急促事关，明咒、真言明妃、圣智明之，匮，施度调伏·一乘如实之道·第一义谛，急促事关，通之，匮，是故、因此、从彼，若尔，希望鸿毛，如是、如此
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & generosity & self-mastery & ultimate truth, rushing on, as subst, of Vidyā, sacred wisdom-spell, illumination, deficient, generosity & self-mastery & supreme vehicle of awakening & ultimate truth, rushing on, as subst, of a spiritual power, deficient, therefore, from that, then, wish for + down, thus, in this way
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：vinv172u.htm（全书共 1715 行）

verses.iast: śikṣitavyaṃ yat kṛtajñā bhaviṣyāmaḥ; svalpam api kṛtaṃ na nāśayiṣyāmaḥ prāg eva prabhūtataram;
verses.meaningZh: 本性寂静止息·造作离相·六度满行清净，凡所…者，工巧，我等未来世、当头，渺小，亦、虽、乃至，所作、已成办，不、非、无，摧灭除遣·离名相假立，誐字门（妙行趣入（gati）·远离寂静周遍），唯、正是、决定，部多弯曲
verses.meaningEn: Primordial tranquil peace & freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās, whatever, that which, grateful, we future, imminent, very small or minute, insignificant, even, also, done, made, accomplished, not, non-, destroying obstacles, awakened spiritual movement (gati) — expansive quiescence, indeed, verily, alone, come forth + crossing
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：vinv172u.htm（全书共 1715 行）

verses.iast: ity evaṃ vo bhikṣavaḥ śikṣitavyaṃ
verses.meaningZh: 耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·诸根清净自在），如是、如此，嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk，希望鸿毛，本性寂静止息·造作离相·六度满行清净
verses.meaningEn: Supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — purified faculties, thus, in this way, supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — consecrating Dharma-stream, wish for + down, primordial tranquil peace & freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：vinv172u.htm（全书共 1715 行）

titleZh: 【梵本】梵文贝叶佛典《Bhaisajyavastu of the Vinayavastvagama [Vastu 6]》总持真言选 (vinv_06u.htm)

tato bhikṣubhir āyuṣmataḥ svāter vikṛtabhojanaṃ dattam / tathāpi na svasthībhavati / etat prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣavo bhagavata ārocayanti / bhagavān āha / śakṣyasi tvam ānanda mamāntikān mahāmāyūrīṃ vidyām udgṛhya paryavāpya svāter bhikṣo rakṣāṃ kartuṃ paritrāṇaṃ parigrahaṃ viṣadūṣaṇaṃ daṇḍaparihāraṃ viṣanāśanaṃ sīmābandhaṃ dharaṇībandhaṃ ca / bhāṣatāṃ bhagavān śroṣyāmi / atha bhagavāṃs tasyāṃ velāyām imāṃ mahāmāyūrīṃ vidyāṃ bhāṣate sma
namo buddhāya namo dharmāya namaḥ saṃghāya
evaṃ bhadantety āyuṣmān ānando bhagavato 'ntikān mahāmāyūrīṃ vidyām udgṛhya paryavāpya svāter bhikṣoḥ svastyayanaṃ kṛtam / nirviṣaś ca saṃvṛtto yathā paurāṇaḥ
bhikṣavaḥ saṃśayajātāḥ sarvasaṃśayacchettāraṃ buddhaṃ bhagavantaṃ papracchuḥ / āscaryaṃ bhagavan yāvac ca bhagavatā mahāmāyūrī vidyā upakarā bahukarā ca / na bhikṣava etarhi yathā mamātīte 'py adhvany akṣaṇapratipannasya ( fol. 239v1 = GBM 6.791 ) vinipatitaśarīrasyāpi mahāmāyūrī vidyārājā upakarā bahukarā ca / tac chrūyatām

verses.iast: dakṣiṇabāhum abhiprasāryodānam udānayati
verses.meaningZh: 右臂，挫·噜噜·尊者·布施，优陀那戒精进
verses.meaningEn: Right + arm, to rush towards + roar, a solemn but joyous utterance + as many
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：vinv_06u.htm（全书共 2009 行）

verses.iast: tato bhikṣubhir āyuṣmataḥ svāter vikṛtabhojanaṃ dattam / tathāpi na svasthībhavati / etat
verses.meaningZh: 次，破有相福德光·造作离相·六度满行清净，具寿，昴宿，恶趣喫，施度调伏·真如实际·无我大慈三昧，或是，不、非、无，一切诸谛圆满·最上真言离言说·无住安立，真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Secondary, blessedness transcending existence & freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās, āyuṣmataḥ, of the auspicious Svātī constellation, objects that cause a change + to eat, generosity & self-mastery & immutable Suchness & selfless great loving-kindness, tathāpi, not, non-, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme ineffable speech & non-abiding equipoise (vocative invocation), immutable Suchness
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：vinv_06u.htm（全书共 2009 行）

verses.iast: prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣavo bhagavata ārocayanti / bhagavān āha / śakṣyasi tvam ānanda mamāntikān
verses.meaningZh: 极所作，希望人情，才鸣呼，此边诸尊增，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，如是宣说、佛言，本性寂静止息·造作离相·六度满行清净，汝、尊者您，阿难，我之侧
verses.meaningEn: Prakaraṇaṃ, wish for + favour, excellence, the hither + they layer, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, spoke, declared thus, primordial tranquil peace & freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās (vocative invocation), Thou, You, servant, my + near
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：vinv_06u.htm（全书共 2009 行）

verses.iast: mahāmāyūrīṃ vidyām udgṛhya paryavāpya svāter bhikṣo rakṣāṃ kartuṃ paritrāṇaṃ parigrahaṃ viṣadūṣaṇaṃ daṇḍaparihāraṃ
verses.meaningZh: 广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，明咒、真言明妃、圣智明，施度调伏·妙行趣入·因缘空寂大乐，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道，昴宿，破有相福德光·造作离相·六度满行清净，守护、结界护念，能作成办·造作离相，皆护，摄受，摧灭毒素，金刚杖回答
verses.meaningEn: Great, Vidyā, sacred wisdom-spell, illumination, generosity & self-mastery & awakened spiritual movement & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening, of the auspicious Svātī constellation, blessedness transcending existence & freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās, protection, safeguarding, making, paritrāṇaṃ, to protect, destroying poison, staff + watchful care
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：vinv_06u.htm（全书共 2009 行）

verses.iast: viṣanāśanaṃ sīmābandhaṃ dharaṇībandhaṃ ca / bhāṣatāṃ bhagavān śroṣyāmi / atha bhagavāṃs tasyāṃ
verses.meaningZh: 毒害摧灭，结界，簷结界系缚邪魔外障以及宣说演畅·破有相福德光，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢·六度满行清净，尔时、次复吉祥启白，星宿诸特，彼之、其（属格）
verses.meaningEn: Poison + destroying, drawing a strict line of, support + bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! and speaking, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust & perfection of the six pāramitās (vocative invocation), now, thereupon, auspiciously, star + bull, his, of that
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：vinv_06u.htm（全书共 2009 行）

verses.iast: velāyām imāṃ mahāmāyūrīṃ vidyāṃ bhāṣate sma
verses.meaningZh: 于时，此（陀罗尼明妃，阴性宾格），广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，明咒、真言明妃、圣智明，说，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: In time, this (feminine accusative), great, Vidyā, sacred wisdom-spell, illumination, to speak, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：vinv_06u.htm（全书共 2009 行）

verses.iast: namo buddhāya namo dharmāya namaḥ saṃghāya
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛陀、觉者·正法、诸法实相·圣僧伽、清净海众！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Buddha, the Awakened One, Dharma, cosmic truth/teaching/phenomena, Saṃgha, noble spiritual community!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：vinv_06u.htm（全书共 2009 行）

verses.iast: evaṃ bhadantety āyuṣmān ānando bhagavato 'ntikān mahāmāyūrīṃ vidyām udgṛhya paryavāpya svāter bhikṣoḥ
verses.meaningZh: 如是、如此，破有相福德光·施度调伏·离名相假立，具寿，普喜，以世尊此，侧，广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，明咒、真言明妃、圣智明，施度调伏·妙行趣入·因缘空寂大乐，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道，昴宿，比丘
verses.meaningEn: Thus, in this way, blessedness transcending existence & generosity & self-mastery & beyond nominal designation, āyuṣmān, ānando, Bhagavān + hence, near, great, Vidyā, sacred wisdom-spell, illumination, generosity & self-mastery & awakened spiritual movement & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening, of the auspicious Svātī constellation, of beggar, religious mendicant, a Brahman in the last stage of his life, also a Buddhist
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：vinv_06u.htm（全书共 2009 行）

verses.iast: svastyayanaṃ kṛtam / nirviṣaś ca saṃvṛtto yathā paurāṇaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 成妙善乐，所作、已成办，离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说以及桑文章，犹如、如…所说，古老
verses.meaningEn: Svastyayanaṃ, done, made, accomplished, beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech and saṃ + turned, just as, according to, belonging to or derived from the olden times
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：vinv_06u.htm（全书共 2009 行）

verses.iast: bhikṣavaḥ saṃśayajātāḥ sarvasaṃśayacchettāraṃ buddhaṃ bhagavantaṃ papracchuḥ / āscaryaṃ bhagavan yāvac ca bhagavatā
verses.meaningZh: 希望鸿毛，疑惑诸部多，救度超脱·一切诸谛圆满，佛陀、觉者，若衍底，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·妙行迁变空，妙行流布·一切诸谛圆满，出有坏，真言宣演·一乘如实之道以及才鸣呼
verses.meaningEn: Wish for + down, doubt + become characterized by, ferrying across, Buddha, the Awakened One, victorious(-ly) passed beyond, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & awakened conduct beyond flux, practicing, bhagavan, uttering and excellence
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：vinv_06u.htm（全书共 2009 行）

verses.iast: mahāmāyūrī vidyā upakarā bahukarā ca / na bhikṣava etarhi yathā mamātīte 'py
verses.meaningZh: 孔雀明王，明咒、真言明妃、圣智明，愈加掌，多作以及不、非、无，希望鸿毛，初时，犹如、如…所说，我之过去尊，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Peahen Queen, Vidyā, sacred wisdom-spell, illumination, thereto + palm, very useful, very helpful and not, non-, wish for + down, now, at present, at this time, just as, according to, my + O gone away, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：vinv_06u.htm（全书共 2009 行）

verses.iast: adhvany akṣaṇapratipannasya vinipatitaśarīrasyāpi mahāmāyūrī vidyārājā upakarā bahukarā ca / tac chrūyatām
verses.meaningZh: 法界总持任持·最上真言离言说·离名相假立，难入之，最上真言离言说·离名相假立·第一义谛，孔雀明王，明王，愈加掌，多作以及左字门（妙行迁变空（caryā）·本不生体性），离覆障清凉·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Dharma-realm retention & supreme ineffable speech & beyond nominal designation, inopportune + of practised, supreme ineffable speech & beyond nominal designation & ultimate truth (vocative invocation), Peahen Queen, lord of spells, thereto + palm, very useful, very helpful and awakened conduct beyond flux (caryā) — primordial non-arising, coolness free of obscuration & stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：vinv_06u.htm（全书共 2009 行）

verses.iast: AVŚ 1,7.4a) agniḥ pūrva ā rabhatāṃ prendro nudatu bāhumān
verses.meaningZh: 奢字门（本性寂静止息（śānti）·本不生体性），悉昙「a」韵字门：本不生体性，圣火、智火（火大），本，悉昙「ā」韵字门：远离寂静周遍，猕猴救度佛母根本种子字，转载印达罗，愿推动、冲击力，解脱系缚大力·因缘空寂大乐·无我大慈三昧
verses.meaningEn: Primordial tranquil peace (śānti) — primordial non-arising, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising, fire, sacred flame (Agni), former, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'ā': expansive quiescence, of a monkey + Tārā root seed syllable Tāṃ, forward, may it push, thrust, spiritual strength freeing bonds & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & selfless great loving-kindness
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：avs___u.htm（全书共 18633 行）

verses.iast: AVŚ 1,8.2c) bṛhaspate vaśe labdhvāgnīṣomā vi vidhyatam
verses.meaningZh: 奢字门（本性寂静止息（śānti）·本不生体性），左字门（妙行迁变空（caryā）·本不生体性），解脱系缚大力·因缘空寂大乐·一切诸谛圆满，因为、截至所以尊，离一切相无相·解脱系缚大力·法界总持任持，嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk，服务天神拘牵
verses.meaningEn: Primordial tranquil peace (śānti) — primordial non-arising, awakened conduct beyond flux (caryā) — primordial non-arising, spiritual strength freeing bonds & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (vocative invocation), O on account of, for the sake of, by reason of, freedom from conditioned marks & spiritual strength freeing bonds & Dharma-realm retention, supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — purified faculties, serve a god + held

verses.meaningEn: To me, my, Dharma-realm retention & causal emptiness & spiritual joy (vocative invocation), awakened spiritual movement (gati) — perfected spiritual vigor, Thou art, strong, in me, upon me, Dharma-realm retention & causal emptiness & spiritual joy (vocative invocation), friend, Thou art, varuṇo, Thou art, Truth and ultimate Reality (Sat)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：maitrs_au.htm（全书共 8844 行）

verses.iast: asi sam ahaṃ viśvair devais, namo mātre pṛthivyai mā māṃ mātā pṛthivī
verses.meaningZh: 汝即是（当体即是），摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），我、真我自性，进入极微，施度调伏·最上真言离言说·一切诸谛圆满，归命，惟尊，向大地、地大，勿、莫令，我，母，大地、地大
verses.meaningEn: Thou art, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, I, the awakened self, enter + particle emphasizing the preceding word or merely expletive, generosity & self-mastery & supreme ineffable speech & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, homage to O merely / in merely, to earth, ground, do not, let not, me (the practitioner), mātā, earth, ground
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：maitrs_au.htm（全书共 8844 行）

verses.iast: hiṃsīt
verses.meaningZh: 因缘空寂大乐·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Causal emptiness & spiritual joy & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：maitrs_au.htm（全书共 8844 行）

verses.iast: anyam asmad icha sā ta ityā namo devi nirṛte tubhyam astu
verses.meaningZh: 他，一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·施度调伏，离覆障清凉，彼、彼圣母（阴性主格），多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·本不生体性），经过、途径，归命，天女、佛母明妃尊，离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，向汝致敬，愿得成就、当如是
verses.meaningEn: Other, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & generosity & self-mastery, coolness free of obscuration, she, that, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — primordial non-arising, course, way, homage to O goddess, sacred female deity, beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), to you, may it be so, let it be!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：maitrs_au.htm（全书共 8844 行）

verses.iast: namo astu sarpebhyo ye keca pṛthivīm anu
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼愿得成就、当如是·蛇富人·凡彼等诸有情·造作离相·妙行迁变空·第一义谛·无住安立·最上真言离言说·日复一日、之后！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to may it be so, let it be!, crawling, belonging to one's household, those who, whoever (pl.), freedom from karmic agency & awakened conduct beyond flux, ultimate truth & non-abiding equipoise & supreme ineffable speech, day after day!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：maitrs_au.htm（全书共 8844 行）

verses.iast: idaṃ viṣṇuḥ
verses.meaningZh: 此、此法门，遍入
verses.meaningEn: This, here, viṣṇuḥ
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：maitrs_au.htm（全书共 8844 行）

verses.iast: MS MS,8.10
verses.meaningZh: 再三娑字门（一切诸谛圆满（sarvasatya）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness (satya) — primordial non-arising again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：maitrs_au.htm（全书共 8844 行）

avyākṛtāttu yatparaṃ paramātmākhyaṃ vidyāviṣayam anāmarūpakarmātmakam"neti neti" iti itarapratyākhyānenopasaṃhariṣyati pṛthak
"prāṇo bṛhatī prāṇa ṛca ityeva vidyāt"iti śrutyantarāt
tasya prajāpateryadbhayaṃ tatkevalāvidyānimittameva paramārthadarśane 'nupapannamityāha- kasmāddhyabheṣyat kimityasau bhītavānparamārthanirūpaṇāyāṃ bhayamanupapannamevetyabhiprāyaḥ
tanna tathā vidyāt, yasmādetasyaiva prajāpateḥ sā visṛṣṭirdevabhedaḥ sarva eṣa u hyeva prajāpatireva prāṇaḥ sarve devāḥ
evamagnīṣomātmakaṃ jagadātmatvena paśyanta kenaciddoṣeṇa lipyate, prajāpatiśca bhavati
athaitasyaiva sādhyasādhanalakṣaṇasya vyākṛtasya jagato vyākaraṇātprāgbījāvasthā yā tāṃ nirdidijñatyaṅkurādikāryānumitāmiva vṛkṣasya, karmabījo 'vidyākṣetro hyasau saṃsāravṛkṣaḥ samūla uddhartavya iti
idaṃ śuklamidaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vā rūpamasyetīdaṃ rūpaḥ
"ātmānastu kāmāya"(bṛ.u.2 / 4 / 5) ityātmārthaḥ tvaśruterayukta iti cenna,"yatra vā anyadiva syāt"ityavidyāviṣayātmārthatvābhyupagamāt tatkena kaṃ paśyet (bṛ.u.4 / 5 / 15) neha nānāsti kiñcana (bṛ.u.4 / 4 / 19) tatra ko mohaḥ kaḥ śokaḥ ekatvamanupaśyataḥ (īśā.7) ityādinā vidyāviṣaye tatpratiṣedhācca nātmadharmatvam
neti neti asthūlam ekamevādvitīyam (chā.u.6 / 2 / 1) aśanāyādyatītaḥ ityevamādivākyānām upāsyātmasvarūpaviśeṣasamarpaṇenopayogaḥṣa phalaṃ ca mokṣo 'vidyānivṛttirvā
evamihāpyātmano 'lābho 'vidyāmātravyavadhānam
tathehāpyabrahmatvamasarvatvaṃ cāvidyākṛtameva nivartyatāṃ brahmavidyayā
brahmaṇyavidyānupapattiriti cet? na, brahmaṇi vidyāvidhānāt
bhavatvevaṃ nāvidyākartṛ bhrāntaṃ ca brahma
kiṃntu naivābrahmāvidyākartā cetano bhrānto 'nya iṣyate
"puṇyaṃ vai puṇyena karmaṇā bhavati"(bṛ.u.3 / 2 / 13) "taṃ vidyākarmaṇī samanvārabhete" ityevamādiśrutismṛtinyāyebhyaḥ parasmādvilakṣaṇo 'nyaḥ saṃsāryavagamyate
nedānīmaidaṃyugīnānāṃ viśeṣato manuṣyāṇām, alpavīryatvāditi syātkasyacidbuddhiḥ, tadutthāpanāyāha- tadidaṃ prakṛtaṃ brahma yatsarvabhūtānupraviṣṭaṃ dṛṣṭikriyādiliṅgam, etarhyetasminnapi vartamānakāle yaḥ kaścidvyāvṛttabāhyautsukya ātmānamevaivaṃ veda'ahaṃ brahmāsmi'iti apohyopādhijanitabhrāntivijñānādhyāropitānviśeṣān saṃsāradharmānāgandhitamanantaramabāhyaṃ brahyevāhamasmi kevalamiti-so 'vidyākṛtāsarvatvanivṛtterbrahāvijhānādidaṃ sarva bhavati
brahyāvidyāphalaprāpyau vidhnakaraṇe devādaya īśata iti kā śaḍkā? ityucyate-devādīnprati ṛṇavattvānmartyānām
na;avidyāpagamamātratvād brahmaprāptiphalasya - yaduktaṃ brahmaprāptiphalaṃ prati devā vighnaṃ kuryuriti, tatra na devānāṃ vighnakaraṇe sāmarthyam;kasmāt? vidyākālānantaritatvād brahmaprāptiphalasya
brahmavidyāsamakālamevāvidyāmātravyavadhānāpagamācchuktikāyā iva rajatābhāsāyāḥ śuktikātvamityavocāma
na tviha vidyāsamakāla ātmabhūte deśakālanimittānantarite, avasarānupapatteḥ
evaṃ tarhi vidyāpratyayasantatyabhāvād viparītapratyayatatkāryayośca darśanād antya evātmapratyayo 'vidyānivartako na tu pūrva iti
evaṃ tarhi santato 'vidyānivartako na vicchinna iti
na hi jīvanādihetuke pratyaye sati vidyāpratyayasantatirupapadyate, virodhāt
prathamā vidyāpratyayasantatirmaraṇakālāntā veti viśeṣābhāvāt, ādyantayoḥ pratyayoḥ pūrvoktau doṣau prasajyeyātām
ya evāvidyādidoṣanivṛttiphalakṛtpratyaya ādyo 'ntyaḥ santato 'santato vā sa eva vidyetyabhyupagamānna codyasyāvatāragandho 'pyasti
kiñca, na ca viparītapratyayo vidyāvata utpadyate, nirviṣayatvāt
kvacittu vidyāyāḥ pūrvotpannaviparītapratyayajanitasaṃskārebhyo viparītapratyayāvabhāsāḥ smṛtayo jāyamānāviparītapratyayabhrāntimakasmātkurvanti;yathā vijñātadigvibhāgasyāpyakasmāddigviparyayavibhramaḥ
ananyatsadvastvātmākhyaṃ yatrāvidyāyāṃ satyāmanyadivasyāttimirakṛtadvitīyacandravat, tatrāvidyākṛtānekakārakāpekṣaṃ darśanādikarma tatkṛtaṃ phalaṃ ca darśayati,"tatrānyo 'nyatpaśyet"ityādinā
etasya hyaviduṣo varṇāśramādipravibhāgavato 'dhikṛtasya karmaṇo vidyāsahitasya kevalasya ca śāstroktasya kāryaṃ manuṣyatvādiko brahmānta utkarṣaḥ
sarvāhīyamupaniṣad vidyāvidyāvibhāgapradarśanenaivopakṣīṇā
tac chreyo rūpam atyasṛjata kṣatraṃ, yāny etāni devatrā kṣatrāṇīndro varuṇaḥ somo rudraḥ parjanyo yamo mṛtyur īśāna iti
kāni punastāni? ityāhatatrābhipiktā eva viśeṣato nirdiśyante-indro devānāṃ rājā, varuṇo yādasām, somo brāhmaṇānām, rudraḥ paśūnām, parjanyo vidyudādīnām, yamaḥ pitṝṇām, mṛtyurogādīnām, īśānobhāsām-ityevamādīni deveṣukṣatrāṇi
yathā ca loke vedo 'nanukto 'nadhītaḥ karmādyavabodhakatvena na bhunakti, anyadvā laukikaṃ kṛṣyādi karmākṛtaṃ svātmanānabhivyañjitam ātmīyaphalapradānena na bhunakti, evamātmā svo lokaḥ svenaiva nityātmasvarūpeṇānabhivyañjito 'vidyādi prahāṇena na bhunaktyeva
tanna, kṛtasya kṣayavattvāt;ityetadāha - yadiha vai saṃsāre 'dbhutavatkaścinmahātmāpi, anevaṃvit-svaṃ lokaṃ yathoktena vidhinā avidvān, mahadbahu aśvamedhādi puṇyaṃ karma iṣṭaphalameva nairantaryeṇa karoti,'anenaivānantyaṃ mama bhaviṣyati'iti, tatkarma hāsyāvidyāvato 'vidyājanitakāmahetutvāt svapnadarśanavibhramodbhūtavibhūtivadantato 'nte phalopabhogasya kṣīyata eva
svātmalokopāsakasya viduṣo vidyāsaṃyogātkarmaiva na kṣīyata ityapare varṣayanti
brahma vidvāṃścettasmātpaśubhāvātkartavyatābandhanarūpātpratimucyate, kenāyaṃ kāritaḥ karmavandhanādhikāre 'vaśa iva pravartate, na punastadvimokṣṇopāye vidyādhikāra iti nanūktaṃ devā rakṣantīti
ātmaiva svābhāviko 'vidvānkāryakaraṇasaṅghātalakṣaṇo varṇī, agre prāgdārasambandhāt,ātmetyabhidhīyate;tasmādātmanaḥ pṛthagbhūtaṃ kāmyamānaṃ jāyādibhedarūpaṃ nāsīt;sa evaika āsīt - jāyādyeṣaṇābījabhūtā vidyāvāneka evāsīt
etadeva ca vidyāprakaraṇe madhuvidyāyāṃ vakṣyāmaḥ -'sarvaṃ sarvasya kāryaṃ madhu'ityātmaikatvavijñānārtham
na tathā vidyāt

verses.meaningZh: 彼经过，真言，略集，最上真言离言说·一乘如实之道·妙行迁变空，婆罗门，转载·命令·二，急促事关，日轮、太阳光明，净水瘟疫，入息尊，一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·无我大慈三昧

verses.meaningEn: There, therein, awakened conduct beyond flux & supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery, all, every, complete, indeed, verily, alone, to be subdued + accomplishing + beginning + breaking + distinction + by, from explain, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'ā': expansive quiescence, the third + study + of completion

verses.iast: sa ca vyākhyāto 'vidyāviṣayaḥ sarva eva dviprakāraḥ- antaḥ prāṇa upaṣṭambhako gṛhasyeva stambhādilakṣaṇaḥ prakāśako 'mṛtaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 彼、此尊（阳性主格）以及以释此，无明境界，一切、普皆遍满，唯、正是、决定，二部，由呼吸、生活，入息，第一义谛·六度满行清净·断除憍慢执障，执着·此尊之·犹如，柱·元·相，转载·有形·忧苦，具甘露
verses.meaningEn: He, that one and explain + hence, ignorance + visaya, all, every, complete, indeed, verily, alone, two, from breathe, live, inward breath, ultimate truth & perfection of the six pāramitās & cutting rigid pride, grasping + of this + like, post + beginning + mark, forward + be visible + not-joy, 'mṛtaḥ
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brupsb2u.htm（全书共 2823 行）

verses.iast: devatācetanāvattve samatvādguṇabhāvānupagama iti cet-prāṇasya viśiṣṭairnāmabhirāmantraṇadarśanāccetanāvattvamabhyupagatam
verses.meaningZh: 天神·可见·鸿毛·长柄尊，趣入通行·一切诸谛圆满，如是（结句印定），多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·钩召发起三昧），入息之，最上真言离言说·本性寂静止息·六度满行清净
verses.meaningEn: A god + perceptible + down + O stem, going toward, thus, so it is stated, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — samādhi invocation, of inward breath, supreme ineffable speech & primordial tranquil peace & perfection of the six pāramitās
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brupsb2u.htm（全书共 2823 行）

verses.iast: nanu ca jāgratkāryakaraṇātmatvaṃ devatātmatvaṃ cāvidyādhyāropitaṃ na paramārthata iti vyatiriktavijñānamayātmapradarśanena pradarśitam
verses.meaningZh: 遮么以及能作成办·生起不可得·尊胜，何为·自我·汝，妙行迁变空·最上真言离言说·施度调伏，不、非、无，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧，如是（结句印定），以过度·识·此处·自我·模样，施予尖锐
verses.meaningEn: Not, by no means, never and making, divinity + self + Thou, awakened conduct beyond flux & supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery, not, non-, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & selfless great loving-kindness, thus, so it is stated, reaching beyond + walk + self + by, giving + whetted
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brupsb2u.htm（全书共 2823 行）

verses.iast: iha hi vidyāvidyāviṣayāvupanyastau
verses.meaningZh: 于此、今于此处，诚然、因为、实乃，最上真言离言说·施度调伏·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Here, in this world/place, for, indeed, surely, supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery & supreme vehicle of awakening (imperative seal)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brupsb2u.htm（全书共 2823 行）

verses.iast: "ātmetyevopāsīta" "ātmānamevāvet" "ātmānameva lokamupāsīta"iti vidyāviṣayaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 我者·经过·犹如·愈加·汝即是·趣往，归命敬礼·真如实际，我者·归命·犹如，离一切相无相·造作离相·无我大慈三昧，如是（结句印定），明咒境界
verses.meaningEn: Course + like + thereto + Thou art + going, bowing, homage + like, freedom from conditioned marks & freedom from karmic agency & selfless great loving-kindness, thus, so it is stated, Vidyā + visaya
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brupsb2u.htm（全书共 2823 行）

verses.iast: tatrāvidyāviṣaye vaktavyaṃ sarvamuktam
verses.meaningZh: 向于彼处无明毒害，最上真言离言说·造作离相·真如实际，一切已解脱
verses.meaningEn: There + ignorance + to poison, supreme ineffable speech & freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness, all + liberated
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brupsb2u.htm（全书共 2823 行）

verses.iast: vidyāviṣayastvātmā kevala upanyasto na nirṇītaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 明咒·毒害·热门踊跃·长柄·我者，纯一无杂，付，不、非、无，创建往外、入定
verses.meaningEn: Vidyā + poison + be hot or eager + stem, exclusive, belonging only to, brought forward, not, non-, found out, ascertained, settled, fixed
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brupsb2u.htm（全书共 2823 行）

verses.iast: atastadbrahma vidyāviṣayabhūtaṃ jñāpayitavyaṃ yāthātmyataḥ
verses.meaningZh: 以此·彼·神父，明咒·境界·部多鬼神，圣智了知·生起不可得·尊胜，一乘如实之道·无住安立·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Hence + that + priest, Vidyā + visaya + spirit, knowing, supreme vehicle of awakening & non-abiding equipoise & immutable Suchness
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brupsb2u.htm（全书共 2823 行）

verses.iast: tathā kauṣītakināmeva"na vācaṃ vijijñāsīta vaktāraṃ vidyāt"ityādinā vāgādikaraṇairvyāvṛttasya kartureva veditavyatāṃ darśayati
verses.meaningZh: 如是、亦复如是，座儿·名为·犹如，不、非、无，语言，圣智了知·最上真言离言说，救度超脱·最上真言离言说，从发现物，以开始即是，能作成办·最上真言离言说，羯磨事业·迅疾·犹如，乃是已知救度佛母根本种子字，示
verses.meaningEn: Thus, in that same way, patron + by name + like, not, non-, words, knowing, ferrying across, from finding, getting, by beginning thus, making, action + quick + like, to be known + Tārā root seed syllable Tāṃ, teach
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brupsb2u.htm（全书共 2823 行）

verses.iast: nāvidyāgocarāsadvastuviṣayamiti na pravartate yathā kāmyeṣu
verses.meaningZh: 妙行流布·离名相假立，不、非、无，转载转，犹如、如…所说，于诸可取、珍贵中
verses.meaningEn: Practicing (vocative invocation), not, non-, forward, just as, according to, among/in desirable, precious, lovely, pleasant
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brupsb2u.htm（全书共 2823 行）

verses.iast: vidyāvatāmeva karmādhikāra iti cet? na, brahmaikatvavidyāyāṃ karmādhikāravirodhasyoktatvāt
verses.meaningZh: 解·截至·是的·犹如，事监督，如是（结句印定），多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·钩召发起三昧），不、非、无，解脱系缚大力·清净离诸尘垢·因缘空寂大乐，事·监督·闢·大坝·此尊之·曰·从长柄
verses.meaningEn: Understanding + up to + yes + like, actions + service, thus, so it is stated, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — samādhi invocation, not, non-, spiritual strength freeing bonds & stainless purity free from dust & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, actions + service + settle + dam + of this + said + from stem
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brupsb2u.htm（全书共 2823 行）

verses.iast: yat kṛṣṇaṃ tenāgnir
verses.meaningZh: 凡所…者，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，借由彼力圣火
verses.meaningEn: Whatever, that which, dark-blue, black, by that truth + fire
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brupsb2u.htm（全书共 2823 行）

verses.iast: kiṃ punastad yaśaḥ? prāṇā vai yaśo viśvarūpam-prāṇāḥ śrotrādayo vāyavaśca marutaḥ saptadhā teṣu prasṛtā yaśaḥ-ityetadāha mantraḥ, śabdādijñānahetutvāt
verses.meaningZh: 迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·诸根清净自在·大空菩提点摄持），第一义谛·离名相假立·一切诸谛圆满，美称，入息，极微，美称，微质怛囒、种种，诸入息，耳残忍，最上真言离言说·一乘如实之道·本性寂静止息，由绝边广川，萨钵多部件、萨钵多时报，真如实际·六度满行清净，庄严，美称，经过·趣往·苦痛，真言、密咒（护心密语），声·元·圣智·因·从长柄
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — purified faculties sealed with bodhicitta bindu, ultimate truth & beyond nominal designation & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, yaśaḥ, inward breath, particle emphasizing the preceding word or merely expletive, yaśo, many-coloured, multiform, manifold, various, inward breath (plural), ear + merciless, supreme ineffable speech & supreme vehicle of awakening & primordial tranquil peace, from god, in seven parts, seven times, immutable Suchness & perfection of the six pāramitās (imperative seal), prasṛtā, yaśaḥ, course + going + pain, Mantra, sacred formula, sound + beginning + primordial wisdom + cause + from stem
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brupsb2u.htm（全书共 2823 行）

verses.iast: tasyāsata ṛṣayaḥ sapta tīra iti-prāṇāḥ parispandātmakāḥ, ta eva ca ṛṣayaḥ, prāṇāvetadāha mantraḥ
verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·一切诸谛圆满·一乘如实之道，六度满行清净·一乘如实之道，七（七佛，堤岸，如是（结句印定），诸入息，动作诸佛子，多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·本不生体性），唯、正是、决定以及六度满行清净·一乘如实之道，入息·鸿毛·趣往·苦痛，真言、密咒（护心密语）
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme vehicle of awakening, perfection of the six pāramitās & supreme vehicle of awakening, seven, side, thus, so it is stated, inward breath (plural), stirring + son, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — primordial non-arising, indeed, verily, alone and perfection of the six pāramitās & supreme vehicle of awakening, inward breath + down + going + pain, Mantra, sacred formula
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brupsb2u.htm（全书共 2823 行）

verses.iast: aupaniṣadaṃmanyā api kecitprakriyāṃ racayanti-mūrtāmūrtarāśirekaḥ, paramātmarāśiruttamaḥ, tābhyāmanyo 'yaṃ madhyamaḥ kila tṛtīyaḥ kartrā bhoktrāvijñānamayena
verses.meaningZh: 第一义谛·离名相假立·六度满行清净，亦、虽、乃至，任何众生根由，化作诸尊此处，无我大慈三昧·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，自性世界·辐条·祷告·最上，真如实际·破有相福德光·一乘如实之道，此尊、此法，第四或第五音，根由，第三，拼写、护符，明了觉识·归命敬礼·破有相福德光
verses.meaningEn: Ultimate truth & beyond nominal designation & perfection of the six pāramitās, even, also, any + bringing forth, produce + they walk, selfless great loving-kindness & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, the supreme spirit + spoke of a wheel + prayer, immutable Suchness & blessedness transcending existence & supreme vehicle of awakening, this one, madhyamaḥ, indeed, of course, the third, spell, charm, discerning, bowing (by spiritual power)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brupsb2u.htm（全书共 2823 行）

verses.iast: ajātaśatrupratibodhitena saha vidyākarmapūrvaprajñāsamudāyaḥ;prayoktā karmarāśiḥ, prayojyaḥ pūrvokto mūrtāmūrtabhūtarāśiḥ sādhanaṃ ceti
verses.meaningZh: 阿阇世王·现观·借由彼力，俱共、与…同在，明咒·作业·不是前身·般若·联邦，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道，事群体，乃是中古，本曰，无我大慈三昧·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，修习，妙行迁变空·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Ajatasutru + realization + by that truth, together with, Vidyā + action + having no predecessor + Prajñā + union, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening, actions + group, to be shot off, to be used, employed, recited, performed, former + said, selfless great loving-kindness & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, sādhanaṃ, awakened conduct beyond flux & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brupsb2u.htm（全书共 2823 行）

verses.iast: etasmādavidyāviṣayādviraktasya pratyagātmaviṣayabrahmavidyāyāmadhikāraḥ kathaṃ nāma syāditi-tṛtīye 'dhyāye upasaṃhṛtaḥ samasto 'vidyāviṣayaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，如何，名为、号曰，一切诸谛圆满·一乘如实之道·施度调伏，第三尊，说品尊，愈加由收，集言，无明境界
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, how? in what way? whence?, by name, called, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme vehicle of awakening & generosity & self-mastery (vocative invocation), O the third, O study, lesson, section of a book, chapter / in study, lesson, section of a book, chapter, thereto + from bring together, samasto, ignorance + visaya
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brupsb2u.htm（全书共 2823 行）

verses.iast: asyā brahmavidyāyā aṅgatvena saṃnyāso vidhitsitaḥ, jāyāputravittādilakṣaṇaṃ pāṅktaṃ karmāvidyāviṣayaṃ yasmānnātmaprāptisādhanam; anyasādhanaṃ hyanyasmai phalasādhanāya prayujyamānaṃ pratikūlaṃ bhavati
verses.meaningZh: 此尊母之（连音省尾式），融通即是，以肢长柄，存放、委托，最上真言离言说·法界总持任持·真如实际，婆利耶·子·已知·元·性相，第一义谛·支分寂静·造作离相，事·无明·境界，成办悉地·归命敬礼·一乘如实之道，他修习，因缘空寂大乐·一乘如实之道·离名相假立，向决口不是工具，团体马匹·摄伏·气息，不顺，成办、生起、安住
verses.meaningEn: Of her, of this deity, to + thus, member + by, deposit, trust, stake, supreme ineffable speech & Dharma-realm retention & immutable Suchness, wife + son + known + beginning, ultimate truth & quiescence of perceptual limbs & freedom from karmic agency, actions + ignorance + visaya, accomplishing, bowing, other, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & supreme vehicle of awakening & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), burst + to, team of horses + hold + breath, counter-pinnacle?, becomes, arises, is
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brupsb2u.htm（全书共 2823 行）

verses.iast: kecittu brahmavido 'pyeṣaṇāsambandhaṃ varṇayanti, tairbṛhadāraṇyakaṃ na śrutam; putrādyeṣaṇānāmavidvadviṣayatvam; vidyāviṣaye ca-"yeṣāṃ no 'yamātmāyaṃ
verses.meaningZh: 造作离相·妙行迁变空·真如实际，梵惊动愁恼，结界系缚·第一义谛，诸尊油漆、显色，真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·解脱系缚大力，不、非、无，闻，第一义谛·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢，向明咒毒害以及那几个的，我等、为我等，此尊·我·出
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency & awakened conduct beyond flux & immutable Suchness (imperative seal), Brahma + of surprise or grief, binding obstacles, they paint, colour, dye, picture, describe, relate, tell, immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & spiritual strength freeing bonds, not, non-, heard, ultimate truth & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust, Vidyā + to poison and yeṣāṃ, us, for us, our, this one + self + income
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brupsb2u.htm（全书共 2823 行）

verses.iast: lokaḥ"ityataḥ"kiṃ prajayā kariṣyāmaḥ"ityeṣa vibhāgastairna śrutaḥ śrutyā kṛtaḥ; sarvakriyākārakaphalopamardasvarūpāyāṃ ca vidyāyāṃ satyām, saha
verses.meaningZh: 世间、世界，真如实际·一乘如实之道，迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·诸根清净自在·大空菩提点摄持），以裔胄、孩子们，能作成办·造作离相，真如实际·一乘如实之道·六度满行清净，最上真言离言说·破有相福德光·妙行趣入，由听，以闻，由作持、从事，一切·守法·眵·制诺迦·调伏摧碾一切恶障·于自性相以及于明咒、真言明妃、圣智明中，谛、真实不虚语，俱共、与…同在
verses.meaningEn: World, realm, immutable Suchness & supreme vehicle of awakening, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — purified faculties sealed with bodhicitta bindu, with/by bringing forth, making, immutable Suchness & supreme vehicle of awakening & perfection of the six pāramitās, supreme ineffable speech & blessedness transcending existence & awakened spiritual movement, from to listen, with/by hearing, ear, sound, noise, report, hearsay, news, tidings, utterance or prescription, from make, do, cause or produce anything in or on one's self or others, all + the making of a decision + a secretion from the eyes + cutting off + subdue and pulverize all evil forces! + in own-form and in Vidyā, sacred wisdom-spell, illumination, truth, reality, veracity, together with
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brupsb2u.htm（全书共 2823 行）

verses.iast: kāryeṇāvidyāyā anupapattilakṣaṇaśca virodhastairna vijñātaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 造作离相·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道，弱点相及最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢·法界总持任持，由酌处权、成长聪慧
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening, not taking place + mark and supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust & Dharma-realm retention, from discretion, mature intelligence
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brupsb2u.htm（全书共 2823 行）

verses.iast: vyāsavākyaṃ ca tairna śrutam; karmavidyāsvarūpayorvidyāvidyātmakayoḥ pratikūlavartanaṃ virodhaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 广大妙语以及真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·离名相假立，闻，能作成办·造作离相，不顺轰隆，障碍、有对
verses.meaningEn: Separation + speech and immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & beyond nominal designation, heard, making, counter-pinnacle? + causing to move or live, obstruction, hindrance, disturbance
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brupsb2u.htm（全书共 2823 行）

verses.iast: evaṃ sarvāsāṃ vidyānāṃ hṛdayam ekāyanam
verses.meaningZh: 如是、如此，湖居，诸发现物之，心，独行
verses.meaningEn: Thus, in this way, a lake + dwell, of all finding, getting, hṛdayam, narrow
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brupsb2u.htm（全书共 2823 行）

verses.iast: yathāyaṃ dṛṣṭāntaḥ, evameva vā are maitreyidaṃ paramātmākhyaṃ mahadbhūtam-yasmānmahato bhūtādavidyayā paricchinnā satī kāryakaraṇopādhisambandhātkhilyamāvamāpannāsi,
verses.meaningZh: 犹如风大自在除障种子，地力娑占达，如是唯，或、抑或，唯，无我大慈三昧·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧，乐趣希有，广大殊胜·一乘如实之道，破有相福德光·真如实际·施度调伏，般剪，器物盘子佛母，能作成办·结界系缚·造作离相
verses.meaningEn: Just as + Vāyu wind-mandala swiftness seed syllable, dṛṣṭāntaḥ, thus + indeed, or, particle, selfless great loving-kindness & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & selfless great loving-kindness, gladden, great, blessedness transcending existence & immutable Suchness & generosity & self-mastery, wisdom + to cut, a vessel or dish (feminine), making, binding obstacles (vocative invocation)

verses.meaningEn: How? in what way? whence?, he, that one, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & selfless great loving-kindness & supreme ineffable speech, emancipating, to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, to you, Vidyā + inactive + meaning, sahasraṃ, giving + thus, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & supreme ineffable speech, freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks & supreme ineffable speech, living in or coming from Videha

verses.iast: anuvedanaṃ nāma vidyāyāḥ paripākāpekṣayā phalāvasānatāniṣṭhā prāptiḥ

verses.meaningEn: Day after day + making known, by name, called, of Vidyā, sacred wisdom-spell, illumination, being completely cooked of digested + with, fruition of enlightenment & freedom from conditioned marks & supreme ineffable speech, prāptiḥ

nedānīmaidaṃyugīnānāṃ viśeṣato manuṣyāṇām, alpavīryatvāditi syātkasyacidbuddhiḥ, tadutthāpanāyāha- tadidaṃ prakṛtaṃ brahma yatsarvabhūtānupraviṣṭaṃ dṛṣṭikriyādiliṅgam, etarhyetasminnapi vartamānakāle yaḥ kaścidvyāvṛttabāhyautsukya ātmānamevaivaṃ veda'ahaṃ brahmāsmi'iti apohyopādhijanitabhrāntivijñānādhyāropitānviśeṣān saṃsāradharmānāgandhitamanantaramabāhyaṃ brahyevāhamasmi kevalamiti-so 'vidyākṛtāsarvatvanivṛtterbrahāvijhānādidaṃ sarva bhavati

na;avidyāpagamamātratvād brahmaprāptiphalasya - yaduktaṃ brahmaprāptiphalaṃ prati devā vighnaṃ kuryuriti, tatra na devānāṃ vighnakaraṇe sāmarthyam;kasmāt? vidyākālānantaritatvād brahmaprāptiphalasya

evaṃ tarhi vidyāpratyayasantatyabhāvād viparītapratyayatatkāryayośca darśanād antya evātmapratyayo 'vidyānivartako na tu pūrva iti
evaṃ tarhi santato 'vidyānivartako na vicchinna iti

ya evāvidyādidoṣanivṛttiphalakṛtpratyaya ādyo 'ntyaḥ santato 'santato vā sa eva vidyetyabhyupagamānna codyasyāvatāragandho 'pyasti
kiñca, na ca viparītapratyayo vidyāvata utpadyate, nirviṣayatvāt

ananyatsadvastvātmākhyaṃ yatrāvidyāyāṃ satyāmanyadivasyāttimirakṛtadvitīyacandravat, tatrāvidyākṛtānekakārakāpekṣaṃ darśanādikarma tatkṛtaṃ phalaṃ ca darśayati,"tatrānyo 'nyatpaśyet"ityādinā
etasya hyaviduṣo varṇāśramādipravibhāgavato 'dhikṛtasya karmaṇo vidyāsahitasya kevalasya ca śāstroktasya kāryaṃ manuṣyatvādiko brahmānta utkarṣaḥ

tanna, kṛtasya kṣayavattvāt;ityetadāha - yadiha vai saṃsāre 'dbhutavatkaścinmahātmāpi, anevaṃvit-svaṃ lokaṃ yathoktena vidhinā avidvān, mahadbahu aśvamedhādi puṇyaṃ karma iṣṭaphalameva nairantaryeṇa karoti,'anenaivānantyaṃ mama bhaviṣyati'iti, tatkarma hāsyāvidyāvato 'vidyājanitakāmahetutvāt svapnadarśanavibhramodbhūtavibhūtivadantato 'nte phalopabhogasya kṣīyata eva

brahma vidvāṃścettasmātpaśubhāvātkartavyatābandhanarūpātpratimucyate, kenāyaṃ kāritaḥ karmavandhanādhikāre 'vaśa iva pravartate, na punastadvimokṣṇopāye vidyādhikāra iti nanūktaṃ devā rakṣantīti

verses.iast: namas te 'stu brahman svasti me 'stu tasmāt prati trīn varān vṛṇīṣva
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼汝、彼等·愿得成就、当如是·梵·吉祥安隐、善妙无恙·于我、为我·愿得成就、当如是·是故、因此、从彼·对·曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·禅定三昧总持）·殊胜、胜愿、妙好·最上真言离言说·离诸诤论无诤·六度满行清净！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Thee / they, may it be so, let it be!, Brahma, well-being, fortune, auspicious safety, me, my, may it be so, let it be!, therefore, from that, toward, beyond nominal designation (nāma) — deep samādhi retention, choicest, supreme boon, excellent, supreme ineffable speech & conflict-free peace & perfection of the six pāramitās!

verses.iast: etad vidyām anuśiṣṭas tvayāhaṃ varāṇām eṣa varas tṛtīyaḥ

verses.meaningEn: This, Vidyā, sacred wisdom-spell, illumination, beyond nominal designation & primordial tranquil peace & perfection of the six pāramitās, by you + Acala Vidyārāja & space-element seed syllable, of choicest, supreme boon, excellent, rushing on, as subst, width, breadth, room, space, the third
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kathop_u.htm（全书共 520 行）

verses.iast: vidyābhīpsinaṃ naciketasaṃ manye na tvā kāmā bahavo 'lolupanta
verses.meaningZh: 企求圣智，那罗，持心、易逝来讲尊，不、非、无，嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk，希，解脱系缚大力·因缘空寂大乐·最上真言离言说，严·发吒·末
verses.meaningEn: Desirous of knowledge, of a man, O thinking one's self-, appearing as, passing for / in thinking one's self-, appearing as, passing for, not, non-, supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — expansive quiescence, wish, spiritual strength freeing bonds & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & supreme ineffable speech, break + end
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kathop_u.htm（全书共 520 行）

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — purified faculties, immutable Suchness

verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bhnstcpu.htm（全书共 466 行）

verses.iast: jagaccitraṃ namas tasmai kalāślāghyāya śūline
verses.meaningZh: 生起不可得·尊胜·妙行趣入·妙行迁变空，归命，向彼尊（为格），向奇法妙，本性寂静止息·离一切相无相·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Transcending birth & victorious & awakened spiritual movement & awakened conduct beyond flux, homage to to him, to that one, a small part, primordial tranquil peace & freedom from conditioned marks & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bhnstcpu.htm（全书共 466 行）

verses.iast: namas tebhyo 'pi ye soma- kalākalitaśekharam
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切向汝、彼等·亦、虽、乃至·凡彼等诸有情·月轮、甘露月·奇法·精神·趣往·花额！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to to Thee / they, even, also, those who, whoever (pl.), moon, nectar-orb, a small part, drive, going!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bhnstcpu.htm（全书共 466 行）

verses.iast: namo 'nantaphalotpāda- kalpavṛkṣāya śambhave
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼无边·果·出世·细轨茂盛树·乐生！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to boundless, direct effect, to appear in this world, style, to, śambhave!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bhnstcpu.htm（全书共 466 行）

verses.iast: namo namaḥ śivāyeti mantrasāmarthyam āśritāḥ
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼寂静·出·瘟疫·真言适存度·本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to kind, income, plague, Mantra, adequacy, primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bhnstcpu.htm（全书共 466 行）

verses.iast: namo niḥśeṣadhīpatri- mālālayamayātmane
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼禅智观照·离名相假立·花鬘·衍伸·狱王·以来·自尊尊！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to meditative wisdom (vocative invocation), garland, spawn, holder, since, O pride!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bhnstcpu.htm（全书共 466 行）

verses.iast: namo bhaktyā nṛṇāṃ muktyai bhavate bhava te 'vate
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼以物流、瓜分·离名相假立·离诸诤论无诤·解脱、解放从中·愿成、善住·愿成、善住·汝、彼等·好好儿、水箱尊！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to with/by distribution, partition, division, portion, share, beyond nominal designation & conflict-free peace, liberation, release from, be! become!, be! become!, Thee / they, O well, cistern / in well, cistern!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bhnstcpu.htm（全书共 466 行）

verses.iast: namo nirupakāryāya trailokyaikopakāriṇe
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼在于色相果·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·离一切相无相！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to in, form, to, immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bhnstcpu.htm（全书共 466 行）

verses.iast: lobhāyāpi namas tasmai tvallābhālambanāya me
verses.meaningZh: 贪欲·出·善友，归命，向彼尊（为格），真如实际·最上真言离言说·离一切相无相，于我、为我
verses.meaningEn: Greed + income + friend, homage to to him, to that one, immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech & freedom from conditioned marks (reverent offering), to me, my
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bhnstcpu.htm（全书共 466 行）

verses.iast: namo namaḥ śivāyeti japanty āhlādavihvalāḥ
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼寂静·出·瘟疫·生起不可得·尊胜·第一义谛·离名相假立·身心爽快诸困惑！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to kind, income, plague, transcending birth & victorious & ultimate truth & beyond nominal designation, refreshment, discountenanced!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bhnstcpu.htm（全书共 466 行）

verses.iast: anāditve 'pi viśvasya bhoktre bhava namo 'stu te
verses.meaningZh: 不是开始长柄尊，亦、虽、乃至，遍一切、森罗万象之，破有相福德光·造作离相·真如实际，愿成、善住，归命，愿得成就、当如是，向汝、彼等
verses.meaningEn: Having no beginning + O stem, even, also, of all-pervading, universal, whole, blessedness transcending existence & freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), be! become! homage to may it be so, let it be! to Thee / they
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bhnstcpu.htm（全书共 466 行）

verses.iast: namas te bhavasambhrānta- bhrāntim udbhāvya bhindate
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼汝、彼等·愿成·随着·谬·迷惑·施度调伏·破有相福德光·最上真言离言说·劈破无明坚固执障（牝陀）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Thee / they, be! become!, along with, error, confusd, generosity & self-mastery & blessedness transcending existence & supreme ineffable speech, cleave asunder stubborn ignorance!!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bhnstcpu.htm（全书共 466 行）

verses.iast: mantro 'si mantraṇīyo 'si mantrī tvattaḥ kuto 'paraḥ
verses.meaningZh: 真言、密咒（护心密语），汝即是（当体即是），无我大慈三昧·离名相假立·真如实际，汝即是（当体即是），密咒，真如实际·最上真言离言说，为谁的，必然
verses.meaningEn: Mantra, sacred formula, Thou art, selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness, Thou art, mantrī, immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech, kuto, a certain
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bhnstcpu.htm（全书共 466 行）

verses.iast: sa mahyaṃ dehi taṃ mantraṃ tvanmantraḥ syāṃ yathā prabho
verses.meaningZh: 彼、此尊（阳性主格），为我、赐予我，请施予、慈悲垂赐悉地！彼（宾格），真言，真如实际·最上真言离言说·离名相假立，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·远离寂静周遍·大空菩提点摄持），犹如、如…所说，光明、星星
verses.meaningEn: He, that one, to me, for me, give! grant! bestow! him, that, mantraṃ, immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech & beyond nominal designation, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — expansive quiescence sealed with bodhicitta bindu, just as, according to, light
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bhnstcpu.htm（全书共 466 行）

verses.iast: namas trailokyanāthāya tubhyaṃ bhava bhavajjuṣām
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼三界依·汝致敬·愿成、善住·破有相福德光·最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Three Worlds, to, you, be! become!, blessedness transcending existence & supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bhnstcpu.htm（全书共 466 行）

verses.iast: tasmai namo 'stu te yas tvaṃ tannirvāṇāmṛtahradaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 向彼尊（为格），归命，愿得成就、当如是，向汝、彼等，娑字门（一切诸谛圆满（sarvasatya）·本不生体性），汝、圣尊您，推广·涅槃·甘露·小海
verses.meaningEn: To him, to that one, homage to may it be so, let it be! to Thee / they, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (satya) — primordial non-arising, Thou, You, extend + Nirvāṇa + ambrosia
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：bhnstcpu.htm（全书共 466 行）

verses.iast: īśānaṃ sarvāsāṃ vidyānāmīśvaraṃ ca bhūtānām
verses.meaningZh: 自在主，湖居，明咒·名·自在主以及诸部多鬼神、一切生类、真实之
verses.meaningEn: Owning, disposing of , able, a lake + dwell, Vidyā + name + Īśvara and of all spirit, living being, true/existent
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jssivpau.htm（全书共 259 行）

verses.iast: rudraṃ śivatvasiddhyai tattvaprerakamahaṃ vande
verses.meaningZh: 紧恶，向寂静长柄悉地，真性·推·酒席，礼敬赞叹·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: Of gods, kind + stem + to Siddhi, the state of being that + to urge + feast, venerating (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jssivpau.htm（全书共 259 行）

verses.iast: namo 'stu saṃjñānahṛde bhavāya namo guṇaiśvaryaviśiṣṭamūrtaye
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼愿得成就、当如是·圣智了知·一切诸谛圆满·愿成、善住·妙行趣入·离诸诤论无诤·本性寂静止息！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to may it be so, let it be!, knowing (vocative invocation), be! become!, awakened spiritual movement & conflict-free peace & primordial tranquil peace (reverent offering)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jssivpau.htm（全书共 259 行）

verses.iast: namo 'parādhīnavaśitvarūpaśikhāya tejaḥkavacātmane namaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼被他人缠缚及不推辞·自在性·色·煈·威光·护身甲胄·我·自然！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to self-control or power over, form, to, armor, self, O certainly!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jssivpau.htm（全书共 259 行）

verses.iast: namo 'vikārāya ṣaḍaṅgamūrtaye sadāśivāyāmṛtarūpiṇe namaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼不是变易·趣入通行·六度满行清净·一切诸谛圆满·施度调伏·本性寂静止息！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to not changing, going toward (reverent offering), all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & generosity & self-mastery & primordial tranquil peace (vocative invocation)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jssivpau.htm（全书共 259 行）
