sarvajñaṃ paramaṃ mantraṃ muktidaṃ vyādhināśanam
jarāmṛtyuharaṃ devi vidyārājeti kīrtitam
kavacaṃ tu samākhyātam asiddhabhedakṛd bhavet
kavacaṃ tu samākhyātaṃ śṛṇu netraṃ yathāsthitam
tayā vidyābhiṣekaṃ tu nyastavyā kalaśe tu sā
bahurūpasamākīrṇaṃ vidyāguṇavibhūṣitam
candrarūpaṃ yadā paśyet tārāmaṇḍalamadhyataḥ
tejastattvaṃ tu taṃ devi rudraśaktibhir āvṛtam
ḍāmarī rāmaṇī caiva lambakarṇī ca kākinī

verses.iast: kālena bahunā kālīm uvācedaṃ kuleśvaraḥ
verses.meaningZh: 以时，以多，造作离相·离一切相无相·无我大慈三昧，最上真言离言说·妙行迁变空·施度调伏，部族自在
verses.meaningEn: By/through black, by many, freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks & selfless great loving-kindness, supreme ineffable speech & awakened conduct beyond flux & generosity & self-mastery, buddha-family
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: evaṃ samyagvidhānena rudraśaktiḥ svayambhunā
verses.meaningZh: 如是、如此，一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·一乘如实之道，紧恶短𬬰，护摩献供·一切诸谛圆满
verses.meaningEn: Thus, in this way, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & supreme vehicle of awakening (by spiritual power), of gods, offering oblation
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: vīrāvalīti tena tvaṃ rudraśaktiḥ praśasyase
verses.meaningZh: 勇猛丈夫·列·如是，借由彼力、以是因缘，汝、圣尊您，紧恶短𬬰，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·本性寂静止息
verses.meaningEn: Heroic + row + thus, by that truth, thereby, through that power, Thou, You, of gods, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & primordial tranquil peace (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: siddhair yā veṣṭitāṅgī parivṛtacaturaiḥ ṣaṣṭibhir yogivṛndair yuktā hṛtpaṅkajena ḍaralakasahajā pātu māṃ rudraśaktiḥ
verses.meaningZh: 悉地成就·一切诸谛圆满，凡彼（阴性关系代词），卷肢，以诸围绕谨慎，六度满行清净·断除憍慢执障·破有相福德光，一乘如实之道·妙行趣入·最上真言离言说，如理，以心髓，息灭诤怨·清净离诸尘垢·离一切相无相，第一义谛·真如实际于我，紧恶短𬬰
verses.meaningEn: Perfected, who, whichever (f.), wrapped + member, covered + by, perfection of the six pāramitās & cutting rigid pride & blessedness transcending existence, supreme vehicle of awakening & awakened spiritual movement & supreme ineffable speech, yuktā, by/through the heart conceived as a lotus-flower, pacifying conflict & turmoil & stainless purity free from dust & freedom from conditioned marks, ultimate truth & immutable Suchness (imperative seal) me, of gods
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: parā mālinī rudramālārcite rudraśaktiḥ khagī siddhayogeśvarī
verses.meaningZh: 他人，具花鬘、殿堂佛母，紧恶·鬘·积累，紧恶短𬬰，鸟佛母，魔法机构自在主
verses.meaningEn: Someone else, possessing garland, of gods + garland + O piled up, of gods, bird (feminine), magic agency + Īśvara
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: divyacaryānurūḍhair namaskāra oṃkārasvāhāsvadhākāravauṣaḍvaṣaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 妙行流布·施度调伏，供养，造作离相·清净离诸尘垢·一切诸谛圆满
verses.meaningEn: Practicing, exclamation of , worship, adoration, freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: rudrāṇī rudraśākī ca gomukhī sumukhī tathā
verses.meaningZh: 清净离诸尘垢·施度调伏·离诸诤论无诤，紧恶住房以及乐器、男人佛母，善见口门佛母，如是、亦复如是
verses.meaningEn: Stainless purity free from dust & generosity & self-mastery & conflict-free peace, of gods + the dwelling of a person of brahman family and a musical instrument, a beautiful mouth (feminine), thus, in that same way
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: vidyām abhayadātāraṃ laulyacāpalyavarjitam
verses.meaningZh: 明咒、真言明妃、圣智明，无畏作施，掉举·身手·微蘖多
verses.meaningEn: Vidyā, sacred wisdom-spell, illumination, non-fear, restlessness + agility + avoided
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: ājñāyogaṃ kriyāmantraṃ muṣitvā yaḥ palāyate
verses.meaningZh: 命令修习，业真言，无我大慈三昧·六度满行清净·真如实际，凡彼…者，逃跑
verses.meaningEn: Command + bond, activity, selfless great loving-kindness & perfection of the six pāramitās & immutable Suchness, whoever, he who, flee
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: oṃkāreṇa tu te guptā namaskāreṇa bhāmini
verses.meaningZh: 以音节，然而、而、实则，向汝、彼等，藏，以供养，星宿急躁
verses.meaningEn: By/through the syllable, but, indeed, moreover, to Thee / they, kept, preserved, guarded, hidden, secret, by/through exclamation of , worship, adoration, star + O impetuous
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: o-jā-pū-kā-kramān bhittvā vidyākubjapade sthitam
verses.meaningZh: 悉昙「o」韵字门：摄受法流灌顶，惹字门（生起不可得·尊胜（jāti，跛字门（第一义谛（paramārtha）·威神增益圆满），迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·远离寂静周遍），次第，破有相福德光·真如实际·最上真言离言说，明咒·跎背·句，立
verses.meaningEn: Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'o': consecrating Dharma-stream, transcending birth & victorious (jaya) — expansive quiescence, ultimate truth (paramārtha) — perfected spiritual vigor, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — expansive quiescence, step, course, method, way, blessedness transcending existence & immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech, Vidyā + humpbacked + O word, standing, abiding, remaining
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: mudrā mantraṃ tathā bhāṣā sarvaṃ jānāti tattvataḥ
verses.meaningZh: 手印、法印、契印，真言，如是、亦复如是，妙语、语言，一切、普皆遍满，了知太，由真性
verses.meaningEn: Mudrā, sacred seal, gesture, mantraṃ, thus, in that same way, speech, language, vernacular l, all, every, complete, knowing + very, from the state of being that, the true state or real nature
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: vidarbho mantra-m-ādau tu mantrānte vīranāyike
verses.meaningZh: 诸人、刹土，真言、密咒（护心密语），摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），施度调伏，然而、而、实则，真言一极，最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Of a people, sgl, Mantra, sacred formula, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, generosity & self-mastery (imperative seal), but, indeed, moreover, Mantra + O ultimate, supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: brahmasthaḥ sakalo mantra aṣṭatriṃśatkalair yutaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 神父依止处，全部、圆满一切，真言、密咒（护心密语），六度满行清净·断除憍慢执障·真如实际，由系上、固执
verses.meaningEn: Priest + standing, entire, complete, all, Mantra, sacred formula, perfection of the six pāramitās & cutting rigid pride & immutable Suchness, from fasten, hold fast, bind, harness, join, unite, draw towards one's self, attract get p
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: pañcāvasthāprabhinnas tu tadā mantra-m ihocyate
verses.meaningZh: 第一义谛·圣智通达·妙行迁变空，然而、而、实则，彼时，真言、密咒（护心密语），摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），因缘空寂大乐·妙行迁变空·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Ultimate truth & non-dual wisdom awareness & awakened conduct beyond flux, but, indeed, moreover, at that time, in that case, then, Mantra, sacred formula, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & awakened conduct beyond flux & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: sapta koṭyas tu vidyānāṃ mantrāṇām amitaujasām
verses.meaningZh: 七（七佛，造作离相·断除憍慢执障·一乘如实之道，然而、而、实则，诸发现物之，诸真言、密咒（护心密语）之，无我大慈三昧·真如实际·生起不可得·尊胜
verses.meaningEn: Seven, freedom from karmic agency & cutting rigid pride & supreme vehicle of awakening, but, indeed, moreover, of all finding, getting, of Mantra, sacred formula, selfless great loving-kindness & immutable Suchness & transcending birth & victorious
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: aiṃ namo bhagavate rudrāya padaṃ caiva daśākṣaram
verses.meaningZh: 妙音辩才智慧心印，归命，向世尊（薄伽梵）致敬，向紧恶，言，以及、亦复如是（ca + eva），边缘天衣看到
verses.meaningEn: Sarasvatī eloquence & wisdom seed syllable, homage to to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, to/for of gods, padaṃ, and indeed, likewise, fringe of a garment + a saw
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: sarvāsāṃ caiva mātṝṇāṃ svāhāpraṇavasaṃyutam
verses.meaningZh: 湖居，以及、亦复如是（ca + eva），无我大慈三昧·真如实际·离诸诤论无诤，圆满吉祥成就·神圣·限制
verses.meaningEn: A lake + dwell, and indeed, likewise, selfless great loving-kindness & immutable Suchness & conflict-free peace, hail! may auspicious accomplishment be sealed + the sacred syllable Om + bound
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: namo mātṛgaṇāyeti triṃśakaṃ kathitaṃ sphuṭam
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼母·海会众·出·瘟疫·第三十之后·讲话、会话·开！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to mother, assembly, income, plague, the thirtieth, or emphasizing particle, said, mentioned, sphuṭam!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: namo namaḥ aiṃ vicce svāhā triṃśam ekottaraṃ padam
verses.meaningZh: 归命归命，妙音辩才智慧心印，最上真言离言说·妙行迁变空，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！第三十，一愈加，言
verses.meaningEn: Homage to homage to Sarasvatī eloquence & wisdom seed syllable, supreme ineffable speech & awakened conduct beyond flux (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! the thirtieth, one + further, padam
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: padabhedas tu vidyāyā jñātavyaḥ sādhakena tu
verses.meaningZh: 第一义谛·施度调伏·破有相福德光，然而、而、实则，发现物即是，觉知勇健，以能成办者、修持行者，然而、而、实则
verses.meaningEn: Ultimate truth & generosity & self-mastery & blessedness transcending existence, but, indeed, moreover, finding + thus, know + strong, by/through accomplishing, practitioner, but, indeed, moreover
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: vidyāyās tu prasaṅgena pañcapraṇavam uddhṛtam
verses.meaningZh: 发现物活泼，然而、而、实则，以容有，五神圣，选
verses.meaningEn: Finding + untired, but, indeed, moreover, by/through = + union, connection, business with, five + the sacred syllable Om, uddhṛtam
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: sāmprataṃ śṛṇu kalyāṇi vidyāmāhātmyam uttamam
verses.meaningZh: 并购·转载·彼，本性寂静止息·离诸诤论无诤，一切好好儿、健康，明咒自在，最上、至高无上
verses.meaningEn: Acquisition + forward + him, primordial tranquil peace & conflict-free peace (imperative seal), well, healthy, ready, able, capable, Vidyā, highest, supreme, most excellent
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: sapta varṇān dadec cādau madhye vidyāpadaṃ dadet
verses.meaningZh: 七（七佛，显色、身色光彩，施予饶益·施度调伏，妙行迁变空·施度调伏，中尊，明咒言，施予饶益·施度调伏
verses.meaningEn: Seven, color, hue, luminous appearance, granting, awakened conduct beyond flux & generosity & self-mastery (imperative seal), O neutral, impartial, Vidyā, granting
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: tasyāgre tu tato mantraṃ hutāśakaṇikākṛtim
verses.meaningZh: 彼之从中，然而、而、实则，次，真言，火供净施·因缘空寂大乐
verses.meaningEn: His + from, but, indeed, moreover, secondary, mantraṃ, sacred offering
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: uccāreta tato mantraṃ śabdarūpaṃ hṛdi priye
verses.meaningZh: 屎趣往，次，真言，声色，心髓，惜者
verses.meaningEn: Excrement + going, secondary, mantraṃ, sound, heart, O dear, valued, pleasing to, beloved of, one's own
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: ātmā manaś ca mantraś ca śivaḥ śaktis tathaiva ca
verses.meaningZh: 我者，无我大慈三昧·离名相假立·本性寂静止息以及无我大慈三昧·离名相假立·真如实际以及兽主徒，本性寂静止息·造作离相·真如实际，真如实际·无住安立·最上真言离言说以及
verses.meaningEn: Ātmā, selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation & primordial tranquil peace and selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness and śivaḥ, primordial tranquil peace & freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness, immutable Suchness & non-abiding equipoise & supreme ineffable speech and
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: brahmā viṣṇus tathā rudra īśvaro 'tha sadāśivaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 梵王，最上真言离言说·六度满行清净·离诸诤论无诤，如是、亦复如是，紧恶，自在，尔时、次复吉祥启白，恒常兽主徒
verses.meaningEn: Brahma, supreme ineffable speech & perfection of the six pāramitās & conflict-free peace, thus, in that same way, of gods, īśvaro, now, thereupon, auspiciously, always
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: mantramudrāgaṇo hy atra vidyāmaṇḍalakādikam
verses.meaningZh: 真言·手印·聚，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），于此处、今此，明咒·规格·第一
verses.meaningEn: Mantra + Mudrā, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, here, in this place, Vidyā + disease which destroys a family + first
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: kavacaṃ yasyā mahādevyā mantramāyātmakaṃ mahat
verses.meaningZh: 盔甲，凡彼…之，以摩诃室利，真言·出·佛子，广大、尊胜
verses.meaningEn: Kavacaṃ, whose, of whom, with/by Mahādevī, income + son, great, mighty, vast
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: rephasaham idaṃ kūṭaṃ vidyāsaptamakaṃ padam
verses.meaningZh: 点子·笑声·唅，此、此法门，边椽，明咒·跟着·种类哮喘，言
verses.meaningEn: Spot + laughter + grunt, this, here, bone of the forehead, horn, Vidyā + follow after + a kind of asthma, padam
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: dvisaptakaṃ ca kavacaṃ netraṃ saptākṣaraṃ śubham
verses.meaningZh: 二星期以及盔甲，绢，七字，清净吉祥、善妙庄严
verses.meaningEn: Two + week and kavacaṃ, netraṃ, seven, auspicious, pure, bright, virtuous
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: mantraṃ caiva tathātmānam ekīkṛtya trayaṃ budhaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 真言，以及、亦复如是（ca + eva），如是·我·气息，联合那个，三重、三合会，水星
verses.meaningEn: Mantraṃ, and indeed, likewise, thus + self + breath, unite + that, triple, threefold, budhaḥ
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: sampūjya yoginīṣaṭkaṃ rāmaṇīśirasānvitam
verses.meaningZh: 供养礼赞·一切诸谛圆满，一乘如实之道·妙行趣入·离名相假立，清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧·离诸诤论无诤
verses.meaningEn: Worshipping, supreme vehicle of awakening & awakened spiritual movement & beyond nominal designation, stainless purity free from dust & selfless great loving-kindness & conflict-free peace
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: rakāraṃ tu lalāṭasthaṃ japen mantraṃ punaḥ punaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 妙音，然而、而、实则，额依止处，生起不可得·尊胜·第一义谛·离名相假立，真言，再三复次、再三
verses.meaningEn: The sound, but, indeed, moreover, forehead + standing, transcending birth & victorious & ultimate truth & beyond nominal designation, mantraṃ, again, furthermore again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: smaraṇāt kevalo mantraḥ sukham utpādayed yathā
verses.meaningZh: 从记忆、传统，纯一无杂，真言、密咒（护心密语），安乐，真如实际·第一义谛·施度调伏，犹如、如…所说
verses.meaningEn: From remembrance, memory, tradition, exclusive, belonging only to, Mantra, sacred formula, sukham, immutable Suchness & ultimate truth & generosity & self-mastery, just as, according to
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: aghorān na paro mantraḥ kasmāc cūlīgatas tu saḥ
verses.meaningZh: 无威怖、猛厉降魔，不、非、无，愈加、之后，真言、密咒（护心密语），造作离相·一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧，妙行迁变空·离一切相无相·妙行趣入，然而、而、实则，彼、彼尊
verses.meaningEn: Non-formidable, terrific, awe-inspiring, not, non-, beyond, on the other or opposite side,, Mantra, sacred formula, freedom from karmic agency & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness, awakened conduct beyond flux & freedom from conditioned marks & awakened spiritual movement, but, indeed, moreover, he, that one
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: siddhārthayogayuktānām aiṃpādādyantayojitam
verses.meaningZh: 一切义成就·修习·诸具，妙音辩才智慧心印·尊足·起讫·驾
verses.meaningEn: = or leading to the goal + bond + of all yoked, Sarasvatī eloquence & wisdom seed syllable + foot + beginning and end + harnessed
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: ādyakṣaraṃ japen mantraṃ punar ādyaṃ niyojayet
verses.meaningZh: 饭食看到，生起不可得·尊胜·第一义谛·离名相假立，真言，复次、再三，饭食，尊胜降伏·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Eatable + a saw, transcending birth & victorious & ultimate truth & beyond nominal designation, mantraṃ, again, furthermore, eatable, food, conquering
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: brahmaṃ bhittvā tato viṣṇuṃ rudram īśvaram eva ca
verses.meaningZh: 神父，破有相福德光·真如实际·最上真言离言说，次，遍入，紧恶，自在主、主宰尊，唯、正是、决定以及
verses.meaningEn: Priest, blessedness transcending existence & immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech, secondary, thousands with names containing prabha, and also containing Viṣṇu, of gods, Īśvara, Sovereign Lord, Master, indeed, verily, alone and
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: sarvavighnopaśamanaṃ mantraṃ tryakṣaram uttamam
verses.meaningZh: 一切·障碍·愈加·寂静息灭，真言，这样法句，最上、至高无上
verses.meaningEn: All + obstacle + thereto + pacifying, mantraṃ, consisting of three sounds or syllables, highest, supreme, most excellent
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: nyastaṃ sarvāṅgikaṃ mantraṃ bhairavākārasaṃsthitam
verses.meaningZh: 抛下、放置一旁，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，真言，怖畏·相·色相
verses.meaningEn: Thrown down, put aside, stretched or laid out, mystically touched, leaned upon, put o, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, mantraṃ, formidable + disposition + form
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: sa eva līyate viṣṇor viṣṇu rudrasamāśritaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 彼、此尊（阳性主格），唯、正是、决定，离一切相无相·一乘如实之道·真如实际，遍入之，遍入，紧恶忠诚
verses.meaningEn: He, that one, indeed, verily, alone, freedom from conditioned marks & supreme vehicle of awakening & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), of thousands with names containing prabha, and also containing Viṣṇu, thousands with names containing prabha, and also containing Viṣṇu, of gods + leaning or resting on
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: sa eva līyate māyā sā ca viṣṇuḥ prakīrtitā
verses.meaningZh: 彼、此尊（阳性主格），唯、正是、决定，离一切相无相·一乘如实之道·真如实际，幻化、如幻妙力，彼、彼圣母（阴性主格）以及遍入，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·造作离相
verses.meaningEn: He, that one, indeed, verily, alone, freedom from conditioned marks & supreme vehicle of awakening & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), illusion, magical display (Māyā), she, that and viṣṇuḥ, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & freedom from karmic agency
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: sa viṣṇuḥ śivatāṃ yāti setuṃ bhittvā kuleśvari
verses.meaningZh: 彼、此尊（阳性主格），遍入，寂静救度佛母根本种子字，揭帝、步调尊，台，破有相福德光·真如实际·最上真言离言说，部族自在主
verses.meaningEn: He, that one, viṣṇuḥ, kind + Tārā root seed syllable Tāṃ, O gone, passed,, binding, fettering, blessedness transcending existence & immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech, buddha-family + O Īśvara
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: vidyārājeti vikhyāto mantrarājeti kathyate
verses.meaningZh: 明王瘟疫，毘佉担，真言·来诣·瘟疫，造作离相·无住安立·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Lord of spells + plague, vikhyāto, Mantra + coming from or belonging to goats + plague, freedom from karmic agency & non-abiding equipoise & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: dhāraṇīyaṃ sadā gātre yathāvat pravadāmy aham
verses.meaningZh: 陀罗尼风大自在除障种子，恒常、一切时，腔尊，也他、好生，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，我、吾身
verses.meaningEn: Dhāraṇī + Vāyu wind-mandala swiftness seed syllable, always, evermore, O a limb of the body, according to propriety, as is fit or right, properly, duly, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, I, myself
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: puṣpeṇa guḍikāṃ kṛtvā mantraṃ bhūrje samālikhet
verses.meaningZh: 以花，成串，既作已、行持已，真言，桦尊，一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·离一切相无相
verses.meaningEn: By/through flower, cluster, having done, having performed, mantraṃ, O a species of birch tree / in a species of birch tree, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & freedom from conditioned marks
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: sarvaṃ kṣasthaṃ paraṃ mantraṃ sarvarakṣākaraṃ param
verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，造作离相·六度满行清净·一切诸谛圆满，管保、自然，真言，一切·慧眼·诸出处，管保、自然
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, assuredly, certainly, mantraṃ, all + eye + scatterer, assuredly, certainly
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: dhāraṇīyā prayatnena śivalokam avāpnuyāt
verses.meaningZh: 总持任持·法界总持任持，以勤勇，寂静世间，最上真言离言说·第一义谛·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Upholding, by/through effort, endeavour, pains at , activity, kind + world, supreme ineffable speech & ultimate truth & beyond nominal designation
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: guruvaktrāt tu vijñeyo madhye oṃkāramadhyagam
verses.meaningZh: 上师从面目，然而、而、实则，闢乃是已知，中尊，音节中间
verses.meaningEn: Lama + from meters, but, indeed, moreover, settle + to be known, O neutral, impartial, the syllable + being in the middle of
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: sarvajñaṃ paramaṃ mantraṃ muktidaṃ vyādhināśanam
verses.meaningZh: 一切智，最胜、第一、无上，真言，解脱调，病患摧灭
verses.meaningEn: Omniscient, supreme, highest, ultimate, mantraṃ, liberation + tame, illness + destroying
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: jarāmṛtyuharaṃ devi vidyārājeti kīrtitam
verses.meaningZh: 老·死·请摄取，天女、佛母明妃尊，明王瘟疫，誉彼
verses.meaningEn: Crackling + death + carry away ! remove! O goddess, sacred female deity, lord of spells + plague, renown + him
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: kavacaṃ tu samākhyātam asiddhabhedakṛd bhavet
verses.meaningZh: 盔甲，然而、而、实则，随着宣，悉地成就·一切诸谛圆满，当得成就、若成
verses.meaningEn: Kavacaṃ, but, indeed, moreover, along with + declare, perfected, may be, would become
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: kavacaṃ tu samākhyātaṃ śṛṇu netraṃ yathāsthitam
verses.meaningZh: 盔甲，然而、而、实则，随着宣，本性寂静止息·离诸诤论无诤，绢，犹如立
verses.meaningEn: Kavacaṃ, but, indeed, moreover, along with + declare, primordial tranquil peace & conflict-free peace (imperative seal), netraṃ, just as + standing
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: tayā vidyābhiṣekaṃ tu nyastavyā kalaśe tu sā
verses.meaningZh: 以彼，发现物灌顶，然而、而、实则，乃是放置，宝瓶、甘露贤瓶尊，然而、而、实则，彼、彼圣母（阴性主格）
verses.meaningEn: Tayā, finding + consecration, but, indeed, moreover, to be put, O auspicious vase, nectar vessel / in auspicious vase, nectar vessel, but, indeed, moreover, she, that
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: bahurūpasamākīrṇaṃ vidyāguṇavibhūṣitam
verses.meaningZh: 微质怛囒·随着·遍布，明咒·功德·闢·繁忙来讲·趣往
verses.meaningEn: Many-coloured + along with + scattered, Vidyā + virtue + settle + be busy for + going
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: candrarūpaṃ yadā paśyet tārāmaṇḍalamadhyataḥ
verses.meaningZh: 月轮色，何时、若是，第一义谛·本性寂静止息·一乘如实之道，圣救度佛母·曼荼罗·由中
verses.meaningEn: Moon, when, if, ultimate truth & primordial tranquil peace & supreme vehicle of awakening, Tārā + Maṇḍala + from neutral
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: tejastattvaṃ tu taṃ devi rudraśaktibhir āvṛtam
verses.meaningZh: 威光真性，然而、而、实则，彼（宾格），天女、佛母明妃尊，清净离诸尘垢·施度调伏·本性寂静止息，纒
verses.meaningEn: Radiance, but, indeed, moreover, him, that, O goddess, sacred female deity, stainless purity free from dust & generosity & self-mastery & primordial tranquil peace, covered
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: ḍāmarī rāmaṇī caiva lambakarṇī ca kākinī
verses.meaningZh: 骚乱、杂沓佛母，清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧·离诸诤论无诤，以及、亦复如是（ca + eva），悬无耳者佛母以及钢镚
verses.meaningEn: Riot, tumult (feminine), stainless purity free from dust & selfless great loving-kindness & conflict-free peace, and indeed, likewise, to hang down + earless and a small coin
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kubjt_pu.htm（全书共 9501 行）

verses.iast: kālītantroktavidhinā saptāhaṃ japapūjanam
verses.meaningZh: 造作离相·离一切相无相·真如实际，萨钵多天次、星期，喳喳供养
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks & immutable Suchness, seven days, a week, whispering + to make offerings
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mabhedtu.htm（全书共 1325 行）

verses.iast: tatraiva prajapen mantraṃ sarvavandyanavātmakam
verses.meaningZh: 于彼处犹如，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·生起不可得·尊胜，真言，一切·赞叹·假定今日·鸿毛·佛子
verses.meaningEn: There + like, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & transcending birth & victorious, mantraṃ, all + praise + suppose now + down + son
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mabhedtu.htm（全书共 1325 行）

verses.iast: tasyopari japen mantraṃ mahāmāyāṃ hi caṇḍike
verses.meaningZh: 彼之般，生起不可得·尊胜·第一义谛·离名相假立，真言，广大泡影，诚然、因为、实乃，妙行迁变空·离诸诤论无诤·息灭诤怨
verses.meaningEn: His + wisdom, transcending birth & victorious & ultimate truth & beyond nominal designation, mantraṃ, the Great Illusion, for, indeed, surely, awakened conduct beyond flux & conflict-free peace & pacifying conflict & turmoil (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mabhedtu.htm（全书共 1325 行）

verses.iast: vihāre yo bhavet putro gaṇeśaḥ sa ca kīrtitaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 佛殿，凡彼圣尊、能…者，当得成就、若成，子，欢喜天，彼、此尊（阳性主格）以及由誉
verses.meaningEn: O dwelling, who, whichever, may be, would become, putro, Ganesa, he, that one and from renown
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mabhedtu.htm（全书共 1325 行）

verses.iast: mahāśaṅkhaṃ vinā devi na mantraḥ siddhidāyakaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 大法螺，远离、除却，天女、佛母明妃尊，不、非、无，真言、密咒（护心密语），悉地施者
verses.meaningEn: Great + conch shell, without, free from, O goddess, sacred female deity, not, non-, Mantra, sacred formula, Siddhi
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mabhedtu.htm（全书共 1325 行）

verses.iast: ṣaḍakṣaraṃ mahāmantraṃ gajāntakasahasrakam
verses.meaningZh: 六度满行清净·息灭诤怨·造作离相，大真言，象·下贱·千·之后
verses.meaningEn: Perfection of the six pāramitās & pacifying conflict & turmoil & freedom from karmic agency, great, elephant + destructions + thousand + or emphasizing particle
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mabhedtu.htm（全书共 1325 行）

verses.iast: tasyopari japen mantraṃ sarvavandyanavātmakam
verses.meaningZh: 彼之般，生起不可得·尊胜·第一义谛·离名相假立，真言，一切·赞叹·假定今日·鸿毛·佛子
verses.meaningEn: His + wisdom, transcending birth & victorious & ultimate truth & beyond nominal designation, mantraṃ, all + praise + suppose now + down + son
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mabhedtu.htm（全书共 1325 行）

verses.iast: etan mantraṃ maheśāni gajāntakasahasrakam
verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·离名相假立，真言，一切广大，象·下贱·千·之后
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation, mantraṃ, the great lord or god, of Śiva, elephant + destructions + thousand + or emphasizing particle
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mabhedtu.htm（全书共 1325 行）

verses.iast: cāmuṇḍāyā mahāmantraṃ kīdṛśaṃ parameśvara
verses.meaningZh: 遮文茶即是，大真言，没用，童子大王
verses.meaningEn: Camunda + thus, great, = , also good for what, useless, a rich or noble lord, a prince or king
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mabhedtu.htm（全书共 1325 行）

verses.iast: kālībījayugaṃ devi kūrcabījaṃ tataḥ param
verses.meaningZh: 尊胜降伏·造作离相，天女、佛母明妃尊，满陀种子，由伊人、本刹，管保、自然
verses.meaningEn: Conquering, O goddess, sacred female deity, bundle + seed, from stem of he, she, it, assuredly, certainly
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mabhedtu.htm（全书共 1325 行）

verses.iast: pūjānte prajapen mantraṃ trisahasraṃ varānane
verses.meaningZh: 供养一极，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·生起不可得·尊胜，真言，三千，幅度口门
verses.meaningEn: Reverence + O ultimate, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & transcending birth & victorious, mantraṃ, three, width + O mouth
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mabhedtu.htm（全书共 1325 行）

verses.iast: tathā rātrau japen mantraṃ kulaśaktisamanvitam
verses.meaningZh: 如是、亦复如是，清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，生起不可得·尊胜·第一义谛·离名相假立，真言，部族·威·辅以
verses.meaningEn: Thus, in that same way, stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness (imperative seal), transcending birth & victorious & ultimate truth & beyond nominal designation, mantraṃ, buddha-family + ability + accompanied by
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mabhedtu.htm（全书共 1325 行）

verses.iast: namo 'ntena tu deveśi āsanaṃ ca samarcayet
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼以末·然而、而、实则·一样、童子尊·床座与一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·清净离诸尘垢！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to by/through end, but, indeed, moreover, O the same , prince, king, seat and all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & stainless purity free from dust!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mabhedtu.htm（全书共 1325 行）

verses.iast: samāpte tu vilomena punar mantraṃ śataṃ japet
verses.meaningZh: 三磨钵耽尊，然而、而、实则，以不顺，复次、再三，真言，百，生起不可得·尊胜·第一义谛·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: O finished, complete, perfect / in finished, complete, perfect, but, indeed, moreover, by/through against the hair or grain, contrary, refractory, again, furthermore, mantraṃ, śataṃ, transcending birth & victorious & ultimate truth & immutable Suchness
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mabhedtu.htm（全书共 1325 行）

verses.iast: śṛṇu mantraṃ pravakṣyāmi trailokyeṣu ca durlabham
verses.meaningZh: 本性寂静止息·离诸诤论无诤，真言，坡度宝山·慧眼·夜摩天尊，于诸三界、三千世界中以及难得
verses.meaningEn: Primordial tranquil peace & conflict-free peace (imperative seal), mantraṃ, slope of a mountain + eye + O Yama Heaven, among/in the Three Worlds (Trailokya) and difficult to be obtained or seen
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mabhedtu.htm（全书共 1325 行）

verses.iast: navākṣaraṃ mahāmantraṃ japed ādau śataṃ priye
verses.meaningZh: 九字，大真言，生起不可得·尊胜·第一义谛·施度调伏，施度调伏，百，惜者
verses.meaningEn: Nine, great, transcending birth & victorious & ultimate truth & generosity & self-mastery, generosity & self-mastery (imperative seal), śataṃ, O dear, valued, pleasing to, beloved of, one's own
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mabhedtu.htm（全书共 1325 行）

verses.iast: viparītaṃ mahāmantraṃ pāṭhānte tu śataṃ japet
verses.meaningZh: 戻，大真言，呗一极，然而、而、实则，百，生起不可得·尊胜·第一义谛·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Perverse, great, a chant + O ultimate, but, indeed, moreover, śataṃ, transcending birth & victorious & ultimate truth & immutable Suchness
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mabhedtu.htm（全书共 1325 行）

verses.iast: oṃ saptaśatīmahāstotrasya medhātithiṛṣir gāyatryanuṣṭubbṛhatīpaṃktitriṣtubjagatyaś chandāṃsi mahākālīmahālakṣmīmahāsarasvīdevatāstavakaṃ aiṃ hrīṃ klīṃ bījāni kṣrauṃ śaktiḥ mamāmukakāmasiddhyarthe viniyogaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！广大殊胜·一切诸谛圆满，锦标·日·仙人，妙行趣入·一乘如实之道·真如实际，音韵肩尊，广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，妙音辩才智慧心印，莲华妙幻自在种子字（清净摄受），金刚钩召敬爱心印，一切种子，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·最上大悲化导·大空菩提点摄持），短𬬰，我之·某甲·希·请成就妙悉地！·他尊，旨
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! great, prize + a lunar day + Ṛṣi, awakened spiritual movement & supreme vehicle of awakening & immutable Suchness, desire + O shoulder, great, Sarasvatī eloquence & wisdom seed syllable, lotus-māyā seed syllable Hrīṃ, magnetizing seed syllable of attraction & compassion, seed, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — supreme compassionate guidance sealed with bodhicitta bindu, śaktiḥ, my + a certain person + wish + be accomplished! manifest siddhi! + O tha, application
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mabhedtu.htm（全书共 1325 行）

verses.iast: mahāmantraṃ śrutaṃ nātha vāmakeśvarayāmale
verses.meaningZh: 大真言，闻，依，除害·自在主·趣往·严
verses.meaningEn: Great, heard, refuge, aid, left + Īśvara + going
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mabhedtu.htm（全书共 1325 行）

verses.iast: kathitaṃ ca mayā pūrvaṃ mantraṃ śṛṇu varānane
verses.meaningZh: 讲话、会话以及由我（具格：如是我闻），元，真言，本性寂静止息·离诸诤论无诤，幅度口门
verses.meaningEn: Said, mentioned and by me, first, mantraṃ, primordial tranquil peace & conflict-free peace (imperative seal), width + O mouth
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mabhedtu.htm（全书共 1325 行）

verses.iast: vāgbījaṃ ca mahāmāyāṃ viṣṇuśaktiṃ samuccaret
verses.meaningZh: 最上真言离言说·妙行趣入·解脱系缚大力以及广大泡影，遍入威，高显超胜·一切诸谛圆满
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & awakened spiritual movement & spiritual strength freeing bonds and the Great Illusion, thousands with names containing prabha + ability, exalting
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mabhedtu.htm（全书共 1325 行）

verses.iast: śrīpādukāṃ samuccārya pūjayāmi namas tataḥ
verses.meaningZh: 吉祥鞋，彼·解放·境界，供养我此处，归命，由伊人、本刹
verses.meaningEn: Auspiciousness + shoe, he + release + a outcast, reverence + I walk, homage to from stem of he, she, it
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mabhedtu.htm（全书共 1325 行）

verses.iast: stutiṃ ca kavacaṃ nātha śrotum icchāmi sāmpratam
verses.meaningZh: 称赞以及盔甲，依，本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，妙行迁变空·离覆障清凉·无我大慈三昧，并购·转载·彼
verses.meaningEn: Praises and kavacaṃ, refuge, aid, primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, awakened conduct beyond flux & coolness free of obscuration & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), acquisition + forward + him
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mabhedtu.htm（全书共 1325 行）

verses.iast: śrīguroḥ kavacaṃ stotraṃ tvayā proktaṃ purā prabho
verses.meaningZh: 吉祥上师之，盔甲，赞叹、偈子，由汝圣尊，转载曰，原来、有一次，光明、星星
verses.meaningEn: Auspiciousness + of lama, kavacaṃ, praise, hymn, by you, forward + said, formerly, once upon a time, of yore, light
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mabhedtu.htm（全书共 1325 行）

verses.iast: idānīṃ strīguroḥ stotraṃ kavacaṃ mayi kathyatām
verses.meaningZh: 如今，女子上师之，赞叹、偈子，盔甲，于我身中，造作离相·无住安立·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Immediately, just, woman + of lama, praise, hymn, kavacaṃ, in me, upon me, freedom from karmic agency & non-abiding equipoise & supreme vehicle of awakening
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mabhedtu.htm（全书共 1325 行）

verses.iast: namas te devadeveśi namas te harapūjite
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼汝、彼等·天人一样·汝、彼等·请摄取所恭敬尊！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Thee / they, god, O the same, Thee / they, carry away ! remove!, O honored!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mabhedtu.htm（全书共 1325 行）

verses.iast: brahmavidyāsvarūpāyai tasyai nityaṃ namo namaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 解脱系缚大力·清净离诸尘垢·因缘空寂大乐，真如实际·一切诸谛圆满·一乘如实之道，常恒、永不间断，归命，至心归命礼！
verses.meaningEn: Spiritual strength freeing bonds & stainless purity free from dust & causal emptiness & spiritual joy (vocative invocation), immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation), constantly, eternally, homage to reverent homage!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mabhedtu.htm（全书共 1325 行）

verses.iast: yayā cakṣur unmīlitaṃ tasyai nityaṃ namo namaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 一乘如实之道，眼，示现，真如实际·一切诸谛圆满·一乘如实之道，常恒、永不间断，归命，至心归命礼！
verses.meaningEn: Supreme vehicle of awakening, eye, = + unfolded, manifest, immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation), constantly, eternally, homage to reverent homage!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mabhedtu.htm（全书共 1325 行）

verses.iast: jñānadā mokṣadā nityā tasyai nityaṃ namo namaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 觉知鲁达罗，究竟解脱·无我大慈三昧，以礼，真如实际·一切诸谛圆满·一乘如实之道，常恒、永不间断，归命，至心归命礼！
verses.meaningEn: Know + roarer, emancipating, nityā, immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation), constantly, eternally, homage to reverent homage!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mabhedtu.htm（全书共 1325 行）

verses.iast: sadā vijñānadātrī ca tasyai nityaṃ namo namaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 恒常、一切时，圣智了别鎌佛母以及真如实际·一切诸谛圆满·一乘如实之道，常恒、永不间断，归命，至心归命礼！
verses.meaningEn: Always, evermore, discerning consciousness + sickle and immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation), constantly, eternally, homage to reverent homage!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mabhedtu.htm（全书共 1325 行）

verses.iast: mahāmokṣapradā devī tasyai nityaṃ namo namaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 大·解脱·施予，天女、佛母明妃，真如实际·一切诸谛圆满·一乘如实之道，常恒、永不间断，归命，至心归命礼！
verses.meaningEn: Great + liberation + giving, goddess, sacred female deity, immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation), constantly, eternally, homage to reverent homage!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mabhedtu.htm（全书共 1325 行）

verses.iast: triguṇātmasvarūpā ca tasyai nityaṃ namo namaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 三·功德·自我·自性相以及真如实际·一切诸谛圆满·一乘如实之道，常恒、永不间断，归命，至心归命礼！
verses.meaningEn: Three + virtue + self + own-form and immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation), constantly, eternally, homage to reverent homage!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mabhedtu.htm（全书共 1325 行）

verses.iast: svanāthaṃ ca samāliṅgya tasyai nityaṃ namo namaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 自依以及一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·离一切相无相，真如实际·一切诸谛圆满·一乘如实之道，常恒、永不间断，归命，至心归命礼！
verses.meaningEn: Own + refuge and all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & freedom from conditioned marks, immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation), constantly, eternally, homage to reverent homage!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mabhedtu.htm（全书共 1325 行）

verses.iast: jñānavijñānadātrī ca tasyai nityaṃ namo namaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 圣智·圣智了别·鎌佛母以及真如实际·一切诸谛圆满·一乘如实之道，常恒、永不间断，归命，至心归命礼！
verses.meaningEn: Primordial wisdom + discerning consciousness + sickle and immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation), constantly, eternally, homage to reverent homage!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mabhedtu.htm（全书共 1325 行）

verses.iast: stotraṃ samāptaṃ deveśi kavacaṃ śṛṇu sādaram
verses.meaningZh: 赞叹、偈子，三磨钵耽，一样、童子尊，盔甲，本性寂静止息·离诸诤论无诤，有偿方面、周到
verses.meaningEn: Praise, hymn, finished, complete, perfect, O the same , prince, king, kavacaṃ, primordial tranquil peace & conflict-free peace (imperative seal), having or paying respect, considerate, careful
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mabhedtu.htm（全书共 1325 行）

verses.iast: iti te kathitaṃ kānte kavacaṃ paramādbhutam
verses.meaningZh: 如是（结句印定），向汝、彼等，讲话、会话，相亲尊，盔甲，最胜希
verses.meaningEn: Thus, so it is stated, to Thee / they, said, mentioned, O desired, loved, lovely, beautiful, kavacaṃ, supreme + extraordinary
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mabhedtu.htm（全书共 1325 行）

verses.iast: gurumantraṃ japitvā tu kavacaṃ prapaṭhed yadi
verses.meaningZh: 上师真言，生起不可得·尊胜·第一义谛·真如实际，然而、而、实则，盔甲，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·远离虚妄安立，设使
verses.meaningEn: Lama, transcending birth & victorious & ultimate truth & immutable Suchness, but, indeed, moreover, kavacaṃ, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & beyond conceptual fabrication, if, when
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mabhedtu.htm（全书共 1325 行）

verses.iast: pūjākāle paṭhed yas tu kavacaṃ mantravigraham
verses.meaningZh: 供时尊，第一义谛·远离虚妄安立·施度调伏，娑字门（一切诸谛圆满（sarvasatya）·本不生体性），然而、而、实则，盔甲，真言离
verses.meaningEn: To make an offering + O black, ultimate truth & beyond conceptual fabrication & generosity & self-mastery, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (satya) — primordial non-arising, but, indeed, moreover, kavacaṃ, Mantra + separation
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mabhedtu.htm（全书共 1325 行）

verses.iast: samastamaṅgalaṃ nāma kavacaṃ paramādbhutam
verses.meaningZh: 广收吉祥，名为、号曰，盔甲，最胜希
verses.meaningEn: Joined, by name, called, kavacaṃ, supreme + extraordinary
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mabhedtu.htm（全书共 1325 行）

verses.iast: samāptaṃ kavacaṃ devi kim anyac chrotum icchasi
verses.meaningZh: 三磨钵耽，盔甲，天女、佛母明妃尊，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·诸根清净自在），离名相假立·一乘如实之道·妙行迁变空，离覆障清凉·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，妙行迁变空·离覆障清凉·一切诸谛圆满
verses.meaningEn: Finished, complete, perfect, kavacaṃ, O goddess, sacred female deity, selfless great loving-kindness — purified faculties, beyond nominal designation & supreme vehicle of awakening & awakened conduct beyond flux, coolness free of obscuration & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, awakened conduct beyond flux & coolness free of obscuration & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mabhedtu.htm（全书共 1325 行）

verses.iast: śrīvidyāviṣaye nātha viśeṣo mayi kathyatām
verses.meaningZh: 向吉祥明咒毒害，依，异，于我身中，造作离相·无住安立·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Auspiciousness + Vidyā + to poison, refuge, aid, distinction, in me, upon me, freedom from karmic agency & non-abiding equipoise & supreme vehicle of awakening
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mabhedtu.htm（全书共 1325 行）

verses.iast: śilāmadhye tathā cakraṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ param
verses.meaningZh: 玻璃中尊，如是、亦复如是，轮，吉祥相那罗延，管保、自然
verses.meaningEn: A precious stone + O neutral, thus, in that same way, cakraṃ, mark + Narayana, assuredly, certainly
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mabhedtu.htm（全书共 1325 行）

verses.iast: pāradasya śatāṃśaikaṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ na hi
verses.meaningZh: 水银之，本性寂静止息·真如实际·造作离相，吉祥相那罗延，不、非、无，诚然、因为、实乃
verses.meaningEn: Pāradasya, primordial tranquil peace & immutable Suchness & freedom from karmic agency, mark + Narayana, not, non-, for, indeed, surely
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mabhedtu.htm（全书共 1325 行）

verses.iast: imaṃ mantraṃ maheśāni prajaped auṣadhopari
verses.meaningZh: 此（真言，真言，一切广大，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·生起不可得·尊胜，六度满行清净·法界总持任持·第一义谛
verses.meaningEn: This (accusative), mantraṃ, the great lord or god, of Śiva, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & transcending birth & victorious, perfection of the six pāramitās & Dharma-realm retention & ultimate truth (vocative invocation)

verses.iast: luptavarṇaṃ samutthāpya punar mantraṃ prakāśayet

verses.iast: mantra evānanyaniṣṭhā vṛttiḥ yasya sa sādhakaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 真言、密咒（护心密语），最上真言离言说·离名相假立·一乘如实之道，疏，凡彼…之，彼、此尊（阳性主格），修习士
verses.meaningEn: Mantra, sacred formula, supreme ineffable speech & beyond nominal designation & supreme vehicle of awakening, vṛttiḥ, whose, of whom, he, that one, sādhakaḥ
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mrgt3cpu.htm（全书共 2233 行）

verses.iast: śūdramūrkhapramattastrīvṛddhāmayāvivikalāṅgairvā jaṭā na dhāraṇīyāḥ
verses.meaningZh: 本性寂静止息·施度调伏·清净离诸尘垢，生起不可得·尊胜·断除憍慢执障，不、非、无，陀罗尼诸此处
verses.meaningEn: Primordial tranquil peace & generosity & self-mastery & stainless purity free from dust, transcending birth & victorious & cutting rigid pride, not, non-, Dhāraṇī
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mrgt3cpu.htm（全书共 2233 行）

verses.iast: vṛddhoktābhiḥ parīkṣābhiḥ prayatnavān parijñāya vidyāvṛddhā āgamoktaparīkṣākuśalā atra vṛddhaśabdenoktāḥ
verses.meaningZh: 老者·曰·融通，以诸辩证、联调联试，转载·凡所…者·九，向遍知，明咒老者，传·曰·辩证·善，于此处、今此，老者·声·勇健·诸曰
verses.meaningEn: Grown up + said + to, with investigation, testing, forward + whatever + nine, to/for (thorough) knowledge, Vidyā + grown up, traditional + said + investigation + wholesome, here, in this place, grown up + sound + strong + said
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mrgt3cpu.htm（全书共 2233 行）

verses.iast: samyagācāntaḥ sādhyamantraṃ japan vaiṣṇave samaye sāyaṃsamaya āsīta
verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·一乘如实之道，所修习真言，生起不可得·尊胜·第一义谛·离名相假立，吠瑟拏微尊，向平，一切诸谛圆满·一乘如实之道·无我大慈三昧，一切诸谛圆满·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & supreme vehicle of awakening, to be subdued, transcending birth & victorious & ultimate truth & beyond nominal designation, O Vaisnavi / in Vaisnavi, to equal, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme vehicle of awakening & selfless great loving-kindness, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mrgt3cpu.htm（全书共 2233 行）

verses.iast: paścāt mṛgājinamāstīrya ardhacandrapadmasvastikādyāsanaṃ baddhvā vidvān iti yogapādapradarśitadhyānādividhijño 'nalasaḥ san tattanmantrajapadhyānaṃ kuryāt
verses.meaningZh: 后，野兽·人皮·勿·隶圉·活跃，弦月·莲华·具吉祥·今日·古老，解脱系缚大力·施度调伏·法界总持任持，能觉，如是（结句印定），修习·尊足·施予·尖锐·禅那·元·了知法律，无懈，曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·本不生体性），彼·推广·真言·喳喳·禅那，成办作持·造作离相
verses.meaningEn: Rear, wild animal + hide + do not + servants + active, half-moon + lotus flower + a kind of bard + to-day + old, spiritual strength freeing bonds & generosity & self-mastery & Dharma-realm retention, vidvān, thus, so it is stated, bond + foot + giving + whetted + meditative concentration + beginning + knowing the law, un-lazy, beyond nominal designation (nāma) — primordial non-arising, That + extend + Mantra + whispering + meditative concentration, enacting
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mrgt3cpu.htm（全书共 2233 行）

verses.iast: prākāraṃ kavacaṃ kuryāt svadhāmno 'pyevameva hi
verses.meaningZh: 园，盔甲，成办作持·造作离相，守地界即时，第一义谛·一乘如实之道·最上真言离言说，诚然、因为、实乃
verses.meaningEn: Encircling wall, rampart, kavacaṃ, enacting, nature or condition + immediately, ultimate truth & supreme vehicle of awakening & supreme ineffable speech, for, indeed, surely
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mrgt3cpu.htm（全书共 2233 行）

verses.iast: tasyāntaḥ sarvabījaiḥ kavacādyabhimantritaiḥ tanmantramuccārayan kavacaprākāraṃ vidadhyāt
verses.meaningZh: 彼之由气息，以诸一切种子，真言宣演·造作离相，推广·真言·屎·假定今日，护身甲胄园，以解以下来
verses.meaningEn: His + from breath, all + by, uttering, extend + excrement + suppose now, armor + encircling wall, understanding + below + since
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mrgt3cpu.htm（全书共 2233 行）

verses.iast: itthameva nityaṃ svanivāse kurvīta
verses.meaningZh: 即是唯，常恒、永不间断，自境界有性，成办作持·造作离相
verses.meaningEn: Thus + indeed, constantly, eternally, own + O state of existence, enacting
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：mrgt3cpu.htm（全书共 2233 行）

verses.meaningZh: 星，归命，解脱系缚大力·清净离诸尘垢·因缘空寂大乐，持，于我、为我，嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk，脆弱不作为，总持任持·法界总持任持，又么床坐，能作成办·造作离相，闻，无我大慈三昧·妙行迁变空·一乘如实之道，无我大慈三昧·六度满行清净·一乘如实之道，嗡！如是（结句印定），执持闻尊，明咒、真言明妃、圣智明
verses.meaningEn: A star, homage to spiritual strength freeing bonds & stainless purity free from dust & causal emptiness & spiritual joy (vocative invocation), dhāraṇaṃ, to me, my, supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — primordial non-arising, strengthless + non-doing, upholding, seat, making, heard, selfless great loving-kindness & awakened conduct beyond flux & supreme vehicle of awakening, selfless great loving-kindness & perfection of the six pāramitās & supreme vehicle of awakening, Oṃ! thus, so it is stated, holder of heard, Vidyā, sacred wisdom-spell, illumination
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：parakspu.htm（全书共 943 行）

verses.iast: sam uccārya sṛṣṭinitye svāheti ham ity uktvā sthitipūrṇe namaḥ ity analabindumahāsaṃhāriṇī kṛśe
verses.meaningZh: 摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），高胜圣，创作常尊，圆满吉祥成就瘟疫，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·诸根清净自在），造作离相·真如实际·最上真言离言说，住富楼那尊，归命，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·诸根清净自在），智慧猛火·渧·大·具画儿一起，瘦尊
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, high + noble, letting loose + O with constantly internal mind fixing your will on salvation, hail! may auspicious accomplishment be sealed + plague, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — purified faculties, freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech, standing + O Purna, homage to supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — purified faculties, sacred fire + a drop + great + goddess possessing drawing together, O lean, thin, slender
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：parakspu.htm（全书共 943 行）

verses.iast: padāc caṇḍaśabdaḥ kāli phaṭ ity agnibindusaptamamudrābījaṃ mahānākhye anantabhāskari mahācaṇḍapadāt kāli phaṭ iti
verses.meaningZh: 第一义谛·施度调伏·妙行迁变空，威猛音，时尊，泮吒（摧破魔障）！耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·诸根清净自在），圣火·渧·第七·手印·种子，大增语，无边一样，大·威猛·从句，时尊，泮吒（摧破魔障）！如是（结句印定）
verses.meaningEn: Ultimate truth & generosity & self-mastery & awakened conduct beyond flux, fierce + sound, O black, Phaṭ! supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — purified faculties, fire + a drop + the seventh + Mudrā + seed, O appellation, boundless + O the same, great + fierce + from word, O black, Phaṭ! thus, so it is stated
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：parakspu.htm（全书共 943 行）

verses.iast: sṛṣṭisthitisaṃhārākhyānāṃ prātilomyaṃ khecarībījaṃ mahācaṇḍavāṇī ca yogīśvarīti vidyāpañcakarūpiṇī kālasaṅkarṣiṇī paramāyuḥpradāyinī
verses.meaningZh: 创作·住·画儿一起·诸增语，倒序，妙行流布·等虚空无碍，大·威猛·芦苇以及修习士·明天·瘟疫，能作成办·最上真言离言说，钩召摄受·造作离相，最胜·寿命·具施物
verses.meaningEn: Letting loose + standing + drawing together + of all appellation, inverted order, practicing, great + fierce + reed and tomorrow + plague, making, drawing in, supreme + life-force + possessing gift
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：parakspu.htm（全书共 943 行）

verses.iast: bhuvanā kamalā subhagā tāro namo bhagavati pūrṇe śekharam anna mamābhilaṣitam uktvānnaṃ dehi dahanajāyeti śriya upāṅgam annapūrṇā
verses.meaningZh: 世间、法界刹土，妙莲华、红莲，幸运、好好儿，星，归命，世尊佛母！（呼格），富楼那尊，花额，喫食，我之·融通·贪欲·趣往，造作离相·真如实际·最上真言离言说，请施予、慈悲垂赐悉地！炽燃·婆利耶·瘟疫，本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道，乌凡伽，喫食富楼那
verses.meaningEn: World, realm of beings, lotus blossom, lucky, well, comfortable, a star, homage to O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī! O Purna, śekharam, food, boiled rice, my + to + desire + going, freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech, give! grant! bestow! burning + wife + plague, primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening, upanga, food + Purna
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：parakspu.htm（全书共 943 行）

verses.iast: tadvidyā tu tritārī kumārī nabhavaśrītaṃśvasajamahāsamuraṃnimāyāsarāvakasastrīruvakasadumṛvakasasavakasalovakaakaṃvamāyahāvarṇā oṃmogatimāgīrirvananorirvakhajimadanaśrīṃrvajaśaṃrirvapuṣaśaṃrirvaṣṭagaśaṃrirvatvaśaṃrirvakaśaṃrimumeśanasvānta mantrādi bījaṣaṭkaṃ prātilomyam iti aṣṭanavativarṇāḥ
verses.meaningZh: 彼明咒，然而、而、实则，三星佛母，孺童，吉祥庄严·广大殊胜·离名相假立，吉祥庄严·滋养增益·无我大慈三昧，真言元，种子·六·之后，倒序，如是（结句印定），八·九十·诸显色
verses.meaningEn: That + Vidyā, but, indeed, moreover, three + a star, kumārī, glorious, great, glorious, nourishing, Mantra + beginning, seed + six + or emphasizing particle, inverted order, thus, so it is stated, eight + ninety + color
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：parakspu.htm（全书共 943 行）

verses.iast: vedādibhuvanaṃ namo vārāhi ghore svapnaṃ ṭhadvitayaṃ agnidārā iti vārtālyupāṅgaṃ svapnavārtālī svapne śubhāśubhaphalavaktrī
verses.meaningZh: 开始毘陀论世间，归命，末罗呬弭尊，威怖、猛厉降魔尊，梦，咤双倍，圣火出租，如是（结句印定），最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，梦·净水·七多罗树，梦尊，便利不愉快·果·面目
verses.meaningEn: The beginning of the Veda + world, homage to O Varahi, O formidable, terrific, awe-inspiring / in formidable, terrific, awe-inspiring, sleep, dream, tha + consisting of two, fire + rent, thus, so it is stated, supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, sleep + water + palm-tree, O sleep, dream / in sleep, dream, agreeable and disagreeable + direct effect + meters
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：parakspu.htm（全书共 943 行）

verses.iast: vidyābhir etābhir yuktā phālacakre paripūjyā bhagavatīyaṃ bhūdāramukhī
verses.meaningZh: 发现物融通，长柄融通，如理，满陀法轮，供养礼赞·第一义谛，世尊佛母！此圣女，昂·出租·面门
verses.meaningEn: Finding + to, stem + to, yuktā, ploughshare or a kind of shovel + O wheel, worshipping, O Blessed Goddess + this, arise + rent + face
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：parakspu.htm（全书共 943 行）

verses.iast: evaṃ raśmimālā sampūrṇā
verses.meaningZh: 如是、如此，光芒鬘，随着富楼那
verses.meaningEn: Thus, in this way, ray of light + garland, along with + Purna
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：parakspu.htm（全书共 943 行）

verses.iast: sarvagātraḥ śuddhavidyāmayatanuḥ sa eva paramaśivaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 一切腔，清净·明咒·身心爽快·不是微细，彼、此尊（阳性主格），唯、正是、决定，管保晦气
verses.meaningEn: All + a limb of the body, pure + Vidyā + refreshment + not small, he, that one, indeed, verily, alone, assuredly + unlucky
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：parakspu.htm（全书共 943 行）

verses.iast: atha vighnadevatāḥ
verses.meaningZh: 尔时、次复吉祥启白，障碍诸何为
verses.meaningEn: Now, thereupon, auspiciously, obstacle + divinity
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：parakspu.htm（全书共 943 行）

verses.iast: irimilikirikilipadāt parimirom ity ekaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 冥合融摄·清净离诸尘垢，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·诸根清净自在），一
verses.meaningEn: Uniting, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & selfless great loving-kindness, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — purified faculties, ekaḥ
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：parakspu.htm（全书共 943 行）

verses.iast: praṇavo māyā namo bhagavati mahātripurād bhaivarṇād ravipadam anu mama traipurarakṣāṃ kuru kuru iti dvitīyaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 神圣，幻化、如幻妙力，归命，世尊佛母！（呼格），广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，破有相福德光·最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢，日轮言，日复一日、之后，我之（行者所有），拥护守护·真如实际，再三成办羯磨事业（俱噜），如是（结句印定），第二
verses.meaningEn: The sacred syllable Om, illusion, magical display (Māyā), homage to O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī! great, blessedness transcending existence & supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust, the sun, day after day, my, of me (the practitioner), protecting, accomplish & enact this sacred work! again and again, thus, so it is stated, second, secondly, for the second time
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：parakspu.htm（全书共 943 行）

verses.iast: īśvaraḥ paramaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ saccidānanda-vigrahaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 自在，为自任，黑面，有性、分别，身言相合
verses.meaningEn: Īśvaraḥ, paramaḥ, kṛṣṇaḥ, existence, thought, and joy, vigrahaḥ
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brhms5cu.htm（全书共 1838 行）

verses.iast: śrī-kṛṣṇa-rūpa-mahimā mama citte mahīyatām
verses.meaningZh: 吉祥、圣德威光，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，色、妙色身，作供，我之（行者所有），心、菩提心、心识尊，节日拘牵
verses.meaningEn: Auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, dark-blue, black, form, matter, sacred body, mahimā, my, of me (the practitioner), O mind, heart, thought, bodhicitta / in mind, heart, thought, bodhicitta, festival + held
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brhms5cu.htm（全书共 1838 行）

verses.iast: yad yac chrī-kṛṣṇa-sandarbhe vistārād vinirūpitam
verses.meaningZh: 凡所…者，左字门（妙行迁变空（caryā）·本不生体性），啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·禅定三昧总持），深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，赢得满陀，救度超脱·最上真言离言说，最上真言离言说·离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Which, what, that which, awakened conduct beyond flux (caryā) — primordial non-arising, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — deep samādhi retention, dark-blue, black, win + O bundle or bunch of grass, ferrying across, supreme ineffable speech & beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brhms5cu.htm（全书共 1838 行）

verses.iast: svayam iti tad eva prathamam āha īśvara iti
verses.meaningZh: 亲自、自性显现，如是（结句印定），彼、如是真实，唯、正是、决定，初，如是宣说、佛言，自在主、主宰尊，如是（结句印定）
verses.meaningEn: Oneself, spontaneously, in person, thus, so it is stated, that, thus, indeed, verily, alone, prathamam, spoke, declared thus, Īśvara, Sovereign Lord, Master, thus, so it is stated
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brhms5cu.htm（全书共 1838 行）

verses.iast: atra kṛṣṇa ity eva
verses.meaningZh: 于此处、今此，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·诸根清净自在），唯、正是、决定
verses.meaningEn: Here, in this place, dark-blue, black, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — purified faculties, indeed, verily, alone
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brhms5cu.htm（全书共 1838 行）

verses.iast: evāntarbhūtaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 以唯内
verses.meaningEn: Indeed + being within
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brhms5cu.htm（全书共 1838 行）

verses.iast: ataiva kṛṣṇe kartṛtvāt sarvotkarṣakatvāt kṛṣṇa iti mukhyaṃ
verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·最上真言离言说，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色尊，实干家从长柄，钩召摄受·一切诸谛圆满，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，如是（结句印定），正尊
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech, O dark-blue, black / in dark-blue, black, doer + from stem, drawing in, dark-blue, black, thus, so it is stated, being in the mouth or face, coming from the mouth
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brhms5cu.htm（全书共 1838 行）

verses.iast: tayor aikyaṃ paraṃ brahma kṛṣṇa ity abhidhīyate
verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·一乘如实之道·清净离诸尘垢，统一性、身份，管保、自然，神父，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·诸根清净自在），融通·分别·拘牵尊
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & supreme vehicle of awakening & stainless purity free from dust, unity, identity, assuredly, certainly, priest, dark-blue, black, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — purified faculties, to + thought + O held
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brhms5cu.htm（全书共 1838 行）

verses.iast: brahma sarvato'pi sarvasyāpi bṛṃhaṇaṃ vastu tat bṛhattamaṃ kṛṣṇa ity
verses.meaningZh: 神父，一切处亦，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，成办脂肪、滋补，物，彼、真如彼岸，弘暗，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·诸根清净自在）
verses.meaningEn: Priest, from or on all sides + even, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation), making fat, strengthening, nourishing, thing, That (ultimate reality), great + dark, dark-blue, black, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — purified faculties
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brhms5cu.htm（全书共 1838 行）

verses.iast: paramaṃ vidur iti viṣṇu-purāṇāt
verses.meaningZh: 最胜、第一、无上，仔细，如是（结句印定），遍入，从先世
verses.meaningEn: Supreme, highest, ultimate, attentive, mindful, thus, so it is stated, thousands with names containing prabha, and also containing Viṣṇu, from former, ancient, old
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brhms5cu.htm（全书共 1838 行）

verses.iast: vyākhyeyam
verses.meaningZh: 释此圣女
verses.meaningEn: Explain + this
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brhms5cu.htm（全书共 1838 行）

verses.iast: pūrvārdhe sarvākarṣaṇa-śakti-viśiṣṭa ānandaḥ kṛṣṇa ity
verses.meaningZh: 东面尊，一切召请，威，殊胜，普喜，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·诸根清净自在）
verses.meaningEn: O the front or upper part, all + the same as, ability, power, capacity of, separate, distinct, marked by, ānandaḥ, dark-blue, black, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — purified faculties
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brhms5cu.htm（全书共 1838 行）

verses.iast: kṛṣṇa-śabda-vācya iti jñeyam
verses.meaningZh: 深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，声，所说，如是（结句印定），乃是已知、创建往外
verses.meaningEn: Dark-blue, black, sound, to be spoken or said, thus, so it is stated, to be known, understood, learnt, found out
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brhms5cu.htm（全书共 1838 行）

verses.iast: sa ca śabdaḥ śrī-devakīnandana eva rūḍhaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 彼、此尊（阳性主格）以及音，吉祥、圣德威光，施度调伏·最上真言离言说·造作离相，唯、正是、决定，升
verses.meaningEn: He, that one and sound, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, generosity & self-mastery & supreme ineffable speech & freedom from karmic agency, indeed, verily, alone, ascend
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brhms5cu.htm（全书共 1838 行）

verses.iast: nikhilam ānandayat iti
verses.meaningZh: 周遍、圆满全体，阿难凡所…者，如是（结句印定）
verses.meaningEn: Entire, whole, servant + whatever, thus, so it is stated
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brhms5cu.htm（全书共 1838 行）

verses.iast: āhuś ca nāma-kaumudī-kārāḥ - kṛṣṇa-śabdasya
verses.meaningZh: 因缘空寂大乐·本性寂静止息以及名为、号曰，命名佛母，诸偈子赞叹、敬礼，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，声之
verses.meaningEn: Causal emptiness & spiritual joy & primordial tranquil peace and by name, called, a patr, hymn of praise, dark-blue, black, of sound
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brhms5cu.htm（全书共 1838 行）

verses.iast: sanātanam iti
verses.meaningZh: 不动，如是（结句印定）
verses.meaningEn: Eternal, everlasting, thus, so it is stated
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brhms5cu.htm（全书共 1838 行）

verses.iast: śrī-viṣṇu-purāṇe - yatrāvatīrṇaṃ kṛṣṇākhyaṃ
verses.meaningZh: 吉祥、圣德威光，遍入，先世尊，凡于何处悟入，造作离相·六度满行清净·离诸诤论无诤
verses.meaningEn: Auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, thousands with names containing prabha, and also containing Viṣṇu, O former, ancient, old, where + comprehend, freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās & conflict-free peace
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brhms5cu.htm（全书共 1838 行）

verses.iast: atha mūlam anusarāmaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 尔时、次复吉祥启白，尾，我等趣往之后、胁士
verses.meaningEn: Now, thereupon, auspiciously, to (the neighborhood of), we going after
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brhms5cu.htm（全书共 1838 行）

verses.iast: yasmād eva tādṛk kṛṣṇa-śabda-vācyas tasmād
verses.meaningZh: 一乘如实之道·一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧，唯、正是、决定，真如实际·施度调伏·造作离相，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，声，语言热门踊跃，真如实际·一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧
verses.meaningEn: Supreme vehicle of awakening & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness, indeed, verily, alone, immutable Suchness & generosity & self-mastery & freedom from karmic agency, dark-blue, black, sound, words + be hot or eager, immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brhms5cu.htm（全书共 1838 行）

verses.iast: kṛṣṇa-śabdasyaivārthāntareṇa
verses.meaningZh: 深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，本性寂静止息·解脱系缚大力·施度调伏
verses.meaningEn: Dark-blue, black, primordial tranquil peace & spiritual strength freeing bonds & generosity & self-mastery (by spiritual power)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brhms5cu.htm（全书共 1838 行）

verses.iast: kāla-rūpeṇa bhagavān tenāyaṃ kṛṣṇa ucyate
verses.meaningZh: 时，以色、妙色身，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，借由彼力出，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，妙行迁变空·一乘如实之道·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Black, by/through form, matter, sacred body, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, by that truth + income, dark-blue, black, awakened conduct beyond flux & supreme vehicle of awakening & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brhms5cu.htm（全书共 1838 行）

verses.iast: śrī-gopāla-tāpanyām-eko vaśī sarvagaḥ kṛṣṇa īḍyaḥ iti
verses.meaningZh: 吉祥、圣德威光，放牛人，真如实际·第一义谛·离名相假立，一，因为、截至所以佛母，趣往一切处、圆通，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，可贵、具寿，如是（结句印定）
verses.meaningEn: Auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, cowherd, immutable Suchness & ultimate truth & beyond nominal designation, eko, on account of, for the sake of, by reason of, going everywhere, all-pervading, omnipresent, universal, dark-blue, black, praiseworthy, venerable, thus, so it is stated
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brhms5cu.htm（全书共 1838 行）

verses.iast: yasmād
verses.meaningZh: 一乘如实之道·一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧
verses.meaningEn: Supreme vehicle of awakening & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brhms5cu.htm（全书共 1838 行）

verses.iast: ṭīkā ca svāmi-pādānām - ādyo hariḥ śrī-kṛṣṇa ity eṣā
verses.meaningZh: 说疏以及主，诸尊足、四句法足之，饭食，哈利，吉祥、圣德威光，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·诸根清净自在），此等
verses.meaningEn: A commentary, on some other commentary and svāmi, of all foot, sacred feet, verse-quarter, eatable, food, hariḥ, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, dark-blue, black, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — purified faculties, they
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brhms5cu.htm（全书共 1838 行）

verses.iast: ekādaśe tu tasya
verses.meaningZh: 十一尊，然而、而、实则，彼之、其（属格）
verses.meaningEn: O the eleventh / in the eleventh, but, indeed, moreover, his, of that
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brhms5cu.htm（全书共 1838 行）

verses.iast: kṛṣṇa-saṃjñaṃ nato'smi iti
verses.meaningZh: 深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，桑了知，凹于此之中尊，如是（结句印定）
verses.meaningEn: Dark-blue, black, saṃ + knowing, bowed + O in this, thus, so it is stated
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brhms5cu.htm（全书共 1838 行）

verses.iast: tādṛśaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 这样一样、这样一块
verses.meaningEn: Such like, such a one
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brhms5cu.htm（全书共 1838 行）

verses.iast: tāpanyāṃ ca -- eko vaśī sarvagaḥ kṛṣṇa īḍyaḥ ity uktvāha nityo
verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·第一义谛·离名相假立以及一，因为、截至所以佛母，趣往一切处、圆通，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，可贵、具寿，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·诸根清净自在），造作离相·真如实际·最上真言离言说，常
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & ultimate truth & beyond nominal designation and eko, on account of, for the sake of, by reason of, going everywhere, all-pervading, omnipresent, universal, dark-blue, black, praiseworthy, venerable, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — purified faculties, freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech, nityo
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brhms5cu.htm（全书共 1838 行）

verses.iast: tasya tāny ayanaṃ pūrvaṃ tena nārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 彼之、其（属格），耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·远离寂静周遍），趣往、来诣，元，借由彼力、以是因缘，那罗延，由忆持、回首
verses.meaningEn: His, of that, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — expansive quiescence, going, coming, first, by that truth, thereby, through that power, Narayana, from remember
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brhms5cu.htm（全书共 1838 行）

verses.iast: ity anena lakṣito yo nārāyaṇaḥ sa tavāṅgaṃ tvaṃ punar aṅgīty arthaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·诸根清净自在），以此（真言功德力），指向，凡彼圣尊、能…者，那罗延，彼、此尊（阳性主格），汝之肢，汝、圣尊您，复次、再三，支分寂静·妙行趣入·真如实际，义利、所求善愿、胜义
verses.meaningEn: Supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — purified faculties, by this, marked with or knowable by , aimed at, meant, who, whichever, Narayana, he, that one, your, Thou, You, again, furthermore, quiescence of perceptual limbs & awakened spiritual movement & immutable Suchness, meaning, benefit, aim, welfare
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brhms5cu.htm（全书共 1838 行）

verses.iast: kṛṣṇa-śabdasya yaugikārtho'pi sādhitaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，声之，一乘如实之道·妙行趣入·造作离相，降临趣往
verses.meaningEn: Dark-blue, black, of sound, supreme vehicle of awakening & awakened spiritual movement & freedom from karmic agency (vocative invocation), come or lead straight + going

verses.iast: gopīti prakṛtiṃ vidyāj janas tattva-samūhakaḥ

verses.meaningEn: Bull + drinking, told the occurrence to the, supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery & supreme vehicle of awakening, race, the state of being that, the true state or real nature, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & causal emptiness & spiritual joy

verses.iast: tac coktam

verses.iast: ṛṣy-ādi-smaraṇe - kṛṣṇaḥ prakṛtir iti
verses.meaningZh: 耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·神变善巧应化），元，记忆、传统尊，黑面，自然本性，如是（结句印定）
verses.meaningEn: Supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — miraculous skillful manifestation, beginning, O remembrance, memory, tradition / in remembrance, memory, tradition, kṛṣṇaḥ, prakṛtir, thus, so it is stated

verses.iast: ārādhya-rūpatvena prāg uktaḥ

verses.meaningEn: To be made favourable, to be won, form + by, awakened spiritual movement (gati) — expansive quiescence, said
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brhms5cu.htm（全书共 1838 行）

verses.iast: īśvaraḥ paramaḥ kṛṣṇa iti

verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brhms5cu.htm（全书共 1838 行）

verses.iast: kvacid durgāyā adhiṣṭhātṛtvaṃ śakti-śaktimator abheda-vivakṣayā yathā ca

verses.iast: neyaṃ māyāṃśa-bhūtā durgātigamyate

verses.iast: niruktiś cātra kṛcchreṇa

verses.iast: yā parā paramā śaktir mahā-viṣṇu-svarūpiṇī

verses.meaningEn: That, thus, by/through son, thus, in that same way, transcending birth & victorious & supreme vehicle of awakening & immutable Suchness, by/through form, matter, sacred body, supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — primordial non-arising, forward + be visible + by, by man, coll, Mantra, sacred formula, by/through form, matter, sacred body

verses.iast: tair ity arthaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·大自在威德统摄），耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·诸根清净自在），义利、所求善愿、胜义

verses.meaningEn: Dark-blue, black and there, therein, chandobhiḥ, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & supreme vehicle of awakening, press out + astonished, thus, so it is stated

verses.iast: kṛṣṇaṃ ca tatra cchandobhiḥ stūyamānaṃ suvismitāḥ
verses.meaningZh: 深青黑、威猛黑蓝色以及于彼处、其中，妙行迁变空·离覆障清凉·离名相假立，一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·一乘如实之道，报刊往外诸惊讶

verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brhms5cu.htm（全书共 1838 行）

verses.iast: iti nandādayo gopāḥ kṛṣṇa-rāma-kathāṃ mudā

verses.meaningEn: Thus, so it is stated, joy + merciless, cow-keeper, cowherd , keeper or guardian , of Kṛṣṇa (plural), dark-blue, black, Rāma, conversation, selfless great loving-kindness & generosity & self-mastery
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brhms5cu.htm（全书共 1838 行）

verses.meaningEn: He, that one, for, indeed, surely, all, every, complete, from going in or to, situate or being in, referring to, dark-blue, black, gladden + space, understood, grasped, mahān
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：brhms5cu.htm（全书共 1838 行）

verses.meaningZh: 彼、真如彼岸，得不是裁定，论，再三寂静，稠林尊，遍入，花样尊，向归命汝
verses.meaningEn: That (ultimate reality), not ruling, vādaḥ, kind, friendly, mild, gracious, lovely, auspicious, fortunate again and again, O guilelessness among the guileful, thousands with names containing prabha, and also containing Viṣṇu, O trick, wile / in trick, wile, homage + to Thee
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：caitcanu.htm（全书共 789 行）

verses.iast: ācarya dharmaṃ paricarya viṣṇuṃ
verses.meaningZh: 妙行流布·清净离诸尘垢，正法、诸法实相，般成了，遍入
verses.meaningEn: Practicing, Dharma, cosmic truth/teaching/phenomena, wisdom + to be done, thousands with names containing prabha, and also containing Viṣṇu
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：caitcanu.htm（全书共 789 行）

verses.iast: bhaktiṃ kṛṣṇa-padāmbuje vidadhataḥ sarvārtham āluṇṭhataḥ
verses.meaningZh: 物流、瓜分，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，句莲华尊，解由下，一切义利、一切所求善愿，离一切相无相·离诸诤论无诤·远离虚妄安立
verses.meaningEn: Distribution, partition, division, portion, share, dark-blue, black, word + O water-born, understanding + from then, all aims and benefits, freedom from conditioned marks & conflict-free peace & beyond conceptual fabrication
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：caitcanu.htm（全书共 789 行）

verses.iast: sva-tejasā kṛṣṇa-padāravinde
verses.meaningZh: 嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk，真如实际·生起不可得·尊胜·一切诸谛圆满，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，句·此边·发现物
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — primordial non-arising, immutable Suchness & transcending birth & victorious & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, dark-blue, black, word + the hither + O finding
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：caitcanu.htm（全书共 789 行）

verses.iast: yasyāśā kṛṣṇa-caitanye rāja-dvāri kim arthinaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 凡彼…之望，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，有知尊，王，门尊，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·诸根清净自在），境界、辛勤
verses.meaningEn: Whose + hope, dark-blue, black, O consciousness, intelligence, mind, soul / in consciousness, intelligence, mind, soul, king, O = , also occasioned by, selfless great loving-kindness — purified faculties, having an object, industrious, eager
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：caitcanu.htm（全书共 789 行）

titleZh: 【梵本】毗湿奴般遮罗怛罗密续 (Vaiṣṇava-Pañcarātra)《Dhyanacandra Gosvami: Gauragovindarcanasmaranapaddhati》真言曼怛罗选 (dhyggs_u.htm)
translatorZh: 德国哥廷根大学 GRETIL 梵文电子校勘库（毗湿奴般遮罗怛罗密续 (Vaiṣṇava-Pañcarātra)）
deityZh: 那罗延毗湿奴 · 吉祥天女 · 奎师那 (Nārāyaṇa-Lakṣmī)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 直接抽取自德国哥廷根大学 GRETIL 毗湿奴般遮罗怛罗密续 (Vaiṣṇava-Pañcarātra)「dhyggs_u.htm」（原书共 1573 行，共提取 60 句核心梵文真言与礼赞颂），支持天城文、悉昙体、梵音拼读参考与唐宋古汉语音译六体对照。

verses.iast: śrī-kānta kṛṣṇa karuṇāmaya kañjanābha
verses.meaningZh: 吉祥、圣德威光，相亲，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，羯噜儜么也，造作离相·圣智通达·生起不可得·尊胜
verses.meaningEn: Auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, desired, loved, lovely, beautiful, dark-blue, black, consisting of compassion, freedom from karmic agency & non-dual wisdom awareness & transcending birth & victorious
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：dhyggs_u.htm（全书共 1573 行）

verses.iast: kṛṣṇa rāma mukunda vāmana vāsudeva jagadguro
verses.meaningZh: 深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，罗摩，鼓音美，短者，财天子，生起不可得·尊胜·妙行趣入·施度调伏
verses.meaningEn: Dark-blue, black, Rāma, drum, dwarfish, short, small, † , † — dwarf, of Viṣṇu , of men, patr, transcending birth & victorious & awakened spiritual movement & generosity & self-mastery
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：dhyggs_u.htm（全书共 1573 行）

verses.iast: śrī-nārāyaṇa puṇḍarīka-nayana śrī-rāma sītā-pate
verses.meaningZh: 吉祥、圣德威光，那罗延，白莲华（芬陀利花），领军、作法，吉祥、圣德威光，罗摩，垄沟、圣女，第一义谛·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, Narayana, white lotus (Puṇḍarīka), a man's name, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, Rāma, furrow, ultimate truth & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：dhyggs_u.htm（全书共 1573 行）

verses.iast: saṃsārārṇava-karṇa-dhāraka hare śrī-kṛṣṇa tubhyaṃ namaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 大海，耳根、船舵，记忆，唯愿救苦圣尊（诃利，吉祥、圣德威光，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，向汝致敬，至心归命礼！
verses.meaningEn: The ocean of mundane existence, ear , rudder, one who retains in his mind, O Hari / Remover of Suffering! auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, dark-blue, black, to you, reverent homage!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：dhyggs_u.htm（全书共 1573 行）

verses.iast: viṣṇu-patni namas tubhyaṃ pāda-sparśaṃ kṣamasva me
verses.meaningZh: 遍入，妻尊，归命，向汝致敬，尊足、四句法足，触，堪自，于我、为我
verses.meaningEn: Thousands with names containing prabha, and also containing Viṣṇu, O mistress, lady, wife, homage to to you, foot, sacred feet, verse-quarter, touching, penetrating, enduring + own, to me, my
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：dhyggs_u.htm（全书共 1573 行）

verses.iast: nityaṃ pratyālayodyat-praṇaya-bhara-lasat-kṛṣṇa-saṃkīrtanāṭyaṃ
verses.meaningZh: 常恒、永不间断，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，相投，方位、战斗，离一切相无相·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，一切诸谛圆满·造作离相·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Constantly, eternally, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, leader, guide, bearing, carrying, freedom from conditioned marks & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness, dark-blue, black, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：dhyggs_u.htm（全书共 1573 行）

verses.iast: iti mantraṃ paṭhitvā śrī-guruṃ daṇḍavat praśamya evaṃ parama-guru-parātpara-guru-parameṣṭhi-guru-gosvāmi-caraṇān krameṇa daṇḍavat praṇamet
verses.meaningZh: 如是（结句印定），真言，分裂丢下，吉祥、圣德威光，上师，一样球竿，转载夹板，如是、如此，最胜、第一、无上，上师，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，上师，依止处、上首尊，上师，所有者牸牛尊，杂罗南，以次第，一样球竿，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤
verses.meaningEn: Thus, so it is stated, mantraṃ, split + leaving alone, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, lama, like a stick, forward + wedge, thus, in this way, supreme, highest, ultimate, lama, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, lama, O standing in the highest place, chief, supreme, lama, O the owner of a cow, residence, by/through step, course, method, way, like a stick, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：dhyggs_u.htm（全书共 1573 行）

verses.iast: śacī-putrāya mitrāya lakṣmīśāya namo namaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 乐众，向子，向朋友，吉祥相卧式，归命，至心归命礼！
verses.meaningEn: Might or help, personif, to/for son, child, the young of an animal, to/for friend, mark + lying, homage to reverent homage!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：dhyggs_u.htm（全书共 1573 行）

verses.iast: gadādhara namas tubhyaṃ yasya gaurāṅgo jīvanam
verses.meaningZh: 方位钢鞭，归命，向汝致敬，凡彼…之，水牛那罗，寿命、有性
verses.meaningEn: Bearing a mace, homage to to you, whose, of whom, actor, causing to live, vivifying
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：dhyggs_u.htm（全书共 1573 行）

verses.iast: namas te śrī-śrīnivāsa-paṇḍita prema-vigraha
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼汝、彼等·吉祥、圣德威光·一样·贤能·慈·离！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Thee / they, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, the same, learned, educated, wise, clever in, familiar with, prema, separation, division!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：dhyggs_u.htm（全书共 1573 行）

verses.iast: jagan-mohana-līlāya namo gopendra-sūnave
verses.meaningZh: 生起不可得·尊胜·妙行趣入·离名相假立，作昏，向戏剧、体育，归命，上首牧民，向佛子、裔胄
verses.meaningEn: Transcending birth & victorious & awakened spiritual movement & beyond nominal designation, stupefying, perplexing, deceiving, to/for play, sport, amusement, pastime, homage to chief herdsman, of Kṛṣṇa, to son, offspring
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：dhyggs_u.htm（全书共 1573 行）

verses.iast: patitānāṃ pāvanebhyo vaiṣṇavebhyo namo namaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 诸倒之，清净富人，最上真言离言说·六度满行清净·离诸诤论无诤，归命，至心归命礼！
verses.meaningEn: Of all fallen, sunk, degraded, an outcast, purifying or purified + belonging to one's household, supreme ineffable speech & perfection of the six pāramitās & conflict-free peace, homage to reverent homage!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：dhyggs_u.htm（全书共 1573 行）

verses.iast: khād-bhraṣṭā rudra-mūrdhni praṇipatita-jalā gāṃ gatāsīti gaṅgā
verses.meaningZh: 陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，败絮、散失，紧恶，顶首，拜趣往，净水，誐字门（妙行趣入（gati）·远离寂静周遍·大空菩提点摄持），去·汝即是·如是，恒迦河
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — expansive quiescence, fallen, dropped down from into, of gods, head, to prostrate + going, water, awakened spiritual movement (gati) — expansive quiescence sealed with bodhicitta bindu, understood + Thou art + thus, Ganges River
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：dhyggs_u.htm（全书共 1573 行）

verses.iast: mucyate sarva-pāpebhyo viṣṇu-lokaṃ sa gacchati
verses.meaningZh: 解放拘牵尊，一切、普皆遍满，罪业富人，遍入，世间、世界，彼、此尊（阳性主格），行
verses.meaningEn: Release + O held, all, every, complete, evil + belonging to one's household, thousands with names containing prabha, and also containing Viṣṇu, world, realm, he, that one, exists, carries on
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：dhyggs_u.htm（全书共 1573 行）

verses.iast: viṣṇuṃ ca dakṣiṇe kukṣau bāhau ca madhusūdanam
verses.meaningZh: 遍入以及右尊，造作离相·六度满行清净，解脱系缚大力·因缘空寂大乐以及蜜素捺那
verses.meaningEn: Thousands with names containing prabha, and also containing Viṣṇu and O right / in right, freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās (imperative seal), spiritual strength freeing bonds & causal emptiness & spiritual joy (imperative seal) and sweet + sudana
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：dhyggs_u.htm（全书共 1573 行）

verses.iast: pūrvavat sthirāsane sthira-cittaḥ tatrādau śrī-navadvīpa-madhye śrī-ratna-mandire ratna-siṃhāsanopari bhakta-vṛnda-parisevitaṃ śrī-śrī-kṛṣṇa-caitanya-devaṃ gurvādi-krameṇa dhyātvā pūjayet
