verses.iast: tayā śrī-kṛṣṇa-candrasya kriḍāyāḥ samaye mune
verses.meaningZh: 以彼，吉祥、圣德威光，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，月轮、清凉满月之，造作离相·清净离诸尘垢·息灭诤怨，向平，无我大慈三昧·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Tayā, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, dark-blue, black, of moon, lunar disc, freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust & pacifying conflict & turmoil, to equal, selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：dhyrkk_u.htm（全书共 533 行）

verses.iast: krīḍānte sthāpayet tantu sthāpanī kṛṣṇa-dehataḥ
verses.meaningZh: 戏一极，一切诸谛圆满·无住安立·第一义谛，一线、绳子，不作为佛母，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，由身
verses.meaningEn: To play + O ultimate, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & non-abiding equipoise & ultimate truth, thread, string, cord, wire, warp of a weft, omission, avoidance, dark-blue, black, from body, person,
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：dhyrkk_u.htm（全书共 533 行）

verses.iast: mahā-mantraṃ japed ādau daśārṇaṃ tad-anantaram
verses.meaningZh: 大、摩诃（广大无边），真言，生起不可得·尊胜·第一义谛·施度调伏，施度调伏，诸人，彼、如是真实，无边
verses.meaningEn: Great, vast, supreme, mantraṃ, transcending birth & victorious & ultimate truth & generosity & self-mastery, generosity & self-mastery (imperative seal), ten-syllabled, that, thus, boundless
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：dhyrkk_u.htm（全书共 533 行）

verses.iast: tataḥ śrī-rādhikā-mantraṃ gāyatrīṃ kāmakīṃ tathā
verses.meaningZh: 由伊人、本刹，吉祥、圣德威光，清净离诸尘垢·法界总持任持·造作离相，真言，妙行趣入·一乘如实之道·真如实际，造作离相·无我大慈三昧，如是、亦复如是
verses.meaningEn: From stem of he, she, it, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, stainless purity free from dust & Dharma-realm retention & freedom from karmic agency, mantraṃ, awakened spiritual movement & supreme vehicle of awakening & immutable Suchness, freedom from karmic agency & selfless great loving-kindness, thus, in that same way
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：dhyrkk_u.htm（全书共 533 行）

verses.iast: rāmaṃ dṛṣṭvā hariṃ tatra bhoktum aicchan su-vigraham
verses.meaningZh: 罗摩，施度调伏·六度满行清净·断除憍慢执障，哈利，于彼处、其中，破有相福德光·造作离相·真如实际，妙行迁变空·离覆障清凉·离名相假立，娑字门（一切诸谛圆满（sarvasatya）·损减除灭忧苦），离
verses.meaningEn: Rāma, generosity & self-mastery & perfection of the six pāramitās & cutting rigid pride, fallow, yellowish, greenish, there, therein, blessedness transcending existence & freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness, awakened conduct beyond flux & coolness free of obscuration & beyond nominal designation, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (satya) — dispelling sorrow, separation, division
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：dhyrkk_u.htm（全书共 533 行）

verses.iast: japan nityaṃ prayatnena mantra-yugmam anuttamam
verses.meaningZh: 生起不可得·尊胜·第一义谛·离名相假立，常恒、永不间断，以勤勇，真言、密咒（护心密语），双，无增
verses.meaningEn: Transcending birth & victorious & ultimate truth & beyond nominal designation, constantly, eternally, by/through effort, endeavour, pains at , activity, Mantra, sacred formula, yugmam, highest , supreme, best, most, excellent
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：dhyrkk_u.htm（全书共 533 行）

verses.iast: kṛṣṇa-vaktrād idaṃ labdhaṃ purā rudreṇa yatnataḥ
verses.meaningZh: 深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，最上真言离言说·造作离相·真如实际，此、此法门，离一切相无相·解脱系缚大力·法界总持任持，原来、有一次，以紧恶，由正勤、用心
verses.meaningEn: Dark-blue, black, supreme ineffable speech & freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness, this, here, freedom from conditioned marks & spiritual strength freeing bonds & Dharma-realm retention, formerly, once upon a time, of yore, by/through of gods, from endeavour, effort, labour, pains about
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：dhyrkk_u.htm（全书共 533 行）

verses.iast: dvātriṃśad-akṣaraṃ mantraṃ nāma-ṣoḍaśakānvitam
verses.meaningZh: 施度调伏·最上真言离言说·真如实际，字，真言，名为、号曰，十六·忧苦·辅以
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery & supreme ineffable speech & immutable Suchness, akṣaraṃ, mantraṃ, by name, called, sixteen + not-joy + followed
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：dhyrkk_u.htm（全书共 533 行）

verses.iast: prajapan vaiṣṇavo nityaṃ rādhā-kṛṣṇa-sthalaṃ labhet
verses.meaningZh: 裔胄微妙，最上真言离言说·六度满行清净·离诸诤论无诤，常恒、永不间断，罗陀，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，陆路，离一切相无相·破有相福德光·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Bringing forth + be wonderful, supreme ineffable speech & perfection of the six pāramitās & conflict-free peace, constantly, eternally, Radha, dark-blue, black, sthalaṃ, freedom from conditioned marks & blessedness transcending existence & immutable Suchness
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：dhyrkk_u.htm（全书共 533 行）

verses.iast: ahar-niśaṃ japen mantraṃ mantrī niyata-mānasaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 日子、天天，一样，生起不可得·尊胜·第一义谛·离名相假立，真言，密咒，刊，心理、心灵上
verses.meaningEn: Day, the same, transcending birth & victorious & ultimate truth & beyond nominal designation, mantraṃ, mantrī, restrained, sprung from the mind, the mind's, mental, spiritual
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：dhyrkk_u.htm（全书共 533 行）

verses.iast: śrīmad-aṣṭākṣaraṃ mantraṃ rādhāyāḥ prema-siddhi-dam
verses.meaningZh: 吉祥泡沫，八字，真言，罗陀之，慈，悉地、妙成就，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Auspiciousness + bubble, eight, mantraṃ, of Radha, prema, Siddhi, spiritual accomplishment/perfection, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：dhyrkk_u.htm（全书共 533 行）

verses.iast: tasya siddhir bhavet prema rādhā-kṛṣṇa-sthalaṃ vrajet
verses.meaningZh: 彼之、其（属格），成就，当得成就、若成，慈，罗陀，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，陆路，最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢·生起不可得·尊胜
verses.meaningEn: His, of that, siddhir, may be, would become, prema, Radha, dark-blue, black, sthalaṃ, supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust & transcending birth & victorious
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：dhyrkk_u.htm（全书共 533 行）

verses.iast: kṛṣṇa prema dena sarva jane
verses.meaningZh: 深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，慈，施度调伏·离名相假立，一切、普皆遍满，世人尊
verses.meaningEn: Dark-blue, black, prema, generosity & self-mastery & beyond nominal designation (by spiritual power), all, every, complete, O people of the world / in people of the world
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：harinc_u.htm（全书共 2976 行）

verses.iast: tumi kṛṣṇa svayaṃ prabho jīva uddhārite vibho
verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·无我大慈三昧，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，亲自、自然本具，光明、星星，命者，总持任持·施度调伏，闢呼请仁者圣众叹词
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), dark-blue, black, oneself, spontaneously, light, living, alive, upholding (vocative invocation), settle + O Venerable Ones!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：harinc_u.htm（全书共 2976 行）

verses.iast: kṛṣṇa-tattva
verses.meaningZh: 深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，真性
verses.meaningEn: Dark-blue, black, the state of being that, the true state or real nature
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：harinc_u.htm（全书共 2976 行）

verses.iast: eka-mātra icchāmaya kṛṣṇa sarveśvara
verses.meaningZh: 一、唯一不二，惟，欲所成，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，一样
verses.meaningEn: One, single, non-dual, merely, made of wish, desire, dark-blue, black, the same
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：harinc_u.htm（全书共 2976 行）

verses.iast: nitya śakti-yoge kṛṣṇa vibhu parātpara
verses.meaningZh: 常，威，修习尊，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，遍主，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: With constantly internal mind fixing your will on salvation, ability, power, capacity of, O bond, tie, attachment / in bond, tie, attachment, dark-blue, black, far-reaching, pervading, omnipresent, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：harinc_u.htm（全书共 2976 行）

verses.iast: kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa-śakti
verses.meaningZh: 再三深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，威
verses.meaningEn: Dark-blue, black again and again, ability, power, capacity of
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：harinc_u.htm（全书共 2976 行）

verses.iast: kṛṣṇa-śakti kṛṣṇa haite nā haya svatantra
verses.meaningZh: 深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，威，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，向呼格极微汝，曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·远离寂静周遍），马，自在
verses.meaningEn: Dark-blue, black, ability, power, capacity of, dark-blue, black, vocative particle + to Thee, beyond nominal designation (nāma) — expansive quiescence, horse, self-dependence, independence, freedom

verses.meaningEn: Supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation), ability, power, capacity of, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (vocative invocation), dark-blue, black, freedom from karmic agency & causal emptiness & spiritual joy (vocative invocation), Vedas, Mantra, sacred formula
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：harinc_u.htm（全书共 2976 行）

verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：harinc_u.htm（全书共 2976 行）

verses.iast: ananta vaikuṇṭha ādi yata kṛṣṇa dhāma

verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：harinc_u.htm（全书共 2976 行）

verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：harinc_u.htm（全书共 2976 行）

verses.meaningZh: 陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，职业、生意，集，遍入，真性，心坚
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — purified faculties, occupation, business, exertion, concern, origin, thousands with names containing prabha, and also containing Viṣṇu, the state of being that, the true state or real nature, maina

verses.meaningZh: 风隅，风息尊，凡于何处，不、非、无，月轮勿，星宿太，凡于何处，不、非、无，一切星宿（二十八宿），星宿一极，凡于何处，离名相假立·妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Vāyur, O wind, where, wherever, not, non-, moon + do not, star + very, where, wherever, not, non-, constellation, lunar mansion (plural), star + O ultimate, where, wherever, beyond nominal designation & awakened spiritual movement & stainless purity free from dust
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：hbhvil_u.htm（全书共 14572 行）

verses.iast: dahati yatra na mṛtyuḥ praviśati yatra na duḥkhaṃ sadānandaṃ paramānandaṃ śāntaṃ śāśvataṃ
verses.meaningZh: 智火焚净一切罪垢（娜贺），凡于何处，不、非、无，死、死魔厄难，转载入，凡于何处，不、非、无，苦，常恒欢喜，郁多摩大乐，柔善，永定
verses.meaningEn: Incinerate all defilements with wisdom-fire! where, wherever, not, non-, death, mortality, forward, where, wherever, not, non-, duḥkhaṃ, eternal joy, the highest bliss, śāntaṃ, constant, perpetual, uninterrupted, eternal
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：hbhvil_u.htm（全书共 14572 行）

verses.iast: sadā-śivaṃ brahmādi-vanditaṃ yogi-dhyeyaṃ paramaṃ padaṃ yatra gatvā na nivartante yoginaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 恒常、一切时，寂静，神父元，赞叹趣往，修习士尊，怀念此圣女，最胜、第一、无上，言，凡于何处，趣往已，不、非、无，在于·幅度·绳子，道者
verses.meaningEn: Always, evermore, kind, friendly, mild, gracious, lovely, auspicious, fortunate, priest + beginning, praise + going, yogi, think of + this, supreme, highest, ultimate, padaṃ, where, wherever, having going in or to, situate or being in, referring to, not, non-, in + width + O cord, united or connected with, relating to
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：hbhvil_u.htm（全书共 14572 行）

verses.iast: tad etad ṛcābhyuktam
verses.meaningZh: 彼、如是真实，此、此事，妙行迁变空·破有相福德光·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: That, thus, this, awakened conduct beyond flux & blessedness transcending existence & supreme vehicle of awakening
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：hbhvil_u.htm（全书共 14572 行）

verses.iast: tad viṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padaṃ sadā paśyanti sūrayaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 彼、如是真实，遍入之，最胜、第一、无上，言，恒常、一切时，诸尊了知、聪明，日轮凡彼…者
verses.meaningEn: That, thus, of thousands with names containing prabha, and also containing Viṣṇu, supreme, highest, ultimate, padaṃ, always, evermore, they looking, knowing, intelligent, the sun + whoever
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：hbhvil_u.htm（全书共 14572 行）

verses.iast: atha śrī-rāma-mantrāṇāṃ māhātmyam
verses.meaningZh: 尔时、次复吉祥启白，吉祥、圣德威光，罗摩，诸真言、密咒（护心密语）之，自在
verses.meaningEn: Now, thereupon, auspiciously, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, Rāma, of Mantra, sacred formula, māhātmyam
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：hbhvil_u.htm（全书共 14572 行）

verses.iast: sarveṣu mantra-vargeṣu śreṣṭhaṃ vaiṣṇavam ucyate
verses.meaningZh: 于诸一切、普皆遍满中，真言、密咒（护心密语），于诸多，胜，最上真言离言说·六度满行清净·离诸诤论无诤，妙行迁变空·一乘如实之道·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Among/in all, every, complete, Mantra, sacred formula, among/in removing, remover, the fairest, most excellent or best of , best in or with regard to, supreme ineffable speech & perfection of the six pāramitās & conflict-free peace, awakened conduct beyond flux & supreme vehicle of awakening & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：hbhvil_u.htm（全书共 14572 行）

verses.iast: vaiṣṇaveṣv api mantreṣu rāma-mantrāḥ phalādhikāḥ
verses.meaningZh: 最上真言离言说·六度满行清净·离诸诤论无诤，亦、虽、乃至，于诸真言、密咒（护心密语）中，罗摩，诸真言、密咒（护心密语），果诸过度
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & perfection of the six pāramitās & conflict-free peace, even, also, among/in Mantra, sacred formula, Rāma, Mantra, sacred formula (plural), direct effect + exceeding
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：hbhvil_u.htm（全书共 14572 行）

verses.iast: mantra-rāja iti proktaḥ sarveṣām uttamottamaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 真言、密咒（护心密语），王，如是（结句印定），转载曰，湖相，最上最上
verses.meaningEn: Mantra, sacred formula, king, thus, so it is stated, forward + said, a lake + work, highest
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：hbhvil_u.htm（全书共 14572 行）

verses.iast: sarvāṇy api praṇaśyanti rāma-mantrānukīrtanāt
verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，亦、虽、乃至，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤，罗摩，真言·日复一日·从寺刹
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, even, also, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace (vocative invocation), Rāma, Mantra + day after day + from temple
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：hbhvil_u.htm（全书共 14572 行）

verses.iast: atha gopāla-deva-mantra-māhātmyam
verses.meaningZh: 尔时、次复吉祥启白，放牛人，天人、诸天护法，真言、密咒（护心密语），自在
verses.meaningEn: Now, thereupon, auspiciously, cowherd, god, celestial deity (Deva), Mantra, sacred formula, māhātmyam
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：hbhvil_u.htm（全书共 14572 行）

verses.iast: mantrās tu kṛṣṇa-devasya sākṣād bhagavato hareḥ
verses.meaningZh: 无我大慈三昧·离名相假立·真如实际，然而、而、实则，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，天人、诸天护法之，一切诸谛圆满·造作离相·六度满行清净，以世尊此，哈利之
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness, but, indeed, moreover, dark-blue, black, of god, celestial deity (Deva), all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās, Bhagavān + hence, of fallow, yellowish, greenish
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：hbhvil_u.htm（全书共 14572 行）

verses.iast: sarveṣāṃ mantra-varyāṇāṃ śreṣṭho vaiṣṇava ucyate
verses.meaningZh: 湖相，真言、密咒（护心密语），诸入选、善哉之，胜，最上真言离言说·六度满行清净·离诸诤论无诤，妙行迁变空·一乘如实之道·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: A lake + work, Mantra, sacred formula, of to be chosen , excellent, best of, śreṣṭho, supreme ineffable speech & perfection of the six pāramitās & conflict-free peace, awakened conduct beyond flux & supreme vehicle of awakening & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：hbhvil_u.htm（全书共 14572 行）

verses.iast: viśeṣāt kṛṣṇa-manavo bhoga-mokṣaika-sādhanam
verses.meaningZh: 从异，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，认为人情，蛇盘身，究竟解脱·无我大慈三昧，修习
verses.meaningEn: From distinction, difference, special property, peculiarity, dark-blue, black, think + favour, winding, curve, coil, emancipating, sādhanam
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：hbhvil_u.htm（全书共 14572 行）

verses.iast: kṛṣṇa eva paraṃ brahma saccidānanda-vigrahaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，唯、正是、决定，管保、自然，神父，有性、分别，身言相合
verses.meaningEn: Dark-blue, black, indeed, verily, alone, assuredly, certainly, priest, existence, thought, and joy, vigrahaḥ
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：hbhvil_u.htm（全书共 14572 行）

verses.iast: kṛṣṇaṃ taṃ viprā bahudhā yajanti
verses.meaningZh: 深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，彼（宾格），英明、渊博，部件、许多，诸尊供养、奉献
verses.meaningEn: Dark-blue, black, him, that, stirred inwardly, inspired, wise, learned, clever, in many ways, forms, parts, or places, much, variously, repeatedly, they worship, with sacrifices or oblations, consecrate, hallow, offer, sacrifice
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：hbhvil_u.htm（全书共 14572 行）

verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jivrkadu.htm（全书共 924 行）

verses.iast: tad-dveṣṭṛṣu tad-dveṣyasyaiveti ca
verses.meaningZh: 彼、如是真实，施度调伏·最上真言离言说·六度满行清净，彼、如是真实，喷子·凡彼…之·犹如·瘟疫以及
verses.meaningEn: That, thus, generosity & self-mastery & supreme ineffable speech & perfection of the six pāramitās (imperative seal), that, thus, hater + whose + like + plague and
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jivrkadu.htm（全书共 924 行）

verses.iast: tathaiva darśitaṃ saptame rājasūyārambhe śrī-yudhiṣṭhirādibhiḥ śiśupālaṃ prati gāli-pradānādinā
verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·无住安立·最上真言离言说，施度调伏·清净离诸尘垢·本性寂静止息，第七尊，即位礼祭发勤尊，吉祥、圣德威光，以诸坚固于阵元，大王，对，侮辱，以施予元
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & non-abiding equipoise & supreme ineffable speech, generosity & self-mastery & stainless purity free from dust & primordial tranquil peace, O the seventh, the seventh day in the half-month, Rajasuya + O slaughter, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, of the eldest son of Paṇḍu + with beginning, of a king slain by Kṛṣṇa, toward, abusive language, insult, giving + by beginning
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jivrkadu.htm（全书共 924 行）

verses.iast: ataḥ śrī-bhagavān apy uktaṃ - pravṛttiṃ ca nivṛttiṃ ca (Gītā 16.7) ity ārabhya
verses.meaningZh: 走道那么、游方，吉祥、圣德威光，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），曰，流转以及还灭以及赞歌，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·诸根清净自在），清净离诸尘垢·破有相福德光·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Walk about, wander, run, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, said, coming forth, rising, appearance, origin and ceasing and Song, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — purified faculties, stainless purity free from dust & blessedness transcending existence & supreme vehicle of awakening
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jivrkadu.htm（全书共 924 行）

verses.iast: yat paśyatā 'sakṛt kṛṣṇaṃ tad-darśanam api yoginām
verses.meaningZh: 凡所…者，有形、突显，不是一下、一再，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，彼、如是真实，观照，亦、虽、乃至，一乘如实之道·妙行趣入·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Whatever, that which, visible, conspicuous, not once, dark-blue, black, that, thus, darśanam, even, also, supreme vehicle of awakening & awakened spiritual movement & beyond nominal designation
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jivrkadu.htm（全书共 924 行）

verses.iast: svargāpavarga-viramaḥ svayam āsa viṣṇuḥ
verses.meaningZh: 天解脱，还灭、除断从中，亲自、自性显现，床坐、本刹，遍入
verses.meaningEn: Going or leading to light or heaven + completion, ceasing, desisting, abstaining from, oneself, spontaneously, in person, seat, viṣṇuḥ
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jivrkadu.htm（全书共 924 行）

verses.iast: vṛṣṇayaḥ kṛṣṇa-cetasaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 最上真言离言说·六度满行清净·离诸诤论无诤，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，相貌、方面
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & perfection of the six pāramitās & conflict-free peace, dark-blue, black, appearance, aspect, intelligence, consciousness, mind, heart, desire, fancy
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jivrkadu.htm（全书共 924 行）

verses.iast: atra pratiyugmāntarasthasyāpi śabdasya dvayena yugma-dvayaṃ pṛthag avamyate
verses.meaningZh: 于此处、今此，对·双·一极·骨头·此尊之·善友，声之，以二，双，二，第一义谛·无住安立·妙行趣入，最上真言离言说·无我大慈三昧·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Here, in this place, toward + paired + ultimate + bone + of this + friend, of sound, by/through both, paired, even, both, ultimate truth & non-abiding equipoise & awakened spiritual movement, supreme ineffable speech & selfless great loving-kindness & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jivrkadu.htm（全书共 924 行）

verses.iast: tataś ca tad brahmākhya tat taṃ munaya upāsate tad arayo 'pi yayuḥ smaraṇāt
verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·本性寂静止息以及彼、如是真实，解脱系缚大力·清净离诸尘垢·因缘空寂大乐，彼、真如彼岸，彼（宾格），祈请牟尼、寂默圣者，愈加我身服用，彼、如是真实，辐条凡彼圣尊，亦、虽、乃至，一乘如实之道，从记忆、传统
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & primordial tranquil peace and that, thus, spiritual strength freeing bonds & stainless purity free from dust & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, That (ultimate reality), him, that, may You Muni, silent sage! thereto + I eat, that, thus, spoke of a wheel + who, even, also, supreme vehicle of awakening, from remembrance, memory, tradition
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jivrkadu.htm（全书共 924 行）

verses.iast: striyaḥ śrī-vraja-devyaḥ aṅghri-saroja-sudhās tat-prema-maya=mādhuryāṇi yayuḥ
verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢，吉祥、圣德威光，折叠、挥洒，施度调伏·最上真言离言说·一乘如实之道，尊足、根本，湖神色，一切诸谛圆满·法界总持任持，彼、真如彼岸，慈，过去、阿修罗，勿一切气流，一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, fold, shed, stable, station of herds, generosity & self-mastery & supreme ineffable speech & supreme vehicle of awakening, foot, root, a lake + odd, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & Dharma-realm retention, That (ultimate reality), prema, made or consisting of, do not + fit to be yoked or harnessed, supreme vehicle of awakening
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jivrkadu.htm（全书共 924 行）

verses.iast: vayam api samadṛśas tābhiḥ sama-bhāvāḥ satyaḥ samās tābhiḥ tulyatāṃ prāptāḥ
verses.meaningZh: 我等，亦、虽、乃至，一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·施度调伏，真如实际·破有相福德光，平，诸物，谛、真实不虚语，彼莽娑，真如实际·破有相福德光，筹量拘牵，诸得
verses.meaningEn: We, even, also, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & generosity & self-mastery, immutable Suchness & blessedness transcending existence, equal, becoming, being, truth, reality, veracity, he + flesh, immutable Suchness & blessedness transcending existence, to estimate + held, filled with astonishment and wonder
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jivrkadu.htm（全书共 924 行）

verses.iast: vyūhāntareṇa gopyo bhūtvā tavāṅghri-saroja-sudhā yayima ity arthaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 以庄严内部，妙行趣入·第一义谛·一乘如实之道，昂已，汝之尊足，湖神色，石灰，一乘如实之道·无我大慈三昧，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·诸根清净自在），义利、所求善愿、胜义
verses.meaningEn: Mass + by, awakened spiritual movement & ultimate truth & supreme vehicle of awakening, having arise, your + foot, a lake + odd, welfare, comfort, supreme vehicle of awakening & selfless great loving-kindness, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — purified faculties, meaning, benefit, aim, welfare

verses.iast: atra bṛhad-vāmana-purāṇe tāsāṃ prārthanā pūrvakāṇi vākyāni santi
verses.meaningZh: 于此处、今此，解脱系缚大力·因缘空寂大乐·施度调伏，短者，先世尊，真如实际·一切诸谛圆满，贪欲、希望，一切已，一切妙语、语言，一切诸谛圆满·离名相假立·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Here, in this place, spiritual strength freeing bonds & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & generosity & self-mastery, dwarfish, short, small, † , † — dwarf, of Viṣṇu , of men, O former, ancient, old, immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, desire, wish, former (plural), speech, words, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation)

verses.iast: strī-śabdasya gopī vācakatvam

verses.meaningEn: Stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — deep samādhi retention, of sound, gopī, speaking + Thou
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jivrkadu.htm（全书共 924 行）

verses.iast: tad arayo 'pi yayuḥ smaraṇād ity anenāsurāṇām api mokṣa-dātṛtvena anyatayā prasiddhasya śrī-kṛṣṇasyaivālambanatvena labdhatvāt
verses.meaningZh: 彼、如是真实，辐条凡彼圣尊，亦、虽、乃至，一乘如实之道，忆念本誓·一切诸谛圆满，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·诸根清净自在），以此诸阿修罗之，亦、虽、乃至，解脱、自在离缚，以施予长柄，以分齐，最称赞，吉祥、圣德威光，造作离相·六度满行清净·离诸诤论无诤，离一切相无相·解脱系缚大力·法界总持任持
verses.meaningEn: That, thus, spoke of a wheel + who, even, also, supreme vehicle of awakening, recalling, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — purified faculties, by this + of Asura, even, also, liberation, emancipation, giving + by, with/by the being other, difference, of accomplished, brought in order, arranged, settled, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās & conflict-free peace (by spiritual power), freedom from conditioned marks & spiritual strength freeing bonds & Dharma-realm retention

verses.iast: tāsām eva tasmin kevalena rāgeṇa bhajana-prasiddheḥ

verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jivrkadu.htm（全书共 924 行）

verses.iast: tad etad apy āstām śrī-nārāyaṇāṅga-sthitāyā lakṣmīto 'pi tāsāṃ parama-vailakṣaṇyaṃ
verses.meaningZh: 彼、如是真实，此、此事，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·无我大慈三昧，吉祥、圣德威光，那罗延肢，立即是，吉祥相从此，亦、虽、乃至，真如实际·一切诸谛圆满，最胜、第一、无上，多样性

verses.iast: tad vidyād ātmano māyāṃ
verses.meaningZh: 彼、如是真实，最上真言离言说·施度调伏·一乘如实之道，我推车，幻化、如幻妙力
verses.meaningEn: That, thus, supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery & supreme vehicle of awakening, self + cart, illusion, magical display (Māyā)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jivrkadu.htm（全书共 924 行）

verses.iast: śriyā puṣṭyā girā kāntyā kīrtyā tuṣṭyelayor jayā ity ādi kiyanto bhedāś ca darśitā
verses.meaningZh: 广大光华，以增益、丰饶增长，梵音、妙语，以美色、光明庄严，以誉，欢喜悦泽·真如实际，誓耶，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·诸根清净自在），元，所有，破有相福德光·施度调伏·本性寂静止息以及施度调伏·清净离诸尘垢·本性寂静止息
verses.meaningEn: With great magnificence, with/by nourishment, increase, prosperity (Puṣṭi), voice, speech, with/by loveliness, splendour, beauty, womanly beauty, charms, with/by renown, delighting, Jayā, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — purified faculties, beginning, kiyanto, blessedness transcending existence & generosity & self-mastery & primordial tranquil peace and generosity & self-mastery & stainless purity free from dust & primordial tranquil peace
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jivrkadu.htm（全书共 924 行）

verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jivrkadu.htm（全书共 924 行）

verses.iast: guṇāśrayā namas tasmai
verses.meaningZh: 功德依止，归命，向彼尊（为格）

verses.iast: tad uktaṃ viṣṇu-purāṇe
verses.meaningZh: 彼、如是真实，曰，遍入，先世尊
verses.meaningEn: That, thus, said, thousands with names containing prabha, and also containing Viṣṇu, O former, ancient, old
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jivrkadu.htm（全书共 924 行）

verses.iast: tad uktaṃ śrī-viṣṇu-purāṇe
verses.meaningZh: 彼、如是真实，曰，吉祥、圣德威光，遍入，先世尊
verses.meaningEn: That, thus, said, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, thousands with names containing prabha, and also containing Viṣṇu, O former, ancient, old
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jivrkadu.htm（全书共 924 行）

verses.iast: ete eva viṣṇu-purāṇe lakṣmī-stave spaṣṭīkṛte
verses.meaningZh: 此等诸尊，唯、正是、决定，遍入，先世尊，吉祥相，向赞叹、庆祝，向作持汝
verses.meaningEn: These, indeed, verily, alone, thousands with names containing prabha, and also containing Viṣṇu, O former, ancient, old, mark, sign, to praise, extol, celebrate, sing, chant, make distinct or clear + to Thee
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jivrkadu.htm（全书共 924 行）

verses.iast: athaivambhūtānanta-vṛttikā yā svarūpa-śaktiḥ sā tv iha bhagavad-vāmāṃśa-vartino mūrtimato lakṣmīr evety āha anapāyinī bhagavatī śrīḥ sākṣād ātmano hareḥ
verses.meaningZh: 无住安立·最上真言离言说·无我大慈三昧，最上真言离言说·真如实际·造作离相，凡彼（阴性关系代词），自性相、本然体相，短𬬰，彼、彼圣母（阴性主格），嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk，于此、今于此处，才宣说，左肩，最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，尊身理趣，吉祥相，最上真言离言说·真如实际·一乘如实之道，如是宣说、佛言，无具恶趣，具足才尊，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·禅定三昧总持·涅槃除障点证入），一切诸谛圆满·造作离相·六度满行清净，我推车，哈利之

verses.meaningZh: 说疏以及无具恶趣，哈利之，短𬬰

suśīlaṃ ca guṇānāṃ ca puṇyeṣu kṛṣṇa-kīrtanam

verses.iast: saubhāgyāsu sundarīṣu rādhā kṛṣṇa-priyāsu ca
verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·破有相福德光·妙行趣入，孙陀利宝箭，罗陀，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，于诸惜者以及
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & blessedness transcending existence & awakened spiritual movement (imperative seal), Sundarī + arrow, Radha, dark-blue, black, in dear, valued, pleasing to, beloved of, one's own and
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jnass01u.htm（全书共 2493 行）

verses.iast: śālagrāmaś ca yantrāṇāṃ pūjāsu kṛṣṇa-pūjanam
verses.meaningZh: 本性寂静止息·离一切相无相·妙行趣入以及诸机之，于诸供中，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，供养
verses.meaningEn: Primordial tranquil peace & freedom from conditioned marks & awakened spiritual movement and of apparatus, in to make an offering, dark-blue, black, to make offerings
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jnass01u.htm（全书共 2493 行）

verses.iast: suśīlaṃ ca guṇānāṃ ca puṇyeṣu kṛṣṇa-kīrtanam
verses.meaningZh: 良好文字以及诸功德、殊胜妙德之以及于诸福德、胜妙功德中，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，寺刹
verses.meaningEn: A good character and of all virtue, excellence, auspicious quality and among/in merit, auspicious virtue, dark-blue, black, temple
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jnass01u.htm（全书共 2493 行）

verses.iast: viṣṇu-bhakteṣu vijñeṣu yathaiva nārado muniḥ
verses.meaningZh: 遍入，于诸饼中，于诸智，一乘如实之道·无住安立·最上真言离言说，人与子，牟尼、寂默圣者
verses.meaningEn: Thousands with names containing prabha, and also containing Viṣṇu, among/in food, among/in knowing, wise, learned, supreme vehicle of awakening & non-abiding equipoise & supreme ineffable speech, nārado, Muni, silent sage
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jnass01u.htm（全书共 2493 行）

verses.iast: siddhe nārāyaṇa-kṣetre sarveṣāṃ abhivāñcchite
verses.meaningZh: 成就者、已成就尊，那罗延，田尊，湖相，破有相福德光·最上真言离言说·圣智通达
verses.meaningEn: O accomplished, perfected adept (Siddha) / in accomplished, perfected adept (Siddha), Narayana, O field / in field, a lake + work, blessedness transcending existence & supreme ineffable speech & non-dual wisdom awareness (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jnass01u.htm（全书共 2493 行）

verses.iast: svātmārāmaṃ pūrṇa-kāmaṃ jñānināṃ ca guror gurum
verses.meaningZh: 自·我·共喜园，富楼那，如意、甘愿，圣智了知·生起不可得·尊胜以及上师之，上师
verses.meaningEn: Own + self + pleasure, Purna, at will, willingly, freely, easily, by all means, indeed, a neg, knowing and of lama, lama
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jnass01u.htm（全书共 2493 行）

verses.iast: kṛṣṇa-mantropāsakasya jīvan-muktasya bhārate
verses.meaningZh: 深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，真言近事男，长寿护命·生起不可得·尊胜，已解脱、自在无碍之，包袱、阿吒吒
verses.meaningEn: Dark-blue, black, Mantra + of lay-disciple, vitalizing, of liberated, freed, released, burden, load, quantity, mass, multitude
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jnass01u.htm（全书共 2493 行）

verses.iast: mantra-grahaṇa-mātreṇa puruṣāṇāṃ śataṃ suta
verses.meaningZh: 真言、密咒（护心密语），摄伏，以惟，诸士夫，百，一切诸谛圆满·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Mantra, sacred formula, to seize, by/through merely, of man, human being, male, person, individual of a generation, śataṃ, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jnass01u.htm（全书共 2493 行）

verses.iast: nahi dharmo nahi tapaḥ śrī-kṛṣṇa-sevanāt param
verses.meaningZh: 的确不是、才不，正法、诸法实相，的确不是、才不，暖气、炽燃，吉祥、圣德威光，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，从依附，管保、自然
verses.meaningEn: Indeed not, by no means, not at all, Dharma, cosmic truth/teaching/phenomena, indeed not, by no means, not at all, heating, burning, tormenting, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, dark-blue, black, from sewing, assuredly, certainly
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jnass01u.htm（全书共 2493 行）

verses.iast: kṛṣṇa-mantropāsakasya tīrtha-pūtasya putraka
verses.meaningZh: 深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，真言近事男，津，第一义谛·真如实际·一切诸谛圆满，一些佛子、童子
verses.meaningEn: Dark-blue, black, Mantra + of lay-disciple, a ford, ultimate truth & immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, little son, boy, of a man
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jnass01u.htm（全书共 2493 行）

verses.iast: mantra-grahaṇa-mātreṇa naṣṭaṃ vahnau yathā tṛṇam
verses.meaningZh: 真言、密咒（护心密语），摄伏，以惟，散失、隐形，御船，犹如、如…所说，卉
verses.meaningEn: Mantra, sacred formula, to seize, by/through merely, lost, disappeared, invisible, fled, escaped , perished, damaged, destroyed, to transport + of of, just as, according to, grass
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jnass01u.htm（全书共 2493 行）

verses.iast: punāti līlayaitāni śuddhaḥ kṛṣṇa-parāyaṇaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 还复太，离一切相无相·一乘如实之道·真如实际，清净、纯洁无染，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，依护
verses.meaningEn: Again + very, freedom from conditioned marks & supreme vehicle of awakening & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), pure, cleansed, bright, dark-blue, black, going away, departure, last way or exit
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jnass01u.htm（全书共 2493 行）

verses.iast: nahi pūta-stri-bhuvane śrī-kṛṣṇa-sevakāt paraḥ
verses.meaningZh: 的确不是、才不，第一义谛·真如实际，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·诸根清净自在），世间、法界刹土尊，吉祥、圣德威光，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，从随事者，他人
verses.meaningEn: Indeed not, by no means, not at all, ultimate truth & immutable Suchness, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — purified faculties, O world, realm of beings / in world, realm of beings, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, dark-blue, black, from sack, someone else
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jnass01u.htm（全书共 2493 行）

verses.iast: śāligrāma-śilā-cakre karoti kṛṣṇa-pūjanam
verses.meaningZh: 粳米邑，玻璃，法轮、金轮、脉轮尊，掌正勤，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，供养
verses.meaningEn: Sgl + dwelling-place, a precious stone, quartz! O wheel, Dharma-wheel, discus / in wheel, Dharma-wheel, discus, palm + effort, dark-blue, black, to make offerings
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jnass01u.htm（全书共 2493 行）

verses.iast: veda-sāraṃ kṛṣṇa-mataṃ mamāpi nahi kalpanā
verses.meaningZh: 吠陀，心坚，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，分别，我之善友，的确不是、才不，分别
verses.meaningEn: Vedas, maina, dark-blue, black, thought, my + friend, indeed not, by no means, not at all, thought
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jnass01u.htm（全书共 2493 行）

verses.iast: sa eva viṣṇu-tulyo hi tad-aṃśo bhārate mune
verses.meaningZh: 彼、此尊（阳性主格），唯、正是、决定，遍入，衡，诚然、因为、实乃，彼、如是真实，分，包袱、阿吒吒，无我大慈三昧·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: He, that one, indeed, verily, alone, thousands with names containing prabha, and also containing Viṣṇu, comparable, for, indeed, surely, that, thus, aṃśo, burden, load, quantity, mass, multitude, selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jnass01u.htm（全书共 2493 行）

verses.iast: bhakta-prāṇo hi kṛṣṇaś ca kṛṣṇa-prāṇā hi vaiṣṇavāḥ
verses.meaningZh: 饼，入息，诚然、因为、实乃，造作离相·六度满行清净·离诸诤论无诤以及深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，入息，诚然、因为、实乃，最上真言离言说·六度满行清净·离诸诤论无诤
verses.meaningEn: Food, inward breath, for, indeed, surely, freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās & conflict-free peace and dark-blue, black, inward breath, for, indeed, surely, supreme ineffable speech & perfection of the six pāramitās & conflict-free peace
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jnass01u.htm（全书共 2493 行）

verses.iast: dhyāyante vaiṣṇavāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇaś ca vaiṣṇavāṃs tathā
verses.meaningZh: 向怀念假定今日汝，最上真言离言说·六度满行清净·离诸诤论无诤，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，造作离相·六度满行清净·离诸诤论无诤以及最上真言离言说·六度满行清净·离诸诤论无诤，如是、亦复如是
verses.meaningEn: Think of + suppose now + to Thee, supreme ineffable speech & perfection of the six pāramitās & conflict-free peace, dark-blue, black, freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās & conflict-free peace and supreme ineffable speech & perfection of the six pāramitās & conflict-free peace, thus, in that same way
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jnass01u.htm（全书共 2493 行）

verses.iast: kṛṣṇa-bhakti-vihīnebhyo dvijebhyaḥ śvapaco mahān
verses.meaningZh: 深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，物流、瓜分，衰败富人，向诸再生，本性寂静止息·最上真言离言说·第一义谛，大
verses.meaningEn: Dark-blue, black, distribution, partition, division, portion, share, abandoned + belonging to one's household, to all twice-born, primordial tranquil peace & supreme ineffable speech & ultimate truth, mahān
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jnass01u.htm（全书共 2493 行）

verses.iast: brahmaṇānāṃ sva-dharmaś ca santataṃ kṛṣṇa-sevanam
verses.meaningZh: 解脱系缚大力·清净离诸尘垢·因缘空寂大乐，嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk，持守摄受·法界总持任持以及赢得慈父，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，依附
verses.meaningEn: Spiritual strength freeing bonds & stainless purity free from dust & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — primordial non-arising, bearing and win + father, dark-blue, black, sevanam
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jnass01u.htm（全书共 2493 行）

verses.iast: dadhyau kṛṣṇa-padāmbhojaṃ paraṃ kalpa-taruṃ śuka
verses.meaningZh: 施予饶益·施度调伏，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，句莲华，管保、自然，细轨，冒失，鸚鹉
verses.meaningEn: Granting (imperative seal), dark-blue, black, word + lotus, assuredly, certainly, style, manner, fashion, rash, parrot, a man's name
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jnass01u.htm（全书共 2493 行）

verses.iast: viṣṇu-bhaktāc ca dharmiṣṭhāt sat-putrāc ca pitā sukhī
verses.meaningZh: 遍入，破有相福德光·造作离相·真如实际以及从公正，多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·本不生体性），第一义谛·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢以及父，乐佛母
verses.meaningEn: Thousands with names containing prabha, and also containing Viṣṇu, blessedness transcending existence & freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness and from perfectly virtuous, just, or lawful, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — primordial non-arising, ultimate truth & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust and father, easy, pleasant, comfortable, happy
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jnass01u.htm（全书共 2493 行）

verses.iast: śrī-kṛṣṇa-vimukhaṃ mūḍhaṃ dvijam eva narādhamam
verses.meaningZh: 吉祥、圣德威光，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，闢面，昏愚，再生，唯、正是、决定，最少男人、可怜虫
verses.meaningEn: Auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, dark-blue, black, settle, erred, gone astray, confused, uncertain, silly, stupid, twice-born, indeed, verily, alone, lowest of men, a wretch
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jnass01u.htm（全书共 2493 行）

verses.iast: tapaḥ karoti śrī-kṛṣṇa-pāda-padmārtham īpsitam
verses.meaningZh: 暖气、炽燃，掌正勤，吉祥、圣德威光，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，尊足、四句法足，莲华义利，所愿
verses.meaningEn: Heating, burning, tormenting, palm + effort, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, dark-blue, black, foot, sacred feet, verse-quarter, lotus flower + meaning, wished, desired
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jnass01u.htm（全书共 2493 行）

verses.iast: paraṃ śrī-kṛṣṇa-bhajanaṃ dhyānaṃ tan-nāma-kīrtanam
verses.meaningZh: 管保、自然，吉祥、圣德威光，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，恭，禅那、静虑禅定，曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·本不生体性），名为、号曰，寺刹
verses.meaningEn: Assuredly, certainly, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, dark-blue, black, bhajanaṃ, meditative concentration (Dhyāna), beyond nominal designation (nāma) — primordial non-arising, by name, called, temple
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jnass01u.htm（全书共 2493 行）

verses.iast: tāmaso hi na jānāti śrī-kṛṣṇaṃ tri-guṇāt param
verses.meaningZh: 答摩，诚然、因为、实乃，不、非、无，了知太，吉祥、圣德威光，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，三，从功德、殊胜妙德，管保、自然
verses.meaningEn: Dark, belonging to ignorance, for, indeed, surely, not, non-, knowing + very, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, dark-blue, black, three, from virtue, excellence, auspicious quality, assuredly, certainly
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jnass01u.htm（全书共 2493 行）

verses.iast: svapne jñāne na jānāti puṇyaṃ vā kṛṣṇa-pūjanam
verses.meaningZh: 梦尊，圣智、无漏真智尊，不、非、无，了知太，福德、胜妙功德，或、抑或，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，供养
verses.meaningEn: O sleep, dream / in sleep, dream, O primordial wisdom, gnosis (Jñāna) / in primordial wisdom, gnosis (Jñāna), not, non-, knowing + very, merit, auspicious virtue, or, dark-blue, black, to make offerings
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jnass01u.htm（全书共 2493 行）

verses.iast: kṛṣṇa-bhakta-sahālāpa-darśana-sparśanaṃ śubhaṃ
verses.meaningZh: 深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，饼，打败讲话，观照，动人、心情，清净吉祥、善妙庄严
verses.meaningEn: Dark-blue, black, food, overpower + talk, false, heretical view, touching, feeling, sensation, auspicious, pure, bright, virtuous
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jnass01u.htm（全书共 2493 行）

verses.iast: tad-vastu bhuktaṃ vipreṇa kṛṣṇa-naivedya-miśritam
verses.meaningZh: 彼、如是真实，物，泮吒彼，以英明、渊博，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，天食，无我大慈三昧·本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: That, thus, thing, crack! + him, by/through stirred inwardly, inspired, wise, learned, clever, dark-blue, black, offering of eatables to a deity, selfless great loving-kindness & primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jnass01u.htm（全书共 2493 行）

verses.iast: atha śrī-kṛṣṇa-mahima-varṇanam
verses.meaningZh: 尔时、次复吉祥启白，吉祥、圣德威光，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，乐趣本刹，显色管保
verses.meaningEn: Now, thereupon, auspiciously, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, dark-blue, black, gladden + this, color + assuredly
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jnass01u.htm（全书共 2493 行）

verses.iast: na ca taṃ khaṇḍituṃ śaktaḥ svayaṃ viṣṇuś ca śaṅkaraḥ
verses.meaningZh: 不、非、无以及彼（宾格），等虚空无碍·离诸诤论无诤·息灭诤怨，由能，亲自、自然本具，最上真言离言说·六度满行清净·离诸诤论无诤以及作乐
verses.meaningEn: Not, non- and him, that, space-like boundlessness & conflict-free peace & pacifying conflict & turmoil, from to be able, oneself, spontaneously, supreme ineffable speech & perfection of the six pāramitās & conflict-free peace and śaṅkaraḥ
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jnass01u.htm（全书共 2493 行）

verses.iast: kaścit kṛṣṇaś ca gauraś ca śyāmalaś ca sva-karmaṇā
verses.meaningZh: 任何一人、或有众生，造作离相·六度满行清净·离诸诤论无诤以及妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢·本性寂静止息以及本性寂静止息·一乘如实之道·无我大慈三昧以及嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk，羯磨事业称计粒子
verses.meaningEn: Anyone, someone, freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās & conflict-free peace and awakened spiritual movement & stainless purity free from dust & primordial tranquil peace and primordial tranquil peace & supreme vehicle of awakening & selfless great loving-kindness and supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — primordial non-arising, action + a measure of grain
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jnass01u.htm（全书共 2493 行）

verses.iast: kaścid bhaktyā ca prāpnoti kṛṣṇa-dāsyaṃ sudurlabham
verses.meaningZh: 造作离相·本性寂静止息·妙行迁变空，以物流、瓜分以及得究竟，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，奴隶制度、依属，报刊往外难得
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency & primordial tranquil peace & awakened conduct beyond flux, with/by distribution, partition, division, portion, share and attain, dark-blue, black, slavery, servitude, dependence, press out + difficult to be obtained or seen
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jnass01u.htm（全书共 2493 行）

verses.iast: bālo voḍhum aśakyantaś ca yayau gamana-mantharaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 幼童，最上真言离言说·法鼓觉悟·无我大慈三昧，本性寂静止息·造作离相·一乘如实之道以及一乘如实之道，行，迟缓、懶怠
verses.meaningEn: Bālo, supreme ineffable speech & awakening Dharma-drum resonance & selfless great loving-kindness, primordial tranquil peace & freedom from karmic agency & supreme vehicle of awakening and supreme vehicle of awakening (imperative seal), going, coming, moving, slow, lazy, tardy
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：jnass01u.htm（全书共 2493 行）

titleZh: 【梵本】毗湿奴般遮罗怛罗密续 (Vaiṣṇava-Pañcarātra)《Krsnadasa: Bhavanasarasamgraha, Lila's 1 & 2》真言曼怛罗选 (kbss_1-u.htm)

verses.meaningZh: 吉祥、圣德威光，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，戏剧、体育，于诸篇章、布局中，得力、勇健

verses.iast: śaṅke bhāsvān udayam udagāt kṛṣṇa! nidrāṃ jahīhi
verses.meaningZh: 疑虑、嫌疑尊，光净自，出现，施度调伏·妙行趣入·真如实际，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，睡觉，生起不可得·尊胜·因缘空寂大乐
verses.meaningEn: O hesitation, doubt, suspicion, fear of, be bright + own, to manifest, generosity & self-mastery & awakened spiritual movement & immutable Suchness, dark-blue, black, sleep, † causing sleep, transcending birth & victorious & causal emptiness & spiritual joy (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kbss_1-u.htm（全书共 6422 行）

verses.iast: prathamam atha sa kṛṣṇaḥ svāpa-līlā-vitṛṣṇaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 初，尔时、次复吉祥启白，彼、此尊（阳性主格），黑面，睡觉、梦想，戏剧、体育，解脱自在
verses.meaningEn: Prathamam, now, thereupon, auspiciously, he, that one, kṛṣṇaḥ, sleep, dream, play, sport, amusement, pastime, free from thirst or desire
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kbss_1-u.htm（全书共 6422 行）

verses.iast: athavā, saṃmohana-mantra-rūpakaṃ kāma-bījaṃ sakala-gopāla-mantrāṇāṃ bījam udāharati kaleti
verses.meaningZh: 尔时或，一样，真言、密咒（护心密语），钱币，希，种子，全部、圆满一切，放牛人，诸真言、密咒（护心密语）之，种子，净水请摄召，尊手瘟疫
verses.meaningEn: Now + or, the same, Mantra, sacred formula, figurative, wish, seed, entire, complete, all, cowherd, of Mantra, sacred formula, seed, water + bring! fetch! bestow! hand + plague
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：krdipc_u.htm（全书共 6508 行）

verses.iast: kṛṣṇa tvadīyapadapaṅkajapañjarāntar adyaiva me viśatu mānasarājahaṃsaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，真如实际·最上真言离言说·施度调伏，今日犹如，于我、为我，愿进入、趣行，心理·来诣·鹅
verses.meaningEn: Dark-blue, black, immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery, now + like, to me, my, may it enter, go in or into, sit or settle down on, sprung from the mind + coming from or belonging to goats
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kumukumu.htm（全书共 229 行）

verses.iast: ālasyaṃ vyapanīya bhaktisulabhaṃ dhyāyasva nārāyaṇaṃ lokasya vyasanāpanodanakaro dāsasya kiṃ na kṣamaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 懒惰，最上真言离言说·一乘如实之道·第一义谛，物流易得，怀念·出·自，那罗延，世间、世界之，入·除断·羯磨事业，奴仆之，迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·诸根清净自在·大空菩提点摄持），不、非、无，堪
verses.meaningEn: Ālasyaṃ, supreme ineffable speech & supreme vehicle of awakening & ultimate truth, distribution + easy to be obtained, think of + income + own, Narayana, of world, realm, moving hither and thither + removing + action, of foe, an evil demon or an infidel, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — purified faculties sealed with bodhicitta bindu, not, non-, enduring
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kumukumu.htm（全书共 229 行）

verses.iast: kṛṣṇaṃ lokaya locanadvaya harer gacchāṅghriyugmālayaṃ jighra ghrāṇa mukundapādatulasīṃ mūrdhan namādhokṣajam
verses.meaningZh: 深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，祈请世间、世界，眼二，唯愿救苦圣尊（诃利，去吧·尊足·双·藏，生起不可得·尊胜·破暗合集·清净离诸尘垢，鼻，无我大慈三昧·造作离相·离名相假立，顶，归命·下·散布·山羊
verses.meaningEn: Dark-blue, black, may You world, realm! eye + both, O Hari / Remover of Suffering! go! proceed! + foot + paired + alaya, transcending birth & victorious & dissolving dense ignorance & stainless purity free from dust, nose, selfless great loving-kindness & freedom from karmic agency & beyond nominal designation, head, homage + then + sprinkle + drift
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kumukumu.htm（全书共 229 行）

verses.iast: nānājñānam apāsya cetasi namo nārāyaṇāyety amuṃ mantraṃ sapraṇavaṃ praṇāmasahitaṃ prāvartayadhvaṃ muhuḥ
verses.meaningZh: 分别圣智，除此之外、度脱，相貌汝即是，归命，离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道，无我大慈三昧，真言，彼神圣，最敬一连，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，突然、赶快
verses.meaningEn: Differently + primordial wisdom, putting aside, in spite of, except, save, appearance + Thou art, homage to beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening, selfless great loving-kindness, mantraṃ, he + the sacred syllable Om, bow + connected, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, suddenly, at once
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kumukumu.htm（全书共 229 行）

verses.iast: tīrthānām avagāhanāni ca gajasnānaṃ vinā yatpada-dvandvāmbhoruhasaṃsmṛtīr vijayate devaḥ sa nārāyaṇaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 诸津之，鸿毛一切低胸以及象·沐·管保，远离、除却，凡所…者句，礼敬赞叹·忆念护持·施度调伏，最胜尊胜、普胜一切！天，彼、此尊（阳性主格），那罗延
verses.meaningEn: Of all a ford, down + plunging and elephant + to wash + assuredly, without, free from, whatever + word, venerating, remembering, supreme victory! triumph! devaḥ, he, that one, Narayana
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kumukumu.htm（全书共 229 行）

verses.iast: kṛṣṇo rakṣatu no jagattrayaguruḥ kṛṣṇaṃ namasyāmy ahaṃ kṛṣṇenāmaraśatravo vinihatāḥ kṛṣṇāya tasmai namaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 黑面，愿慈悲守护！我等、为我等，三界上师，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，归命敬礼·离名相假立，我、真我自性，深青黑·勇健·仙人·因缘·妙音，闢诸坏，向深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，向彼尊（为格），至心归命礼！
verses.meaningEn: Kṛṣṇo, may he/she protect! us, for us, our, the three worlds + lama, dark-blue, black, bowing, I, the awakened self, dark-blue + strong + immortal + cut in pieces + sound, settle, to/for dark-blue, black, to him, to that one, reverent homage!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kumukumu.htm（全书共 229 行）

verses.iast: kṛṣṇād eva samutthitaṃ jagad idaṃ kṛṣṇasya dāso 'smy ahaṃ kṛṣṇe tiṣṭhati sarvam etad akhilaṃ he kṛṣṇa saṃrakṣa mām
verses.meaningZh: 造作离相·六度满行清净·离诸诤论无诤，唯、正是、决定，高胜，生起不可得·尊胜·妙行趣入·施度调伏，此、此法门，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色之，奴仆，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），我、真我自性，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色尊，坐，一切、普皆遍满，此、此事，无硬度，呼唤圣尊叹词（咄！圣者！），深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，婆罗守护，我（宾格：守护
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās & conflict-free peace, indeed, verily, alone, risen, raised, high, transcending birth & victorious & awakened spiritual movement & generosity & self-mastery, this, here, of dark-blue, black, dāso, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, I, the awakened self, O dark-blue, black / in dark-blue, black, attaching, all, every, complete, this, non-hardness, O! Hail! Vocative invocation particle, dark-blue, black, guardian or guard, me
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kumukumu.htm（全书共 229 行）

verses.iast: śrīnātha nārāyaṇa vāsudeva śrīkṛṣṇa bhaktapriya cakrapāṇe
verses.meaningZh: 吉祥依，那罗延，财天子，吉祥深青黑，饼惜者，颤动·絮叨·命令尊
verses.meaningEn: Auspiciousness + refuge, Narayana, patr, auspiciousness + dark-blue, food + dear, tremble + chatter + O command
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kumukumu.htm（全书共 229 行）

verses.iast: śrīpadmanābhācyuta kaiṭabhāre śrīrāma padmākṣa hare murāre
verses.meaningZh: 吉祥·秋天·认为·光明庄严·没，明知岂止，吉祥罗摩，莲华眼目，唯愿救苦圣尊（诃利，恶鬼岂止
verses.meaningEn: Auspiciousness + fall + think + splendour + gone away, ritual science + far, auspiciousness + Rāma, lotus flower + eye, O Hari / Remover of Suffering! of a demon slain by Kṛṣṇa + far
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kumukumu.htm（全书共 229 行）

verses.iast: ananta vaikuṇṭha mukunda kṛṣṇa govinda dāmodara mādhaveti
verses.meaningZh: 无边，极微干脆，鼓音美，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，牯牛发现物，月份男人，第二瘟疫
verses.meaningEn: Boundless, particle emphasizing the preceding word or merely expletive + blunt, drum, dark-blue, black, bull + finding, of Viṣṇu-Kṛṣṇa, vernal + plague
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：kumukumu.htm（全书共 229 行）

verses.meaningEn: Homage to him, to that one, the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, dark-blue, thus, blunt, fat, O laughter!

verses.meaningEn: Dark-blue, black, color, hue, luminous appearance, magnetizing, haviNg limbs or a body + upanga + dart, attendant

verses.iast: idaṃ śrī-kṛṣṇa-tad-bhakta-sambandhād amṛtaṃ dvidhā

verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：laghbh_u.htm（全书共 2988 行）

verses.iast: tatra puruṣa-lakṣaṇaṃ, yathā śrī-viṣṇu-purāṇe
verses.meaningZh: 于彼处、其中，士夫，性相，犹如、如…所说，吉祥、圣德威光，遍入，先世尊
verses.meaningEn: There, therein, man, human being, male, person, individual of a generation, lakṣaṇaṃ, just as, according to, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, thousands with names containing prabha, and also containing Viṣṇu, O former, ancient, old
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：laghbh_u.htm（全书共 2988 行）

verses.iast: avāpa nārāyaṇa ādidevaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 鸿毛净水，那罗延，阿地提婆
verses.meaningEn: Down + water, Narayana, Adideva
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：laghbh_u.htm（全书共 2988 行）

verses.iast: nārāyaṇaḥ sa bhagavān āpas tasmāt sanātanāt
verses.meaningZh: 那罗延，彼、此尊（阳性主格），世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，第一义谛·一切诸谛圆满，是故、因此、从彼，从不动
verses.meaningEn: Narayana, he, that one, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, ultimate truth & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, therefore, from that, from eternal, everlasting
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：laghbh_u.htm（全书共 2988 行）

verses.iast: viṣṇur brahmā ca rudraś ca sthiti-sargādi-karmaṇe
verses.meaningZh: 遍入，梵王以及清净离诸尘垢·施度调伏·本性寂静止息以及住，分品类元，羯磨事业称计粒子尊
verses.meaningEn: Viṣṇur, Brahma and stainless purity free from dust & generosity & self-mastery & primordial tranquil peace and standing, stopping, staying, remaining in or with, shot + beginning, action + O a measure of grain
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：laghbh_u.htm（全书共 2988 行）

verses.iast: rudra ekādaśa-vyūhas tathāṣṭatanur apy asau
verses.meaningZh: 紧恶，十一，最上真言离言说·一乘如实之道·因缘空寂大乐，如是·八·薄，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），那个
verses.meaningEn: Of gods, the eleventh, supreme ineffable speech & supreme vehicle of awakening & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, thus + eight + thin, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, yonder, that, one so and so
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：laghbh_u.htm（全书共 2988 行）

verses.iast: kālāgni-rudraḥ kalpānte bhavet saṅkarṣaṇād api
verses.meaningZh: 时圣火，紧恶，究竟劫波尊，当得成就、若成，钩召摄受·一切诸谛圆满，亦、虽、乃至
verses.meaningEn: Black + fire, rudraḥ, O the end of a Kalpa, destruction of the world / in the end of a Kalpa, destruction of the world, may be, would become, drawing in, even, also
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：laghbh_u.htm（全书共 2988 行）

verses.iast: śrī-viṣṇuḥ, yathā śrī-tṛtīye
verses.meaningZh: 吉祥、圣德威光，遍入，犹如、如…所说，吉祥、圣德威光，第三尊
verses.meaningEn: Auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, viṣṇuḥ, just as, according to, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, O the third
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：laghbh_u.htm（全书共 2988 行）

verses.iast: tal loka-padmaṃ sa u eva viṣṇuḥ
verses.meaningZh: 攞字门（离一切相无相（lakṣaṇa）·本不生体性），世间、世界，壤，彼、此尊（阳性主格），悉昙「u」韵字门：损减除灭忧苦，唯、正是、决定，遍入
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from conditioned marks (lakṣaṇa) — primordial non-arising, world, realm, padmaṃ, he, that one, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'u': dispelling sorrow, indeed, verily, alone, viṣṇuḥ
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：laghbh_u.htm（全书共 2988 行）

verses.iast: yo viṣṇuḥ paṭhyate so'sau kṣīrāmbudhiśayo mataḥ
verses.meaningZh: 凡彼圣尊、能…者，遍入，读诵拘牵尊，一切诸谛圆满，乳·大海·睡，由摩
verses.meaningEn: Who, whichever, viṣṇuḥ, read aloud + O held, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (imperative seal), milk + the ocean + sleep, from ma
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：laghbh_u.htm（全书共 2988 行）

verses.iast: viṣṇu-dharmottarādy-uktā yāḥ pūryo'jāṇḍa-madhyataḥ
verses.meaningZh: 遍入，持守摄受·法界总持任持，曰，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·远离寂静周遍·涅槃除障点证入），圆满充盈·第一义谛，由中
verses.meaningEn: Thousands with names containing prabha, and also containing Viṣṇu, bearing, said, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — expansive quiescence with nirvāṇic visarga release, fulfilling, from neutral, impartial
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：laghbh_u.htm（全书共 2988 行）

verses.iast: santi viṣṇu-prakāśānāṃ tāḥ kathyante samāsataḥ
verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·离名相假立·真如实际，遍入，诸光明之，多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·远离寂静周遍·涅槃除障点证入），造作离相·无住安立·一乘如实之道，略集
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), thousands with names containing prabha, and also containing Viṣṇu, of all light, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — expansive quiescence with nirvāṇic visarga release, freedom from karmic agency & non-abiding equipoise & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation), samāsataḥ
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：laghbh_u.htm（全书共 2988 行）

verses.iast: agamyaḥ sarva-lokānāṃ viṣṇu-lokaḥ prakīrtitaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 难于接近、费解，一切、普皆遍满，诸世间、世界之，遍入，世间、世界，由嘉许、赞叹
verses.meaningEn: Inaccessible, unintelligible, all, every, complete, of all world, realm, thousands with names containing prabha, and also containing Viṣṇu, world, realm, from commendation, praise
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：laghbh_u.htm（全书共 2988 行）

verses.iast: kiṃ ca viṣṇu-purāṇādau mokṣa-dharme ca kīrtitam
verses.meaningZh: 迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·诸根清净自在·大空菩提点摄持）以及遍入，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤，解脱、自在离缚，正法、诸法实相尊以及誉彼
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — purified faculties sealed with bodhicitta bindu and thousands with names containing prabha, and also containing Viṣṇu, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace (imperative seal), liberation, emancipation, O Dharma, cosmic truth/teaching/phenomena / in Dharma, cosmic truth/teaching/phenomena and renown + him
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：laghbh_u.htm（全书共 2988 行）

verses.iast: viṣṇuḥ sattvaṃ tanotīti śāstre sattva-tanuṃ smṛtaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 遍入，心力，裔胄·正勤·如是，论，有情、众生、勇猛心，薄，由忆持、回首
verses.meaningEn: Viṣṇuḥ, sattvaṃ, offspring + effort + thus, O instruction, precept, rule, theory, a scientific or canonical work / in instruction, precept, rule, theory, a scientific or canonical work, sentient being, living creature, courage, thin, from remember
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：laghbh_u.htm（全书共 2988 行）

verses.iast: siddhānte punar eka eva bhagavān viṣṇuḥ samastāgama
verses.meaningZh: 成究竟，复次、再三，一、唯一不二，唯、正是、决定，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，遍入，广收传
verses.meaningEn: O established end or truth, dogma, axiom / in established end or truth, dogma, axiom, again, furthermore, one, single, non-dual, indeed, verily, alone, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, viṣṇuḥ, joined + traditional
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：laghbh_u.htm（全书共 2988 行）

verses.iast: nārāyaṇa-kalāḥ śāntā bhajanti hy anasūyavaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 那罗延，诸尊手，寂静、调柔安稳，诸尊做买卖往外、分摊，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），离名相假立·一切诸谛圆满·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Narayana, hand, peaceful, calm, tranquil, they deal out, apportion, dispense, distribute , share, divide, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, beyond nominal designation & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme vehicle of awakening
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：laghbh_u.htm（全书共 2988 行）

verses.iast: viṣṇu-dharmottare tv etat mārkaṇḍeyena bhāṣitam
verses.meaningZh: 遍入，胜法，嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk，真如实际，以座儿、古老圣仙，妙语、语言
verses.meaningEn: Thousands with names containing prabha, and also containing Viṣṇu, dharmottare, supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — primordial non-arising, immutable Suchness, by/through patron, spoken, told, uttered
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：laghbh_u.htm（全书共 2988 行）

verses.iast: matsya-rūpa-dharo viṣṇuḥ śṛṅgī bhūtvā jagat-patiḥ
verses.meaningZh: 鱼，色、妙色身，请执持、总持护念！遍入，角佛母，昂已，动人、活着，君
verses.meaningEn: Fish, form, matter, sacred body, hold! bear! sustain! viṣṇuḥ, horn , tusk of an elephant, syringe, peak of a mountain, turret of a temple or palace (feminine), having arise, moving, alive, prince
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：laghbh_u.htm（全书共 2988 行）

verses.iast: viṣṇu-dharmottarāj jñeyāḥ prādurbhāvāś caturdaśa
verses.meaningZh: 遍入，持守摄受·法界总持任持，诸乃是已知、创建往外，现·光净·下贱，十四
verses.meaningEn: Thousands with names containing prabha, and also containing Viṣṇu, bearing, to be known, understood, learnt, found out, to manifest + be bright + bleat, the fourteenth, consisting of fourteen
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：laghbh_u.htm（全书共 2988 行）

verses.iast: varaṃ dattvānasūyāyai viṣṇuḥ sarva-jaganmayaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 殊胜、胜愿、妙好，施度调伏·真如实际·最上真言离言说，遍入，一切、普皆遍满，生起不可得·尊胜·妙行趣入·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Choicest, supreme boon, excellent, generosity & self-mastery & immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation), viṣṇuḥ, all, every, complete, transcending birth & victorious & awakened spiritual movement & beyond nominal designation
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：laghbh_u.htm（全书共 2988 行）

verses.iast: ato viṣṇu-purāṇādau viśeṣeṇaiva varṇitaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 以此、次复，遍入，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤，最上真言离言说·本性寂静止息·六度满行清净，呪
verses.meaningEn: Hence, afterwards, then, from now, thousands with names containing prabha, and also containing Viṣṇu, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace (imperative seal), supreme ineffable speech & primordial tranquil peace & perfection of the six pāramitās, varṇitaḥ
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：laghbh_u.htm（全书共 2988 行）

verses.iast: kṛṣṇa-dvaipāyanaṃ vyāsaṃ viddhi nārāyaṇaṃ svayam
verses.meaningZh: 深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，来诣趣往，广大，打击、弄伤尊，那罗延，亲自、自性显现
verses.meaningEn: Dark-blue, black, being in or coming from an island + going, separation, division, O pierced, hit, wounded, hurt, Narayana, oneself, spontaneously, in person
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：laghbh_u.htm（全书共 2988 行）

verses.iast: atha śrī-rāma-kṛṣṇau
verses.meaningZh: 尔时、次复吉祥启白，吉祥、圣德威光，罗摩，造作离相·六度满行清净·离诸诤论无诤
verses.meaningEn: Now, thereupon, auspiciously, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, Rāma, freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās & conflict-free peace (imperative seal)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：laghbh_u.htm（全书共 2988 行）

verses.iast: śrī-prathame
verses.meaningZh: 吉祥、圣德威光，初尊
verses.meaningEn: Auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, O first, primal, foremost, earliest, principal, best, chief
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：laghbh_u.htm（全书共 2988 行）

verses.iast: rāma-kṛṣṇāv iti bhuvo bhagavān aharad bharam
verses.meaningZh: 罗摩，造作离相·六度满行清净·离诸诤论无诤，如是（结句印定），空界（中空生命气息），世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，因缘空寂大乐·清净离诸尘垢·施度调伏，方位、战斗
verses.meaningEn: Rāma, freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās & conflict-free peace, thus, so it is stated, Atmosphere realm (Bhuvar-loka), the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & stainless purity free from dust & generosity & self-mastery, bearing, carrying
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：laghbh_u.htm（全书共 2988 行）

verses.iast: śrī-rāmaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 吉祥、圣德威光，罗摩
verses.meaningEn: Auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, Rāma
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：laghbh_u.htm（全书共 2988 行）

verses.iast: saṅkarṣaṇo dvitīyo yo vyūhaḥ rāmaḥ sa eva hi
verses.meaningZh: 钩召摄受·一切诸谛圆满，第二，凡彼圣尊、能…者，庄严，罗摩，彼、此尊（阳性主格），唯、正是、决定，诚然、因为、实乃
verses.meaningEn: Drawing in, second, secondly, for the second time, who, whichever, vyūhaḥ, Rāma, he, that one, indeed, verily, alone, for, indeed, surely
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：laghbh_u.htm（全书共 2988 行）

verses.iast: śrī-kṛṣṇaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 吉祥、圣德威光，黑面
verses.meaningEn: Auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, kṛṣṇaḥ
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：laghbh_u.htm（全书共 2988 行）

verses.iast: janitā viṣṇu-yaśaso nāmnā kalkir jagat-patiḥ
verses.meaningZh: 诸人、那罗，遍入，一乘如实之道·本性寂静止息·一切诸谛圆满，离名相假立·无我大慈三昧，未来世，动人、活着，君
verses.meaningEn: People, thousands with names containing prabha, and also containing Viṣṇu, supreme vehicle of awakening & primordial tranquil peace & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, beyond nominal designation & selfless great loving-kindness, of a future liberator of the world, moving, alive, prince
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：laghbh_u.htm（全书共 2988 行）

verses.iast: bhāvī viṣṇu-yaśās cāyam iti pādme prakīrtitam
verses.meaningZh: 出，遍入，一乘如实之道·本性寂静止息·一切诸谛圆满，怖畏、供养，如是（结句印定），尊足于我，嘉许彼
verses.meaningEn: Bhāvī, thousands with names containing prabha, and also containing Viṣṇu, supreme vehicle of awakening & primordial tranquil peace & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, fear, worship, revere, thus, so it is stated, foot + to me, commendation + him
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：laghbh_u.htm（全书共 2988 行）

verses.iast: dvādaśe rudra-sāvarṇanīye sudhāmā
verses.meaningZh: 十二尊，紧恶，一切诸谛圆满·最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢，石灰勿
verses.meaningEn: O the twelfth, consisting of twelve, of gods, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), welfare + do not
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：laghbh_u.htm（全书共 2988 行）

verses.iast: tathā hi śrī-viṣṇu-dharmottare śrī-rudra-praśnaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 如是、亦复如是，诚然、因为、实乃，吉祥、圣德威光，遍入，胜法，吉祥、圣德威光，紧恶，请问、需要
verses.meaningEn: Thus, in that same way, for, indeed, surely, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, thousands with names containing prabha, and also containing Viṣṇu, dharmottare, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, of gods, question, demand, inquiry, controversy
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：laghbh_u.htm（全书共 2988 行）

verses.iast: yavīyāṃsam ahaṃ premnā kṛṣṇaṃ praśyāmi nārada
verses.meaningZh: 一乘如实之道·最上真言离言说·一切诸谛圆满，我、真我自性，喜爱、恩爱，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，转载青黑尊，人与子
verses.meaningEn: Supreme vehicle of awakening & supreme ineffable speech & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, I, the awakened self, love, affection, dark-blue, black, forward + O black, or of myth
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：laghbh_u.htm（全书共 2988 行）

verses.iast: dvāparānte karma-bhūtau āyātau kṛṣṇa-phālgunau
verses.meaningZh: 二最后究竟，事，破有相福德光·真如实际，一乘如实之道·真如实际，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，妙果圆成·离一切相无相·妙行趣入
verses.meaningEn: Two + O the final end, actions, blessedness transcending existence & immutable Suchness (imperative seal), supreme vehicle of awakening & immutable Suchness (imperative seal), dark-blue, black, fruition of enlightenment & freedom from conditioned marks & awakened spiritual movement (imperative seal)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：laghbh_u.htm（全书共 2988 行）

verses.iast: nṛsiṃha-rāma-kṛṣṇeṣu ṣāḍguṇyaṃ paripūritam
verses.meaningZh: 广大，罗摩，于诸深青黑、威猛黑蓝色中，六度满行清净·息灭诤怨·妙行趣入，成就彼
verses.meaningEn: Man-lion, a great hero or Viṣṇu, Rāma, among/in dark-blue, black, perfection of the six pāramitās & pacifying conflict & turmoil & awakened spiritual movement, filling up + him
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：laghbh_u.htm（全书共 2988 行）

verses.iast: vāgīśā yasya vadane lakṣmīr yasya ca vakṣasi
verses.meaningZh: 最上真言离言说·妙行趣入·本性寂静止息，凡彼…之，演说、水深尊，吉祥相，凡彼…之以及因缘汝即是
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & awakened spiritual movement & primordial tranquil peace, whose, of whom, O speaking, sounding, lakṣmīr, whose, of whom and cause to grow or increase + Thou art
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：laghbh_u.htm（全书共 2988 行）

verses.iast: viṣṇu-dharmottare rāma-lakṣmaṇādyāḥ kramādamī
verses.meaningZh: 遍入，胜法，罗摩，相好标帜·称计粒子·元之，造作离相·清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧
verses.meaningEn: Thousands with names containing prabha, and also containing Viṣṇu, dharmottare, Rāma, mark + a measure of grain + of beginning, freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust & selfless great loving-kindness

verses.iast: jagan-mohana-līlāya namo gopendra-sūnave
verses.meaningZh: 生起不可得·尊胜·妙行趣入·离名相假立，作昏，向戏剧、体育，归命，上首牧民，向佛子、裔胄
verses.meaningEn: Transcending birth & victorious & awakened spiritual movement & beyond nominal designation, stupefying, perplexing, deceiving, to/for play, sport, amusement, pastime, homage to chief herdsman, of Kṛṣṇa, to son, offspring
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：muktacau.htm（全书共 2800 行）

verses.iast: ekadā kiñcin-mātra-śruta-pūrva-vṛttāntayā satyabhāmayā kṛṣṇaḥ sākūtaṃ pṛṣṭaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 赶快、同时，造作离相·圣智通达·妙行迁变空，惟，闻，本，以报道、故事，以谛光明，黑面，成心、重大，背
verses.meaningEn: At once, at the same time, sometimes, at a certain time = once upon a time, freedom from karmic agency & non-dual wisdom awareness & awakened conduct beyond flux, merely, heard, former, with/by occurrence, adventures, truth + with, kṛṣṇaḥ, intentional, significant, asked, questioned, that which is asked or inquired after
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：muktacau.htm（全书共 2800 行）

verses.iast: tatas tad-vṛttānta-smaraṇāt kṛṣṇaḥ svāntar-glānir bahir vihasyāha
verses.meaningZh: 次，彼、如是真实，报道、故事，从记忆、传统，黑面，王国刹土、心髓，妙行趣入·离一切相无相·离名相假立，外方，最上真言离言说·因缘空寂大乐·一切诸谛圆满
verses.meaningEn: Secondary, that, thus, occurrence, adventures, from remembrance, memory, tradition, kṛṣṇaḥ, one's own end or death, kingdom or country, awakened spiritual movement & freedom from conditioned marks & beyond nominal designation, outside, supreme ineffable speech & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：muktacau.htm（全书共 2800 行）

verses.iast: kṛṣṇaḥ punar āha
verses.meaningZh: 黑面，复次、再三，如是宣说、佛言
verses.meaningEn: Kṛṣṇaḥ, again, furthermore, spoke, declared thus
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：muktacau.htm（全书共 2800 行）

verses.iast: ekadā kārttike māsi gokule govardhana-girau
verses.meaningZh: 赶快、同时，造作离相·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，月尊，牯牛部族尊，宝山笔者，妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: At once, at the same time, sometimes, at a certain time = once upon a time, freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), O moon , month, bull + O buddha-family, of a mountain and an author, awakened spiritual movement & stainless purity free from dust (imperative seal)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：muktacau.htm（全书共 2800 行）

verses.iast: tato lalitā sarvāsāṃ mauktikāni punaḥ punaś cālayantī bhūyaḥ prāha
verses.meaningZh: 次，连续，湖居，一切企求解脱、真珠，复次、再三，第一义谛·离名相假立·本性寂静止息，妙行迁变空·离一切相无相·一乘如实之道，又么，转载如是宣说
verses.meaningEn: Secondary, lalitā, a lake + dwell, desirous of emancipation, again, furthermore, ultimate truth & beyond nominal designation & primordial tranquil peace, awakened conduct beyond flux & freedom from conditioned marks & supreme vehicle of awakening, bhūyaḥ, forward + spoke
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：muktacau.htm（全书共 2800 行）

verses.meaningZh: 呼唤圣尊叹词（咄！圣者！），深青黑、威猛黑蓝色

verses.meaningEn: There + daily, dark-blue, black, talk (plural), forward + moving + Tārā root seed syllable Tāṃ
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ruphbr_u.htm（全书共 8999 行）

verses.iast: atha śri-kṛṣṇa-tad-bhakta-prasādajaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 尔时、次复吉祥启白，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·诸根清净自在），深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，彼、如是真实，饼，淳金刚钩召摄引入坛种子
verses.meaningEn: Now, thereupon, auspiciously, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — purified faculties, dark-blue, black, that, thus, food, pure + Vajra-hook summoning seed syllable
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ruphbr_u.htm（全书共 8999 行）

verses.iast: sa bhāvaḥ kṛṣṇa-tad-bhakta-prasādaja itīyate
verses.meaningZh: 彼、此尊（阳性主格），物，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，彼、如是真实，饼，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·一切诸谛圆满，向如是此处汝
verses.meaningEn: He, that one, bhāvaḥ, dark-blue, black, that, thus, food, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, thus + to Thee
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ruphbr_u.htm（全书共 8999 行）

verses.iast: atha śrī-kṛṣṇa-prasādajaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 尔时、次复吉祥启白，吉祥、圣德威光，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，淳金刚钩召摄引入坛种子
verses.meaningEn: Now, thereupon, auspiciously, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, dark-blue, black, pure + Vajra-hook summoning seed syllable
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ruphbr_u.htm（全书共 8999 行）

verses.iast: adṛṣṭa-pūrvam ālokya kṛṣṇaṃ jāṅgala-vāsinaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 隐形、意料之外，元，离一切相无相·造作离相·一乘如实之道，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，沙石山野所在，香水、喷香
verses.meaningEn: Unseen, invisible, unforeseen, unexpected, first, freedom from conditioned marks & freedom from karmic agency & supreme vehicle of awakening, dark-blue, black, arid, level, fertile, perfume
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ruphbr_u.htm（全书共 8999 行）

verses.iast: vinopāyair upeyābhūd viṣṇu-bhaktir ihoditā
verses.meaningZh: 最上真言离言说·离名相假立·第一义谛，第一义谛·一乘如实之道·破有相福德光，遍入，物流、瓜分，于此演
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & beyond nominal designation & ultimate truth, ultimate truth & supreme vehicle of awakening & blessedness transcending existence, thousands with names containing prabha, and also containing Viṣṇu, distribution, partition, division, portion, share, here + to expound
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ruphbr_u.htm（全书共 8999 行）

verses.iast: daśatv alaṃ gāyata viṣṇu-gāthāḥ
verses.meaningZh: 施度调伏·本性寂静止息·真如实际，严，妙行趣入·一乘如实之道·真如实际，遍入，诸孤起
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery & primordial tranquil peace & immutable Suchness, enough, one's fill, awakened spiritual movement & supreme vehicle of awakening & immutable Suchness, thousands with names containing prabha, and also containing Viṣṇu, gatha
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ruphbr_u.htm（全书共 8999 行）

verses.iast: atha kṛṣṇa-karṇāmṛte
verses.meaningZh: 尔时、次复吉祥启白，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，耳根甘露
verses.meaningEn: Now, thereupon, auspiciously, dark-blue, black, ear + O ambrosia
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ruphbr_u.htm（全书共 8999 行）

verses.iast: tad-guṇākhyāne āsāktiḥ, yathā kṛṣṇa-karṇāmṛte
verses.meaningZh: 彼、如是真实，功德古语尊，一切诸谛圆满·造作离相·真如实际，犹如、如…所说，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，耳根甘露
verses.meaningEn: That, thus, virtue + O telling, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness, just as, according to, dark-blue, black, ear + O ambrosia
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ruphbr_u.htm（全书共 8999 行）

verses.iast: bhāvo 'py abhāvam āyāti kṛṣṇa-preṣṭhāparādhataḥ
verses.meaningZh: 物，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），无物，那罗，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，非常愉快由罪
verses.meaningEn: Bhāvo, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, not being, non-existence, absence, want, failure, destruction, death, of a man, dark-blue, black, most dear or beloved + from the same
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ruphbr_u.htm（全书共 8999 行）

verses.iast: yaḥ prathīyān bhaved bhāvaḥ sa tu kṛṣṇa-prasādajaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 凡彼…者，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·无住安立，破有相福德光·最上真言离言说·施度调伏，物，彼、此尊（阳性主格），然而、而、实则，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，淳金刚钩召摄引入坛种子
verses.meaningEn: Whoever, he who, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & non-abiding equipoise, blessedness transcending existence & supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery, bhāvaḥ, he, that one, but, indeed, moreover, dark-blue, black, pure + Vajra-hook summoning seed syllable
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ruphbr_u.htm（全书共 8999 行）

verses.iast: śrī-kṛṣṇa-gāthāṃ gāyantī romāṇcodbheda-lakṣaṇā
verses.meaningZh: 吉祥、圣德威光，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，讽颂，妙行趣入·一乘如实之道·离名相假立，清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧·离诸诤论无诤，相、妙相标帜
verses.meaningEn: Auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, dark-blue, black, gatha, awakened spiritual movement & supreme vehicle of awakening & beyond nominal designation, stainless purity free from dust & selfless great loving-kindness & conflict-free peace, mark, auspicious sign, characteristic
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ruphbr_u.htm（全书共 8999 行）

verses.iast: asmin-manvantare snigdhā śrī-kṛṣṇa-priya-vartayā
verses.meaningZh: 于此之中，认为·一样·弯曲，柔软，吉祥、圣德威光，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，惜者，以幅度彼
verses.meaningEn: In this, think + te + O crossing, snigdhā, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, dark-blue, black, dear, valued, pleasing to, beloved of, one's own, width
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ruphbr_u.htm（全书共 8999 行）

verses.iast: abhisandhi-vinirmuktā bhaktir-viṣṇu-vaśaṅkarī
verses.meaningZh: 融通指，最上真言离言说·离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢，物流、瓜分，遍入，能作成办·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: To, supreme ineffable speech & beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust, distribution, partition, division, portion, share, thousands with names containing prabha, and also containing Viṣṇu, making
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ruphbr_u.htm（全书共 8999 行）

verses.iast: eṣā kṛṣṇa-ratiḥ sthāyī bhāvo bhakti-raso bhavet
verses.meaningZh: 此等，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，嬉，保佛母，物，物流、瓜分，味，当得成就、若成
verses.meaningEn: They, dark-blue, black, pleasure, persevering (feminine), bhāvo, distribution, partition, division, portion, share, raso, may be, would become
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ruphbr_u.htm（全书共 8999 行）

verses.iast: RBhrs RBhrs,1.5
verses.meaningZh: 再三娑字门（一切诸谛圆满（sarvasatya）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness (satya) — primordial non-arising again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ruphbr_u.htm（全书共 8999 行）

verses.iast: ye kṛṣṇa-bhakta-muralī-nādādyā hetavo rateḥ
verses.meaningZh: 凡彼等诸有情，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，饼，捕捞、诸人佛母，茎干饭食，因缘空寂大乐·真如实际·最上真言离言说，嬉之
verses.meaningEn: Those who, whoever (pl.), dark-blue, black, food, a fish, stalk + eatable, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech, of pleasure
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ruphbr_u.htm（全书共 8999 行）

verses.iast: kṛṣṇaś ca kṛṣṇa-bhaktāś ca budhair ālambanā matāḥ
verses.meaningZh: 造作离相·六度满行清净·离诸诤论无诤以及深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，破有相福德光·造作离相·真如实际以及解脱系缚大力·法界总持任持·清净离诸尘垢，所縁，诸理趣
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās & conflict-free peace and dark-blue, black, blessedness transcending existence & freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness and spiritual strength freeing bonds & Dharma-realm retention & stainless purity free from dust, object of meditation, thought, believed, supposed
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ruphbr_u.htm（全书共 8999 行）

verses.iast: śrīmat-kṛṣṇa-kavīndreṇa kṛpayā prakaṭīkṛtam
verses.meaningZh: 吉祥庄严·本性寂静止息，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，以作文者因陀逻，以慈悲，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·造作离相

verses.iast: mantra-mayyāṃ samāsena sevā kiñcid vilikhyate

verses.meaningEn: Mantra, sacred formula, of a Brahman, by/through time, occasion, juncture, visit, service, attendance, worship, devotion to, use, practice, employment, freedom from karmic agency & non-dual wisdom awareness & awakened conduct beyond flux, settle + scratch + O held

verses.iast: sva-sevā samarpitā
