verses.meaningZh: 走道那么、游方，一切诸入，作，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，妙行迁变空·一乘如实之道·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Walk about, wander, run, all + of descent, kāraṇaṃ, dark-blue, black, awakened conduct beyond flux & supreme vehicle of awakening & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：satvtanu.htm（全书共 1571 行）

verses.iast: jñātvāpi sarvagaṃ viṣṇuṃ tāratamyena prītimān
verses.meaningZh: 觉知·长柄·善友，趣往一切处、圆通，遍入，以分齐、比重，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Know + stem + friend, going everywhere, all-pervading, omnipresent, universal, thousands with names containing prabha, and also containing Viṣṇu, by/through the being more or less, difference, gradation, proportion, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：satvtanu.htm（全书共 1571 行）

verses.iast: gogopavanitāmunivṛndajuṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ purāṇapuruṣaṃ manasā smarāmi
verses.meaningZh: 牯牛·牧牛·小老婆·牟尼·聚群·说得过去，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，先世补卢衫，那罗、天女，我祈请忆念本誓
verses.meaningEn: Bull + cow-keeper + mistress + Muni + heap + acceptable, dark-blue, black, former + man, of man, of a goddess, =, I remember Your primordial vow!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：satvtanu.htm（全书共 1571 行）

verses.iast: oṃ namo vāsudevāya kṛṣṇāya paramātmane
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，向财天子，向深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，自性世界自然
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to/for patr, to/for dark-blue, black, the supreme spirit + O certainly
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：satvtanu.htm（全书共 1571 行）

verses.iast: oṃ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ śrīpatiḥ śrīmān śrīdharaḥ śrīsukhāśrayaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！吉祥黑面，吉祥君，清癯本刹，吉祥请执持，吉祥·乐·依止
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! auspiciousness, auspiciousness + prince, lean + this, auspiciousness + hold! bear! sustain! auspiciousness + easy + to depend upon
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：satvtanu.htm（全书共 1571 行）

verses.iast: vidyāpatir vittapatiḥ satpatiḥ kamalāpatiḥ
verses.meaningZh: 明咒君，一样，勇健，造作离相·无我大慈三昧·离一切相无相
verses.meaningEn: Vidyā + prince, the same, strong chief or hero, freedom from karmic agency & selfless great loving-kindness & freedom from conditioned marks
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：satvtanu.htm（全书共 1571 行）

verses.iast: āyurvedakaro vaidyarājo vidyāpradāyakaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 作明对羯磨事业，医生来诣，明咒施予
verses.meaningEn: The science of health + action, coming from or belonging to goats, Vidyā + giving
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：satvtanu.htm（全书共 1571 行）

verses.iast: kālīyadarpadalano nāganārīnutipriyaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 造作离相·离一切相无相·一乘如实之道，龙族·女人·赞叹·惜者
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks & supreme vehicle of awakening, Nāga + woman + praise
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：satvtanu.htm（全书共 1571 行）

verses.iast: śritasāṃdīpanigurur vidyāsāgarapāragaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，明咒·大海·弯曲以上
verses.meaningEn: Primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, Vidyā + ocean + crossing over
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：satvtanu.htm（全书共 1571 行）

verses.iast: viṣṇuḥ sarvajagatpātā śāntaḥ śuddhaḥ sanātanaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 遍入，一切·动人·陨，静，清净、纯洁无染，不动
verses.meaningEn: Viṣṇuḥ, all + moving + fall, śāntaḥ, pure, cleansed, bright, sanātanaḥ
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：satvtanu.htm（全书共 1571 行）

verses.iast: taraty addhā prapadye taṃ kṛṣṇaṃ gopālarūpiṇam
verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道，的确、如实，转载造偈句尊，彼（宾格），深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，守护养育·妙行趣入
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening, indeed, truly, forward + O way, him, that, dark-blue, black, guarding
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：satvtanu.htm（全书共 1571 行）

verses.iast: śaraṇaṃ me jagannāthaḥ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ puruṣottamaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 归依，于我、为我，世主、神明男人，吉祥黑面，士夫最上
verses.meaningEn: Śaraṇaṃ, to me, my, lord of the world, of gods men, auspiciousness, man
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：satvtanu.htm（全书共 1571 行）

verses.iast: ekam eva yajet kṛṣṇaṃ sarvadevamayaṃ dhiyā
verses.meaningZh: 一，唯、正是、决定，一乘如实之道·生起不可得·尊胜·真如实际，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，一切施·犹如·过去，法界总持任持·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Ekam, indeed, verily, alone, supreme vehicle of awakening & transcending birth & victorious & immutable Suchness, dark-blue, black, one who gives everything + like + made or consisting of, Dharma-realm retention & supreme vehicle of awakening
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：satvtanu.htm（全书共 1571 行）

verses.iast: gṛhāśramī viṣṇubhaktaḥ kuryāt kṛṣṇaṃ dhiyā smaran
verses.meaningZh: 次第居士佛母，遍入饼，成办作持·造作离相，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，法界总持任持·一乘如实之道，矣喜滋滋
verses.meaningEn: The order of the householder (feminine), thousands with names containing prabha + food, enacting, dark-blue, black, Dharma-realm retention & supreme vehicle of awakening, particle to express certainty + be pleased
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：satvtanu.htm（全书共 1571 行）

verses.iast: kalatraputramitrādīn hitvā kṛṣṇaṃ samāśritāḥ
verses.meaningZh: 造作离相·离一切相无相·真如实际，丢下，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，诸忠诚
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks & immutable Suchness, leaving alone, neglecting, dark-blue, black, leaning or resting on, resorted to, entered or being in , got to, arrived at
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：satvtanu.htm（全书共 1571 行）

verses.iast: sāpi lakṣmīr yac caraṇaṃ sevate tadanādṛtā
verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·第一义谛，吉祥相，左字门（妙行迁变空（caryā）·本不生体性），杂罗南，住宿截至、出没，彼不是尊贵
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & ultimate truth (vocative invocation), lakṣmīr, awakened conduct beyond flux (caryā) — primordial non-arising, caraṇaṃ, stay by , inhabit, frequent, visit, that + not respected
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：satvtanu.htm（全书共 1571 行）

verses.iast: tato 'dhiko 'sti ko devo lakṣmīkāntāj janārdanāt
verses.meaningZh: 次，过度、特殊，有、真实安住，迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·摄受法流灌顶），天，离一切相无相·造作离相·六度满行清净，生起不可得·尊胜·离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Secondary, exceeding, extraordinary, is, truly exists, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — consecrating Dharma-stream, devo, freedom from conditioned marks & freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās, transcending birth & victorious & beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：satvtanu.htm（全书共 1571 行）

verses.iast: tatsaṅgenaiva puruṣo viṣṇuṃ prāpnoti niścitam
verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·一切诸谛圆满·支分寂静，男子，遍入，得究竟，入定事物、入定
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & quiescence of perceptual limbs, puruṣo, thousands with names containing prabha, and also containing Viṣṇu, attain, having settled a thing, resolved upon, sure of
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：satvtanu.htm（全书共 1571 行）

verses.iast: tair āgamair mandadhiyā hitvā kṛṣṇaṃ jagadgurum
verses.meaningZh: 啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·大自在威德统摄），趣入通行·妙行趣入，施予饶益·无我大慈三昧，丢下，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，慈父世间、神明
verses.meaningEn: Stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — sovereign spiritual mastery, going toward, granting, leaving alone, neglecting, dark-blue, black, father of the world, of gods
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：satvtanu.htm（全书共 1571 行）

verses.iast: oṃ namo 'stu kṛṣṇāya vikuṇṭhavedhase tvatpādalīlāśrayajīvabandhave
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，愿得成就、当如是，向深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，尖锐·圣智·笑声尊，长寿护命·结界系缚·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to may it be so, let it be! to/for dark-blue, black, sharp + knowledge + O laughter, vitalizing, binding obstacles (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：satvtanu.htm（全书共 1571 行）

verses.iast: kṛṣṇāya nānātanum īyuṣe same kṛtānurāgāya namo namas te
verses.meaningZh: 向深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，分别薄，一乘如实之道·六度满行清净，平尊，向所作恩爱，归命，归命，向汝、彼等
verses.meaningEn: To/for dark-blue, black, differently + thin, supreme vehicle of awakening & perfection of the six pāramitās (vocative invocation), O equal, done + to, homage to homage to to Thee / they
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：satvtanu.htm（全书共 1571 行）

verses.iast: mahānubhāvāya nirañjanāya nityātmalābhāya namo namas te
verses.meaningZh: 向乐趣体面，向廉洁，向常我衰，归命，归命，向汝、彼等
verses.meaningEn: Gladden + to, to/for without unguent or paint, deceitless, honest, with constantly internal mind fixing your will on salvation + self + to, homage to homage to to Thee / they
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：satvtanu.htm（全书共 1571 行）

verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：sdahennu.htm（全书共 4607 行）

verses.iast: ! ! DHN 160 om. vaikhānasasūtraśāstrayoḥ
verses.meaningZh: 曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·本不生体性），嗡（三身总持圣音）！最上真言离言说·等虚空无碍·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation (nāma) — primordial non-arising, Oṃ! supreme ineffable speech & space-like boundlessness & beyond nominal designation
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：sdahennu.htm（全书共 4607 行）

verses.iast: hārītasmṛtau: "pūrvaṃ vikhanaso viṣṇuḥ proktavān svayam acyutaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 忆念护持·因缘空寂大乐，元，最上真言离言说·等虚空无碍·离名相假立，遍入，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·造作离相，亲自、自性显现，坚固
verses.meaningEn: Remembering (imperative seal), first, supreme ineffable speech & space-like boundlessness & beyond nominal designation, viṣṇuḥ, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & freedom from karmic agency, oneself, spontaneously, in person, unshaken, firm, imperishable
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：sdahennu.htm（全书共 4607 行）

verses.iast: marīcir mandare viṣṇuṃ arcayamāsa keśavam
verses.meaningZh: 除暗得光，神圣宝山、宝树乐园尊，遍入，清净离诸尘垢·妙行迁变空·一乘如实之道，长发
verses.meaningEn: Marīcir, O of a sacred mountain, a tree in paradise, men / in of a sacred mountain, a tree in paradise, men, thousands with names containing prabha, and also containing Viṣṇu, stainless purity free from dust & awakened conduct beyond flux & supreme vehicle of awakening, having long hair
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：sdahennu.htm（全书共 4607 行）

verses.iast: ādeśād brahmaṇo viṣṇuṃ śrīnivāse 'trir arcayet
verses.meaningZh: 施度调伏·本性寂静止息，解脱系缚大力·清净离诸尘垢·因缘空寂大乐，遍入，一样尊，裔胄阿低利，清净离诸尘垢·妙行迁变空·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery & primordial tranquil peace, spiritual strength freeing bonds & stainless purity free from dust & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, thousands with names containing prabha, and also containing Viṣṇu, O the same / in the same, eating, devouring, stainless purity free from dust & awakened conduct beyond flux & supreme vehicle of awakening
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：sdahennu.htm（全书共 4607 行）

verses.iast: nanāma ca tadā viṣṇuṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam
verses.meaningZh: 不名为以及彼时，遍入，法螺·法轮·方位钢鞭
verses.meaningEn: Not + by name and at that time, in that case, then, thousands with names containing prabha, and also containing Viṣṇu, conch shell + wheel + bearing a mace
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：sdahennu.htm（全书共 4607 行）

verses.iast: vanasthānān tu sarveṣāṃ vidhiś śrāmaṇakābhidhaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 园止，然而、而、实则，湖相，最上真言离言说·法界总持任持·本性寂静止息，本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧
verses.meaningEn: Free from lust + point, but, indeed, moreover, a lake + work, supreme ineffable speech & Dharma-realm retention & primordial tranquil peace, primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust & selfless great loving-kindness
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：sdahennu.htm（全书共 4607 行）

verses.iast: vaikhānasasya sūtrasya cāgneḥ śrāmaṇakasya ca
verses.meaningZh: 梵行、苦行人之，契经，妙行迁变空·妙行趣入·离名相假立，比丘性谁以及
verses.meaningEn: Of a class of Ṛṣis stars, of discourse, awakened conduct beyond flux & awakened spiritual movement & beyond nominal designation, monkhood and
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：sdahennu.htm（全书共 4607 行）

verses.iast: agnīṣomādayo devā ye yajñāṃśahavir bhujaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 火天苏摩残忍，天人、诸天护法，凡彼等诸有情，祭祠·肩·护摩供，臂、千臂庄严
verses.meaningEn: Agni and Soma + merciless, god, celestial deity (Deva), those who, whoever (pl.), sacrifice + part + oblation or gift for the gods, arm, hand
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：sdahennu.htm（全书共 4607 行）

verses.iast: viṣṇuñ ca puruṣaṃ satyam acyutañ cāniruddhakam
verses.meaningZh: 最上真言离言说·六度满行清净·离诸诤论无诤以及补卢衫，谛、真实不虚语，妙行迁变空·一乘如实之道·真如实际，妙行迁变空·离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & perfection of the six pāramitās & conflict-free peace and man, truth, reality, veracity, awakened conduct beyond flux & supreme vehicle of awakening & immutable Suchness, awakened conduct beyond flux & beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：sdahennu.htm（全书共 4607 行）

verses.iast: nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ garbhe mudrāṃ dhārayate nijām
verses.meaningZh: 那罗延，亲自、自然本具，藏、胎藏、心髓宝藏尊，手印、法印、契印，放置活期，先天、原居
verses.meaningEn: Narayana, oneself, spontaneously, O womb, treasury, essence, matrix / in womb, treasury, essence, matrix, Mudrā, sacred seal, gesture, put + current, inborn, indigenous, native, own
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：sdahennu.htm（全书共 4607 行）

verses.iast: ! ! Dieser Vers ist auch DHN 103.14-15 zitiert; der zweite Halbvers
verses.meaningZh: 施度调伏·一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢，娑字门（一切诸谛圆满（sarvasatya）·钩召发起三昧），多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·诸根清净自在），侘字门（离覆障清凉（chāyā）·最上大悲化导），曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·本不生体性），真如实际·清净离诸尘垢，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·钩召发起三昧），真如实际，因缘空寂大乐·离一切相无相·解脱系缚大力
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (satya) — samādhi invocation, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — purified faculties, coolness free of obscuration (chāyā) — supreme compassionate guidance, beyond nominal designation (nāma) — primordial non-arising, immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — samādhi invocation, immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), causal emptiness & spiritual joy & freedom from conditioned marks & spiritual strength freeing bonds
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：sdahennu.htm（全书共 4607 行）

verses.iast: ist auch in KrA enthalten. Vgl. ĀS 16.33 (Nārāyaṇa spricht zu Vikhanas):
verses.meaningZh: 多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·诸根清净自在），侘字门（离覆障清凉（chāyā）·最上大悲化导），曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·诸根清净自在），啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·本不生体性），离名相假立·无住安立·离一切相无相，攞字门（离一切相无相（lakṣaṇa）·本不生体性），娑字门（一切诸谛圆满（sarvasatya）·远离寂静周遍），那罗延，多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·诸根清净自在），悉昙「zu」韵字门：损减除灭忧苦，梵行、牟尼
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness (tathatā) — purified faculties, coolness free of obscuration (chāyā) — supreme compassionate guidance, beyond nominal designation (nāma) — purified faculties, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — primordial non-arising, beyond nominal designation & non-abiding equipoise & freedom from conditioned marks, freedom from conditioned marks (lakṣaṇa) — primordial non-arising, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (satya) — expansive quiescence, Narayana, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — purified faculties, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'zu': dispelling sorrow, of Brahman, of a Muni
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：sdahennu.htm（全书共 4607 行）

verses.iast: tvadvaṃśajānāṃ sarveṣāṃ garbhavaiṣṇavajanmanāṃ / ahaṃ eva svayaṃ garbhe manmudrāṃ dhārayāṃy ahaṃ
verses.meaningZh: 儞·笛·了知，湖相，妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢·破有相福德光，我、真我自性，唯、正是、决定，亲自、自然本具，藏、胎藏、心髓宝藏尊，认为手印，总持任持·法界总持任持，我、真我自性
verses.meaningEn: You + tradition + knowing, a lake + work, awakened spiritual movement & stainless purity free from dust & blessedness transcending existence, I, the awakened self, indeed, verily, alone, oneself, spontaneously, O womb, treasury, essence, matrix / in womb, treasury, essence, matrix, think + Mudrā, upholding, I, the awakened self
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：sdahennu.htm（全书共 4607 行）

verses.iast: vgl. auch ĀS 19.12: vaikhānasānāṃ sarveṣāṃ garbhavaiṣṇavajanmanāṃ / aham eva svayaṃ garbhe mannudrāṃ dhārayāmi tāṃ
verses.meaningZh: 攞字门（离一切相无相（lakṣaṇa）·本不生体性），侘字门（离覆障清凉（chāyā）·最上大悲化导），娑字门（一切诸谛圆满（sarvasatya）·远离寂静周遍），诸梵行、苦行人之，湖相，妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢·破有相福德光，我、吾身，唯、正是、决定，亲自、自然本具，藏、胎藏、心髓宝藏尊，无我大慈三昧·离名相假立·施度调伏，放置我活期，救度佛母（绿度母）根本种子字
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from conditioned marks (lakṣaṇa) — primordial non-arising, coolness free of obscuration (chāyā) — supreme compassionate guidance, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (satya) — expansive quiescence, of all a class of Ṛṣis stars, a lake + work, awakened spiritual movement & stainless purity free from dust & blessedness transcending existence, I, myself, indeed, verily, alone, oneself, spontaneously, O womb, treasury, essence, matrix / in womb, treasury, essence, matrix, selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation & generosity & self-mastery, put + I current, Tārā root seed syllable Tāṃ / her
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：sdahennu.htm（全书共 4607 行）

verses.iast: brahmāpi bhagavān devo harir nārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 神父善友，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，天，哈利，那罗延，由忆持、回首
verses.meaningEn: Priest + friend, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, devo, harir, Narayana, from remember
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：sdahennu.htm（全书共 4607 行）

verses.iast: kṛṣṇa-varṇaṃ tviṣākṛṣṇaṃ sāṅgopāṅgāstra-pārṣadam
verses.meaningZh: 深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，显色、身色光彩，钩召摄引·真如实际，肢体尊身·乌凡伽·飞奔，胁士
verses.meaningEn: Dark-blue, black, color, hue, luminous appearance, magnetizing, haviNg limbs or a body + upanga + dart, attendant
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss1_tatu.htm（全书共 2177 行）

verses.iast: kṛṣṇaṃ sa jīvaḥ prabhur astu no gatiḥ
verses.meaningZh: 深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，彼、此尊（阳性主格），命者，主宰，愿得成就、当如是，我等、为我等，揭底
verses.meaningEn: Dark-blue, black, he, that one, jīvaḥ, prabhur, may it be so, let it be! us, for us, our, gatiḥ
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss1_tatu.htm（全书共 2177 行）

verses.iast: avadhāpyāha kṛṣṇa-varṇam iti
verses.meaningZh: 鸿毛·放置·膨胀·如是宣说，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，显色、身色光彩，如是（结句印定）
verses.meaningEn: Down + put + swell + spoke, dark-blue, black, color, hue, luminous appearance, thus, so it is stated
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss1_tatu.htm（全书共 2177 行）

verses.iast: sumedhaso janāḥ kalāv api hariṃ bhajanti
verses.meaningZh: 报刊往外·脂·笑声，诸世人，造作离相·离一切相无相·最上真言离言说，亦、虽、乃至，哈利，诸尊做买卖往外、分摊
verses.meaningEn: Press out + fat + laughter, people of the world (plural), freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks & supreme ineffable speech, even, also, fallow, yellowish, greenish, they deal out, apportion, dispense, distribute , share, divide
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss1_tatu.htm（全书共 2177 行）

verses.iast: antaḥkṛṣṇaṃ bahir gauraṃ darśitāṅgādi-vaibhavam
verses.meaningZh: 离名相假立·真如实际·造作离相，外方，洁白、黄不溜秋，施度调伏·清净离诸尘垢·本性寂静止息，威力、威神力
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness & freedom from karmic agency, outside, white, yellowish, reddish, generosity & self-mastery & stainless purity free from dust & primordial tranquil peace (vocative invocation), might, power, high position, majesty, grandeur
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss1_tatu.htm（全书共 2177 行）

verses.iast: kalau saṅkīrtanādyaiḥ smaḥ kṛṣṇa-caitanyam āśritāḥ
verses.meaningZh: 造作离相·离一切相无相，一切诸谛圆满·支分寂静·造作离相，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入），深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，有知，本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks (imperative seal), all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & quiescence of perceptual limbs & freedom from karmic agency, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release, dark-blue, black, caitanyam, primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness

verses.iast: yatrādhikṛtya gāyatrīm iti lakṣaṇa-pūrvakam
verses.meaningZh: 凡于何处据，妙行趣入·一乘如实之道·真如实际，如是（结句印定），相、妙相标帜，已
verses.meaningEn: Where + regarding, awakened spiritual movement & supreme vehicle of awakening & immutable Suchness, thus, so it is stated, mark, auspicious sign, characteristic, former
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss1_tatu.htm（全书共 2177 行）

verses.iast: tad evam asya śāstrasya gāyatrīm adhikṛtya pravṛttir darśitā
verses.meaningZh: 彼、如是真实，如是（如《如是我闻》evam mayā śrutam），此尊之、此咒之，论，妙行趣入·一乘如实之道·真如实际，据，流转，施度调伏·清净离诸尘垢·本性寂静止息
verses.meaningEn: That, thus, thus, in this manner, of this, his/its, of instruction, precept, rule, theory, a scientific or canonical work, awakened spiritual movement & supreme vehicle of awakening & immutable Suchness, regarding, pravṛttir, generosity & self-mastery & stainless purity free from dust & primordial tranquil peace
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss1_tatu.htm（全书共 2177 行）

verses.iast: pratipādaka-vāg-viśeṣa-rūpa-sarasvatītvād upayuktam eva
verses.meaningZh: 落发器，誐字门（妙行趣入（gati）·远离寂静周遍），异，色、妙色身，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，中古、实用，唯、正是、决定
verses.meaningEn: Leg, awakened spiritual movement (gati) — expansive quiescence, distinction, difference, special property, peculiarity, form, matter, sacred body, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, employed, used, consumed, indeed, verily, alone
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss1_tatu.htm（全书共 2177 行）

verses.iast: yad uktam agni
verses.meaningZh: 凡所…者，曰，圣火、智火（火大）
verses.meaningEn: Which, what, that which, said, fire, sacred flame (Agni)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss1_tatu.htm（全书共 2177 行）

verses.iast: dharmaḥ kṛṣṇa-saṅkīrtana-lakṣaṇaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 正法、诸法实相，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，一切诸谛圆满·支分寂静·造作离相，相、妙相标帜
verses.meaningEn: Dharma, cosmic truth/teaching/phenomena, dark-blue, black, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & quiescence of perceptual limbs & freedom from karmic agency, mark, auspicious sign, characteristic
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss1_tatu.htm（全书共 2177 行）

verses.iast: nanu ced īdṛśaṃ śrī-bhāgavataṃ tarhi
verses.meaningZh: 遮么，陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，施度调伏·本性寂静止息，吉祥、圣德威光，分鸣呼，若尔
verses.meaningEn: Not, by no means, never, generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — samādhi invocation, generosity & self-mastery & primordial tranquil peace, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, part, then
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss1_tatu.htm（全书共 2177 行）

verses.iast: tamo'vidyām atititīrṣatāṃ saṃsāriṇāṃ karuṇayā yaḥ purāṇa-guhyaṃ śrī
verses.meaningZh: 暗无明，真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·六度满行清净，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤，以大悲（拔苦悲心），凡彼…者，先世，密，吉祥、圣德威光
verses.meaningEn: Ignorance, immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & perfection of the six pāramitās, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace, with/by compassion (Karuṇā), whoever, he who, former, ancient, old, guhyaṃ, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss1_tatu.htm（全书共 2177 行）

verses.iast: parāśaro gādhi-suto 'tha rāma
verses.meaningZh: 脇生，福特、坚硬地面尊，一切诸谛圆满·真如实际，尔时、次复吉祥启白，罗摩
verses.meaningEn: Parāśaro, O ford, solid ground, firm basis, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness, now, thereupon, auspiciously, Rāma
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss1_tatu.htm（全书共 2177 行）

verses.iast: tv āpekṣikam iti
verses.meaningZh: 嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk，第一义谛·造作离相·六度满行清净，如是（结句印定）
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — primordial non-arising, ultimate truth & freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās, thus, so it is stated
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss1_tatu.htm（全书共 2177 行）

verses.iast: aho kiṃ bahunā, śrī-kṛṣṇa-pratinidhi-rūpam evedam
verses.meaningZh: 奇哉，迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·诸根清净自在·大空菩提点摄持），以多，吉祥、圣德威光，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，更代、取代，色，唯此
verses.meaningEn: Exclamation of joy, sorrow or astonishment, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — purified faculties sealed with bodhicitta bindu, by many, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, dark-blue, black, substitution, substitute, rūpam, indeed + this
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss1_tatu.htm（全书共 2177 行）

verses.iast: yata
verses.meaningZh: 拘牵
verses.meaningEn: Held, restrained, checked, controlled
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss1_tatu.htm（全书共 2177 行）

verses.iast: kṛṣṇa-pratinidhitvāt kṛṣṇavat sarva-guṇa-yuktatvam ity arthaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，更代从长柄，深青黑不过逮捕，一切、普皆遍满，功德、殊胜妙德，具汝，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·诸根清净自在），义利、所求善愿、胜义
verses.meaningEn: Dark-blue, black, substitution + from stem, dark-blue + only apprehend, all, every, complete, virtue, excellence, auspicious quality, yoked + Thou, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — purified faculties, meaning, benefit, aim, welfare
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss1_tatu.htm（全书共 2177 行）

verses.iast: priyeva
verses.meaningZh: 惜者犹如
verses.meaningEn: Dear + like
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss1_tatu.htm（全书共 2177 行）

verses.iast: pūrvam ity ādi-dvādaśokter brahma-nārāyaṇa-saṃvāda-rūpam aṣṭādaśasu
verses.meaningZh: 元，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·诸根清净自在），元，十二神气，神父，那罗延，演说一起、协定，色，十八报刊往外
verses.meaningEn: First, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — purified faculties, beginning, the twelfth + of expression, priest, Narayana, speaking together, conversation with, rūpam, eighteenth + press out
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss1_tatu.htm（全书共 2177 行）

verses.iast: yathā sa bhagavān vyāsaḥ sākṣān nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ
verses.meaningZh: 犹如、如…所说，彼、此尊（阳性主格），世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，广大，一切诸谛圆满·造作离相·六度满行清净，那罗延，主宰
verses.meaningEn: Just as, according to, he, that one, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, vyāsaḥ, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās, Narayana, prabhuḥ
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss1_tatu.htm（全书共 2177 行）

verses.iast: purastād vistareṇa vivecanīyam
verses.meaningZh: 第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·一切诸谛圆满，以广说，最上真言离言说·妙行迁变空·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, by/through to explain, supreme ineffable speech & awakened conduct beyond flux & beyond nominal designation
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss2_bhgu.htm（全书共 6564 行）

verses.iast: bhagavac chabdārthaḥ śrī-viṣṇu-purāṇe
verses.meaningZh: 才告诉，离覆障清凉·解脱系缚大力·施度调伏，吉祥、圣德威光，遍入，先世尊
verses.meaningEn: Excellence + say, coolness free of obscuration & spiritual strength freeing bonds & generosity & self-mastery, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, thousands with names containing prabha, and also containing Viṣṇu, O former, ancient, old
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss2_bhgu.htm（全书共 6564 行）

verses.iast: tasmai namo bhagavate brahmaṇe paramātmane ity atra varuṇa
verses.meaningZh: 向彼尊（为格），归命，向世尊（薄伽梵）致敬，解脱系缚大力·清净离诸尘垢·因缘空寂大乐，自性世界自然，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·诸根清净自在），于此处、今此，水神
verses.meaningEn: To him, to that one, homage to to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, spiritual strength freeing bonds & stainless purity free from dust & causal emptiness & spiritual joy (vocative invocation), the supreme spirit + O certainly, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — purified faculties, here, in this place, the All-encompasser, of a god
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss2_bhgu.htm（全书共 6564 行）

verses.iast: kṛta-śrī-kṛṣṇa-stutau ṭīkā ca - paramātmane sarva-jīva-niyantre ity eṣā
verses.meaningZh: 所作、已成办，吉祥、圣德威光，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，一切诸谛圆满·真如实际，说疏以及自性世界自然，一切、普皆遍满，命者，在于机尊，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·诸根清净自在），此等
verses.meaningEn: Done, made, accomplished, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, dark-blue, black, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness (imperative seal), a commentary, on some other commentary and the supreme spirit + O certainly, all, every, complete, living, alive, in + O apparatus, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — purified faculties, they
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss2_bhgu.htm（全书共 6564 行）

verses.iast: anytamatvaṃ dvādaśe śrī-nārāyaṇa-rṣiṃ prati mārkaṇḍeyena
verses.meaningZh: 离名相假立·一乘如实之道·真如实际，十二尊，吉祥、圣德威光，那罗延，沙字门（六度满行清净（ṣaṭpāramitā）·诸根清净自在·大空菩提点摄持），对，以座儿、古老圣仙
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation & supreme vehicle of awakening & immutable Suchness, O the twelfth, consisting of twelve, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, Narayana, perfection of the six pāramitās — purified faculties sealed with bodhicitta bindu, toward, by/through patron
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss2_bhgu.htm（全书共 6564 行）

verses.iast: bhagavan tasmāt tava śuklāṃ sattva-maya-līlādhiṣṭhātrīṃ tanuṃ śrī-viṣṇu
verses.meaningZh: 出有坏，是故、因此、从彼，汝之、圣尊之，白，有情、众生、勇猛心，过去、阿修罗，离一切相无相·法界总持任持·六度满行清净，薄，吉祥、圣德威光，遍入
verses.meaningEn: Bhagavan, therefore, from that, your, thine, white, sentient being, living creature, courage, made or consisting of, freedom from conditioned marks & Dharma-realm retention & perfection of the six pāramitās, thin, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, thousands with names containing prabha, and also containing Viṣṇu
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss2_bhgu.htm（全书共 6564 行）

verses.meaningEn: Form, matter, sacred body, wholesome, virtuous, skillful, subtle, they deal out, apportion, dispense, distribute , share, divide, stay by + within, not, non-, supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — primordial non-arising, other, priest, of gods, form, matter, sacred body, to Thee / they

verses.meaningZh: 趣往、来诣，彼之、其（属格），多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·远离寂静周遍·涅槃除障点证入），元，借由彼力、以是因缘，那罗延，由忆持、回首
verses.meaningEn: Going, coming, his, of that, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — expansive quiescence with nirvāṇic visarga release, first, by that truth, thereby, through that power, Narayana, from remember

verses.meaningEn: Wrath + of entered, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & transcending birth & victorious & non-dual wisdom awareness (vocative invocation), rudraḥ, drawing together, contraction, abridgment, compendium, collection, kārakaḥ
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss3_paru.htm（全书共 4198 行）

verses.iast: śrī-kṛṣṇa-sandarbha
verses.meaningZh: 吉祥、圣德威光，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，赢得满陀
verses.meaningEn: Auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, dark-blue, black, win + bundle or bunch of grass
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss4_krsu.htm（全书共 7567 行）

verses.iast: yasya pauruṣa-rūpasyāmbhasi pralaya-kālīna-garbhodake śayānasya sataḥ
verses.meaningZh: 凡彼…之，奴婢、狗腿，清净离诸尘垢·第一义谛·一切诸谛圆满，转载惛沈，造作离相·离一切相无相·离名相假立，心浮肿，事关床卧鼻根，由彼、此尊（阳性主格）
verses.meaningEn: Whose, of whom, servant, henchman, attendant, stainless purity free from dust & ultimate truth & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (vocative invocation), forward + dulling or hebetating the mind, freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks & beyond nominal designation, O dropsy, on the bed + being in the nose, from he, that one
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss4_krsu.htm（全书共 7567 行）

verses.iast: avāpa nārāyaṇa ādi-devaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 鸿毛净水，那罗延，元，天
verses.meaningEn: Down + water, Narayana, beginning, devaḥ
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss4_krsu.htm（全书共 7567 行）

verses.iast: ānvīkṣikīm ātma-vidyām
verses.meaningZh: 离名相假立·最上真言离言说·造作离相，真如实际·无我大慈三昧，明咒、真言明妃、圣智明
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation & supreme ineffable speech & freedom from karmic agency, immutable Suchness & selfless great loving-kindness, Vidyā, sacred wisdom-spell, illumination
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss4_krsu.htm（全书共 7567 行）

verses.iast: śrī-viṣṇor evāvatāro'yam
verses.meaningZh: 吉祥、圣德威光，遍入之，唯·入·此尊
verses.meaningEn: Auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, of thousands with names containing prabha, and also containing Viṣṇu, indeed + this one
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss4_krsu.htm（全书共 7567 行）

verses.iast: saṃjñā satyavratasya
verses.meaningZh: 想（取相认知），禁戒真实性之
verses.meaningEn: Perception, conceptualization, of a vow of truthfulness
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss4_krsu.htm（全书共 7567 行）

verses.iast: pratimanvantarāvasāne'pi pralayaḥ śrūyate
verses.meaningZh: 第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，转载惛沈，听编织
verses.meaningEn: Ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), forward, to listen + weave
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss4_krsu.htm（全书共 7567 行）

verses.iast: śrī-viṣṇu
verses.meaningZh: 吉祥、圣德威光，遍入
verses.meaningEn: Auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, thousands with names containing prabha, and also containing Viṣṇu
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss4_krsu.htm（全书共 7567 行）

verses.iast: puruṣa eva
verses.meaningZh: 士夫，唯、正是、决定
verses.meaningEn: Man, human being, male, person, individual of a generation, indeed, verily, alone
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss4_krsu.htm（全书共 7567 行）

verses.iast: skānde śrī-rāma-gītāyāṃ viśva-rūpaṃ darśayatas tasya brahma
verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·造作离相·离名相假立，吉祥、圣德威光，罗摩，于赞歌中，遍一切、森罗万象，色，色尘如何哪些，彼之、其（属格），神父
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & freedom from karmic agency & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, Rāma, in Song, all-pervading, universal, whole, rūpaṃ, looking or aiming at + from whom, his, of that, priest
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss4_krsu.htm（全书共 7567 行）

verses.iast: viṣṇu-rudra-kṛta-stuteḥ śravaṇāt
verses.meaningZh: 遍入，紧恶，所作、已成办，称赞之，从听闻
verses.meaningEn: Thousands with names containing prabha, and also containing Viṣṇu, of gods, done, made, accomplished, of praises, from monk
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss4_krsu.htm（全书共 7567 行）

verses.iast: rāma-kṛṣṇāv iti bhuvo bhagavān aharad bharam
verses.meaningZh: 罗摩，造作离相·六度满行清净·离诸诤论无诤，如是（结句印定），空界（中空生命气息），世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，因缘空寂大乐·清净离诸尘垢·施度调伏，方位、战斗
verses.meaningEn: Rāma, freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās & conflict-free peace, thus, so it is stated, Atmosphere realm (Bhuvar-loka), the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & stainless purity free from dust & generosity & self-mastery, bearing, carrying
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss4_krsu.htm（全书共 7567 行）

verses.iast: śrī-kṛṣṇa-rūpeṇa nijāṃśa-rūpatvād rāma-rūpeṇāpi bhārahāritvaṃ bhagavata
verses.meaningZh: 吉祥、圣德威光，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，以色、妙色身，先天肩，清净离诸尘垢·第一义谛·真如实际，罗摩，清净离诸尘垢·第一义谛·离诸诤论无诤，包袱·拿来净水·汝，才鸣呼
verses.meaningEn: Auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, dark-blue, black, by/through form, matter, sacred body, inborn + part, stainless purity free from dust & ultimate truth & immutable Suchness, Rāma, stainless purity free from dust & ultimate truth & conflict-free peace (vocative invocation), burden + to fetch water + Thou, excellence
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss4_krsu.htm（全书共 7567 行）

verses.iast: janitā viṣṇu-yaśaso nāmnā kalkir jagat-patiḥ
verses.meaningZh: 诸人、那罗，遍入，一乘如实之道·本性寂静止息·一切诸谛圆满，离名相假立·无我大慈三昧，未来世，动人、活着，君
verses.meaningEn: People, thousands with names containing prabha, and also containing Viṣṇu, supreme vehicle of awakening & primordial tranquil peace & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, beyond nominal designation & selfless great loving-kindness, of a future liberator of the world, moving, alive, prince
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss4_krsu.htm（全书共 7567 行）

verses.iast: vidyācita eva iti śrutir manaś cid-ādīnām agnīnāṃ prakaraṇa-prāptaṃ
verses.meaningZh: 解借，唯、正是、决定，如是（结句印定），闻，无我大慈三昧·离名相假立·本性寂静止息，陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，诸元之，诸圣火、智火（火大）之，极所作，得
verses.meaningEn: Understanding + borrowed, indeed, verily, alone, thus, so it is stated, śrutir, selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation & primordial tranquil peace, generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — purified faculties, of beginning, of fire, sacred flame (Agni), bringing forth, creation, filled with astonishment and wonder
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss4_krsu.htm（全书共 7567 行）

verses.iast: kṛṣṇaḥ svayaṃ samabhavat paramaḥ pumān yo
verses.meaningZh: 黑面，亲自、自然本具，平汝，为自任，丈夫，凡彼圣尊、能…者
verses.meaningEn: Kṛṣṇaḥ, oneself, spontaneously, equal + you, paramaḥ, pumān, who, whichever
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss4_krsu.htm（全书共 7567 行）

verses.iast: avatārāś ca prākṛta-vaibhave'vataraṇam iti
verses.meaningZh: 救度超脱·最上真言离言说以及俗语，最上真言离言说·破有相福德光·真如实际，如是（结句印定）
verses.meaningEn: Ferrying across and natural, normal, usual, common, vulgar, vernacular, supreme ineffable speech & blessedness transcending existence & immutable Suchness, thus, so it is stated
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss4_krsu.htm（全书共 7567 行）

verses.iast: śrī-kṛṣṇa-sāhacaryeṇa śrī
verses.meaningZh: 吉祥、圣德威光，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，以同行，吉祥、圣德威光
verses.meaningEn: Auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, dark-blue, black, by/through being or standing together, being joined or united with, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss4_krsu.htm（全书共 7567 行）

verses.iast: jyotiṣṭomādhikaraṇe vasante vasante ca jyotiṣā yajeta ity atra jyotiḥ-śabdo
verses.meaningZh: 能作成办·生起不可得·尊胜，再三春尊以及星者，供养长柄，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·诸根清净自在），于此处、今此，打败正勤，音
verses.meaningEn: Making (vocative invocation), O spring / in spring again and again and astronomy, worship + stem, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — purified faculties, here, in this place, overpower + effort, sound
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss4_krsu.htm（全书共 7567 行）

verses.iast: kalābhyāṃ nitarāṃ hareḥ iti hareḥ kalā pṛthvī, ābhyāṃ rāma
verses.meaningZh: 造作离相·离一切相无相·破有相福德光，下贱语气、全然，哈利之，如是（结句印定），哈利之，奇法，第一义谛·无住安立·最上真言离言说，破有相福德光·一乘如实之道，罗摩
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks & blessedness transcending existence, downwards, in a low tone, of fallow, yellowish, greenish, thus, so it is stated, of fallow, yellowish, greenish, a small part, a sixteenth of the moon's orb, ultimate truth & non-abiding equipoise & supreme ineffable speech, blessedness transcending existence & supreme vehicle of awakening, Rāma
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss4_krsu.htm（全书共 7567 行）

verses.iast: vaṃśayor avatīrṇāv ity arthaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 金刚界大日智法身水轮甘露种子卧式之，最上真言离言说·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·诸根清净自在），义利、所求善愿、胜义
verses.meaningEn: Vajradhātu Mahāvairocana ambrosia seed syllable + of lying, supreme ineffable speech & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — purified faculties, meaning, benefit, aim, welfare
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss4_krsu.htm（全书共 7567 行）

verses.iast: arjune tu narāveśaḥ kṛṣṇo nārāyaṇaḥ svayam
verses.meaningZh: 有修尊，然而、而、实则，男子阿尾舍，黑面，那罗延，亲自、自性显现
verses.meaningEn: O silver-white, but, indeed, moreover, man + spirit possession, kṛṣṇo, Narayana, oneself, spontaneously, in person
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss4_krsu.htm（全书共 7567 行）

verses.iast: ity ādinā darśitaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·诸根清净自在），以元，施度调伏·清净离诸尘垢·本性寂静止息
verses.meaningEn: Supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — purified faculties, by beginning, generosity & self-mastery & stainless purity free from dust & primordial tranquil peace
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss4_krsu.htm（全书共 7567 行）

verses.iast: sa punaḥ kṛṣṇa ity arthāntarāpekṣayā mantavyam
verses.meaningZh: 彼、此尊（阳性主格），复次、再三，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·诸根清净自在），以义利内部待，认为勇健
verses.meaningEn: He, that one, again, furthermore, dark-blue, black, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — purified faculties, meaning + interior + with, think + strong
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss4_krsu.htm（全书共 7567 行）

verses.iast: yayor
verses.meaningZh: 一乘如实之道·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Supreme vehicle of awakening & stainless purity free from dust
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss4_krsu.htm（全书共 7567 行）

verses.iast: eva samaṃ vīparyam ity ādi nyāyāt
verses.meaningZh: 唯、正是、决定，平，最上真言离言说·第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·诸根清净自在），元，从如
verses.meaningEn: Indeed, verily, alone, equal, supreme ineffable speech & ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — purified faculties, beginning, from norm, standard
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss4_krsu.htm（全书共 7567 行）

verses.iast: tathā viṣṇu-dharme
verses.meaningZh: 如是、亦复如是，遍入，正法、诸法实相尊
verses.meaningEn: Thus, in that same way, thousands with names containing prabha, and also containing Viṣṇu, O Dharma, cosmic truth/teaching/phenomena / in Dharma, cosmic truth/teaching/phenomena
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss4_krsu.htm（全书共 7567 行）

verses.iast: taṃ prati śrī-bhagavad-vākyāc cārjunasyāpi śrī-kṛṣṇa-sakhatvena nārāyaṇa
verses.meaningZh: 彼（宾格），对，吉祥、圣德威光，才宣说，语索取，妙行迁变空·清净离诸尘垢·生起不可得·尊胜，吉祥、圣德威光，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，以彼虚空长柄，那罗延
verses.meaningEn: Him, that, toward, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, excellence + speak, ask, awakened conduct beyond flux & stainless purity free from dust & transcending birth & victorious (vocative invocation), auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, dark-blue, black, he + hole + by, Narayana
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss4_krsu.htm（全书共 7567 行）

verses.iast: tat-pratītāv evāṃśa ivāṃśa iti jñeyam
verses.meaningZh: 彼、真如彼岸，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，唯肩，犹如肩，如是（结句印定），乃是已知、创建往外
verses.meaningEn: That (ultimate reality), ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, indeed + part, like + part, thus, so it is stated, to be known, understood, learnt, found out
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss4_krsu.htm（全书共 7567 行）

verses.iast: nārāyaṇa-samo guṇaiḥ
verses.meaningZh: 那罗延，平，以诸功德、殊胜妙德
verses.meaningEn: Narayana, equal, by/with virtue, excellence, auspicious quality
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：ss4_krsu.htm（全书共 7567 行）

verses.iast: ity atrāpi nārāyaṇaḥ paravyomādhipa eva guṇaiḥ samo yasyety eva
verses.meaningZh: 耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·诸根清净自在），于此处善友，那罗延，他人·包扎·难迥遮·自在主，唯、正是、决定，以诸功德、殊胜妙德，平，一乘如实之道·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际，唯、正是、决定

verses.iast: ityādiśya surānsarvānmahāviṣṇuḥ svajāyayā
verses.meaningZh: 经过来诣，广大殊胜·一切诸谛圆满，以自婆利耶
verses.meaningEn: Course + relating to the quarters of the sky or to the horizon, great, own + with
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：dbhp_dgu.htm（全书共 1805 行）

verses.iast: namo devyai mahādevyai śivāyai satataṃ namaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼天女、佛母明妃·摩诃室利·本性寂静止息·最上真言离言说·一乘如实之道·不已、从来！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to goddess, sacred female deity, Mahādevī, primordial tranquil peace & supreme ineffable speech & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation), continual!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：dbhp_dgu.htm（全书共 1805 行）

verses.iast: sarasvatīmaditiṃ dakṣaduhitaraṃ namāmaḥ pāvanāṃ śivām
verses.meaningZh: 妙音天女·泡沫·如是，有辩才·乳糜·普遍，我等归命、敬礼，清净、圣洁，寂静
verses.meaningEn: Sarasvatī + bubble + thus, able + milk + commonplace, we homage, salutation, purifying or purified, pure, holy, kind, friendly, mild, gracious, lovely, auspicious, fortunate
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：dbhp_dgu.htm（全书共 1805 行）

verses.iast: = DbhP
verses.meaningZh: 跛字门（第一义谛（paramārtha）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Ultimate truth (paramārtha) — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：dbhp_dgu.htm（全书共 1805 行）

verses.iast: namo virāṭsvarūpiṇyai namaḥ sūtrātmamūrtaye
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢·断除憍慢执障·契经自我尊身！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust & cutting rigid pride (vocative invocation), discourse, self, to embodiment!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：dbhp_dgu.htm（全书共 1805 行）

verses.iast: namo 'vyākṛtarūpiṇyai namaḥ śrībrahma mūrtaye
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼最上真言离言说·一乘如实之道·造作离相·吉祥神父·尊身、化现妙相！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to supreme ineffable speech & supreme vehicle of awakening & freedom from karmic agency (vocative invocation), auspiciousness, priest, embodiment, sacred form, image!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：dbhp_dgu.htm（全书共 1805 行）

verses.iast: namaḥ praṇavarūpāyai namo hrīṅkāramūrtaye
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤·清净惭愧·因缘空寂大乐！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace (vocative invocation), modest purity (reverent offering)!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：dbhp_dgu.htm（全书共 1805 行）

verses.iast: nānāmantrātmikāyai te karuṇāyai namo namaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 离名相假立·无我大慈三昧·真如实际，向汝、彼等，能作成办·造作离相，归命，至心归命礼！
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation & selfless great loving-kindness & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), to Thee / they, making (vocative invocation), homage to reverent homage!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：dbhp_dgu.htm（全书共 1805 行）

verses.iast: sarvavedāntasaṃsiddhe namo hrīṅkāramūrtaye
verses.meaningZh: 成就所有权·一极·具足，归命，清净惭愧·因缘空寂大乐
verses.meaningEn: Having complete possession + ultimate + O accomplished, homage to modest purity (reverent offering)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：dbhp_dgu.htm（全书共 1805 行）

verses.iast: brahmacaryaṃ vidhiścaiva yasmāttasmai namo namaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 梵行，最上真言离言说·法界总持任持·本性寂静止息，向那等彼尊，归命，至心归命礼！
verses.meaningEn: Pure practices, supreme ineffable speech & Dharma-realm retention & primordial tranquil peace, because + to him, homage to reverent homage!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：dbhp_dgu.htm（全书共 1805 行）

verses.iast: yasmādoṣadhayaḥ sarvā rasāstasmai namo namaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 热门踊跃·勿·罪过·饮用，一切、普皆遍满，清净离诸尘垢·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际，归命，至心归命礼！
verses.meaningEn: Be hot or eager + do not + hatred + sucking, all, every, complete, stainless purity free from dust & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), homage to reverent homage!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：dbhp_dgu.htm（全书共 1805 行）

verses.iast: adha ūrdhvaṃ caturdikṣu mātarbhūyo namo namaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 下，上，妙行迁变空·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢，勿·星宿·又么，归命，至心归命礼！
verses.meaningEn: Then, so, and but, therefore, accordingly, ūrdhvaṃ, awakened conduct beyond flux & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust (imperative seal), do not + star, homage to reverent homage!
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：dbhp_dgu.htm（全书共 1805 行）

verses.iast: śrīraktadantikāsthānaṃ durgāsthānaṃ tathaiva ca
verses.meaningZh: 吉祥庄严·本性寂静止息，难近母立，真如实际·无住安立·最上真言离言说以及
verses.meaningEn: Glorious, Durga, immutable Suchness & non-abiding equipoise & supreme ineffable speech and
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：dbhp_dgu.htm（全书共 1805 行）

verses.iast: brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca īśvaraśca sadāśivaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 梵王，遍入及紧恶及自在及恒常兽主徒
verses.meaningEn: Brahma, and and and always
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：dbhp_dgu.htm（全书共 1805 行）

verses.iast: mahāvidyāmahāmantraistoṣayenmāṃ muhurmuhuḥ
verses.meaningZh: 广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，暂突然
verses.meaningEn: Great, suddenly + suddenly
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：dbhp_dgu.htm（全书共 1805 行）

verses.iast: tatra devaiḥ stutā devī lakṣmīprāptyarthamādarāt
verses.meaningZh: 于彼处、其中，以诸天人、诸天护法，一切诸谛圆满·真如实际，天女、佛母明妃，吉祥相·转载·神明·他·勿·从揭幕
verses.meaningEn: There, therein, by/with god, celestial deity (Deva), all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness, goddess, sacred female deity, mark + forward + of gods + tha + do not + from cleaving
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：dbhp_dgu.htm（全书共 1805 行）

verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：agp_bi_u.htm（全书共 49519 行）

verses.iast: rudraśāntiḥ
verses.meaningZh: 紧恶息灾
verses.meaningEn: Of gods + peace
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：agp_bi_u.htm（全书共 49519 行）

verses.iast: oṃ namo bhagavate vāsudevāya

verses.iast: śriyaṃ sarasvatīṃ gaurīṃ gaṇeśaṃ skandamīśvaram
verses.meaningZh: 清癯风大自在除障种子，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢，欢喜天，飞跃·这·明天
verses.meaningEn: Lean + Vāyu wind-mandala swiftness seed syllable, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, awakened spiritual movement & stainless purity free from dust, Ganesa, leap + tomorrow
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：agp_bi_u.htm（全书共 49519 行）

verses.iast: sārātsāro hi bhagavān viṣṇuḥ sargādikṛdvibhuḥ
verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，诚然、因为、实乃，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，遍入，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·妙行趣入
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, for, indeed, surely, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, viṣṇuḥ, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & awakened spiritual movement
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：agp_bi_u.htm（全书共 49519 行）

verses.iast: lakṣmīmiti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 吉祥相称计，伽字门（破暗合集（ghana）·本不生体性），妙行迁变空·因缘空寂大乐·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Mark + measure, dissolving dense ignorance (ghana) — primordial non-arising, awakened conduct beyond flux & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & beyond nominal designation
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：agp_bi_u.htm（全书共 49519 行）

verses.iast: kālāgnirūpiṇam viṣṇuṃ jyotirbrahma parātparam /AP 1.011ab
verses.meaningZh: 造作离相·离一切相无相·妙行趣入，遍入，智慧大光明神父，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，跛字门（第一义谛（paramārtha）·本不生体性），跋字门（解脱系缚大力（bala
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks & awakened spiritual movement, thousands with names containing prabha, and also containing Viṣṇu, the supreme Light of wisdom + priest, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, ultimate truth (paramārtha) — primordial non-arising, spiritual strength freeing bonds (bala) — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：agp_bi_u.htm（全书共 49519 行）

verses.iast: vidyāsāraṃ yadviditvā sarvajño jāyate naraḥ
verses.meaningZh: 明咒心坚，一乘如实之道·施度调伏·最上真言离言说，一切智，生起不可得·尊胜·一乘如实之道·真如实际，男子
verses.meaningEn: Vidyā + maina, supreme vehicle of awakening & generosity & self-mastery & supreme ineffable speech, sarvajño, transcending birth & victorious & supreme vehicle of awakening & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), naraḥ
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：agp_bi_u.htm（全书共 49519 行）

verses.iast: viṣṇuḥ kālāgnirudro 'haṃ vidyāsāraṃ vadāmi te

verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：agp_bi_u.htm（全书共 49519 行）

verses.iast: rāmaḥ śarair jarjaritaṃ rāvaṇañcākarodraṇe /AP 10.010ab
verses.meaningZh: 罗摩，本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢，腐朽、褫落，能作成办·清净离诸尘垢，跛字门（第一义谛（paramārtha）·本不生体性），跋字门（解脱系缚大力（bala
verses.meaningEn: Rāma, primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust, decayed, worn out, broken, hurt, tattered, perforated, making (vocative invocation), ultimate truth (paramārtha) — primordial non-arising, spiritual strength freeing bonds (bala) — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：agp_bi_u.htm（全书共 49519 行）

verses.iast: ato gacchāmi yuddhāya rāmaṃ hanmi savānaram
verses.meaningZh: 以此、次复，我去吧、趣向菩提！向战斗，罗摩，因缘空寂大乐·离名相假立·无我大慈三昧，彼猴
verses.meaningEn: Hence, afterwards, then, from now, I go! proceed! to/for fought, Rāma, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & beyond nominal designation & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), he + monkey
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：agp_bi_u.htm（全书共 49519 行）

verses.iast: indrokto mātalī rāmaṃ rathasthaṃ pracakāra tam
verses.meaningZh: 因陀逻曰，勿表面地面佛母，罗摩，依止处，转载法句，彼（宾格）
verses.meaningEn: Śakra king of the gods + said, do not + surface of the ground, Rāma, standing on a chariot, forward + the word, him, that
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：agp_bi_u.htm（全书共 49519 行）

verses.iast: rāmaḥ śastraistamastraiś ca vavardha jalado yathā /AP 10.024ab
verses.meaningZh: 罗摩，本性寂静止息·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际以及增长福慧·最上真言离言说，云彩，犹如、如…所说，跛字门（第一义谛（paramārtha）·本不生体性），跋字门（解脱系缚大力（bala
verses.meaningEn: Rāma, primordial tranquil peace & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness and increasing, a cloud, just as, according to, ultimate truth (paramārtha) — primordial non-arising, spiritual strength freeing bonds (bala) — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：agp_bi_u.htm（全书共 49519 行）

verses.iast: kṛṣṇaścolūkhale baddho dāmnā vyagrayaśodayā
verses.meaningZh: 造作离相·六度满行清净·离诸诤论无诤，带子、丁字裤，施度调伏·无我大慈三昧·离名相假立，不包·美称·慈
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās & conflict-free peace (vocative invocation), strap, thong, generosity & self-mastery & selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation, separate + sympathy
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：agp_bi_u.htm（全书共 49519 行）

verses.iast: vṛndāvanagataḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kāliyaṃ yamunāhradāt
verses.meaningZh: 神圣林子由趣往，黑面，造作离相·离一切相无相·一乘如实之道，江河从小海
verses.meaningEn: Of a sacred grove + from going in or to, kṛṣṇaḥ, freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks & supreme vehicle of awakening, of river + from pool
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：agp_bi_u.htm（全书共 49519 行）

verses.iast: māyāvatyā yayau kṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇo hṛṣṭo 'tha rukmiṇī
verses.meaningZh: 勿·乃至·疾速，一乘如实之道，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，黑面，依止处、安装，尔时、次复吉祥启白，具庄严具黄金、黄金佛母
verses.meaningEn: Do not + how + hastening, supreme vehicle of awakening (imperative seal), dark-blue, black, kṛṣṇo, standing on end, erect, now, thereupon, auspiciously, goddess possessing ornament of gold
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：agp_bi_u.htm（全书共 49519 行）

verses.iast: śrutvā tu nāradāt kṛṣṇaḥ pradyumnabalabhadravān
verses.meaningZh: 听已，然而、而、实则，从人与子，黑面，天神喜爱·种类生类·液
verses.meaningEn: Having to listen, but, indeed, moreover, from or of myth, kṛṣṇaḥ, of the god of love + a kind of insect + fluid
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：agp_bi_u.htm（全书共 49519 行）

verses.iast: śivādyaiḥ pūjito viṣṇuḥ soniruddha uṣādiyuk
verses.meaningZh: 以诸寂静饭食，所恭敬，遍入，一切诸谛圆满·离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢，六度满行清净·施度调伏·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Kind + by, honored, viṣṇuḥ, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust, perfection of the six pāramitās & generosity & self-mastery & supreme vehicle of awakening
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：agp_bi_u.htm（全书共 49519 行）

verses.iast: uttarāyaṇamīkṣaṃś ca dhyāyan viṣṇuṃ stavan sthitaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道以及怀念假定今日，遍入，一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·最上真言离言说，立
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening and think of + suppose now, thousands with names containing prabha, and also containing Viṣṇu, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech, standing, abiding, remaining
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：agp_bi_u.htm（全书共 49519 行）

verses.iast: pāṇḍavāḥ sātyakiḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sapta muktā na cāpare
verses.meaningZh: 狮子男，座儿，黑面，七（七佛，真珠，不、非、无，妙行迁变空·第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Pāṇḍavāḥ, patron, kṛṣṇaḥ, seven, pearl, not, non-, awakened conduct beyond flux & ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：agp_bi_u.htm（全书共 49519 行）

verses.iast: prakṛtiṃ puruṣaṃ viṣṇuḥ praviśyākṣobhayattataḥ
verses.meaningZh: 自然本性，补卢衫，遍入，转载·闢·凝固·躁动·凡所…者·由伊人
verses.meaningEn: Told the occurrence to the, man, viṣṇuḥ, forward + settle + freeze + shaking + whatever + from stem of he
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：agp_bi_u.htm（全书共 49519 行）

verses.iast: ayanantasya tāḥ pūrvantena nārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 一乘如实之道·离名相假立·真如实际，多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·远离寂静周遍·涅槃除障点证入），圆满充盈·第一义谛，那罗延，由忆持、回首
verses.meaningEn: Supreme vehicle of awakening & beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — expansive quiescence with nirvāṇic visarga release, fulfilling (by spiritual power), Narayana, from remember
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：agp_bi_u.htm（全书共 49519 行）

verses.iast: sanatkumāraṃ rudrañca sasarja krodhasambhavam
verses.meaningZh: 普施童子，清净离诸尘垢·施度调伏·圣智通达，彼龙卷，忿三婆吠
verses.meaningEn: The eternal youth, of a Ṛṣi, stainless purity free from dust & generosity & self-mastery & non-dual wisdom awareness, he + turner, wrath + giving rise to
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：agp_bi_u.htm（全书共 49519 行）

verses.iast: prācīnavarhiṣaṃ śukraṃ gayaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vrajājinau
verses.meaningZh: 第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·妙行迁变空，金星，房子、家庭，深青黑、威猛黑蓝色，折叠·种姓·船
verses.meaningEn: Ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & awakened conduct beyond flux, clear, bright, pure, white, house, household, family, of a Ṛṣi , of a people, dark-blue, black, fold + running or fighting match + of of
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：agp_bi_u.htm（全书共 49519 行）

verses.iast: āsan viṣṇuś ca śakraś ca tvaṣṭā dhātā tathāryamā
verses.meaningZh: 口门，最上真言离言说·六度满行清净·离诸诤论无诤以及本性寂静止息·造作离相·清净离诸尘垢以及真如实际·最上真言离言说·六度满行清净，驮架子，如是狱王
verses.meaningEn: Mouth, jaws, supreme ineffable speech & perfection of the six pāramitās & conflict-free peace and primordial tranquil peace & freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust and immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech & perfection of the six pāramitās, dha + frame, thus + holder
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：agp_bi_u.htm（全书共 49519 行）

verses.iast: pāvakaḥ pavamānobhūcchuciḥ svāhāgnijobhavat /AP 20.016ab
verses.meaningZh: 簸嚩句，第一义谛·最上真言离言说·无我大慈三昧，一切诸谛圆满·最上真言离言说·因缘空寂大乐，跛字门（第一义谛（paramārtha）·本不生体性），跋字门（解脱系缚大力（bala
verses.meaningEn: Pavaka, ultimate truth & supreme ineffable speech & selfless great loving-kindness, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme ineffable speech & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, ultimate truth (paramārtha) — primordial non-arising, spiritual strength freeing bonds (bala) — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：agp_bi_u.htm（全书共 49519 行）

verses.iast: samastaparivārāya acyutāya namo yajet
verses.meaningZh: 向广收眷属，向坚固，归命，一乘如实之道·生起不可得·尊胜·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Joined + to, to/for unshaken, firm, imperishable, homage to supreme vehicle of awakening & transcending birth & victorious & immutable Suchness
verses.tangNoteZh: GRETIL 梵文原典档案：agp_bi_u.htm（全书共 49519 行）
